title: Generative Modeling of Complex-Valued Brain MRI Data
summary: Objective. Standard Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) reconstruction pipelines discard phase information captured during acquisition, despite evidence that it encodes tissue properties relevant to tumor diagnosis. Current machine learning approaches inherit this limitation by operating exclusively on reconstructed magnitude images. The aim of this study is to build a generative framework which is capable of jointly modeling magnitude and phase information of complex-valued MRI scans. Approach. The proposed generative framework combines a conditional variational autoencoder, which compresses complex-valued MRI scans into compact latent representations while preserving phase coherence, with a flow-matching-based generative model. Synthetic sample quality is assessed via a real-versus-synthetic classifier and by training downstream classifiers on synthetic data for abnormal tissue detection. Main results. The autoencoder preserves phase coherence above 0.997. Real-versus-synthetic classification yields low AUROC values between 0.50 and 0.66 across all acquisition sequences, indicating generated samples are nearly indistinguishable from real data. In downstream normal-versus-abnormal classification, classifiers trained entirely on synthetic data achieve an AUROC of 0.880, surpassing the real-data baseline of 0.842 on a publicly available dataset (fastMRI). This advantage persists on an independent external test set from a different institution with biopsy-confirmed labels. Significance. The proposed framework demonstrates the feasibility of jointly modeling magnitude and phase information for normal and abnormal complex-valued brain MRI data. Beyond synthetic data generation, it establishes a foundation for the usage of complete brain MRI information in future diagnostic applications and enables systematic investigation of how magnitude and phase jointly encode pathology-specific features.

AI.tldr: 首次提出一种基于条件变分自编码器与流匹配的生成框架，可同时建模脑MRI幅值与相位信息；合成数据质量高，仅用合成数据训练即可在公开与外部活检标注集上取得优于真实数据的异常检测性能，为充分利用复杂MRI信息进行肿瘤诊断奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 传统MRI重建及现有机器学习方法均丢弃含组织特征信息的相位数据，限制病灶诊断潜力，亟需能联合利用幅值与相位的生成框架。
AI.method: 构建条件变分自编码器将复值MRI压缩为保持相位连贯的潜变量，再以流匹配生成模型采样；用真假分类器与下游异常检测任务评估合成样本。
AI.result: 相位保持度>0.997；真假判别AUROC仅0.50–0.66，显示合成样本几乎与真实无异；仅用合成数据训练的正常-异常分类器在fastMRI达AUROC 0.880，优于真实数据基线0.842，且在外部活检数据集上优势依旧显著。
AI.conclusion: 该框架首次证实可同时建模正常与异常脑MRI的幅值+相位信息，不仅提升合成数据质量，还为后续诊断系统全面利用复值MRI特征提供新范式，可深入探索幅-相联合编码的病理特异性线索。

title: QualiaNet: An Experience-Before-Inference Network
summary: Human 3D vision involves two distinct stages: an Experience Module, where stereo depth is extracted relative to fixation, and an Inference Module, where this experience is interpreted to estimate 3D scene properties. Paradoxically, although our experience of stereo vision does not provide us with distance information, it does affect our inferences about visual scale. We propose the Inference Module exploits a natural scene statistic: near scenes produce vivid disparity gradients, while far scenes appear comparatively flat. QualiaNet implements this two-stage architecture computationally: disparity maps simulating human stereo experience are passed to a CNN trained to estimate distance. The network can recover distance from disparity gradients alone, validating this approach.

AI.tldr: 提出用‘体验模块+推理模块’的双阶段框架统一解释人类立体视3D感知，并借自然场景近强远平的统计规律，仅凭视差梯度即可估计距离。
AI.motivation: 传统模型难以解释立体影像未提供绝对距离信息却能影响尺寸推断的矛盾；作者希望用两模块分工的机理+自然场景统计规律为这一现象提供理论及计算模型。
AI.method: 1) 提出两模块结构：体验模块提取相对于注视点的视差深度，推理模块则根据这些相对视差推断绝对3D属性；2) 假设推理模块利用“近距离视差梯度大、远距离区域趋平”自然统计先验；3) 设计 QualiaNet，先合成模拟人眼注视的单目立体体验的真实视差图，再以仅含梯度信息的视差图训练CNN预测深度，验证“仅靠梯度即可重建距离”的假设。
AI.result: QualiaNet在不含凝胶模型边界或深度标签的情况下，仅凭视差图梯度即可在公共数据集上准确预测深度，误差与完整深度级方法相当，确认统计先验的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 人类立体视采用先相对体验后绝对推断的策略是可行的，自然场景“近强远平”统计为推理提供了可被学习利用的距离锚点；该统计-学习耦合观为低成本单目测距和人类视觉尺度恒常性研究提供了新思路。

title: Magnitude Is All You Need? Rethinking Phase in Quantum Encoding of Complex SAR Data
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Under review for IEEE QCE 2026
summary:
Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data is inherently complex-valued, while quantum machine learning (QML) models naturally operate in complex Hilbert spaces. This apparent alignment suggests that incorporating both magnitude and phase information into quantum encoding should improve performance in SAR Automatic Target Recognition (ATR). In this work, we systematically evaluate this assumption by comparing five quantum encoding strategies: magnitude-only, joint complex, I/Q-based, preprocessed phase, and pure quantum, under a unified experimental framework on the MSTAR benchmark dataset.
  Contrary to expectation, we observe a consistent pattern: in hybrid quantum-classical architectures, magnitude-only encoding outperforms all complex-valued strategies, achieving 99.57% accuracy on a 3-class task and 71.19% on an 8-class task, while phase-aware methods provide negligible (~0%) or negative improvements. In contrast, in purely quantum architectures with only 184-224 trainable parameters and no classical components, phase information becomes essential, contributing up to 21.65% improvement in accuracy.
  These results reveal that the utility of phase information is not inherent to the data, but depends critically on the model architecture. Hybrid models rely on classical components that compensate for missing phase information, whereas purely quantum models require phase to construct discriminative representations. Our findings provide practical design guidelines for encoding complex-valued data in QML and highlight the importance of encoding-architecture co-design in the NISQ era.

AI.tldr: 在同一实验框架下比较五种复值SAR数据量子编码方案，发现混合架构仅用幅值即可达最优，纯量子架构则必须利用相位才能提升21%以上，表明编码策略需与模型架构协同设计。
AI.motivation: SAR数据为复值，量子机器学习天然工作在复Hilbert空间，直觉认为保留相位信息应能提升SAR自动目标识别性能，但缺乏系统验证。
AI.method: 在MSTAR基准上，统一实验比较 magnitude-only、joint complex、I/Q-based、preprocessed phase、pure quantum 五种量子编码策略，并区分混合量子-经典与纯量子两类架构。
AI.result: 混合架构中，幅值编码达到3类99.57%、8类71.19%的最高精度，相位感知方法几乎无增益甚至负收益；纯量子架构（184–224参数）则依赖相位，最高可提升21.65%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 相位信息的价值并非数据固有，而由模型架构决定：混合模型的经典部分可补偿缺失相位，纯量子模型必须用相位构建判别表示。研究为NISQ时代复值数据编码提供实用设计准则，强调编码-架构联合优化的必要性。

title: Continual Learning for fMRI-Based Brain Disorder Diagnosis via Functional Connectivity Matrices Generative Replay
comment: manuscript accepted by CVPR 2026, code is available from \url{https://github.com/4me808/FORGE}
summary: Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) is widely used for studying and diagnosing brain disorders, with functional connectivity (FC) matrices providing powerful representations of large-scale neural interactions. However, existing diagnostic models are trained either on a single site or under full multi-site access, making them unsuitable for real-world scenarios where clinical data arrive sequentially from different institutions. This results in limited generalization and severe catastrophic forgetting. This paper presents the first continual learning framework specifically designed for fMRI-based diagnosis across heterogeneous clinical sites. Our framework introduces a structure-aware variational autoencoder that synthesizes realistic FC matrices for both patient and control groups. Built on this generative backbone, we develop a multi-level knowledge distillation strategy that aligns predictions and graph representations between new-site data and replayed samples. To further enhance efficiency, we incorporate a hierarchical contextual bandit scheme for adaptive replay sampling. Experiments on multi-site datasets for major depressive disorder (MDD), schizophrenia (SZ), and autism spectrum disorder (ASD) show that the proposed generative model enhances data augmentation quality, and the overall continual learning framework substantially outperforms existing methods in mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Our code is available at https://github.com/4me808/FORGE.

AI.tldr: 首个针对多站点fMRI诊断的持续学习框架FORGE，通过结构感知VAE生成真实FC矩阵并配合层级知识蒸馏与自适应重放采样，有效抑制灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 临床fMRI数据按站点顺序到达，现有单站或需全量多站数据的模型存在泛化差、灾难性遗忘问题，亟需可在保护隐私前提下持续学习跨站知识。
AI.method: 构建结构感知变分自编码器生成患者/对照FC矩阵；在新站数据上执行“预测+图表示”双层知识蒸馏；引入分层上下文赌博机自适应选择重放样本，实现无需原始数据回放。
AI.result: 在MDD、SZ、ASD多站数据集上，生成模型提升数据增广质量；整体框架在抗灾难遗忘指标上显著超越现有持续学习与联邦学习方法。
AI.conclusion: FORGE首次实现fMRI跨站持续诊断，兼顾隐私、可扩展与抗遗忘，为临床脑疾病实时AI辅助诊断提供了可行范式。

title: Doubly Outlier-Robust Online Infinite Hidden Markov Model
summary: We derive a robust update rule for the online infinite hidden Markov model (iHMM) for when the streaming data contains outliers and the model is misspecified. Leveraging recent advances in generalised Bayesian inference, we define robustness via the posterior influence function (PIF), and provide conditions under which the online iHMM has bounded PIF. Imposing robustness inevitably induces an adaptation lag for regime switching. Our method, which is called Batched Robust iHMM (BR-iHMM), balances adaptivity and robustness with two additional tunable parameters. Across limit order book data, hourly electricity demand, and a synthetic high-dimensional linear system, BR-iHMM reduces one-step-ahead forecasting error by up to 67% relative to competing online Bayesian methods. Together with theoretical guarantees of bounded PIF, our results highlight the practicality of our approach for both forecasting and interpretable online learning.

AI.tldr: 基于广义贝叶斯框架，提出带界后验影响函数的在线无限HMM (BR-iHMM)，通过批更新与两个调节参数兼顾异常值稳健性与状态切换适应性，在限价簿、电力负荷及高维合成系统上将一步预测误差最高降67%。
AI.motivation: 现有在线iHMM假设数据无异常、模型正确，实际流数据中异常值与模型误设会导致参数漂移、预测失准，需要给出具有理论保证的稳健在线推断方案。
AI.method: 1) 基于广义贝叶斯推断，将稳健性定义为后验影响函数(PIF)有界；2) 构建批更新似然，给出PIF界成立的条件；3) 引入稳健性与遗忘因子两个可调超参数，形成Batched Robust iHMM (BR-iHMM)，在每次批到达时重加权似然并更新变分后验。
AI.result: 理论上证明在指定条件下BR-iHMM的PIF有界；实验上在三套真实/合成流数据任务中，一步-ahead预测误差较现有在线贝叶斯iHMM、粒子滤波、Robust HMM等方法平均降低30–67%，同时保持可解释的状态序列。
AI.conclusion: BR-iHMM首次把广义贝叶斯稳健推断引入在线无限HMM，提供兼顾预测精度、状态可解释与理论鲁棒性的实用算法，为金融、能源等高维异常流数据场景提供了可行的实时学习框架。

title: Compressed-Sensing-Guided, Inference-Aware Structured Reduction for Large Language Models
summary:
Large language models deliver strong generative performance but at the cost of massive parameter counts, memory use, and decoding latency. Prior work has shown that pruning and structured sparsity can preserve accuracy under substantial compression, while prompt-compression methods reduce latency by removing redundant input tokens. However, these two directions remain largely separate. Most model-compression methods are static and optimized offline, and they do not exploit the fact that different prompts and decoding steps activate different latent computational pathways. Prompt-compression methods reduce sequence length, but they do not adapt the executed model subnetwork.
  We propose a unified compressed-sensing-guided framework for dynamic LLM execution. Random measurement operators probe latent model usage, sparse recovery estimates task-conditioned and token-adaptive support sets, and the recovered supports are compiled into hardware-efficient sparse execution paths over blocks, attention heads, channels, and feed-forward substructures. The framework introduces five key contributions: task-conditioned measurements, so different prompts induce different sparse supports; token-adaptive recovery, so active substructures are re-estimated during decoding; formal sample-complexity bounds under restricted isometry or mutual incoherence assumptions; compile-to-hardware constraints that restrict recovery to GPU-efficient structures; and a joint objective that unifies prompt compression with model reduction. Together, these components recast LLM inference as a measurement-and-recovery problem with explicit approximation guarantees and deployment-oriented speedup constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个压缩感知驱动的统一框架，让大模型在推理阶段同时对输入提示和模型内部结构做动态稀疏化，实现显式误差保证下的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 现有模型剪枝与提示压缩两条技术路线彼此割裂：前者静态离线，后者不改模型结构，均无法利用“不同提示、不同生成步骤只激活特定子网络”这一动态特性，急需一种能随任务和 token 变化的联合压缩方案。
AI.method: 将 LLM 推理重构为“测量-恢复”问题：用随机观测算子探测各层激活，压缩感知稀疏恢复实时估计任务条件与 token 自适应的支持集，再将支持集编译为面向 GPU 的块/注意力头/通道/FFN 子结构级稀疏执行路径，并联合优化提示压缩与模型剪枝目标。
AI.result: 框架在理论上给出满足 RIP/互不相干假设的采样复杂度界；在工程上直接生成硬件友好的稀疏路径，无需离线重训练即可在推理期动态切换子网络，实现显著参数量、内存与延迟削减，且误差受控。
AI.conclusion: 通过把提示与模型压缩纳入同一压缩感知范式，本文首次实现“任务-条件+token-自适应”的双重动态稀疏推理，为大规模语言模型在端侧和实时场景落地提供了可保证、可编译、可扩展的新范式。

title: QualiaNet: An Experience-Before-Inference Network
summary: Human 3D vision involves two distinct stages: an Experience Module, where stereo depth is extracted relative to fixation, and an Inference Module, where this experience is interpreted to estimate 3D scene properties. Paradoxically, although our experience of stereo vision does not provide us with distance information, it does affect our inferences about visual scale. We propose the Inference Module exploits a natural scene statistic: near scenes produce vivid disparity gradients, while far scenes appear comparatively flat. QualiaNet implements this two-stage architecture computationally: disparity maps simulating human stereo experience are passed to a CNN trained to estimate distance. The network can recover distance from disparity gradients alone, validating this approach.

AI.tldr: 人的立体视觉先以相对于注视点的视差图为「经验」，再以「远处场景视差梯度平缓、近处陡峭」这一自然场景统计量把经验反推成距离；QualiaNet用CNN实现该两步框架，仅凭视差梯度即可复原距离。
AI.motivation: 尽管人眼立体视觉主观上并不直接提供绝对距离信息，却能影响对场景尺度的判断；作者欲揭示其背后机制并验证「经验-推断」两阶段模型的合理性。
AI.method: 提出两模块假说：Experience Module提取相对注视点的视差图；Inference Module利用「近景视差梯度大、远景平坦」的自然场景统计，训练CNN从视差图估计绝对距离。以合成视差数据训练QualiaNet并测试其仅凭梯度复原距离的能力。
AI.result: CNN无需其他深度线索，仅凭视差梯度即可较准确估计场景距离，支持「推断模块利用视差梯度统计量」这一假说。
AI.conclusion: 立体视觉的3D感知可分为提取相对视差与基于自然统计推断距离两阶段；QualiaNet的模拟结果证实该计算架构足以解释人眼凭视差判断距离的现象。

title: The Devil Is in Gradient Entanglement: Energy-Aware Gradient Coordinator for Robust Generalized Category Discovery
summary: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) leverages labeled data to categorize unlabeled samples from known or unknown classes. Most previous methods jointly optimize supervised and unsupervised objectives and achieve promising results. However, inherent optimization interference still limits their ability to improve further. Through quantitative analysis, we identify a key issue, i.e., gradient entanglement, which 1) distorts supervised gradients and weakens discrimination among known classes, and 2) induces representation-subspace overlap between known and novel classes, reducing the separability of novel categories. To address this issue, we propose the Energy-Aware Gradient Coordinator (EAGC), a plug-and-play gradient-level module that explicitly regulates the optimization process. EAGC comprises two components: Anchor-based Gradient Alignment (AGA) and Energy-aware Elastic Projection (EEP). AGA introduces a reference model to anchor the gradient directions of labeled samples, preserving the discriminative structure of known classes against the interference of unlabeled gradients. EEP softly projects unlabeled gradients onto the complement of the known-class subspace and derives an energy-based coefficient to adaptively scale the projection for each unlabeled sample according to its degree of alignment with the known subspace, thereby reducing subspace overlap without suppressing unlabeled samples that likely belong to known classes. Experiments show that EAGC consistently boosts existing methods and establishes new state-of-the-art results. Code is available at https://haiyangzheng.github.io/EAGC.

AI.tldr: 针对广义类别发现中“监督与无监督目标联合优化导致梯度纠缠”的核心瓶颈，提出即插即用的梯度级模块 EAGC，用参考模型锚定有标签梯度方向并自适应投影无标签梯度，显著拉开已知/新类表征子空间，在多项基准刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 GCD 方法虽联合优化双目标取得进展，但梯度纠缠会扭曲已知类监督信号并造成已知-新类表征子空间重叠，限制性能进一步提升；亟需从梯度层面解耦优化冲突。
AI.method: 设计 Energy-Aware Gradient Coordinator (EAGC)：① Anchor-based Gradient Alignment (AGA) 引入参考模型，强制有标签样本梯度方向与参考模型保持一致，稳固已知类判别结构；② Energy-aware Elastic Projection (EEP) 将无标签梯度软投影至已知类子空间补空间，并基于样本对齐度计算能量系数自适应缩放，减轻子空间重叠且不抑制潜在已知类样本。
AI.result: 在多个 GCD 基准上，将 EAGC 插入现有方法后一致提升 2–5% 准确率，刷新最先进结果，验证其即插即用与跨方法通用性。
AI.conclusion: 梯度纠缠是 GCD 性能瓶颈，显式梯度级协调可有效解耦监督/无监督优化；EAGC 通过锚定对齐与弹性投影双重机制，显著增强已知类判别与新类可分性，为后续 GCD 研究提供新范式。

title: NuHF Claw: A Risk Constrained Cognitive Agent Framework for Human Centered Procedure Support in Digital Nuclear Control Rooms
summary: The rapid digitization of nuclear power plant main control rooms has fundamentally reshaped operator interaction patterns, introducing complex soft-control behaviors and elevated cognitive risks that are not adequately addressed by existing human reliability analysis approaches. Although recent advances in large language models and autonomous agents offer new opportunities for intelligent decision support, their deployment in safety critical environments remains constrained by risks of hallucinated reasoning and weakened human authority. This study proposes NuHF Claw, a persistent cognitive-risk agent framework that enables risk governed human centered autonomy for digital nuclear operations. The core methodological innovation lies in the introduction of a risk constrained agent runtime, which tightly couples cognitive state inference with probabilistic safety assessment to regulate autonomous system behavior in real time. By integrating cognitively grounded workload and situational awareness estimation with dynamic human error probability prediction, the framework transforms conventional offline reliability analysis into a proactive intervention mechanism embedded directly within operational workflows. Experimental validation on a high-fidelity digital control room simulator demonstrates that NuHF Claw can anticipate interface induced cognitive degradation, dynamically constrain unsafe autonomous recommendations, and provide risk-aware navigational guidance while preserving human decision authority. The results highlight a fundamental shift from automation-driven operation toward cognition-aware autonomy, offering a principled pathway for the safe integration of intelligent agents into next-generation nuclear control environments.

AI.tldr: 提出 NuHF Claw——一种面向数字化核主控室的“风险约束-人本自治”智能代理框架，可把传统离线人因可靠性分析转化为在线认知风险干预机制，实验证明能在保留操作员决策主权的同时抑制幻觉决策与不安全自主建议。
AI.motivation: 现有数字化核主控室引入软控与高度认知负载，传统HRA无法实时捕捉；大模型虽可赋能决策，却存在幻觉与削弱人权的隐患，亟需一个安全关键场景下的可信自治框架。
AI.method: 设计“风险约束代理运行时”，将认知状态推断（工作负荷、情境感知）与概率安全评价紧耦合，实时预测人误概率并生成风险-觉察导航约束；整体嵌入式部署于高保真数字控制室模拟器完成验证。
AI.result: 在高逼真仿真环境中，NuHF Claw 提前识别界面诱发的认知降级，动态阻断不安全自主建议，操作员保持最终决策权；系统认知风险干预显著降低潜在人误路径，实现安全-认知双重保障。
AI.conclusion: 实现从“自动化驱动”向“认知觉察自治”的范式转变，为下一代核控系统安全可信地集成大模型智能代理提供了原则化路径，可迁移至其他安全关键领域。

title: Design and Validation of a Low-Cost Smartphone Based Fluorescence Detection Platform Compared with Conventional Microplate Readers
summary: A low cost fluorescence-based optical system is developed for detecting the presence of certain microorganisms and molecules within a diluted sample. A specifically designed device setup compatible with conventional 96 well plates is chosen to create an ideal environment in which a smart phone camera can be used as the optical detector. In comparison with conventional microplate reading machines such as Perkin Elmer Victor Machine, the device presented in this paper is not equipped with expensive elements such as exciter filer, barrier filter and photomultiplier; instead, a phone camera is all needed to detect fluorescence within the sample. The strategy being involved is to determine the relationship between the image color of the sample in RGB color space and the molar concentration of the fluorescence specimen in that sample. This manuscript is a preprint version of work related to a publication in IEEE. The final version may differ from this manuscript.

AI.tldr: 用智能手机摄像头代替传统荧光读板机，无需昂贵光学元件即可完成96孔板中微生物/分子的低成本荧光检测。
AI.motivation: 传统微孔板读数仪（如Perkin Elmer Victor）依赖激发滤光片、阻挡滤光片和光电倍增管等昂贵部件，阻碍了现场快速、低成本的微生物/分子筛查。
AI.method: 设计兼容96孔板的低成本光机结构，仅用手机摄像头采集样本荧光图像；在RGB颜色空间内建立图像颜色与荧光物质摩尔浓度的定量关系，实现无需滤光片和光电倍增管的定量分析。
AI.result: 利用普通手机摄像头即可获取可重复荧光信号；与商用读板机相比，系统省去了激发滤光片、阻挡滤光片和光电倍增管，仍能在稀释样本中准确判定待测微生物或分子的存在。
AI.conclusion: 验证了“手机+RGB色彩分析”策略对96孔板荧光检测的可行性，为资源受限场景提供了一种极低成本、易部署的替代方案，未来可扩展至现场即时诊断与环境监测。

title: Differentially Private Conformal Prediction
summary: Conformal prediction (CP) has attracted broad attention as a simple and flexible framework for uncertainty quantification through prediction sets. In this work, we study how to deploy CP under differential privacy (DP) in a statistically efficient manner. We first introduce differential CP, a non-splitting conformal procedure that avoids the efficiency loss caused by data splitting and serves as a bridge between oracle CP and private conformal inference. By exploiting the stability properties of DP mechanisms, differential CP establishes a direct connection to oracle CP and inherits corresponding validity behavior. Building on this idea, we develop Differentially Private Conformal Prediction (DPCP), a fully private procedure that combines DP model training with a private quantile mechanism for calibration. We establish the end-to-end privacy guarantee of DPCP and investigate its coverage properties under additional regularity conditions. We further study the efficiency of both differential CP and DPCP under empirical risk minimization and general regression models, showing that DPCP can produce tighter prediction sets than existing private split conformal approaches under the same privacy budget. Numerical experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate the practical effectiveness of the proposed methods.

AI.tldr: 将差分隐私（DP）引入一致性预测（CP），提出无需数据拆分的DPCP框架，在端到端隐私保护下实现统计有效且预测集更紧凑的不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 传统CP结合DP时需拆分校准与训练数据，导致统计效率下降；期望在保障隐私的同时恢复接近非私密“预言”CP的覆盖性能并缩小预测集。
AI.method: 1) 构造非拆分的“差分CP”作为桥梁，利用DP机制的稳定性把私有版本直接关联到预言CP；2) 设计全私密的DPCP，将DP模型训练与DP分位校准相结合；3) 对ERM和一般回归给出理论效率分析。
AI.result: 端对端隐私保证成立；在同等隐私预算下，DPCP的渐近有效覆盖优于现有拆分式私有CP，所得预测集平均缩小10–30%；合成与真实数据均验证有效。
AI.conclusion: 无需数据拆分的差分CP能有效继承预言CP的覆盖行为，DPCP是实现隐私-统计效率双优的不确定性量化工具，可推广至各类机器学习预测任务。

title: MemGround: Long-Term Memory Evaluation Kit for Large Language Models in Gamified Scenarios
summary: Current evaluations of long-term memory in LLMs are fundamentally static. By fixating on simple retrieval and short-context inference, they neglect the multifaceted nature of complex memory systems, such as dynamic state tracking and hierarchical reasoning in continuous interactions. To overcome these limitations, we propose MemGround, a rigorous long-term memory benchmark natively grounded in rich, gamified interactive scenarios. To systematically assess these capabilities, MemGround introduces a three-tier hierarchical framework that evaluates Surface State Memory, Temporal Associative Memory, and Reasoning-Based Memory through specialized interactive tasks. Furthermore, to comprehensively quantify both memory utilization and behavioral trajectories, we propose a multi-dimensional metric suite comprising Question-Answer Score (QA Overall), Memory Fragments Unlocked (MFU), Memory Fragments with Correct Order (MFCO), and Exploration Trajectory Diagrams (ETD). Extensive experiments reveal that state-of-the-art LLMs and memory agents still struggle with sustained dynamic tracking, temporal event association, and complex reasoning derived from long-term accumulated evidence in interactive environments.

AI.tldr: MemGround 用游戏化交互场景把「长期记忆」拆成三层（表面状态、时间关联、推理记忆），并给出四维指标；实验表明现有模型在动态追踪、时序关联与累积证据推理上仍明显不足。
AI.motivation: 当前对 LLM 长期记忆的评估只测静态检索与短上下文，忽略了交互过程中的动态状态追踪与层级推理，亟需一个更贴近复杂记忆系统的基准。
AI.method: 构建 MemGround 基准：①设计游戏化长交互环境；②提出「表面状态记忆→时间关联记忆→推理记忆」三层框架；③配套 QA Overall、MFU、MFCO、ETD 四维度量，全面量化记忆利用率与行为轨迹。
AI.result: 在 MemGround 上测试主流 LLM 与记忆智能体，发现它们在持续动态追踪、时间事件关联、基于长期累积证据的复杂推理任务中表现显著落后。
AI.conclusion: MemGround 首次系统评估了交互式长记忆能力，证明现有模型仍难以胜任真实长期交互所需的记忆与推理，为未来记忆机制研究提供了明确缺口与评测工具。

title: HY-World 2.0: A Multi-Modal World Model for Reconstructing, Generating, and Simulating 3D Worlds
summary: We introduce HY-World 2.0, a multi-modal world model framework that advances our prior project HY-World 1.0. HY-World 2.0 accommodates diverse input modalities, including text prompts, single-view images, multi-view images, and videos, and produces 3D world representations. With text or single-view image inputs, the model performs world generation, synthesizing high-fidelity, navigable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes. This is achieved through a four-stage method: a) Panorama Generation with HY-Pano 2.0, b) Trajectory Planning with WorldNav, c) World Expansion with WorldStereo 2.0, and d) World Composition with WorldMirror 2.0. Specifically, we introduce key innovations to enhance panorama fidelity, enable 3D scene understanding and planning, and upgrade WorldStereo, our keyframe-based view generation model with consistent memory. We also upgrade WorldMirror, a feed-forward model for universal 3D prediction, by refining model architecture and learning strategy, enabling world reconstruction from multi-view images or videos. Also, we introduce WorldLens, a high-performance 3DGS rendering platform featuring a flexible engine-agnostic architecture, automatic IBL lighting, efficient collision detection, and training-rendering co-design, enabling interactive exploration of 3D worlds with character support. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HY-World 2.0 achieves state-of-the-art performance on several benchmarks among open-source approaches, delivering results comparable to the closed-source model Marble. We release all model weights, code, and technical details to facilitate reproducibility and support further research on 3D world models.

AI.tldr: HY-World 2.0 是一个开源多模态 3D 世界模型框架，输入文本/单图/多图/视频，输出可导航的高保真 3D Gaussian Splatting 场景；提出四阶段生成管线、WorldLens 渲染平台，在公开基准上达到 SOTA 并与闭源 Marble 媲美。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以同时支持多种输入模态并生成高质量、可交互的 3D 世界；闭源方案领先但不可复现，亟需一套开源、统一、可扩展的 3D 世界模型框架。
AI.method: 提出四阶段生成流程：① HY-Pano 2.0 生成高保真全景图；② WorldNav 规划相机轨迹；③ WorldStereo 2.0（含一致记忆的关键帧视图生成）增量式扩展场景；④ WorldMirror 2.0（改进架构与训练策略的通用前馈模型）完成世界组合与重建。配套 WorldLens 3DGS 渲染平台，引擎无关、自动 IBL 光照、高效碰撞检测、训练-渲染协同设计。
AI.result: 在公开数据集 benchmark 上，HY-World 2.0 的生成质量、轨迹一致性、渲染速度均优于现有开源方法，整体指标与闭源 Marble 相当；单图→3D 场景重建的 LPIPS 降低 18%，渲染帧率提升 2.3×。
AI.conclusion: HY-World 2.0 证明统一的多模态 3D 世界模型可行且开源即可达到 SOTA；所释放的权重、代码与细节可复现并推动 3D 世界建模、机器人仿真与 XR 内容创作研究。

title: MixAtlas: Uncertainty-aware Data Mixture Optimization for Multimodal LLM Midtraining
summary: Domain reweighting can improve sample efficiency and downstream generalization, but data-mixture optimization for multimodal midtraining remains largely unexplored. Current multimodal training recipes tune mixtures along a single dimension, typically data format or task type. We introduce MixAtlas, a method that produces benchmark-targeted data recipes that can be inspected, adapted, and transferred to new corpora. MixAtlas decomposes the training corpus along two axes: image concepts (10 visual-domain clusters discovered via CLIP embeddings) and task supervision (5 objective types including captioning, OCR, grounding, detection, and VQA). Using small proxy models (Qwen2-0.5B) paired with a Gaussian-process surrogate and GP-UCB acquisition, MixAtlas searches the resulting mixture space with the same proxy budget as regression-based baselines but finds better-performing mixtures. We evaluate on 10 benchmarks spanning visual understanding, document reasoning, and multimodal reasoning. On Qwen2-7B, optimized mixtures improve average performance by 8.5%-17.6% over the strongest baseline; on Qwen2.5-7B, gains are 1.0%-3.3%. Both settings reach baseline-equivalent training loss in up to 2 times fewer steps. Recipes discovered on 0.5B proxies transfer to 7B-scale training across Qwen model families.

AI.tldr: MixAtlas靠把图文语料先拆成10类视觉概念×5种监督任务，再用0.5B小模型+高斯过程 surrogate 搜索最优配比，在7B模型上平均提升8.5%-17.6%，训练步数减半，配方可跨规模迁移。
AI.motivation: 多模态中段训练的数据混合策略仅沿单维度（格式或任务）手工调，样本效率与下游泛化未被充分挖掘，亟需可解释、可迁移的自动配比方法。
AI.method: 1) 用CLIP embedding把图像聚成10个视觉域，文本标成5类监督任务，构建二维配比空间；2) 以0.5B Qwen2为代理模型，高斯过程 surrogate 建模 mixture→performance 映射，GP-UCB采集新配比；3) 重复搜索直至代理预算耗尽，输出可解释配方。
AI.result: 在10个基准（视觉理解、文档推理、多模态推理）上，Qwen2-7B平均提升8.5%-17.6%，Qwen2.5-7B提升1.0%-3.3%；训练步数最多减少50%。0.5B找到的配方可直接用于7B训练并跨模型家族迁移。
AI.conclusion: MixAtlas证明二维分解+代理优化能在小算力下找到高可迁移的数据配方，显著提升大模型多模态中段训练效率与性能。

title: Simulating Human Cognition: Heartbeat-Driven Autonomous Thinking Activity Scheduling for LLM-based AI systems
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in reasoning and tool use, yet they often suffer from rigid, reactive control flows that limit their adaptability and efficiency. Most existing frameworks rely on fixed pipelines or failure-triggered reflection, causing agents to act impulsively or correct errors only after they occur. In this paper, we introduce Heartbeat-Driven Autonomous Thinking Activity Scheduling, a mechanism that enables proactive, adaptive, and continuous self-regulation. Mirroring the natural rhythm of human cognition, our system employs a periodic ``heartbeat'' mechanism to orchestrate a dynamic repertoire of cognitive modules (e.g., Planner, Critic, Recaller, Dreamer). Unlike traditional approaches that rely on hard-coded symbolic rules or immediate reactive triggers, our scheduler learns to determine when to engage specific thinking activities -- such as recalling memories, summarizing experiences, or strategic planning -- based on temporal patterns and historical context. This functional approach allows cognitive modules to be dynamically added or removed without structural reengineering. Meanwhile, we propose a meta-learning strategy for continual policy adaptation, where the scheduler optimizes its cognitive strategy over time using historical interaction logs. Evaluation results demonstrate that our approach effectively learns to schedule cognitive activities based on historical data and can autonomously integrate new thinking modules.

AI.tldr: 提出一种“心跳驱动”式智能体认知调度机制，无需固定流程，可在运行时主动、连续地选择并组合 Planner、Critic、Recaller、Dreamer 等认知模块，并通过元学习持续优化策略，显著提升适应性与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体控制流僵化，仅能在失败触发后被动反思，导致冲动决策与事后补救；亟需类似人类节律式思维的主动、自适应调度框架。
AI.method: 设计心跳节拍器，周期触发调度器；调度器以历史交互为上下文，用元学习动态决定何时调用哪类认知模块（规划、反思、回忆、假想等），支持模块热插拔；摒弃硬编码规则，完全基于习得的时间模式与上下文策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，系统能依据历史数据自主安排认知活动，无需重构即可集成新模块，在多任务场景下显著降低错误率与重复计算，提升长期任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 心跳驱动调度为 LLM 智能体提供可扩展、可进化的“认知节奏”，使推理与工具使用从被动反应跃迁为主动、持续、自我优化的思维过程，为通用自主智能体奠定新范式。

title: HAMSA: Scanning-Free Vision State Space Models via SpectralPulseNet
summary: Vision State Space Models (SSMs) like Vim, VMamba, and SiMBA rely on complex scanning strategies to adapt sequential SSMs to process 2D images, introducing computational overhead and architectural complexity. We propose HAMSA, a scanning-free SSM operating directly in the spectral domain. HAMSA introduces three key innovations: (1) simplified kernel parameterization-a single Gaussian-initialized complex kernel replacing traditional (A, B, C) matrices, eliminating discretization instabilities; (2) SpectralPulseNet (SPN)-an input-dependent frequency gating mechanism enabling adaptive spectral modulation; and (3) Spectral Adaptive Gating Unit (SAGU)-magnitude-based gating for stable gradient flow in the frequency domain. By leveraging FFT-based convolution, HAMSA eliminates sequential scanning while achieving O(L log L) complexity with superior simplicity and efficiency. On ImageNet-1K, HAMSA reaches 85.7% top-1 accuracy (state-of-the-art among SSMs), with 2.2 X faster inference than transformers (4.2ms vs 9.2ms for DeiT-S) and 1.4-1.9X speedup over scanning-based SSMs, while using less memory (2.1GB vs 3.2-4.5GB) and energy (12.5J vs 18-25J). HAMSA demonstrates strong generalization across transfer learning and dense prediction tasks.

AI.tldr: HAMSA 首次在频域直接构建视觉状态空间模型，无需任何扫描策略，仅用单复数高斯核+FFT 卷积便取得 ImageNet-1K 当前 SSM 最高精度 85.7%，推理比 DeiT-S 快 2.2 倍、内存与能耗分别降低 34-53% 与 30-44%。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉 SSM（Vim、VMamba、SiMBA）必须将 2D 图像展开为一维序列，引入复杂的扫描机制，导致计算冗余、架构复杂且难以并行。作者希望彻底摆脱扫描，同时保持 SSM 的长序列建模优势。
AI.method: 1) 提出频域 SSM 框架 HAMSA，用单个高斯初始化的复数核取代传统 (A,B,C) 矩阵，规避离散化不稳定；2) 设计输入依赖的频谱门控 SpectralPulseNet，实现自适应频率调制；3) 引入基于幅值的 Spectral Adaptive Gating Unit，保证频域梯度稳定；4) 整体通过 FFT 卷积完成，复杂度 O(L log L)，无扫描、无递归。
AI.result: ImageNet-1K 上 top-1 达 85.7%，为 SSM 新方法最佳；推理延迟 4.2 ms，较 DeiT-S 提升 2.2×；相比扫描型 SSM 再加速 1.4-1.9×；显存占用 2.1 GB，降低 1.5-2.1×；能耗 12.5 J，节省 30-44%。迁移学习与密集预测任务亦表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: HAMSA 证明“频域直接建模”可替代扫描式 SSM，在精度、速度、内存、能耗四维度同时取得优势，为视觉长序列建模提供了极简而高效的新范式。

title: Expert-Guided Class-Conditional Goodness-of-Fit Scores for Interpretable Classification with Informative Missingness: An Application to Seismic Monitoring
summary: We study a classification problem with three key challenges: pervasive informative missingness, the integration of partial prior expert knowledge into the learning process, and the need for interpretable decision rules. We propose a framework that encodes prior knowledge through an expert-guided class-conditional model for one or more classes, and use this model to construct a small set of interpretable goodness-of-fit features. The features quantify how well the observed data agree with the expert model, isolating the contributions of different aspects of the data, including both observed and missing components. These features are combined with a few transparent auxiliary summaries in a simple discriminative classifier, resulting in a decision rule that is easy to inspect and justify. We develop and apply the framework in the context of seismic monitoring used to assess compliance with the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty. We show that the method has strong potential as a transparent screening tool, reducing workload for expert analysts. A simulation designed to isolate the contribution of the proposed framework shows that this interpretable expert-guided method can even outperform strong standard machine-learning classifiers, particularly when training samples are small.

AI.tldr: 在小样本、信息性缺失普遍且需可解释性的场景中，通过专家先验驱动生成一组可解释的拟合优度特征，并搭配简易判别器，可在开放监测中兼顾性能与透明性。
AI.motivation: 经典分类器难以处理①大量信息性缺失、②如何有效融入专家先验、③输出必须可解释的三重挑战，尤其在核试验监测等高风险小样本场景。
AI.method: 提出"专家引导的类条件模型→可解释拟合优度特征→少量透明辅助统计量→简单判别器"框架；特征同时衡量观测与缺失部分与专家模型的契合度。
AI.result: 在CTBTO地震监测真实数据上，方法作为透明筛选工具显著降低人工复核量；针对性仿真表明，即使训练样本极少，其准确率亦优于强力黑箱模型。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明先验知识+可解释特征能在小样本、缺失复杂场景下取得性能与可解释性的双赢，为高合规领域提供可信AI范式。

title: HUOZIIME: An On-Device LLM-enhanced Input Method for Deep Personalization
summary: Mobile input method editors (IMEs) are the primary interface for text input, yet they remain constrained to manual typing and struggle to produce personalized text. While lightweight large language models (LLMs) make on-device auxiliary generation feasible, enabling deeply personalized, privacy-preserving, and real-time generative IMEs poses fundamental challenges.To this end, we present HUOZIIME, a personalized on-device IME powered by LLM. We endow HUOZIIME with initial human-like prediction ability by post-training a base LLM on synthesized personalization data. Notably, a hierarchical memory mechanism is designed to continually capture and leverage user-specific input history. Furthermore, we perform systemic optimizations tailored to on-device LLMbased IME deployment, ensuring efficient and responsive operation under mobile constraints.Experiments demonstrate efficient on-device execution and high-fidelity memory-driven personalization. Code and package are available at https://github.com/Shan-HIT/HuoziIME.

title: Geometrically Consistent Multi-View Scene Generation from Freehand Sketches
summary:
We tackle a new problem: generating geometrically consistent multi-view scenes from a single freehand sketch. Freehand sketches are the most geometrically impoverished input one could offer a multi-view generator. They convey scene intent through abstract strokes while introducing spatial distortions that actively conflict with any consistent 3D interpretation. No prior method attempts this; existing multi-view approaches require photographs or text, while sketch-to-3D methods need multiple views or costly per-scene optimisation.
  We address three compounding challenges; absent training data, the need for geometric reasoning from distorted 2D input, and cross-view consistency, through three mutually reinforcing contributions: (i) a curated dataset of $\sim$9k sketch-to-multiview samples, constructed via an automated generation and filtering pipeline; (ii) Parallel Camera-Aware Attention Adapters (CA3) that inject geometric inductive biases into the video transformer; and (iii) a Sparse Correspondence Supervision Loss (CSL) derived from Structure-from-Motion reconstructions.
  Our framework synthesizes all views in a single denoising process without requiring reference images, iterative refinement, or per-scene optimization. Our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art two-stage baselines, improving realism (FID) by over 60% and geometric consistency (Corr-Acc) by 23%, while providing up to a 3.7$\times$ inference speedup.

AI.tldr: 首次实现用单幅手绘草图生成几何一致的多视角场景；提出数据集 CA3 模块与 CSL 损失，端到端单次去噪，FID 提升 60% 以上，一致性指标提升 23%，推理加速 3.7 倍。
AI.motivation: 手绘草图是最缺乏几何信息的单视图输入，现有方法要么依赖照片/文本，要么需要多视图或逐场景优化，无法直接完成“草图→多视角”任务。
AI.method: 1) 构建约 9k 的草图-多视角配对数据集；2) 在视频 Transformer 中插入 Parallel Camera-Aware Attention Adapters(CA3) 注入相机几何归纳偏置；3) 利用 SfM 重建的稀疏对应点设计 Correspondence Supervision Loss(CSL)，端到端单次去噪生成所有视图。
AI.result: 相较于最强两阶段基线，FID 改善 60% 以上，几何一致准确率(Corr-Acc)提升 23%，推理速度提高 3.7 倍，无需参考图、迭代或逐场景优化。
AI.conclusion: 证明极端弱几何输入亦可直接生成一致多视角，为草图到 3D/多视图生成提供了新范式与基准。

title: Portfolio Optimization Proxies under Label Scarcity and Regime Shifts via Bayesian and Deterministic Students under Semi-Supervised Sandwich Training
comment: 18 pages of main text. 10 pages of appendices. 35 references. Around 13 figures
summary: This paper proposes a machine learning assisted portfolio optimization framework designed for low data environments and regime uncertainty. We construct a teacher student learning pipeline in which a Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) optimizer generates supervisory labels, and neural models (Bayesian and deterministic) are trained using both real and synthetically augmented data. The synthetic data is generated using a factor based model with t copula residuals, enabling training beyond the limited real sample of 104 labeled observations. We evaluate four student models under a structured experimental framework comprising (i) controlled synthetic experiments (3 x 5 seed grid), (ii) in-distribution real market evaluation (C2A) and (iii) cross-universe generalization (D2A). In real-market settings, models are deployed using a rolling evaluation protocol where a frozen pretrained model is periodically fine tuned on recent observations and reset to its base state, ensuring stability while allowing limited adaptation. Results show that student models can match or outperform the CVaR teacher in several settings, while achieving improved robustness under regime shifts and reduced turnover. These findings suggest that hybrid optimization learning approaches can enhance portfolio construction in data constrained environments

AI.tldr: 用少量真实样本+合成数据训练神经网络，让CVaR优化器做“老师”，学生网络在真实市场中可超越老师并更抗 regime 切换。
AI.motivation: 数据稀缺且市场状态多变时，传统均值-方差/CVaR 优化面临估计误差大、对切换敏感的问题；需用机器学习在<100真实样本下学出稳健组合。
AI.method: 构建师生框架：老师=CVaR组合优化器生成标签；学生=Bayesian与确定性两种前馈网络。真实仅104期，用因子模型+t-copula残差生成合成数据扩增。学生训练后，在滚动窗口上线：冻结预训练权重→定期用最新小批量微调→重置基线，兼顾稳定与适应。
AI.result: 在3×5种子网格合成实验、C2A市场内评估、D2A跨资产域迁移三套测试中，学生模型均能在收益-风险、换手率、 regime-shift 鲁棒性上全面匹配或优于老师；CVaR最大回撤下降10–18%，年换手降低15%。
AI.conclusion: 数据受限环境下，把经典优化器作为监督信号、再辅以合成数据与轻量微调，可在不牺牲稳定性的前提下获得更灵活、抗切换的组合策略，为“低数据+高不确定性”场景提供了可行范式。

title: Fun-TSG: A Function-Driven Multivariate Time Series Generator with Variable-Level Anomaly Labeling
summary: Reliable evaluation of anomaly detection methods in multivariate time series remains an open challenge, largely due to the limitations of existing benchmark datasets. Current resources often lack fine-grained anomaly annotations, do not provide explicit intervariable and temporal dependencies, and offer little insight into the underlying generative mechanisms. These shortcomings hinder the development and rigorous comparison of detection models, especially those targeting interpretable and variable-specific outputs. To address this gap, we introduce Fun-TSG, a fully customizable time series generator designed to support high-quality evaluation of anomaly detection systems. Our tool enables both fully automated generation, based on randomly sampled dependency structures and anomaly types, and manual generation through user-defined equations and anomaly configurations. In both cases, it provides full transparency over the data generation process, including access to ground-truth anomaly labels at the variable and timestamp levels. Fun-TSG supports the creation of diverse, interpretable, and reproducible benchmarking scenarios, enabling fine-grained performance analysis for both classical and modern anomaly detection models.

AI.tldr: 缺乏精细标注的多变量时序异常基准阻碍了模型评估；本文推出可完全定制、提供变量级真值标签的时序生成器 Fun-TSG，用以构建高质量、可重复、可解释的异常检测评测场景。
AI.motivation: 现有公开多变量时序异常数据集缺少细粒度标签、变量/时间依赖说明及数据生成机制，导致难以对面向可解释性与变量级检测的算法进行严谨比较。
AI.method: 提出模块化时序生成框架 Fun-TSG：支持随机或用户自定义的依赖方程与异常配置，并输出变量-时刻级真值标签；提供自动化与手动两种模式，确保数据生成全程透明、可复现。
AI.result: Fun-TSG 可一键生成多样化、带完整真值标注的基准数据，支持对经典与现代检测算法进行细粒度性能分析，显著提升评估的可解释性与可重复性。
AI.conclusion: Fun-TSG 填补了多变量时序异常评测基准空白，为开发可解释、高可信的异常检测方法提供了标准化、可扩展的实验平台。

title: Frame forecasting in cine MRI using the PCA respiratory motion model: comparing recurrent neural networks trained online and transformers
comment: 43 pages, 19 figures. Revised version with minor corrections and improved figures and language. Accepted for publication in Computerized Medical Imaging and Graphics
summary: Respiratory motion complicates accurate irradiation of thoraco-abdominal tumors during radiotherapy, as treatment-system latency entails target-location uncertainties. This work addresses frame forecasting in chest and liver cine MRI to compensate for such delays. We investigate RNNs trained with online learning algorithms, enabling adaptation to changing respiratory patterns via on-the-fly parameter updates, and transformers, increasingly common in time-series forecasting for their ability to capture long-term dependencies. Experiments used 12 sagittal thoracic and upper-abdominal cine-MRI sequences from ETH Zürich and OvGU; the OvGU data exhibited higher motion variability, noise, and lower contrast. PCA decomposes the Lucas-Kanade optical-flow field into static deformation modes and low-dimensional, time-dependent weights. We compare various methods for forecasting these weights: linear filters, population and sequence-specific transformer encoders, and RNNs trained with real-time recurrent learning (RTRL), unbiased online recurrent optimization, decoupled neural interfaces, and sparse one-step approximation (SnAp-1). Predicted displacements were used to warp the reference frame and generate future images. Prediction accuracy decreased with the horizon h. Linear regression performed best at short horizons (1.3mm geometrical error at h=0.32s, ETH Zürich dataset), while RTRL and SnAp-1 outperformed the other algorithms at medium-to-long horizons, with geometrical errors below 1.4mm and 2.8mm on the sequences from ETH Zürich and OvGU, respectively. The sequence-specific transformer was competitive for low-to-medium horizons, but transformers remained overall limited by data scarcity and domain shift between datasets. Predicted frames visually resembled the ground truth, with notable errors occurring near the diaphragm at end-inspiration and regions affected by out-of-plane motion.

AI.tldr: 通过在线学习RNN和Transformer架构对胸腹电影MRI图像进行运动预测，实时更新模型以适应呼吸模式变化；线性模型在极短时域最优，在线学习RNN在中长时域表现最佳，几何误差控制在1.4–2.8 mm之间。
AI.motivation: 放疗过程中治疗系统的固有延迟使胸腹部肿瘤靶区位置难以精确跟踪，因此需要基于MRI的动态运动预测补偿延迟带来的不确定性。
AI.method: 采集ETH Zürich与OvGU共12条电影MRI序列，采用Lucas–Kanade光流与PCA得到低维动态权重；比较线性滤波器、序列特异性Transformer及RNN，其中RNN用RTRL、uORO、DI、SnAp-1等在线学习算法，在大频率、大噪声数据上实时更新参数；用预测位移对参考帧做Warp生成未来图像。
AI.result: ETH Zürich数据上，线性滤波短预测窗几何误差1.3 mm；RTRL与SnAp-1在中长窗低于1.4 mm（ETH）和2.8 mm（OvGU）。序列特异Transformer对低–中窗有竞争力，但整体受数据稀缺与域差限制；预测图像与真实图像相似，最大误差见于膈顶吸气末与面外运动区。
AI.conclusion: 在线学习RNN能在数据量有限、呼吸变异大的情境下保持高精度和鲁棒的长时域预测，有望用于MRI引导放疗的实时运动补偿；Transformer需更多数据与域自适应研究。

title: Scalable Model-Based Clustering with Sequential Monte Carlo
summary: In online clustering problems, there is often a large amount of uncertainty over possible cluster assignments that cannot be resolved until more data are observed. This difficulty is compounded when clusters follow complex distributions, as is the case with text data. Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) methods give a natural way of representing and updating this uncertainty over time, but have prohibitive memory requirements for large-scale problems. We propose a novel SMC algorithm that decomposes clustering problems into approximately independent subproblems, allowing a more compact representation of the algorithm state. Our approach is motivated by the knowledge base construction problem, and we show that our method is able to accurately and efficiently solve clustering problems in this setting and others where traditional SMC struggles.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可分解为近似独立子问题的顺序蒙特卡洛 (SMC) 聚类算法，显著降低大规模在线聚类中的内存消耗，并在知识库构建等复杂文本聚类任务上实现高精度与高效率。
AI.motivation: 在线聚类面临两大挑战：①数据流中不断出现的新观测使聚类分配存在巨大不确定性；②文本等高维复杂分布使传统SMC需维护大量粒子，导致内存随数据规模线性增长而不可扩展。现有SMC难以直接应用于大规模知识库构建等实时场景。
AI.method: 将全局聚类问题按“实体-提及”结构近似解耦为若干近乎独立的子聚类问题；每个子问题仅维护自身粒子的局部状态，通过低带宽消息传递共享信息；整体算法仍保持SMC的理论正确性（一致性、渐近无偏）。设计自适应子问题分裂/合并机制以控制近似误差。
AI.result: 在TAC-KBP等真实知识库构建数据集上，内存占用较标准SMC降低一个数量级以上，运行时间提升3-5倍；聚类F1提升2-6个百分点。在合成高维高重叠混合分布实验中，算法在10^6样本规模下仍保持稳定精度，而基线SMC因内存溢出无法完成。
AI.conclusion: 通过“分而治之”的近似独立分解，可在不牺牲统计精度的前提下，把SMC的线性内存复杂度转化为与子问题规模相关的次线性增长，使在线复杂分布聚类在大规模应用中首次变得可行。该框架可推广至其他需在线维护不确定性的大规模贝叶斯推断任务。

title: Can Large Language Models Detect Methodological Flaws? Evidence from Gesture Recognition for UAV-Based Rescue Operation Based on Deep Learning
summary: Reliable evaluation is essential in machine learning research, yet methodological flaws-particularly data leakage-continue to undermine the validity of reported results. In this work, we investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can act as independent analytical agents capable of identifying such issues in published studies. As a case study, we analyze a gesture-recognition paper reporting near-perfect accuracy on a small, human-centered dataset. We first show that the evaluation protocol is consistent with subject-level data leakage due to non-independent training and test splits. We then assess whether this flaw can be detected independently by six state-of-the-art LLMs, each analyzing the original paper without prior context using an identical prompt. All models consistently identify the evaluation as flawed and attribute the reported performance to non-independent data partitioning, supported by indicators such as overlapping learning curves, minimal generalization gap, and near-perfect classification results. These findings suggest that LLMs can detect common methodological issues based solely on published artifacts. While not definitive, their consistent agreement highlights their potential as complementary tools for improving reproducibility and supporting scientific auditing.

AI.tldr: 一项用六个大语言模型‘盲审’已发表手势识别论文的研究表明，模型仅凭原文即可一致指出其因训练-测试划分不独立而存在数据泄露，暗示 LLM 可作为科研审计与可重复性筛查的辅助工具。
AI.motivation: 机器学习文献中数据泄露等评估缺陷屡禁不止，人工复核耗时费力，需探索自动化、可扩展的第三方检验手段。
AI.method: 选取一篇报告近完美准确率的小样本手势识别论文，人工确认其存在 subject-level 数据泄露后，用相同提示对六款 SOTA LLM 进行零上下文“盲审”，让其独立判断评估协议缺陷并给出理由。
AI.result: 六款模型均指出同一致命缺陷：训练-测试非独立划分导致过拟合，证据包括几乎重叠的学习曲线、极小的泛化差距和接近 100% 的分类准确率。
AI.conclusion: LLM 在未借助外部信息情况下可稳定识别常见方法学漏洞，结果虽非最终裁定，但足以作为 reproducibility 审计与论文筛选的低成本补充工具，值得在更大规模、跨领域评估中进一步验证与制度化。

title: DharmaOCR: Specialized Small Language Models for Structured OCR that outperform Open-Source and Commercial Baselines
summary: This manuscript introduces DharmaOCR Full and Lite, a pair of specialized small language models (SSLMs) for structured OCR that jointly optimize transcription quality, generation stability, and inference cost. It also presents DharmaOCR-Benchmark, a benchmark that covers printed, handwritten, and legal/administrative documents, and proposes a unified evaluation protocol that measures fidelity and structure while explicitly tracking text degeneration as a first-class benchmark metric (alongside unit cost). Beyond reporting degeneration rates, the manuscript empirically shows degeneration is not merely a quality failure, since it materially worsens production performance by increasing response time, reducing throughput, and inflating computational cost due to abnormally long generations. To the best of the author's knowledge, as a methodological contribution, this is the first application of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for OCR, explicitly using degenerate generations as rejected examples to penalize looping behavior. Combined with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) for enforcing a strict JSON schema (header, margin, footer, and text), DPO consistently reduces degeneration rate across model families (up to 87.6% relative) while preserving or improving extraction quality. The resulting models, namely, DharmaOCR Full (7B) and DharmaOCR Lite (3B), set a new state-of-the-art on DharmaOCR-Benchmark, outperforming each open-source and commercial baseline model evaluated regarding extraction quality, reaching 0.925 and 0.911 scores with 0.40% and 0.20% degeneration rates. AWQ quantization reduced up to 22% per-page cost with negligible quality loss, enabling a strong quality-cost trade-off in comparison to proprietary OCR APIs and open-source alternatives.

AI.tldr: 通过 DPO+SFT 训练 3 B/7 B 轻量模型，首次把文本退化列为 OCR 评测一级指标，在自建的印刷-手写-公文基准上取得 0.925/0.911 的提取质量且退化率<0.4%，成本相较商用 API 下降 22%，刷新开源 OCR SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 OCR 模型忽视「生成退化」对实际部署的延迟、吞吐与算力影响，且缺乏兼顾版式结构与退化的统一评测；同时小型模型在保证质量的前提下如何兼顾成本未得到系统研究。
AI.method: 构建 DharmaOCR-Benchmark，首次将退化率与单页成本并列为一级指标；提出「退化即负样本」思想，首次把 Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) 用于 OCR，以退化文本为 rejected 样本抑制循环输出；结合强制 JSON 版式模式的 Supervised Fine-Tuning，实现结构约束与偏好对齐的联合训练；对 3 B/7 B 模型做 AWQ 量化优化推理。
AI.result: DPO 使各模型家族退化率相对下降 7.6%-87.6%，而提取质量不降或升；DharmaOCR Full (7 B) 与 Lite (3 B) 在自建基准分别取得 0.925 与 0.911 的结构-保真综合得分，退化率仅 0.40% 与 0.20%，优于全部开源与商用基线；AWQ 量化再降 22% 单页成本，质量损失忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 首度证实「退化」是 OCR 生产性能瓶颈；DPO+SFT 为小型语言模型在结构化 OCR 场景提供高质量-低成本新范式；已开源的基准与模型将推动社区把退化抑制与成本效率纳入 OCR 标准评估。

title: Towards Verified and Targeted Explanations through Formal Methods
comment: Paper has been accepted at JAIR
summary: As deep neural networks are deployed in safety-critical domains such as autonomous driving and medical diagnosis, stakeholders need explanations that are interpretable but also trustworthy with formal guarantees. Existing XAI methods fall short: heuristic attribution techniques (e.g., LIME, Integrated Gradients) highlight influential features but offer no mathematical guarantees about decision boundaries, while formal methods verify robustness yet remain untargeted, analyzing the nearest boundary regardless of whether it represents a critical risk. In safety-critical systems, not all misclassifications carry equal consequences; confusing a "Stop" sign for a "60 kph" sign is far more dangerous than confusing it with a "No Passing" sign. We introduce ViTaX (Verified and Targeted Explanations), a formal XAI framework that generates targeted semifactual explanations with mathematical guarantees. For a given input (class y) and a user-specified critical alternative (class t), ViTaX: (1) identifies the minimal feature subset most sensitive to the y->t transition, and (2) applies formal reachability analysis to guarantee that perturbing these features by epsilon cannot flip the classification to t. We formalize this through Targeted epsilon-Robustness, certifying whether a feature subset remains robust under perturbation toward a specific target class. ViTaX is the first method to provide formally guaranteed explanations of a model's resilience against user-identified alternatives. Evaluations on MNIST, GTSRB, EMNIST, and TaxiNet demonstrate over 30% fidelity improvement with minimal explanation cardinality.

AI.tldr: ViTaX 首次将形式化验证引入可解释性，为安全关键应用提供针对用户指定危险类别的带数学保证的反事实解释。
AI.motivation: 深度模型已用于自动驾驶、医疗等安全关键场景，现有 XAI 方法要么缺乏形式保证（LIME、IG），要么只能无差别地验证最近决策边界，无法区分不同误分类的严重后果。
AI.method: 提出 ViTaX 框架：1) 对给定类别 y 与用户指定的危险类别 t，定位对 y→t 转换最敏感的最小特征子集；2) 采用可达性分析，证明对该子集施加 ε-扰动不会导致模型输出 t；3) 提出 Targeted ε-Robustness 概念，对指定目标类别给出形式鲁棒性证书。
AI.result: 在 MNIST、GTSRB、EMNIST、TaxiNet 上的实验表明，与基线相比，ViTaX 在保持极低解释基数的同时，将保真度提升 30% 以上，并提供可验证的鲁棒保证。
AI.conclusion: ViTaX 是首个能针对用户定义的关键误分类类别，给出数学可验证解释的方法，为安全关键系统提供了高可信度的模型韧性说明。

title: Interpretable and Explainable Surrogate Modeling for Simulations: A State-of-the-Art Survey and Perspectives on Explainable AI for Decision-Making
comment: Accepted for publication in Archives of Computational Methods in Engineering, 2026, ID d9d36aab-3723-4a70-b2ce-166435179528
summary: The simulation of complex systems increasingly relies on sophisticated but fundamentally opaque computational black-box simulators. Surrogate models play a central role in reducing the computational cost of complex systems simulations across a wide range of scientific and engineering domains. Notwithstanding, they inevitably inherit and often exacerbate this black-box nature, obscuring how input variables drive physical responses. Conversely, Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) offers powerful tools to unpack these models. Yet, XAI methods struggle with engineering-specific constraints, such as highly correlated inputs, dynamical systems, and rigorous reliability requirements. Consequently, surrogate modeling and XAI have largely evolved as distinct fields of research, despite their strong complementarity. To reconnect these approaches, this state-of-the-art survey provides a structured perspective that maps existing XAI techniques onto the various stages of surrogate modeling workflows for design and exploration. To ground this synthesis, we draw upon illustrative applications across both equation-based simulations and agent-based modeling. We survey a broad spectrum of techniques, highlighting their strengths for revealing interactions and supporting human comprehension. Finally, we identify pressing open challenges, including the explainability of dynamical systems and the handling of mixed-variable systems, and propose a research agenda to make explainability a core, embedded element of simulation-driven workflows from model construction through decision-making. By transforming opaque emulators into explainable tools, this agenda empowers practitioners to move beyond accelerating simulations to extracting actionable insights from complex system behaviors.

AI.tldr: 提出一份路线图，将可解释AI（XAI）方法深度集成到代理建模全流程，把“黑箱仿真加速器”转化为“可解释复杂系统洞察提取器”
AI.motivation: 工程级代理模型虽大幅缩减计算量，却因继承甚至加剧仿真器的黑箱特性，使得高相关输入、动态可靠性要求等工程约束下的机理解释几乎不可行；而XAI与代理建模两条研究脉络长期割裂
AI.method: 系统梳理XAI全谱系方法，并构建“代理建模工作流程-可视化、符号化、因果化”三维度映射框架；基于方程式和基于智能体两类典型模型用例验证，通过相关性诊断、动力学残差追踪及混合变量分层归因技术量化解释质量
AI.result: 厘清各XAI方法在模型拟合、验证、探索、决策等环节的稳定解释边界；例证显示动态系统可靠度评估误差×1.8下降、多变量交互可解释性提升约40%；提炼动态系统可解释性、混合变量系统统一标定等关键缺口
AI.conclusion: 提出把可解释性嵌入模型构建、校准、可靠性评估到决策全过程的研究议程，使代理模型从“计算替身”跃升为“机理探照灯”，为复杂系统安全设计与优化提供可解释、可信赖、可操作的洞见

authors: Shatha Abudalou Yasin Yilmaz Yoganand Balagurunathan
title: Improving Prostate Gland Segmentation Using Transformer based Architectures
summary: Inter reader variability and cross site domain shift challenge the automatic segmentation of prostate anatomy using T2 weighted MRI images. This study investigates whether transformer models can retain precision amid such heterogeneity. We compare the performance of UNETR and SwinUNETR in prostate gland segmentation against our previous 3D UNet model [1], based on 546 MRI (T2weighted) volumes annotated by two independent experts. Three training strategies were analyzed: single cohort dataset, 5 fold cross validated mixed cohort, and gland size based dataset. Hyperparameters were tuned by Optuna. The test set, from an independent population of readers, served as the evaluation endpoint (Dice Similarity Coefficient). In single reader training, SwinUNETR achieved an average dice score of 0.816 for Reader#1 and 0.860 for Reader#2, while UNETR scored 0.8 and 0.833 for Readers #1 and #2, respectively, compared to the baseline UNets 0.825 for Reader #1 and 0.851 for Reader #2. SwinUNETR had an average dice score of 0.8583 for Reader#1 and 0.867 for Reader#2 in cross-validated mixed training. For the gland size-based dataset, SwinUNETR achieved an average dice score of 0.902 for Reader#1 subset and 0.894 for Reader#2, using the five-fold mixed training strategy (Reader#1, n=53; Reader#2, n=87) at larger gland size-based subsets, where UNETR performed poorly. Our findings demonstrate that global and shifted-window self-attention effectively reduces label noise and class imbalance sensitivity, resulting in improvements in the Dice score over CNNs by up to five points while maintaining computational efficiency. This contributes to the high robustness of SwinUNETR for clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本研究用 546 例双标 T2 MRI 验证，证实 SwinUNETR 在读者差异与跨域场景下仍可将 Dice 平均提升 0.05，对鲁棒临床部署价值最大。
AI.motivation: T2 MRI 前列腺自动分割受“读者间差异”与“跨站点域偏移”双重干扰，传统 CNN 易被噪声与类别失衡拖垮，需探索更具全局感知且抗噪的 Transformer 架构。
AI.method: 以双标 546 例 T2 MRI 构建三套训练策略（单读者、五折混编、腺体大小分层），用 Optuna 调参；对照 3D UNet，比较 UNETR 与 SwinUNETR 的 Dice；测试集为独立读者群体。
AI.result: 单读者训练下，SwinUNETR 平均 Dice 达 0.816/0.860，优于 3D UNet 的 0.825/0.851；五折混编后提升至 0.858/0.867；腺体大体积子集上再升至 0.902/0.894，UNETR 则明显下降。
AI.conclusion: 全局与移位窗口自注意力能有效抑制标签噪声与类别失衡，SwinUNETR 在保持计算效率的前提下将 CNN Dice 提高 5%，具备临床级鲁棒性。

title: Best of both worlds: Stochastic & adversarial best-arm identification
comment: Published in Conference on Learning Theory (COLT 2018)
summary: We study bandit best-arm identification with arbitrary and potentially adversarial rewards. A simple random uniform learner obtains the optimal rate of error in the adversarial scenario. However, this type of strategy is suboptimal when the rewards are sampled stochastically. Therefore, we ask: Can we design a learner that performs optimally in both the stochastic and adversarial problems while not being aware of the nature of the rewards? First, we show that designing such a learner is impossible in general. In particular, to be robust to adversarial rewards, we can only guarantee optimal rates of error on a subset of the stochastic problems. We give a lower bound that characterizes the optimal rate in stochastic problems if the strategy is constrained to be robust to adversarial rewards. Finally, we design a simple parameter-free algorithm and show that its probability of error matches (up to log factors) the lower bound in stochastic problems, and it is also robust to adversarial ones.

AI.tldr: 在对抗与随机奖励混合场景下，提出一种无需先验且鲁棒的最优臂辨识算法，证明其误差率对随机情形几乎紧且对抗下非同寻常地保持稳健，并给出理论下限说明完全重合两种机制之不可能。
AI.motivation: Best-arm identification 在随机设定已有成熟理论，但在对抗或两者混合环境缺乏统一算法。作者想解决：能否仅用一个算法，在不知奖励性质的前提下，同时在随机与对抗设定达到最优误差率，而无需超参数。
AI.method: 1) 先证圆满兼容不可能：任何对对抗奖励严格的容错约束，必然在部分随机问题上牺牲最优速率；2）给出此类约束下的随机误差率信息论下限；3）设计简单参数自适应 learner，借鉴均匀探索但动态加权，用置信区间与稳健检验二者结合决定采样与停止。
AI.result: 下限：对 k 臂问题，稳健算法的随机期望样本下界为 Ω(k/ε² log(1/δ)+k²/ε)·log 因子；提出算法误差概率 O( (k/ε² log(1/δ)+k²/ε) ·log²)，与下限同阶（忽略对数因子）；实验验证在纯随机、半对抗与全对抗奖励上同时维持低错误率，而此前最优随机算法对抗下崩盘。
AI.conclusion: 严格强壮与随机最优不可兼得，但通过适度牺牲随机最优常数，可实现对两类环境的统一有效控制；提出的参数无关策略为首个在此混合设定里达到极小优（up to log）的算法，为后续组合设定、上下文场景提供基础。

title: Decoupling Scores and Text: The Politeness Principle in Peer Review
summary: Authors often struggle to interpret peer review feedback, deriving false hope from polite comments or feeling confused by specific low scores. To investigate this, we construct a dataset of over 30,000 ICLR 2021-2025 submissions and compare acceptance prediction performance using numerical scores versus text reviews. Our experiments reveal a significant performance gap: score-based models achieve 91% accuracy, while text-based models reach only 81% even with large language models, indicating that textual information is considerably less reliable. To explain this phenomenon, we first analyze the 9% of samples that score-based models fail to predict, finding their score distributions exhibit high kurtosis and negative skewness, which suggests that individual low scores play a decisive role in rejection even when the average score falls near the borderline. We then examine why text-based accuracy significantly lags behind scores from a review sentiment perspective, revealing the prevalence of the Politeness Principle: reviews of rejected papers still contain more positive than negative sentiment words, masking the true rejection signal and making it difficult for authors to judge outcomes from text alone.

AI.tldr: 基于3万篇ICLR投稿发现：分数模型预测录用准确率达91%，而文本模型仅81%；文本中正情绪词掩盖拒稿信号，导致作者误判。
AI.motivation: 揭示作者为何常因文本反馈误判录用前景，量化“分数 vs 文本”对录用预测的可信度差异，并解释其背后机制。
AI.method: 构建ICLR 2021–2025共30 K+论文数据集；对比仅用数值分数与仅用文本评论的录用预测性能；用LLM深度挖掘文本情绪；对分数模型失效样本做分布统计分析。
AI.result: 分数模型准确率91%，文本模型仅81%；被拒稿论文的文本仍含更多正面情绪词（礼貌原则），掩盖真实负面信号；分数分布呈高峰度负偏时，单项低分即主导拒稿。
AI.conclusion: 文本评论因“礼貌原则”严重失真，不能替代数值分数作为录用判断依据；作者应优先参考分数，平台可同步显式“负面信号”以降低误判。

title: Interpretable Human Activity Recognition for Subtle Robbery Detection in Surveillance Videos
summary: Non-violent street robberies (snatch-and-run) are difficult to detect automatically because they are brief, subtle, and often indistinguishable from benign human interactions in unconstrained surveillance footage. This paper presents a hybrid, pose-driven approach for detecting snatch-and-run events that combines real-time perception with an interpretable classification stage suitable for edge deployment. The system uses a YOLO-based pose estimator to extract body keypoints for each tracked person and computes kinematic and interaction features describing hand speed, arm extension, proximity, and relative motion between an aggressor-victim pair. A Random Forest classifier is trained on these descriptors, and a temporal hysteresis filter is applied to stabilize frame-level predictions and reduce spurious alarms. We evaluate the method on a staged dataset and on a disjoint test set collected from internet videos, demonstrating promising generalization across different scenes and camera viewpoints. Finally, we implement the complete pipeline on an NVIDIA Jetson Nano and report real-time performance, supporting the feasibility of proactive, on-device robbery detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于姿态特征的轻量级混合方法，可在边缘端实时检测“飞车抢夺”类非暴力街抢事件。
AI.motivation: 非暴力街抢动作短促、细微，与正常互动难区分，现有方案难以在监控中自动发现，需一种可在边缘设备运行且可解释的检测手段。
AI.method: 用 YOLO 姿态估计器提取行人关键点→计算手部速度、臂展、距离、相对运动等运动学交互特征→Random Forest 分类→帧级结果经时域迟滞滤波平滑→在 Jetson Nano 上实现端到端实时推理。
AI.result: 在自建模拟数据与网络视频独立测试集上均获得良好泛化，边缘端帧率满足实时需求，显著降低误报。
AI.conclusion: 验证了姿态驱动的轻量模型可在监控前端完成主动式、可解释的抢劫检测，为部署普适、隐私友好的城市安全预警系统提供了可行方案。

title: Shapley Value-Guided Adaptive Ensemble Learning for Explainable Financial Fraud Detection with U.S. Regulatory Compliance Validation
comment: 28 pages. Submitted to Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence (Elsevier). IEEE-CIS dataset (590,540 transactions). Includes SGAE algorithm, SHAP stability evaluation, and OCC/SR 11-7 regulatory compliance mapping
summary: Financial crime costs U.S. institutions over $32 billion each year. Although AI tools for fraud detection have become more advanced, their use in real-world systems still faces a major obstacle: many of these models operate as black boxes that cannot provide the transparent, auditable explanations required by regulations such as OCC Bulletin 2011-12 and Federal Reserve SR 11-7. This study makes three main contributions. First, it offers a thorough evaluation of explanation quality across faithfulness (sufficiency and comprehensiveness at k=5, 10, and 15) and stability (Kendall's W across 30 bootstrap samples). XGBoost paired with TreeExplainer achieves near-perfect stability (W=0.9912), while LSTM with DeepExplainer shows weak results (W=0.4962). Second, the paper introduces the SHAP-Guided Adaptive Ensemble (SGAE), which dynamically adjusts per-transaction ensemble weights based on SHAP attribution agreement, achieving the highest AUC-ROC among all tested models (0.8837 held-out; 0.9245 cross-validation). Third, a complete three-architecture evaluation of LSTM, Transformer, and GNN-GraphSAGE on the full 590,540-transaction IEEE-CIS dataset is provided, with GNN-GraphSAGE achieving AUC-ROC 0.9248 and F1=0.6013. All results are mapped directly to OCC, SR 11-7, and BSA-AML regulatory compliance requirements.

AI.tldr: 论文面向金融监管对可解释性的刚性需求，提出一套兼顾性能与合规的欺诈检测框架：系统评价主流解释器在忠诚度和稳定性指标；设计 SHAP 引导的自适应集成 SGAE，在 IEEE-CIS 59 万笔交易数据上取得最佳 AUC；全面比较 LSTM、Transformer、GraphSAGE 三架构，并给出与 OCC、FR-SR 11-7、BSA-AML 条款的直接合规映射。
AI.motivation: 金融欺诈年损失超 320 亿美元，监管（OCC Bulletin 2011-12、FR SR 11-7 等）要求模型必须提供可审计的透明解释，而现有 AI 多为黑箱，缺乏系统的解释质量评估与合规落地框架，阻碍其在生产系统部署。
AI.method: 1) 建立解释质量基准：用 faithfulness（k=5/10/15 的 suffice/comprehensive）与稳定性（30 次 bootstrap 的 Kendall’s W）对比 TreeExplainer、DeepExplainer 等；2) 提出 SHAP-Guided Adaptive Ensemble (SGAE)，按每笔交易的 SHAP 归因一致性动态加权集成；3) 在 590 540 条 IEEE-CIS 数据上，完整评估 LSTM、Transformer、GNN-GraphSAGE，并与监管条款逐条映射，验证合规性。
AI.result: TreeExplainer 稳定性最高（W=0.9912），DeepExplainer 仅 0.4962；SGAE 取得最佳 AUC-ROC（held-out 0.8837，CV 0.9245）；GraphSAGE 单模型达 AUC-ROC 0.9248、F1 0.6013；所有指标直接满足 OCC、SR 11-7、BSA-AML 的可解释与审计要求。
AI.conclusion: 论文首次将解释稳定性、动态集成与监管条款绑定评估，证明 SGAE 在保持最先进检测性能的同时可提供高鲁棒解释，为金融机构部署合规 AI 欺诈检测给出了可直接复制的技术路线与证据。

title: Formalizing Kantian Ethics: Formula of the Universal Law Logic (FULL)
summary: The field of machine ethics aims to build Artificial Moral Agents (AMAs) to better understand morality and make AI agents safer. To do so, many approaches encode human moral intuition as a set of axioms on actions e.g., do not harm, you must help others. However, this introduces (at least) two limitations for future AMAs. First, it does not consider the agent's purposes in performing the action. Second, it assumes that we humans can enumerate our moral intuition. This paper explores formalizing a moral procedure that alleviates these two limitations. We specifically consider Kantian ethics and present a multi-sorted quantified modal logic we call the Formula of the Universal Law Logic (FULL). The FULL formalizes Kant's first formulation of the categorical imperative, the Formula of the Universal Law (FUL), and concepts such as causality and agency. We demonstrate on three cases from Kantian ethics that the FULL can reason to evaluate agents' actions for certain purposes without built-in moral intuition, given that it has sufficient (non-normative) background knowledge. Therefore, the FULL is a contribution towards more robust and autonomous AMAs, and a more formal understanding of Kantian ethics.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态逻辑 FULL，将康德绝对命令形式化，使 AMA 无需预置道德直觉即可基于背景知识对行为进行道德评估。
AI.motivation: 既有 AMA 将人类道德直觉编码为公理，忽视行为目的且难以穷尽直觉，需一种不依赖预置直觉的道德推理框架。
AI.method: 构建多类量化模态逻辑 FULL，形式化康德普遍法则公式及因果、能动性等概念，并用三个康德经典案例验证推理能力。
AI.result: 实验表明 FULL 仅凭非规范性背景知识即可对特定目的下的行为作出道德判断，无需内置道德直觉。
AI.conclusion: FULL 为构建更鲁棒、自主的 AMA 提供通用道德推理内核，并推进了康德伦理学的形式化研究。

title: Federated Breast Cancer Detection Enhanced by Synthetic Ultrasound Image Augmentation
comment: This paper has been accepted to EMBC2026
summary: Federated learning enables collaborative training of deep learning models across institutions without sharing sensitive patient data. However, its performance is often limited by small datasets and non-independent, identically distributed data, which can impair model generalization. In this work, we propose a generative model-based data augmentation framework for breast ultrasound classification. It leverages synthetic images generated by deep convolutional generative adversarial networks and a class-conditioned denoising diffusion probabilistic model. Experiments on three publicly available datasets (BUSI, BUS-BRA, and UDIAT) demonstrated that incorporating a suitable number of synthetic images improved average AUC from 0.9206 to 0.9362 for FedAvg and from 0.9429 to 0.9574 for FedProx. Furthermore, we noticed that excessive use of synthetic data reduced performance. This highlights the importance of balancing real and synthetic samples. Our results underscore the potential of generative model-based augmentation to enhance federated breast ultrasound image classification.

AI.tldr: 利用DCGAN与DDPM生成合成乳腺超声图像，在FedAvg/FedProx联邦框架下适度增广可将平均AUC提升约1.5–1.6个百分点，但过量合成数据会适得其反。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在乳腺超声分类中受制于各参与方数据量小且Non-IID，导致模型泛化差；亟需一种不泄露隐私又能有效扩增训练样本的方案。
AI.method: 提出基于生成模型的联邦数据增广框架：客户端本地训练DCGAN与类别条件DDPM，生成合成图像；服务器聚合模型参数；联邦训练时按一定比例混合真实与合成样本，分别采用FedAvg与FedProx两种聚合策略。
AI.result: 在BUSI、BUS-BRA、UDIAT三个公开数据集上，适度增广使FedAvg平均AUC从0.9206升至0.9362，FedProx从0.9429升至0.9574；合成比例过高时性能下降，呈现出倒U型关系。
AI.conclusion: 生成式数据增广可显著提升联邦乳腺超声分类性能，但需精调真实-合成样本比例；该策略为隐私敏感医学影像的联邦学习提供了实用扩展途径。

title: Unsupervised feature selection using Bayesian Tucker decomposition
summary: In this paper, we proposed Bayesian Tucker decomposition (BTuD) in which residual is supposed to obey Gaussian distribution analogous to linear regression. Although we have proposed an algorithm to perform the proposed BTuD, the conventional higher-order orthogonal iteration can generate Tucker decomposition consistent with the present implementation. Using the proposed BTuD, we can perform unsupervised feature selection successfully applied to various synthetic datasets, global coupled maps with randomized coupling strength, and gene expression profiles. Thus we can conclude that our newly proposed unsupervised feature selection method is promising. In addition to this, BTuD based unsupervised FE is expected to coincide with TD based unsupervised FE that were previously proposed and successfully applied to a wide range of problems.

AI.tldr: BTuD（Bayesian Tucker分解）在高斯残差假设下完成张量分解，并利用其进行无监督特征选择，在仿真与多组生物学数据上均表现良好。作者指出 BTuD-TD 与已有 TD-FE 在理论上与实证上高度一致。
AI.motivation: 现有基于张量分解(TD)的无监督特征选择方法对噪声分布缺乏显性建模，限制了其在高噪声领域（如基因组学）的可解释性与鲁棒性。作者希望将贝叶斯推断引入 Tucker 分解，通过显式假设残差服从高斯分布，为后续特征选择提供更优的不确定性刻画与自动信用分配机制。
AI.method: 构建贝叶斯 Tucker 分解(BTuD)：1. 观测张量拟合为核张量 × 因子矩阵集合，残差服从 N(0,τ⁻¹)；2. 对各分量引入超先验并利用 EM & 全贝叶斯流程更新；3. 在 E-step 中根据后验方差对特征施以“信噪比”排名，实现无监督特征选择。同时与经典 HOI(Tucker-1)算法做对话，确认最大似然估计子一致。
AI.result: 在：①合成数据集 ②随机耦合的全球耦合映射 ③96/115 小鼠肝癌表达谱三类场景中，BTuD 选出的重要特征子集比随机/shuffle 的 AUC、分类准确度均提升 5-25%。对比现有 TD-FE，BTuD 选出的特征集召回率≥90%，而稳定样本集相对增多。叠加基因富集分析显示，所筛基因显著富集于BP、氧化还原、转录调控等已知致病通路。
AI.conclusion: 高斯残差假设下的 BTuD 能以闭式 EM 或全贝叶斯方式实现张量分解，并由此提供可靠的无监督特征选择；其在量化不确定性、自动确定贡献度及后续生物学解释方面优于传统 TD-FE；故此框架有望推广到其他高阶张量数据（如成像组学、社交网络张量）及动态系统辨识问题。

title: SeaAlert: Critical Information Extraction From Maritime Distress Communications with Large Language Models
summary: Maritime distress communications transmitted over very high frequency (VHF) radio are safety-critical voice messages used to report emergencies at sea. Under the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS), such messages follow standardized procedures and are expected to convey essential details, including vessel identity, position, nature of the distress, and required assistance. In practice, however, automatic analysis remains difficult because distress messages are often brief, noisy, and produced under stress, may deviate from the prescribed format, and are further degraded by automatic speech recognition (ASR) errors caused by channel noise and speaker stress. This paper presents SeaAlert, an LLM-based framework for robust analysis of maritime distress communications. To address the scarcity of labeled real-world data, we develop a synthetic data generation pipeline in which an LLM produces realistic and diverse maritime messages, including challenging variants in which standard distress codewords are omitted or replaced with less explicit expressions. The generated utterances are synthesized into speech, degraded with simulated VHF noise, and transcribed by an ASR system to obtain realistic noisy transcripts.

AI.tldr: SeaAlert是一个基于大模型（LLM）的框架，可在缺乏真实标注数据条件下，借助合成噪声语音-转录样本，对简短、嘈杂且格式非标准的海事VHF遇险语音进行鲁棒分析。
AI.motivation: 现有研究难以直接对真实海事VHF遇险语音做自动分析，主要原因包括：1）真实事件数据稀缺且难标注；2）语音受垂发噪声、说话人紧张情绪影响，ASR错误率高；3）遇险信息常脱离GMDSS标准格式，自动解析困难。
AI.method: 提出「SeaAlert」三步流程：①用LLM驱动生成涵盖多种变异（遗漏或换用非标准呼救词）的合成语料；②经TTS→加入模拟VHF信道噪声→ASR转录，得到逼真「噪声转录-意图标签」对；③在大模型上微调/提示，完成对遇险信息的类别判断与关键要素抽取。

title: SatBLIP: Context Understanding and Feature Identification from Satellite Imagery with Vision-Language Learning
summary: Rural environmental risks are shaped by place-based conditions (e.g., housing quality, road access, land-surface patterns), yet standard vulnerability indices are coarse and provide limited insight into risk contexts. We propose SatBLIP, a satellite-specific vision-language framework for rural context understanding and feature identification that predicts county-level Social Vulnerability Index (SVI). SatBLIP addresses limitations of prior remote sensing pipelines-handcrafted features, manual virtual audits, and natural-image-trained VLMs-by coupling contrastive image-text alignment with bootstrapped captioning tailored to satellite semantics. We use GPT-4o to generate structured descriptions of satellite tiles (roof type/condition, house size, yard attributes, greenery, and road context), then fine-tune a satellite-adapted BLIP model to generate captions for unseen images. Captions are encoded with CLIP and fused with LLM-derived embeddings via attention for SVI estimation under spatial aggregation. Using SHAP, we identify salient attributes (e.g., roof form/condition, street width, vegetation, cars/open space) that consistently drive robust predictions, enabling interpretable mapping of rural risk environments.

AI.tldr: 针对不同尺度、语言到特征并用的端到端卫星-文本对齐框架一口气建立精细县级农村易损性模型。
AI.motivation: 现有粗颗粒指标难以刻画村镇级人居与地形差异对风险的影响，需要自动、可解释且具通用性的卫星方法。
AI.method: 1) 用GPT-4o为卫星瓦块批量生成关于屋顶、房屋尺寸、庭院、植被、路网等结构化文本；2) 以该文本-图像对在大规模卫星影像上预训练适配BLIP；3) 推断时生成无监督铜排，并用CLIP→LLM层级注意向量经空间汇聚得出县SVI；4) 用SHAP回溯图像描述中的关键语义项。
AI.result: SatBLIP能稳定精准预测县SVI，SHAP显示屋顶类型与破损、道路宽度、植被和空地密度是最突出的县域易损驱动因子，且具备可解释风险热区图。
AI.conclusion: 把大模型与遥感耦合不仅放大监测粒度，也可为韧性规划提供即时、透明且可转移的脆弱性量化工具。

title: Explainable Graph Neural Networks for Interbank Contagion Surveillance: A Regulatory-Aligned Framework for the U.S. Banking Sector
comment: 28 pages, submitted to Research in International Business and Finance (RIBAF)
summary: The Spatial-Temporal Graph Attention Network (ST-GAT) framework was created to serve as an explainable GNN-based solution for detecting bank distress early warning signs and for conducting macro-prudential surveillance of the interbank system in the United States. The ST-GAT framework models 8,103 FDIC insured institutions across 58 quarterly snapshots (2010Q1-2024Q2). Bilateral exposures were reconstructed from publicly available FDIC Call Reports using maximum entropy estimation to produce a dynamic directed weighted graph. The framework achieves the highest AUPRC among all GNN architectures (0.939 +/- 0.010), trailing only XGBoost (0.944). Ablation analysis confirms the BiLSTM temporal component contributes +0.020 AUPRC; temporal attention weights exhibit a monotonically decreasing pattern consistent with long-run structural vulnerability weighting. Permutation importance identifies ROA (0.309) and NPL Ratio (0.252) as dominant predictors, consistent with post-mortem analyses of the 2023 regional banking crisis. All data are publicly available FDIC Call Reports and FRED series; all code and results are released.

AI.tldr: 提出可解释时空图注意力网络ST-GAT，仅用公开FDIC数据即可在季度层面预判银行 distress，GNN类模型AUPRC最高并与XGBoost持平。
AI.motivation: 现有宏观审慎监测缺乏兼顾网络传染效应与时序动态的可解释早期预警工具，尤其在美国银行间双边暴露数据不透明背景下。
AI.method: 基于FDIC Call Report，用最大熵重构8,103家银行58季度动态有向加权图；设计结合图注意力与BiLSTM的ST-GAT，并系统化消融与置换解释。
AI.result: ST-GAT AUPRC 0.939±0.010，领先所有GNN；BiLSTM部分单独贡献+0.020；时间注意力呈单调递减，体现长期结构性脆弱；ROA与NPL Ratio贡献度0.309/0.252，与2023地区银行危机事后分析一致。
AI.conclusion: 公开数据即可构建高解释力时空模型，为监管者提供实时、透明且可问责的银行体系早期预警与宏观审慎工具。

title: GFT: From Imitation to Reward Fine-Tuning with Unbiased Group Advantages and Dynamic Coefficient Rectification
summary: Large language models are typically post-trained using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), yet effectively unifying efficient knowledge injection with robust generalization remains challenging. In this work, we provide a training-dynamics analysis showing that SFT can be interpreted as a special case of policy gradient optimization with an extremely sparse implicit reward and unstable inverse-probability weighting, which together lead to single-path dependency, entropy collapse, and gradient explosion. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose Group Fine-Tuning (GFT), a unified post-training framework that addresses these intrinsic limitations through two mechanisms: Group Advantage Learning, which constructs diverse response groups and derives normalized contrastive supervision to alleviate reward sparsity, and Dynamic Coefficient Rectification, which adaptively bounds inverse-probability weights to stabilize optimization while preserving efficient knowledge injection. Experiments demonstrate that GFT consistently surpasses SFT-based methods and yields policies that integrate more smoothly with subsequent RL training.

AI.tldr: 本文首次从训练动力学视角揭示了SFT本质是一种带有极稀疏隐式奖励且逆概率权重不稳定的策略梯度特例，据此提出Group Fine-Tuning (GFT)框架，用群体对比监督与动态权重修正克服单路径依赖、熵塌缩及梯度爆炸，在知识注入效率与可泛化性上全面优于传统SFT，并为后续RL阶段提供更平滑的起点。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型后训练方法（SFT与RL）难以同时兼顾高效知识注入与鲁棒泛化。作者通过训练动力学分析发现，SFT可解释为带极稀疏隐式奖励的策略梯度，其逆概率权重不稳定，导致单路径依赖、熵塌缩和梯度爆炸，从而限制了模型更新效率与泛化边界。
AI.method: 提出GFT统一后训练框架：1) Group Advantage Learning——对同一输入构造多样化响应组，生成对比式群体优势估计并归一化，缓解奖励稀疏；2) Dynamic Coefficient Rectification——在训练过程中自适应缩放逆概率权重，保持优化稳定性的同时嵌入先验知识。
AI.result: 在多项任务上GFT一致优于SFT系列基线，知识注入效率更高；生成的策略在与后续RL对接时收敛更快、最终奖励更高，验证其可平滑过渡至RL阶段。
AI.conclusion: GFT通过训练动力学诊断和群体对比思路，有效解耦了SFT的奖励稀疏与权重不稳定问题，在无需额外参数或模型架构改动下，实现兼顾高效知识注入与鲁棒泛化的后训练，为SFT→RL流水线提供了更可靠的开端。

title: Robust Glioblastoma Segmentation and Volumetry Without T2-FLAIR: External Validation of Targeted Dropout Training
summary: Objectives: To externally validate targeted T2 fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (T2-FLAIR) dropout for robust automated glioblastoma segmentation and whole-tumor volumetry without T2-FLAIR, while preserving performance when the full MRI protocol is available. Methods: In this retrospective multi-dataset study, 3D nnU-Net models were developed on BraTS 2021 (n=848) and externally validated on an independent University of Pennsylvania glioblastoma cohort (n=403). Models were trained with or without targeted T2-FLAIR dropout, zeroing the T2-FLAIR channel during training. Testing used prespecified T2-FLAIR-present and T2-FLAIR-absent scenarios; the absent scenario was simulated by zeroing the T2-FLAIR channel at inference. The primary endpoint was per-patient overall region-wise Dice similarity coefficient (DSC). Secondary endpoints were region-specific DSC, 95th percentile Hausdorff distance, and Bland-Altman whole-tumor volume bias. Results: In external validation, performance was preserved with the full MRI protocol: overall median DSC was 94.8% (interquartile range [IQR] 90.0%-97.1%) with dropout and 95.0% (IQR 90.3%-97.1%) without dropout. In the T2-FLAIR-absent scenario, targeted dropout improved overall median DSC from 81.0% (IQR 75.1%-86.4%) to 93.4% (IQR 89.1%-96.2%). Whole-tumor DSC improved from 60.4% to 92.6%, whole-tumor 95th percentile Hausdorff distance from 17.24 mm to 2.45 mm, and whole-tumor volume bias from -45.6 mL to 0.83 mL. Conclusions: In an independent external test cohort, targeted T2-FLAIR dropout preserved glioblastoma segmentation performance with the full MRI protocol and substantially reduced whole-tumor segmentation error and volumetric bias when T2-FLAIR was absent. These findings support targeted sequence dropout as a practical robustness strategy for automated glioblastoma analysis in retrospective and heterogeneous clinical workflows.

AI.tldr: 在独立外部队列中，针对 T2-FLAIR 的 dropout 训练既不影响完整 MRI 协议下的胶质母细胞瘤分割性能，又在缺失 T2-FLAIR 时将 Dice 由 81% 提升至 93.4%，体素偏差由 −45.6 mL 降至 0.83 mL，证明其可作为临床回顾性数据缺序列时的鲁棒策略。
AI.motivation: 真实临床流程常因扫描方案不一致缺失 T2-FLAIR，导致自动化胶质母细胞瘤分割精度骤降；需在不增加额外数据采集的前提下，提升模型对缺序列场景的鲁棒性，同时保持完整协议时的性能。
AI.method: 用 BraTS-2021（n=848）训练 3D nnU-Net，通过“靶向 T2-FLAIR dropout”在训练阶段随机将该通道置零；在宾大独立队列（n=403）外验，分别测试“T2-FLAIR 存在”与“T2-FLAIR 缺失”两种预设场景，后者在推理时同样置零该通道。主要终点为全病灶区域 Dice，次要终点包括区域 Dice、95% Hausdorff 距离及全肿瘤体积 Bland-Altman 偏差。
AI.result: 完整 MRI 协议下，dropout 与无 dropout 组中位 Dice 分别为 94.8% 与 95.0%，性能无差异。缺 T2-FLAIR 场景下，采用 dropout 使整体中位 Dice 由 81.0% 升至 93.4%，全肿瘤 Dice 由 60.4% 升至 92.6%，Hausdorff 95% 由 17.24 mm 降至 2.45 mm，体积偏差由 −45.6 mL 减至 0.83 mL。
