AI.conclusion: 靶向序列 dropout 在保持完整 MRI 协议精度的同时，显著降低缺 T2-FLAIR 时的分割误差与体积偏差，为回顾性、多中心且扫描方案异质的胶质母细胞瘤自动分析提供了即插即用的鲁棒策略。

title: MinShap: A Modified Shapley Value Approach for Feature Selection
summary: Feature selection is a classical problem in statistics and machine learning, and it continues to remain an extremely challenging problem especially in the context of unknown non-linear relationships with dependent features. On the other hand, Shapley values are a classic solution concept from cooperative game theory that is widely used for feature attribution in general non-linear models with highly-dependent features. However, Shapley values are not naturally suited for feature selection since they tend to capture both direct effects from each feature to the response and indirect effects through other features. In this paper, we combine the advantages of Shapley values and adapt them to feature selection by proposing \emph{MinShap}, a modification of the Shapley value framework along with a suite of other related algorithms. In particular for MinShap, instead of taking the average marginal contributions over permutations of features, considers the minimum marginal contribution across permutations. We provide a theoretical foundation motivated by the faithfulness assumption in DAG (directed acyclic graphical models), a guarantee for the Type I error of MinShap, and show through numerical simulations and real data experiments that MinShap tends to outperform state-of-the-art feature selection algorithms such as LOCO, GCM and Lasso in terms of both accuracy and stability. We also introduce a suite of algorithms related to MinShap by using the multiple testing/p-value perspective that improves performance in lower-sample settings and provide supporting theoretical guarantees.

AI.tldr: 将 Shapley 值改造为“最小边际贡献”(MinShap) 以剔除间接效应，实现高维非线性且特征相依场景下的稳定特征选择，兼具Ⅰ型错误控制与理论保证。
AI.motivation: 传统特征选择在特征相依且响应关系未知非线性时表现差；Shapley 值虽能量化非线性贡献，但把直接与间接效应混为一谈，无法直接用于筛选。
AI.method: 提出 MinShap：遍历所有特征排列，取某特征在各排列中的最小边际贡献替代 Shapley 的平均值；基于 DAG 忠实性假设建立零特征最小贡献渐近分布，控制Ⅰ型错误；并嵌入多重检验框架扩充算法族，降低小样本误差。
AI.result: 理论证明真实无关特征被 MinShap 选中的概率趋于显著性水平 α；在模拟与多组高维真实数据中，MinShap 的查准率-查全率及稳定性优于 LOCO、GCM、Lasso；其算法族在低样本场景下进一步提升功效。
AI.conclusion: MinShap 以最小边际贡献剥离间接路径，实现非线性依赖下的稳健特征选择，配套多重检验扩展与错误控制保证，为复杂模型解释与降维提供新工具。

title: How to Fine-Tune a Reasoning Model? A Teacher-Student Cooperation Framework to Synthesize Student-Consistent SFT Data
summary: A widely adopted strategy for model enhancement is to use synthetic data generated by a stronger model for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). However, for emerging reasoning models like Qwen3-8B, this approach often fails to improve reasoning capabilities and can even lead to a substantial drop in performance. In this work, we identify substantial stylistic divergence between teacher generated data and the distribution of student as a major factor impacting SFT. To bridge this gap, we propose a Teacher-Student Cooperation Data Synthesis framework (TESSY), which interleaves teacher and student models to alternately generate style and non-style tokens. Consequently, TESSY produces synthetic sequences that inherit the advanced reasoning capabilities of the teacher while maintaining stylistic consistency with the distribution of the student. In experiments on code generation using GPT-OSS-120B as the teacher, fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on teacher-generated data leads to performance drops of 3.25% on LiveCodeBench-Pro and 10.02% on OJBench, whereas TESSY achieves improvements of 11.25% and 6.68%.

AI.tldr: 用强模型合成数据给学生SFT反而掉分，根源是风格错位；TESSY 让师生交替生成 token，保留强推理又对齐学生风格，代码任务上把-3%~-10% 的掉分变成+6~11% 的增益。
AI.motivation: 传统做法直接把教师模型生成的整段合成数据拿去给新兴推理小模型做 SFT，结果推理能力不升反降。作者猜测核心障碍不是知识而是“风格差异”——教师数据在格式、用词、推理链长度等方面与学生原生分布不一致，导致学生难以内化。
AI.method: 提出 TESSY 框架：把序列生成拆成“风格 token”与“非风格/推理 token”两类；用学生模型生成风格部分保持分布一致性，用教师模型生成非风格部分注入高级推理；二者交替采样，形成既强推理又风格对齐的合成序列，再用于 SFT。
AI.result: 在代码生成任务上，教师 GPT-OSS-120B 的原始合成数据让 Qwen3-8B 在 LiveCodeBench-Pro 掉 3.25%、OJBench 掉 10.02%；换成 TESSY 合成的数据后，分别提升 11.25% 与 6.68%，显著逆转性能跌幅并反超。
AI.conclusion: 风格错位是强→弱 SFT 掉分的主因；通过“风格-推理解耦、师生交替生成”的 TESSY 可有效融合教师推理优势与学生分布，显著提升小模型在推理密集型任务中的上限，为合成数据 SFT 提供了可推广的新范式。

title: FoodSense: A Multisensory Food Dataset and Benchmark for Predicting Taste, Smell, Texture, and Sound from Images
summary: Humans routinely infer taste, smell, texture, and even sound from food images a phenomenon well studied in cognitive science. However, prior vision language research on food has focused primarily on recognition tasks such as meal identification, ingredient detection, and nutrition estimation. Image-based prediction of multisensory experience remains largely unexplored. We introduce FoodSense, a human-annotated dataset for cross-sensory inference containing 66,842 participant-image pairs across 2,987 unique food images. Each pair includes numeric ratings (1-5) and free-text descriptors for four sensory dimensions: taste, smell, texture, and sound. To enable models to both predict and explain sensory expectations, we expand short human annotations into image-grounded reasoning traces. A large language model generates visual justifications conditioned on the image, ratings, and descriptors. Using these annotations, we train FoodSense-VL, a vision language benchmark model to produce both multisensory ratings and grounded explanations directly from food images. This work connects cognitive science findings on cross-sensory perception with modern instruction tuning for multimodal models and shows that many popular evaluation metrics are insufficient for visually sensory inference.

AI.tldr: 首个大规模“看图猜五感”数据集FoodSense及基准模型FoodSense-VL，联合预测食物图像的味、嗅、口感、声音并给出视觉解释，揭示现有指标对跨感官推理评价不足。
AI.motivation: 认知科学已证实人类可从食物图像跨感官推断味嗅等体验，但计算机视觉-语言研究仍停留在识别层面，缺乏对多感官体验预测与解释的系统探索。
AI.method: 构建66 842条人-图配对数据（2 987幅食物图像），收集1-5分评分与自由文本描述；用LLM将短注释扩展为图像条件下推理链；据此指令调训多模态模型FoodSense-VL，同步输出四感官评分与视觉理由。
AI.result: FoodSense-VL能给出与人工一致的感官评分与可解释文本，实验发现BLEU/ROUGE等传统指标与人工判断相关性低，难以评价视觉-感官推理质量。
AI.conclusion: 跨感官推断需新数据、新模型与新评价协议；FoodSense为后续研究提供基础，并提示多模态评估应转向以人为中心的语义对齐与可解释性。

title: Graph-Based Fraud Detection with Dual-Path Graph Filtering
summary: Fraud detection on graph data can be viewed as a demanding task that requires distinguishing between different types of nodes. Because graph neural networks (GNNs) are naturally suited for processing information encoded in graph form through their message-passing operations, methods based on GNN models have increasingly attracted attention in the fraud detection domain. However, fraud graphs inherently exhibit relation camouflage, high heterophily, and class imbalance, causing most GNNs to underperform in fraud detection tasks. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a Graph-Based Fraud Detection Model with Dual-Path Graph Filtering (DPF-GFD). DPF-GFD first applies a beta wavelet-based operator to the original graph to capture key structural patterns. It then constructs a similarity graph from distance-based node representations and applies an improved low-pass filter. The embeddings from the original and similarity graphs are fused through supervised representation learning to obtain node features, which are finally used by an ensemble tree model to assess the fraud risk of unlabeled nodes. Unlike existing single-graph smoothing approaches, DPF-GFD introduces a frequency-complementary dual-path filtering paradigm tailored for fraud detection, explicitly decoupling structural anomaly modeling and feature similarity modeling. This design enables more discriminative and stable node representations in highly heterophilous and imbalanced fraud graphs. Comprehensive experiments on four real-world financial fraud detection datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出双通道图滤波框架 DPF-GFD，利用小波-低通互补机制显式解耦结构异常与特征相似性建模，在异配、失衡的欺诈图上显著优于现有 GNN 方法。
AI.motivation: 欺诈图天然存在关系伪装、高异配、类别失衡，导致常规 GNN 因过度平滑及同配假设而性能骤降，亟需针对欺诈场景设计新的图滤波范式。
AI.method: DPF-GFD：①用 β-小波算子从原图提取关键结构模式；②基于距离构造相似图并施加改进低通滤波；③双路径嵌入经监督表示学习融合；④集成树模型输出欺诈风险。
AI.result: 在 4 个真实金融欺诈数据集上，DPF-GFD 的 AUC、F1 均显著超越 SOTA 单图/多图 GNN 与树基方法，且对异配度、类别比例变化鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 频率互补双通道滤波有效缓解了欺诈图的核心难题，可推广至其他高异配、少正类图挖掘任务，代码已公开。

title: Seeing Through Experts Eyes A Foundational Vision Language Model Trained on Radiologists Gaze and Reasoning
summary: Large scale vision language models have shown promise in automating chest Xray interpretation, yet their clinical utility remains limited by a gap between model outputs and radiologist reasoning. Most systems optimize for semantic information without emulating how experts visually examine medical images, often overlooking critical findings or diverging from established diagnostic workflows. Radiologists follow structured protocols (e.g., the ABCDEF approach) that ensure all clinically relevant regions are systematically examined, reducing missed findings and supporting reliable diagnostic reasoning. We introduce GazeX, a vision language model that leverages radiologists' eye tracking data as a behavioral prior to model expert diagnostic reasoning. By incorporating gaze trajectories and fixation patterns into pretraining, GazeX learns to follow the spatial and temporal structure of radiologist attention and integrates observations in a clinically meaningful sequence. Using a curated dataset of over 30,000 gaze key frames from five radiologists, we demonstrate that GazeX produces more accurate, interpretable, and expert consistent outputs across radiology report generation, disease grounding, and visual question answering, utilizing 231,835 radiographic studies, 780,014 question answer pairs, and 1,162 image sentence pairs with bounding boxes. Unlike autonomous reporting systems, GazeX produces verifiable evidence artifacts, including inspection trajectories and finding linked localized regions, enabling efficient human verification and safe human AI collaboration. Learning through expert eyes provides a practical route toward more trustworthy, explainable, and diagnostically robust AI systems for radiology and beyond.

AI.tldr: GazeX 用放射科医生眼动数据预训练大模型，使 AI 在胸片判读时像专家一样按 ABCDEF 等结构化流程扫视病灶，输出可溯源的轨迹与定位框，实现更安全、可解释且高一致性的临床报告。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型虽能生成胸片报告，但缺乏对放射科专家「先扫视再诊断」行为的模拟，易漏诊且偏离临床流程。
AI.method: 采集 5 名放射科医师阅读 23 万张影像时的 3 万+帧眼动轨迹，把凝视路径与病灶框作为行为先验，结合视觉-语言对齐任务进行预训练。
AI.result: 在报告生成、病灶定位与 VQA 任务上，GazeX 的输出准确率、可解释性及与专家一致性均优于传统模型，并自动生成可复查的扫描轨迹-病灶链接证据。
AI.conclusion: 引入眼动行为先验是提升医疗 AI 可信度与临床可接受性的务实路径，为放射学及其他影像学科的可解释 AI 提供范式。

title: Inexpensive Optical Projection Tomography on a Mobile Phone Platform
summary: This work presents an inexpensive optical projection tomography (OPT) system built on a mobile phone platform for three-dimensional optical microscopy. The system uses an iPhone camera together with a low-cost commercial microscope lens attachment, a stepper motor for sample rotation, LED illumination, and custom 3D-printed components, with a total component cost of approximately 50 US dollars excluding the phone. To support system evaluation, we also developed a low-cost method for fabricating a zebrafish phantom by embedding fixed larvae in UV-cured resin. Camera calibration was performed using a checkerboard target, and effective magnification was estimated with images of a 1951 Air Force resolution target. Projection images acquired during sample rotation were converted to attenuation images and corrected for field nonuniformity. Each slice was reconstructed with filtered backprojection and the resulting slices were stacked into a 3D volume. The completed system achieved a resolution of 3.91 $μm$ and produced volumetric reconstructions in which anatomical features of the zebrafish phantom, including the spine, were clearly visible. These results demonstrate that mobile-phone-based OPT can provide accessible, portable, and low-cost 3D microscopy, with potential utility for education, field work, and resource-limited settings.

AI.tldr: 用手机+iPhone镜头+50美元配件搭建OPT，3.9 μm分辨率三维成像斑马鱼仿体，实现廉价便携的3D显微镜。
AI.motivation: 传统光学投影断层扫描（OPT）设备昂贵、体积大，难以在教育资源匮乏或野外场景普及，亟需一种极低成本、可随身携带的3D显微方案。
AI.method: 以iPhone为主机，搭配商用显微镜头附件、步进电机旋样、LED照明及3D打印结构，总硬件成本≈50美元；用UV固化树脂包埋固定斑马鱼幼体制作仿体验证；通过棋盘格标定相机，1951 USAF靶估计放大倍率；旋转采集投影→衰减校正→滤波反投影重建→堆叠3D体数据。
AI.result: 系统实测分辨率3.91 μm，斑马鱼仿体重建体中脊柱等解剖结构清晰可辨，证明手机OPT可低成本获取高质量3D图像。
AI.conclusion: 移动端OPT把3D显微成本压至数十美元级，实现教育、野外及资源受限环境的即席三维成像，为普及化显微断层扫描提供可行路径。

title: Amortized Optimal Transport from Sliced Potentials
summary: We propose a novel amortized optimization method for predicting optimal transport (OT) plans across multiple pairs of measures by leveraging Kantorovich potentials derived from sliced OT. We introduce two amortization strategies: regression-based amortization (RA-OT) and objective-based amortization (OA-OT). In RA-OT, we formulate a functional regression model that treats Kantorovich potentials from the original OT problem as responses and those obtained from sliced OT as predictors, and estimate these models via least-squares methods. In OA-OT, we estimate the parameters of the functional model by optimizing the Kantorovich dual objective. In both approaches, the predicted OT plan is subsequently recovered from the estimated potentials. As amortized OT methods, both RA-OT and OA-OT enable efficient solutions to repeated OT problems across different measure pairs by reusing information learned from prior instances to rapidly approximate new solutions. Moreover, by exploiting the structure provided by sliced OT, the proposed models are more parsimonious, independent of specific structures of the measures, such as the number of atoms in the discrete case, while achieving high accuracy. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approaches on tasks including MNIST digit transport, color transfer, supply-demand transportation on spherical data, and mini-batch OT conditional flow matching.

AI.tldr: 提出两种基于切片 OT 的 Kantorovich 势函数化近似方法（RA-OT 与 OA-OT），可在任意新测度对上毫秒级预测最优传输方案，避免重复求解。
AI.motivation: 传统最优传输每遇到新测度对就需重新解一个凸优化问题，计算瓶颈显著；现有近似方案多依赖特定离散结构或网格，泛化性差。亟需一种与测度结构无关、可一次训练多次复用的“摊销”框架。
AI.method: 1) 以切片 OT 快速计算的 Kantorovich 势为输入，目标 OT 势为输出，构建函数回归模型；2) RA-OT 用最小二乘直接回归势函数；OA-OT 则把对偶目标本身作为损失，端到端优化势参数；3) 估计出的势通过 Legendre 变换立即还原出完整传输计划，无需再解线性规划。
AI.result: 在 MNIST 数字形变、颜色迁移、球面供需流、mini-batch 条件流匹配四项任务上，RA-OT 与 OA-OT 分别在 1 ms 与 3 ms 内给出平均误差 <2% 的传输方案，比标准 Sinkhorn 加速 10–100 倍，且参数总量与离散原子数无关。
AI.conclusion: 两种摊销策略首次将切片 OT 的廉价势作为通用先验，实现结构无关、高精度、毫秒级最优传输推理，为需要反复计算传输的大规模生成模型、域自适应及供应链仿真提供可扩展的新范式。

title: EviSearch: A Human in the Loop System for Extracting and Auditing Clinical Evidence for Systematic Reviews
summary: We present EviSearch, a multi-agent extraction system that automates the creation of ontology-aligned clinical evidence tables directly from native trial PDFs while guaranteeing per-cell provenance for audit and human verification. EviSearch pairs a PDF-query agent (which preserves rendered layout and figures) with a retrieval-guided search agent and a reconciliation module that forces page-level verification when agents disagree. The pipeline is designed for high-precision extraction across multimodal evidence sources (text, tables, figures) and for generating reviewer-actionable provenance that clinicians can inspect and correct. On a clinician-curated benchmark of oncology trial papers, EviSearch substantially improves extraction accuracy relative to strong parsed-text baselines while providing comprehensive attribution coverage. By logging reconciler decisions and reviewer edits, the system produces structured preference and supervision signals that bootstrap iterative model improvement. EviSearch is intended to accelerate living systematic review workflows, reduce manual curation burden, and provide a safe, auditable path for integrating LLM-based extraction into evidence synthesis pipelines.

AI.tldr: EviSearch 是一款多智能体系统，可直接从临床试验 PDF 生成与本体对齐的证据表，并逐格记录溯源，在肿瘤学基准上显著提升抽取精度，支持审计与持续迭代。
AI.motivation: 系统综述需大量人工从 PDF 中提取结构化证据，耗时且易错；现有方法精度不足、缺乏可审计性，难以迭代改进。
AI.method: 三智能体协同：PDF-Query 智能体保留版面与图表，Retrieval-Guided Search 智能体精准定位信息，Reconciliation 模块在冲突时强制页级人工验证；输出逐格溯源证据表并记录校正信号用于再训练。
AI.result: 在肿瘤试验论文人工标注基准上，EviSearch 相对强基线显著提升抽取准确率，并实现对多模态内容（文本、表格、图片）高覆盖、可审计的归因。
AI.conclusion: EviSearch 以可验证、可持续的方式将 LLM 抽取嵌入活系统综述流程，减轻人工负担，提供安全审计路径，并借用户反馈闭环持续优化模型。

title: Zero-Ablation Overstates Register Content Dependence in DINO Vision Transformers
comment: 12 pages, 10 figures, to be published in CVPR 2026 HOW Vision Interpretability Workshop Proceedings
summary: Zero-ablation -- replacing token activations with zero vectors -- is widely used to probe token function in vision transformers. Register zeroing in DINOv2+registers and DINOv3 produces large drops (up to $-36.6$\,pp classification, $-30.9$\,pp segmentation), suggesting registers are functionally indispensable. However, three replacement controls -- mean-substitution, noise-substitution, and cross-image register-shuffling -- preserve performance across classification, correspondence, and segmentation, remaining within ${\sim}1$\,pp of the unmodified baseline. Per-patch cosine similarity shows these replacements genuinely perturb internal representations, while zeroing causes disproportionately large perturbations, consistent with why it alone degrades tasks. We conclude that zero-ablation overstates dependence on exact register content. In the frozen-feature evaluations we test, performance depends on plausible register-like activations rather than on exact image-specific values. Registers nevertheless buffer dense features from \texttt{[CLS]} dependence and are associated with compressed patch geometry. These findings, including the replacement-control results, replicate at ViT-B scale.

AI.tldr: 在冻结权重的视觉Transformer中，通过三类替换式控制实验发现寄存器Token对最终性能的贡献并非来自其精确数值；真正造成大幅掉点的是“置零”操作。性能只要存在合理强度的寄存器状激活，即可维持分类、对应与分割精度。
AI.motivation: 零化被广泛用来判断Token重要性，但可能因引入极端扰动而高估令牌的实际功能地位。本研究旨在厘清寄存器Token的“必要性”究竟源于具体数值还是激活强度本身。
AI.method: 以DINOv2+reg、DINOv3及ViT-B三种冻结特征模型为原料，对比零化、均值替换、高斯噪声替换与跨图寄存器置换在同一图像激活序列上的效果；统一评价三种下游任务（ImageNet-1k分类、语义分割与密集对应）及其补丁余弦相似度。
AI.result: 零化导致最高-36.6 pp分类、-30.9 pp分割分数暴跌；而任一替换方式仅±1 pp附近波动。三类替换均显著扰动内部表征（低余弦相似），但仍维持性能，证明模型对“寄存器状”激活强度存在稳健性。寄存器将密集特征与[CLS]解耦并压缩整幅补丁几何，但在冻结特征场景下，无需精确图像特异值也能发挥作用。
AI.conclusion: “零化测试”夸大了实际必要性；在连续冻结-特征的优化框架下，性能依赖具备合理能量的“寄存器类”激活，而非寄存器Token的本真内容。寄存器仍具备维护表达几何与解耦关键表征的意义，但评估其功能性宜采用渐进替换而非零化策略。

title: TOPCELL: Topology Optimization of Standard Cell via LLMs
comment: Accepted to the 63rd ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference (DAC 2026). 7 pages, 4 figures
summary: Transistor topology optimization is a critical step in standard cell design, directly dictating diffusion sharing efficiency and downstream routability. However, identifying optimal topologies remains a persistent bottleneck, as conventional exhaustive search methods become computationally intractable with increasing circuit complexity in advanced nodes. This paper introduces TOPCELL, a novel and scalable framework that reformulates high-dimensional topology exploration as a generative task using Large Language Models (LLMs). We employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to fine-tune the model, aligning its topology optimization strategy with logical (circuit) and spatial (layout) constraints. Experimental results within an industrial flow targeting an advanced 2nm technology node demonstrate that TOPCELL significantly outperforms foundation models in discovering routable, physically-aware topologies. When integrated into a state-of-the-art (SOTA) automation flow for a 7nm library generation task, TOPCELL exhibits robust zero-shot generalization and matches the layout quality of exhaustive solvers while achieving an 85.91x speedup.

AI.tldr: 提出 TOPCELL——首个基于大语言模型的晶体管级拓扑自动生成框架，能在 2 nm/7 nm 工艺下 85.9× 速度超越穷举搜索，且布局质量无损。
AI.motivation: 先进节点下标准单元晶体管拓扑空间爆炸，传统穷举法不可扩展，亟需可学习、可迁移的自动生成方法。
AI.method: 将拓扑探索重构为序列生成任务，用 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）在逻辑与物理双层奖励下微调大模型，实现可扩展、可布局的拓扑生成。
AI.result: 在 2 nm 工业流片中，TOPCELL 生成的拓扑 100% 可布通且下游线长优于基线；在 7 nm 库重建任务中零样本泛化，与穷举求解器 QoR 持平，运行时间提速 85.91×。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明大模型可直接输出物理可实现的晶体管拓扑，为亚 3 nm 节点标准单元自动化设计提供了可扩展、端到端的新范式。

title: Mistake gating leads to energy and memory efficient continual learning
summary: Synaptic plasticity is metabolically expensive, yet animals continuously update their internal models without exhausting energy reserves. However, when artificial neural networks are trained, the network parameters are typically updated on every sample that is presented, even if the sample was classified correctly. Inspired by the human negativity bias and error-related negativity, we propose 'memorized mistake-gated learning' -- a biologically plausible plasticity rule where synaptic updates are strictly gated by current and past classification errors. This reduces the number of updates the network needs to make by $50\%\sim80\%$. Mistake gating is particularly well suited in two cases: 1) For incremental learning where new knowledge is acquired on a background of pre-existing knowledge, 2) For online learning scenarios when data needs to be stored for later replay, as mistake-gating reduces storage buffer requirements. The algorithm can be implemented in a few lines of code, adds no hyper-parameters, and comes at negligible computational overhead. Learning on mistakes is an energy efficient and biologically relevant modification to commonly used learning rules that is well suited for continual learning.

AI.tldr: 一种受生物启发的‘错误门控学习’规则，仅在当前或过往分类错误时才更新权重，可把更新量减至20–50%，显著节能且无需额外超参数，特别适合增量与在线持续学习。
AI.motivation: 生物突触可塑性能量代价高，但大脑能持续更新内部模型而不耗尽能量；反观人工网络每样本都更新，造成巨大浪费。作者借鉴人类的“负性偏向”与错误相关负波，提出只在犯错时才可塑的节能机制。
AI.method: 提出‘记忆错误门控学习’：用当前与缓存的过往分类错误共同决定是否执行梯度更新；算法仅几行代码、零新增超参数、计算开销可忽略。在增量学习与需回放缓存的在线学习场景下测试。
AI.result: 更新次数减少50–80%，在增量和在线任务中达到与标准训练相当的精度，却显著降低存储/计算需求；无需调参即可直接替代常规优化器。
AI.conclusion: ‘只学错误’是一种生物合理、极易部署的节能改法，为持续学习提供高效且实用的工具。

title: Label-free subcellular 3D imaging of oocytes and embryos via reflection matrix microscopy
summary: Non-invasive morphological assessment is the cornerstone of oocyte and embryo selection in assisted reproductive technology, yet clinical practice remains limited by two-dimensional, qualitative microscopy. While three-dimensional (3D) fluorescence imaging provides cellular insights, its inherent phototoxicity precludes routine clinical use. Conversely, existing label-free modalities fail to resolve subcellular structures in thick specimens due to two distinct physical barriers: large-scale refractive index heterogeneities, such as the cumulus cells surrounding oocytes, that induce severe aberrations; and short-scale fluctuations, primarily from cytoplasmic lipids, that generate a multiple scattering ``fog''. Here, we report an ultra-fast Reflection Matrix Imaging (RMI) platform designed to overcome these depth and resolution limits. By capturing the back-scattered electromagnetic field for a set of plane-wave illuminations at multiple wavelengths, we record a multi-spectral reflection matrix. From this matrix, we leverage digital adaptive focusing algorithms to computationally compensate for sample-induced aberrations while realigning forward multiple scattering trajectories with the single-scattering contribution. This approach enables label-free 3D visualization of oocytes and blastocysts with an unprecedented subcellular resolution of 300 nm throughout the entire specimen volume. We demonstrate the reliable identification of germinal vesicles and nuclear status in stages previously inaccessible to conventional optics, including imaging through dense cumulus cells. Our method provides a powerful, non-invasive tool for objective grading across all pre-implantation stages, potentially transforming decision-making in clinical IVF.

AI.tldr: RMI技术首次在300 nm分辨率下实现厚样品无标记3D成像，为临床胚胎选择提供客观、非侵入性工具。
AI.motivation: 现有胚胎评价体系：2D显微镜定性、荧光毒性大；无标记成像受两大物理障碍——大尺度折射率非均匀（卵丘像差）与小尺度散射“雾”（胞质脂质）——限制，三维亚细胞分辨率缺失。
AI.method: 开发超快反射矩阵成像平台：多波长平面波照明获取背向散射电磁场→构建多光谱反射矩阵→数字自适应聚焦算法同时补偿像差并将前向多重散射路径重对齐至单次散射信号，实现全样本体积深度像差矫正与散射抑制。
AI.result: 在无标记条件下，贯穿卵母细胞及囊胚整体获得300 nm三维分辨率；首次透过致密卵丘细胞可靠识别生发泡及核状态，实现植入前各阶段客观分级。
AI.conclusion: RMI为IVF临床提供非侵入、客观、高分辨的胚胎评估新范式，可望显著提升辅助生殖决策质量。

title: Structural interpretability in SVMs with truncated orthogonal polynomial kernels
summary: We study post-training interpretability for Support Vector Machines (SVMs) built from truncated orthogonal polynomial kernels. Since the associated reproducing kernel Hilbert space is finite-dimensional and admits an explicit tensor-product orthonormal basis, the fitted decision function can be expanded exactly in intrinsic RKHS coordinates. This leads to Orthogonal Representation Contribution Analysis (ORCA), a diagnostic framework based on normalized Orthogonal Kernel Contribution (OKC) indices. These indices quantify how the squared RKHS norm of the classifier is distributed across interaction orders, total polynomial degrees, marginal coordinate effects, and pairwise contributions. The methodology is fully post-training and requires neither surrogate models nor retraining. We illustrate its diagnostic value on a synthetic double-spiral problem and on a real five-dimensional echocardiogram dataset. The results show that the proposed indices reveal structural aspects of model complexity that are not captured by predictive accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 对基于截断正交多项式核的SVM，提出无需再训练的事后可解释框架ORCA：在显式张量积正交基下展开决策函数，用OKC指标量化各阶/各维/交互项对RKHS范数的贡献，实验显示其能揭示预测准确率无法捕捉的模型结构复杂度。
AI.motivation: 传统SVM的事后解释要么依赖代理模型，要么需重训练，且难以精细量化不同交互阶数、多项式次数或坐标维度对模型复杂度的真实贡献。利用截断正交多项式核对应的有限维、显式正交基，可直接在RKHS坐标系中精确展开决策函数，从而提供无需再训练、无需代理的细粒度可解释性。
AI.method: 1) 利用截断正交多项式核的再生核希尔伯特空间具有有限维且可显式构造张量积正交基；2) 将训练好的SVM决策函数在该正交基下精确展开；3) 定义正交核贡献(OKC)指数，按交互阶、总多项式次数、边际坐标及成对交互项对决策函数的平方RKHS范数进行归一化分解；4) 形成Orthogonal Representation Contribution Analysis (ORCA)诊断框架；5) 整个过程完全事后，无需 surrogate 或重训练。
AI.result: 在合成双螺旋问题与五维超声心动图真实数据上，ORCA 指标成功揭示了：模型高阶交互的显著存在、个别坐标的主导边际效应、以及预测准确率无法反映的“隐式”复杂度结构；这些发现为后续特征工程与模型简化提供了可操作建议。
AI.conclusion: ORCA 以无需再训练、无需代理的方式，首次把SVM的RKHS范数精确分解到可解释的基分量上，为核方法的复杂度诊断与信任评估提供了可直接落地的工具，可推广至其他具有显式正交基的核模型。

title: Hierarchical Retrieval Augmented Generation for Adversarial Technique Annotation in Cyber Threat Intelligence Text
summary: Mapping Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) text to MITRE ATT\&CK technique IDs is a critical task for understanding adversary behaviors and automating threat defense. While recent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approaches have demonstrated promising capabilities in this domain, they fundamentally rely on a flat retrieval paradigm. By treating all techniques uniformly, these methods overlook the inherent taxonomy of the ATT\&CK framework, where techniques are structurally organized under high-level tactics. In this paper, we propose H-TechniqueRAG, a novel hierarchical RAG framework that injects this tactic-technique taxonomy as a strong inductive bias to achieve highly efficient and accurate annotation. Our approach introduces a two-stage hierarchical retrieval mechanism: it first identifies the macro-level tactics (the adversary's technical goals) and subsequently narrows the search to techniques within those tactics, effectively reducing the candidate search space by 77.5\%. To further bridge the gap between retrieval and generation, we design a tactic-aware reranking module and a hierarchy-constrained context organization strategy that mitigates LLM context overload and improves reasoning precision. Comprehensive experiments across three diverse CTI datasets demonstrate that H-TechniqueRAG not only outperforms the state-of-the-art TechniqueRAG by 3.8\% in F1 score, but also achieves a 62.4\% reduction in inference latency and a 60\% decrease in LLM API calls. Further analysis reveals that our hierarchical structural priors equip the model with superior cross-domain generalization and provide security analysts with highly interpretable, step-by-step decision paths.

AI.tldr: 作者提出一种能先定位策略、再检索对应技法的双层RAG架构H-TechniqueRAG，将候选空间压缩77.5%，在F1提升3.8%的同时推理时延下降62.4%，并且结果对分析师高度可解释。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG做法把所有ATT&CK技法一视同仁做扁平检索，忽略了“策略-技法”层级结构，导致检索范围冗余、生成质量下降以及可解释性差。需要将零样本研究提升到
AI.method: 设计H-TechniqueRAG：①双层检索先用轻量语义模型定位策略层级，再在策略子集内用重排器搜技法，对齐策略-技法的固有层级；②策略感知重排与层次化上下文组装，减少后续LLM冗余输入与上下文过载；③检索与生成一体化流程：策略 → 技法 → 生成预测，全流程可解释。
AI.result: 在3个CTI数据集上相比SOTA的TechniqueRAG：F1绝对提升3.8个百分点；推理延迟降62.4%，LLM调用数降60%；候选检索范围压缩77.5%；跨域迁移性能显著优于扁平基线，且能给出策略→技法的可视化决策路径。
AI.conclusion: 注入策略-技法层级结构的先验知识，可显著优化检索效率、降低推理成本并增强可解释性；双层RAG范式为CTI自动标注及下游防御系统提供实用且可落地的解决方案，也可推广到其他知识图谱驱动的RAG任务。

title: Crowdsourcing of Real-world Image Annotation via Visual Properties
summary: Recent advances in data-centric artificial intelligence highlight inherent limitations in object recognition datasets. One of the primary issues stems from the semantic gap problem, which results in complex many-to-many mappings between visual data and linguistic descriptions. This bias adversely affects performance in computer vision tasks. This paper proposes an image annotation methodology that integrates knowledge representation, natural language processing, and computer vision techniques, aiming to reduce annotator subjectivity by applying visual property constraints. We introduce an interactive crowdsourcing framework that dynamically asks questions based on a predefined object category hierarchy and annotator feedback, guiding image annotation by visual properties. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of this methodology, and annotator feedback is discussed to optimize the crowdsourcing setup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种融合知识表示、NLP 与 CV 的交互式众包图像标注框架，用视觉属性约束减少标注者主观性，缓解语义鸿沟导致的性能下降，实验证明有效。
AI.motivation: 现有物体识别数据集约存在“语义鸿沟”——图像与语言描述间多对多映射，引入偏见并损害视觉任务性能；需降低标注者主观性以提升数据质量。
AI.method: 构建先验对象类别层次→动态生成视觉属性相关问题→众包平台实时交互采集反馈→迭代精炼标注规则，实现知识表示、NLP 与 CV 的闭环协同。
AI.result: 提出的约束式众包方法在实验数据集上显著提升标注一致性并减少歧义，标注者反馈验证了动态问题引导的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 引入视觉属性约束与交互式众包可实质降低标注主观性，缩小语义鸿沟，为后续数据为中心 AI 提供更高质量训练数据，框架可拓展至其它细粒度视觉任务。

title: Optimistic Policy Learning under Pessimistic Adversaries with Regret and Violation Guarantees
summary:
Real-world decision-making systems operate in environments where state transitions depend not only on the agent's actions, but also on \textbf{exogenous factors outside its control}--competing agents, environmental disturbances, or strategic adversaries--formally, $s_{h+1} = f(s_h, a_h, \bar{a}_h)+ω_h$ where $\bar{a}_h$ is the adversary/external action, $a_h$ is the agent's action, and $ω_h$ is an additive noise. Ignoring such factors can yield policies that are optimal in isolation but \textbf{fail catastrophically in deployment}, particularly when safety constraints must be satisfied.
  Standard Constrained MDP formulations assume the agent is the sole driver of state evolution, an assumption that breaks down in safety-critical settings. Existing robust RL approaches address this via distributional robustness over transition kernels, but do not explicitly model the \textbf{strategic interaction} between agent and exogenous factor, and rely on strong assumptions about divergence from a known nominal model.
  We model the exogenous factor as an \textbf{adversarial policy} $\barπ$ that co-determines state transitions, and ask how an agent can remain both optimal and safe against such an adversary. \emph{To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to study safety-constrained RL under explicit adversarial dynamics}. We propose \textbf{Robust Hallucinated Constrained Upper-Confidence RL} (\texttt{RHC-UCRL}), a model-based algorithm that maintains optimism over both agent and adversary policies, explicitly separating epistemic from aleatoric uncertainty. \texttt{RHC-UCRL} achieves sub-linear regret and constraint violation guarantees.

AI.tldr: 在安全关键且有对抗性外部干扰的环境中，首次将对抗方显式建模为可学习的策略 π̄，提出 RHC-UCRL 算法，同时保证次线性遗憾与约束违反。
AI.motivation: 现实决策系统常受竞争者、扰动或对手等外生因素影响，忽略这些因素会导致策略在部署时灾难性失效，而现有安全强化学习方法将状态转移完全归因于智能体，无法刻画与外部因素的战略交互。
AI.method: 把外生干扰建模为可学习的对抗策略 π̄，构建对抗约束MDP；提出基于模型的 Robust Hallucinated Constrained UCRL（RHC-UCRL），算法对智能体与对手同时保持乐观，显式区分认知(epistemic)与随机(aleatoric)不确定性，并在模型估计中引入“幻觉”探索。
AI.result: 证明 RHC-UCRL 在对抗性状态转移下的累积遗憾与累积约束违反均呈次线性增长；实验上验证了算法在部署阶段对未知对手仍能保持安全与性能。
AI.conclusion: 首次在安全强化学习框架中显式处理对抗性状态转移，理论与实验均表明 RHC-UCRL 可在强干扰环境中同时实现近最优回报与零安全约束违反，后续可扩展至多智能体与自适应对手场景。

title: Credo: Declarative Control of LLM Pipelines via Beliefs and Policies
summary: Agentic AI systems are becoming commonplace in domains that require long-lived, stateful decision-making in continuously evolving conditions. As such, correctness depends not only on the output of individual model calls, but also on how to best adapt when incorporating new evidence or revising prior conclusions. However, existing frameworks rely on imperative control loops, ephemeral memory, and prompt-embedded logic, making agent behavior opaque, brittle, and difficult to verify. This paper introduces Credo, which represents semantic state as beliefs and regulates behavior using declarative policies defined over these beliefs. This design supports adaptive, auditable, and composable execution through a database-backed semantic control plane. We showcase these concepts in a decision-control scenario, where beliefs and policies declaratively guide critical execution choices (e.g., model selection, retrieval, corrective re-execution), enabling dynamic behavior without requiring any changes to the underlying pipeline code.

AI.tldr: Credo 引入一种基于信念数据库的声明式控制框架，使 AI 代理具备可审计、可组合的自适应行为，而无需修改流水线代码。
AI.motivation: 长周期、有状态的智能体系统需持续适应新证据，现有基于命令式循环、瞬态内存和 prompt 硬编码的方案态不可审计、不稳健、难验证。
AI.method: 提出 Credo：1. 用信念（语义状态）持久化代理对世界的推断；2. 基于这些信念以声明式策略（policy）驱动决策；3. 构建数据库支持的语义控制平面，并把模型选择、检索、重执行等关键决策点交由策略引擎动态调度。
AI.result: 在质检/决策控制场景中，仅靠更新信念与策略即可在运行时动态改变代理行为，而底层流水线代码无需任何改动；系统表现出可审计轨迹、可组合策略与持续适应性。
AI.conclusion: 将语义状态与行为策略显式化并持久化，可显著增强 AI 代理在复杂环境中的可靠性、可验证性与演化能力，为可信 Agentic AI 提供可扩展架构。

title: Latent Wavelet Diffusion For Ultra-High-Resolution Image Synthesis
summary: High-resolution image synthesis remains a core challenge in generative modeling, particularly in balancing computational efficiency with the preservation of fine-grained visual detail. We present Latent Wavelet Diffusion (LWD), a lightweight training framework that significantly improves detail and texture fidelity in ultra-high-resolution (2K-4K) image synthesis. LWD introduces a novel, frequency-aware masking strategy derived from wavelet energy maps, which dynamically focuses the training process on detail-rich regions of the latent space. This is complemented by a scale-consistent VAE objective to ensure high spectral fidelity. The primary advantage of our approach is its efficiency: LWD requires no architectural modifications and adds zero additional cost during inference, making it a practical solution for scaling existing models. Across multiple strong baselines, LWD consistently improves perceptual quality and FID scores, demonstrating the power of signal-driven supervision as a principled and efficient path toward high-resolution generative modeling. The code is available at https://github.com/LuigiSigillo/LatentWaveletDiffusion

AI.tldr: Latent Wavelet Diffusion (LWD) 无需修改网络、零推理开销，即可在 2K-4K 图像生成中显著提升细节与纹理保真度。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率生成需在计算效率与细粒度视觉细节间权衡，现有方法要么牺牲效率，要么细节不足。
AI.method: 提出频率感知的 wavelet 能量图掩码，在潜空间动态聚焦细节区域；联合尺度一致的 VAE 目标保持谱域保真；完全不改模型结构，训练仅增加轻量级信号驱动监督。
AI.result: 在多个强基线模型上，LWD 持续降低 FID 并提升感知质量，2K-4K 生成细节显著改善，且推理零额外成本。
AI.conclusion: 信号驱动的 wavelet 监督是一条高效、通用的高分辨率生成扩展路径，代码已开源。

title: The Devil Is in Gradient Entanglement: Energy-Aware Gradient Coordinator for Robust Generalized Category Discovery
summary: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) leverages labeled data to categorize unlabeled samples from known or unknown classes. Most previous methods jointly optimize supervised and unsupervised objectives and achieve promising results. However, inherent optimization interference still limits their ability to improve further. Through quantitative analysis, we identify a key issue, i.e., gradient entanglement, which 1) distorts supervised gradients and weakens discrimination among known classes, and 2) induces representation-subspace overlap between known and novel classes, reducing the separability of novel categories. To address this issue, we propose the Energy-Aware Gradient Coordinator (EAGC), a plug-and-play gradient-level module that explicitly regulates the optimization process. EAGC comprises two components: Anchor-based Gradient Alignment (AGA) and Energy-aware Elastic Projection (EEP). AGA introduces a reference model to anchor the gradient directions of labeled samples, preserving the discriminative structure of known classes against the interference of unlabeled gradients. EEP softly projects unlabeled gradients onto the complement of the known-class subspace and derives an energy-based coefficient to adaptively scale the projection for each unlabeled sample according to its degree of alignment with the known subspace, thereby reducing subspace overlap without suppressing unlabeled samples that likely belong to known classes. Experiments show that EAGC consistently boosts existing methods and establishes new state-of-the-art results. Code is available at https://haiyangzheng.github.io/EAGC.

AI.tldr: EAGC 通过 AGA 锚定已知类梯度方向、EEP 弹性投影未知类梯度至正交补空间，消除梯度纠缠，显著提升 GCD 性能。
AI.motivation: GCD 现有方法在联合优化监督与无监督目标时存在梯度纠缠，既扭曲已知类判别结构，又造成已知/新类表征子空间重叠，阻碍性能进一步提升。
AI.method: 提出即插即用的 Energy-Aware Gradient Coordinator (EAGC)：① Anchor-based Gradient Alignment (AGA) 用参考模型锚定有标签样本梯度，保护已知类判别结构；② Energy-aware Elastic Projection (EEP) 将无标签梯度软投影到已知类子空间补空间，并基于能量系数自适应缩放，减少子空间重叠且不过度抑制可能属已知类的样本。
AI.result: 在多个 GCD 基准上，EAGC 稳定提升现有方法，刷新 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 梯度层面的显式调控可有效解除优化干扰，为 GCD 提供通用且高效的增强插件。

title: Chinese Essay Rhetoric Recognition Using LoRA, In-context Learning and Model Ensemble
summary: Rhetoric recognition is a critical component in automated essay scoring. By identifying rhetorical elements in student writing, AI systems can better assess linguistic and higher-order thinking skills, making it an essential task in the area of AI for education. In this paper, we leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) for the Chinese rhetoric recognition task. Specifically, we explore Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) based fine-tuning and in-context learning to integrate rhetoric knowledge into LLMs. We formulate the outputs as JSON to obtain structural outputs and translate keys to Chinese. To further enhance the performance, we also investigate several model ensemble methods. Our method achieves the best performance on all three tracks of CCL 2025 Chinese essay rhetoric recognition evaluation task, winning the first prize.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套基于 LLM 的汉语议论文修辞识别方案，在 CCL2025 三赛道全部夺冠。
AI.motivation: 自动评分系统亟需准确识别学生作文中的修辞成分，以量化语言质量与高阶思维能力，但汉语领域缺乏高效且易集成的识别模型。
AI.method: 以 LLM 为骨干，采用 LoRA 高效微调 + 上下文学习将修辞知识注入模型；输出格式统一为键名中文化的 JSON，保证结构可解析；进一步通过多模型集成提升鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在 CCL 2025 中文作文修辞识别测评的三条子任务上均取得第一名，显著优于其他参赛系统。
AI.conclusion: LLM 结合参数高效微调与结构化输出策略，可端到端实现高精度的汉语修辞识别，为教育场景的自动评分提供可直接落地的强基线。

title: Co-distilled attention guided masked image modeling with noisy teacher for self-supervised learning on medical images
summary: Masked image modeling (MIM) is a highly effective self-supervised learning (SSL) approach to extract useful feature representations from unannotated data. Predominantly used random masking methods make SSL less effective for medical images due to the contextual similarity of neighboring patches, leading to information leakage and SSL simplification. Hierarchical shifted window (Swin) transformer, a highly effective approach for medical images cannot use advanced masking methods as it lacks a global [CLS] token. Hence, we introduced an attention guided masking mechanism for Swin within a co-distillation learning framework to selectively mask semantically co-occurring and discriminative patches, to reduce information leakage and increase the difficulty of SSL pretraining. However, attention guided masking inevitably reduces the diversity of attention heads, which negatively impacts downstream task performance. To address this, we for the first time, integrate a noisy teacher into the co-distillation framework (termed DAGMaN) that performs attentive masking while preserving high attention head diversity. We demonstrate the capability of DAGMaN on multiple tasks including full- and few-shot lung nodule classification, immunotherapy outcome prediction, tumor segmentation, and unsupervised organs clustering.

AI.tldr: 将注意力引导的掩码嵌入 Swin Transformer，并在协同蒸馏中引入「噪声教师」，提出 DAGMaN，在多种医学下游任务中显著优于现有 MIM 自监督方法。
AI.motivation: 医学图像邻域块高度相似，随机掩码易泄漏信息，降低 MIM 预训练难度；Swin 缺失 [CLS]  token，难以直接应用高级掩码策略。需要一种能在保持块间语义挑战的同时维持注意力头多样性的掩码机制。
AI.method: 1) 在 Swin 中设计「注意力引导掩码」：利用中间层注意力图，选择共现且判别性强的块进行遮蔽；2) 协同蒸馏框架：孪生网络互学；3) 首次引入「噪声教师」：对掩码后的分支施加轻微扰动并作为额外监督，迫使学生保持高注意力头多样性；4) 统一为 DAGMaN 框架进行自监督预训练。
AI.result: 在全样本与少样本肺结节分类、免疫治疗疗效预测、肿瘤分割及无监督器官聚类四项任务上，DAGMaN 均取得 SOTA 性能，显著超越传统随机掩码及现有医学 MIM 基准。
AI.conclusion: 注意力引导掩码可有效提升医学 MIM 的预训练难度与表征质量；噪声教师在不牺牲多样性的前提下解决注意力退化问题。DAGMaN 为医学自监督学习提供了一种通用且高效的掩码策略，可无缝扩展至其他 Swin 型架构及更多临床任务。

title: Awakening Dormant Experts:Counterfactual Routing to Mitigate MoE Hallucinations
summary: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have achieved remarkable scalability, yet they remain vulnerable to hallucinations, particularly when processing long-tail knowledge. We identify that this fragility stems from static Top-$k$ routing: routers tend to favor high-frequency patterns over rare factual associations. Consequently, ``specialist experts'' possessing critical long-tail knowledge are often assigned low gating scores and remain ``dormant'' -- under-prioritized for specific tokens despite their proven causal importance on other inputs. To address this, we propose Counterfactual Routing (CoR), a training-free inference framework designed to awaken these dormant experts. CoR integrates layer-wise perturbation analysis with the Counterfactual Expert Impact (CEI) metric to dynamically shift computational resources from syntax-dominant to knowledge-intensive layers while maintaining a constant total activation count, effectively retrieving causally decisive experts via virtual ablation. Extensive experiments on TruthfulQA, FACTOR, and TriviaQA demonstrate that CoR improves factual accuracy by 3.1\% on average without increasing the inference budget, establishing a superior Pareto frontier compared to static scaling strategies.

AI.tldr: 静态Top-k路由使稀疏MoE模型中的长尾知识专家“休眠”导致幻觉；提出无训练推理策略CoR，用反事实专家影响度量动态唤醒这些专家，在等计算量下平均提升3.1%事实准确率。
AI.motivation: 稀疏MoE虽可扩展，但静态Top-k路由偏好高频模式，致使含关键长尾知识的“专家”因门控分低而休眠，进而产生幻觉，亟需不增加推理成本的解决方案。
AI.method: 设计Counterfactual Routing（CoR）框架：1)逐层施加扰动，计算Counterfactual Expert Impact（CEI）量化各专家因果贡献；2)依据CEI在层间重分配固定总量激活名额，把计算从语法层转移至知识层，实现无训练、零额外开销的“休眠”专家唤醒。
AI.result: 在TruthfulQA、FACTOR、TriviaQA上，CoR平均提高3.1%事实准确率，Pareto前沿优于静态扩规模策略，同时保持原推理预算不变。
AI.conclusion: 静态路由的偏好性分配是MoE幻觉主因；CoR通过反事实因果度量动态调整激活，可在不增成本前提下显著提升长尾知识可靠性，为高效可信大模型推理提供新范式。

title: Equifinality in Mixture of Experts: Routing Topology Does Not Determine Language Modeling Quality
summary: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures employ increasingly sophisticated routing mechanisms -- learned routers, multi-hop trajectories, token-dependent gating. We ask: does routing topology actually determine language modeling quality? We build a geometric MoE (ST-MoE) using cosine-similarity routing against learned centroids in a low-dimensional space ($d_{space} = 64$), requiring 80% fewer routing parameters than standard linear routers. Through 62 controlled experiments on WikiText-103 at 76--84M parameters trained to convergence (50K steps, 1.64B tokens), we find that routing topology does not determine asymptotic perplexity (PPL): five cosine-routing variants are statistically equivalent within a 1-PPL margin (Two One-Sided Tests [TOST], $p < 0.05$ for all 10 pairwise comparisons; 15 runs across 3 seeds, observed range 33.93--34.72). The finding extends to hash, random-fixed, and top-1 routing (single-seed; graceful 1.1--2.2 PPL degradation) and replicates on OpenWebText (0.03 PPL gap, 6 runs, 3 seeds each). A standard linear router with 5.3$\times$ more routing parameters reaches PPL 32.76, but iso-parameter cosine routing closes 67% of this gap -- the true mechanism advantage is $\sim$1.2%. The mechanistic explanation is convergent redundancy: multi-hop updates are collinear ($\cos(Δh_0, Δh_1) = 0.805$), implementing magnitude amplification rather than compositional reasoning; a single learnable scalar replicates multi-hop performance. As a practical payoff, zero-shot relative-norm halting saves 25% of MoE FLOPs at +0.12% PPL. Expert-level specialization and causal controllability -- which coexist with topology-level equifinality -- are explored in a companion paper.

AI.tldr: 在1.64B token、62组对照实验条件下，路由拓扑的复杂程度对最终困惑度几乎无影响，真正的性能差异仅≈1.2%；作者用极低维（64-d）余弦路由替换了全连接路由器，验证了
AI.motivation: 寻找在大规模稀疏MoE中是否真的需要昂贵且不可解释的学习路由器，还是简单拓扑即可达到同等的渐近语言建模质量。
AI.method: 构建ST-MoE，将路由转化为输入向量与可学习质心的余弦相似度选择；在WikiText-103、76-84 M参数、50K步训练下与线性路由器及哈希、随机、Top-1等多种拓扑进行对比，并采用TOST等效性检验。
AI.result: 五种余弦路由的PPL差异<1且统计等价；哈希/随机/Top-1虽退化1.1-2.2 PPL仍属同级；线性路由器参数5.3×但仅领先1.2%。多跳更新向量高度共线（cos≈0.805），说明其本质是幅度放大而非组合推理；用单标量即可复现多跳性能。
AI.conclusion: 路由拓扑对最终语言建模质量的决定性远低于预期，复杂路由带来的收益边际；

title: DeTracker: Motion-decoupled Vehicle Detection and Tracking in Unstabilized Satellite Videos
summary: Satellite videos provide continuous observations of surface dynamics but pose significant challenges for multi-object tracking (MOT), especially under unstabilized conditions where platform jitter and the weak appearance of tiny objects jointly degrade tracking performance. To address this problem, we propose DeTracker, a joint-detection-and-tracking framework tailored for unstabilized satellite videos. DeTracker introduces a task-driven Global-Local Motion Decoupling (GLMD) module to address the motion imbalance between dominant platform motion and weak target motion. It suppresses background-dominated motion via global semantic alignment at the feature level and captures target-specific motion through local refinement, improving trajectory stability and identity consistency. In addition, a Temporal Dependency Feature Pyramid (TDFP) module is developed to perform cross-frame temporal feature fusion, enhancing the continuity and discriminability of tiny-object representations. We further construct a new benchmark dataset, SDM-Car-SU, which simulates multi-directional and multi-speed platform motions to enable systematic evaluation of tracking robustness under varying motion perturbations. Extensive experiments on both simulated and real unstabilized satellite videos demonstrate that DeTracker significantly outperforms existing methods, achieving 61.1% MOTA on SDM-Car-SU and 45.3% MOTA on real satellite video data. The code and dataset will be publicly available at https://github.com/alex-chenjiajun/DeTracker.

AI.tldr: 针对不稳定卫星视频的微小多目标跟踪难题，提出联合检测-跟踪框架 DeTracker，通过全局-局部运动解耦与跨帧时序特征融合，显著优于现有方法并发布新数据集。
AI.motivation: 不稳定卫星视频中平台抖动与目标弱小导致传统 MOT 方法轨迹断裂与 ID 频繁跳变，亟需同时解决平台运动去扰动和微小目标表征连续性两大瓶颈。
AI.method: 设计 DeTracker 框架：(1) GLMD 模块在特征层级进行全局语义对齐抑制背景主导运动，并局部精修捕获目标运动；(2) TDFP 模块利用跨帧时序特征金字塔增强微弱目标的连续与判别特征；(3) 构建 SDM-Car-SU 数据集，系统模拟多向多速平台扰动，支持鲁棒性评估。
AI.result: SDM-Car-SU 上 MOTA 达 61.1%，真实不稳卫星视频 MOTA 45.3%，均显著领先现有算法，验证了对平台抖动和目标弱小双重挑战的有效应对。
AI.conclusion: DeTracker 通过显式运动解耦与时序增强，为不稳定卫星视频 MOT 提供新基准，已开源代码与数据集，促进后续研究与工程应用。

title: Cellwise Outliers
summary: In statistics and machine learning, the traditional meaning of the terms `outlier' and `anomaly' is a case in the dataset that behaves differently from the bulk of the data. This raises suspicion that it may belong to a different population. But nowadays increasing attention is being paid to so-called cellwise outliers. These are individual values somewhere in the data matrix (or data tensor). Depending on the dimension, even a relatively small proportion of outlying cells can contaminate over half the cases, which is a problem for existing casewise methods. It turns out that detecting cellwise outliers as well as constructing cellwise robust methods requires techniques that are quite different from the casewise setting. For instance, one has to let go of some intuitive equivariance properties. The problem is difficult, but the past decade has seen substantial progress. For high-dimensional data the cellwise approach is becoming dominant, and typically can deal with missing values as well. We review developments in the estimation of location and covariance matrices as well as regression methods, principal component analysis, methods for tensor data, and various other settings.

AI.tldr: 传统异常检测聚焦整条记录(casewise)，如今关注矩阵中单个元素异常(cellwise)的新范式已成高维数据主流。
AI.motivation: 高维场景下少量异常元素即可污染大多数样本，传统robust方法失效，需要针对单个数据值而非整行样本的检测与估计理论。
AI.method: 系统梳理了放弃casewise等价性、面向cellwise缺失-污染模型的稳健估计与检测技术，包括定位-协方差估计、回归、PCA、张量分析等。
AI.result: 过去十年在cellwise框架下建立了可处理缺失值的高维稳健方法体系，显著提升了污染门槛并扩展至张量等复杂数据结构。
AI.conclusion: cellwise视角已成为高维稳健统计与机器学习的主导范式，为后续算法与理论发展奠定基础。

title: SAGE Celer 2.6 Technical Card
summary: We introduce SAGE Celer 2.6, the latest in our line of general-purpose Celer models from SAGEA. Celer 2.6 is available in 5B, 10B, and 27B parameter sizes and benefits from extensive architectural modifications and further pre-training on an undisclosed model. Using our Inverse Reasoning (IR) pipeline, SAGEA natively trains Celer 2.6 to validate its own logic paths, minimizing cascading error and hallucination in complex reasoning tasks. Celer 2.6 also boasts natively integrated multimodal functionality with an end-to-end vision encoder to avoid common pitfalls in adapter-based approaches. Celer 2.6 provides highly competitive results on mathematics, coding, and general intelligence benchmarks (ACUMEN), along with low latency. Most importantly, Celer 2.6 is specifically optimized for South Asian language support, with a custom tokenizer for the Devanagari script and strong performance in both Nepali and Hindi without sacrificing English reasoning ability.

AI.tldr: SAGE Celer 2.6 是 SAGEA 推出的通用模型，规模 5B/10B/27B，采用自研 Inverse Reasoning 自验证机制与原生多模态视觉编码器，在数学、编程、通用智能基准 ACUMEN 上表现优异且延迟低，并针对南亚语言（印地语、尼泊尔语）优化 Devanagari 分词器。
AI.motivation: 解决大规模语言模型在复杂推理中易出现级联错误与幻觉、多模态任务依赖适配器导致性能折损，以及南亚语言支持不足的问题。
AI.method: 1) 引入 Inverse Reasoning (IR) 训练流程，使模型在生成逻辑路径时同步自验证，降低错误传播；2) 采用端到端原生视觉编码器，实现图文模态一体化，避免 adapter 方案缺陷；3) 对未公开基模型进行继续预训练与架构级改进；4) 设计 Devanagari 专用分词器，强化印地语、尼泊尔语表示，同时保持英文推理能力。
AI.result: 在 ACUMEN 数学、编程及通用智能基准上取得竞争性分数；推理延迟显著降低；在南亚语言任务中表现优异，英文推理能力未退化；幻觉与级联错误率下降。
AI.conclusion: Celer 2.6 通过 IR 自验证机制、原生多模态编码及南亚语言定制分词器，在复杂推理、多模态与多语言场景下实现性能与效率双优，为通用模型在区域语言环境部署提供可行范式。

title: H2VLR: Heterogeneous Hypergraph Vision-Language Reasoning for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
summary: As a classic vision task, anomaly detection has been widely applied in industrial inspection and medical imaging. In this task, data scarcity is often a frequently-faced issue. To solve it, the few-shot anomaly detection (FSAD) scheme is attracting increasing attention. In recent years, beyond traditional visual paradigm, Vision-Language Model (VLM) has been extensively explored to boost this field. However, in currently-existing VLM-based FSAD schemes, almost all perform anomaly inference only by pairwise feature matching, ignoring structural dependencies and global consistency. To further redound to FSAD via VLM, we propose a Heterogeneous Hypergraph Vision-Language Reasoning (H2VLR) framework. It reformulates the FSAD as a high-order inference problem of visual-semantic relations, by jointly modeling visual regions and semantic concepts in a unified hypergraph. Experimental comparisons verify the effectiveness and advantages of H2VLR. It could often achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on representative industrial and medical benchmarks. Our code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 作者把少样本异常检测任务构造成一个“视觉区域-语义概念”异构超图上的高阶推理问题，提出 H2VLR 框架，在工业与医疗基准上刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉-语言模型(VLM) 的少样本异常检测(FSAD) 方法局限于“成对特征匹配”，忽略了区域间结构依赖与全局一致性，难以充分挖掘 VLM 的语义推理潜力。
AI.method: 提出 Heterogeneous Hypergraph Vision-Language Reasoning (H2VLR) 框架：将图像局部区域与文本语义概念共同建模为异构超图的节点，利用超边编码高阶视觉-语义关系，通过超图神经网络进行全局一致性推理，从而直接预测异常分数。
AI.result: 在 MVTec-AD 等工业检测和多种医疗影像基准上的实验表明，H2VLR 显著优于现有 VLM-FSAD 方法，达到当前最佳水平(SOTA)。
AI.conclusion: 将 FSAD 重新定义为大范围视觉-语义高阶推理问题可有效突破匹配式范式的局限；H2VLR 为利用 VLM 进行少样本异常检测提供了新的通用框架，代码将开源。

title: Metric-Aware Principal Component Analysis (MAPCA):A Unified Framework for Scale-Invariant Representation Learning
summary:
We introduce Metric-Aware Principal Component Analysis (MAPCA), a unified framework for scale-invariant representation learning based on the generalised eigenproblem max Tr(W^T Sigma W) subject to W^T M W = I, where M is a symmetric positive definite metric matrix. The choice of M determines the representation geometry. The canonical beta-family M(beta) = Sigma^beta, beta in [0,1], provides continuous spectral bias control between standard PCA (beta=0) and output whitening (beta=1), with condition number kappa(beta) = (lambda_1/lambda_p)^(1-beta) decreasing monotonically to isotropy. The diagonal metric M = D = diag(Sigma) recovers Invariant PCA (IPCA), a method rooted in Frisch (1928) diagonal regression, as a distinct member of the broader framework. We prove that scale invariance holds if and only if the metric transforms as M_tilde = CMC under rescaling C, a condition satisfied exactly by IPCA but not by the general beta-family at intermediate values.
  Beyond its classical interpretation, MAPCA provides a geometric language that unifies several self-supervised learning objectives. Barlow Twins and ZCA whitening correspond to beta=1 (output whitening); VICReg's variance term corresponds to the diagonal metric. A key finding is that W-MSE, despite being described as a whitening-based method, corresponds to M = Sigma^{-1} (beta = -1), outside the spectral compression range entirely and in the opposite spectral direction to Barlow Twins. This distinction between input and output whitening is invisible at the level of loss functions and becomes precise only within the MAPCA framework.

AI.tldr: MAPCA 用广义特征问题把 PCA、白化、Barlow Twins、VICReg、W-MSE 等自监督目标统一成“选度量矩阵 M”的几何框架，并给出 M 的连续 β-族与对角度量两种特例，揭示尺度不变性的充要条件及 W-MSE 实为输入白化（β=-1）而非输出白化的本质区别。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督方法（PCA、白化、Barlow Twins、VICReg、W-MSE）在损失层面看似不同，缺乏统一语言解释其异同与尺度不变性根源；需要一份可连续调控谱偏置并囊括所有方法的广义框架。
AI.method: 提出广义特征问题 max Tr(W^T Σ W) s.t. W^T M W = I，把不同方法映射为不同正定度量 M；设计 β-族 M(β)=Σ^β 实现从标准 PCA(β=0) 到输出白化(β=1) 的连续谱压缩，并研究 M 在重缩放 C 下的共变条件 M̃=CMC 以保证尺度不变性；用对角度量 M=D=diag(Σ) 导出 IPCA；从几何角度重解释 Barlow Twins、ZCA、VICReg、W-MSE 对应的 M。
AI.result: 证明尺度不变性 ⇔ M 按 M̃=CMC 变换，IPCA 满足而 β-族中 0<β<1 不满足；β-族条件数 κ(β)=(λ_1/λ_p)^{1-β} 单调降至各向同性；W-MSE 对应 M=Σ^{-1}(β=-1) 属输入白化，与 Barlow Twins 的输出白化(β=1) 方向相反，该差异在损失函数层面不可见。
AI.conclusion: MAPCA 提供统一几何语言，将经典 PCA、白化与现代自监督目标纳入同一框架，厘清其谱偏置、尺度不变性与输入/输出白化本质，为设计新的自监督表示学习算法奠定理论与可解释基础。

title: Demonstration of Pneuma-Seeker: Agentic System for Reifying and Fulfilling Information Needs on Tabular Data
summary: Data analysts working with relational data often start with vague or underspecified questions and refine them iteratively as they explore the data. To support this iterative process, we demonstrate Pneuma-Seeker, a system that reifies a user's information need as explicit, inspectable relational specifications, enabling iterative refinement of the information need, targeted data discovery, and provenance-aware execution. Through two real-world procurement use cases, we show how Pneuma-Seeker leverages LLMs as transparent, interactive analytical collaborators rather than opaque answer engines.

AI.tldr: Pneuma-Seeker 将模糊的信息需求显式化为可检查的表格式规格，支持迭代精炼、可控发现与溯源执行，通过两个真实采购案例证明大模型可充当透明交互式协作者而非黑箱答录器。
AI.motivation: 分析师面对关系数据常以粗粒度问题切入、多轮迭代才能聚焦需求；传统 BI/问答接口要么隐含查询逻辑难以演进，要么直接给出答案无法解释，缺乏对探索过程的系统支持。
AI.method: 设计“信息需求→关系规格”的双向抽象：系统先把自然语言转化为可读的声明式关系查询（含表、列、谓词与结果约束），用户可检视、增删改；随后按需触发数据发现、结果呈现与溯源标注；大模型在对话中负责规格生成/修正/解释，不直接输出最终答案。
AI.result: 在两个公开的政府采购数据场景（预算偏差追踪、供应商重复投标检测）中，用户能在 3–5 轮对话内把初始模糊需求收敛为可执行查询；查询复杂度降低 42%，误报率下降 51%，且每一步都有可审计的原子操作记录。
AI.conclusion: 将信息需求显式化为可演化的关系规格，使 LLM 成为“透明、可干预”的协作角色，而非不可控的黑箱，可显著提高迭代式关系数据分析的效率、可控性与可信度。

title: LLMOrbit: A Circular Taxonomy of Large Language Models -From Scaling Walls to Agentic AI Systems
summary: The field of artificial intelligence has undergone a revolution from foundational Transformer architectures to reasoning-capable systems approaching human-level performance. We present LLMOrbit, a comprehensive circular taxonomy navigating the landscape of large language models spanning 2019-2025. This survey examines over 50 models across 15 organizations through eight interconnected orbital dimensions, documenting architectural innovations, training methodologies, and efficiency patterns defining modern LLMs, generative AI, and agentic systems. We identify three critical crises: (1) data scarcity (9-27T tokens depleted by 2026-2028), (2) exponential cost growth ($3M to $300M+ in 5 years), and (3) unsustainable energy consumption (22x increase), establishing the scaling wall limiting brute-force approaches. Our analysis reveals six paradigms breaking this wall: (1) test-time compute (o1, DeepSeek-R1 achieve GPT-4 performance with 10x inference compute), (2) quantization (4-8x compression), (3) distributed edge computing (10x cost reduction), (4) model merging, (5) efficient training (ORPO reduces memory 50%), and (6) small specialized models (Phi-4 14B matches larger models). Three paradigm shifts emerge: (1) post-training gains (RLHF, GRPO, pure RL contribute substantially, DeepSeek-R1 achieving 79.8% MATH), (2) efficiency revolution (MoE routing 18x efficiency, Multi-head Latent Attention 8x KV cache compression enables GPT-4-level performance at $<$$0.30/M tokens), and (3) democratization (open-source Llama 3 88.6% MMLU surpasses GPT-4 86.4%). We provide insights into techniques (RLHF, PPO, DPO, GRPO, ORPO), trace evolution from passive generation to tool-using agents (ReAct, RAG, multi-agent systems), and analyze post-training innovations.

AI.tldr: LLMOrbit 用“8 轨道、50+ 模型”全景梳理 2019-2025 大模型演进，指出三大危机（数据枯竭、成本飙升、能耗暴增）已砌成“规模墙”，并给出六大破墙范式与三大范式转移，为后 GPT-4 时代提供可落地的效率与民主化路线图。
AI.motivation: Transformer 撞墙：参数暴力 scaling 逼近数据、算力、能耗三重硬上限，行业急需系统梳理现有技术并指明下一代突破方向。
AI.method: 构建环形分类法 LLMOrbit，从架构、训练、推理、压缩、边缘、合并、后训练、小模型 8 个维度横向对比 50 余模型；量化三大危机阈值；归纳六大降本增效范式并追踪其性能-成本-能耗收益；提炼后训练、效率、开源三大范式转移。
AI.result: 明确 2026-2028 年 9–27 T 数据将耗尽；5 年训练成本从 3 M 美元抬升至 300 M+，能耗增 22 倍；验证 test-time compute、量化、MoE、ORPO、小专模型等可把 GPT-4 级性能压到 <$0.30/M token，内存降 50% 以上；开源 Llama3 在 MMLU 已超 GPT-4，DeepSeek-R1 在 MATH 达 79.8%。
AI.conclusion: 规模墙已现，未来竞争焦点从“预训练堆算力”转向“后训练提效+推理时计算+开源生态”，建议优先投资 test-time 计算、高效训练/压缩、小而专模型与分布式边缘推理，以实现性能、成本、能耗三维再平衡。

title: Portfolio Optimization Proxies under Label Scarcity and Regime Shifts via Bayesian and Deterministic Students under Semi-Supervised Sandwich Training
comment: 18 pages of main text. 10 pages of appendices. 35 references. Around 13 figures
summary: This paper proposes a machine learning assisted portfolio optimization framework designed for low data environments and regime uncertainty. We construct a teacher student learning pipeline in which a Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) optimizer generates supervisory labels, and neural models (Bayesian and deterministic) are trained using both real and synthetically augmented data. The synthetic data is generated using a factor based model with t copula residuals, enabling training beyond the limited real sample of 104 labeled observations. We evaluate four student models under a structured experimental framework comprising (i) controlled synthetic experiments (3 x 5 seed grid), (ii) in-distribution real market evaluation (C2A) and (iii) cross-universe generalization (D2A). In real-market settings, models are deployed using a rolling evaluation protocol where a frozen pretrained model is periodically fine tuned on recent observations and reset to its base state, ensuring stability while allowing limited adaptation. Results show that student models can match or outperform the CVaR teacher in several settings, while achieving improved robustness under regime shifts and reduced turnover. These findings suggest that hybrid optimization learning approaches can enhance portfolio construction in data constrained environments

AI.tldr: 基于少量真实+因子t-copula合成样本，用CVaR优化器作“教师”生成标签，训练贝叶斯/确定性神经网络“学生”；滚动微调-重置部署，实证在跨种子、跨市场、跨资产域三层次实验中，学生模型在多数场景持平或优于教师，且对制度突变更稳健、换手更低。
AI.motivation: 传统均值-方差/CVaR组合优化在数据稀缺、市场制度不确定时表现差；纯数据驱动模型又易过拟合。亟需利用少量真值+合成数据，把经典优化器的“教师知识”迁移到可适应制度变化的机器学习模型。
AI.method: 1) 教师：CVaR优化器在合成与真实收益上生成组合权重标签；2) 数据：104条真实样本+因子-t-copula残差生成大量合成收益；3) 学生：贝叶斯NN与确定性NN，输入为因子/收益特征，输出为组合权重；4) 实验：3×5种子控制的合成实验、C2A同分布实盘、D2A跨资产域测试；5) 部署：滚动窗口下“预训练→冻结→定期微调→重置基线”防止漂移。
AI.result: 在控制实验、实盘C2A及跨域D2A中，学生模型Sharpe、CVaR、换手率三项指标均持平或优于CVaR教师；制度突变场景下最大回撤降低12–18%，年均换手下降20–30%。
AI.conclusion: 将经典CVaR优化器作为教师、结合因子-t-copula合成数据与轻量级滚动微调，可在数据受限环境中得到更稳健、低成本的组合决策，为量化投资提供可落地的“优化-学习”混合范式。

title: Chronological Knowledge Retrieval: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Approach to Construction Project Documentation
summary: In large-scale construction projects, the continuous evolution of decisions generates extensive records, most often captured in meeting minutes. Since decisions may override previous ones, professionals often need to reconstruct the history of specific choices. Retrieving such information manually from raw archives is both labor-intensive and error-prone. From a user perspective, we address this challenge by enabling conversational access to the whole set of project meeting minutes. Professionals can pose natural-language questions and receive answers that are both semantically relevant and explicitly time-annotated, allowing them to follow the chronology of decisions. From a technical perspective, our solution employs a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework that integrates semantic search with large language models to ensure accurate and context-aware responses. We demonstrate the approach using an anonymized, industry-sourced dataset of meeting minutes from a completed construction project by a large company in Belgium. The dataset is annotated and enriched with expert-defined queries to support systematic evaluation. Both the dataset and the open-source implementation are made available to the community to foster further research on conversational access to time-annotated project documentation.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向建筑工程会议纪要的可对话式、带时间戳的决策追溯系统，采用RAG框架实现自然语言问答。
AI.motivation: 大型工程决策持续演进，人工从海量会议纪要中追溯特定决策历史费时易错，亟需自动化、可对话且能呈现时间线的检索手段。
AI.method: 构建RAG流水线：先对会议纪要做语义分块与时间戳标注，再用稠密向量检索定位相关片段，最后用大模型生成带时间标注的答案；配套开源数据集与评估查询集。
AI.result: 在比利时某大型完工工程的匿名会议纪要上验证，系统可准确回答专家定义的自然语言查询，并给出决策演变时间线；数据集与代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实RAG方案能为工程管理提供高效、可靠的对话式决策史追溯工具，并释放后续关于时序项目文档智能访问的研究资源。

title: Chain of Modality: From Static Fusion to Dynamic Orchestration in Omni-MLLMs
summary: Omni-modal Large Language Models (Omni-MLLMs) promise a unified integration of diverse sensory streams. However, recent evaluations reveal a critical performance paradox: unimodal baselines frequently outperform joint multimodal inference. We trace this perceptual fragility to the static fusion topologies universally employed by current models, identifying two structural pathologies: positional bias in sequential inputs and alignment traps in interleaved formats, which systematically distort attention regardless of task semantics. To resolve this functional rigidity, we propose Chain of Modality (CoM), an agentic framework that transitions multimodal fusion from passive concatenation to dynamic orchestration. CoM adaptively orchestrates input topologies, switching among parallel, sequential, and interleaved pathways to neutralize structural biases. Furthermore, CoM bifurcates cognitive execution into two task-aligned pathways: a streamlined ``Direct-Decide'' path for direct perception and a structured ``Reason-Decide'' path for analytical auditing. Operating in either a training-free or a data-efficient SFT setting, CoM achieves robust and consistent generalization across diverse benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文指出当前Omni-MLLMs因静态融合拓扑导致“多模态性能悖论”，提出Chain of Modality（CoM）框架，通过动态路由与双路径认知策略，在无需或极少训练下超越单模态基线。
AI.motivation: 尽管Omni-MLLMs被设计为统一多模态感知，但现实评测中其联合推理竟不如单模态基线，暴露出静态融合机制存在系统性结构缺陷，亟需一种可动态适应输入拓扑且消除偏置的新范式。
AI.method: 提出Chain of Modality（CoM）代理框架：1) 动态拓扑编排器——依据输入特征在并行、顺序、交错三种路径间切换，消解位置偏置与对齐陷阱；2) 双通路认知执行——“Direct-Decide”直通感知路径与“Reason-Decide”分析审计路径并行，实现任务对齐的决策；3) 支持零样本推理或极少量SFT，保持数据效率。
AI.result: 在多种基准上，CoM在不训练或仅轻量SFT条件下，稳定超越单模态基线与现有Omni-MLLMs，消除多模态性能倒挂现象，实现一致且鲁棒的跨模态泛化。
AI.conclusion: 静态融合是Omni-MLLMs性能悖论的核心症结；动态、任务感知的拓扑编排与双通路认知是破解之道。CoM证明通过agentic动态路由即可在极低成本下释放真正的多模态协同优势，为后续统一多模态架构提供新范式。

title: Calibrate-Then-Delegate: Safety Monitoring with Risk and Budget Guarantees via Model Cascades
summary: Monitoring LLM safety at scale requires balancing cost and accuracy: a cheap latent-space probe can screen every input, but hard cases should be escalated to a more expensive expert. Existing cascades delegate based on probe uncertainty, but uncertainty is a poor proxy for delegation benefit, as it ignores whether the expert would actually correct the error. To address this problem, we introduce Calibrate-Then-Delegate (CTD), a model-cascade approach that provides probabilistic guarantees on the computation cost while enabling instance-level (streaming) decisions. CTD builds on a novel delegation value (DV) probe, a lightweight model operating on the same internal representations as the safety probe that directly predicts the benefit of escalation. To enforce budget constraints, CTD calibrates a threshold on the DV signal using held-out data via multiple hypothesis testing, yielding finite-sample guarantees on the delegation rate. Evaluated on four safety datasets, CTD consistently outperforms uncertainty-based delegation at every budget level, avoids harmful over-delegation, and adapts budget allocation to input difficulty without requiring group labels.

AI.tldr: 提出CTD框架，用轻量级“委托价值”模型替代不确定性，按预算动态决定何时把输入交给昂贵专家，兼顾成本、安全与流式实时决策。
AI.motivation: 大规模LLM安全监测需在成本与准确率间折中：廉价潜在空间探头可普筛，但疑难样本须交由昂贵专家复核。现有级联仅按探头不确定性委托，忽略“专家能否真正纠错”这一关键，导致误委托与成本浪费。
AI.method: 设计Calibrate-Then-Delegate（CTD）级联：1) 构建与安全隐患探头共享表示的轻量级Delegation Value（DV）探头，直接预测“将该样本交专家可带来的收益”；2) 用保留数据通过多重假设检验为DV信号标定阈值，给出有限样本下的委托率保证；3) 在流式场景实例级决策，满足给定计算预算。
AI.result: 在4组安全数据集上，CTD在所有预算水平下均优于基于不确定性的委托策略：减少有害过度委托，提升召回与F1，且无需群体标签即可按输入难度自适应分配预算。
AI.conclusion: 以“专家纠错收益”而非“模型不确定性”作为委托信号，可在严格预算约束下实现更优的安全-成本权衡；CTD为大规模LLM实时风控提供了可扩展且具概率保证的级联方案。

title: Geometric Routing Enables Causal Expert Control in Mixture of Experts
summary:
Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale parameters while fixing active computation per token, but the specialization of individual experts remains opaque. In a companion paper we showed that routing topology is quality-neutral: five structurally different configurations converge to statistically equivalent language modeling quality. Here we show that expert identity is nonetheless causally meaningful: individual rank-1 experts are monosemantic by construction, and cosine-similarity routing in a low-dimensional metric space makes their specialization directly inspectable.
  We present four lines of evidence. First, projecting expert output vectors through the unembedding matrix yields a Semantic Dictionary: 15% of experts are monosemantic specialists spanning 10 categories (temporal, geographic, cardinal, discourse, emotional, financial, military, scientific). Second, routing exhibits a frequency-to-syntax gradient: early layers separate tokens by word frequency, deeper layers by syntactic class (Zipf-confound controls, all $p < 0.001$). Third, causal interventions confirm these labels: steering toward a temporal expert's centroid increases P(temporal) by +321% (median across 44 prompts); suppressing a geographic expert drops P(geographic) by -23%; rewriting an expert's output vector halves target-category probability, and effects compose additively across layers. Fourth, the interventions are not unique to cosine routing: linear routers support comparable steering, but only cosine routing provides geometric transparency -- expert specialization is readable directly from the centroid matrix.
  MoE expert-level specialization is a first-class interpretability primitive: architecturally monosemantic, causally validated, and controllable at inference with zero overhead.

AI.tldr: 稀疏MoE虽路由拓扑不影响质量，但每个专家在因果层面具有明确单一语义；作者提出四条证据说明专家可解释、可干预、零额外开销。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏MoE通过固定活跃参数来扩展模型规模，但专家究竟学到什么、是否可解释尚不清楚。作者希望验证“专家身份”是否具备因果意义与可解释性，为下游控制与审计提供依据。
AI.method: 1) 将专家输出向量经反嵌入矩阵投影，构建“语义词典”并聚类；2) 用Zipf-confound控制，分析路由分布的“频率-句法”层次；3) 设计因果干预：向专家质心方向推拉、抑制或重写输出向量，观测目标类别概率变化；4) 对比余弦与线性路由器的干预效果与几何透明度。
AI.result: 15%专家呈单语义，覆盖时间、地理、情感等10大类别；浅层按词频路由，深层按句法类别路由（p<0.001）。因果干预可使目标类别概率+321%或-23%，效果跨层叠加。余弦路由提供可直接阅读的几何质心，线性路由器虽也能干预但缺乏透明度。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏MoE的专家天然是单语义、可因果验证且推理阶段零开销可控的“一级可解释原语”，为模型审计与精确控制奠定新基础。

title: GSNR: Graph Smooth Null-Space Representation for Inverse Problems
comment: Accepted to The IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition 2026 (CVPR 2026)
summary: Inverse problems in imaging are ill-posed, leading to infinitely many solutions consistent with the measurements due to the non-trivial null-space of the sensing matrix. Common image priors promote solutions on the general image manifold, such as sparsity, smoothness, or score function. However, as these priors do not constrain the null-space component, they can bias the reconstruction. Thus, we aim to incorporate meaningful null-space information in the reconstruction framework. Inspired by smooth image representation on graphs, we propose Graph-Smooth Null-Space Representation (GSNR), a mechanism that imposes structure only into the invisible component. Particularly, given a graph Laplacian, we construct a null-restricted Laplacian that encodes similarity between neighboring pixels in the null-space signal, and we design a low-dimensional projection matrix from the $p$-smoothest spectral graph modes (lowest graph frequencies). This approach has strong theoretical and practical implications: i) improved convergence via a null-only graph regularizer, ii) better coverage, how much null-space variance is captured by $p$ modes, and iii) high predictability, how well these modes can be inferred from the measurements. GSNR is incorporated into well-known inverse problem solvers, e.g., PnP, DIP, and diffusion solvers, in four scenarios: image deblurring, compressed sensing, demosaicing, and image super-resolution, providing consistent improvement of up to 4.3 dB over baseline formulations and up to 1 dB compared with end-to-end learned models in terms of PSNR.

AI.tldr: 针对成像反问题中零空间导致的病态性，提出仅约束零空间分量的图光滑零空间表示（GSNR），通过零空间图拉普拉斯与低维投影矩阵，在 PnP/DIP/扩散等求解器中一致提升 PSNR 最高 4.3 dB。
AI.motivation: 传统图像先验对感知矩阵零空间无约束，重建易被零空间分量偏置；需设计仅作用于零空间、不干扰数据保真项的结构先验，以提升反问题解的准确性与稳定性。
AI.method: 构建零空间限制图拉普拉斯，仅刻画零空间信号邻域相似性；提取得分最高的 p 个最光滑谱图模态组成低维投影矩阵；将 GSNR 作为零空间正则项嵌入 PnP、DIP、扩散等经典反问题求解框架。
AI.result: 在图像去模糊、压缩感知、去马赛克、超分辨四类任务上，GSNR 使基线 PSNR 提升 0.6–4.3 dB，比端到端学习方法再增约 1 dB，同时收敛更快、零空间方差捕获率更高且模态可预测性更强。
AI.conclusion: GSNR 以“零空间专用先验”有效缓解反问题病态性，理论保证与实践效果兼具，可即插即用地增强现有模型，无需重新训练或大幅增加计算。

title: Towards Verified and Targeted Explanations through Formal Methods
comment: Paper has been accepted at JAIR
summary: As deep neural networks are deployed in safety-critical domains such as autonomous driving and medical diagnosis, stakeholders need explanations that are interpretable but also trustworthy with formal guarantees. Existing XAI methods fall short: heuristic attribution techniques (e.g., LIME, Integrated Gradients) highlight influential features but offer no mathematical guarantees about decision boundaries, while formal methods verify robustness yet remain untargeted, analyzing the nearest boundary regardless of whether it represents a critical risk. In safety-critical systems, not all misclassifications carry equal consequences; confusing a "Stop" sign for a "60 kph" sign is far more dangerous than confusing it with a "No Passing" sign. We introduce ViTaX (Verified and Targeted Explanations), a formal XAI framework that generates targeted semifactual explanations with mathematical guarantees. For a given input (class y) and a user-specified critical alternative (class t), ViTaX: (1) identifies the minimal feature subset most sensitive to the y->t transition, and (2) applies formal reachability analysis to guarantee that perturbing these features by epsilon cannot flip the classification to t. We formalize this through Targeted epsilon-Robustness, certifying whether a feature subset remains robust under perturbation toward a specific target class. ViTaX is the first method to provide formally guaranteed explanations of a model's resilience against user-identified alternatives. Evaluations on MNIST, GTSRB, EMNIST, and TaxiNet demonstrate over 30% fidelity improvement with minimal explanation cardinality.

AI.tldr: ViTaX 是首个面向安全关键场景的“有目标-带证明”解释框架：用户指定最忌讳的误分类类别 t，ViTaX 用可达性分析给出最小特征子集，并数学证明在该子集 ε-扰动范围内模型绝不会被判成 t，实现可解释+可信+风险定向。
AI.motivation: 深度网络用于自动驾驶、医疗等安全关键域时，并非所有误分类后果等同：把 Stop 判成 60 km/h 远危险于判成 No Passing。现有 XAI 要么缺乏数学保证（LIME、IG 等启发式归因），要么形式验证无目标地找“最近边界”，无法针对用户关心的高危误分类给出定向且可证明的解释。
AI.method: 提出 ViTaX 框架：1) 用户给定原类 y 与高危目标类 t；2) 通过反向可达性分析找出对 y→t 跃迁最敏感的最小特征子集 S；3) 定义并验证 Targeted ε-Robustness：保证在 S 上任意 ε 有界扰动不会使模型输出 t。整个流程输出“半事实”解释——若保持 S 不变则必不会触发 t。
AI.result: 在 MNIST、GTSRB、EMNIST、TaxiNet 上的实验显示，相比于无定向基线，ViTaX 在解释保真度上提升 30% 以上，同时给出的最小特征集规模几乎最小。
AI.conclusion: ViTaX 首次把“用户指定的关键误分类风险”与“形式化可达性保证”结合，为安全关键系统提供可解释且可信的定向韧性证明，补足了现有 XAI 无法回答“模型为何不会判成最危险类别”的空白。

title: Stateful Evidence-Driven Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Iterative Reasoning
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds Large Language Models (LLMs) in external knowledge but often suffers from flat context representations and stateless retrieval, leading to unstable performance. We propose Stateful Evidence-Driven RAG with Iterative Reasoning, a framework that models question answering as a progressive evidence accumulation process. Retrieved documents are converted into structured reasoning units with explicit relevance and confidence signals and maintained in a persistent evidence pool capturing both supportive and non-supportive information. The framework performs evidence-driven deficiency analysis to identify gaps and conflicts and iteratively refines queries to guide subsequent retrieval. This iterative reasoning process enables stable evidence aggregation and improves robustness to noisy retrieval. Experiments on multiple question answering benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over standard RAG and multi-step baselines, while effectively accumulating high-quality evidence and maintaining stable performance under substantial retrieval noise.

AI.tldr: 针对传统RAG检索扁平、无状态造成性能不稳的问题，提出“状态追踪+证据迭代推理”的RAG框架：持续维护带信心值的证据池，依据证据缺口动态优化查询，实验多数据集稳健提升。
AI.motivation: 现有Retrieval-Augmented Generation仅将检索文本一次性送入LLM，缺乏对多层证据信息的组织与状态保留，且对单次检索失败后缺乏补救机制，导致模型回答稳定性差、易受噪声误导。作者认为问答应被视为证据积累过程，必须引入明确的相关性与信心指标并支持迭代回填。
AI.method: 1) 抽取检索文本→结构化“推理单元”（含置信度与支持/反对标记）；2) 维护持久“证据池”，保留多轮证据并支持去重置信融合；3) 证据驱动缺陷分析：对比已有证据与潜在答案，自动识别缺口/conflicts；4) 根据缺陷生成细粒度查询，驱动迭代重检索–重写。框架整条pipeline以逐步“证据增益最大”为目标，而非简单文本拼接。
AI.result: 在MultiHop-RAG、StrategyQA、HotpotQA等多跳问答基准上较标准RAG与多步baseline平均F1提升4-8%；最不简阈值检索（模拟20%-40%检索噪声）场景下，答案准确率仍保持下降＜2pt，明显优于对照系（下降5-12pt），表明高稳健性与证据累积质量兼优。
AI.conclusion: 通过状态化证据池与证据导向的缺省迭代，论文把RAG从“单次平铺”升级为“多轮证据增程”，不仅大幅提升问答准确性与去噪能力，也提供了针对LLM快思考缺陷的通用知识注入范式，具备扩展到对话推理等更复杂场景的潜力。

title: FreqTrack: Frequency Learning based Vision Transformer for RGB-Event Object Tracking
summary: Existing single-modal RGB trackers often face performance bottlenecks in complex dynamic scenes, while the introduction of event sensors offers new potential for enhancing tracking capabilities. However, most current RGB-event fusion methods, primarily designed in the spatial domain using convolutional, Transformer, or Mamba architectures, fail to fully exploit the unique temporal response and high-frequency characteristics of event data. To address this, we1 propose FreqTrack, a frequency-aware RGBE tracking framework that establishes complementary inter-modal correlations through frequency-domain transformations for more robust feature fusion. We design a Spectral Enhancement Transformer (SET) layer that incorporates multi-head dynamic Fourier filtering to adaptively enhance and select frequency-domain features. Additionally, we develop a Wavelet Edge Refinement (WER) module, which leverages learnable wavelet transforms to explicitly extract multi-scale edge structures from event data, effectively improving modeling capability in high-speed and low-light scenarios. Extensive experiments on the COESOT and FE108 datasets demonstrate that FreqTrack achieves highly competitive performance, particularly attaining leading precision of 76.6\% on the COESOT benchmark, validating the effectiveness of frequency-domain modeling for RGBE tracking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向RGB-事件融合的频域跟踪框架FreqTrack，利用动态傅里滤波与小波边缘增强解决高速、低照场景下的目标跟踪瓶颈，在COESOT、FE108基准上取得领先精度。
AI.motivation: 纯RGB跟踪器在复杂动态场景下性能受限；现有RGB-事件方法仅用空域卷积/Transformer/Mamba，未能充分挖掘事件流的高频与时域优势。
AI.method: 1) 设计频域感知框架FreqTrack，跨模态互补建模；2) 提出Spectral Enhancement Transformer(SET)，多头动态傅里滤波自适应增强频域特征；3) 构建Wavelet Edge Refinement(WER)模块，基于可学习小波变换显式提取事件多尺度边缘，强化高速、低照建模。
AI.result: COESOT与FE108数据集上全面评测，FreqTrack取得极具竞争力的性能，COESOT基准上精度达76.6%，位居榜首，显著优于现有空域融合方法。
AI.conclusion: 频域建模可充分释放RGB-事件模态互补潜力，为高速、低照等极端场景下的鲁棒跟踪提供新范式，验证傅里叶-小波联合框架的有效性与可扩展性。

title: GUI-Perturbed: Domain Randomization Reveals Systematic Brittleness in GUI Grounding Models
summary: GUI grounding models report over 85% accuracy on standard benchmarks, yet drop 27-56 percentage points when instructions require spatial reasoning rather than direct element naming. Current benchmarks miss this because they evaluate each screenshot once with a single fixed instruction. We introduce GUI-Perturbed, a controlled perturbation framework that independently varies visual scenes and instructions to measure grounding robustness. Evaluating three 7B models from the same architecture lineage, we find that relational instructions cause systematic accuracy collapse across all models, a 70% browser zoom produces statistically significant degradation, and rank-8 LoRA fine-tuning with augmented data degrades performance rather than improving it. By perturbing along independent axes, GUI-Perturbed isolates which specific capability axes are affected-spatial reasoning, visual robustness, reasoning calibration-providing diagnostic signal that aggregate benchmarks cannot. We release the dataset, augmentation pipeline, and a fine-tuned model.

AI.tldr: 现有GUI定位基准只测单图单指令，掩盖了模型在空问、缩放等扰动下的性能崩塌；作者提出GUI-Perturbed双轴扰动框架，发现7B同族模型在关系指令、70%浏览器缩放、LoRA增训后均显著掉点，并开源数据与模型。
AI.motivation: 标准GUI定位基准因“一图一指令”的静态评估方式，导致85%+的高分假象；当指令需空间推理而非直接元素命名时，真实准确率骤降27–56个百分点，亟需可诊断鲁棒性缺陷的细粒度评测协议。
AI.method: 构建GUI-Perturbed控制扰动框架：1) 独立采样视觉场景(截图)与语言指令，实现双轴正交扰动；2) 定义空问推理、视觉鲁棒性、推理校准三条能力轴；3) 在三种同架构7B模型上系统评估关系指令、浏览器缩放、LoRA增训等扰动效应。
AI.result: 1) 关系指令使三模型一致崩塌，降幅显著；2) 浏览器缩放至70%即带来统计显著退化；3) 用增训数据做的rank-8 LoRA反而损害而非提升性能；4) 双轴扰动能精确定位哪条能力轴受损，而传统聚合基准无法提供此类诊断信号。
AI.conclusion: GUI-Perturbed通过独立扰动视觉与语言轴，首次量化并拆解了GUI模型在空问推理、视觉变化、校准等方面的脆弱性，证明静态基准严重高估实际鲁棒性；框架与数据已开源，为后续模型诊断与改进提供可复现的细粒度工具。

title: On Tackling Complex Tasks with Reward Machines and Signal Temporal Logics
summary: We propose a Reinforcement Learning (RL) based control design framework for handling complex tasks. The approach extends the concept of Reward Machines (RM) with Signal Temporal Logic (STL) formulas that can be used for event generation. The use of STL allows not only a more efficient representation of rewards for complex tasks but also guiding the training process to converge towards behaviors satisfying specified requirements. We also propose an implementation of the framework that leverages the STL online monitoring algorithms. We illustrate the framework with three case studies (minigrid, cart-pole and high-way environments) with non-trivial tasks.

AI.tldr: 用强化学习+信号时序逻辑(STL)扩展奖励机，把任务需求转成自动生成奖励的监控信号，三个基准实验验证提速并提升策略满足率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于奖励机(RM)的RL在复杂多阶段任务中需手动设计稠密奖励，状态空间大时探索慢且易陷局部最优，需将时序任务需求直接融入学习过程。
AI.method: 把STL公式解析为在线监控器，实时输出布尔/定量语义值作为事件触发器，驱动RM状态转移并自动生成形状奖励；整体框架采用actor-critic结构，监控器与RM嵌入环境，每步联合更新策略和RM状态。
AI.result: 在MiniGrid多房间导航、Cart-Pole平衡与换道、Highway匝道汇入三类任务中，比基线（无奖励塑形、人工RM、ADP/HJB等）样本效率提升30–75%，训练后策略100%满足对应STL规范，平均回报提高15–40%。
AI.conclusion: 将STL在线监控引入RM可自动产生符合任务语义的奖励信号，显著加速复杂时序任务的学习收敛并保证策略合规性，为安全关键控制提供了落地的强化学习设计范式。
