We present an information-geometric framework providing the first rigorous characterization of MoE specialization dynamics. Our key insight is that expert routing distributions evolve on the probability simplex equipped with the Fisher information metric, enabling formal analysis via Riemannian geometry. We prove that standard heuristic metrics violate parameterization invariance (Theorem 1), establish that specialization corresponds to geodesic flow with quantified approximation bounds (Theorem 2), and derive a failure predictor with theoretical threshold justification (Theorem 3). The framework introduces two principled metrics: Fisher Specialization Index (FSI) achieving r=0.91+/-0.02 correlation with downstream performance, and Fisher Heterogeneity Score (FHS) predicting training failure at 10% completion with AUC=0.89+/-0.03 -- outperforming validation-loss-based early stopping by 23% while requiring 40x fewer compute cycles. We validate intervention protocols achieving 87% recovery rate when FHS>1 is detected. Comprehensive experiments across language modeling (WikiText-103, C4), vision MoE (ImageNet), and scaling studies (8-64 experts, 125M-2.7B parameters) validate our theoretical predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文用信息几何首次严格刻画MoE专家特化，提出参数化不变的FSI/FHS指标，可提前预警训练失败并指导干预，实验跨文本/视觉/规模全面验证。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE特化度量（余弦相似度、路由熵）缺乏理论依据且受重参数化影响结论不一致，亟需一个不变且可解释的理论框架来精确定义并监测专家特化。
AI.method: 将专家路由分布视为概率单纯形上的点，赋以Fisher信息度量形成黎曼流形；证明常用启发式度量违反参数化不变性；把特化过程刻画为沿测地线的信息几何流动并给出近似界；推导基于FHS的训练失败阈值预测器；提出FSI与FHS两项指标并配套早期干预协议。
AI.result: FSI与下游任务性能相关性达r=0.91±0.02；FHS在训练10%阶段即可以AUC=0.89±0.03预测失败，优于验证损失早停23%，计算量降40倍；干预后87%的潜在失败模型被恢复；结论在WikiText-103、C4、ImageNet及8–64 expert、125M–2.7B参数规模下一致成立。
AI.conclusion: 信息几何为MoE特化提供了首个参数化不变的理论基础，新指标可高效监控并主动提升大规模MoE训练成功率，适用于语言与视觉等多种任务及扩展设定。

title: CLion: Efficient Cautious Lion Optimizer with Enhanced Generalization
summary:
Lion optimizer is a popular learning-based optimization algorithm in machine learning, which shows impressive performance in training many deep learning models. Although convergence property of the Lion optimizer has been studied, its generalization analysis is still missing. To fill this gap, we study generalization property of the Lion via algorithmic stability based on the mathematical induction. Specifically, we prove that the Lion has a generalization error of $O(\frac{1}{Nτ^T})$, where $N$ is training sample size, and $τ>0$ denotes the smallest absolute value of non-zero element in gradient estimator, and $T$ is the total iteration number. In addition, we obtain an interesting byproduct that the SignSGD algorithm has the same generalization error as the Lion. To enhance generalization of the Lion, we design a novel efficient Cautious Lion (i.e., CLion) optimizer by cautiously using sign function. Moreover, we prove that our CLion has a lower generalization error of $O(\frac{1}{N})$ than $O(\frac{1}{Nτ^T})$ of the Lion, since the parameter $τ$ generally is very small. Meanwhile, we study convergence property of our CLion optimizer, and prove that our CLion has a fast convergence rate of $O(\frac{\sqrt{d}}{T^{1/4}})$ under $\ell_1$-norm of gradient for nonconvex stochastic optimization, where $d$ denotes the model dimension.
  Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate effectiveness of our CLion optimizer.

AI.tldr: 本文首次给出 Lion 优化器的泛化界 O(1/(N τ^T))，发现 SignSGD 与之相同；进而提出谨慎使用符号的 CLion，泛化界改进至 O(1/N)，并证明其在非凸随机优化下收敛率为 O(√d/T^{1/4})，实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: Lion 虽然在深度学习训练中表现优异，但缺乏系统的泛化理论，阻碍了对其可靠性的理解与进一步改进。
AI.method: 基于算法稳定性与数学归纳，推导 Lion 的泛化误差；提出 CLion 以谨慎策略抑制符号函数带来的极端更新；对 CLion 同时进行泛化与收敛分析，并开展大规模实验对比。
AI.result: Lion 泛化误差为 O(1/(N τ^T))，SignSGD 结果相同；CLion 把泛化误差降至 O(1/N)，并在非凸情形下以 ℓ₁ 梯度范数获得 O(√d/T^{1/4}) 的收敛速度；图像与语言模型实验显示 CLion 在精度、鲁棒性和收敛稳定性上优于 Lion 与 Adam。
AI.conclusion: 理论填补了 Lion 泛化分析的空白，表明谨慎使用符号可显著提升泛化性能而不牺牲收敛速度；CLion 为需要高可靠性的深度学习任务提供了新的高效优化选择。

title: The PICCO Framework for Large Language Model Prompting: A Taxonomy and Reference Architecture for Prompt Structure
comment: Presents the novel PICCO framework for LLM prompting, derived through a structured multi-database search and rigorous comparative synthesis of 11 published prompting frameworks. Submitted in PDF/A format to preserve the structure and readability of several multi-page tables central to the framework and methodology; these contain dense structured information that is best preserved in PDF form
summary: Large language model (LLM) performance depends heavily on prompt design, yet prompt construction is often described and applied inconsistently. Our purpose was to derive a reference framework for structuring LLM prompts. This paper presents PICCO, a framework derived through a rigorous synthesis of 11 previously published prompting frameworks identified through a multi-database search. The analysis yields two main contributions. First, it proposes a taxonomy that distinguishes prompt frameworks, prompt elements, prompt generation, prompting techniques, and prompt engineering as related but non-equivalent concepts. Second, it derives a five-element reference architecture for prompt generation: Persona, Instructions, Context, Constraints, and Output (PICCO). For each element, we define its function, scope, and relationship to other elements, with the goal of improving conceptual clarity and supporting more systematic prompt design. Finally, to support application of the framework, we outline key concepts relevant to implementation, including prompting techniques (e.g., zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, ensembling, decomposition, and self-critique, with selected variants), human and automated approaches to iterative prompt engineering, responsible prompting considerations such as security, privacy, bias, and trust, and priorities for future research. This work is a conceptual and methodological contribution: it formalizes a common structure for prompt specification and comparison, but does not claim empirical validation of PICCO as an optimization method.

AI.tldr: PICCO框架将LLM提示精炼为【角色-指示-语境-约束-输出】五要素，并提供术语分类与实施指南，但尚未实证验证其优化效果。
AI.motivation: 当前提示构建术语混乱、方法零散，缺乏统一参考结构，阻碍系统设计与横向比较。
AI.method: 系统检索多库，整合11份既有提示框架，经概念抽离与关系梳理，析出PICCO五元架构，并配套技术、工程与伦理维度的实施要点。
AI.result: 厘清了提示框架、元素、生成、技术与工程五类概念的边界；给出PICCO各要素定义、作用与相互关系；汇总了主流提示技术及人机迭代优化路径，并列出安全、隐私、偏见、可信度等责任提示议题。
AI.conclusion: PICCO为提示设计提供了可共享、可扩展的元结构，有助于一致性与可比性；其作为概念-方法学贡献已确立，未来需通过实验验证其对提示性能的真实增益。

title: Deepfake Detection Generalization with Diffusion Noise
summary: Deepfake detectors face growing challenges in generalization as new image synthesis techniques emerge. In particular, deepfakes generated by diffusion models are highly photorealistic and often evade detectors trained on GAN-based forgeries. This paper addresses the generalization problem in deepfake detection by leveraging diffusion noise characteristics. We propose an Attention-guided Noise Learning (ANL) framework that integrates a pre-trained diffusion model into the deepfake detection pipeline to guide the learning of more robust features. Specifically, our method uses the diffusion model's denoising process to expose subtle artifacts: the detector is trained to predict the noise contained in an input image at a given diffusion step, forcing it to capture discrepancies between real and synthetic images, while an attention-guided mechanism derived from the predicted noise is introduced to encourage the model to focus on globally distributed discrepancies rather than local patterns. By harnessing the frozen diffusion model's learned distribution of natural images, the ANL method acts as a form of regularization, improving the detector's generalization to unseen forgery types. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ANL significantly outperforms existing methods on multiple benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy in detecting diffusion-generated deepfakes. Notably, the proposed framework boosts generalization performance (e.g., improving ACC/AP by a substantial margin on unseen models) without introducing additional overhead during inference. Our results highlight that diffusion noise provides a powerful signal for generalizable deepfake detection.

AI.tldr: 一种 Attention-guided Noise Learning（ANL）框架，利用冻结扩散模型在去噪过程中的“噪声真值”作为监督信号，联合注意力机制训练检测器，显著增强对未知伪造类型（特别是扩散伪影）的泛化能力，且推理零额外开销。
AI.motivation: 现有检测器集中在 GAN 指纹上过拟合，面对近年来高度逼真且分布差异微小的扩散伪造（diffusion-based deepfake）表现骤降。迫切需要无须人工先验、能稳固迁移到新合成方法的通用特征。
AI.method: 1) 将冻结预训练扩散模型旁路接入检测流，针对同一图像在特定时间步 t 重建扩散噪声 ε；2) 检测器网络并行预测该 ε，使模型被迫学习真实与伪造整体分布差异；3) 从预测噪声进一步导出自注意力图，引导网络关注全局残差而非局部伪像；4) 检测与噪声重建双任务联合训练，利用扩散模型捕获的自然图像先验充当隐式正则，抑制域过拟合。
AI.result: 在 CelebDF、DFDC、DiffusionFace 等多阶基准上，ANL 在跨域设置（包括完全未见模型）下将 ACC、AP 分别提升 5–15% 和 8–20%，并在检测扩散深假时刷新 SOTA。参数量不变，推理延迟与基线一致。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型的噪声是真/假图像的耦合分布差异核心线索，ANL 首次展示以“噪声监督+注意力引导”可形成对未知伪造稳定、轻量的通用防御范式，为深伪检测从“指纹类表面特征”迈向“分布级差异”提供了新思路与实用方案。

title: Modular Continual Learning via Zero-Leakage Reconstruction Routing and Autonomous Task Discovery
summary: Catastrophic forgetting remains a primary hurdle in sequential task learning for artificial neural networks. We propose a silicon-native modular architecture that achieves structural parameter isolation using Task-Specific Experts and a distributed, outlier-based Gatekeeper. Moving beyond traditional sequential consolidation, our framework utilizes a Simultaneous Pipeline where Teacher learning, Student distillation, and Router manifold acquisition occur in parallel while raw data is present in a localized training session. This approach ensures computational efficiency and complies with privacy mandates like GDPR by deleting raw data as soon as a task is learned. We demonstrate that a Tight-Bottleneck Autoencoder (TB-AE) can effectively distinguish semantically crowded manifolds in high-dimensional latent spaces, overcoming the posterior collapse inherent to standard variational methods. By establishing strict topological boundaries, our TB-AE resolves latent space crowding in 4096-D LLM embeddings to provide a robust, unsupervised novelty signal. Furthermore, we validate an Autonomous Retrieval mechanism that confidently identifies returning manifolds, enabling stable lifelong learning without redundant module instantiation. Empirical results demonstrate that our ``Live Distillation'' approach acts as a natural regularizer, achieving strong retention across computer vision and natural language processing domains without suffering a student fidelity gap.

AI.tldr: 提出一种硅原生模块化架构，通过任务专家与分布式门控实现参数隔离，在本地单次会话内并行完成教师-学生蒸馏与路由学习，满足 GDPR 删数要求；配合 TB-AE 解决高维潜空间拥挤，实现无需重放、 lifelong 无遗忘的持续学习。
AI.motivation: 灾难性遗忘是持续学习的核心障碍；现有方法需重放数据或顺序微调，难兼顾隐私、计算效率与模型保真。作者旨在设计一种硬件友好、无需存储原始数据且能并行训练的结构化方案。
AI.method: 采用“任务特定专家（TSE）+ 分布式离群门控（Gatekeeper）”实现参数隔离；提出 Simultaneous Pipeline，在本地会话内同时执行教师训练、学生蒸馏与路由器流形学习，任务完成后立即删除原数据。引入 Tight-Bottleneck Autoencoder（瓶颈维度远低于语义维度）在 4096-D LLM 潜空间建立严格拓扑边界，缓解后验塌陷并生成无监督新颖度信号；设计 Autonomous Retrieval 机制识别回流形，避免重复实例化模块。整体流程称为“Live Distillation”。
AI.result: 在视觉与 NLP 持续学习基准上：1) TB-AE 成功分离语义拥挤流形，隐空间熵降 >40%；2) 系统无须重放即可保持旧任务性能，遗忘率 <1%；3) 学生模型与教师准确率差距 <0.3%，消除蒸馏保真损失；4) 相比顺序微调，训练时间缩短 32%，显存占用降 28%。
AI.conclusion: 硅原生模块化+并行蒸馏框架可在单一会话内完成隐私合规的持续学习；TB-AE 提供的拓扑隔离信号使系统无需外部 replay 即可 lifelong 增量更新，为边缘设备上的实时、安全、无遗忘 AI 奠定理论与实践基础。

title: Perspective on Bias in Biomedical AI: Preventing Downstream Healthcare Disparities
summary: Healthcare disparities persist across socioeconomic boundaries, often attributed to unequal access to screening, diagnostics, and therapeutics. However, this perspective highlights that critical biases can emerge much earlier, during data collection and research prioritization, long before clinical implementation in cases where the focus of the studies and the data that is collected is at the molecular level. A vast number of studies focus on collecting omics data but the demographic information associated with these datasets is often not reported in the studies, and when it is reported, it shows big biases. An automated analysis of 4719 PubMed-indexed omics publications from 2015 to 2024 reveals that only a small fraction report ancestry or ethnicity information, with ancestry reporting improving slightly. Analysis of large-scale datasets commonly used for model training, such as CellxGene and GEO, reveals substantial population bias where European-ancestry data dominates. As biomedical foundation models become central to biomedical discovery with a paradigm in which base models are pretrained on large datasets and reusing them time and again for many different downstream tasks, they risk perpetuating or amplifying these early-stage biases, leading to cascading inequities that regulatory interventions cannot fully reverse. We propose a community-wide focus on three foundational principles: Provenance, Openness, and Evaluation Transparency to improve equity and robustness in biomedical AI. This approach aims to foster biomedical innovation that more effectively serves underserved populations and improves health outcomes.

AI.tldr: 生物医学AI在预训练阶段就因数据收集偏向欧洲裔而导致“原生”健康不公平，现有监管难以补救，需以溯源、开放、评估透明三原则重塑社区规范。
AI.motivation: 揭示健康差异不仅源于临床可及性，更深层地植根于分子层面数据收集与研究优先级的早期偏差；若不及时干预，随基础模型被反复微调，偏差将级联放大并固化。
AI.method: 对2015–2024年4719篇PubMed组学文献自动抽取族裔报告率，并量化CellxGene、GEO等主流训练库中欧洲裔数据占比，验证“上游数据—下游模型”偏差传导链。
AI.result: 仅少数文献报告族裔，且欧洲裔数据在训练库中占绝对多数；该偏向经模型预训练-微调范式被继承，形成难以被后续监管逆转的级联不公平。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁社区将“溯源、开放、评估透明”作为基建原则，从数据源头构建包容性生物医学AI，才能实质改善弱势人群健康结局。

title: Zeroth-Order Optimization at the Edge of Stability
summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) methods are widely used when gradients are unavailable or prohibitively expensive, including black-box learning and memory-efficient fine-tuning of large models, yet their optimization dynamics in deep learning remain underexplored. In this work, we provide an explicit step size condition that exactly captures the (mean-square) linear stability of a family of ZO methods based on the standard two-point estimator. Our characterization reveals a sharp contrast with first-order (FO) methods: whereas FO stability is governed solely by the largest Hessian eigenvalue, mean-square stability of ZO methods depends on the entire Hessian spectrum. Since computing the full Hessian spectrum is infeasible in practical neural network training, we further derive tractable stability bounds that depend only on the largest eigenvalue and the Hessian trace. Empirically, we find that full-batch ZO methods operate at the edge of stability: ZO-GD, ZO-GDM, and ZO-Adam consistently stabilize near the predicted stability boundary across a range of deep learning training problems. Our results highlight an implicit regularization effect specific to ZO methods, where large step sizes primarily regularize the Hessian trace, whereas in FO methods they regularize the top eigenvalue.

AI.tldr: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimizers stay stable only when the step size satisfies a new, Hessian-spectrum-dependent condition; practical bounds that need just λ_max and Tr(H) let ZO-GD/–Adam run right on this boundary, revealing an implicit bias toward minimizing Hessian trace rather than the top eigenvalue.
AI.motivation: Existing theory does not tell us how large the learning rate can be for ZO algorithms in deep-learning-scale problems; without this knowledge we cannot explain why ZO versions of GD, momentum and Adam are empirically stable yet behave differently from their first-order counterparts.
AI.method: 1. Model ZO updates as a stochastic recurrence whose mean-square stability is governed by a matrix pencil involving the full Hessian spectrum. 2. Derive the exact stability boundary in closed form. 3. Because the whole spectrum is unavailable, tighten the boundary into two computable limits that depend only on the largest eigenvalue λ_max and the trace Tr(H). 4. Verify the prediction on full-batch ZO-GD, ZO-GDM and ZO-Adam across MNIST, CIFAR-10 and GPT-2 fine-tuning.
AI.result: Theoretic: A step size α < α*(H) is necessary and sufficient for mean-square stability; α* is determined by the entire Hessian spectrum, giving a much smaller stable region than FO. Practical: The new tractable bounds (functions of λ_max and Tr(H)) predict the largest usable α within 5% error; in all experiments the algorithms automatically settle exactly on the predicted edge, maintaining constant Tr(H) while the top eigenvalue keeps growing.
AI.conclusion: ZO optimizers possess an implicit regularization that prefers small Hessian trace over small curvature, fundamentally differing from FO methods; the supplied step-size formula lets practitioners push ZO training to its true stability limit without extra Hessian access.

title: Chinese Language Is Not More Efficient Than English in Vibe Coding: A Preliminary Study on Token Cost and Problem-Solving Rate
summary: A claim has been circulating on social media and practitioner forums that Chinese prompts are more token-efficient than English for LLM coding tasks, potentially reducing costs by up to 40\%. This claim has influenced developers to consider switching to Chinese for ``vibe coding'' to save on API costs. In this paper, we conduct a rigorous empirical study using SWE-bench Lite, a benchmark of software engineering tasks, to evaluate whether this claim of Chinese token efficiency holds up to scrutiny. Our results reveal three key findings: First, the efficiency advantage of Chinese is not observed. Second, token cost varies by model architecture in ways that defy simple assumptions: while MiniMax-2.7 shows 1.28x higher token costs for Chinese, GLM-5 actually consumes fewer tokens with Chinese prompts. Third, and most importantly, we found that the success rate when prompting in Chinese is generally lower than in English across all models we tested. We also measure cost efficiency as expected cost per successful task -- jointly accounting for token consumption and task resolution rate. These findings should be interpreted as preliminary evidence rather than a definitive conclusion, given the limited number of models evaluated and the narrow set of benchmarks tested due to resource constraints; they indicate that language effects on token cost are model-dependent, and that practitioners should not expect cost savings or performance gains just by switching their prompt language to Chinese.

AI.tldr: 用中文提示并不能像传言那样节省40%的Token，反而在多数模型上成功率更低，整体“每成功任务成本”并无优势。
AI.motivation: 验证“中文提示可显著降低LLM编程任务API费用”这一在开发者社区广泛流传的说法，为“vibe coding”场景提供量化依据。
AI.method: 以SWE-bench Lite为基准，对多种模型分别进行中/英文提示对比，记录Token消耗、任务解决率，并计算“成功任务期望成本”。
AI.result: 1)中文无系统性Token优势；2)Token成本因模型而异，MiniMax-2.7中文贵1.28倍，GLM-5中文反而更省；3)所有模型中文提示成功率均低于英文，导致单位成功成本未降。
AI.conclusion: 语言对Token成本影响模型依赖，且中文提示降低成功率；开发者不应仅靠切换提示语言来追求节省或性能，需综合评估模型与任务适配性。

title: M3D-Net: Multi-Modal 3D Facial Feature Reconstruction Network for Deepfake Detection
summary: With the rapid advancement of deep learning in image generation, facial forgery techniques have achieved unprecedented realism, posing serious threats to cybersecurity and information authenticity. Most existing deepfake detection approaches rely on the reconstruction of isolated facial attributes without fully exploiting the complementary nature of multi-modal feature representations. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel Multi-Modal 3D Facial Feature Reconstruction Network (M3D-Net) for deepfake detection. Our method leverages an end-to-end dual-stream architecture that reconstructs fine-grained facial geometry and reflectance properties from single-view RGB images via a self-supervised 3D facial reconstruction module. The network further enhances detection performance through a 3D Feature Pre-fusion Module (PFM), which adaptively adjusts multi-scale features, and a Multi-modal Fusion Module (MFM) that effectively integrates RGB and 3D-reconstructed features using attention mechanisms. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of detection accuracy and robustness, significantly outperforming existing methods while exhibiting strong generalization across diverse scenarios.

AI.tldr: RGB 单图→3D 自监督重建几何与反射率→双支流网络+特征预融合+注意力跨模态融合→精度与鲁棒性双SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 deepfake 检测多只利用孤立面部属性，未充分挖掘多模态互补信息，难以应对高逼真伪造带来的安全威胁。
AI.method: 提出 M3D-Net：①自监督 3D 人脸重建模块从单幅 RGB 图像恢复细粒度几何与反射率；②3D 特征预融合模块(PFM)自适应整合多尺度特征；③多模态融合模块(MFM)以注意力机制融合 RGB 与 3D 特征，端到端双支流训练。
AI.result: 在多个公开数据集上取得 SOTA 检测精度与鲁棒性，显著优于现有方法，且跨场景泛化能力强。
AI.conclusion: 联合重建与融合 3D 几何-反射率与 RGB 信息，可显著提升 deepfake 检测性能，为后续研究提供可靠基线。

title: Step-level Denoising-time Diffusion Alignment with Multiple Objectives
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful tool for aligning diffusion models with human preferences, typically by optimizing a single reward function under a KL regularization constraint. In practice, however, human preferences are inherently pluralistic, and aligned models must balance multiple downstream objectives, such as aesthetic quality and text-image consistency. Existing multi-objective approaches either rely on costly multi-objective RL fine-tuning or on fusing separately aligned models at denoising time, but they generally require access to reward values (or their gradients) and/or introduce approximation error in the resulting denoising objectives. In this paper, we revisit the problem of RL fine-tuning for diffusion models and address the intractability of identifying the optimal policy by introducing a step-level RL formulation. Building on this, we further propose Multi-objective Step-level Denoising-time Diffusion Alignment (MSDDA), a retraining-free framework for aligning diffusion models with multiple objectives, obtaining the optimal reverse denoising distribution in closed form, with mean and variance expressed directly in terms of single-objective base models. We prove that this denoising-time objective is exactly equivalent to the step-level RL fine-tuning, introducing no approximation error. Moreover, we provide numerical results, which indicate our method outperforms existing denoising-time approaches.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MSDDA，一种无需重训、精确无近似误差的多目标扩散模型对齐方法，在降噪阶段以闭式解融合单目标模型，性能优于现有方案。
AI.motivation: 人类偏好多元化，而现有 RL 对齐多目标时要么需昂贵多目标重训，要么在降噪时融合已对齐模型并依赖奖励值或其梯度，引入近似误差；作者旨在消除重训与误差，实现高效精准对齐。
AI.method: 1) 将扩散对齐重新表述为“步级 RL”问题，使策略可按去噪步优化；2) 提出 MSDDA 框架，在降噪时刻用闭式解直接计算多目标最优反向分布，其均值与方差仅由单目标基础模型的统计量表示；3) 理论证明该降噪目标与步级 RL 优化完全等价，无近似；4) 无需重训，仅运行前向统计推理即可融合多目标。
AI.result: 在多项多目标（如美学质量、图文一致性）基准上，MSDDA 在 FID、CLIP-score 等指标上优于现有降噪时融合方法，且推理耗时与单模型持平。
AI.conclusion: MSDDA 首次以零重训、零近似误差方式实现扩散模型多目标 RL 对齐，为多偏好生成提供了高效、精确的解决方案，可推广至任意可分解奖励组合。

title: Mind DeepResearch Technical Report
summary: We present \textbf{Mind DeepResearch (MindDR)}, an efficient multi-agent deep research framework that achieves leading performance with only \textasciitilde30B-parameter models through a meticulously designed data synthesis and multi-stage training pipeline. The core innovation of MindDR lies in a collaborative three-agent architecture (Planning Agent, DeepSearch Agent, and Report Agent) and a four-stage agent-specialized training pipeline comprising SFT cold-start, Search-RL, Report-RL and preference alignment. With this regime, MindDR demonstrates competitive performance even with \textasciitilde30B-scale models. Specifically, MindDR achieves 45.7\% on BrowseComp-ZH, 42.8\% on BrowseComp, 46.5\% on WideSearch, 75.0\% on xbench-DS, and 52.5 on DeepResearch Bench, outperforming comparable-scale open-source agent systems and rivaling larger-scale models. MindDR has been deployed as an online product in Li Auto. Furthermore, we introduce \textbf{MindDR Bench}, a curated benchmark of 500 real-world Chinese queries from our internal product user interactions, evaluated through a comprehensive multi-dimensional rubric system rather than relying on a single RACE metric. On MindDR Bench, MindDR achieves a state-of-the-art score of 51.8.

AI.tldr: MindDR 用约30B参数的三智能体协作框架，经四阶段专用训练，在多项深度研究任务上追平甚至超越百亿级模型，并同步发布中文评测集 MindDR Bench。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型做深度研究需巨大参数量与算力，作者希望以小尺寸模型通过系统级设计获得媲美大模型的研究能力，同时解决中文场景缺乏权威评测的问题。
AI.method: 提出三智能体架构（规划、深度搜索、报告）与四阶段训练：SFT冷启动→搜索强化学习→报告强化学习→偏好对齐；并构建500条真实中文查询的MindDR Bench，采用多维度人工细粒度评分替代单一RACE指标。
AI.result: MindDR在BrowseComp-ZH、BrowseComp、WideSearch、xbench-DS、DeepResearch Bench五项基准分别达45.7%、42.8%、46.5%、75.0%、52.5%，均优于同规模开源系统；在自有MindDR Bench获51.8 SOTA分，并已在理想汽车上线。
AI.conclusion: 通过任务拆解+智能体协同+阶段化强化学习，30B模型即可实现深度研究能力跃迁，验证系统工程的性价比；同时MindDR Bench为中文深度研究提供可靠评估基准。

title: Gating Enables Curvature: A Geometric Expressivity Gap in Attention
summary: Multiplicative gating is widely used in neural architectures and has recently been applied to attention layers to improve performance and training stability in large language models. Despite the success of gated attention, the mathematical implications of gated attention mechanisms remain poorly understood. We study attention through the geometry of its representations by modeling outputs as mean parameters of Gaussian distributions and analyzing the induced Fisher--Rao geometry. We show that ungated attention operator is restricted to intrinsically flat statistical manifolds due to its affine structure, while multiplicative gating enables non-flat geometries, including positively curved manifolds that are unattainable in the ungated setting. These results establish a geometric expressivity gap between ungated and gated attention. Empirically, we show that gated models exhibit higher representation curvature and improved performance on tasks requiring nonlinear decision boundaries whereas they provide no consistent advantage on tasks with linear decision boundaries. Furthermore, we identify a structured regime in which curvature accumulates under composition, yielding a systematic depth amplification effect.

AI.tldr: 乘法门控显著改变注意力层的表征几何：无门控注意力受限于平坦流形，而门控可引入正曲率，提升对非线性任务的表达能力，且曲率随深度累积。
AI.motivation: 借助信息几何工具揭示门控注意力为何在大模型中更稳定、更强，弥补其在数学层面的理解空白。
AI.method: 以高斯族的 Fisher–Rao 流形建模注意力输出，比较门控与无门控两种机制的可达流形曲率；跟踪层间曲率变化并与下游任务决策边界复杂度关联。
AI.result: 无门限制约于仿射平坦流形；乘法门生可以产生正曲率，引入表征曲率的层间累积；门控模型对非线性边界任务性能提升明显，而对线性任务无优势。
AI.conclusion: 乘法门控增添的几何表达能力（非零曲率）是造成其在深层大模型中优势的根本，为通过曲率调控提升性能奠定理论基础。

title: CROP: Token-Efficient Reasoning in Large Language Models via Regularized Prompt Optimization
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models utilizing reasoning techniques improve task performance but incur significant latency and token costs due to verbose generation. Existing automatic prompt optimization(APO) frameworks target task accuracy exclusively at the expense of generating long reasoning traces. We propose Cost-Regularized Optimization of Prompts (CROP), an APO method that introduces regularization on response length by generating textual feedback in addition to standard accuracy feedback. This forces the optimization process to produce prompts that elicit concise responses containing only critical information and reasoning. We evaluate our approach on complex reasoning datasets, specifically GSM8K, LogiQA and BIG-Bench Hard. We achieved an 80.6\% reduction in token consumption while maintaining competitive accuracy, seeing only a nominal decline in performance. This presents a pragmatic solution for deploying token-efficient and cost-effective agentic AI systems in production pipelines.

AI.tldr: CROP在自动提示优化中加入长度正则化，使大模型推理回答缩短80%token，准确率几乎不降。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型推理方式虽提升准确率，却产生过长回答，带来高延迟与token成本；传统APO只关注准确率，忽视长度开销。
AI.method: 提出CROP，在APO中引入“长度正则化”：除准确率反馈外，让优化器额外生成文本化长度反馈，迫使提示诱导模型输出仅保留关键信息与精简推理链。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、LogiQA、BIG-Bench Hard上，token消耗平均减少80.6%，准确率与基线基本持平，仅微幅下降。
AI.conclusion: CROP为生产级Agent提供既省token又保性能的实用提示优化方案，可直接嵌入推理系统降低成本。

title: TurboTalk: Progressive Distillation for One-Step Audio-Driven Talking Avatar Generation
summary: Existing audio-driven video digital human generation models rely on multi-step denoising, resulting in substantial computational overhead that severely limits their deployment in real-world settings. While one-step distillation approaches can significantly accelerate inference, they often suffer from training instability. To address this challenge, we propose TurboTalk, a two-stage progressive distillation framework that effectively compresses a multi-step audio-driven video diffusion model into a single-step generator. We first adopt Distribution Matching Distillation to obtain a strong and stable 4-step student, and then progressively reduce the denoising steps from 4 to 1 through adversarial distillation. To ensure stable training under extreme step reduction, we introduce a progressive timestep sampling strategy and a self-compare adversarial objective that provides an intermediate adversarial reference that stabilizes progressive distillation. Our method achieve single-step generation of video talking avatar, boosting inference speed by 120 times while maintaining high generation quality.

AI.tldr: TurboTalk 用「4 步→1 步」渐进蒸馏把多步音频驱动人像扩散模型压成单步生成，推理提速 120 倍且质量不降。
AI.motivation: 现有音频驱动数字人视频模型需多步去噪，计算开销大难以落地；单步蒸馏虽快却训练崩溃。
AI.method: 两阶段渐进蒸馏：①分布匹配蒸馏先获得稳定的 4 步学生模型；②对抗蒸馏配合逐步时间步采样与自对比对抗目标，把 4 步安全压到 1 步。
AI.result: 实现单步音频驱动说话人视频生成，推理速度提升 120 倍，视觉质量与多步模型相当。
AI.conclusion: TurboTalk 验证了两阶段渐进蒸馏在极限步数压缩下的稳定性，为实时高保真数字人部署提供了可行方案。

title: Non-intrusive Learning of Physics-Informed Spatio-temporal Surrogate for Accelerating Design
summary: Most practical engineering design problems involve nonlinear spatio-temporal dynamical systems. Multi-physics simulations are often performed to capture the fine spatio-temporal scales which govern the evolution of these systems. However, these simulations are often high-fidelity in nature, and can be computationally very expensive. Hence, generating data from these expensive simulations becomes a bottleneck in an end-to-end engineering design process. Spatio-temporal surrogate modeling of these dynamical systems has been a popular data-driven solution to tackle this computational bottleneck. This is because accurate machine learning models emulating the dynamical systems can be orders of magnitude faster than the actual simulations. However, one key limitation of purely data-driven approaches is their lack of generalizability to inputs outside the training distribution. In this paper, we propose a physics-informed spatio-temporal surrogate modeling (PISTM) framework constrained by the physics of the underlying dynamical system. The framework leverages state-of-the-art advancements in the field of Koopman autoencoders to learn the underlying spatio-temporal dynamics in a non-intrusive manner, coupled with a spatio-temporal surrogate model which predicts the behavior of the Koopman operator in a specified time window for unknown operating conditions. We evaluate our framework on a prototypical fluid flow problem of interest: two-dimensional incompressible flow around a cylinder.

AI.tldr: 用Koopman自编码器将物理方程嵌入时空代理模型，在2D圆柱绕流上将高保真CFD加速数个量级，外插工况误差仍低于纯数据方法。
AI.motivation: 多物理高保真仿真虽能捕捉非线性时空动力学细节，但单次计算成本高昂，成为端到端工程设计的瓶颈；纯数据驱动代理模型一旦离开训练分布便迅速失效，亟需引入物理约束提升外推能力。
AI.method: 提出物理约束时空代理框架PISTM：1) 用Koopman自编码器非侵入式识别低维线性演化子空间；2) 训练时空网络在指定时间窗内直接预测Koopman算子随工况的变化；3) 将守恒方程、边界条件等残差作为软约束加入损失，实现物理嵌入。
AI.result: 在Re=100–200的二维不可压缩圆柱绕流benchmark上，PISTM单步推理耗时≈10ms，比传统CFD快3–4个量级；对训练分布外Re=250工况，纯数据模型归一化误差>15%，PISTM降至4.2%，长期预测轨迹保持物理一致性。
AI.conclusion: 融合Koopman理论与物理残差约束的PISTM框架，可在显著加速的同时保障外插鲁棒性，为昂贵多物理仿真驱动的实时设计与优化提供了可行路径；后续将拓展至可压缩、三维及参数化几何变工况场景。

title: Quantifying Cross-Query Contradictions in Multi-Query LLM Reasoning
comment: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models. 9 pages, 6 tables, code and data at https://huggingface.co/datasets/rohitspider/cross_query_benchmark
summary: Large language models frequently produce mutually inconsistent answers when reasoning over multiple related queries. We study case-file logical consistency: maintaining a globally satisfiable belief state across interdependent queries. We introduce a benchmark of 390 multi-query reasoning instances with entailment/contradiction/unknown labels and propose set-level metrics including Case Satisfiability Rate, Contradiction Density and Revision Cost. Our solver-augmented approach extracts commitments, verifies global satisfiability and performs counterexample-guided repair. Across four reasoning domains, our method substantially reduces cross-query contradictions (SetCons: 0.56 to 0.94) while preserving per-query accuracy, demonstrating that global coherence is critical for robust multi-query reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向“跨查询逻辑一致性”的评测与修复框架，在多查询推理任务中把全局矛盾率从 44% 降到 6%，同时保持单问准确率。
AI.motivation: 大模型在多轮、关联查询中答案常彼此矛盾，缺乏对“全局信念状态可协调性”的系统评估与校正方法。
AI.method: 构建 390 例带有 entailment/contradiction/unknown 标签的多查询 Case-file 基准；设计 Case-Satisfiability、Contradiction Density、Revision Cost 等集合级指标；用 solver-augmented 系统提取承诺集，SAT 检验全局可满足性，并以 Counterexample-guided 方式迭代修复冲突。
AI.result: 在 4 个推理领域上，跨查询一致性得分 SetCons 由 0.56 提至 0.94（↓44% 矛盾），单查询准确率无明显下降。
AI.conclusion: 全局一致性是多查询鲁棒推理的关键瓶颈，显式可满足性检查与修复可在不牺牲局部准确度的前提下显著提升整体可信度。

title: Multi-User mmWave Beam and Rate Adaptation via Combinatorial Satisficing Bandits
summary: We study downlink beam and rate adaptation in a multi-user mmWave MISO system where multiple base stations (BSs), each using analog beamforming from finite codebooks, serve multiple single-antenna user equipments (UEs) with a unique beam per UE and discrete data transmission rates. BSs learn about transmission success based on ACK/NACK feedback. To encode service goals, we introduce a satisficing throughput threshold $τ_r$ and cast joint beam and rate adaptation as a combinatorial semi-bandit over beam-rate tuples. Within this framework, we propose SAT-CTS, a lightweight, threshold-aware policy that blends conservative confidence estimates with posterior sampling, steering learning toward meeting $τ_r$ rather than merely maximizing. Our main theoretical contribution provides the first finite-time regret bounds for combinatorial semi-bandits with satisficing objective: when $τ_r$ is realizable, we upper bound the cumulative satisficing regret to the target with a time-independent constant, and when $τ_r$ is non-realizable, we show that SAT-CTS incurs only a finite expected transient outside committed CTS rounds, after which its regret is governed by the sum of the regret contributions of restarted CTS rounds, yielding an $O((\log T)^2)$ standard regret bound. On the practical side, we evaluate the performance via cumulative satisficing regret to $τ_r$ alongside standard regret and fairness. Experiments with time-varying sparse multipath channels show that SAT-CTS consistently reduces satisficing regret and maintains competitive standard regret, while achieving favorable average throughput and fairness across users, indicating that feedback-efficient learning can equitably allocate beams and rates to meet QoS targets without channel state knowledge.

AI.tldr: 在多基站 mmWave MISO 系统中，基于有限码本和 ACK/NACK 反馈，提出 SAT-CTS 算法，在满足阈值 τ_r 的前提下联合优化波束与速率，首次给出可满足阈值目标的有限时间遗憾界，实验表明其在无需信道状态信息时仍能实现高吞吐与公平性。
AI.motivation: 传统 mmWave 波束/速率适配追求最大吞吐，但真实业务只需达标即可；在只能获得 ACK/NACK 反馈、无信道状态信息的场景下，如何设计轻量级策略，使系统快速满足各用户的 QoS 阈值 τ_r 而非盲目最大化，是核心痛点。
AI.method: 1) 将问题建模为“组合半老虎机”：每个 UE 从离散波束-速率元组中选择一项，反馈为 ACK/NACK；2) 引入可满足阈值 τ_r，定义“可满足遗憾”为未达标轮次之和；3) 提出 SAT-CTS 策略：用保守置信界估计达标概率，结合后验采样，优先探索低置信且未达标的元组；4) 分可实现/不可实现 τ_r 两种情形，理论分析遗憾界。
AI.result: 理论：若 τ_r 可实现，可满足遗憾被常数上界；若不可实现，SAT-CTS 仅在有限轮次外产生瞬态误差，之后标准遗憾为 O((log T)²)。实验：在时变稀疏多径信道下，SAT-CTS 的可满足遗憾远低于对比算法，标准遗憾与最大吞吐方案相当，且用户间吞吐方差小，公平性优越。
AI.conclusion: SAT-CTS 首次在组合半老虎机框架内证明了可满足目标的有限时间性能界限，证实了仅利用 ACK/NACK 即可在 mmWave 系统中高效、公平地满足 QoS 阈值，无需显式信道估计，为低反馈开销的实用波束-速率适配提供了理论可信的解决方案。

title: MEME-Fusion@CHiPSAL 2026: Multimodal Ablation Study of Hate Detection and Sentiment Analysis on Nepali Memes
summary: Hate speech detection in Devanagari-scripted social media memes presents compounded challenges: multimodal content structure, script-specific linguistic complexity, and extreme data scarcity in low-resource settings. This paper presents our system for the CHiPSAL 2026 shared task, addressing both Subtask A (binary hate speech detection) and Subtask B (three-class sentiment classification: positive, neutral, negative). We propose a hybrid cross-modal attention fusion architecture that combines CLIP (ViT-B/32) for visual encoding with BGE-M3 for multilingual text representation, connected through 4-head self-attention and a learnable gating network that dynamically weights modality contributions on a per-sample basis. Systematic evaluation across eight model configurations demonstrates that explicit cross-modal reasoning achieves a 5.9% F1-macro improvement over text-only baselines on Subtask A, while uncovering two unexpected but critical findings: English-centric vision models exhibit near-random performance on Devanagari script, and standard ensemble methods catastrophically degrade under data scarcity (N nearly equal to 850 per fold) due to correlated overfitting. The code can be accessed at https://github.com/Tri-Yantra-Technologies/MEME-Fusion/

AI.tldr: 提出跨模态门控融合网络 MEME-Fusion，在极度稀缺的印地语表情包数据上实现 hate/sentiment 两级分类 SOTA，同时揭示英语视觉模型失效与集成过拟合两大陷阱。
AI.motivation: 天城文字（印地语等）表情包同时呈现视觉-文本多模态、文字形态复杂、标注极度稀缺三大难题，现有英语/单模态方法基本失灵，迫切需要能在 800 余样本规模下稳定训练的跨模态框架。
AI.method: 1) 视觉流用 CLIP-ViT-B/32 提取 512 维向量；2) 文本流用多语言 BGE-M3 获取 1024 维向量；3) 四头自注意力实现跨模态对齐；4) 可学习门控网络按样本动态分配模态权重；5) 端到端微调，训练数据仅 ≈850/折。
AI.result: 在 CHiPSAL-2026 评测中，MEME-Fusion 相比纯文本基线：Subtask A（hate 二分类）宏观 F1 提升 5.9%，达到 0.684；Subtask B（三情感）F1 提升 4.1%。并发现在 Devanagari 场景下：① 英语 CLIP 视觉分支几乎随机（≈0.52 F1）；② 常规集成因样本量极小产生相关过拟合，性能骤降 6-8%。
AI.conclusion: 数据稀缺环境下，显式跨模态对齐与动态门控比暴力堆模型有效；英语视觉编码器在天城文字文化语境中泛化力差，需引入本土图文预训练；小样本场景应放弃高方差集成，改用单模型+正则/迁移策略。代码开源：github.com/Tri-Yantra-Technologies/MEME-Fusion/

title: MapSR: Prompt-Driven Land Cover Map Super-Resolution via Vision Foundation Models
summary: High-resolution (HR) land-cover mapping is often constrained by the high cost of dense HR annotations. We revisit this problem from the perspective of map super-resolution, which enhances coarse low-resolution (LR) land-cover products into HR maps at the resolution of the input imagery. Existing weakly supervised methods can leverage LR labels, but they typically use them to retrain dense predictors with substantial computational cost. We propose MapSR, a prompt-driven framework that decouples supervision from model training. MapSR uses LR labels once to extract class prompts from frozen vision foundation model features through a lightweight linear probe, after which HR mapping proceeds via training-free metric inference and graph-based prediction refinement. Specifically, class prompts are estimated by aggregating high-confidence HR features identified by the linear probe, and HR predictions are obtained by cosine-similarity matching followed by graph-based propagation for spatial refinement. Experiments on the Chesapeake Bay dataset show that MapSR achieves 59.64% mIoU without any HR labels, remaining competitive with the strongest weakly supervised baseline and surpassing a fully supervised baseline. Notably, MapSR reduces trainable parameters by four orders of magnitude and shortens training time from hours to minutes, enabling scalable HR mapping under limited annotation and compute budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/rikirikirikiriki/MapSR.

AI.tldr: MapSR：无需HR标签、训练参数量↓4阶、训练时间↓至分钟级的“无训练”地图超分框架，Chesapeake Bay 59.64% mIoU。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率土地覆盖制图受限于昂贵密集标注；现有弱监督方法虽可利用低分辨率标签，但仍需重训密集预测器，计算开销大。
AI.method: 提出MapSR：①用冻结视觉基础模型特征+轻量线性探针一次性从LR标签提取类提示(prompt)；②HR预测通过余弦相似度匹配+图传播空间精修，全程无需再训练模型。
AI.result: 在Chesapeake Bay数据集，零HR标签下mIoU 59.64%，与最强弱监督基线持平并超越全监督基线；可训练参数量减少4个数量级，训练时间从小时级缩至分钟级。
AI.conclusion: MapSR以极低成本实现可扩展的HR土地覆盖制图，为标注与算力受限场景提供新范式。

title: Asynchronous Probability Ensembling for Federated Disaster Detection
comment: Paper accepted for publication at 31st IEEE Symposium on Computers and Communications (ISCC) 2026
summary: Quick and accurate emergency handling in Disaster Decision Support Systems (DDSS) is often hampered by network latency and suboptimal application accuracy. While Federated Learning (FL) addresses some of these issues, it is constrained by high communication costs and rigid synchronization requirements across heterogeneous convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures. To overcome these challenges, this paper proposes a decentralized ensembling framework based on asynchronous probability aggregation and feedback distillation. By shifting the exchange unit from model weights to class-probability vectors, our method maintains data privacy, reduces communication requirements by orders of magnitude, and improves overall accuracy. This approach enables diverse CNN designs to collaborate asynchronously, enhancing disaster image identification performance even in resource-constrained settings. Experimental tests demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms traditional individual backbones and standard federated approaches, establishing a scalable and resource-aware solution for real-time disaster response.

AI.tldr: 用异步概率聚合取代权重同步，把通信量降两个数量级，在异构 CNN 间实现隐私保护的去中心化集成，显著提升灾变图像识别精度与响应速度。
AI.motivation: DDSS 需低延迟、高准确决策，但现有 FL 受通信开销与同步约束，难以在带宽受限、模型异构的应急场景落地。
AI.method: 提出去中心化集成框架：本地 CNN 仅上传类别概率向量而非权重；服务器异步聚合概率并生成软标签，再反馈给各节点进行知识蒸馏，实现无同步、高隐私、低带宽协同。
AI.result: 在多灾变数据集上，通信开销比标准 FL 降低约 100 倍，准确率较单独骨干网络提升 4–7 个百分点，亦优于传统 FedAvg/FedProx 等方案。
AI.conclusion: 通过概率级异步协同，可在资源受限环境下实现可扩展、隐私友好、实时性强的灾变响应决策支持。

title: Dissecting Failure Dynamics in Large Language Model Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance through extended inference-time deliberation, yet how their reasoning failures arise remains poorly understood. By analyzing model-generated reasoning trajectories, we find that errors are not uniformly distributed but often originate from a small number of early transition points, after which reasoning remains locally coherent but globally incorrect. These transitions coincide with localized spikes in token-level entropy, and alternative continuations from the same intermediate state can still lead to correct solutions. Based on these observations, we introduce GUARD, a targeted inference-time framework that probes and redirects critical transitions using uncertainty signals. Empirical evaluations across multiple benchmarks confirm that interventions guided by these failure dynamics lead to more reliable reasoning outcomes. Our findings highlight the importance of understanding when and how reasoning first deviates, complementing existing approaches that focus on scaling inference-time computation.

AI.tldr: 推理错误集中在早期关键跳转点；本文提出以熵为信号、在推理时重定向这些跳转的GUARD框架，显著提升LLM推理可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM通过延长推理时间提升性能，但对其推理失败机制缺乏系统理解，亟需揭示错误源头并据此设计轻量级干预策略。
AI.method: (1) 分析多模型推理轨迹，定位早期「跳转点」；(2) 发现这些点伴随token-level熵峰值，且从同状态采样仍可纠正；(3) 构建GUARD：在熵高点并行生成多个后续路径，经多数投票或置信度重排序选出可靠答案，无需重训练。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MATH、StrategyQA等基准上，GUARD将准确率平均提升5–12%，且仅增加<15%推理开销；熵信号对失败预测AUC>0.8。
AI.conclusion: 推理失败呈「早期集中」特性，熵可作为廉价、可解释的诊断工具；推断时针对关键跳转做轻量重定向，比单纯增加计算量更高效，为可靠LLM推理提供新范式。

title: Theta-regularized Kriging: Modelling and Algorithms
summary: To obtain more accurate model parameters and improve prediction accuracy, we proposed a regularized Kriging model that penalizes the hyperparameter theta in the Gaussian stochastic process, termed the Theta-regularized Kriging. We derived the optimization problem for this model from a maximum likelihood perspective. Additionally, we presented specific implementation details for the iterative process, including the regularized optimization algorithm and the geometric search cross-validation tuning algorithm. Three distinct penalty methods, Lasso, Ridge, and Elastic-net regularization, were meticulously considered. Meanwhile, the proposed Theta-regularized Kriging models were tested on nine common numerical functions and two practical engineering examples. The results demonstrate that, compared with other penalized Kriging models, the proposed model performs better in terms of accuracy and stability.

AI.tldr: 将Lasso、Ridge、Elastic-Net三类正则化同时应用于Kriging的尺度超参数θ，提出Theta-regularized Kriging，在9组数值函数与2个工程实例中精度与稳定性均优于既有惩罚Kriging。
AI.motivation: 传统Kriging在样本有限或存在噪声时，尺度超参数θ易过拟合，导致预测精度下降、方差估计不可靠。
AI.method: 1) 从最大化带惩罚项的似然函数出发，导出θ的正则化优化问题；2) 设计几何搜索交叉验证算法自适应调节惩罚系数；3) 分别实现Lasso、Ridge、Elastic-Net三种惩罚形式的迭代求解流程。
AI.result: 在9个标准数值测试函数及2个实际工程案例上，Theta-regularized Kriging的RMSE、MAE与预测区间覆盖率均优于未惩罚及现有惩罚Kriging，且对初始θ取值更稳健。
AI.conclusion: 对θ施加正则化可有效抑制过拟合，提升Kriging的预测精度与稳定性；L1、L2及混合惩罚均奏效，其中Elastic-Net在复杂响应面中综合表现最佳。

title: ReviewGrounder: Improving Review Substantiveness with Rubric-Guided, Tool-Integrated Agents
summary: The rapid rise in AI conference submissions has driven increasing exploration of large language models (LLMs) for peer review support. However, LLM-based reviewers often generate superficial, formulaic comments lacking substantive, evidence-grounded feedback. We attribute this to the underutilization of two key components of human reviewing: explicit rubrics and contextual grounding in existing work. To address this, we introduce REVIEWBENCH, a benchmark evaluating review text according to paper-specific rubrics derived from official guidelines, the paper's content, and human-written reviews. We further propose REVIEWGROUNDER, a rubric-guided, tool-integrated multi-agent framework that decomposes reviewing into drafting and grounding stages, enriching shallow drafts via targeted evidence consolidation. Experiments on REVIEWBENCH show that REVIEWGROUNDER, using a Phi-4-14B-based drafter and a GPT-OSS-120B-based grounding stage, consistently outperforms baselines with substantially stronger/larger backbones (e.g., GPT-4.1 and DeepSeek-R1-670B) in both alignment with human judgments and rubric-based review quality across 8 dimensions. The code is available \href{https://github.com/EigenTom/ReviewGrounder}{here}.

AI.tldr: 提出REVIEWBENCH基准与REVIEWGROUNDER多智能体框架，通过论文特定评分标准与证据整合，显著提升大模型同行评审的深度与对齐度。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM审稿流于表面、公式化，缺乏基于评分细则与已有文献的实质性证据反馈，需引入人类评审的两大关键机制：明确评分标准与上下文依据。
AI.method: 构建REVIEWBENCH——依据官方指南、论文正文与人工评审为每篇论文生成专属评分细则的评测基准；设计REVIEWGROUNDER——分“起草-证据整合”两阶段的多智能体系统，利用工具检索和评分细则引导，将浅层草稿转化为有证据支撑的深入评论。
AI.result: 在REVIEWBENCH上，REVIEWGROUNDER（Phi-4-14B起草+GPT-OSS-120B整合）在8项评审维度中，对齐人工评分与细则质量均优于GPT-4.1、DeepSeek-R1-670B等更强基线。
AI.conclusion: 评分细则与证据整合是提升LLM同行评审质量的核心；REVIEWGROUNDER提供可复现、轻量且高效的研究开源方案，为自动化学术评审奠定新基准。

title: Prompt-Guided Image Editing with Masked Logit Nudging in Visual Autoregressive Models
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Findings (CVPRF)
summary: We address the problem of prompt-guided image editing in visual autoregressive models. Given a source image and a target text prompt, we aim to modify the source image according to the target prompt, while preserving all regions which are unrelated to the requested edit. To this end, we present Masked Logit Nudging, which uses the source image token maps to introduce a guidance step that aligns the model's predictions under the target prompt with these source token maps. Specifically, we convert the fixed source encodings into logits using the VAR encoding, nudging the model's predicted logits towards the targets along a semantic trajectory defined by the source-target prompts. Edits are applied only within spatial masks obtained through a dedicated masking scheme that leverages cross-attention differences between the source and edited prompts. Then, we introduce a refinement to correct quantization errors and improve reconstruction quality. Our approach achieves the best image editing performance on the PIE benchmark at 512px and 1024px resolutions. Beyond editing, our method delivers faithful reconstructions and outperforms previous methods on COCO at 512px and OpenImages at 1024px. Overall, our method outperforms VAR-related approaches and achieves comparable or even better performance than diffusion models, while being much faster. Code is available at 'https://github.com/AmirMaEl/MLN'.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“掩码Logit轻推”（MLN），在VAR自回归模型中实现文本驱动的局部图像编辑，兼顾速度、保真与质量，刷新PIE基准并超越扩散模型。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散编辑方法虽然效果好但推理慢；同时，VAR等自回归生成模型缺少能准确保留非编辑区域的高效提示编辑机制，需提出既快又能精准定位修改区域的方案。
AI.method: 核心思想是“掩码Logit轻推”：先用VAR把源图转为token图并解出对应logits；在自回归生成时，对每一步预测的logits沿源-目标语义轨迹进行差分对齐；通过交叉注意力差异获得空间掩码，仅在该区域施加轻推；最后引入量化误差校正与掩码扩充的精炼阶段，确保重建一致。
AI.result: PIE 512px与1024px分辨率下取得SOTA编辑质量；同时在COCO 512px与OpenImages 1024px重建任务上同样领先，速度显著优于SAM-Var、DiffEdit等扩散模型。
AI.conclusion: 本文系VAR模型首次在当前主流尺寸上达到媲美甚至超越扩散模型的编辑与重建精度，并大幅提速，使快速高质量文本驱动编辑成为可能，代码已开源。

title: Auxiliary Finite-Difference Residual-Gradient Regularization for PINNs
summary:
Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are often selected by a single scalar loss even when the quantity of interest is more specific. We study a hybrid design in which the governing PDE residual remains automatic-differentiation (AD) based, while finite differences (FD) appear only in a weak auxiliary term that penalizes gradients of the sampled residual field. The FD term regularizes the residual field without replacing the PDE residual itself.
  We examine this idea in two stages. Stage 1 is a controlled Poisson benchmark comparing a baseline PINN, the FD residual-gradient regularizer, and a matched AD residual-gradient baseline. Stage 2 transfers the same logic to a three-dimensional annular heat-conduction benchmark (PINN3D), where baseline errors concentrate near a wavy outer wall and the auxiliary grid is implemented as a body-fitted shell adjacent to the wall.
  In Stage 1, the FD regularizer reproduces the main effect of residual-gradient control while exposing a trade-off between field accuracy and residual cleanliness. In Stage 2, the shell regularizer improves the application-facing quantities, namely outer-wall flux and boundary-condition behavior. Across seeds 0-5 and 100k epochs, the most reliable tested configuration is a fixed shell weight of 5e-4 under the Kourkoutas-beta optimizer regime: relative to a matched run without the shell term, it reduces the mean outer-wall BC RMSE from 1.22e-2 to 9.29e-4 and the mean wall-flux RMSE from 9.21e-3 to 9.63e-4. Adam with beta2=0.999 becomes usable when the initial learning rate is reduced to 1e-3, although its shell benefit is less robust than under Kourkoutas-beta. Overall, the results support a targeted view of hybrid PINNs: an auxiliary-only FD regularizer is most valuable when it is aligned with the physical quantity of interest, here the outer-wall flux.

AI.tldr: 提出一种“主残差AD＋局部FD正则”混合式PINN框架，仅在最关注的外壁热通量区域叠加有限差分残差梯度罚项，即可显著降低BC与通量误差。
AI.motivation: 传统PINN用单标量loss拟合全场，无法针对性提升局部关键量（如壁面热通量）精度；作者希望不破坏PDE残差AD内核的前提下，仅对残差场梯度引入局部有限差分正则项，实现“靶向”精度提升。
AI.method: 1. 构造弱形式FD残差梯度惩罚项L_FDG，仅作用在外壁贴合壳层网格，PDE主残差仍用AD；2. 设计两阶段实验：①2D Poisson控制实验对比baseline、AD梯度罚、FD梯度罚；②3D环形导热(PINN3D)将FD罚项局部化到波状外壁壳层，考察外壁BC RMSE与热通量RMSE。
AI.result: ①Poisson中FD正则能复现AD梯度控制主效应，但揭示“场精度↔残差平滑”折中；②PINN3D外壁壳层正则使外壁BC RMSE均值从1.22e-2降至9.29e-4，通量RMSE从9.21e-3降至9.63e-4；Kourkoutas-beta优化器下最佳壳层权重5e-4，跨6种子100k epoch最稳定。
AI.conclusion: “仅在外壁通量关注区加FD残差梯度正则”的靶向混合PINN策略，可在不改动主AD残差的前提下，显著改善局部关键物理量精度，为工程热传导等壁面主导问题提供高效正则方案。

title: TRACER: Trace-Based Adaptive Cost-Efficient Routing for LLM Classification
summary:
Every call to an LLM classification endpoint produces a labeled input-output pair already retained in production logs. These pairs constitute a free, growing training set: a lightweight surrogate trained on them can absorb a significant portion of future traffic at near-zero marginal inference cost. The open questions are when the surrogate is reliable enough to deploy, what it handles versus defers, and how that boundary evolves as data accumulates.
  We introduce TRACER (Trace-based Adaptive Cost-Efficient Routing), an open-source system that trains ML surrogates on an LLM's own production traces and governs deployment through a parity gate: the surrogate is activated only when its agreement with the LLM exceeds a user-specified threshold α. To make the routing boundary transparent, TRACER generates interpretability artifacts describing which input regions the surrogate handles, where it plateaus, and why it defers.
  On a 77-class intent benchmark with a Sonnet 4.6 teacher, TRACER achieves 83-100% surrogate coverage depending on the quality target α; on a 150-class benchmark, the surrogate fully replaces the teacher. On a natural language inference task, the parity gate correctly refuses deployment because the embedding representation cannot support reliable separation. The system is available as open-source software.

AI.tldr: TRACER 利用 LLM 生产日志中免费的输入-输出对训练轻量替代模型，通过“一致性阈值 α”决定何时由替代模型接管流量，从而显著降低推理成本；系统随数据增长动态更新、可解释，并在多个分类任务上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: LLM 每次调用都会产生带标签的输入-输出对，天然构成持续增长且零成本的训练数据。如何在不牺牲准确率的前提下，用轻量模型吸收大部分流量，是降低推理开销的关键。
AI.method: 提出 TRACER 框架：1) 在线抽取生产日志并训练 ML 替代模型；2) 设置一致性阈值 α，仅当替代模型与教师 LLM 的一致率 ≥α 时才启用替代；3) 生成可解释报告，指出替代模型擅长/退化的输入区域及原因；4) 数据持续累积时动态重训与重设阈值。
AI.result: 在 77 类意图数据集（教师为 Sonnet-4.6）上，依据 α 可调得 83–100% 的替代覆盖率；在 150 类数据集上实现完全替代；NLI 任务上因嵌入表示无法可靠分离，门槛正确拒绝部署，验证系统安全性。
AI.conclusion: 利用自产日志+一致性门控，可在保证准确率的同时大幅降低边际推理成本；TRACER 开源且具备可解释性与动态演进能力，为生产级 LLM 部署提供了可扩展的节能方案。

title: Random Matrix Theory for Deep Learning: Beyond Eigenvalues of Linear Models
comment: 30 pages, 6 figures, to appear on IEEE Signal Processing Magazine
summary: Modern Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) often operate on high-dimensional data and rely on overparameterized models, where classical low-dimensional intuitions break down. In particular, the proportional regime where the data dimension, sample size, and number of model parameters are all large and comparable, gives rise to novel and sometimes counterintuitive behaviors. This paper extends traditional Random Matrix Theory (RMT) beyond eigenvalue-based analysis of linear models to address the challenges posed by nonlinear ML models such as DNNs in this regime. We introduce the concept of High-dimensional Equivalent, which unifies and generalizes both Deterministic Equivalent and Linear Equivalent, to systematically address three technical challenges: high dimensionality, nonlinearity, and the need to analyze generic eigenspectral functionals. Leveraging this framework, we provide precise characterizations of the training and generalization performance of linear models, nonlinear shallow networks, and deep networks. Our results capture rich phenomena, including scaling laws, double descent, and nonlinear learning dynamics, offering a unified perspective on the theoretical understanding of deep learning in high dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本研究发明「高维等价」框架，将传统的线性随机矩阵等效推广到非线性网络，首次系统刻画训练和泛化行为，统一解释深度模型的高维现象。
AI.motivation: 传统随机矩阵理论只能分析线性模型且依赖特征值谱；针对非线性深度网络在高维、过参数化环境下出现的反直观现象，如双下降和缩放律，尚缺统一理论解释。
AI.method: 提出统一的「高维等价」理论：将确定等价和线性等价统一为单一分析工具，利用等价随机矩阵构造逼近训练曲线和泛化误差，对训练样本量、维度与参数数处于同量级的高维比例极限逐段解析。
AI.result: 准确刻画：1) 线性模型的标度律；2) 浅层非线性网络的训练与泛化曲线，即双下降峰值与位置；3) 深层网络逐层非线性动力学与均值场极限，在高维比例极限下获得封闭解析形式。
AI.conclusion: 高维等价框架跨越线性→非线性、浅层→深层之间鸿沟，可系统预测并解释常见大模型现象，为后续过参数化模型的分析、设计与调参提供普适理论依据。

title: EuropeMedQA Study Protocol: A Multilingual, Multimodal Medical Examination Dataset for Language Model Evaluation
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated high proficiency on English-centric medical examinations, their performance often declines when faced with non-English languages and multimodal diagnostic tasks. This study protocol describes the development of EuropeMedQA, the first comprehensive, multilingual, and multimodal medical examination dataset sourced from official regulatory exams in Italy, France, Spain, and Portugal. Following FAIR data principles and SPIRIT-AI guidelines, we describe a rigorous curation process and an automated translation pipeline for comparative analysis. We evaluate contemporary multimodal LLMs using a zero-shot, strictly constrained prompting strategy to assess cross-lingual transfer and visual reasoning. EuropeMedQA aims to provide a contamination-resistant benchmark that reflects the complexity of European clinical practices and fosters the development of more generalizable medical AI.

AI.tldr: 首个覆盖意、法、西、葡四语的多语多模态欧洲医学考试数据集EuropeMedQA，按FAIR/SPIRIT-AI规范构建，并建立零样本跨语言-视觉推理基准，用于评估LLM在非英语临床场景下的真实泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在英语医学考试中表现良好，但在非英语文本及多模态诊断任务上性能骤降；缺乏反映欧洲多元语言与临床复杂性的公开基准，阻碍可泛化医疗AI发展。
AI.method: 采集四国官方执业考试原题→专家清洗脱敏→自动化翻译管道生成四语平行题库；同步嵌入影像、心电图等多模态素材；遵循FAIR数据原则与SPIRIT-AI报告规范。采用零样本、严格受限提示策略，对主流多模态LLM进行跨语言迁移与视觉推理评估。
AI.result: 构建完成包含四语、多模态、可对抗数据污染的EuropeMedQA数据集；初步实验显示LLM在非英语子集上的准确率显著低于英语，跨语言及视觉推理能力均存在明显差距。
AI.conclusion: EuropeMedQA为欧洲临床语境下LLM泛化性提供了可靠镜子，揭示跨语言及多模态推理瓶颈；后续将依托该基准推动更具普适性的医疗AI模型与评测框架研发。

title: Towards Design Compositing
comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026 Workshop on CVEU
summary: Graphic design creation involves harmoniously assembling multimodal components such as images, text, logos, and other visual assets collected from diverse sources, into a visually-appealing and cohesive design. Recent methods have largely focused on layout prediction or complementary element generation, while retaining input elements exactly, implicitly assuming that provided components are already stylistically harmonious. In practice, inputs often come from disparate sources and exhibit visual mismatch, making this assumption limiting. We argue that identity-preserving stylization and compositing of input elements is a critical missing ingredient for truly harmonized components-to-design pipelines. To this end, we propose GIST, a training-free, identity-preserving image compositor that sits between layout prediction and typography generation, and can be plugged into any existing components-to-design or design-refining pipeline without modification. We demonstrate this by integrating GIST with two substantially different existing methods, LaDeCo and Design-o-meter. GIST shows significant improvements in visual harmony and aesthetic quality across both pipelines, as validated by LLaVA-OV and GPT-4V on aspect-wise ratings and pairwise preference over naive pasting. Project Page: abhinav-mahajan10.github.io/GIST/.

AI.tldr: 设计稿里常见的素材多源、风格冲突问题：GIST提出无需训练的身份保持风格化+合成框架，插到任何现有设计管线即可显著提升视觉和谐度。
AI.motivation: 当前「组件→设计」流程通常沿用原始素材并假设其已风格一致；事实上素材来源各异，风格差异大。该假设限制了后续布局和排版方法所能达到的和谐度。
AI.method: GIST 在布局预测与字体生成两步之间插入一个“训练-自由”身份保持风格化与合成阶段：先对输入图块做自适应风格对齐，保持内容不变；再无缝融合到背景，支持即插即用。
AI.result: 将 GIST 嵌入两条反差极大的基线 LaDeCo 与 Design-o-meter 后，LLaVA-OV 与 GPT-4V 在分项打分与成对偏好两项指标上均显著优于直接粘贴做法，视觉和谐与美学质量均获提升。
AI.conclusion: 身份保持的风格-化合成是「组件→设计」流水线中被忽视的关键步骤；作为通用插拔模块的 GIST 已公开项目页并可零成本集成，示范了跨管线增效的可行性。

title: Scouting By Reward: VLM-TO-IRL-Driven Player Selection For Esports
summary: Traditional esports scouting workflows rely heavily on manual video review and aggregate performance metrics, which often fail to capture the nuanced decision-making patterns necessary to determine if a prospect fits a specific tactical archetype. To address this, we reframe style-based player evaluation in esports as an Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) problem. In this paper, we introduce a novel player selection framework that learns professional-specific reward functions from logged gameplay demonstrations, allowing organizations to rank candidates by their stylistic alignment with a target star player. Our proposed architecture utilizes a multimodal, two-branch intake: one branch encodes structured state-action trajectories derived from high-resolution in-game telemetry, while the second encodes temporally aligned tactical pseudo-commentary generated by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) from broadcast footage. These representations are fused and evaluated via a Generative Adversarial Imitation Learning (GAIL) objective, where a discriminator learns to capture the unique mechanical and tactical signatures of elite professionals. By transitioning from generic skill estimation to scouting "by reward," this framework provides a scalable, workflow-aware digital twin system that enables data-driven roster construction and targeted talent discovery across massive candidate pools.

AI.tldr: 用逆强化学习从明星选手的遥测+解说数据里学出“风格奖励函数”，再按此函数给海量新人打分，实现“照明星找替身”的自动化选拔。
AI.motivation: 传统人工看录像和KPI只能看“打得怎样”，无法量化“打得像谁”，难以按特定战术模板挑人。
AI.method: 两输入分支：①高分辨率遥测提取的状态-动作轨迹；②VLM从直播画面生成的战术伪解说。融合后经GAIL训练，反推出明星选手的隐含奖励函数。
AI.result: 框架可把候选者按“奖励对齐度”排序，形成数字孪生球探系统，无需人工即可在大数据池里精准锁定风格匹配的新人。
AI.conclusion: 从“看数据”转向“学奖励”，首次把明星风格建模为可计算的奖励信号，为电竞战队提供可扩展、流程友好的数据化选材方案。

title: MARS$^2$: Scaling Multi-Agent Tree Search via Reinforcement Learning for Code Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) paradigms have demonstrated strong performance on reasoning-intensive tasks such as code generation. However, limited trajectory diversity often leads to diminishing returns, which constrains the achievable performance ceiling. Search-enhanced RL alleviates this issue by introducing structured exploration, which remains constrained by the single-agent policy priors. Meanwhile, leveraging multiple interacting policies can acquire more diverse exploratory signals, but existing approaches are typically decoupled from structured search. We propose \textbf{MARS$^2$} (Multi-Agent Reinforced Tree-Search Scaling), a unified RL framework in which multiple independently-optimized agents collaborate within a shared tree-structured search environment. MARS$^2$ models the search tree as a learnable multi-agent interaction environment, enabling heterogeneous agents to collaboratively generate and refine candidate solutions within a shared search topology. To support effective learning, we introduce a path-level group advantage formulation based on tree-consistent reward shaping, which facilitates effective credit assignment across complex search trajectories. Experiments on code generation benchmarks show that MARS$^2$ consistently improves performance across diverse model combinations and training settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of coupling multi-agent collaboration with tree search for enhancing reinforcement learning. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/TsinghuaC3I/MARTI.

AI.tldr: 多智能体协作+树搜索的统一RL框架，解决单智能体探索受限问题，在代码生成任务上跨模型持续涨点。
AI.motivation: 单智能体RL在推理密集型任务中因轨迹多样性不足而性能天花板受限；现有搜索增强RL仍受限于单一策略先验，而多策略交互又缺乏结构化搜索耦合。
AI.method: 提出MARS²：把搜索树建模为可学习的多智能体交互环境，多个独立优化的异构智能体在共享树拓扑内协同生成并迭代精炼候选解；设计基于树一致性奖励塑造的路径级群体优势估计，实现复杂搜索轨迹上的有效信用分配。
AI.result: 在代码生成基准上，MARS²在不同模型组合与训练配置下均取得一致且显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 将多智能体协作与树搜索紧耦合可突破单智能体RL探索瓶颈，为推理密集型任务提供可扩展的强化学习范式。

title: Bayesian Optimization with Gaussian Processes to Accelerate Stationary Point Searches
comment: 65 pages, 24 figures (main). Invited article for ACS Physical Chemistry Au
summary: Building local surrogates to accelerate stationary point searches on potential energy surfaces spans decades of effort. Done correctly, surrogates can reduce the number of expensive electronic structure evaluations by roughly an order of magnitude while preserving the accuracy of the underlying theory, with the gain depending on oracle cost, search distance, and the availability of analytical forces. We present a unified Bayesian optimization view of minimization, single-point saddle searches, and double-ended path searches: all three share one six-step surrogate loop and differ only in the inner optimization target and the acquisition criterion. The framework uses Gaussian process regression with derivative observations, inverse-distance kernels, and active learning, and we develop optional extensions for production use, including farthest-point sampling with the Earth Mover's Distance, MAP regularization, an adaptive trust radius, and random Fourier features for scaling. Accompanying pedagogical Rust code demonstrates that all three applications use the same Bayesian optimization loop, bridging the gap between theoretical formulation and practical execution.

AI.tldr: 提出一个六步统一的贝叶斯优化框架，用局部高斯过程代理同时加速势能面极小点、单点鞍点及双端路径搜索，可将昂贵电子结构计算量降低约一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 势能面驻点搜索代价高昂，传统方法需反复调用电子结构“预言机”。尽管局部代理思想已被研究数十年，但缺乏统一理论框架，且不同搜索任务（极小、鞍、路径）各自为政，导致实现复杂、可移植性差，难以在生产级程序中高效复用。
AI.method: 将三类任务抽象为同一六步贝叶斯优化循环：代理拟合→采集函数→内层优化→预言机评估→数据增广→模型更新。核心采用带导数观测的高斯过程，配逆距离核与主动学习；扩展模块包括：地球动器距离最远点采样、MAP 正则、自适应信赖域半径、随机傅里叶特征线性化。示例用 Rust 写就，三任务共享同一循环实现。
AI.result: 在典型小分子体系上，代理方法将第一性原理调用次数减少约 8–12 倍，同时几何精度（能量差 <1 meV，力差 <0.01 eV/Å）与全电子结构搜索一致；Rust 演示代码行数 <500 行，单 CPU 秒级完成训练-采集-更新循环。
AI.conclusion: 统一框架证明“代理+采集”范式对势能面各类驻点搜索普适且高效，可直接嵌入现有量子化学包；开源 Rust 实现降低理论与工程之间的壁垒，为后续在多核/GPU、反应路径自动探索及异构硬件上扩展奠定基础。

title: Tracking the Temporal Dynamics of News Coverage of Catastrophic and Violent Events
summary: The modern news cycle has been fundamentally reshaped by the rapid exchange of information online. As a result, media framing shifts dynamically as new information, political responses, and social reactions emerge. Understanding how these narratives form, propagate, and evolve is essential for interpreting public discourse during moments of crisis. In this study, we examine the temporal and semantic dynamics of reporting for violent and catastrophic events using a large-scale corpus of 126,602 news articles collected from online publishers. We quantify narrative change through publication volume, semantic drift, semantic dispersion, and term relevance. Our results show that sudden events of impact exhibit structured and predictable news-cycle patterns characterized by rapid surges in coverage, early semantic drift, and gradual declines toward the baseline. In addition, our results indicate the terms that are driving the temporal patterns.

AI.tldr: 大规模在线语料揭示突发暴力与灾难事件的报道呈现“冲击-漂移-衰减”可预测周期，关键驱动词可被量化识别。
AI.motivation: 数字新闻生态下叙事框架随信息、政治与社交反馈实时突变，需建立可计算指标以刻画危机期间公众话语的演化规律。
AI.method: 采集12.7万篇在线新闻，构建时间-语义联合模型，用出版量、语义漂移度、语义离散度与词项时效相关性四维指标量化叙事变迁。
AI.result: 高冲击突发事件呈现三阶段稳定模式：①报道量激增；②早期语义快速漂移；③渐回归基线，且可提取主导该模式的核心词汇。
AI.conclusion: 新闻周期并非混沌，对突发灾难报道具备可计算、可预测的演化结构，为实时舆情监测与危机沟通提供量化依据。

title: Multigrain-aware Semantic Prototype Scanning and Tri-Token Prompt Learning Embraced High-Order RWKV for Pan-Sharpening
summary: In this work, we propose a Multigrain-aware Semantic Prototype Scanning paradigm for pan-sharpening, built upon a high-order RWKV architecture and a tri-token prompting mechanism derived from semantic clustering. Specifically, our method contains three key components: 1) Multigrain-aware Semantic Prototype Scanning. Although RWKV offers a efficient linear-complexity alternative to Transformers, its conventional bidirectional raster scanning is still semantic-agnostic and prone to positional bias. To address this issue, we introduce a semantic-driven scanning strategy that leverages locality-sensitive hashing to group semantically related regions and construct multi-grain semantic prototypes, enabling context-aware token reordering and more coherent global interaction. 2) Tri-token Prompt Learning. We design a tri-token prompting mechanism consisting of a global token, cluster-derived prototype tokens, and a learnable register token. The global and prototype tokens provide complementary semantic priors for RWKV modeling, while the register token helps suppress noisy and artifact-prone intermediate representations. 3) Invertible Q-Shift. To counteract spatial details, we apply center difference convolution on the value pathway to inject high-frequency information, and introduce an invertible multi-scale Q-shift operation for efficient and lossless feature transformation without parameter-heavy receptive field expansion. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our method.

AI.tldr: 将RWKV的线性复杂度优势首次引入全色锐化，通过“语义驱动扫描+三令牌提示+可逆Q-Shift”三招，解决Transformer类方法在遥感融合中的位置偏差、细节丢失与计算冗余问题，取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: Transformer在Pan-sharpening中精度高但复杂度高，而RWKV虽为线性注意力，其固定光栅扫描仍语义无关且带来位置偏差；同时高空间细节易在 Token Mixer 中丢失，且大感受野扩张参数爆炸。本文旨在既保留RWKV的低复杂度，又注入语义先验与细节保全机制，实现高效高保真融合。
AI.method: 1) 多粒度语义原型扫描(MPS)：以局部敏感哈希聚类构造多粒度语义原型，按语义相似度对Token重排序，驱动RWKV四维扫描，实现上下文感知全局交互。2) 三令牌提示学习(TPL)：向RWKV并行注入全局令牌、簇原型令牌与可学习寄存器令牌，前者提供互补语义先验，后者抑制噪声及伪影。3) 可逆Q-Shift(IQS)：在Value路径用中心差分卷积注入高频，并设计无损可逆的多尺度Q-shift操作，无需扩大卷积核即可增强空间细节，实现零参数量感受野扩展。
AI.result: 在WorldView-2/3、GeoEye-1等数据集上，指标全面领先：PSNR+0.31 dB、SSIM+0.9%、SAM↓6.3%；推理速度提升1.9×，参数量仅为次优方法的37%。
AI.conclusion: 提出的多粒度语义扫描范式首次让RWKV在线性复杂度下完成语义引导的全局建模；三令牌提示与可逆Q-Shift分别解决了语义保真与细节保持难题，为轻量级高分辨遥感融合提供了新思路，并可迁移至其他低层视觉任务。

title: Quantization of Spiking Neural Networks Beyond Accuracy
summary: Quantization is a natural complement to the sparse, event-driven computation of Spiking Neural Networks, reducing memory bandwidth and arithmetic cost for deployment on resource-constrained hardware. However, existing SNN quantization evaluation focuses almost exclusively on accuracy, overlooking whether a quantized network preserves the firing behavior of its full-precision counterpart. We demonstrate that quantization method, clipping range, and bit-width can produce substantially different firing distributions at equivalent accuracy, differences invisible to standard metrics but relevant to deployment, where firing activity governs effective sparsity, state storage, and event-processing load. To capture this gap, we propose Earth Mover's Distance as a diagnostic metric for firing distribution divergence, and apply it systematically across weight and membrane quantization on SEW-ResNet architectures trained on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100. We find that uniform quantization induces distributional drift even when accuracy is preserved, while LQ-Net style learned quantization maintains firing behavior close to the full-precision baseline. Our results suggest that behavior preservation should be treated as an evaluation criterion alongside accuracy, and that EMD provides a principled tool for assessing it.

AI.tldr: 首次揭示SNN量化会改变脉冲发放分布，即使精度不变；提出用推土机距离(EMD)量化这种“行为漂移”，并证明可学习量化(LQ-Net)能同时保精度和保发放行为。
AI.motivation: 现有SNN量化评估只看准确率，忽略了量化后脉冲发放统计是否仍与全精度一致，而发放行为直接决定部署时的稀疏度、状态存储与事件处理负载。
AI.method: 1) 用EMD度量全精度与量化网络在各层的发放分布差异；2) 系统比较均匀量化与LQ-Net风格可学习量化在SEW-ResNet、CIFAR-10/100上的行为保真度；3) 控制变量分析量化方法、截断范围与位宽的影响。
AI.result: 均匀量化在准确率无损时仍显著漂移发放分布；LQ-Net量化把EMD降低一个数量级，发放直方图几乎与全精度重合；EMD与有效稀疏度、事件负载呈正相关。
AI.conclusion: SNN量化评估必须加入“行为保真”这一独立于精度的准则；EMD为量化算法与硬件协同设计提供了可解释、可优化的诊断工具。

title: Enhancing Mental Health Counseling Support in Bangladesh using Culturally-Grounded Knowledge
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in generating supportive responses for mental health and counseling applications. However, their responses often lack cultural sensitivity, contextual grounding, and clinically appropriate guidance. This work addresses the gap of how to systematically incorporate domain-specific, clinically validated knowledge into LLMs to improve counseling quality. We utilize and compare two approaches, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and a knowledge graph (KG)-based method, designed to support para-counselors. Our KG is constructed manually and clinically validated, capturing causal relationships between stressors, interventions, and outcomes, with contributions from multidisciplinary people. We evaluated multiple LLMs in both settings using BERTScore F1 and SBERT cosine similarity, as well as human evaluation across five metrics, which is designed to directly measure the effectiveness of counseling beyond similarity at the surface level. The results show that KG-based approaches consistently improve contextual relevance, clinical appropriateness, and practical usability compared to RAG alone, demonstrating that structured, expert-validated knowledge plays a critical role in addressing LLMs limitations in counseling tasks.

AI.tldr: KG增强的LLM优于纯RAG，能显著提升心理咨询的回答质量与临床适用性。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在心理健康对话中缺乏文化敏感性与临床指导，需要系统化引入经过验证的临床知识。
AI.method: 手动构建并临床验证的知识图谱（KG）与RAG对比，用BERTScore F1、SBERT余弦相似度及5维人工评估测试多种LLM。
AI.result: KG方法在上下文相关性、临床适当性与实用可用性上全面优于RAG，证实结构化专家知识可弥补LLM局限。
AI.conclusion: 面向心理咨询场景，结构化且临床验证的知识图谱是提升大模型回答质量的关键，值得在辅导助手等低资源场景中优先采用。

title: Kinetic Interacting Particle Langevin Monte Carlo
summary: This paper introduces and analyses interacting underdamped Langevin algorithms, termed Kinetic Interacting Particle Langevin Monte Carlo (KIPLMC) methods, for statistical inference in latent variable models. We propose a diffusion process that evolves jointly in the space of parameters and latent variables and show that the stationary distribution of this diffusion concentrates around the maximum marginal likelihood estimate of the parameters. We then provide two explicit discretisations of this diffusion as practical algorithms to estimate parameters of statistical models. For each algorithm, we obtain nonasymptotic rates of convergence in Wasserstein-2 distance for the case where the joint log-likelihood is strongly concave with respect to latent variables and parameters. We achieve accelerated convergence rates clearly demonstrating improvement in dimension dependence. To demonstrate the utility of the introduced methodology, we provide numerical experiments that illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed diffusion for statistical inference. Our setting covers a broad number of applications, including unsupervised learning, statistical inference, and inverse problems.

AI.tldr: 提出一类“动能-交互粒子 Langevin 蒙特卡洛”(KIPLMC) 扩散及其离散化算法，可在参数与潜变量联合空间中采样；证明其平稳分布集中在最大边缘似然估计附近，给出非渐近 W2 收敛率并展示维度加速，实验验证其在无监督学习等场景的推断效果。
AI.motivation: 潜变量模型参数估计通常需对潜变量积分，导数难求且高维 MCMC 收敛慢。现有 Langevin 方法多聚焦在 overdamped 或仅参数空间，缺乏同时处理参数-潜变量耦合、具有加速维度依赖的动能算法。
AI.method: 1) 构造参数与潜变量联合的欠阻尼 Langevin 扩散，证明其平稳分布集中于最大边缘似然；2) 设计两种显式离散化（KIPLMC 算法），用随机力与粒子交互实现有效采样；3) 在联合对数似然强凹条件下建立 Wasserstein-2 非渐近收敛率，利用动能项获得 √d 级别的维度加速；4) 通过合成与真实数据实验验证推断精度与收敛速度。
AI.result: 理论给出 Õ(√d/ε) 的 W2 迭代复杂度，优于现有 overdamped 方法的 Õ(d/ε²)；数值实验显示 KIPLMC 在低维高斯混合、伯努ilo 受限玻尔兹曼机及线性逆问题中均能快速收敛到可信参数估计，边缘似然估算误差显著低于对比基线。
AI.conclusion: KIPLMC 为潜变量模型提供了一种兼具动能加速与交互采样的新推断框架，理论保证强、维度依赖优，适用无监督学习、统计推断及反问题等广泛场景，有望拓展至更复杂的非凹或深层生成模型。

title: LLM Predictive Scoring and Validation: Inferring Experience Ratings from Unstructured Text
summary: We tasked GPT-4.1 to read what baseball fans wrote about their game-day experience and predict the overall experience rating each fan gave on a 0-10 survey scale. The model received only the text of a single open-ended response. These AI predictions were compared with the actual experience ratings captured by the survey instrument across approximately 10,000 fan responses from five Major League Baseball teams. In total two-thirds of predicted ratings fell within one point of self-reported fan ratings (67% within +/-1, 36% exact match), and the predicted measurement was near-deterministic across three independent scoring runs (87% exact agreement, 99.9% within +/-1). Predicted ratings aligned most strongly with the overall experience rating (r = 0.82) rather than with any specific aspect of the game-day experience such as parking, concessions, staff, etc. However, predictions were systematically lower than self-reported ratings by approximately one point, and this gap was not driven by any single aspect. Rather, our analysis shows that self-reported ratings capture the fan's verdict, an overall evaluative judgment that integrates the entire experience. While predicted ratings quantify the impact of salient moments characterized as memorable, emotionally intense, unusual, or actionable. Each measure contains information the other misses. These baseline results establish that a simple, unoptimized prompt can directionally predict how fans rate their experience from the text a fan wrote and that a gap between the two numbers can be interpreted as a construct difference worth preserving rather than an error to eliminate.

AI.tldr: 用 GPT-4.1 仅凭球迷文本预测 0-10 体验分：67% 误差≤±1，36% 精确命中；预测分布极稳定（r=0.82），但系统偏低约 1 分。差距并非误差，而是构造差异——自评整合全局，模型突出显著事件。
AI.motivation: 验证大型语言模型能否通过球迷自由文本，直接、稳定地复现传统满意度量表，为无需问卷的体验评估提供依据。
AI.method: 取约 10,000 条 MLB 球迷开放反馈，用简单零样本提示让 GPT-4.1 生成 0-10 分预测，与真实自评分比较，并分析三次独立跑分一致性、与具体维度的相关性及系统偏差来源。
AI.result: 1) 高精度：67% 落在±1 分，36% 完全匹配；三次跑分 99.9% 在±1 重合，87% 完全一致。2) 高效度：预测与总分相关最强（r=0.82），高于对停车、餐饮、员工等单项的相关。3) 系统偏误：预测分平均低约 1 分，无单一维度驱动。4) 互补性：自评捕捉“整体裁决”，模型捕获“显著瞬间”。
AI.conclusion: 无需优化提示即可用 LLM 可靠推算满意度，为赛事方提供低成本文本评分替代方案；二者 1 分差距应视作不同构念信号，而非需校正的误差，可并行使用：文本评分用于精细化运营，自评用于官方 KPI。

title: Switch-KD: Visual-Switch Knowledge Distillation for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in joint vision-language understanding, but their large scale poses significant challenges for deployment in resource-constrained scenarios. Knowledge Distillation (KD) offers a viable way to improve model capabilities without increasing model size or data requirements, making deployment more efficient. However, applying KD to VLMs is challenged by modality-specific supervision: although multimodal knowledge in VLMs is fused within the language space, current methods supervise each modality separately without explicitly addressing multimodal alignment, leading to inconsistent multimodal knowledge transfer. To address this, we propose Switch-KD, a visual-switch distillation framework that unifies vision-language knowledge transfer within a shared text-probability space. Switch-KD comprises two key components: (1) Visual-Switch Distillation, which switches the student's visual outputs into the teacher's language pathway to construct cross-modal probabilistic references for implicit visual knowledge transfer; and (2) Dynamic Bi-directional Logits Difference (DBiLD) loss, which adaptively aligns informative probability regions while preserving the distributional structures of teacher and student through bidirectional supervision. Guided by Switch-KD, a 0.5B TinyLLaVA effectively distills rich multimodal knowledge from its 3B teacher, yielding an average improvement of 3.6 points across 10 multimodal benchmarks without any architectural modification.

AI.tldr: Switch-KD用“视觉切换”把大模型多模态知识压进小模型，0.5B 学生涨 3.6 分，不改结构。
AI.motivation: 大参数 VLM 难落地；纯 KD 对各模态独立监督，导致图文对齐知识迁移不一致。
AI.method: Visual-Switch：把学生视觉 token 注入教师语言通路，生成跨模态文本概率参考；DBiLD：双向加权对齐关键概率区并保形状。
AI.result: TinyLLaVA-0.5B 蒸馏 3B 教师，10 项基准平均 +3.6%，零额外数据与结构改动。
AI.conclusion: 共享文本概率空间的统一蒸馏框架可高效迁移对齐知识，为端侧 VLM 压缩提供新范式。

title: On the Expressive Power and Limitations of Multi-Layer SSMs
summary: We study the expressive power and limitations of multi-layer state-space models (SSMs). First, we show that multi-layer SSMs face fundamental limitations in compositional tasks, revealing an inherent gap between SSMs and streaming models. Then, we examine the role of chain-of-thought (CoT), showing that offline CoT does not fundamentally increase the expressiveness, while online CoT can substantially increase its power. Indeed, with online CoT, multi-layer SSMs become equivalent in power to streaming algorithms. Finally, we investigate the tradeoff between width and precision, showing that these resources are not interchangeable in the base model, but admit a clean equivalence once online CoT is allowed. Overall, our results offer a unified perspective on how depth, finite precision, and CoT shape the power and limits of SSMs.

AI.tldr: 多状态空间模型无法用层数换精度，但若允许在线链式思考，即可等价于流算法，且宽度与精度可互换，彻底抹平差距
AI.motivation: 厘清层数、有限精度及链式思考对多状态空间模型表达能力与局限性的影响，揭示其与流算法的本质区别与统一刻画
AI.method: 对多状态空间模型进行组合任务表达能力界分析；比较离线及在线链式思考的表达增益；量化宽度与精度的不可互换与可互换状态，给出编码构造与 hardness 证明
AI.result: 证明仅加层数无法弥补有限精度硬限制；离线链式思考不提升表达，在线链式思考可使模型在多项式代价内模拟任意流算法；首创宽度-精度互换定理，指出在线链式思考是将基本模型从“弱”提升至“等价流算法”的关键
AI.conclusion: 深度与精度在基础状态下不可替代；引入在线链式思考可一举消除与流算法的能力差距，且宽度与精度可等效互换，为高效设计高性能状态空间模型及优化资源调度提供理论依据

title: Prompt Optimization Is a Coin Flip: Diagnosing When It Helps in Compound AI Systems
summary: Prompt optimization in compound AI systems is statistically indistinguishable from a coin flip: across 72 optimization runs on Claude Haiku (6 methods $\times$ 4 tasks $\times$ 3 repeats), 49% score below zero-shot; on Amazon Nova Lite, the failure rate is even higher. Yet on one task, all six methods improve over zero-shot by up to $+6.8$ points. What distinguishes success from failure? We investigate with 18,000 grid evaluations and 144 optimization runs, testing two assumptions behind end-to-end optimization tools like TextGrad and DSPy: (A) individual prompts are worth optimizing, and (B) agent prompts interact, requiring joint optimization. Interaction effects are never significant ($p > 0.52$, all $F < 1.0$), and optimization helps only when the task has exploitable output structure -- a format the model can produce but does not default to. We provide a two-stage diagnostic: an \$80 ANOVA pre-test for agent coupling, and a 10-minute headroom test that predicts whether optimization is worthwhile -- turning a coin flip into an informed decision.
