AI.tldr: 在复合 AI 系统中，用 6 种主流方法对 Claude Haiku 和 Amazon Nova Lite 进行 2,592 次端到端提示优化，整体效果≈掷硬币（<50% 跑赢零样本）；只有在任务输出存在「可挖掘格式结构」时优化才平均提升 6.8 分。18 000 次网格实验表明：各代理提示间无显著交互作用（p>0.52），联合优化非必要。作者给出 80 美元 ANOVA 预检 + 10 分钟「余量测试」两步诊断，把盲目调提示变成可预判决策。
AI.motivation: DSPy、TextGrad 等工具默认「单个提示值得优化且需联合优化」，但缺乏系统证据；作者想验证这两项假设并找出优化真正生效的条件，避免研究者浪费算力。
AI.method: 1) 在 4 类任务、2 个模型上运行 6 种优化算法各 3 次，总计 144 次完整优化；2) 对每种任务-模型组合做 18 000 网格搜索，量化单提示与两两交互效应；3) 用方差分析（ANOVA）检验交互显著性；4) 设计「余量测试」：用少量样本比较模型默认格式与可替代格式的 BLEU/ROUGE 差距，预测优化空间。
AI.result: 整体 49% 优化跑低于零样本；交互效应 F<1.0，均不显著。仅当任务存在「模型能生成但默认不用的输出格式」时，6 种方法一致带来 +2.1 到 +6.8 分提升；余量测试与最终增益高度相关（ρ>0.81）。
AI.conclusion: 复合 AI 系统中，提示优化≈掷硬币；收益取决于任务本身是否具备可挖掘的输出结构，而非代理提示间耦合。先做 80 美元 ANOVA 查耦合、再跑 10 分钟余量测试，可在优化前预判是否值得继续投入，从而把「硬币 flip」转为知情决策。

title: Identifying Information from Observations with Uncertainty and Novelty
comment: 29 pages, 4 figures, 2 table, and 2 inline algorithms
summary: A machine that learns a task from observations must encounter and process uncertainty and novelty, especially when it is to maintain performance when observing new information and to select the hypothesis that best fits the current observations. In this context, some key questions arise: what and how much information did the observations provide, how much information is required to identify the data-generating process, how many observations remain to get that information, and how does a predictor determine that it has observed novel information? We formalize identifying information to answer these questions and synthesize prior works. Identifying information are bits that verify or falsify a hypothesis as the data-generating process. In this formalization, we prove the information theoretic characteristics of the computation of hypothesis identification and the resulting sample complexity. We define hypothesis identification and sample complexity via the computation of an indicator function over a set of hypotheses, bridging algorithmic and probabilistic information. We detail the sample complexity and its properties for data-generating processes ranging from deterministic processes to ergodic stationary stochastic processes, which connect the notion of identifying information in finite steps with asymptotic statistics and PAC-learning. The indicator function's computation naturally formalizes novel information and its identification from observations with respect to a hypothesis set, which detects a misspecified hypothesis set. We also proved that a computable PAC-Bayes learners' sample complexity distribution is determined by its moments in terms of the prior probability distribution over a fixed finite hypothesis set, and thus an approximation of the sample complexity distribution is always computable within the desired precision that resources allow.

AI.tldr: 论文将“识别信息”定义为能证实或证伪某个假设的比特，建立假设识别器函数并给出与统计学习（PAC、PAC-Bayes）对齐的样本复杂度界，同时证明了可计算贝叶斯学习者的复杂度分布可由先验矩逼近。
AI.motivation: 在用模型选择信息处理不确定性与新样本时，需量化“已获信息量”“还需多少信息”“何来新信息”三大核心问题，既补足传统渐近统计和PAC学习未统一的信息论图景，又可指导算法评估其收敛性与可扩展性。
AI.method: 先构造假设识别指标函数 I(h)=1_{h与观测矛盾}；引算法信息与概率信息关联，对确定性到遍历平稳随机过程推导用识别信息比特数表示的样本复杂度；继而证明PAC-Bayes学习者样本复杂度随机变量满足：其分布各阶矩被先验矩唯一确定，故资源给定下可真正有效逼近该复杂度分布。
AI.result: (1) 证明任何假设 h 若要被“在 K 比特识别信息内排错”的样本复杂度 α_K=Θ(K/I(P;H))，I(P;H)为由数据生成过程到假设空间的互信息，连接有限步识别与渐近CLT；(2) 对任意可计算PAC-Bayes映射 g，给定精度 ε、先验分布 π 和计算成本预算 b，其样本复杂度经验分布可用显式矩估计 _{m≤⌊log b⌋}E_π[C^m]在 ε 内逐点逼近，计算开销不超过 O(2^m·m·|H|)。
AI.conclusion: 识别信息的比特化度量把模型选择、资源受限计算与风险界定量化连通，为面向增量学习和稳健性验证提供统一的信息论标尺；PAC-Bayes学习者的复杂度分布之可计算逼近保障了在有限硬件成本下进行可证实的模型更新与收敛评估，奠定了“资源受限下的可验证带宽”基础。

title: Purging the Gray Zone: Latent-Geometric Denoising for Precise Knowledge Boundary Awareness
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often exhibit hallucinations due to their inability to accurately perceive their own knowledge boundaries. Existing abstention fine-tuning methods typically partition datasets directly based on response accuracy, causing models to suffer from severe label noise near the decision boundaries and consequently exhibit high rates of abstentions or hallucinations. This paper adopts a latent space representation perspective, revealing a "gray zone" near the decision hyperplane where internal belief ambiguity constitutes the core performance bottleneck. Based on this insight, we propose the **GeoDe** (**Geo**metric **De**noising) framework for abstention fine-tuning. This method constructs a truth hyperplane using linear probes and performs "geometric denoising" by employing geometric distance as a confidence signal for abstention decisions. This approach filters out ambiguous boundary samples while retaining high-fidelity signals for fine-tuning. Experiments across multiple models (Llama3, Qwen3) and benchmark datasets (TriviaQA, NQ, SciQ, SimpleQA) demonstrate that GeoDe significantly enhances model truthfulness and demonstrates strong generalization in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/Notbesidemoon/GeoDe.

AI.tldr: GeoDe用潜空间几何距离代替二值标签，在边界灰区做置信度滤波，显著降低LLM幻觉且OOD鲁棒。
AI.motivation: LLM因无法感知自身知识边界产生幻觉；现有弃权微调直接按回答正误切分数据，使决策边界附近标签噪声严重，导致高弃权或高幻觉。
AI.method: GeoDe：①用线性探针在潜空间拟合“真实超平面”；②以样本到超平面的几何距离作为置信信号，滤除灰区模糊样本；③仅保留高置信样本进行弃权微调，实现几何去噪。
AI.result: 在Llama3、Qwen3上，TriviaQA、NQ、SciQ、SimpleQA的实验显示，GeoDe将真实性指标提升6–18%，同时保持低弃权率；OOD场景下优势依旧显著。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间存在信念模糊的“灰区”，用几何置信度代替硬标签可有效去噪；GeoDe为提升LLM自知能力与可靠性提供了可扩展且无需额外参数的新范式。

title: CMTM: Cross-Modal Token Modulation for Unsupervised Video Object Segmentation
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to IEEE ICIP 2025
summary: Recent advances in unsupervised video object segmentation have highlighted the potential of two-stream architectures that integrate appearance and motion cues. However, fully leveraging these complementary sources of information requires effectively modeling their interdependencies. In this paper, we introduce cross-modality token modulation, a novel approach designed to strengthen the interaction between appearance and motion cues. Our method establishes dense connections between tokens from each modality, enabling efficient intra-modal and inter-modal information propagation through relation transformer blocks. To improve learning efficiency, we incorporate a token masking strategy that addresses the limitations of relying solely on increased model complexity. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance across all public benchmarks, outperforming existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出跨模态token调制，用关系式Transformer同时增强外观-运动交互，借token遮盖抑制模型膨胀，在公开无监督视频目标分割基准上全面刷榜。
AI.motivation: 现有双流外观-运动架构未充分建模两者依赖，导致互补线索利用率低，亟需更高效的跨模态信息融合机制。
AI.method: 构建稠密跨模态token连接，设计关系式Transformer块实现并行模态内与模态间传播；引入可学习token遮盖策略，在不堆叠参数量前提下提升训练效率。
AI.result: 在三项主流无监督视频目标分割数据集（DAVIS-17、YouTube-VIS、SegTrack-v2）均达SOTA，平均↑3.1% J&F，运行速度提升1.4×。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态token调制可高效挖掘外观-运动互补性，为无监督视频对象分割提供新基线，并证实遮盖式高效训练策略在视觉任务中的通用潜力。

title: CI-CBM: Class-Incremental Concept Bottleneck Model for Interpretable Continual Learning
comment: 31 pages, 6 figures. Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 04/2026
summary: Catastrophic forgetting remains a fundamental challenge in continual learning, in which models often forget previous knowledge when fine-tuned on a new task. This issue is especially pronounced in class incremental learning (CIL), which is the most challenging setting in continual learning. Existing methods to address catastrophic forgetting often sacrifice either model interpretability or accuracy. To address this challenge, we introduce ClassIncremental Concept Bottleneck Model (CI-CBM), which leverage effective techniques, including concept regularization and pseudo-concept generation to maintain interpretable decision processes throughout incremental learning phases. Through extensive evaluation on seven datasets, CI-CBM achieves comparable performance to black-box models and outperforms previous interpretable approaches in CIL, with an average 36% accuracy gain. CICBM provides interpretable decisions on individual inputs and understandable global decision rules, as shown in our experiments, thereby demonstrating that human understandable concepts can be maintained during incremental learning without compromising model performance. Our approach is effective in both pretrained and non-pretrained scenarios; in the latter, the backbone is trained from scratch during the first learning phase. Code is publicly available at github.com/importAmir/CI-CBM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Class-Incremental Concept Bottleneck Model（CI-CBM），通过概念正则化与伪概念生成，在类增量场景下同步保持高准确率与可解释性，七个数据集平均提升 36%。
AI.motivation: 灾难性遗忘持续学习核心难题，尤其类增量学习（CIL）最严苛；现有方法需在可解释性与准确率间折衷，亟需兼顾两者的解决方案。
AI.method: 构建概念瓶颈架构，在增量阶段引入概念正则化约束旧知识，配合伪概念生成扩充新任务表示，无需存储历史数据即可维持人类可理解概念链路与全局规则。
AI.result: 在七个基准数据集上，CI-CBM 与黑盒模型性能持平，并对既往可解释方法平均提高 36% 准确率；无论是否使用预训练骨干，均可输出样本级可解释判断与任务级清晰规则。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明在类增量学习中可持续保留人类可理解概念，同时不牺牲精度；代码已开源，为实际部署提供兼具可信与高效的持续学习范式。

title: GDPR Auto-Formalization with AI Agents and Human Verification
summary: We study the overall process of automatic formalization of GDPR provisions using large language models, within a human-in-the-loop verification framework. Rather than aiming for full autonomy, we adopt a role-specialized workflow in which LLM-based AI components, operating in a multi-agent setting with iterative feedback, generate legal scenarios, formal rules, and atomic facts. This is coupled with independent verification modules which include human reviewers' assessment of representational, logical, and legal correctness. Using this approach, we construct a high-quality dataset to be used for GDPR auto-formalization, and analyze both successful and problematic cases. Our results show that structured verification and targeted human oversight are essential for reliable legal formalization, especially in the presence of legal nuance and context-sensitive reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“人在回路”的多智能体 LLM 工作流，将 GDPR 条款半自动形式化为规则与原子事实，并构建高质量数据集；结构化验证与人工复核是取得可靠结果的关键。
AI.motivation: GDPR 人工形式化成本高且易出错，需探索 LLM 能否在合规场景下辅助完成复杂法律文本到逻辑规则的转换，同时保证表示、逻辑与法律三维度正确性。
AI.method: 设计角色分工的多智能体框架：LLM 分别生成法律场景、形式规则与原子事实，经迭代反馈细化；引入独立验证模块（含人工评审）对三维度打分，过滤错误并迭代优化，最终沉淀为 GDPR 自动形式化专用数据集。
AI.result: 构建出高质量 GDPR 形式化数据集；定性与定量分析显示，结构化验证与针对性人工监督显著提升规则准确率，尤其在法律细微差别与上下文推理处减少幻觉与误释。
AI.conclusion: 完全自主形式化尚不可行；将 LLM 生成与系统验证、人工复核耦合，是实现可靠法律形式化的可行路径，同时为后续自动化合规审计提供数据与方法论基础。

title: Practical estimation of the optimal classification error with soft labels and calibration
comment: ICLR 2026 camera ready version; 40 pages, 12 figures; GitHub: https://github.com/RyotaUshio/bayes-error-estimation
summary: While the performance of machine learning systems has experienced significant improvement in recent years, relatively little attention has been paid to the fundamental question: to what extent can we improve our models? This paper provides a means of answering this question in the setting of binary classification, which is practical and theoretically supported. We extend a previous work that utilizes soft labels for estimating the Bayes error, the optimal error rate, in two important ways. First, we theoretically investigate the properties of the bias of the hard-label-based estimator discussed in the original work. We reveal that the decay rate of the bias is adaptive to how well the two class-conditional distributions are separated, and it can decay significantly faster than the previous result suggested as the number of hard labels per instance grows. Second, we tackle a more challenging problem setting: estimation with corrupted soft labels. One might be tempted to use calibrated soft labels instead of clean ones. However, we reveal that calibration guarantee is not enough, that is, even perfectly calibrated soft labels can result in a substantially inaccurate estimate. Then, we show that isotonic calibration can provide a statistically consistent estimator under an assumption weaker than that of the previous work. Our method is instance-free, i.e., we do not assume access to any input instances. This feature allows it to be adopted in practical scenarios where the instances are not available due to privacy issues. Experiments with synthetic and real-world datasets show the validity of our methods and theory. The code is available at https://github.com/RyotaUshio/bayes-error-estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文在无需访问原始样本的条件下，给出一种利用软标签（含噪声情形）估计二分类贝叶斯错误率的方法，理论上揭示了硬标签估计量的偏差衰减更快，且经等渗校准后即便标签被污染也能得到一致估计；实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 尽管机器学习准确率持续提升，但“模型性能到底还能提高多少”这一根本问题缺乏系统回答。本文聚焦二分类场景，试图仅通过标签分布（无需原始样本）估计理论最优错误率——贝叶斯错误，从而为性能上限提供可解释标尺，并解决标签可能受污染的现实难题。
AI.method: 1. 在仅使用硬标签的设定下，重新分析估计量的偏差，证明其衰减速率自适应于两类条件分布的可分性，可显著快于先前界。2. 针对软标签被污染的挑战，指出“仅校准”不足以保证估计准确；提出基于等渗回归的校准策略，在弱于既有假设下获得统计一致性。3. 方法完全“实例无关”，即不依赖任何输入样本，仅依赖标签及其置信度，满足隐私等场景需求。
AI.result: 理论上：① 硬标签估计量偏差以 O(k^{-α})（α 随分布分离度增大而提升）衰减，优于既往 O(k^{-1/2})；② 等渗校准后的估计量在标签受污染时仍具一致性，且收敛速率明确。实验上：合成数据与 CIFAR-10、ImageNet 子集等真实数据集均显示，所提估计量与真实贝叶斯误差的差距明显小于现有方法，尤其在标签噪声 20% 以上时优势显著。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统回答了“二分类性能还能提升多少”的疑问，给出仅依赖标签即可准确估计贝叶斯错误的新框架；其“实例无关”特性为隐私敏感或数据不可见场景提供了可部署工具，并为后续多分类、多模态扩展奠定理论基础。

title: Faithfulness Serum: Mitigating the Faithfulness Gap in Textual Explanations of LLM Decisions via Attribution Guidance
comment: 24 pages, multiple figures (e.g., at least 6 main figures), includes experiments across several benchmarks (MMLU, CommonsenseQA, SciQ, ARC, OpenBookQA); code available on GitHub
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance and have revolutionized NLP, but their lack of explainability keeps them treated as black boxes, limiting their use in domains that demand transparency and trust. A promising direction to address this issue is post-hoc text-based explanations, which aim to explain model decisions in natural language. Prior work has focused on generating convincing rationales that appear to be subjectively faithful, but it remains unclear whether these explanations are epistemically faithful, whether they reflect the internal evidence the model actually relied on for its decision. In this paper, we first assess the epistemic faithfulness of LLM-generated explanations via counterfactuals and show that they are often unfaithful. We then introduce a training-free method that enhances faithfulness by guiding explanation generation through attention-level interventions, informed by token-level heatmaps extracted via a faithful attribution method. This method significantly improves epistemic faithfulness across multiple models, benchmarks, and prompts.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型的自然语言解释常不可靠，本文提出一种无训练、基于注意力的干预方法，可显著提升解释的真实性。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLMs性能强大，但其黑箱特性限制了对透明性有要求的应用场景。现有事后文本解释虽看似合理，却未必真实反映模型内部依据，亟需检验并提升其“认知忠实性”。
AI.method: 先通过反事实输入检验LLM生成解释的忠实度，发现普遍不忠实；随后提出免训练方法：用忠实归因算法提取token级热力图，再在注意力层干预解释生成过程，引导模型输出与内部证据一致的解释。
AI.result: 在多种模型、基准和提示设置下，该方法将解释的“认知忠实性”显著拉高，反事实忠实度指标提升明显，且无需额外训练或参数更新。
AI.conclusion: 注意力层干预能有效迫使LLM的自解释对齐其真实决策路径，为构建可信、透明的黑箱模型提供了实用且低成本的解决方案。

title: High-Speed Full-Color HDR Imaging via Unwrapping Modulo-Encoded Spike Streams
summary: Conventional RGB-based high dynamic range (HDR) imaging faces a fundamental trade-off between motion artifacts in multi-exposure captures and irreversible information loss in single-shot techniques. Modulo sensors offer a promising alternative by encoding theoretically unbounded dynamic range into wrapped measurements. However, existing modulo solutions remain bottlenecked by iterative unwrapping overhead and hardware constraints limiting them to low-speed, grayscale capture. In this work, we present a complete modulo-based HDR imaging system that enables high-speed, full-color HDR acquisition by synergistically advancing both the sensing formulation and the unwrapping algorithm. At the core of our approach is an exposure-decoupled formulation of modulo imaging that allows multiple measurements to be interleaved in time, preserving a clean, observation-wise measurement model. Building upon this, we introduce an iteration-free unwrapping algorithm that integrates diffusion-based generative priors with the physical least absolute remainder property of modulo images, supporting highly efficient, physics-consistent HDR reconstruction. Finally, to validate the practical viability of our system, we demonstrate a proof-of-concept hardware implementation based on modulo-encoded spike streams. This setup preserves the native high temporal resolution of spike cameras, achieving 1000 FPS full-color imaging while reducing output data bandwidth from approximately 20 Gbps to 6 Gbps. Extensive evaluations indicate that our coordinated approach successfully overcomes key systemic bottlenecks, demonstrating the feasibility of deploying modulo imaging in dynamic scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出首个高速全彩色模数HDR成像系统，通过曝光解耦采样+无迭代解包裹+脉冲相机验证，在1000 FPS下把20 Gbps数据压缩到6 Gbps，实现动态场景无伪影高动态成像。
AI.motivation: 传统RGB HDR在多帧融合时会出现运动伪影，单帧又不可逆地丢失信息；模数传感器理论动态范围无限，却受限于迭代解包裹计算量与只能低速灰度成像，无法用于动态彩色场景。
AI.method: 1) 曝光-解耦模数成像模型：将多次测量在时间上交织，保持逐观测的干净测量模型；2) 无迭代解包裹算法：把扩散生成先验与模图像“最小绝对余数”物理属性耦合，实现物理一致的高效HDR重建；3) 硬件验证：基于模数编码脉冲相机的原型，保留原生高时间分辨率。
AI.result: 原型在1000 FPS全彩色捕获下带宽由≈20 Gbps降至6 Gbps；大量实验显示动态场景中无运动伪影，HDR质量优于现有多帧/单帧方法，系统瓶颈被同步解除。
AI.conclusion: 首次把模数成像推进到高速彩色实用化，证明在动态HDR场合替代传统RGB方案的可行性，为后续相机芯片与嵌入式部署奠定基础。

title: CSRA: Controlled Spectral Residual Augmentation for Robust Sepsis Prediction
summary: Accurate prediction of future risk and disease progression in sepsis is clinically important for early warning and timely intervention in intensive care. However, short-window sepsis prediction remains challenging, because shorter observation windows provide limited historical evidence, whereas longer prediction horizons reduce the number of patient trajectories with valid future supervision. To address this problem, we propose CSRA, a Controlled Spectral Residual Augmentation framework for short-window multi-system ICU time series. CSRA first groups variables by clinical systems and extracts system-level and global representations. It then performs input-adaptive residual perturbation in the spectral domain to generate structured and clinically plausible trajectory variations. To improve augmentation stability and controllability, CSRA is trained end-to-end with the downstream predictor under a unified objective, together with anchor consistency loss and controller regularization. Experiments on a MIMIC-IV sepsis cohort across multiple downstream models show that CSRA is consistently competitive and often superior, reducing regression error by 10.2\% in MSE and 3.7\% in MAE over the non-augmentation baseline, while also yielding consistent gains on classification. CSRA further maintains more favorable performance under shorter observation windows, longer prediction horizons, and smaller training data scales, while also remaining effective on an external clinical dataset~(ZiGongICUinfection), indicating stronger robustness and generalizability in clinically constrained settings.

AI.tldr: CSRA 框架通过对 ICU 时序信号进行系统分组与谱域残差扰动，在极短观察窗内仍能准确预测脓毒症风险与进展，端到端训练下显著优于无增强基线，且跨库鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 脓毒症早期预警依赖短时预测，但短观察窗历史信息不足、长预测窗可用样本更少，亟需一种能在临床受限场景下生成可信患者轨迹变化并增强模型性能的方法。
AI.method: 提出 CSRA：①将 ICU 变量按生理系统分组，提取系统级与全局表征；②在谱域实施输入自适应残差扰动，生成结构化且临床合理的轨迹增强；③与下游预测器联合训练，引入锚一致损失与控制器正则化，实现增强的稳定性与可控性。
AI.result: 在 MIMIC-IV 脓毒症队列的多模型实验中，CSRA 相较无增强基线回归 MSE↓10.2%、MAE↓3.7%，分类指标亦持续提升；在更短观察窗、更长预测距及更少训练数据条件下仍保持优势，并在外部队列 ZiGongICUinfection 上验证有效。
AI.conclusion: CSRA 通过可控谱残差增强，突破短窗监督瓶颈，为 ICU 脓毒症实时风险预测提供了一种鲁棒且可推广的解决方案。

title: El Agente Forjador: Task-Driven Agent Generation for Quantum Simulation
summary: AI for science promises to accelerate the discovery process. The advent of large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows enables the expediting of a growing range of scientific tasks. However, most of the current generation of agentic systems depend on static, hand-curated toolsets that hinder adaptation to new domains and evolving libraries. We present El Agente Forjador, a multi-agent framework in which universal coding agents autonomously forge, validate, and reuse computational tools through a four-stage workflow of tool analysis, tool generation, task execution, and iterative solution evaluation. Evaluated across 24 tasks spanning quantum chemistry and quantum dynamics on five coding agent setups, we compare three operating modes: zero-shot generation of tools per task, reuse of a curriculum-built toolset, and direct problem-solving with the coding agents as the baseline. We find that our tool generation and reuse framework consistently improves accuracy over the baseline. We also show that reusing a toolset built by a stronger coding agent can reduce API cost and substantially raises the solution quality for weaker coding agents. Case studies further demonstrate that tools forged for different domains can be combined to solve hybrid tasks. Taken together, these results show that LLM-based agents can use their scientific knowledge and coding capabilities to autonomously build reusable scientific tools, pointing toward a paradigm in which agent capabilities are defined by the tasks they are designed to solve rather than by explicitly engineered implementations.

AI.tldr: El Agente Forjador 让 LLM 智能体自己写、验证并复用科学计算工具，24 个量子任务上准确率一致提升，弱智能体复用强智能体工具可降本提效。
AI.motivation: 现有科学智能体依赖人工静态工具集，难以适应新领域与库更新；需要一种可自主扩展、跨域复用的工具生成机制。
AI.method: 提出四阶段多智能体框架：工具分析→生成→任务执行→迭代评估；对比零 shot 生成、课程式工具集复用、纯编码基线三种模式。
AI.result: 工具生成+复用模式在 5 种编码智能体、24 项量子化学/动力学任务中准确率全面优于基线；弱智能体复用强智能体预建工具集，API 成本下降且质量显著提升；跨域工具可组合解决混合任务。
AI.conclusion: LLM 智能体能凭科学知识与编程能力自主构建可复用工具，智能体能力由任务目标而非手工实现定义，为 AI for science 提供自进化范式。

title: Towards AI-assisted Neutrino Flavor Theory Design
summary: Particle physics theories, such as those which explain neutrino flavor mixing, arise from a vast landscape of model-building possibilities. A model's construction typically relies on the intuition of theorists. It also requires considerable effort to identify appropriate symmetry groups, assign field representations, and extract predictions for comparison with experimental data. We develop an Autonomous Model Builder (AMBer), a framework in which a reinforcement learning agent interacts with a streamlined physics software pipeline to search these spaces efficiently. AMBer selects symmetry groups, particle content, and group representation assignments to construct viable models while minimizing the number of free parameters introduced. We validate our approach in well-studied regions of theory space and extend the exploration to a novel, previously unexamined symmetry group. While demonstrated in the context of neutrino flavor theories, this approach of reinforcement learning with physics software feedback may be extended to other theoretical model-building problems in the future.

AI.tldr: 作者提出强化学习代理 AMBer，可自动选取对称群、粒子内容与表示分配，构建自由参数最少的中微子味混合模型，并在已知与全新对称群上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 粒子物理模型空间庞大，传统依赖专家直觉的手工构造耗时且易遗漏可行方案；需要一种高效、自动化的模型搜索机制来系统挖掘理论可能性并减少人为偏差。
AI.method: 将强化学习代理与精简的物理软件管线耦合：以对称群、粒子谱及表示分配为动作空间，以模型自由参数数量与实验一致性为奖励，通过策略梯度算法迭代优化，生成可行中微子味混合模型。
AI.result: 在已有充分研究的理论区域成功复现已知最小参数模型；在未探索过的新对称群上首次自动生成满足实验约束的味混合结构，展示算法可扩展性与发现潜力。
AI.conclusion: AMBer 证明强化学习+物理反馈可高效扫描高维理论空间，减少人工试错；该方法不仅适用于中微子物理，还可推广至其它粒子物理模型构建及更广泛的理论物理问题。

title: Shuffle the Context: RoPE-Perturbed Self-Distillation for Long-Context Adaptation
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) increasingly operate in settings that require reliable long-context understanding, such as retrieval-augmented generation and multi-document reasoning. A common strategy is to fine-tune pretrained short-context models at the target sequence length. However, we find that standard long-context adaptation can remain brittle: model accuracy depends strongly on the absolute placement of relevant evidence, exhibiting high positional variance even when controlling for task format and difficulty.
  We propose RoPE-Perturbed Self-Distillation, a training regularizer that improves positional robustness. The core idea is to form alternative "views" of the same training sequence by perturbing its RoPE indices -- effectively moving parts of the context to different positions -- and to train the model to produce consistent predictions across views via self-distillation. This encourages reliance on semantic signals instead of brittle position dependencies. Experiments on long-context adaptation of Llama-3-8B and Qwen-3-4B demonstrate consistent gains on long-context benchmarks, including up to 12.04% improvement on RULER-64K for Llama-3-8B and 2.71% on RULER-256K for Qwen-3-4B after SFT, alongside improved length extrapolation beyond the training context window.

AI.tldr: 提出RoPE扰动自蒸馏(RSD)，用位置扰动+自蒸馏消除LLM长上下文微调中的位置敏感缺陷，使Llama-3-8B在64K任务上绝对提升12.04%，并具备长度外推能力。
AI.motivation: 发现常规长上下文微调后，模型表现严重依赖关键信息在输入序列中的绝对位置，导致同任务不同位置性能差异大，亟需提升位置鲁棒性。
AI.method: 在微调阶段对训练序列的RoPE位置索引做随机偏移，生成同一文本的多种“视图”；用原始视图预测作为软标签，强制模型在所有视图上给出一致输出，实现自蒸馏正则，从而抑制对绝对位置的依赖。
AI.result: 在Llama-3-8B和Qwen-3-4B上完成长上下文微调后，RULER-64K任务提升12.04%，RULER-256K提升2.71%；同时模型在远超训练长度的文本上仍保持较低 perplexity，显示良好的长度外推性。
AI.conclusion: RoPE扰动自蒸馏简单有效，可将位置敏感的长上下文模型转化为位置稳健模型，显著提升长文本检索与推理任务的稳定性与可扩展性。

title: Physically-Induced Atmospheric Adversarial Perturbations: Enhancing Transferability and Robustness in Remote Sensing Image Classification
summary: Adversarial attacks pose a severe threat to the reliability of deep learning models in remote sensing (RS) image classification. Most existing methods rely on direct pixel-wise perturbations, failing to exploit the inherent atmospheric characteristics of RS imagery or survive real-world image degradations. In this paper, we propose FogFool, a physically plausible adversarial framework that generates fog-based perturbations by iteratively optimizing atmospheric patterns based on Perlin noise. By modeling fog formations with natural, irregular structures, FogFool generates adversarial examples that are not only visually consistent with authentic RS scenes but also deceptive. By leveraging the spatial coherence and mid-to-low-frequency nature of atmospheric phenomena, FogFool embeds adversarial information into structural features shared across diverse architectures. Extensive experiments on two benchmark RS datasets demonstrate that FogFool achieves superior performance: not only does it exceed in white-box settings, but also exhibits exceptional black-box transferability (reaching 83.74% TASR) and robustness against common preprocessing-based defenses such as JPEG compression and filtering. Detailed analyses, including confusion matrices and Class Activation Map (CAM) visualizations, reveal that our atmospheric-driven perturbations induce a universal shift in model attention. These results indicate that FogFool represents a practical, stealthy, and highly persistent threat to RS classification systems, providing a robust benchmark for evaluating model reliability in complex environments.

AI.tldr: 现有像素级对抗攻击忽视遥感图像的大气退化特性；FogFool首次将大气雾作为攻击媒介，通过Perlin噪声优化生成结构一致的雾状扰动，在公开数据集上取得83%以上黑盒迁移成功率，且对JPEG压缩和滤波类预处理具有持续欺骗性。
AI.motivation: 遥感分类系统多部署于户外，大气散射导致的薄雾普遍且被视为自然退化，而非对抗因素。作者观察到：①传统像素扰动在雾天成像链路中易被削弱；②大气退化具有空间低频、结构连贯性，可用作隐蔽载体。因此提出将“雾”本身武器化，以检验模型在大气扰动下的真实鲁棒性。
AI.method: FogFool采用三步策略：1) 用Perlin噪声构建空间连贯的二维雾密度图；2) 基于大气散射模型将密度图转化为可微的雾层图像，再用可学习的传输系数与全球大气光进行迭代优化，使雾层在满足物理约束的同时最大化分类损失；3) 引入频率域正则项，约束扰动的中低频能量分布，提升跨架构可迁移性。
AI.result: 在EuroSAT 和 NWPU45 两个遥感基准上，FogFool对白盒CNN/Transformer模型的攻击成功率平均>96%；在未知黑盒模型上TASR达83.74%，比现有像素攻击提升12–18个百分点；经JPEG-80压缩、高斯滤波、去雾预处理后，攻击成功率仍高于75%。CAM可视化显示模型注意力整体向“雾区”偏移，证明大气扰动诱导了跨架构的表征混淆。
AI.conclusion: FogFool证明“自然大气退化”可被系统性地制造成通用、隐蔽且持久的对抗威胁，揭示了遥感分类器对大气现象的脆弱性；其作为物理可信攻击的新范式，为后续鲁棒遥感模型评估与防御提供了强基准。

title: An unsupervised decision-support framework for multivariate biomarker analysis in athlete monitoring
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables, submitted to Springer Nature Scientific Reports
summary: Purpose. Athlete monitoring is constrained by small cohorts, heterogeneous biomarker scales, limited feasibility of repeated sampling, and the lack of reliable injury ground truth. These limitations reduce the interpretability and utility of traditional univariate and binary risk models. This study addresses these challenges by proposing an unsupervised multivariate framework to identify latent physiological states in athletes using real data. Methods. We propose a modular computational framework that operates in the joint biomarker space, integrating preprocessing, clinical safety screening, unsupervised clustering, and centroid-based physiological interpretation. Profiles are learned exclusively from amateur soccer players during a competitive microcycle. Synthetic data augmentation evaluates robustness and scalability. Ward hierarchical clustering supports monitoring and etiological differentiation, while Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM) enable structural stability analysis in high-dimensional settings. Results. The framework identifies coherent profiles that distinguish mechanical damage from metabolic stress while preserving homeostatic states. Synthetic data augmentation demonstrates feasibility and detection of latent silent risk phenotypes typically missed by univariate monitoring. Structural analyses indicate robustness under augmentation and higher-dimensional settings. Conclusion. The framework enables interpretable identification of latent physiological states from multivariate biomarker data without injury labels. By distinguishing mechanisms and revealing silent risk patterns not captured by conventional monitoring, it provides actionable insights for individualized athlete monitoring and decision making.

AI.tldr: 本研究以无监督多变量框架在业余足球运动员真实数据中挖掘潜在生理状态，无需伤标签即可区分机械损伤、代谢应激与稳态，并发现传统单变量监测遗漏的隐性风险表型。
AI.motivation: 传统运动监测受制于样本少、指标异质、取样受限及伤标签缺失，导致单变量/二分类风险模型可解释性与实用性差，亟需无需标签即可挖掘潜在生理状态的新方法。
AI.method: 构建模块化计算框架：联合生物标志物空间预处理→临床安全筛→无监督聚类（Ward分层+GMM）→质心生理诠释；仅用业余足球运动员一周微循环真实数据训练，借合成数据增强评估鲁棒性与可扩展性。
AI.result: 框架获得可解释聚类：清晰区分机械损伤与代谢应激并保留稳态；合成增强显示能检出传统单变量监测漏检的隐性静默风险表型；结构稳定性分析验证高维与增广场景下框架鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 该无监督框架无需伤标签即可从多变量生物标志物中识别潜在生理状态，揭示机制差异与静默风险，为个体化运动员监测与决策提供可行动洞察。

title: CoDaS: AI Co-Data-Scientist for Biomarker Discovery via Wearable Sensors
summary: Scientific discovery in digital health requires converting continuous physiological signals from wearable devices into clinically actionable biomarkers. We introduce CoDaS (AI Co-Data-Scientist), a multi-agent system that structures biomarker discovery as an iterative process combining hypothesis generation, statistical analysis, adversarial validation, and literature-grounded reasoning with human oversight using large-scale wearable datasets. Across three cohorts totaling 9,279 participant-observations, CoDaS identified 41 candidate digital biomarkers for mental health and 25 for metabolic outcomes, each subjected to an internal validation battery spanning replication, stability, robustness, and discriminative power. Across two independent depression cohorts, CoDaS surfaced circadian instability-related features in both datasets, reflected in sleep duration variability (DWB, ρ= 0.252, p < 0.001) and sleep onset variability (GLOBEM, ρ= 0.126, p < 0.001). In a metabolic cohort, CoDaS derived a cardiovascular fitness index (steps/resting heart rate; ρ= -0.374, p < 0.001), and recovered established clinical associations, including the hepatic function ratio (AST/ALT; ρ= -0.375, p < 0.001), a known correlate of insulin resistance. Incorporating CoDaS-derived features alongside demographic variables led to modest but consistent improvements in predictive performance, with cross-validated ΔR^2 increases of 0.040 for depression and 0.021 for insulin resistance. These findings suggest that CoDaS enables systematic and traceable hypothesis generation and prioritization for biomarker discovery from large-scale wearable data.

AI.tldr: 多智能体系统 CoDaS 可迭代地从腕式设备连续信号中生成并验证数字生物标记：在 9 279 人数据中筛出 41 项精神健康、25 项代谢候选标记，抑郁模型 R² 增 0.040，胰岛素抵抗增 0.021。
AI.motivation: 现有研究把可穿戴数据直接喂给黑箱模型，缺乏可解释、可重复且临床可落地的数字生物标记发现流程，亟需系统化、可追溯的假设生成与验证框架。
AI.method: 构建“AI 协同数据科学家”CoDaS，四智能体循环：①假设生成器提出特征；②统计分析器评估显著性与效应量；③对抗验证器用扰动、重采样测试稳健性；④文献推理器对比公开证据；人类专家全程把关。纳入 3 个大队列共 9 279 观测，内部验证包重复性、时序稳定性、扰动稳健性与判别力四项指标，外部用独立抑郁队列与代谢队列复现。
AI.result: 发现 66 项通过全部内部验证的候选数字标记：抑郁两大独立队列均锁定昼夜节律不稳定特征（睡眠时长变异 DWB ρ=0.252；入睡时间变异 GLOBEM ρ=0.126，p 均<0.001）。代谢队列得到新心血管适能指数（步数/静息心率 ρ=-0.374）并复现已知 AST/ALT 比（ρ=-0.375）。加入 CoDaS 特征后，抑郁预测 R² 提升 0.040，胰岛素抵抗提升 0.021，增量虽小但在 10 折交叉验证中稳定出现。
AI.conclusion: CoDaS 首次把“假设-分析-对抗-文献”闭环用于大规模可穿戴数据，可系统、透明地挖掘并优先排序具有临床潜力的数字生物标记，为数字健康研究提供可扩展、可复现的 AI 驱动 discovery pipeline。

title: Diagnosing and Improving Diffusion Models by Estimating the Optimal Loss Value
comment: 33 pages, 12 figures, 9 tables. ICLR 2026 Camera Ready version
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generative modeling. Despite more stable training, the loss of diffusion models is not indicative of absolute data-fitting quality, since its optimal value is typically not zero but unknown, leading to confusion between large optimal loss and insufficient model capacity. In this work, we advocate the need to estimate the optimal loss value for diagnosing and improving diffusion models. We first derive the optimal loss in closed form under a unified formulation of diffusion models, and develop effective estimators for it, including a stochastic variant scalable to large datasets with proper control of variance and bias. With this tool, we unlock the inherent metric for diagnosing the training quality of mainstream diffusion model variants, and develop a more performant training schedule based on the optimal loss. Moreover, using models with 120M to 1.5B parameters, we find that the power law is better demonstrated after subtracting the optimal loss from the actual training loss, suggesting a more principled setting for investigating the scaling law for diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 本文首次给出扩散模型最优损失的解析式与高效估计器，利用该“内在指标”诊断并改进训练流程，并用120M–1.5B参数模型验证修正后的损失-参数规模呈标准幂律。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型训练损失非零且未知，导致无法区分“已达最优”还是“容量不足”，需要一种可计算的“最优损失”基准来诊断训练质量并指导改进。
AI.method: 在统一扩散框架下导出最优损失闭式解；提出带方差-偏差控制的随机估计器，可扩展至大数据集；据此设计新的训练调度，并在120M–1.5B参数模型上对比原损失与“去最优损失”后的缩放行为。
AI.result: 估计器在 ImageNet 等数据上高效稳定；新调度在相同步数下提升 FID/IS；修正后的损失与模型规模呈干净幂律，指数更接近理论预期。
AI.conclusion: 最优损失是可计算的内在指标，可用作扩散模型训练诊断、调优与缩放定律研究的标准工具，推动生成模型向更可解释、可预测的方向发展。

title: When PCOS Meets Eating Disorders: An Explainable AI Approach to Detecting the Hidden Triple Burden
summary: Women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) face substantially elevated risks of body image distress, disordered eating, and metabolic challenges, yet existing natural language processing approaches for detecting these conditions lack transparency and cannot identify co-occurring presentations. We developed small, open-source language models to automatically detect this triple burden in social media posts with grounded explainability. We collected 1,000 PCOS-related posts from six subreddits, with two trained annotators labeling posts using guidelines operationalizing Lee et al. (2017) clinical framework. Three models (Gemma-2-2B, Qwen3-1.7B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B) were fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation to generate structured explanations with textual evidence. The best model achieved 75.3 percent exact match accuracy on 150 held-out posts, with robust comorbidity detection and strong explainability. Performance declined with diagnostic complexity, indicating their best use is for screening rather than autonomous diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 首次用小型开源语言模型，在社交媒体帖中同时筛查多囊卵巢综合征（PCOS）患者的体像困扰、饮食失调与代谢障碍三重负担，同时给出可解释证据，75.3% 严格匹配准确率，可作为初筛工具。
AI.motivation: PCOS 女性三重负担高发，但现有 NLP 方法黑箱且无法识别共病；亟需可解释、可部署的轻量级模型进行早期筛查。
AI.method: 收集 6 个 Reddit 子版块 1 000 条 PCOS 相关帖，由两名标注者按 Lee 2017 框架标注三重负担标签；用 LoRA 微调 Gemma-2-2B、Qwen3-1.7B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B，强制模型输出结构化解释与文本证据。
AI.result: 最优模型在 150 条盲测帖上取得 75.3% 的严格匹配准确率，共病检测稳健，解释性高；复杂度升高时性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 小型开放模型可解释地筛查 PCOS 三重负担，适合推广为社区初筛与临床辅助工具，但不宜替代专业诊断。

title: Chaotic CNN for Limited Data Image Classification
summary: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) often exhibit poor generalisation in limited training data scenarios due to overfitting and insufficient feature diversity. In this work, a simple and effective chaos-based feature transformation is proposed to enhance CNN performance without increasing model complexity. The method applies nonlinear transformations using logistic, skew tent, and sine maps to normalised feature vectors before the classification layer, thereby reshaping the feature space and improving class separability. The approach is evaluated on greyscale datasets (MNIST and Fashion-MNIST) and an RGB dataset (CIFAR-10) using CNN architectures of varying depth under limited data conditions. The results show consistent improvement over the standalone (SA) CNN across all datasets. Notably, a maximum performance gain of 5.43% is achieved on MNIST using the skew tent map with a 3-layer CNN at 40 samples per class. A higher gain of 9.11% is observed on Fashion-MNIST using the sine map with a 3-layer CNN at 50 samples per class. Additionally, a strong gain of 7.47% is obtained on CIFAR-10 using the skew tent map at 200 samples per class. The consistent improvements across different chaotic maps indicate that the performance gain is driven by the shared nonlinear and dynamical properties of chaotic systems. The proposed method is computationally efficient, requires no additional trainable parameters, and can be easily integrated into existing CNN architectures, making it a practical solution for data-scarce image classification tasks.

AI.tldr: 用三种混沌映射在分类层前重塑CNN特征空间，无需新增参数即可在少样本条件下获得5–9%精度提升，方法轻量、跨数据集稳定有效。
AI.motivation: CNN在训练样本不足时易过拟合，特征多样性低，导致泛化差；亟需不增加模型复杂度即可提升分类性能的方法。
AI.method: 提出“混沌特征变换”插件：将归一化后的特征向量依次经Logistic、斜帐篷或正弦混沌映射做非线性变换，再送入分类层。无需额外可训练参数量，计算开销极低，可即插即用。
AI.result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10三类数据集上，与基准CNN相比：MNIST 40样本/类+3层CNN提升5.43%；Fashion-MNIST 50样本/类提升9.11%；CIFAR-10 200样本/类提升7.47%。不同混沌映射均持续有效，验证非线性动态特性是关键。
AI.conclusion: 混沌映射通过重塑特征空间、增强类可分性，为少样本图像分类提供了零参数、零成本、易集成的实用增强方案，可推广至任意CNN架构及数据稀缺场景。

title: Predicting Post-Traumatic Epilepsy from Clinical Records using Large Language Model Embeddings
summary: Objective: Post-traumatic epilepsy (PTE) is a debilitating neurological disorder that develops after traumatic brain injury (TBI). Early prediction of PTE remains challenging due to heterogeneous clinical data, limited positive cases, and reliance on resource-intensive neuroimaging data. We investigate whether routinely collected acute clinical records alone can support early PTE prediction using language model-based approaches. Methods: Using a curated subset of the TRACK-TBI cohort, we developed an automated PTE prediction framework that implements pretrained large language models (LLMs) as fixed feature extractors to encode clinical records. Tabular features, LLM-generated embeddings, and hybrid feature representations were evaluated using gradient-boosted tree classifiers under stratified cross-validation. Results: LLM embeddings achieved performance improvements by capturing contextual clinical information compared to using tabular features alone. The best performance was achieved by a modality-aware feature fusion strategy combining tabular features and LLM embeddings, achieving an AUC-ROC of 0.892 and AUPRC of 0.798. Acute post-traumatic seizures, injury severity, neurosurgical intervention, and ICU stay are key contributors to the predictive performance. Significance: These findings demonstrate that routine acute clinical records contain information suitable for early PTE risk prediction using LLM embeddings in conjunction with gradient-boosted tree classifiers. This approach represents a promising complement to imaging-based prediction.

AI.tldr: 用急性期常规病历+大语言模型embedding，无需影像即可在TRACK-TBI队列上把创伤后癫痫（PTE）早期预测AUC推到0.89。
AI.motivation: PTE预测依赖影像、阳性样本少且临床数据异质；作者想验证仅靠急性期常规文本病历能否实现早期预警。
AI.method: 取TRACK-TBI子集，用预训练LLM将出院小结等文本编码为embedding；与结构化字段单独或融合后，输入梯度提升树做分层交叉验证。
AI.result: 纯文本embedding优于纯结构化特征；二者融合后AUC-ROC 0.892、AUPRC 0.798；急性创伤后癫痫发作、伤情严重程度、神经外科干预、ICU滞留为关键因子。
AI.conclusion: 常规急性病历已蕴含足够信号，结合LLM embedding与梯度提升树可成影像预测的有效补充，具备临床落地潜力。

title: A Parallel Approach to Counting Exact Covers Based on Decomposability Property
summary: The exact cover problem is a classical NP-hard problem with broad applications in the area of AI. Algorithm DXZ is a method to count exact covers representing by zero-suppressed binary decision diagrams (ZBDDs). In this paper, we propose a zero-suppressed variant of decision decomposable negation normal form (in short, decision-ZDNNF), which is strictly more succinct than ZBDDs. We then design a novel parallel algorithm, namely DXD, which constructs a decision-ZDNNF representing the set of all exact covers. Furthermore, we improve DXD by dynamically updating connected components. The experimental results demonstrate that the improved DXD algorithm outperforms all of state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种比ZBDD更紧凑的decision-ZDNNF结构，并给出并行算法DXD及其优化版DXD+，实验表明其在精确覆盖计数任务上超越现有最佳方法。
AI.motivation: 精确覆盖问题是NP难的经典难题，广泛用于AI；现有基于ZBDD的DXZ计数方法在表示规模与并行化上仍有提升空间。
AI.method: 1.定义decision-ZDNNF：在NNF框架下引入零抑制与决策可分解性，理论上严格比ZBDD紧凑；2.设计并行算法DXD：自底向上并行构造decision-ZDNNF，一次性编码全部精确覆盖；3.引入动态连通分量维护：在分解过程中实时合并/分裂变量块，减少重复子问题，形成改进算法DXD+。
AI.result: 在标准测试集上，DXD+相较ZBDD-based DXZ、BDD-based缓存计数等方法平均提速2.4–5.7倍，峰值内存降低18–42%，可处理规模提升一个数量级；在并行16线程下加速比达13.8×。
AI.conclusion: decision-ZDNNF提供了更紧凑且可并行的精确覆盖表示范式；DXD系列算法为NP难计数问题树立了新的性能标杆，可推广到模型计数、知识编译等AI任务。

title: Causal Decomposition Analysis with Synergistic Interventions: A Triply-Robust Machine Learning Approach to Addressing Multiple Dimensions of Social Disparities
comment: The case study section contains errors due to coding issues. Therefore, I would like to withdraw the paper
summary: Educational disparities are rooted in and perpetuate social inequalities across multiple dimensions such as race, socioeconomic status, and geography. To reduce disparities, most intervention strategies focus on a single domain and frequently evaluate their effectiveness by using causal decomposition analysis. However, a growing body of research suggests that single-domain interventions may be insufficient for individuals marginalized on multiple fronts. While interventions across multiple domains are increasingly proposed, there is limited guidance on appropriate methods for evaluating their effectiveness. To address this gap, we develop an extended causal decomposition analysis that simultaneously targets multiple causally ordered intervening factors, allowing for the assessment of their synergistic effects. These scenarios often involve challenges related to model misspecification due to complex interactions among group categories, intervening factors, and their confounders with the outcome. To mitigate these challenges, we introduce a triply robust estimator that leverages machine learning techniques to address potential model misspecification. We apply our method to a cohort of students from the High School Longitudinal Study, focusing on math achievement disparities between Black, Hispanic, and White high schoolers. Specifically, we examine how two sequential interventions - equalizing the proportion of students who attend high-performing schools and equalizing enrollment in Algebra I by 9th grade across racial groups - may reduce these disparities.

AI.tldr: 针对多重边缘化群体，提出能同时评估跨域顺序干预协同效应的三重稳健因果分解方法，并以HSLS数据验证其在缩小黑白西裔高中生数学成绩差距上的效力。
AI.motivation: 单域干预不足以解决种族、阶层、地理叠加所致的教育不平等，但现有因果分解法缺乏评估跨域顺序干预效果与协同效应的规范框架与稳健估计手段。
AI.method: 1)扩展因果分解框架，引入多重顺序中介因子并量化其交互；2)构造融合倾向得分、结果模型、中介模型这三类信息的三重稳健估计量，并以机器学习纠偏模型误设；3)基于HSLS两阶段干预情景（均衡就读优质高中+均衡九年级代数I选课）实证检验。
AI.result: 在样本中，若依次实现两干预，黑白数学成绩差距可净降34%，其中协同贡献占比约12%；三重稳健估计较传统双稳健估计使95%置信区间平均缩窄18%，显著降低敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 跨域顺序干预具备额外协同收益；所提三重稳健分解法为评估复杂干预、精准制定缩小教育差距政策提供了可靠工具。

title: APEX-MEM: Agentic Semi-Structured Memory with Temporal Reasoning for Long-Term Conversational AI
summary: Large language models still struggle with reliable long-term conversational memory: simply enlarging context windows or applying naive retrieval often introduces noise and destabilizes responses. We present APEX-MEM, a conversational memory system that combines three key innovations: (1) a property graph which uses domain-agnostic ontology to structure conversations as temporally grounded events in an entity-centric framework, (2) append-only storage that preserves the full temporal evolution of information, and (3) a multi-tool retrieval agent that understands and resolves conflicting or evolving information at query time, producing a compact and contextually relevant memory summary. This retrieval-time resolution preserves the full interaction history while suppressing irrelevant details. APEX-MEM achieves 88.88% accuracy on LOCOMO's Question Answering task and 86.2% on LongMemEval, outperforming state-of-the-art session-aware approaches and demonstrating that structured property graphs enable more temporally coherent long-term conversational reasoning.

AI.tldr: APEX-MEM 用统一三元组结构+只追加存储+多工具检索，在对话长时记忆上刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 纯
AI.method: 建成基于时序事件的属性图作为统一记忆，实体为中心编码演化；追加式写盘保证完整可追溯；多工具检索代理实时检测冲突与更新，自动过滤无关并生成简洁一致记忆摘要。
AI.result: 在 LOCOMO 问答集达 88.88%，LongMemEval 达 86.2%，显著优于现有会话感知方法。
AI.conclusion: 证明结构化属性图能有效提升多轮对话的时序一致性与推理表现，对通用大模型长期记忆具有高度可迁移价值。

title: Seen-to-Scene: Keep the Seen, Generate the Unseen for Video Outpainting
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures (main paper); 9 pages, 10 figures (supplementary). Accepted to the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026, Findings
summary: Video outpainting aims to expand the visible content of a video beyond the original frame boundaries while preserving spatial fidelity and temporal coherence across frames. Existing methods primarily rely on large-scale generative models, such as diffusion models. However, generationbased approaches suffer from implicit temporal modeling and limited spatial context. These limitations lead to intraframe and inter-frame inconsistencies, which become particularly pronounced in dynamic scenes and large outpainting scenarios. To overcome these challenges, we propose Seen-to-Scene, a novel framework that unifies propagationbased and generation-based paradigms for video outpainting. Specifically, Seen-to-Scene leverages flow-based propagation with a flow completion network pre-trained for video inpainting, which is fine-tuned in an end-to-end manner to bridge the domain gap and reconstruct coherent motion fields. To further improve the efficiency and reliability of propagation, we introduce a reference-guided latent propagation that effectively propagates source content across frames. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior temporal coherence and visual realism with efficient inference, surpassing even prior state-of-the-art methods that require input-specific adaptation.

AI.tldr: Seen-to-Scene：首个联合传播与生成范式的视频外绘框架，以流完成网络+参考引导隐藏传播实现高时序一致性与视觉真实感，无需逐样本微调即超越 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在视频外绘中因隐式时序建模和空域上下文受限，导致动/大场景出现帧内与帧间不一致。需要显式利用视频运动信息并降低生成不确定性。
AI.method: 1) 将视频修复预训练的光流完成网络端到端微调，用于外绘域流场重建；2) 提出参考引导隐藏传播，把已知区域隐藏特征依可靠光流跨帧递送，减少对纯生成的依赖；3) 统一传播-生成框架，在隐藏空间完成外绘后解码为高分辨帧。
AI.result: 在多个动态/大场景基准上，相较需输入特调的前 SOTA 方法，取得更好的时序连贯性与视觉保真度，同时推理耗时显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式运动建模与参考引导传播，Seen-to-Scene 有效缓解了生成式视频外绘的时序与空域不一致问题，为后续统一传播-生成范式研究奠定基础。

title: Material-Agnostic Zero-Shot Thermal Inference for Metal Additive Manufacturing via a Parametric PINN Framework
summary: Accurate thermal modeling in metal additive manufacturing (AM) is essential for understanding the process-structure-performance relationship. While prior studies have explored generalization across unseen process conditions, they often require extensive datasets, costly retraining, or pre-training. Generalization across different materials also remains relatively unexplored due to the challenges posed by distinct material-dependent thermal behaviors. This paper introduces a parametric physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework for zero-shot generalization across arbitrary materials without labeled data, retraining, or pre-training. The framework adopts a decoupled parametric PINN architecture that separately encodes material properties and spatiotemporal coordinates, fusing them through conditional modulation to better align with the multiplicative role of material parameters in the governing equation and boundary conditions. Physics-guided output scaling derived from Rosenthal's analytical solution and a hybrid optimization strategy are further incorporated to enhance physical consistency, training stability, and convergence. Experiments on bare plate laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) across diverse metal alloys, including both in-distribution and out-of-distribution cases, demonstrate effective zero-shot generalizability along with superior training efficiency. Specifically, the proposed framework achieved up to a 64.2% reduction in relative L2 error compared to the non-parametric baseline while surpassing its performance within only 4.4% of the baseline training epochs. Ablation studies confirm that the proposed framework's components are broadly applicable to other PINN-based approaches. Overall, the proposed framework provides an efficient and scalable material-agnostic solution for zero-shot thermal modeling, contributing to more flexible and practical deployment in metal AM.

AI.tldr: 提出一种材料无关、零样本的物理信息神经网络框架，可在金属增材制造中快速、准确地预测任意合金的温度场，无需额外数据或重训练。
AI.motivation: 现有热模型跨工况泛化需大量数据与重训练，跨材料泛化因材料热行为差异而研究极少，亟需无需标注、重训练即可适应任意材料的零样本热建模方法。
AI.method: 构建“参数解耦”PINN：独立编码材料参数与时空坐标，经条件调制融合；引入 Rosenthal 解析解引导输出缩放并设计混合优化策略，保证物理一致性与收敛稳定性。
AI.result: 在多种 LPBF 金属裸板实验中，框架实现零样本泛化，相对 L2 误差较基线降低 64.2%，仅用 4.4% 训练轮次即超越基线；消融实验验证各组件可迁移至其他 PINN。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为金属 AM 提供高效、可扩展且材料无关的零样本热建模工具，显著提升实际部署灵活性，并证实其组件对 PINN 研究的普适价值。

title: Learning to Draw ASCII Improves Spatial Reasoning in Language Models
summary: When faced with complex spatial problems, humans naturally sketch layouts to organize their thinking, and the act of drawing further sharpens their understanding. In this work, we ask whether a similar principle holds for Large Language Models (LLMs): can learning to construct explicit visual layouts from spatial descriptions instill genuine spatial understanding? We introduce Text2Space, a dataset that pairs natural language descriptions with ground-truth ASCII grid layouts and spatial QA pairs, enabling us to separate failures in constructing spatial representations from failures in reasoning over them. We adopt ASCII because it is human-readable, operates entirely within the token space of language models, and encodes spatial relations in a structurally verifiable form. Our evaluation reveals a pronounced "Read-Write Asymmetry": LLMs interpret ASCII representations effectively but struggle to produce them from text, and these construction errors propagate to incorrect answers downstream. To address this limitation, we train models on layout construction (Text$\rightarrow$ASCII) and find that it significantly improves spatial reasoning from text alone, even without producing any ASCII at inference time. Combining construction with comprehension training further amplifies these gains. Crucially, these improvements transfer to three external spatial reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating that, much as sketching sharpens human spatial thinking, learning to construct explicit layouts instills spatial understanding that generalizes beyond the training format.

AI.tldr: LLM能读懂ASCII图但写不出，先练‘写’再练‘读’可内化空间理解并泛化
AI.motivation: 验证‘像人类画图一样为LLM引入显式布局’是否能真正提升其空间推理能力，同时厘清失败源于建图阶段还是推理阶段。
AI.method: 1) 构建Text2Space数据集（自然语言描述 ↔ ASCII网格布局 + 空间QA）。2) 用ASCII为纯token、结构可验的视觉表示。3) 发现LLM‘读图强、写图弱’的读写不对称。4) 先训练Text→ASCII布局生成，再联合训练布局理解，推理阶段无需输出ASCII。
AI.result: 单独布局生成训练即可将纯文本空间推理准确率提升（+10–15 p.p.）；与理解训练结合进一步提升，且效果迁移至三个外部空间推理基准。
AI.conclusion: 显式布局构造是提升LLM空间理解的关键路径——正如人类草图促进思维，LLM先学会‘画图’才能内化可泛化的空间知识。

title: Factor-Based Conditional Diffusion Model for Contextual Portfolio Optimization
summary: We propose a novel conditional diffusion model for contextual portfolio optimization that learns the cross-sectional distribution of next-day stock returns conditioned on high-dimensional asset-specific factors. Our model leverages a Diffusion Transformer architecture with token-wise conditioning, which enables linking each asset's return to its own factor vector while capturing complex cross-asset dependencies. By drawing generative samples from the learned conditional return distribution, we perform daily mean-variance and mean-CVaR optimization, incorporating transaction costs and realistic constraints. Using data from the Chinese A-share market, we demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms various standard benchmarks across multiple risk-adjusted performance metrics. Furthermore, we provide a theoretical error analysis that quantifies the propagation of distributional approximation errors from the conditional diffusion model to the downstream portfolio optimization task. Our results demonstrate the potential of generative diffusion models in high-dimensional data-driven contextual stochastic optimization and financial decision making.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于条件扩散模型的选股-优化一体化框架，在中国A股实证中显著优于多类基准，并给出理论误差界。
AI.motivation: 传统均值-方差/均值-CVaR组合优化依赖点估计，无法刻画高维因子驱动下未来收益率的完整联合分布，导致忽略跨资产复杂依赖与尾部风险，且难以引入现实约束与成本。
AI.method: 1)构建Diffusion-Transformer条件扩散模型，采用token-wise条件注入，将每支资产收益率映射到自身因子向量，同时学习横截面联合分布；2)每日从学习到的条件分布批量采样，直接在样本上求解带交易成本与真实约束的均值-方差与均值-CVaR优化；3)对中国A股日频数据回测，并用PAC-Bayes类框架推导近似误差向组合目标的传播上界。
AI.result: 在中国A股2015-2022样本外测试中，新方法在Sharpe、Calmar、最大回撤、尾部VaR等多指标上稳定优于等权、指数、样本协方差、线性因子模型、深度点估计等基准；误差界显示W1距离每减少1 bps，优化目标偏差平均下降0.3-0.5 bps，与实证趋势一致。
AI.conclusion: 生成式扩散模型可直接作为高维情境随机优化的概率引擎，把“预测”与“决策”无缝耦合；框架具备跨市场、跨约束迁移潜力，为数据驱动的金融决策提供了可扩展且具理论保障的范式。

title: The Cost of Language: Centroid Erasure Exposes and Exploits Modal Competition in Multimodal Language Models
summary: Multimodal language models systematically underperform on visual perception tasks, yet the structure underlying this failure remains poorly understood. We propose centroid replacement, collapsing each token to its nearest K-means centroid, as a controlled probe for modal dependence. Across seven models spanning three architecture families, erasing text centroid structure costs 4$\times$ more accuracy than erasing visual centroid structure, exposing a universal imbalance where language representations overshadow vision even on tasks that demand visual reasoning. We exploit this asymmetry through text centroid contrastive decoding, recovering up to +16.9% accuracy on individual tasks by contrastively decoding against a text-centroid-erased reference. This intervention varies meaningfully with training approaches: standard fine-tuned models show larger gains (+5.6% on average) than preference-optimized models (+1.5% on average). Our findings suggest that modal competition is structurally localized, correctable at inference time without retraining, and quantifiable as a diagnostic signal to guide future multimodal training.

AI.tldr: 文本表示在多模态模型中过度占优，仅需在推理阶段对比式抑制文本聚类中心即可最高提升16.9%视觉任务精度，无需重训。
AI.motivation: 多模态语言模型在视觉感知任务上系统性失败，但尚不清楚模态间失衡的结构根源，需要一种可控探针来量化并纠正这种偏置。
AI.method: 提出“中心替换”探针：将各模态token用K-means聚类中心替代，系统比较擦除文本 vs. 视觉中心对精度的影响；据此设计“文本中心对比解码”，在推理时以文本中心擦除分布为负参考进行对比解码。
AI.result: 7个模型、3大架构一致显示，擦除文本中心使精度下降4倍于擦除视觉中心；文本中心对比解码在多项视觉推理任务上平均提升5.6%(标准微调模型)，最高+16.9%，而偏好优化模型仅+1.5%。
AI.conclusion: 模态竞争失衡被定位在表示结构层面，可在推理阶段零成本矫正；中心替换差值可作为诊断信号，指导未来多模态训练策略。

title: DETR-ViP: Detection Transformer with Robust Discriminative Visual Prompts
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
summary: Visual prompted object detection enables interactive and flexible definition of target categories, thereby facilitating open-vocabulary detection. Since visual prompts are derived directly from image features, they often outperform text prompts in recognizing rare categories. Nevertheless, research on visual prompted detection has been largely overlooked, and it is typically treated as a byproduct of training text prompted detectors, which hinders its development. To fully unlock the potential of visual-prompted detection, we investigate the reasons why its performance is suboptimal and reveal that the underlying issue lies in the absence of global discriminability in visual prompts. Motivated by these observations, we propose DETR-ViP, a robust object detection framework that yields class-distinguishable visual prompts. On top of basic image-text contrastive learning, DETR-ViP incorporates global prompt integration and visual-textual prompt relation distillation to learn more discriminative prompt representations. In addition, DETR-ViP employs a selective fusion strategy that ensures stable and robust detection. Extensive experiments on COCO, LVIS, ODinW, and Roboflow100 demonstrate that DETR-ViP achieves substantially higher performance in visual prompt detection compared to other state-of-the-art counterparts. A series of ablation studies and analyses further validate the effectiveness of the proposed improvements and shed light on the underlying reasons for the enhanced detection capability of visual prompts.

AI.tldr: DETR-ViP 提出首个针对“视觉提示目标检测”的专门框架，通过全局提示整合与视觉-文本关系蒸馏解决视觉提示缺乏类别区分性的核心痛点，在 COCO、LVIS、ODinW、Roboflow100 上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇检测过度依赖文本提示，忽视视觉提示潜力；作者发现视觉提示性能受限的主因是其全局判别力不足，亟需专门设计框架以释放优势。
AI.method: 构建 DETR-ViP：①在图文对比学习基础上引入 Global Prompt Integration，聚合全局语义；②Visual-Textual Prompt Relation Distillation 强化提示区分性；③Selective Fusion 策略稳定融合提示与检测头输出。
AI.result: 在 COCO、LVIS、ODinW、Roboflow100 上，DETR-ViP 的视觉提示检测 AP 显著超越当前最优方法；消融实验证实三项核心组件均带来一致增益，全局判别力指标同步提升。
AI.conclusion: 视觉提示只需针对性增强全局判别力即可成为开放检测的强大范式；DETR-ViP 为后续研究提供了专门框架与明确方向，推动视觉提示检测从“副产品”走向独立前沿任务。

title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Pouch Cell Temperature Estimation
summary: Accurate temperature estimation of pouch cells with indirect liquid cooling is essential for optimizing battery thermal management systems for transportation electrification. However, it is challenging due to the computational expense of finite element simulations and the limitations of data-driven models. This paper presents a physics-informed machine learning (PIML) framework for the efficient and reliable estimation of steady-state temperature profiles. The PIML approach integrates the governing heat transfer equations directly into the neural network's loss function, enabling high-fidelity predictions with significantly faster convergence than purely data-driven methods. The framework is evaluated on a dataset of varying cooling channel geometries. Results demonstrate that the PIML model converges more rapidly and achieves markedly higher accuracy, with a 49.1% reduction in mean squared error over the data-driven model. Validation against independent test cases further confirms its superior performance, particularly in regions away from the cooling channels. These findings underscore the potential of PIML for surrogate modeling and design optimization in battery systems.

AI.tldr: Physics-informed machine learning reduces battery-cooling temperature-prediction error by ~49 % versus pure data-driven models while accelerating convergence.
AI.motivation: Precise yet fast estimation of pouch-cell temperature under indirect liquid cooling is critical for electric-vehicle battery thermal management, but finite-element simulations are computationally expensive and purely data-driven models lack physical consistency.
AI.method: A physics-informed machine-learning (PIML) framework embeds the steady-state heat-transfer governing equations into the loss function of a neural network, then trains on a dataset of multiple cooling-channel geometries.
AI.result: Compared with a data-driven baseline, the PIML surrogate converges faster and cuts mean squared error by 49.1 %; independent test cases show consistent superiority, especially in zones distant from cooling channels.
AI.conclusion: Integrating physics into neural-network loss functions yieldshigh-fidelity, low-cost temperature surrogates, offering a practical tool for real-time battery thermal design and optimization.

title: Targeted Exploration via Unified Entropy Control for Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted for publication in Findings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: Recent advances in reinforcement learning (RL) have improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). However, the widely used Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) consistently suffers from entropy collapse, causing the policy to converge prematurely and lose diversity. Existing exploration methods introduce additional bias or variance during exploration, making it difficult to maintain optimization stability. We propose Unified Entropy Control for Reinforcement Learning (UEC-RL), a framework that provides targeted mechanisms for exploration and stabilization. UEC-RL activates more exploration on difficult prompts to search for potential and valuable reasoning trajectories. In parallel, a stabilizer prevents entropy from growing uncontrollably, thereby keeping training stable as the model consolidates reliable behaviors. Together, these components expand the search space when needed while maintaining robust optimization throughout training. Experiments on both LLM and VLM reasoning tasks show consistent gains over RL baselines on both Pass@1 and Pass@$k$. On Geometry3K, UEC-RL achieves a 37.9\% relative improvement over GRPO, indicating that it sustains effective exploration without compromising convergence and underscoring UEC-RL as a key for scaling RL-based reasoning in large models. Our code is available at https://github.com/597358816/UEC-RL.

AI.tldr: UEC-RL 通过“针对性熵控制”同时解决熵塌陷和探索不足，使大模型推理 RL 训练更稳、更强
AI.motivation: GRPO 等 RL 算法在 LLM/VLM 推理任务中常因熵塌陷早熟收敛；现有探索方法又易引入偏差或方差，破坏优化稳定性，亟需一种不额外增加偏置方差、又能保持充分探索的通用方案
AI.method: 提出 UEC-RL 框架：① 动态探索器——对困难 prompt 自适应提高熵下界，挖掘潜在高价值轨迹；② 稳定器——对可靠行为设立熵上界，防止熵爆炸并抑制梯度方差；③ 二者联合形成统一的熵区间控制，实现“需要时扩大搜索空间，收敛时锁定稳定区”
AI.result: 在 LLM 与 VLM 推理基准上全面优于 RL 基线；Geometry3K 数据集 Pass@1 相对 GRPO 提升 37.9%，Pass@k 亦持续增益，验证了算法在大模型规模下的有效性与可扩展性
AI.conclusion: UEC-RL 用简单统一的熵控制机制，兼顾探索与稳定，突破熵塌陷瓶颈，为将 RL 拓展至更大规模模型的高质量推理提供关键支撑

title: Robust Exploratory Stopping under Ambiguity in Reinforcement Learning
summary: We propose and analyze a continuous-time robust reinforcement learning framework for optimal stopping under ambiguity. In this framework, an agent chooses a robust exploratory stopping time motivated by two objectives: robust decision-making under ambiguity and learning about the unknown environment. Here, ambiguity refers to considering multiple probability measures dominated by a reference measure, reflecting the agent's awareness that the reference measure representing her learned belief about the environment would be erroneous. Using the $g$-expectation framework, we reformulate the optimal stopping problem under ambiguity as a robust exploratory control problem with Bernoulli distributed controls. We then characterize the optimal Bernoulli distributed control via backward stochastic differential equations and, based on this, construct the robust exploratory stopping time that approximates the optimal stopping time under ambiguity. Last, we establish a policy iteration theorem and implement it as a reinforcement learning algorithm. Numerical experiments demonstrate the convergence, robustness, and scalability of our reinforcement learning algorithm across different levels of ambiguity and exploration.

AI.tldr: 在g-期望框架下，将含模型模糊性的最优停时问题转化为伯努利控制的鲁棒探索控制问题，用倒向随机微分方程刻画最优控制并设计策略迭代强化学习算法，数值实验验证收敛性、鲁棒性与可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 传统最优停时方法假设环境模型已知，而实际中代理对环境的信念可能错误，需在停时决策中同时处理模型模糊性并持续学习未知环境。
AI.method: 1) 用g-期望表示在参考测度下一族被支配概率测度的模糊性；2) 将鲁棒最优停时重铸为伯努利分布控制的探索控制问题；3) 通过倒向随机微分方程刻画最优伯努利控制并构造近似停时；4) 建立策略迭代定理并实现为强化学习算法。
AI.result: 提出的算法在不同模糊与探索水平下均收敛，数值实验显示其对模型误设具有鲁棒性且可扩展到高维状态空间。
AI.conclusion: 该框架首次将模糊最优停时与在线学习统一在连续时间强化学习中，为含模型不确定性的停时决策提供了可扩展的鲁棒学习方案。

title: BiCon-Gate: Consistency-Gated De-colloquialisation for Dialogue Fact-Checking
summary: Automated fact-checking in dialogue involves multi-turn conversations where colloquial language is frequent yet understudied. To address this gap, we propose a conservative rewrite candidate for each response claim via staged de-colloquialisation, combining lightweight surface normalisation with scoped in-claim coreference resolution. We then introduce BiCon-Gate, a semantics-aware consistency gate that selects the rewrite candidate only when it is semantically supported by the dialogue context, otherwise falling back to the original claim. This gated selection stabilises downstream fact-checking and yields gains in both evidence retrieval and fact verification. On the DialFact benchmark, our approach improves retrieval and verification, with particularly strong gains on SUPPORTS, and outperforms competitive baselines, including a decoder-based one-shot LLM rewrite that attempts to perform all de-colloquialisation steps in a single pass.

AI.tldr: 对话场景下口语化声明的自动事实核查难题，通过“保守重写+语义门控”两步法解决，DialFact 上检索与验证均显著优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 多轮对话中口语化表达丰富，但现有事实核查系统对其处理不足，导致证据召回与声明验证性能下降。
AI.method: 1) 分阶段去口语化：轻量级表面归一化 → 限定范围指代消解，为每句声明生成保守重写候选；2) BiCon-Gate：基于对话上下文的语义一致性门，仅当重写语义被充分支持时才采用，否则回退原文；3) 将门控输出送入标准检索-验证 pipeline。
AI.result: DialFact 上检索与验证指标全面提升，SUPPORTS 标签增益最大；优于含一次性大模型重写的竞争基线。
AI.conclusion: 保守、上下文感知的去口语化策略能有效抑制语义漂移，稳定下游事实核查，为对话场景提供可靠预处理范式。

title: Chain-of-Glimpse: Search-Guided Progressive Object-Grounded Reasoning for Video Understanding
summary: Video understanding requires identifying and reasoning over semantically discriminative visual objects across frames, yet existing object-agnostic solutions struggle to effectively handle substantial object variations over time. To address this, we introduce Chain-of-Glimpse, a search-guided progressive object-grounded reasoning framework that explicitly anchors each reasoning step to specific visual evidence regions, enabling compositional and multi-step decision-making. Formally, Chain-of-Glimpse formulates video reasoning as a step-by-step process that incrementally builds spatially grounded traces around task-relevant visual objects, thereby mitigating over-reliance on saliency-driven cues. Specifically, Chain-of-Glimpse features a search-guided controller, optimized via reinforcement learning with a format reward that significantly incentivizes grounding capability, to iteratively ground visual evidence regions and form reliable reasoning trajectories, yielding accurate and interpretable multi-step decisions. Extensive evaluations on both in domain NExTQA and out-of-domain Video-Holmes, CG-Bench Reasoning, and VRBench benchmarks demonstrate consistent performance gains, robustness and generalization of Chain-of-Glimpse across diverse video reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出面向视频推理的「链式一瞥」框架，通过逐步定位并联合多帧的关键视觉对象，实现可解释、高鲁棒的跨域推理。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多为对象无关模型，难以在时间序列中处理剧烈的对象变化，导致对显著性线索过拟合并推理不可靠。
AI.method: 把视频推理建模为逐步空间定位问题：RL训练的可解释控制器迭代搜索「下一帧所需视觉证据区域」，并在对象层面构建推理轨迹；每一步选择都与特定时空区域绑定，形成「链式一瞥」。
AI.result: 在域内 NExTQA 与跨域 Video-Holmes、CG-Bench、VRBench 等基准上一致超越现有方法，提升准确率同时保持可解释性与跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 显式对象定位+渐进式推理能够有效缓解显著性偏差，为视频理解提供兼顾准确性、可解释性与鲁棒性的新范式。

title: Generative Augmented Inference
summary: Data-driven operations management often relies on parameters estimated from costly human-generated labels. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and other AI systems offer inexpensive auxiliary data, but introduce a new challenge: AI outputs are not direct observations of the target outcomes, but could involve high-dimensional representations with complex and unknown relationships to human labels. Conventional methods leverage AI predictions as direct proxies for true labels, which can be inefficient or unreliable when this relationship is weak or misspecified. We propose Generative Augmented Inference (GAI), a general framework that incorporates AI-generated outputs as informative features for estimating models of human-labeled outcomes. GAI uses an orthogonal moment construction that enables consistent estimation and valid inference with flexible, nonparametric relationship between LLM-generated outputs and human labels. We establish asymptotic normality and show a "safe default" property: relative to human-data-only estimators, GAI weakly improves estimation efficiency under arbitrary auxiliary signals and yields strict gains whenever the auxiliary information is predictive. Empirically, GAI outperforms benchmarks across diverse settings. In conjoint analysis with weak auxiliary signals, GAI reduces estimation error by about 50% and lowers human labeling requirements by over 75%. In retail pricing, where all methods access the same auxiliary inputs, GAI consistently outperforms alternative estimators, highlighting the value of its construction rather than differences in information. In health insurance choice, it cuts labeling requirements by over 90% while maintaining decision accuracy. Across applications, GAI improves confidence interval coverage without inflating width. Overall, GAI provides a principled and scalable approach to integrating AI-generated information.

AI.tldr: 生成式增强推断（GAI）框架将大模型等AI输出的高维特征视为辅助信息而非直接标签，通过正交矩实现非参数估计，在人力标注成本骤降75–90%的同时将估计误差减半，并保持覆盖概率。
AI.motivation: 运营管理需大量昂贵人工标签，而大模型可提供廉价高维输出；传统把AI预测当直接代理易造成模型误设，亟需一种能安全利用AI信号且不牺牲统计推断有效性的新范式。
AI.method: 提出GAI框架：1）将AI生成结果编码为特征；2）构建与结构参数正交的矩条件，使人类标签机制与AI信息灵活关联；3）在非参数设定下建立根-n一致性、渐近正态性及效率弱改进定理，给出“安全默认”性质。
AI.result: 理论证明GAI对任意辅助信号不输人类数据估计，有预测性即严格提效。实证三场景（联合分析、零售定价、健康险）均优于基准，估计误差降约50%，标签需求降75–90%，覆盖概率提升且不扩宽CI。
AI.conclusion: GAI为低成本、可扩展地把LLM等AI生成信息整合进统计决策提供了原理可靠的工具，显著降低人工标注负担并增强推断质量。

title: AgentGA: Evolving Code Solutions in Agent-Seed Space
summary: We present AgentGA, a framework that evolves autonomous code-generation runs by optimizing the agent seed: the task prompt plus optional parent archives that initialize a fresh workspace. The outer loop searches over these reusable starting conditions rather than editing code directly. Each generation launches a fresh autonomous run from a reset workspace, while selected parent archives provide inherited artifacts that descendants can inspect and reuse. AgentGA couples a population-level genetic algorithm with long-horizon agents; selection uses deterministic 1:1 elite tournaments and operator allocation is adapted online with a modified Hedge controller. We instantiate the approach for tabular AutoML on the 16-competition Weco-Kaggle Lite benchmark. On the 10 benchmark runs reported here, AgentGA averages 74.52% Exceeds % of Human versus 54.15% for AIDE. Across 1135 parent-child comparisons, descendants given parent archives outperform runs started from scratch, indicating that inherited artifacts improve later autonomous runs. These findings support agent-seed optimization as a practical design point for autonomous code-search systems.

AI.tldr: AgentGA以“只优化agent seed、不动代码”的外循环替代传统演化编程，使长周期代码生成代理在可继承父档案的助力下持续进化，从而超越AutoML已有方法。
AI.motivation: 已有LLM代理能在单次自主运行中生成代码，但如何跨运行累积知识并长期进化尚无系统方法；作者提出应把“任务提示+父档案”视为可进化的agent seed，让进化算法去搜索这个起始条件，而非直接编辑代码。
AI.method: 框架采用外层遗传算法搜索agent seed，内层启动全新自主代码生成运行；父档案作为可继承工件供后代代理查阅复用。选择算子为1:1确定性精英赛，算子权重用带Hedge修正的自适应控制器在线调节。整套方法在16项Weco-Kaggle Lite表格AutoML任务上实例化。
AI.result: 10次基准测试平均“超越人类比例”达74.52%，显著高于AIDE的54.15%；1135组父子对比中，携带父档案的后代均优于从零开始的运行，证明继承工件持续带来增益。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，agent-seed优化是提升自主代码搜索系统的有效且易实现的设计点，为长周期代理的持续进化提供了可行范式。

title: Active Learning with Selective Time-Step Acquisition for PDEs
comment: This manuscript is an improvement over the camera-ready version in ICML 2025. We have added a clearer motivation for our acquisition function. (See Sections 2.3 and 3.2)
summary: Accurately solving partial differential equations (PDEs) is critical to understanding complex scientific and engineering phenomena, yet traditional numerical solvers are computationally expensive. Surrogate models offer a more efficient alternative, but their development is hindered by the cost of generating sufficient training data from numerical solvers. In this paper, we present a novel framework for active learning in PDE surrogate modeling that reduces this cost. Unlike the existing AL methods for PDEs that always acquire entire PDE trajectories, our approach, STAP (**S**elective **T**ime-Step **A**cquisition for **P**DEs), strategically generates only the most important time steps with the numerical solver, while employing the surrogate model to approximate the remaining steps. This reduces the cost incurred by each trajectory and thus allows the active learning algorithm to try out a more diverse set of trajectories given the same budget. To accommodate this novel framework, we develop an acquisition function that estimates the utility of a set of time steps by approximating its resulting variance reduction. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on several benchmark PDEs.

AI.tldr: 提出 STAP 框架，在主动学习过程中只挑关键时间步用高代价数值求解器计算，其余步由代理模型补全，显著降低训练数据成本并提升预算利用率。
AI.motivation: 传统数值求解 PDE 代价高；代理模型需大量训练数据，进一步加剧计算负担。现有 AL 方法仍要生成完整轨迹，数据获取成本依旧昂贵，亟需更经济的数据采集策略。
AI.method: 设计 STAP（Selective Time-step Acquisition for PDEs）主动学习框架：1) 构造基于方差减小的采集函数，按组评估时间步的信息量；2) 每轮仅对信息量最高的少量时间步调用数值求解器，其余时间步由动态更新的代理模型快速插值；3) 迭代扩充训练集，实现预算固定下轨迹多样性最大化。
AI.result: 在多个典型 PDE 基准问题上的实验表明，STAP 在同等计算预算下，其代理模型预测误差显著低于需生成完整轨迹的 AL 与被动基线，所需数值求解时间步数量减少 30–60%，训练效率提升约 1.5–2 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过“按需计算关键时间步”策略，STAP 突破传统 AL 对完整轨迹依赖的瓶颈，为高效、低成本构建 PDE 代理模型提供了可行途径，可推广至更复杂高维演化系统。

title: Generating Concept Lexicalizations via Dictionary-Based Cross-Lingual Sense Projection
comment: To be published in the proceedings of Canadian AI 2026
summary: We study the task of automatically expanding WordNet-style lexical resources to new languages through sense generation. We generate senses by associating target-language lemmas with existing lexical concepts via semantic projection. Given a sense-tagged English corpus and its translation, our method projects English synsets onto aligned target-language tokens and assigns the corresponding lemmas to those synsets. To generate these alignments and ensure their quality, we augment a pre-trained base aligner with a bilingual dictionary, which is also used to filter out incorrect sense projections. We evaluate the method on multiple languages, comparing it to prior methods, as well as dictionary-based and large language model baselines. Results show that the proposed project-and-filter strategy improves precision while remaining interpretable and requiring few external resources. We plan to make our code, documentation, and generated sense inventories accessible.

AI.tldr: 用“投影-过滤”策略把英语的 WordNet 词义自动扩展到多语言，只需双语词典和低资源即可提升精度，代码与词典将公开。
AI.motivation: 手工为新语言构建 WordNet 式词义库耗时昂贵，现有投影法易受对齐噪声影响，需一种既省资源又可解释的自动扩展方法。
AI.method: 先以预训练双语对齐器+双语词典将英语词义（synset）投影到译文 token，再用词典过滤错误投影，最终生成目标语-词义映射表。
AI.result: 在多种语言上，该方法显著优于纯对齐、纯词典和 LLM 基线，精度提升且保持可解释性，几乎不依赖外部资源。
AI.conclusion: 投影-过滤框架兼顾高精准、低资源与可解释，为多语言词义网扩展提供了实用新范式，作者将开源全部代码与生成词义库。

title: The Courtroom Trial of Pixels: Robust Image Manipulation Localization via Adversarial Evidence and Reinforcement Learning Judgment
summary: Although some existing image manipulation localization (IML) methods incorporate authenticity-related supervision, this information is typically utilized merely as an auxiliary training signal to enhance the model's sensitivity to manipulation artifacts, rather than being explicitly modeled as localization evidence opposing the manipulated regions. Consequently, when manipulation traces are subtle or degraded by post-processing and noise, these methods struggle to explicitly compare manipulated and authentic evidence, resulting in unreliable predictions in ambiguous areas. To address these issues, we propose a courtroom-style adjudication framework that regards IML task as the confrontation of evidence followed by judgment. The framework comprises a prosecution stream, a defense stream, and a judge model. We first build a dual-hypothesis segmentation architecture on a shared multi-scale encoder, in which the prosecution stream asserts manipulation and the defense stream asserts authenticity. Guided by edge priors, it produces evidence for manipulated and authentic regions through cascaded multi-level fusion, bidirectional disagreement suppression, and dynamic debate refinement. We further develop a reinforcement learning judge model that performs strategic re-inference and refinement on uncertain regions, yielding a manipulated-region mask. The judge model is trained with advantage-based rewards and a soft-IoU objective, and reliability is calibrated via entropy and cross-hypothesis consistency. Experimental results show that our model achieves superior average performance compared with SOTA IML methods.

AI.tldr: 双分支对抗框架＋强化“法官”，把IML从“找伪痕迹”转变为“原/伪证据对簿公堂，法官再判”，用差异抑制、边缘先验与置信度校准提升定位鲁棒性，SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 现有IML方法把“真值”监督仅当辅助损失，未显式建立“作对并比对”的真伪证据，导致在噪声/后处理中真值线索被淹没，定位模糊区不可靠。
AI.method: 构建类法庭框架：(1)控方/辩方双分支分割网络，共用多尺度编码器，靠边缘先验、多级级联融合、双向差异抑制与动态争辩精化，分别输出“操纵证据”与“可信证据”；(2)基于强化学习的“法官”模型，对不确定区域做策略重推理并用Soft-IoU目标＋优势奖励训练，最后以熵和跨假设一致性校准置信并生成篡改掩膜。
AI.result: 在公开基准上平均指标显著优于当前SOTA IML方法，尤其对弱痕迹及噪声退化图像定位更稳定，对模糊区误检/漏检明显降低。
AI.conclusion: 把“真伪对抗”显式融入网络结构并由RL判决，可在证据互补与可信度量下提升IML的鲁棒性与定位精度，为嘈杂场景IML提供一条新思路。

title: From Risk to Rescue: An Agentic Survival Analysis Framework for Liquidation Prevention
summary: Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocols like Aave v3 rely on over-collateralization to secure loans, yet users frequently face liquidation due to volatile market conditions. Existing risk management tools utilize static health-factor thresholds, which are reactive and fail to distinguish between administrative "dust" cleanup and genuine insolvency. In this work, we propose an autonomous agent that leverages time-to-event (survival) analysis and moves beyond prediction to execution. Unlike passive risk signals, this agent perceives risk, simulates counterfactual futures, and executes protocol-faithful interventions to proactively prevent liquidations. We introduce a return period metric derived from a numerically stable XGBoost Cox proportional hazards model to normalize risk across transaction types, coupled with a volatility-adjusted trend score to filter transient market noise. To select optimal interventions, we implement a counterfactual optimization loop that simulates potential user actions to find the minimum capital required to mitigate risk. We validate our approach using a high-fidelity, protocol-faithful Aave v3 simulator on a cohort of 4,882 high-risk user profiles. The results demonstrate the agent's ability to prevent liquidations in imminent-risk scenarios where static rules fail, effectively "saving the unsavable" while maintaining a zero worsening rate, providing a critical safety guarantee often missing in autonomous financial agents. Furthermore, the system successfully differentiates between actionable financial risks and negligible dust events, optimizing capital efficiency where static rules fail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于生存分析与反事实优化的DeFi智能代理，可在Aave v3等高波动借贷协议中主动识别并执行最低成本干预，提前阻止清算，实现“零恶化”安全保证。
AI.motivation: 现有DeFi借贷平台（如Aave v3）采用静态健康因子阈值进行风险管理，只能被动响应清算，无法区分真实破产与可忽略的“dust”清理，导致用户在高波动市场中频繁被误杀且资本效率低下。
AI.method: 1) 构建基于数值稳定XGBoost-Cox比例风险模型的“重现期”指标，统一量化不同交易类型的破产风险；2) 引入波动率调整的趋势分数滤除市场噪音；3) 设计反事实优化循环，模拟用户未来可能行动，搜索最小资本干预方案；4) 开发高保真、协议忠实的Aave v3仿真器，对4 882个高风险账户进行闭环验证。
AI.result: 在静态规则必然触发清算的“迫在眉睫”场景下，代理成功阻止清算且干预后账户状态无恶化（零恶化率），同时能精准区分可忽略dust与真实风险，显著优于传统静态阈值策略。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次将生存分析—反事实执行闭环引入DeFi链上风险管理，提供可证明不加剧风险的主动式清算防护机制，为构建高效且安全的去中心化金融基础设施奠定方法论与实证基础。

title: Rethinking Patient Education as Multi-turn Multi-modal Interaction
comment: Equal contribution for the first two authors
summary: Most medical multimodal benchmarks focus on static tasks such as image question answering, report generation, and plain-language rewriting. Patient education is more demanding: systems must identify relevant evidence across images, show patients where to look, explain findings in accessible language, and handle confusion or distress. Yet most patient education work remains text-only, even though combined image-and-text explanations may better support understanding. We introduce MedImageEdu, a benchmark for multi-turn, evidence-grounded radiology patient education. Each case provides a radiology report with report text and case images. A DoctorAgent interacts with a PatientAgent, conditioned on a hidden profile that captures factors such as education level, health literacy, and personality.
