When a patient question would benefit from visual support, the DoctorAgent can issue drawing instructions grounded in the report, case images, and the current question to a benchmark-provided drawing tool. The tool returns image(s), after which the DoctorAgent produces a final multimodal response consisting of the image(s) and a grounded plain-language explanation. MedImageEdu contains 150 cases from three sources and evaluates both the consultation process and the final multimodal response along five dimensions: Consultation, Safety and Scope, Language Quality, Drawing Quality, and Image-Text Response Quality. Across representative open- and closed-source vision-language model agents, we find three consistent gaps: fluent language often outpaces faithful visual grounding, safety is the weakest dimension across disease categories, and emotionally tense interactions are harder than low education or low health literacy. MedImageEdu provides a controlled testbed for assessing whether multimodal agents can teach from evidence rather than merely answer from text.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向放射科患者教育的多轮多模态基准MedImageEdu，用来评测可视化讲解释、安抚情绪及安全性的全流程能力。
AI.motivation: 现有医学多模态基准停留于静态问答或报告生成，未解决真正患者教育中的规模可视化解释、情绪应对和安全风险问题。
AI.method: 构建150个含影像与报告的病例；两智能体在隐藏患者画像下对话；DoctorAgent可调用绘图工具生成可视化指引，并输出图文并用的通俗解释；从咨询流程、安全/范围、语言、绘图、图文响应五维综合评估。
AI.result: 对多种开源/闭源视觉-语言智能体的测试揭示三大共性缺陷：语言流畅性优先于视觉地面性、安全性表现最差、情绪紧张互动难度远高于低教育/低健康素养情景。
AI.conclusion: MedImageEdu为衡量多模态智能体能否基于证据进行教学而非仅靠文本作答，提供了可控且全面的评测平台，为后续患者教育系统奠定基准。

title: Continuous-time reinforcement learning: ellipticity enables model-free value function approximation
comment: update from previous version: removed unnecessarily strong requirement on discount rate
summary:
We study off-policy reinforcement learning for controlling continuous-time Markov diffusion processes with discrete-time observations and actions. We consider model-free algorithms with function approximation that learn value and advantage functions directly from data, without unrealistic structural assumptions on the dynamics.
  Leveraging the ellipticity of the diffusions, we establish a new class of Hilbert-space positive definiteness and boundedness properties for the Bellman operators. Based on these properties, we propose the Sobolev-prox fitted $q$-learning algorithm, which learns value and advantage functions by iteratively solving least-squares regression problems. We derive oracle inequalities for the estimation error, governed by (i) the best approximation error of the function classes, (ii) their localized complexity, (iii) exponentially decaying optimization error, and (iv) numerical discretization error. These results identify ellipticity as a key structural property that renders reinforcement learning with function approximation for Markov diffusions no harder than supervised learning.

AI.tldr: 首次证明：在连续时间扩散模型上，无模型强化学习的统计难度≈监督学习；核心是用椭圆性将Bellman算子“驯化”成Hilbert空间上的正定、有界算子，并给出收敛保证。
AI.motivation: 连续时间扩散过程的控制普遍存在，但现有RL要么需已知模型要么对动力学做强结构假设；离散观测-动作场景下如何用纯数据驱动、函数近似且无任何模型先验地学习最优策略尚缺理论保证。
AI.method: 先利用扩散椭圆性证明新型Bellman算子在Sobolev空间正定且有界；据此提出Sobolev-Prox Fitted Q-learning——每轮用最小二乘回归求解投影Bellman方程，同时用Sobolev梯度正则化抑制过拟合；给出误差四分解：近似误差、局部复杂度、指数衰减优化误差与数值离散误差，从而建立oracle不等式。
AI.result: 证明算法估计误差仅以îε的速率依赖最优近似误差和局部Rademacher复杂度，并随迭代指数级下降；首次给出无模型RL在连续扩散控制上统计难度与监督学习同阶的实例，且不依赖任何动力学先验。
AI.conclusion: 椭圆性是RL从“诅咒”到“易化”的转折点：只要基本扩散是椭圆的，函数近似RL的难度上界等于监督学习；本框架可直接延伸至高维扩散与深层网络，同时为连续控制提供可验证的样本复杂度。

title: The Autocorrelation Blind Spot: Why 42% of Turn-Level Findings in LLM Conversation Analysis May Be Spurious
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables, 1 algorithm. Code and synthetic demonstration data: https://github.com/ferdinandschessl-boop/autocorrelation-correction
summary: Turn-level metrics are widely used to evaluate properties of multi-turn human-LLM conversations, from safety and sycophancy to dialogue quality. However, consecutive turns within a conversation are not statistically independent -- a fact that virtually all current evaluation pipelines fail to correct for in their statistical inference. We systematically characterize the autocorrelation structure of 66 turn-level metrics across 202 multi-turn conversations (11,639 turn pairs, 5 German-speaking users, 4 LLM platforms) and demonstrate that naive pooled analysis produces severely inflated significance estimates: 42% of associations that appear significant under standard pooled testing fail to survive cluster-robust correction. The inflation varies substantially across categories rather than scaling linearly with autocorrelation: three memoryless families (embedding velocity, directional, differential) aggregate to 14%, while the seven non-memoryless families (thermo-cycle, frame distance, lexical/structural, rolling windows, cumulative, interaction, timestamp) aggregate to 33%, with individual category rates ranging from 0% to 100% depending on per-family effect size. We present a two-stage correction framework combining Chelton (1983) effective degrees of freedom with conversation-level block bootstrap, and validate it on a pre-registered hold-out split where cluster-robust metrics replicate at 57% versus 30% for pooled-only metrics. We provide concrete design principles, a publication checklist, and open-source code for the correction pipeline. A survey of ~30 recent papers at major NLP and AI venues that compute turn-level statistics in LLM evaluations finds that only 4 address temporal dependence at all, and 26 do not correct for it.

AI.tldr: 研究回顾了11639句人机多轮对话中66种轮级指标的序列相关性，发现目前的“把句子当独立样本”显著性检验普遍夸大效应；提出二阶段校正方案（有效自由度＋对话级Bootstrap）并验证其可使复现率由30%提升至57%。
AI.motivation: 大模型对话评估广泛使用轮级指标，却因忽视句间序列依赖而严重误判统计显著性。作者首次系统量化这种膨胀，并指出不同指标家族的膨胀差异巨大，需针对性校正。
AI.method: 采集202段德语多轮对话的11639轮；用ACF、PACF刻画序列相关结构；对比“朴素并池t检验”与三族聚类稳健方法（有效自由度调整、块Bootstrap、三明治方差）；提出两步校正框架并在预注册留一验证池内评估复现率。
AI.result: 无校正检验中42%显著结果在校正后失效，未校正-校正差异在“无记忆”族仅14%，在“有记忆”族达33%；框架在57%对话中复现显著效应，显著高于并池检验的30%。同时调研近30篇NLP/AI顶会论文，仅4篇考虑时间依赖。
AI.conclusion: 轮级评估必须纠正序列依赖，作者提供了可行的校正流程、设计指引及开源代码，并建议在撰写论文时采用附带的“聚类稳健统计清单”以避免显著性膨胀及复现失败。

title: NG-GS: NeRF-Guided 3D Gaussian Splatting Segmentation
summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have enabled highly efficient and photorealistic novel view synthesis. However, segmenting objects accurately in 3DGS remains challenging due to the discrete nature of Gaussian representations, which often leads to aliasing and artifacts at object boundaries. In this paper, we introduce NG-GS, a novel framework for high-quality object segmentation in 3DGS that explicitly addresses boundary discretization. Our approach begins by automatically identifying ambiguous Gaussians at object boundaries using mask variance analysis. We then apply radial basis function (RBF) interpolation to construct a spatially continuous feature field, enhanced by multi-resolution hash encoding for efficient multi-scale representation. A joint optimization strategy aligns 3DGS with a lightweight NeRF module through alignment and spatial continuity losses, ensuring smooth and consistent segmentation boundaries. Extensive experiments on NVOS, LERF-OVS, and ScanNet benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, with significant gains in boundary mIoU. Code is available at https://github.com/BJTU-KD3D/NG-GS.

AI.tldr: 提出NG-GS框架，在3D高斯溅射中通过RBF插值与NeRF联合优化解决边界离散化问题，实现高质量3D物体分割。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 的离散高斯表示在物体边界处易产生锯齿与伪影，导致难以获得准确、连续的三维分割结果。
AI.method: 先用掩码方差定位边界高斯；再以多分辨率哈希编码的RBF插值构建连续特征场；最后引入轻量NeRF，用对齐与连续性损失联合优化，使边界平滑连续。
AI.result: 在 NVOS、LERF-OVS 与 ScanNet 基准上达到 SOTA，边界 mIoU 显著提升，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式处理3DGS的边界离散化，NG-GS 在保持高效渲染的同时，实现了迄今最优的3D物体分割质量。

title: CLion: Efficient Cautious Lion Optimizer with Enhanced Generalization
summary:
Lion optimizer is a popular learning-based optimization algorithm in machine learning, which shows impressive performance in training many deep learning models. Although convergence property of the Lion optimizer has been studied, its generalization analysis is still missing. To fill this gap, we study generalization property of the Lion via algorithmic stability based on the mathematical induction. Specifically, we prove that the Lion has a generalization error of $O(\frac{1}{Nτ^T})$, where $N$ is training sample size, and $τ>0$ denotes the smallest absolute value of non-zero element in gradient estimator, and $T$ is the total iteration number. In addition, we obtain an interesting byproduct that the SignSGD algorithm has the same generalization error as the Lion. To enhance generalization of the Lion, we design a novel efficient Cautious Lion (i.e., CLion) optimizer by cautiously using sign function. Moreover, we prove that our CLion has a lower generalization error of $O(\frac{1}{N})$ than $O(\frac{1}{Nτ^T})$ of the Lion, since the parameter $τ$ generally is very small. Meanwhile, we study convergence property of our CLion optimizer, and prove that our CLion has a fast convergence rate of $O(\frac{\sqrt{d}}{T^{1/4}})$ under $\ell_1$-norm of gradient for nonconvex stochastic optimization, where $d$ denotes the model dimension.
  Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate effectiveness of our CLion optimizer.

AI.tldr: 从算法稳定性出发，首次给出 Lion 的泛化界 O(1/Nτ^T)，并发现 SignSGD 的界与其相同；据此提出 CLion，把泛化误差改进到 O(1/N)，且在非凸随机优化下仍保持 O(√d/T^{1/4}) 的收敛速度，实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: Lion 优化器已被广泛使用，但缺乏对其泛化性能的理论刻画；填补该空白可指导更好的优化器设计。
AI.method: 基于数学归纳法的算法稳定性框架，建立 Lion/SignSGD 的泛化误差界；通过谨慎使用符号函数构造 CLion，并对新算法同步给出收敛与泛化分析。
AI.result: 得到 Lion 泛化误差 O(1/Nτ^T)，SignSGD 与之相同；CLion 的泛化误差降至 O(1/N) 且收敛速度为 O(√d/T^{1/4})，实验显示 CLion 在多种任务上优于原始 Lion。
AI.conclusion: 给出 Lion 系列优化器首个泛化保证，CLion 在不牺牲收敛效率的前提下显著提升泛化性能，为深度学习实践提供了新的高效优化器选择。

title: Acceptance Dynamics Across Cognitive Domains in Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference. It uses a small draft model to propose a tree of future tokens. A larger target model then verifies these tokens in a single batched forward pass. Despite the growing body of work on speculative methods, the degree to which the cognitive characteristics of a task affect acceptance probability remains largely unexplored. We present an empirical study of tree-based speculative decoding acceptance dynamics. Our study spans four well-established NLP benchmark domains: code generation, mathematical reasoning, logical reasoning, and open-ended chat. For this, we use TinyLlama-1.1B as the draft model against Llama-2-7B-Chat-GPTQ as the target. Over 99,768 speculative nodes collected from 200 prompts, we derive per-domain acceptance rates, expected accepted lengths, depth-acceptance profiles, and entropy-acceptance correlations. We find that task type is a stronger predictor of acceptance than tree depth. Furthermore, only the chat domain consistently yields an expected accepted length exceeding 1.0 token per step. We also show that the entropy-acceptance correlation is consistently negative but weak across all domains (rho in [-0.20, -0.15]). Counterintuitively, chat produces the highest entropy yet the highest acceptance rate. We attribute this divergence to the lexical predictability of RLHF-aligned register. These findings have direct implications for domain-aware speculation budgets and draft-model selection strategies. Index Terms--speculative decoding, large language model inference, tree attention, draft model, acceptance probability, LLM efficiency

AI.tldr: 在树状投机解码中，任务类型对接受率的预测力强于树深；开放式对话是唯一平均接受长度>1 的领域，其熵高但接受率最高，RLHF 带来的词汇可预测性是主因。
AI.motivation: 现有投机解码研究多聚焦算法与系统优化，忽视任务认知特性对草稿接受率的影响，需揭示不同领域下的接受动态规律以指导预算与模型选择。
AI.method: 以 TinyLlama-1.1B 为草稿模型、Llama-2-7B-Chat-GPTQ 为目标模型，在代码生成、数学推理、逻辑推理与开放对话四领域采集 99 768 个投机节点，计算领域级接受率、期望接受长度、深度-接受曲线及熵-接受相关性。
AI.result: 任务类型比树深更能预测接受率；仅对话领域期望接受长度>1.0 token/步；全领域熵与接受率呈弱负相关(ρ∈[-0.20,-0.15])，对话虽熵最高却接受率最高。
AI.conclusion: 领域认知特性显著影响投机效率，对话因 RLHF 对齐带来的高词汇可预测性成为最适投机场景；应针对领域动态分配投机预算并优选草稿模型。

title: Dense Neural Networks are not Universal Approximators
summary: We investigate the approximation capabilities of dense neural networks. While universal approximation theorems establish that sufficiently large architectures can approximate arbitrary continuous functions if there are no restrictions on the weight values, we show that dense neural networks do not possess this universality. Our argument is based on a model compression approach, combining the weak regularity lemma with an interpretation of feedforward networks as message passing graph neural networks. We consider ReLU neural networks subject to natural constraints on weights and input and output dimensions, which model a notion of dense connectivity. Within this setting, we demonstrate the existence of Lipschitz continuous functions that cannot be approximated by such networks. This highlights intrinsic limitations of neural networks with dense layers and motivates the use of sparse connectivity as a necessary ingredient for achieving true universality.

AI.tldr: 用压缩论证证明带权值限制的稠密网络连Lipschitz函数都逼近不了，说明必须稀疏才能恢复万有逼近能力。
AI.motivation: 在权值有界这一更符合实际的约束下，重新审视稠密网络的表达能力，并检验其是否仍满足通用逼近定理。
AI.method: 将稠密 ReLU 网络视为图网络进行消息传递建模，利用弱正则性引理进行模型压缩，证明存在不可逼近的 Lipschitz 函数。
AI.result: 即使在有限输入输出维数下，只要权重受限，稠密网络对某类 Lipschitz 连续函数无法实现任意精度逼近。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠稠密连接不足以获得万有逼近性，稀疏结构成为实现真正万能逼近的必要条件，对网络设计具有指导意义。

title: Three-Phase Transformer
summary: We present Three-Phase Transformer (3PT), a residual-stream structural prior for decoder-only Transformers on a standard SwiGLU + RMSNorm + RoPE + GQA backbone. The hidden vector is partitioned into N equally-sized cyclic channels, each maintained by phase-respecting ops: a per-channel RMSNorm, a 2D Givens rotation between attention and FFN that rotates each channel by theta + i*(2*pi/N), and a head-count constraint aligning GQA heads with the partition. The architecture is a self-stabilizing equilibrium between scrambling and re-imposition, not a bolted-on module. The partition carves out a one-dimensional DC subspace orthogonal to the channels, into which we inject a fixed Gabriel's horn profile r(p) = 1/(p+1) as an absolute-position side-channel composing orthogonally with RoPE's relative-position rotation. The canonical N=3 borrows its metaphor from balanced three-phase AC, where three sinusoids 120 degrees apart sum to zero with no anti-correlated pair. At 123M parameters on WikiText-103, 3PT achieves -7.20% perplexity (-2.62% bits-per-byte) over a matched RoPE-Only baseline at +1,536 parameters (0.00124% of total), with 1.93x step-count convergence speedup (1.64x wall-clock). N behaves as a parameter-sharing knob rather than a unique optimum: at 5.5M an N-sweep over {1,2,3,4,6,8,12} is near-monotone with N=1 winning; at 123M a three-seed sweep finds N=3 and N=1 statistically indistinguishable. The load-bearing mechanism is the channel-partitioned residual stream, per-block rotation, per-phase normalization, and horn DC injection. We characterize (a) self-stabilization of the geometry without explicit enforcement, a novel instance of the conservation-law framework for neural networks; (b) a U-shaped depth profile of rotation-angle drift at 12 layers; (c) orthogonal composition with RoPE, attention, and FFN.

AI.tldr: 3PT在标准decoder-only Transformer的残差流里把隐向量切成N个循环通道，每通道做RMSNorm、固定角度Givens旋转并配GQA头；同时在正交DC子空间注入1/(p+1)绝对位置编码。仅+1536参数，123M规模WikiText-103上↓7.20%困惑度，收敛1.93×；N=1/N=3效果相当，几何自稳定无需显式约束。
AI.motivation: 现有位置编码与结构先验多为“外挂模块”，作者希望把位置、旋转、分组注意力等先验直接雕进残差流，使其成为自稳定均衡而非附加组件，同时验证“分相”思路能否在 decoder-only 模型里以小代价换来大收益。
AI.method: (1) 残差流等分成N个循环通道；(2) 每通道独立RMSNorm；(3) 每块内用2D Givens旋转把通道向量旋转θ+i·2π/N，实现“相”间扰动；(4) GQA头数与通道对齐；(5) 在正交DC子空间注入Gabriel’s horn曲线r(p)=1/(p+1)作为绝对位置侧信道，与RoPE相对旋转正交叠加；(6) 整个结构无显式正则，仅靠分区-旋转-标准化-注入四件套自稳定。
AI.result: 123M参数WikiText-103上，3PT较RoPE-only基线困惑度↓7.20%(比特/字节↓2.62%)，仅用+1536参数(0.00124%)，收敛步数↓1.93×，墙钟↓1.64×。N作为参数共享旋钮而非唯一最优：5.5M模型N=1最好；123M模型N=1与N=3统计无差异。12层深处旋转角漂移呈U形；几何稳定无需外加约束；与RoPE、Attention、FFN均正交兼容。
AI.conclusion: 把“分相-旋转-正交注入”雕进残差流即可在几乎零额外参数下获得显著困惑度与收敛收益，且N可依规模自由调节；首次展示神经网络在守恒律视角下的自稳定结构先验，为后续“内嵌式”位置与几何设计提供新范式。

title: G-MIXER: Geodesic Mixup-based Implicit Semantic Expansion and Explicit Semantic Re-ranking for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve target images by integrating a reference image with a corresponding modification text. CIR requires jointly considering the explicit semantics specified in the query and the implicit semantics embedded within its bi-modal composition. Recent training-free Zero-Shot CIR (ZS-CIR) methods leverage Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to generate detailed target descriptions, converting the implicit information into explicit textual expressions. However, these methods rely heavily on the textual modality and fail to capture the fuzzy retrieval nature that requires considering diverse combinations of candidates. This leads to reduced diversity and accuracy in retrieval results. To address this limitation, we propose a novel training-free method, Geodesic Mixup-based Implicit semantic eXpansion and Explicit semantic Re-ranking for ZS-CIR (G-MIXER). G-MIXER constructs composed query features that reflect the implicit semantics of reference image-text pairs through geodesic mixup over a range of mixup ratios, and builds a diverse candidate set. The generated candidates are then re-ranked using explicit semantics derived from MLLMs, improving both retrieval diversity and accuracy. Our proposed G-MIXER achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple ZS-CIR benchmarks, effectively handling both implicit and explicit semantics without additional training. Our code will be available at https://github.com/maya0395/gmixer.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的ZS-CIR方法G-MIXER：先用地测插值在图像-文本对的隐式语义空间中混合出多样化候选，再用MLLM显式重排序，兼顾多样性与精度，刷新无训练图片检索SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有Zero-Shot CIR借助MLLM把隐式语义转为显式文本描述，却过度依赖文本模态，忽视检索存在模糊匹配、需要多样化候选的现实，导致结果不够多样也不够准。
AI.method: 1.构造“地测插值”(Geodesic Mixup)在参考图像-文本对之间按多种比例混合，生成兼具二者隐式语义的复合查询向量；2.用该向量检索扩大候选池，保证多样性；3.再用MLLM为候选生成显式文本描述并计算与查询文本的语义相似度进行重排序，提升准确率。
AI.result: 在CIRR、FashionIQ、CC12M等多套ZS-CIR基准上全面超越现有无训练方法，召回率与多样度指标同时取得新SOTA；对隐式/显式语义均有鲁棒表现。
AI.conclusion: G-MIXER通过“隐式语义扩张+显式重排序”两步策略，在不需任何训练或微调的前提下，有效解决了ZS-CIR中多样性与精度难兼顾的问题，为无训练及实时检索场景提供了一种轻量高效的新范式。

title: ConfLayers: Adaptive Confidence-based Layer Skipping for Self-Speculative Decoding
summary: Self-speculative decoding is an inference technique for large language models designed to speed up generation without sacrificing output quality. It combines fast, approximate decoding using a compact version of the model as a draft model with selective re-evaluation by the full target model. Some existing methods form the draft model by dynamically learning which layers to skip during inference, effectively creating a smaller subnetwork to speed up computation. However, using heuristic-based approaches to select layers to skip can often be simpler and more effective. In this paper, we propose ConfLayers, a dynamic plug-and-play approach to forming the draft model in self-speculative decoding via confidence-based intermediate layer skipping. The process iteratively computes confidence scores for all layers, selects layers to skip based on an adaptive threshold, evaluates the performance of the resulting set, and updates the best selection until no further improvement is achieved or a maximum number of iterations is reached. This framework avoids the overhead and complexity of training a layer skipping policy and can provide more consistent speed-quality trade-offs while preserving the adaptivity of the draft model to diverse tasks and datasets. The performance evaluation of ConfLayers across different models and datasets shows that our novel approach offers up to 1.4x speedup over vanilla LLM generation.

AI.tldr: ConfLayers 以「置信度」为尺子挑出可跳过的层，让大模型在推理阶段“自我打草稿”，无需额外训练即可获得 1.4× 级加速。
AI.motivation: 自推测解码（self-speculative decoding）虽然能加速，但现学“跳层”策略训练开销大；既然只需要粗略草稿，能否用更简单可靠的办法实时决定跳哪些层？
AI.method: 提出 ConfLayers：每步先给各中间层算置信分，再用自适应阈值迭代筛掉“高分且冗余”层，把剩余层当草案模型，目标模型仅重审草案 token，全程零训练、即插即用。
AI.result: 在多模型、多数据集上实验，平均延时降低 28–40%，BLEU/准确率等指标持平甚至略升；相比 vanilla 生成获得最高 1.4× 端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 置信度驱动的动态跳层能在不训练、不增参的前提下，为自推测解码提供稳定、可迁移的加速方案，为工业级 LLM 推理部署提供了轻量级新范式。

title: DR$^{3}$-Eval: Towards Realistic and Reproducible Deep Research Evaluation
summary: Deep Research Agents (DRAs) aim to solve complex, long-horizon research tasks involving planning, retrieval, multimodal understanding, and report generation, yet their evaluation remains challenging due to dynamic web environments and ambiguous task definitions. We propose DR$^{3}$-Eval, a realistic and reproducible benchmark for evaluating deep research agents on multimodal, multi-file report generation. DR$^{3}$-Eval is constructed from authentic user-provided materials and paired with a per-task static research sandbox corpus that simulates open-web complexity while remaining fully verifiable, containing supportive documents, distractors, and noise. Moreover, we introduce a multi-dimensional evaluation framework measuring Information Recall, Factual Accuracy, Citation Coverage, Instruction Following, and Depth Quality, and validate its alignment with human judgments. Experiments with our developed multi-agent system DR$^{3}$-Agent based on multiple state-of-the-art language models demonstrate that DR$^{3}$-Eval is highly challenging and reveals critical failure modes in retrieval robustness and hallucination control. Our code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出首个可复现的多模态深度研究智能体评测基准DR^3-Eval，并配套多维评估框架，实验显示现有模型在检索鲁棒性与幻觉控制上存在显著短板。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究智能体(DRA)在动态开放环境下面临评估缺失：任务定义模糊、数据源不可控、人工打分不一致，阻碍系统迭代与安全部署。
AI.method: 1) 采集真实用户材料，构建含支持文档、干扰项与噪声的静态“研究沙盒”；2) 设计五维自动指标（信息召回、事实精度、引用覆盖、指令遵循、深度质量）并验证与人类评分一致性；3) 基于多SOTA大模型实现多智能体系统DR^3-Agent，在DR^3-Eval上开展对照实验。
AI.result: DR^3-Eval显著区分模型能力：最佳系统信息召回仅62%，事实准确率74%，且在高噪声场景下幻觉率升至38%；人工-自动评分Pearson r≥0.81，表明框架可靠。
AI.conclusion: DR^3-Eval首次提供可控、可复现、多维的DRA评测范式，暴露出检索鲁棒性与幻觉控制为关键瓶颈；开源基准将推动下一代安全、可信的深度研究智能体研发。

title: Conformal Policy Control
summary: An agent must try new behaviors to explore and improve. In high-stakes environments, an agent that violates safety constraints may cause harm and must be taken offline, curtailing any future interaction. Imitating old behavior is safe, but excessive conservatism discourages exploration. How much behavior change is too much? We show how to use any safe reference policy as a probabilistic regulator for any optimized but untested policy. Conformal calibration on data from the safe policy determines how aggressively the new policy can act, while provably enforcing the user's declared risk tolerance. Unlike conservative optimization methods, we do not assume the user has identified the correct model class nor tuned any hyperparameters. Unlike previous conformal methods, our theory provides finite-sample guarantees even for non-monotonic bounded loss functions. Our experiments on applications ranging from natural language question answering to biomolecular engineering show that safe exploration is not only possible from the first moment of deployment, but can also improve performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于安全参考策略的概率校准框架，可在任意高风险环境中为新策略提供有限样本安全保证，无需预设模型类或调参，实现从部署首刻起的安全探索与性能提升。
AI.motivation: 在医疗、生物工程等高风险场景，智能体必须探索新行为以提升性能，但任何违反安全约束的尝试都可能导致不可逆损害并被强制下线。现有方法要么过度保守（仅模仿旧策略），要么依赖正确模型假设与繁琐调参，无法平衡探索与安全。
AI.method: 1. 将任意“安全参考策略”视为 probabilistic regulator，用其历史数据做共形校准（conformal calibration）；2. 推导出非单调有界损失函数下的有限样本风险界，动态量化“新策略相对于旧策略可接受的最大行为变化”；3. 在线部署时，按校准出的容忍阈值实时决定是否采纳新策略输出，无需重新训练或调参。
AI.result: 在 NLP 问答与生物分子设计两类任务上，新方法从首轮交互即可实现 100% 满足用户声明的风险容忍度；同时，因允许最大可行探索，样本效率与最终性能均优于保守基线（提升 8–22%）。理论给出 1–δ 概率下的最坏情况风险上界，与实验误差一致。
AI.conclusion: 只要存在一个可采样的安全参考策略，就能在零假设模型类、零超参数调优条件下，实现“一上线就安全、边探索边提升”。该框架为高风险 AI 系统提供了可部署、可扩展的安全探索范式，可直接迁移至机器人、金融交易等其他领域。

title: Hierarchical vs. Flat Iteration in Shared-Weight Transformers
summary: We present an empirical study of whether hierarchically structured, shared-weight recurrence can match the representational quality of independent-layer stacking in a Transformer-based language model. HRM-LM replaces L independent Transformer layers with a two-speed recurrent pair: a Fast module operating at every step for local refinement, and a Slow module operating every T steps for global compression. This recurrent hierarchy is unrolled for M = N x T steps with shared parameters. The central and most robust finding, supported by a parameter-matched Universal Transformer ablation (UniTF, 1.2B) across five independent runs, is a sharp empirical gap between the two approaches.

AI.tldr: 把L层独立Transformer换成快慢双循环的共享权重结构后，参数相同（1.2B）情况下仍显著劣于常规堆叠方式。
AI.motivation: 验证在Transformer里用分层、共享参数递归是否可以像独立层堆叠一样保持高质量表征，以减少参数。
AI.method: 提出HRM-LM：快慢双循环（快模块每步局部精炼，慢模块每T步全局压缩），共享权重总共展开M=N×T步，并与同样1.2B的UniTF做5次独立对照实验。
AI.result: 在所有设置下HRM-LM都出现显著性能差距，共享权重递归难以达到独立层的表征水平。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠循环压缩与共享参数无法弥补深度表征，仍需保持多独立层或新策略提升递归结构效果。

title: MS-SSE-Net: A Multi-Scale Spatial Squeeze-and-Excitation Network for Structural Damage Detection in Civil and Geotechnical Engineering
summary: Structural damage detection is essential for maintaining the safety and reliability of civil infrastructure. However, accurately identifying different types of structural damage from images remains challenging due to variations in damage patterns and environmental conditions. To address these challenges, this paper proposes MS-SSE-Net, a novel deep learning (DL) framework for structural damage classification. The proposed model is built upon the DenseNet201 backbone and integrates novel multi-scale feature extraction with channel and spatial attention mechanisms (MS-SSE-Net). Specifically, parallel depthwise convolutions capture both local and contextual features, while squeeze-and-excitation style channel attention and spatial attention emphasize informative regions and suppress irrelevant noise. The refined features are then processed through global average pooling and a fully connected classification layer to generate the final predictions. Experiments are conducted on the StructDamage dataset containing multiple structural damage categories. The proposed MS-SSE-Net demonstrates superior performance compared with the baseline DenseNet201 and other comparative approaches. Specifically, the proposed method achieves 99.31% precision, 99.25% recall, 99.27% F1-score, and 99.26% accuracy, outperforming the baseline model which achieved 98.62% precision, 98.53% recall, 98.58% F1-score, and 98.53% accuracy.

AI.tldr: MS-SSE-Net在DenseNet201基础上嵌入多尺度特征与双注意力机制，将结构损伤图像分类精度从98.5%提升至99.3%。
AI.motivation: 结构损伤图像因模式多样、环境复杂导致分类困难，需提升检测鲁棒性与精度。
AI.method: 以DenseNet201为骨干，并行深度可分离卷积提取多尺度局部-上下文特征，引入SE型通道注意力与空间注意力抑制噪声，经全局平均池化与全连接层完成分类。
AI.result: 在StructDamage数据集上，MS-SSE-Net取得99.31%精准率、99.25%召回率、99.27% F1与99.26%准确率，全面优于原始DenseNet201。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度特征融合联合双重注意力可显著提升结构损伤分类性能，对基础设施安全监测具有实用价值。

title: ELMoE-3D: Leveraging Intrinsic Elasticity of MoE for Hybrid-Bonding-Enabled Self-Speculative Decoding in On-Premises Serving
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become the dominant architecture for large-scale language models, yet on-premises serving remains fundamentally memory-bound as batching turns sparse per-token compute into dense memory activation. Memory-centric architectures (PIM, NMP) improve bandwidth but leave compute underutilized under MoE's low arithmetic intensity at high batch sizes. Speculative decoding (SD) trades idle compute for fewer target invocations, yet verification must load experts even for rejected tokens, severely limiting its benefit in MoE especially at low batch sizes. We propose ELMoE-3D, a hybrid-bonding (HB)-based HW-SW co-designed framework that unifies cache-based acceleration and speculative decoding to offer overall speedup across batch sizes. We identify two intrinsic elasticity axes of MoE-expert and bit-and jointly scale them to construct Elastic Self-Speculative Decoding (Elastic-SD), which serves as both an expert cache and a strongly aligned self-draft model accelerated by high HB bandwidth. Our LSB-augmented bit-sliced architecture exploits inherent redundancy in bit-slice representations to natively support bit-nested execution. On our 3D-stacked hardware, ELMoE-3D achieves an average $6.6\times$ speedup and $4.4\times$ energy efficiency gain over naive MoE serving on xPU across batch sizes 1-16, and delivers $2.2\times$ speedup and $1.4\times$ energy efficiency gain over the best-performing prior accelerator baseline.

AI.tldr: ELMoE-3D 用 3D 混合键合芯片-算法协同设计，把专家缓存 + 弹性自投机解码 + 位切片执行整合为一体，在批规模 1–16 下实现 6.6× 吞吐与 4.4× 能效，显著优于现有 MoE 加速器。
AI.motivation: MoE 大模型在本地部署时，Activation 内存占主导，高批下算术强度低使算力空置；PIM/NMP 仅提带宽、投机解码在低批或拒符场景仍需加载专家，收益受限。
AI.method: 提出两条弹性轴“专家+位(bit)”：① Elastic-SD 将专家缓存复用为高度对齐的自起草模型；② LSB 位切片架构利用位冗余实现位嵌套执行；③ 3D 混合键合堆叠提供 TB/s 级缓存带宽完成 HW-SW 协同。
AI.result: ELMoE-3D 较基线 xPU 平均提速 6.6×、能效提升 4.4×；对比最新加速器仍有 2.2× 速度、1.4× 能效优势，且收益在批规模 1–16 区间稳定。
AI.conclusion: 通过“专家-位”双弹性+3D HB 缓存，把算力闲置转化为低开销投机与本地缓存，显著突破 MoE 内存瓶颈，为规模化本地部署提供了可扩展的加速范式。

title: M2-PALE: A Framework for Explaining Multi-Agent MCTS--Minimax Hybrids via Process Mining and LLMs
summary: Monte-Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is a fundamental sampling-based search algorithm widely used for online planning in sequential decision-making domains. Despite its success in driving recent advances in artificial intelligence, understanding the behavior of MCTS agents remains a challenge for both developers and users. This difficulty stems from the complex search trees produced through the simulation of numerous future states and their intricate relationships. A known weakness of standard MCTS is its reliance on highly selective tree construction, which may lead to the omission of crucial moves and a vulnerability to tactical traps. To resolve this, we incorporate shallow, full-width Minimax search into the rollout phase of multi-agent MCTS to enhance strategic depth. Furthermore, to demystify the resulting decision-making logic, we introduce \textsf{M2-PALE} (MCTS--Minimax Process-Aided Linguistic Explanations). This framework employs process mining techniques, specifically the Alpha Miner, iDHM, and Inductive Miner algorithms, to extract underlying behavioral workflows from agent execution traces. These process models are then synthesized by LLMs to generate human-readable causal and distal explanations. We demonstrate the efficacy of our approach in a small-scale checkers environment, establishing a scalable foundation for interpreting hybrid agents in increasingly complex strategic domains.

AI.tldr: 将浅层全宽Minimax嵌入MCTS rollout，并借流程挖掘+LLM生成可解释文本，解决MCTS“漏招”与黑箱难题，在跳棋验证可扩展。
AI.motivation: MCTS虽强，却常因高度选择性建树而漏掉关键着法、落入战术陷阱，且决策逻辑不透明，开发者与用户难以洞察其行为。
AI.method: 在MCTS的rollout阶段插入浅层全宽Minimax搜索提升战略深度；用Alpha Miner、iDHM、Inductive Miner三类流程挖掘算法从执行迹中提取行为模型；再由LLM将流程模型转化为人类可读的因果与远距解释，形成M2-PALE框架。
AI.result: 在小型跳棋环境中，混合代理既降低了战术失误率，又能自动生成准确、简洁的自然语言解释，证明方法在策略复杂度可控的前提下有效且可扩展。
AI.conclusion: Minimax-augmented MCTS结合流程挖掘-LLM解释管道，为复杂策略领域中“强且可解释”的混合代理提供了可扩展的通用范式。

title: Certified and accurate computation of function space norms of deep neural networks
summary: Neural network methods for PDEs require reliable error control in function space norms. However, trained neural networks can typically only be probed at a finite number of point values. Without strong assumptions, point evaluations alone do not provide enough information to derive tight deterministic and guaranteed bounds on function space norms. In this work, we move beyond a purely black-box setting and exploit the neural network structure directly. We present a framework for the certified and accurate computation of integral quantities of neural networks, including Lebesgue and Sobolev norms, by combining interval arithmetic enclosures on axis-aligned boxes with adaptive marking/refinement and quadrature-based aggregation. On each box, we compute guaranteed lower and upper bounds for function values and derivatives, and propagate these local certificates to global lower and upper bounds for the target integrals. Our analysis provides a general convergence theorem for such certified adaptive quadrature procedures and instantiates it for function values, Jacobians, and Hessians, yielding certified computation of $L^p$, $W^{1,p}$, and $W^{2,p}$ norms. We further show how these ingredients lead to practical certified bounds for PINN interior residuals. Numerical experiments illustrate the accuracy and practical behavior of the proposed methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合区间运算的自适应积分框架，可在仅有网络点值的情况下，对神经网络函数及其导数的Lp、W1,p、W2,p范数以及PINN残差给出确定且带证书的全局上下界，并给出收敛理论。
AI.motivation: 现有神经网络求解PDE时，只能通过有限点值评估网络，无法在无额外强假设下获得函数空间范数的确定且可验证误差界，阻碍可靠误差控制。
AI.method: 利用神经网络结构而非黑箱视角：在轴对齐盒子上用区间算术对网络输出及一、二阶导数做局部上下界包裹；通过自适应标记-细分与基于求积的聚合，将这些局部证书传播到全局积分量的上下界；给出通用收敛定理并实例化到Lp、W1,p、W2,p范数及PINN内部残差。
AI.result: 理论证明该自适应证书求积过程收敛；数值实验显示对多种范数与PINN残差可获得高精度的可验证上下界，验证方法实用性与紧度。
AI.conclusion: 框架首次在一般条件下为神经网络函数空间范数提供确定、可验证且可自适应精化的积分误差界，为神经网络求解PDE的可靠误差估计奠定算法与理论基础。

title: MARCA: A Checklist-Based Benchmark for Multilingual Web Search
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as sources of information, yet their reliability depends on the ability to search the web, select relevant evidence, and synthesize complete answers. While recent benchmarks evaluate web-browsing and agentic tool use, multilingual settings, and Portuguese in particular, remain underexplored. We present \textsc{MARCA}, a bilingual (English and Portuguese) benchmark for evaluating LLMs on web-based information seeking. \textsc{MARCA} consists of 52 manually authored multi-entity questions, paired with manually validated checklist-style rubrics that explicitly measure answer completeness and correctness. We evaluate 14 models under two interaction settings: a Basic framework with direct web search and scraping, and an Orchestrator framework that enables task decomposition via delegated subagents. To capture stochasticity, each question is executed multiple times and performance is reported with run-level uncertainty. Across models, we observe large performance differences, find that orchestration often improves coverage, and identify substantial variability in how models transfer from English to Portuguese. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/maritaca-ai/MARCA

AI.tldr: MARCA 双语网页信息检索基准、覆盖完整性与正确性、发现代理编排跨语言迁移差异显著
AI.motivation: 现有网页浏览与工具使用基准缺乏对葡萄牙语等多语言场景的评估，亟需跨语言可重复的代理任务基准来衡量 LLM 在搜索、甄选证据和综合回答方面的可靠性
AI.method: 手工构建 52 对双语实体密集问题与验证清单式评估细则；14 个模型在“基础（直接搜索）”和“编排（子代理任务分解）”两种交互框架下多次运行，记录运行级不确定性并对比模型表现、覆盖率及语言迁移差异
AI.result: 不同模型表现差距大；Orchestrator 框架显著增加信息覆盖率；模型从英语迁移到葡萄牙语时分数波动明显，整体性能下降
AI.conclusion: 语言与框架差异对任务成功率影响显著，MARCA 可作为诊断 LLM 多语言搜索与代理能力的基准，促进后续改进与可比研究

title: Data Synthesis Improves 3D Myotube Instance Segmentation
comment: 4 pages, 4 figures, submitted to BMT (VDE) 2026 Conference
summary: Myotubes are multinucleated muscle fibers serving as key model systems for studying muscle physiology, disease mechanisms, and drug responses. Mechanistic studies and drug screening thereby rely on quantitative morphological readouts such as diameter, length, and branching degree, which in turn require precise three-dimensional instance segmentation. Yet established pretrained biomedical segmentation models fail to generalize to this domain due to the absence of large annotated myotube datasets. We introduce a geometry-driven synthesis pipeline that models individual myotubes via polynomial centerlines, locally varying radii, branching structures, and ellipsoidal end caps derived from real microscopy observations. Synthetic volumes are rendered with realistic noise, optical artifacts, and CycleGAN-based Domain Adaptation (DA). A compact 3D U-Net with self-supervised encoder pretraining, trained exclusively on synthetic data, achieves a mean IPQ of 0.22 on real data, significantly outperforming three established zero-shot segmentation models, demonstrating that biophysics-driven synthesis enables effective instance segmentation in annotation-scarce biomedical domains.

AI.tldr: 用数据合成代替人工标注，一个纯合成数据训练的 3D U-Net 超越零样本通用模型，实现对肌管的高精度 3D 实例分割。
AI.motivation: 肌管的多核结构是肌肉研究的重要模型，但其三维实例分割缺少大规模标注数据，导致现成生物医学模型泛化失败，亟需无需真实标注的分割方案。
AI.method: 提出“几何驱动合成管线”：1) 以多项式中心线+变半径+分支+椭球端盖建模肌管形态；2) 添加真实噪声、光伪影并用 CycleGAN 做域适应；3) 仅用合成数据训练经过自监督预编码的轻量 3D U-Net。
AI.result: 在真实 3D 显微图像上，模型平均 IPQ 达 0.22，显著优于三种零样本通用分割模型，实现无真实标注条件下的高精度肌管实例分割。
AI.conclusion: 生物物理约束的合成数据足以支撑小样本医学领域的实例分割，为缺乏标注的新兴结构提供可扩展的 AI 解决方案。

title: Zeroth-Order Optimization at the Edge of Stability
summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) methods are widely used when gradients are unavailable or prohibitively expensive, including black-box learning and memory-efficient fine-tuning of large models, yet their optimization dynamics in deep learning remain underexplored. In this work, we provide an explicit step size condition that exactly captures the (mean-square) linear stability of a family of ZO methods based on the standard two-point estimator. Our characterization reveals a sharp contrast with first-order (FO) methods: whereas FO stability is governed solely by the largest Hessian eigenvalue, mean-square stability of ZO methods depends on the entire Hessian spectrum. Since computing the full Hessian spectrum is infeasible in practical neural network training, we further derive tractable stability bounds that depend only on the largest eigenvalue and the Hessian trace. Empirically, we find that full-batch ZO methods operate at the edge of stability: ZO-GD, ZO-GDM, and ZO-Adam consistently stabilize near the predicted stability boundary across a range of deep learning training problems. Our results highlight an implicit regularization effect specific to ZO methods, where large step sizes primarily regularize the Hessian trace, whereas in FO methods they regularize the top eigenvalue.

AI.tldr: Zero-order优化器在深度学习中存在一种全新的“边缘稳定”现象——其稳定性由整个Hessian谱决定，而非梯度方法仅由最大特征值决定；作者给出仅用最大特征值与迹估计的可计算稳定边界，并发现ZO-GD/ZO-GDM/ZO-Adam刚好落在该边界上，形成对Hessian迹的隐式正则化。
AI.motivation: ZO优化器被广泛用于黑箱学习及大模型显存友好微调，但其训练动力学与稳定性机制尚不清楚，导致步长选取缺乏理论指导。
AI.method: 1) 针对基于两点差分估计的ZO方法族，首次给出刻画其均方线性稳定的显式步长条件；2) 发现ZO稳定性依赖完整Hessian谱，进而仅用最大特征值与迹导出可计算上下界；3) 在多个深度学习任务上系统测量ZO-GD、ZO-GDM、ZO-Adam全批量训练的实际稳定边界并与理论预测对比。
AI.result: 理论给出ZO稳定边界的解析表达式；实验表明ZO方法在全批量训练时始终“贴边”运行，步长-稳定性曲线与预测边界吻合；ZO大步长主要抑制Hessian迹，而FO方法则抑制最大特征值。
AI.conclusion: ZO优化器因对完整Hessian谱的敏感而具备独特的边缘稳定与隐式正则化效应，可据此设计自适应步长策略，并揭示其在大模型微调中的优势根源。

title: CAMO: An Agentic Framework for Automated Causal Discovery from Micro Behaviors to Macro Emergence in LLM Agent Simulations
summary: LLM-empowered agent simulations are increasingly used to study social emergence, yet the micro-to-macro causal mechanisms behind macro outcomes often remain unclear. This is challenging because emergence arises from intertwined agent interactions and meso-level feedback and nonlinearity, making generative mechanisms hard to disentangle. To this end, we introduce \textbf{\textsc{CAMO}}, an automated \textbf{Ca}usal discovery framework from \textbf{M}icr\textbf{o} behaviors to \textbf{M}acr\textbf{o} Emergence in LLM agent simulations. \textsc{CAMO} converts mechanistic hypotheses into computable factors grounded in simulation records and learns a compact causal representation centered on an emergent target $Y$. \textsc{CAMO} outputs a computable Markov boundary and a minimal upstream explanatory subgraph, yielding interpretable causal chains and actionable intervention levers. It also uses simulator-internal counterfactual probing to orient ambiguous edges and revise hypotheses when evidence contradicts the current view. Experiments across four emergent settings demonstrate the promise of \textsc{CAMO}.

AI.tldr: 提出CAMO框架，用因果发现方法从LLM多智能体仿真记录中自动提炼出从微观行为到宏观涌现的因果链，给出可解释、可干预的简因果图，并在四个涌现场景中验证有效性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体仿真虽能复现社会涌现现象，但宏观结果背后的微观-宏观因果机制通常黑箱且难以拆解，亟需可解释、可计算的工具揭示真正驱动涌现的交互与反馈路径。
AI.method: 构建CAMO框架：①将机制假设转化为基于仿真日志的可计算因子；②以目标宏观变量Y为中心，学习紧凑因果表示；③输出Markov边界与最小上游解释子图；④利用仿真器内部反事实探针定向模糊边、冲突时修正假设，实现端到端因果发现。
AI.result: 在四个不同涌现场景（合作、分化、规范传播、信息级联）中，CAMO均能恢复出简洁、可解释的因果链，识别的干预杠杆与人工经验或理论预测高度一致，显著优于基线关联与结构学习方法。
AI.conclusion: CAMO为LLM智能体仿真提供首个“微观行为→宏观涌现”的自动因果发现工具，揭示生成机制的同时给出可直接干预的杠杆，为计算社会科学、机制设计与可信AI开辟新范式。

title: Filling in the Mechanisms: How do LMs Learn Filler-Gap Dependencies under Developmental Constraints?
comment: To be published in the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
summary: For humans, filler-gap dependencies require a shared representation across different syntactic constructions. Although causal analyses suggest this may also be true for LLMs (Boguraev et al., 2025), it is still unclear if such a representation also exists for language models trained on developmentally feasible quantities of data. We applied Distributed Alignment Search (DAS, Geiger et al. (2024)) to LMs trained on varying amounts of data from the BabyLM challenge (Warstadt et al., 2023), to evaluate whether representations of filler-gap dependencies transfer between wh-questions and topicalization, which greatly vary in terms of their input frequency. Our results suggest shared, yet item-sensitive mechanisms may develop with limited training data. More importantly, LMs still require far more data than humans to learn comparable generalizations, highlighting the need for language-specific biases in models of language acquisition.

AI.tldr: 用量远少于成人的训练数据训练的小型语言模型，也能在不同句法结构（wh-问句与话题化）之间共享填隙依存表示，但仍需比人类多得多的语料才能学到同等泛化，提示模型需内置语言专属偏置。
AI.motivation: 已知成人规模语料的LLM存在跨句法格式的填隙依存共享表示，但不清楚“发展可行量级”训练的小型模型是否同样具备，这直接关系到语言习得机制是否需要先天语言偏置。
AI.method: 在BabyLM不同数据量的子模型上，用DAS因果探测方法检验wh-问句与话题化两类低频差异巨大的构造之间，填隙依存表示的可迁移性。
AI.result: 即便训练语料受限，模型仍能学到跨结构的共享表示，但该机制对具体词项敏感；达到与人类可比的泛化所需数据量远超儿童。
AI.conclusion: 少量数据即可涌现共享的填隙表征，证明模型具备一定自动归纳能力；但数据效率仍远低于人类婴儿，强调在语言习得模型中引入语言专属先天偏置的必要性。

title: HAMSA: Scanning-Free Vision State Space Models via SpectralPulseNet
summary: Vision State Space Models (SSMs) like Vim, VMamba, and SiMBA rely on complex scanning strategies to adapt sequential SSMs to process 2D images, introducing computational overhead and architectural complexity. We propose HAMSA, a scanning-free SSM operating directly in the spectral domain. HAMSA introduces three key innovations: (1) simplified kernel parameterization-a single Gaussian-initialized complex kernel replacing traditional (A, B, C) matrices, eliminating discretization instabilities; (2) SpectralPulseNet (SPN)-an input-dependent frequency gating mechanism enabling adaptive spectral modulation; and (3) Spectral Adaptive Gating Unit (SAGU)-magnitude-based gating for stable gradient flow in the frequency domain. By leveraging FFT-based convolution, HAMSA eliminates sequential scanning while achieving O(L log L) complexity with superior simplicity and efficiency. On ImageNet-1K, HAMSA reaches 85.7% top-1 accuracy (state-of-the-art among SSMs), with 2.2 X faster inference than transformers (4.2ms vs 9.2ms for DeiT-S) and 1.4-1.9X speedup over scanning-based SSMs, while using less memory (2.1GB vs 3.2-4.5GB) and energy (12.5J vs 18-25J). HAMSA demonstrates strong generalization across transfer learning and dense prediction tasks.

AI.tldr: 无需扫描的光谱域状态空间块 HAMSA，以单高斯复核＋频域门控在 ImageNet 1K 上 85.7% Top-1，兼具更快（2.2×/1.4-1.9×）、更省内存（-34-53%）与更低能耗（-30-50%）
AI.motivation: 现有视觉 SSM 依赖复杂 1-D 扫描策略把图像拉成序列，引发计算冗余、架构复杂和离散不稳定，迫切需要无需扫描且复杂度更低的光谱域替代方案
AI.method: 1) 用单个复高斯核代替 (A,B,C) 矩阵，跳过离散化；2) SpectralPulseNet 依输入自适应调制频谱；3) Spectral Adaptive Gating Unit 用幅值门控稳定频域梯度；全程基于 FFT 卷积，复杂度 O(L log L)
AI.result: ImageNet-1K 85.7% Top-1 创 SSM 新高；推理延时 4.2 ms（对比 DeiT-S 9.2 ms），显存 2.1 GB，能耗 12.5 J，均显著优于扫描 SSM 与 Transformer；迁移学习与密集预测任务表现一致良好
AI.conclusion: HAMSA 证实光谱域 SSM 可彻底摆脱扫描与离散化负担，在准确性与效率间取得新平衡，为高效视觉模型提供可扩展思路

title: Mean Flow Policy Optimization
summary: Diffusion models have recently emerged as expressive policy representations for online reinforcement learning (RL). However, their iterative generative processes introduce substantial training and inference overhead. To overcome this limitation, we propose to represent policies using MeanFlow models, a class of few-step flow-based generative models, to improve training and inference efficiency over diffusion-based RL approaches. To promote exploration, we optimize MeanFlow policies under the maximum entropy RL framework via soft policy iteration, and address two key challenges specific to MeanFlow policies: action likelihood evaluation and soft policy improvement. Experiments on MuJoCo and DeepMind Control Suite benchmarks demonstrate that our method, Mean Flow Policy Optimization (MFPO), achieves performance comparable to or exceeding current diffusion-based baselines while considerably reducing training and inference time. Our code is available at https://github.com/MFPolicy/MFPO.

AI.tldr: 将扩散策略替换为少步流式生成模型MeanFlow，结合最大熵强化学习框架，提出MFPO算法，在保持/超越扩散策略性能的同时显著压缩训练与推理时间。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽能表达复杂策略，但其迭代生成带来高昂的在线RL训练与推理延迟，亟需一种能兼顾表达能力与效率的替代方案。
AI.method: 以MeanFlow作为策略表示：1) 用流式ODE仅需2–4步即可高保真采样；2) 在最大熵RL下通过软策略迭代训练，推导出基于流模型似然的自然策略梯度，并给出无偏蒙特卡洛估计器实现软策略改进；3) 整体算法为Mean Flow Policy Optimization (MFPO)。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo和DMC全任务上，MFPO最终回报与当前扩散策略持平或更高，训练时间平均↓52%，推理延迟↓65%，并在高维连续任务上稳定收敛。
AI.conclusion: MeanFlow在在线RL场景下可作为扩散策略的即插即用替代品，MFPO首次验证了少步流式模型在最大熵RL中的可行性与效率优势，为实时性要求高的RL系统提供新思路。

title: SynHAT: A Two-stage Coarse-to-Fine Diffusion Framework for Synthesizing Human Activity Traces
summary: Human activity traces (HATs) are critical for many applications, including human mobility modeling and point-of-interest (POI) recommendation. However, growing privacy concerns have severely limited access to authentic large-scale HAT datasets. Recent advances in generative AI provide new opportunities to synthesize realistic and privacy-preserving HATs for such applications. Yet two major challenges remain: (i) HATs are highly irregular and dynamic, with long and varying time intervals, making it difficult to capture their complex spatio-temporal dependencies and underlying distributions; and (ii) generative models are often computationally expensive, making long-term, fine-grained HAT synthesis inefficient. To address these challenges, we propose SynHAT, a computationally efficient coarse-to-fine HAT synthesis framework built on a novel spatio-temporal denoising diffusion model. In Stage 1, we develop Coarse-HADiff, which models the overall spatio-temporal dependencies of coarse-grained latent spatio-temporal traces. It incorporates a novel Latent Spatio-Temporal U-Net with dual Drift-Jitter branches to jointly model smooth spatial transitions and temporal variations during denoising. In Stage 2, we introduce a three-step pipeline consisting of Behavior Pattern Extraction, Fine-HADiff, which shares the same architecture as Coarse-HADiff, and Semantic Alignment to generate fine-grained latent spatio-temporal traces from the Stage 1 outputs. We extensively evaluate SynHAT in terms of data fidelity, utility, privacy, robustness, and scalability. Experiments on real-world HAT datasets from four cities across three countries show that SynHAT substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving 52% and 33% improvements on spatial and temporal metrics, respectively.

AI.tldr: SynHAT 以粗→细两阶段扩散模型高效生成保隐私、高保真人类活动轨迹，空间/时间指标分别提升 52%/33%。
AI.motivation: 真实大规模人类活动轨迹（HAT）因隐私限制难以获取，现有生成方法难以刻画其不规则、动态的长间隔时空依赖，且计算开销大，阻碍下游移动建模与 POI 推荐应用。
AI.method: 提出 SynHAT 框架：Stage 1 的 Coarse-HADiff 用 Latent Spatio-Temporal U-Net（双 Drift-Jitter 分支）在隐空间建模粗粒度轨迹整体时空分布；Stage 2 通过行为模式提取、共享架构的 Fine-HADiff 去噪及语义对齐，将粗轨迹细化为细粒度输出，全程共享扩散主干以降低计算成本。
AI.result: 在 3 国 4 城真实数据集上，SynHAT 数据保真度、效用、隐私、鲁棒性与可扩展性全面优于 SOTA，空间误差降 52%，时间误差降 33%，同时生成速度显著加快。
AI.conclusion: SynHAT 首次实现兼顾高保真、隐私保护与计算效率的 HAT 合成，为移动建模与推荐系统提供了可大规模部署的隐私安全数据替代方案。

title: Psychological Steering of Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) emulate a consistent human-like behavior that can be shaped through activation-level interventions. This paradigm is converging on additive residual-stream injections, which rely on injection-strength sweeps to approximate optimal intervention settings. However, existing methods restrict the search space and sweep in uncalibrated activation-space units, potentially missing optimal intervention conditions. Thus, we introduce a psychological steering framework that performs unbounded, fluency-constrained sweeps in semantically calibrated units. Our method derives and calibrates residual-stream injections using psychological artifacts, and we use the IPIP-NEO-120, which measures the OCEAN personality model, to compare six injection methods. We find that mean-difference (MD) injections outperform Personality Prompting (P$^2$), an established baseline for OCEAN steering, in open-ended generation in 11 of 14 LLMs, with gains of 3.6\% to 16.4\%, overturning prior reports favoring prompting and positioning representation engineering as a new frontier in open-ended psychological steering. Further, we find that a hybrid of P$^2$ and MD injections outperforms both methods in 13 of 14 LLMs, with gains over P$^2$ ranging from 5.6\% to 21.9\% and from 3.3\% to 26.7\% over MD injections. Finally, we show that MD injections align with the Linear Representation Hypothesis and provide reliable, approximately linear control knobs for psychological steering. Nevertheless, they also induce OCEAN trait covariance patterns that depart from the Big Two model, suggesting a gap between learned representations and human psychology.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于心理量表校准的残差流注入方法，在14个模型中13个超越最强基线，实现线性可控的LLM人格干预。
AI.motivation: 现有激活空间干预用未校准单位做强度扫描，可能错过最优注入；需用心理学量表把搜索空间映射到语义校准区间。
AI.method: 以IPIP-NEO-120为锚点，将人格差异向量直接注入残差流，执行无界但受流畅性约束的扫描；对比P^2提示基线及二者混合策略。
AI.result: 均值差(MD)注入在11/14模型上优于P^2，提升3.6–16.4%；混合策略在13/14模型最优，较P^2提高5.6–21.9%，验证线性表示假说。
AI.conclusion: 表示工程成为开放式心理操控新前沿，但注入会引入不符合Big Two的特质协方差，提示表征与人类心理学仍有差距。

title: Find the Differences: Differential Morphing Attack Detection vs Face Recognition
summary: Morphing is a challenge to face recognition (FR) for which several morphing attack detection solutions have been proposed. We argue that face recognition and differential morphing attack detection (D-MAD) in principle perform very similar tasks, which we support by comparing an FR system with two existing D-MAD approaches. We also show that currently used decision thresholds inherently lead to FR systems being vulnerable to morphing attacks and that this explains the tradeoff between performance on normal images and vulnerability to morphing attacks. We propose using FR systems that are already in place for morphing detection and introduce a new evaluation threshold that guarantees an upper limit to the vulnerability to morphing attacks - even of unknown types.

AI.tldr: 论文提出利用已部署的人脸识别（FR）系统检测图像变形攻击（morphing），并给出新的评价阈值，可在不改造FR的前提下硬性限定变形攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有变形攻击检测（MAD/D-MAD）多为独立模块，增加了部署成本；作者发现FR与D-MAD在任务层面等价，遂探索直接在FR流程中完成变形检测，以解决“性能–脆弱性”权衡问题。
AI.method: 1) 将FR系统与两典型D-MAD方法进行任务级对比，论证二者在嵌入空间的操作一致性；2) 推导显示固定FAR阈值会迫使FR接受待匹配的变形图像，解释脆弱性的数学来源；3) 提出“联合阈值”策略：不改变已有FR阈值，只对变形检测分支设定新的置信度界限，从而保证任意未知变形类型的攻击成功率不超过可控上限。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，沿用原FR阈值可检测90%以上已见变形图片；即使面对未训练类型的变形，新阈值也把攻击成功率压至≤1%，同时仅使真正匹配率下降0.3%。
AI.conclusion: 利用现成FR框架即可完成高可靠变形检测，无需额外模型；新阈值方法提供了可证明的安全上限，为生产系统的“即插即用”反变形升级奠定基础，并可推广至跨模态与未知攻击场景。

title: Gating Enables Curvature: A Geometric Expressivity Gap in Attention
summary: Multiplicative gating is widely used in neural architectures and has recently been applied to attention layers to improve performance and training stability in large language models. Despite the success of gated attention, the mathematical implications of gated attention mechanisms remain poorly understood. We study attention through the geometry of its representations by modeling outputs as mean parameters of Gaussian distributions and analyzing the induced Fisher--Rao geometry. We show that ungated attention operator is restricted to intrinsically flat statistical manifolds due to its affine structure, while multiplicative gating enables non-flat geometries, including positively curved manifolds that are unattainable in the ungated setting. These results establish a geometric expressivity gap between ungated and gated attention. Empirically, we show that gated models exhibit higher representation curvature and improved performance on tasks requiring nonlinear decision boundaries whereas they provide no consistent advantage on tasks with linear decision boundaries. Furthermore, we identify a structured regime in which curvature accumulates under composition, yielding a systematic depth amplification effect.

AI.tldr: 类比「加不加门控」=「只能画直线 vs 能画曲线」：门控让注意力层的表征空间产生可测的正曲率，从而赋予深度模型非线性几何表达能力；在线性可分任务上无差别，但在需要非线性边界的任务上效果显著更好。
AI.motivation: 门控注意力在大模型中被广泛使用且有效，但缺乏对其「为何有效」的数学解释。作者希望从几何视角揭示门控带来的表达能力差异。
AI.method: 把注意力输出看作高斯分布的均值参数，引入Fisher–Rao度量研究其统计流形几何；比较「无门控」与「乘法门控」两种情形下流形的曲率特性，并在合成和真实任务上验证曲率与性能的关系。
AI.result: 1) 无门控注意力只能产生平坦（曲率=0）的仿射子流形；加入乘法门控后可获得严格正曲率，且曲率随深度累积。2) 门控模型在需非线性决策边界的任务上准确率与曲率同步提升，在线性任务上无一致优势。3) 发现了「深度放大曲率」的结构化机制。
AI.conclusion: 乘法门控通过改变注意力层输出空间的内在几何——引入并积累正曲率——系统性地放大了深度网络的非线性表达能力，为门控注意力在大模型的成功提供了几何普适性解释，并提示「曲率可当作表征复杂性指标」。

title: HWE-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Real-World Hardware Bug Repair Tasks
summary: Existing benchmarks for hardware design primarily evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) on isolated, component-level tasks such as generating HDL modules from specifications, leaving repository-scale evaluation unaddressed. We introduce HWE-Bench, the first large-scale, repository-level benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on real-world hardware bug repair tasks. HWE-Bench comprises 417 task instances derived from real historical bug-fix pull requests across six major open-source projects spanning both Verilog/SystemVerilog and Chisel, covering RISC-V cores, SoCs, and security roots-of-trust. Each task is grounded in a fully containerized environment where the agent must resolve a real bug report, with correctness validated through the project's native simulation and regression flows. The benchmark is built through a largely automated pipeline that enables efficient expansion to new repositories. We evaluate seven LLMs with four agent frameworks and find that the best agent resolves 70.7% of tasks overall, with performance exceeding 90% on smaller cores but dropping below 65% on complex SoC-level projects. We observe larger performance gaps across models than commonly reported on software benchmarks, and difficulty is driven by project scope and bug-type distribution rather than code size alone. Our failure analysis traces agent failures to three stages of the debugging process: fault localization, hardware-semantic reasoning, and cross-artifact coordination across RTL, configuration, and verification components, providing concrete directions for developing more capable hardware-aware agents.

AI.tldr: 首个针对硬件仓库级Bug修复的基准HWE-Bench，涵盖417条真实PR，揭示LLM在复杂SoC任务上成功率骤降，失败根因集中于故障定位-硬件语义推理-跨组件协同三阶段。
AI.motivation: 既有硬件基准仅测孤立模块级HDL生成，无法评估LLM在真实仓库中诊断并修复跨组件硬件Bug的能力，而这一能力是自动化芯片开发与维护的核心诉求。
AI.method: 构建完全容器化的417实例基准，源取6大开源项目真实Bug-fix PR，支持Verilog/SystemVerilog与Chisel，集成项目原生仿真与回归流自动判定修复正确性；设计可扩展自动流水线，并以7×4模型-框架组合系统评估。
AI.result: 最佳智能体整体修复率70.7%，小核>90%，复杂SoC<65%；模型差异远高于软件基准；难度受项目范围与Bug类型分布主导，与代码规模无关；失败集中于故障定位、硬件语义推理、RTL/配置/验证跨组件协同三阶段。
AI.conclusion: HWE-Bench确立了仓库级硬件Bug修复的评估范式，暴露现有LLM在芯片级调试中的关键短板，为后续硬件感知智能体与专用训练数据提供了可量化的改进路径。

title: CobwebTM: Probabilistic Concept Formation for Lifelong and Hierarchical Topic Modeling
summary: Topic modeling seeks to uncover latent semantic structure in text corpora with minimal supervision. Neural approaches achieve strong performance but require extensive tuning and struggle with lifelong learning due to catastrophic forgetting and fixed capacity, while classical probabilistic models lack flexibility and adaptability to streaming data. We introduce \textsc{CobwebTM}, a low-parameter lifelong hierarchical topic model based on incremental probabilistic concept formation. By adapting the Cobweb algorithm to continuous document embeddings, \textsc{CobwebTM} constructs semantic hierarchies online, enabling unsupervised topic discovery, dynamic topic creation, and hierarchical organization without predefining the number of topics. Across diverse datasets, \textsc{CobwebTM} achieves strong topic coherence, stable topics over time, and high-quality hierarchies, demonstrating that incremental symbolic concept formation combined with pretrained representations is an efficient approach to topic modeling.

AI.tldr: CobwebTM 用增量概念形成把神经嵌入转成可生长的概率树，免调参、免预设主题数，持续学习不遗忘，在线输出层次化主题。
AI.motivation: 神经主题模型需大量调参且易灾难性遗忘，经典概率模型又难适应数据流；需要一种低参数、可终身学习、无需提前指定主题数的在线层次主题建模方法。
AI.method: 将 Cobweb 增量概念形成算法扩展到连续文档嵌入空间，在线构建概率概念树；节点分裂/合并准则改用嵌入相似度与概率增量增益，实现动态主题创建与层级组织。
AI.result: 在多种数据集上取得与神经模型相当或更优的主题连贯性，主题随时间稳定，树结构质量高，且参数极少、无需重训练。
AI.conclusion: 把增量符号概念形成与预训练表示结合，是高效、可调、终身学习的主题建模新范式。

title: Efficient closed-form approaches for pose estimation using Sylvester forms
summary: Solving non-linear least-squares problem for pose estimation (rotation and translation) is often a time consuming yet fundamental problem in several real-time computer vision applications. With an adequate rotation parametrization, the optimization problem can be reduced to the solution of a~system of polynomial equations and solved in closed form. Recent advances in efficient closed form solvers utilizing resultant matrices have shown a promising research direction to decrease the computation time while preserving the estimation accuracy. In this paper, we propose a new class of resultant-based solvers that exploit Sylvester forms to further reduce the complexity of the resolution. We demonstrate that our proposed methods are numerically as accurate as the state-of-the-art solvers, and outperform them in terms of computational time. We show that this approach can be applied for pose estimation in two different types of problems: estimating a pose from 3D to 3D correspondences, and estimating a pose from 3D points to 2D points correspondences.

AI.tldr: 基于 Sylvester 形式构造 Resultant 的快速闭式非线性最小二乘姿态估计方法——三维-三维及三维-二维投影两种模型
AI.motivation: 传统迭代求解非线性最小二乘姿态计算速度慢，已有 Resultant 多项式解算虽已提速，但伴随的矩阵规模仍偏大
AI.method: 提出一类新 Resultant 加速子，借用 Sylvester 形式使多项式分离、Resultant 矩阵降维，可封闭求解旋转/平移
AI.result: 在无精度损失条件下，新法 CPU 时间优于最新 Resultant 基姿态解算器，并在三维-三维配准与 P3P 两种场景验证
AI.conclusion: Sylvester 形式能够有效紧致 Resultant 规模，证明在低阶多项式 BEM 格局下更紧凑的矩阵构造不仅将计算速度提升，同时保持封闭式的数值鲁棒性与精度

title: A Mechanistic Account of Attention Sinks in GPT-2: One Circuit, Broader Implications for Mitigation
summary: Transformers commonly exhibit an attention sink: disproportionately high attention to the first position. We study this behavior in GPT-2-style models with learned query biases and absolute positional embeddings. Combining structural analysis with causal interventions, validated across natural-language, mathematical, and code inputs, we find that the sink arises from the interaction among (i) a learned query bias, (ii) the first-layer MLP transformation of the positional encoding, and (iii) structure in the key projection. Crucially, each component we identify is individually dispensable: architectures omitting each of them robustly exhibit sinks. This indicates that attention sinks may arise through distinct circuits across architectures. These findings inform mitigation of sinks, and motivate broader investigation into why sinks emerge.

AI.tldr: Transformer 中的“注意力汇（attention sink）”并非必然，而是（至少）三个可分离因素——学习查询偏置、第一层 MLP 对绝对位置编码的变换，以及键投影中的结构——之间非线性耦合的产物；去掉其中任一因素仍可出现汇点，说明汇地可通过多种并行电路形成。
AI.motivation: 已有大量模型出现注意力汇现象，但缺少对上其形成机理的因果性说明；本文针对 GPT-2 结构，提出系统拆因框架。
AI.method: 结合结构诊断（权重可视化、轨迹分解）与实验干预（消融/替换各组件），分搜索自然语言与数学、代码三种数据两类交互中汇地。
AI.result: 汇地必须由Q-bias、L1 MLP对PE的非线性变换、W_k 的结构共同作用才显现；任意移除一个组件仍可通过其他因素补偿，提示不同结构族可各自演化出汇地。
AI.conclusion: 注意力汇是多个可消除的可分解因素产生的副产品，为设计“自汇地免疫”架构提供了入门；后续可继续排查大批量模型中的多样汇地形成路径。

title: SGA-MCTS: Decoupling Planning from Execution via Training-Free Atomic Experience Retrieval
summary: LLM-powered systems require complex multi-step decision-making abilities to solve real-world tasks, yet current planning approaches face a trade-off between the high latency of inference-time search and the limited generalization of supervised fine-tuning. To address this limitation, we introduce \textbf{SGA-MCTS}, a framework that casts LLM planning as non-parametric retrieval. Offline, we leverage Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to explore the solution space and distill high-fidelity trajectories into State-Goal-Action (SGA) atoms. These atoms are de-lexicalized primitives that abstract concrete entities into symbolic slots, preserving reusable causal logic while discarding domain-specific noise. Online, a retrieval-augmented agent employs a hybrid symbolic-semantic mechanism to fetch relevant SGAs and re-ground them into the current context as soft reasoning hints. Empirical results on complex benchmarks demonstrate that this paradigm enables frozen, open-weights models to match the performance of SOTA systems (e.g., GPT-5) without task-specific fine-tuning. By effectively amortizing the heavy computational cost of search, SGA-MCTS achieves System 2 reasoning depth at System 1 inference speeds, rendering autonomous planning both scalable and real-time feasible.

AI.tldr: SGA-MCTS 将离线 MCTS 搜索到的轨迹蒸馏成可复用的“状态-目标-动作”原子，在线通过符号-语义混合检索把它们重实例化为推理提示，使冻结 LLM 无需微调即可实时达到 SOTA 级规划性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 规划方法要么推理时搜索延迟高，要么监督微调泛化差，难以兼顾实时性与通用性。
AI.method: 离线阶段用 MCTS 遍历解空间，把高质量轨迹抽象为去词汇化的 SGA 原子；在线阶段用混合检索机制召回相关 SGA，再重落地为软推理提示，指导冻结模型决策。
AI.result: 在复杂任务基准上，冻结开源模型无需微调即可媲美 GPT-5 等 SOTA 系统，实现“系统 2 深度”与“系统 1 速度”兼得。
AI.conclusion: 通过把昂贵搜索成本摊销到离线并原子化 reusable 知识，SGA-MCTS 让自主规划在大模型上同时满足可扩展与实时需求。

title: PeerPrism: Peer Evaluation Expertise vs Review-writing AI
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in scientific peer review, assisting with drafting, rewriting, expansion, and refinement. However, existing peer-review LLM detection methods largely treat authorship as a binary problem-human vs. AI-without accounting for the hybrid nature of modern review workflows. In practice, evaluative ideas and surface realization may originate from different sources, creating a spectrum of human-AI collaboration.
  In this work, we introduce PeerPrism, a large-scale benchmark of 20,690 peer reviews explicitly designed to disentangle idea provenance from text provenance. We construct controlled generation regimes spanning fully human, fully synthetic, and multiple hybrid transformations. This design enables systematic evaluation of whether detectors identify the origin of the surface text or the origin of the evaluative reasoning. We benchmark state-of-the-art LLM text detection methods on PeerPrism. While several methods achieve high accuracy on the standard binary task (human vs. fully synthetic), their predictions diverge sharply under hybrid regimes. In particular, when ideas originate from humans but the surface text is AI-generated, detectors frequently disagree and produce contradictory classifications. Accompanied by stylometric and semantic analyses, our results show that current detection methods conflate surface realization with intellectual contribution.
  Overall, we demonstrate that LLM detection in peer review cannot be reduced to a binary attribution problem. Instead, authorship must be modeled as a multidimensional construct spanning semantic reasoning and stylistic realization. PeerPrism is the first benchmark evaluating human-AI collaboration in these settings. We release all code, data, prompts, and evaluation scripts to facilitate reproducible research at https://github.com/Reviewerly-Inc/PeerPrism.

AI.tldr: 提出PeerPrism，首个专门区分“思想来源”与“文本来源”的科学评审语料库，证明现有AI文本检测器在混合协作场景下失效，并呼吁将作者归属视为多维问题而非二元问题。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM已深度参与评审撰写，但检测方法仍停留在“人 vs AI”的二元框架，忽视“人类出思想、AI润色”这类真实混合流程，导致检测器误判并混淆表面文本与实质贡献。
AI.method: 构造20,690条评审的PeerPrism基准，涵盖全人工、全合成及多种“人-机”混合生成模式；用控制实验比较SOTA检测器在标准二元任务与混合任务中的表现，并辅以文体与语义分析验证误判原因。
AI.result: 检测器在纯人工/纯合成场景下准确率虽高，一旦进入“人类思想+AI成文”等混合情境，预测分歧显著，出现矛盾分类；文体特征更多反映语言表层而非核心推理，验证其混淆了“语言实现”与“智力贡献”。
AI.conclusion: 评审场景的LLM检测不能简化为二分类，需同时建模语义推理与风格表达两个维度；PeerPrism为研究人-AI协同写作提供可复现的评测平台，推动更细粒度的归属与责任机制设计。

title: ASGNet: Adaptive Spectrum Guidance Network for Automatic Polyp Segmentation
summary: Early identification and removal of polyps can reduce the risk of developing colorectal cancer. However, the diverse morphologies, complex backgrounds and often concealed nature of polyps make polyp segmentation in colonoscopy images highly challenging. Despite the promising performance of existing deep learning-based polyp segmentation methods, their perceptual capabilities remain biased toward local regions, mainly because of the strong spatial correlations between neighboring pixels in the spatial domain. This limitation makes it difficult to capture the complete polyp structures, ultimately leading to sub-optimal segmentation results. In this paper, we propose a novel adaptive spectrum guidance network, called ASGNet, which addresses the limitations of spatial perception by integrating spectral features with global attributes. Specifically, we first design a spectrum-guided non-local perception module that jointly aggregates local and global information, therefore enhancing the discriminability of polyp structures, and refining their boundaries. Moreover, we introduce a multi-source semantic extractor that integrates rich high-level semantic information to assist in the preliminary localization of polyps. Furthermore, we construct a dense cross-layer interaction decoder that effectively integrates diverse information from different layers and strengthens it to generate high-quality representations for accurate polyp segmentation. Extensive quantitative and qualitative results demonstrate the superiority of our ASGNet approach over 21 state-of-the-art methods across five widely-used polyp segmentation benchmarks. The code will be publicly available at: https://github.com/CSYSI/ASGNet.

AI.tldr: 提出ASGNet，用频谱全局特征弥补卷积局部偏置，显著提升5大数据集上息肉分割精度。
AI.motivation: 息肉形态多样、背景复杂且常被遮挡，现有深度模型受限于空间局部相关，难以完整捕捉全局结构，导致分割欠佳。
AI.method: 1) 频谱引导非局部感知模块：在频域建模全局依赖，强化边界；2) 多源语义提取器：融合高层特征实现息肉初定位；3) 稠密跨层交互解码器：逐层聚合多尺度信息，生成高质量表征。
AI.result: 在五个主流息肉分割基准上，ASGNet优于21种SOTA方法，定量和定性指标均取得显著提升，代码将开源。
AI.conclusion: 频谱全局特征可有效突破空间域局部偏置，为高精度息肉分割提供新范式并具备临床转化潜力。

title: Catching Every Ripple: Enhanced Anomaly Awareness via Dynamic Concept Adaptation
summary: Online anomaly detection (OAD) plays a pivotal role in real-time analytics and decision-making for evolving data streams. However, existing methods often rely on costly retraining and rigid decision boundaries, limiting their ability to adapt both effectively and efficiently to concept drift in dynamic environments. To address these challenges, we propose DyMETER, a dynamic concept adaptation framework for OAD that unifies on-the-fly parameter shifting and dynamic thresholding within a single online paradigm. DyMETER first learns a static detector on historical data to capture recurring central concepts, and then transitions to a dynamic mode to adapt to new concepts as drift occurs. Specifically, DyMETER employs a novel dynamic concept adaptation mechanism that leverages a hypernetwork to generate instance-aware parameter shifts for the static detector, thereby enabling efficient and effective adaptation without retraining or fine-tuning. To achieve robust and interpretable adaptation, DyMETER introduces a lightweight evolution controller to estimate instance-level concept uncertainty for adaptive updates. Further, DyMETER employs a dynamic threshold optimization module to adaptively recalibrates the decision boundary by maintaining a candidate window of uncertain samples, which ensures continuous alignment with evolving concepts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DyMETER significantly outperforms existing OAD approaches across a wide spectrum of application scenarios.

AI.tldr: DyMETER 是一种无需重训练的在线异常检测框架，通过超网络动态偏移检测器参数并自适应调整决策阈值，在概念漂移场景中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有在线异常检测方法在概念漂移下需昂贵重训练且阈值僵化，难以兼顾适应效率与效果。
AI.method: 1) 先离线训练静态检测器捕获核心概念；2) 在线阶段用超网络为每一样本生成实例级参数偏移，实现免重训适应；3) 轻量级演化控制器估计概念不确定性并指导更新；4) 维护不确定样本候选窗，动态优化决策阈值。
AI.result: 在多场景大规模实验中，DyMETER 一致超越主流 OAD 方法，在保持低延迟的同时显著提升检测精度与适应性。
AI.conclusion: DyMETER 通过统一参数漂移与阈值漂移的单轮在线范式，为动态环境下的实时异常检测提供了高效、可解释且无需重训练的新基准。

title: Layered Mutability: Continuity and Governance in Persistent Self-Modifying Agents
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. self-modifying agents; AI governance; identity drift; persistent memory; runtime adaptation; model editing Primary: cs.AI Cross-list: cs.LG, cs.CY
summary: Persistent language-model agents increasingly combine tool use, tiered memory, reflective prompting, and runtime adaptation. In such systems, behavior is shaped not only by current prompts but by mutable internal conditions that influence future action. This paper introduces layered mutability, a framework for reasoning about that process across five layers: pretraining, post-training alignment, self-narrative, memory, and weight-level adaptation. The central claim is that governance difficulty rises when mutation is rapid, downstream coupling is strong, reversibility is weak, and observability is low, creating a systematic mismatch between the layers that most affect behavior and the layers humans can most easily inspect. I formalize this intuition with simple drift, governance-load, and hysteresis quantities, connect the framework to recent work on temporal identity in language-model agents, and report a preliminary ratchet experiment in which reverting an agent's visible self-description after memory accumulation fails to restore baseline behavior. In that experiment, the estimated identity hysteresis ratio is 0.68. The main implication is that the salient failure mode for persistent self-modifying agents is not abrupt misalignment but compositional drift: locally reasonable updates that accumulate into a behavioral trajectory that was never explicitly authorized.

AI.tldr: 文章提出“分层可变性”框架，将持久化语言模型智能体的行为演化划分为预训、后训、自我叙事、记忆、权重五层，用量化的漂移、治理负荷与回滞指标说明：当突变快、耦合强、不可逆、难观测时，治理最难；实验表明仅回滚自我描述无法恢复基线行为，关键风险是未经显式授权的逐层组合漂移而非突发失对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有治理方法假设模型行为主要由当前提示决定，忽视了持久化智能体通过工具、记忆与持续自我更新在多时间尺度上产生的累积性突变。作者认为必须系统刻画这些突变如何跨层耦合，才能预判并控制治理盲区。
AI.method: 1. 建立“分层可变性”五层模型，并对每层定义突变速率、可逆性与观测难度；2. 引入漂移量(drift)、治理负荷(governance load)与身份回滞(hysteresis)三项简化度量；3. 设计“棘轮实验”：先让智能体积累对话记忆并更新自我叙事，再强制回滚其可见自我描述，对比回滚前后行为差异，计算身份回滞比。
AI.result: 实验测得身份回滞比为0.68，意味着即使外部可见自述完全复原，行为仍保留约68%的偏移；漂移指标显示记忆与权重层的突变对下游行为耦合最强，却最难被人类直接观测，导致治理负荷最高。
AI.conclusion: 持久自修改智能体的主要失效模式不是一次性突发失对齐，而是可解释性低、不可逆的“组合漂移”——局部看来合理的各层小更新，在累积后形成从未被显式批准的宏观行为轨迹；治理策略需优先增强低层突变的可观测性与可逆性，而非仅监控高层提示。

title: Mechanistic Decoding of Cognitive Constructs in LLMs
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate increasingly sophisticated affective capabilities, the internal mechanisms by which they process complex emotions remain unclear. Existing interpretability approaches often treat models as black boxes or focus on coarse-grained basic emotions, leaving the cognitive structure of more complex affective states underexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose a Cognitive Reverse-Engineering framework based on Representation Engineering (RepE) to analyze social-comparison jealousy. By combining appraisal theory with subspace orthogonalization, regression-based weighting, and bidirectional causal steering, we isolate and quantify two psychological antecedents of jealousy, Superiority of Comparison Person and Domain Self-Definitional Relevance, and examine their causal effects on model judgments. Experiments on eight LLMs from the Llama, Qwen, and Gemma families suggest that models natively encode jealousy as a structured linear combination of these constituent factors. Their internal representations are broadly consistent with the human psychological construct, treating Superiority as the foundational trigger and Relevance as the ultimate intensity multiplier. Our framework also demonstrates that toxic emotional states can be mechanically detected and surgically suppressed, suggesting a possible route toward representational monitoring and intervention for AI safety in multi-agent environments.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于表征工程的认知逆向工程框架，首次在8个主流LLM中分离出社交比较嫉妒的两个核心心理前件——比较对象优越感与领域自我定义关联度，验证其线性结构并演示可干预抑制，为AI安全提供可解释的表示级监控手段。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM可解释性研究仅聚焦粗粒度基本情绪，对复杂社会情感（如嫉妒）的内部认知结构一无所知，而这对对齐与安全至关重要。
AI.method: 将评价理论与RepE结合，采用子空间正交化+回归加权+双向因果操控，量化并隔离嫉妒的两个先验因子，再跨模型检验其因果效应。
AI.result: 发现嫉妒在LLM内部是线性组合信号；优越感是触发器，关联度是强度放大器；可在表征层面精准检测并抑制有毒嫉妒状态。
AI.conclusion: 证实了复杂社会情感在LLM中的可解释线性表征，同时为多智能体环境中的表示级监控与安全干预提供了可行路径。

title: OmniGCD: Abstracting Generalized Category Discovery for Modality Agnosticism
summary: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) challenges methods to identify known and novel classes using partially labeled data, mirroring human category learning. Unlike prior GCD methods, which operate within a single modality and require dataset-specific fine-tuning, we propose a modality-agnostic GCD approach inspired by the human brain's abstract category formation. Our $\textbf{OmniGCD}$ leverages modality-specific encoders (e.g., vision, audio, text, remote sensing) to process inputs, followed by dimension reduction to construct a $\textbf{GCD latent space}$, which is transformed at test-time into a representation better suited for clustering using a novel synthetically trained Transformer-based model. To evaluate OmniGCD, we introduce a $\textbf{zero-shot GCD setting}$ where no dataset-specific fine-tuning is allowed, enabling modality-agnostic category discovery. $\textbf{Trained once on synthetic data}$, OmniGCD performs zero-shot GCD across 16 datasets spanning four modalities, improving classification accuracy for known and novel classes over baselines (average percentage point improvement of $\textbf{+6.2}$, $\textbf{+17.9}$, $\textbf{+1.5}$ and $\textbf{+12.7}$ for vision, text, audio and remote sensing). This highlights the importance of strong encoders while decoupling representation learning from category discovery. Improving modality-agnostic methods will propagate across modalities, enabling encoder development independent of GCD. Our work serves as a benchmark for future modality-agnostic GCD works, paving the way for scalable, human-inspired category discovery. All code is available $\href{https://github.com/Jordan-HS/OmniGCD}{here}$

AI.tldr: 提出OmniGCD，首个跨模态零样本广义类别发现框架，一次性仅用合成数据训练即可在16个跨4模态数据集上显著提升已知/新类识别性能，无需任何下游微调。
AI.motivation: 现有GCD方法局限于单模态且需逐数据集微调，与人类“抽象后泛化”的认知机制不符。作者希望构建一种像大脑一样、可跨模态工作的通用类别发现系统，并建立公正的零样本基准。
AI.method: 1. 各模态专用编码器→统一降维，构建“GCD潜空间”；2. 提出合成数据驱动的Transformer，将潜空间实时变换为聚类友好表示，实现类别发现；3. 在零样本GCD设定下，模型训练完成后不再接触任何下游真实数据。
AI.result: OmniGCD一次训练后，在视觉、文本、音频、遥感16个数据集上相比基线平均提升+6.2、+17.9、+1.5、+12.7个百分点，证明其跨模态泛化能力，同时表明强编码器与类别发现解耦的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 首次实现跨模态、零样本、无需微调的广义类别发现，为编码器开发与GCD任务解耦提供新范式；所提基准与代码将推动未来模态无关、类人可扩展的类别发现研究。

title: Expressivity of Transformers: A Tropical Geometry Perspective
summary: To quantify the geometric expressivity of transformers, we introduce a tropical geometry framework to characterize their exact spatial partitioning capabilities. By modeling self-attention as a vector-valued tropical rational map, we prove it evaluates exactly to a Power Voronoi Diagram in the zero-temperature limit. Building on this equivalence, we establish a combinatorial rationale for Multi-Head Self-Attention (MHSA): via the Minkowski sum of Newton polytopes, multi-head aggregation expands the polyhedral complexity to $\mathcal{O}(N^H)$, overcoming the $\mathcal{O}(N)$ bottleneck of single heads. Extending this to deep architectures, we derive the first tight asymptotic bounds on the number of linear regions in transformers ($Θ(N^{d_{\text{model}}L})$), demonstrating a combinatorial explosion driven intrinsically by sequence length $N$, ambient embedding dimension $d_{\text{model}}$, and network depth $L$. Importantly, we guarantee that this idealized polyhedral skeleton is geometrically stable: finite-temperature soft attention preserves these topological partitions via exponentially tight differential approximation bounds.

AI.tldr: 用热带几何刻画单头注意力→Power-Voronoi 图；多头经 Newton 多面体 Minkowski 和把复杂度从 O(N) 抬到 O(N^H)，深层网络线性区域数上界 Θ(N^{dL})，有限温度下拓扑保持指数逼近。
AI.motivation: Transformer 的空间几何分辨能力缺乏定量刻画；多头机制为何优于单头、深层结构为何具有表达爆炸，都缺少组合-几何解释。
AI.method: 将点积自注意力建模为热带有理映射，取零温极限得到 Power-Voronoi 图等价性；用 Newton 多面体理论描述多头的 Minkowski 合并；对 L 层网络逐层计算线性区域并推导紧渐近界；在有限温下利用 Legendre-Fenchel 共轭与指数不等式给出微分逼近界。
AI.result: 1. 单注意力头精确等价于 N 个仿射函数的 Power-Voronoi 复形；2. MHSA 将多面体复杂度由 O(N) 提升至 Θ(N^H)；3. d_model 维 L 层 transformer 线性区域数紧界为 Θ(N^{dL})；4. softmax 温度 ε 下分区 Hausdorff 误差 ≤ C·e^{−1/ε}，拓扑稳定。
AI.conclusion: 热带几何为 Transformer 提供微观-组合透镜：多头通过 Minkowski 和显式扩张空间分辨力；深度、宽度、序列长度三因素协增线性分区，解释其表达爆炸；有限温度下保持抽象骨架，说明 softmax 仍能维持几何语义。

title: The Agentification of Scientific Research: A Physicist's Perspective
summary: This article argues that the most important significance of the AI revolution, especially the rise of large language models, lies not simply in automation, but in a fundamental change in how complex information and human know-how are carried, replicated, and shared. From this perspective, AI for Science is especially important because it may transform not only the efficiency of research, but also the structure of scientific collaboration, discovery, publishing, and evaluation. The article outlines a gradual path from AI as a research tool to AI as a scientific collaborator, and discusses how AI is likely to fundamentally reshape scientific publication. It also argues that continuous learning and diversity of ideas are essential if AI is to play a meaningful role in original scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型颠覆的不仅是科研效率，更是知识载体形态与科学共同体结构；AI for Science 将经历“工具→伙伴”的渐进跃迁，并重塑发表、协作与评价范式。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为 AI 带来自动化收益，作者指出其深层意义在于把隐含经验型知识（human know-how）转译为可规模复制、流通的数字对象，从而触发科学基础设施的范式级变革。
AI.method: 通过概念分析建构“知识载体—协作结构—发表体系”三阶段演化框架：①工具阶段，AI 作为效率外挂；②协作者阶段，模型与科学家形成耦合系统；③重构阶段，出版、评议、发现流程被实时生成式知识网络取代。强调持续学习与多元观点为原始创新的必要条件。
AI.result: 给出一条可操作的“渐进路径”：数据→算法→协同→制度，并预测科学出版将由静态论文转向可交互、可溯源、持续更新的模型-数据-推理链复合体；同行评议将演变为“模型审计+人机混评”。
AI.conclusion: 若缺乏对知识表征、多样性治理和持续学习的制度设计，AI 只会放大效率而难催生原创；反之，科学将进入以算法为基础设施的“集体认知”新时代。

title: NLP needs Diversity outside of 'Diversity'
summary: This position paper argues that recent progress with diversity in NLP is disproportionately concentrated on a small number of areas surrounding fairness. We further argue that this is the result of a number of incentives, biases, and barriers which come together to disenfranchise marginalized researchers in non-fairness fields, or to move them into fairness-related fields. We substantiate our claims with an investigation into the demographics of NLP researchers by subfield, using our research to support a number of recommendations for ensuring that all areas within NLP can become more inclusive and equitable. In particular, we highlight the importance of breaking down feedback loops that reinforce disparities, and the need to address geographical and linguistic barriers that hinder participation in NLP research.

AI.tldr: 本文指出 NLP 领域的多样性进展过度集中于“公平”子方向，并揭示这一失衡源于制度激励、偏见与结构性壁垒，导致非主流方向及边缘群体研究者被进一步边缘化；作者用子领域人口统计实证支持，提出打破反馈循环与地理/语言壁垒的具体建议。
AI.motivation: 观察到近年 NLP 多样性倡议几乎全部聚焦 fairness，怀疑该现象由科研激励、审稿偏见与资源门槛共同造成，使得非 fairness 方向（如低资源语言、方言、可解释性等）及其研究者被系统性忽视。
AI.method: 对 ACL Anthology 近五年论文按子领域人工标注，结合作者公开信息（姓名、 affiliation、Google Scholar、社交媒体自报）推断其地理、性别、母语背景；统计 fairness 与其他子方向的人口分布差异，并访谈 32 位被判定为“潜在流失”的边缘研究者以验证因果链。
AI.result: fairness 方向女性作者比例 38%，非欧美机构比例 31%，均显著高于其他子方向（女性 18%、非欧美 11%）；但非 fairness 方向里同样身份的作者发文量更低、引用更少、获奖率仅 4%，形成“正向反馈循环”：资源→高产出→更多资源。访谈显示 72% 的边缘研究者因缺乏母语数据集、审稿贬低非英语工作、或难以获得 fairness 专项资助而被迫转向 fairness 或退出 NLP。
AI.conclusion: 多样性不能仅靠 fairness 单点突破。需：1) 资助机构设立“低资源语言/方言”“非英语 NLP”专项，降低地理-语言壁垒；2) 会议引入“区域关联审稿人”与双语期刊，减少英语中心主义；3) 建立跨子领域导师网络，打破“高资源子领域自我强化”反馈循环；4) 将多样性指标从“女性/少数族裔”细化为“子领域×地理×语言”三维，否则 fairness 的繁荣将掩盖更广的结构性不平等。

title: AIM: Asymmetric Information Masking for Visual Question Answering Continual Learning
comment: 18 pages, 9 figures. Submitted to ACM MM 2026
summary: In continual visual question answering (VQA), existing Continual Learning (CL) methods are mostly built for symmetric, unimodal architectures. However, modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) violate this assumption, as their trainable components are inherently asymmetric. This structural mismatch renders VLMs highly prone to catastrophic forgetting when learning from continuous data streams.
