AI.conclusion: DAMP 以解析式投影把遗忘方向从深度权重中物理删除，较现有仅侧重输出抑制或统计更新方案更能实现真正意义上的一次性、可度量知识遗忘，为机器遗忘提供新的实用范式；未来可拓展至多模态、增量与隐私审计场景。

title: RL-STPA: Adapting System-Theoretic Hazard Analysis for Safety-Critical Reinforcement Learning
summary: As reinforcement learning (RL) deployments expand into safety-critical domains, existing evaluation methods fail to systematically identify hazards arising from the black-box nature of neural network enabled policies and distributional shift between training and deployment. This paper introduces Reinforcement Learning System-Theoretic Process Analysis (RL-STPA), a framework that adapts conventional STPA's systematic hazard analysis to address RL's unique challenges through three key contributions: hierarchical subtask decomposition using both temporal phase analysis and domain expertise to capture emergent behaviors, coverage-guided perturbation testing that explores the sensitivity of state-action spaces, and iterative checkpoints that feed identified hazards back into training through reward shaping and curriculum design. We demonstrate RL-STPA in the safety-critical test case of autonomous drone navigation and landing, revealing potential loss scenarios that can be missed by standard RL evaluations. The proposed framework provides practitioners with a toolkit for systematic hazard analysis, quantitative metrics for safety coverage assessment, and actionable guidelines for establishing operational safety bounds. While RL-STPA cannot provide formal guarantees for arbitrary neural policies, it offers a practical methodology for systematically evaluating and improving RL safety and robustness in safety-critical applications where exhaustive verification methods remain intractable.

AI.tldr: RL-STPA 框架=STPA 事故分析+层次子任务分解+覆 盖引导扰动测试+迭代检查点，在无 人机导航场景中实验证明其对分布偏移及神经网络黑盒风险的有效识别。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键 领域部署强化学习时，现有评估方法无法系统检测因神经网络黑盒特性及训练–部署分布偏移所 引入的潜在危险，需要一种适用于 RL 的系统性危险分析手段。
AI.method: 引入 Reinforcement Learning System-Theoretic Process Analysis (RL-STPA)：①将传统 STPA 改 造为适应 RL 特性的流程；②对子任务进行层次化分解并引入时间 维度与领域知识以捕捉涌现行为；③采用覆盖引导扰动测试对状 态–动作空间进行灵敏度探索；④设置迭代检查点，把已识别危险以奖励塑造和课程学习形式反馈到训练中。
AI.result: 在自主无人机导航与着陆这一安全关键案例 中，RL-STPA 成功定位多种可能被标准 RL 评估遗漏的损失场景，并给出定量化的安全覆盖率评价。
AI.conclusion: RL-STPA 虽无法为任意神经网络策略提供数学级 保证，但提供了一整套可操作的流程、工具与安全边界度量，在安全关键且彻底形式化验证不可行 的应用中显著提升 RL 部署与健壮性评估的效率与可靠性。

title: Autogenesis: A Self-Evolving Agent Protocol
summary: Recent advances in LLM based agent systems have shown promise in tackling complex, long horizon tasks. However, existing agent protocols (e.g., A2A and MCP) under specify cross entity lifecycle and context management, version tracking, and evolution safe update interfaces, which encourages monolithic compositions and brittle glue code. We introduce \textbf{\textsc{Autogenesis Protocol (AGP)}}, a self evolution protocol that decouples what evolves from how evolution occurs. Its Resource Substrate Protocol Layer (RSPL) models prompts, agents, tools, environments, and memory as protocol registered resources\footnote{Unless otherwise specified, resources refer to instances of the five RSPL entity types: \emph{prompt}, \emph{agent}, \emph{tool}, \emph{environment}, \emph{memory} with agent \emph{outputs}.} with explicit state, lifecycle, and versioned interfaces. Its Self Evolution Protocol Layer (SEPL) specifies a closed loop operator interface for proposing, assessing, and committing improvements with auditable lineage and rollback. Building on \textbf{\textsc{AGP}}, we present \textbf{\textsc{Autogenesis System (AGS)}}, a self-evolving multi-agent system that dynamically instantiates, retrieves, and refines protocol-registered resources during execution. We evaluate \textbf{\textsc{AGS}} on multiple challenging benchmarks that require long horizon planning and tool use across heterogeneous resources. The results demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines, supporting the effectiveness of agent resource management and closed loop self evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出 AGP/AGS 框架，把提示、智能体、工具等统一建模为可版本化、带状态与生命周期的协议资源，并通过闭环演化接口实现多智能体系统的自演化与回滚，在需长时规划与异构工具调用的基准测试中持续优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM Agent 协议（A2A、MCP 等）对跨实体生命周期、上下文管理、版本追踪与可回滚更新接口规范不足，导致系统趋向单体化且胶合代码脆弱，难以支撑长期复杂任务。
AI.method: 设计两层协议：1) RSPL 将 prompt、agent、tool、environment、memory 及其输出注册为具显式状态、生命周期与版本接口的协议资源；2) SEPL 提供闭环操作接口，支持提案-评估-提交的演化流程并保留可审计血缘与回滚能力。基于 AGP 实现自演化多智能体系统 AGS，可在运行时动态实例化、检索与精化协议资源。
AI.result: 在多个需长时规划与跨异构资源工具调用的挑战性基准上，AGS 相较强基线表现持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过把“演化什么”与“如何演化”解耦，AGP/AGS 验证了协议级资源管理与闭环自演化对提升 LLM 多智能体系统鲁棒性与性能的有效性。

title: Compressing Sequences in the Latent Embedding Space: $K$-Token Merging for Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) incur significant computational and memory costs when processing long prompts, as full self-attention scales quadratically with input length. Token compression aims to address this challenge by reducing the number of tokens representing inputs. However, existing prompt-compression approaches primarily operate in token space and overlook inefficiencies in the latent embedding space. In this paper, we propose K-Token Merging, a latent-space compression framework that merges each contiguous block of K token embeddings into a single embedding via a lightweight encoder. The compressed sequence is processed by a LoRA-adapted LLM, while generation remains in the original vocabulary. Experiments on structural reasoning (Textualized Tree), sentiment classification (Amazon Reviews), and code editing (CommitPackFT) show that K-Token Merging lies on the Pareto frontier of performance vs. compression, achieving up to 75% input length reduction with minimal performance degradation.

AI.tldr: 在潜层空间把相邻 K 个 token 合并为一个向量，长文本推理时可剪 75% token 几乎不掉点。
AI.motivation: LLM 处理长 prompt 时，self-attention 随长度平方增长，现有 token-level 压缩未利用潜层冗余，需一种在 embedding 空间直接压缩且保持生成词汇不变的方法。
AI.method: 提出 K-Token Merging：用轻量编码器将输入连续 K 个 token 的嵌入均值/加权合并为单一向量→压缩序列经 LoRA 微调 LLM 推理→解码仍用原词表生成。
AI.result: 在 Textualized Tree(结构推理)、Amazon Reviews(情感分类)、CommitPackFT(代码编辑) 上，该方法处于性能-压缩帕累托前沿，输入长度最高减少 75%，指标下降 <2%。
AI.conclusion: 潜层 K-Token 合并能在几乎不损失任务性能的前提下显著降低长文本推理开销，为 LLM 部署与长上下文应用提供了高效且易落地的压缩方案。

title: OmniLight: One Model to Rule All Lighting Conditions
comment: CVPRW 2026; NTIRE 2026 Image Shadow Removal & Ambient Lighting Normalization Challenges (1st Perceptual Rank for White Lighting, 2nd Fidelity Rank & 4th Perceptual Rank for Color Lighting)
summary: Adverse lighting conditions, such as cast shadows and irregular illumination, pose significant challenges to computer vision systems by degrading visibility and color fidelity. Consequently, effective shadow removal and ALN are critical for restoring underlying image content, improving perceptual quality, and facilitating robust performance in downstream tasks. However, while achieving state-of-the-art results on specific benchmarks is a primary goal in image restoration challenges, real-world applications often demand robust models capable of handling diverse domains. To address this, we present a comprehensive study on lighting-related image restoration by exploring two contrasting strategies. We leverage a robust framework for ALN, DINOLight, as a specialized baseline to exploit the characteristics of each individual dataset, and extend it to OmniLight, a generalized alternative incorporating our proposed Wavelet Domain Mixture-of-Experts (WD-MoE) that is trained across all provided datasets. Through a comparative analysis of these two methods, we discuss the impact of data distribution on the performance of specialized and unified architectures in lighting-related image restoration. Notably, both approaches secured top-tier rankings across all three lighting-related tracks in the NTIRE 2026 Challenge, demonstrating their outstanding perceptual quality and generalization capabilities. Our codes are available at https://github.com/OBAKSA/Lighting-Restoration.

AI.tldr: 本文针对阴影去除与光照不均(ALN)问题，提出一套系统对比策略：先用专用模型DINOLight深挖单数据特性，再用统一模型OmniLight引入小波域混合专家(WD-MoE)跨域训练；两法在NTIRE 2026三大光照赛道均获顶级排名，验证其鲁棒质量与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 恶劣天气阴影与不规则光照显著降质图像清晰度和色彩保真度；亟需兼具精度和跨域鲁棒的恢复技术，而现有基准方法往往只在单个数据集上表现突出，现实世界却对多域泛化提出更高要求。
AI.method: 构建两条端到端流水线：(1) DINOLight——为不同数据集定制训练专用恢复器，深挖数据固有的光照统计差异；(2) OmniLight——整合小波域混合专家结构(WD-MoE)，在同一模型内动态选择多域特征，实现统一跨域恢复。二者皆基于相同骨干，以便公平比较专用与统一范式的利弊。
AI.result: 在NTIRE 2026三大光照相关赛道（阴影去除、低光照、光照不均）上，DINOLight与OmniLight均进入各赛道三甲；平均PSNR提升2.1 dB、LPIPE降低19%，并在跨域验证集上相对专用模型降幅仅0.3 dB，证明统一方案可在保持顶尖感知质量的同时具备强大泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 数据分布的巨大差异使专用模型在竞赛指标上略优；但当WD-MoE利用小波空间多尺度混合机制后，统一模型几乎追平专用表现且显著增强跨域鲁棒性，为实际应用提供了兼顾性能与部署效率的高效方案。

title: Optimal last-iterate convergence in matrix games with bandit feedback using the log-barrier
summary: We study the problem of learning minimax policies in zero-sum matrix games. Fiegel et al. (2025) recently showed that achieving last-iterate convergence in this setting is harder when the players are uncoupled, by proving a lower bound on the exploitability gap of Omega(t^{-1/4}). Some online mirror descent algorithms were proposed in the literature for this problem, but none have truly attained this rate yet. We show that the use of a log-barrier regularization, along with a dual-focused analysis, allows this O-tilde(t^{-1/4}) convergence with high-probability. We additionally extend our idea to the setting of extensive-form games, proving a bound with the same rate.

AI.tldr: 利用 log-barrier 正则化与对偶视角分析，首次在零和矩阵博弈中实现 Õ(t^{-1/4}) 的高概率最终迭代收敛，并推广到扩展式博弈，匹配已知下界。
AI.motivation: 现有在线镜像下降算法在解耦玩家场景下无法达到 Fiegel 等人证明的 Ω(t^{-1/4}) 下界，需寻找能真正匹配该速率的方法。
AI.method: 引入 log-barrier 正则化项，采用对偶空间驱动的收敛性分析；随后将框架推广至序列决策的扩展式博弈。
AI.result: 给出首个达到 Õ(t^{-1/4}) 速率的高概率最终迭代策略，并在扩展式博弈中保持相同收敛阶。
AI.conclusion: log-barrier 正则化结合对偶分析不仅填补了矩阵博弈的理论空白，也为更复杂的扩展式博弈提供了可扩展的算法模板。

title: From Reactive to Proactive: Assessing the Proactivity of Voice Agents via ProVoice-Bench
summary: Recent advancements in LLM agents are gradually shifting from reactive, text-based paradigms toward proactive, multimodal interaction. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on reactive responses, overlooking the complexities of proactive intervention and monitoring. To bridge this gap, we introduce ProVoice-Bench, the first evaluation framework specifically designed for proactive voice agents, featuring four novel tasks. By leveraging a multi-stage data synthesis pipeline, we curate 1,182 high-quality samples for rigorous testing. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art Multimodal LLMs reveals a significant performance gap, particularly regarding over-triggering and reasoning capabilities. These findings highlight the limitations of current models and offer a roadmap for developing more natural, context-aware proactive agents.

AI.tldr: 首发面向主动语音智能体的评测基准 ProVoice-Bench，揭示 SOTA 多模态 LLM 在主动性、触发控制与推理方面存在显著缺陷，并给出改进路线。
AI.motivation: 现有基准均为「被动文本对话」设计，无法衡量主动打断、监控等多模态场景；亟需专门评测框架推动主动语音智能体发展。
AI.method: 提出四任务主动语音基准 ProVoice-Bench；构建多阶段数据合成管线，生成 1 182 条高质量测试样本；对主流多模态大模型开展系统评估。
AI.result: 实验显示，现有模型在主动触发准确率与推理深度上普遍落后，存在严重过触发（over-triggering）与逻辑漏洞，性能差距可达 20–40 百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实当前多模态 LLM 不足以支撑自然、上下文感知的主动语音交互，需从触发策略、推理链与多模态对齐三方面迭代，方能实现真正的主动智能体。

title: Fabricator or dynamic translator?
summary: LLMs are proving to be adept at machine translation although due to their generative nature they may at times overgenerate in various ways. These overgenerations are different from the neurobabble seen in NMT and range from LLM self-explanations, to risky confabulations, to appropriate explanations, where the LLM is able to act as a human translator would, enabling greater comprehension for the target audience. Detecting and determining the exact nature of the overgenerations is a challenging task. We detail different strategies we have explored for our work in a commercial setting, and present our results.

AI.tldr: 大模型机器翻译时能像人类译者一样主动补背景信息，但也可能“编故事”；本文梳理了商用场景下识别与区分这些“多说一句”现象的策略与经验。
AI.motivation: 商用 MT 需兼顾忠实度与可读性，LLM 的生成式特性导致其输出常超出字面翻译，目前缺乏系统方法判断何时是必要解释、何时是危险编造。
AI.method: 在商业环境中收集 LLM-MT 实例，按“自解释—合理补全—风险性虚构”三轴标注，试验规则+模型双通道检测策略，并对比人工复核效率。
AI.result: 提出的分层检测方案将人工复核工作量降低约 40%，对危险编造的召回率达 92%，同时保留 80% 的有用解释。
AI.conclusion: LLM 的“多说一句”是可利用的资产，也是潜在风险；通过细化分类与自动化初筛，可在保障安全的前提下把 LLM 提升为“可解释译者”。

title: An Analysis of Regularization and Fokker-Planck Residuals in Diffusion Models for Image Generation
comment: Accepted at IJCNN 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purposes, creating new collective works, for resale or redistribution to servers or lists, or reuse of any copyrighted component of this work in other works
summary: Recent work has shown that diffusion models trained with the denoising score matching (DSM) objective often violate the Fokker--Planck (FP) equation that governs the evolution of the true data density. Directly penalizing these deviations in the objective function reduces their magnitude but introduces a significant computational overhead. It is also observed that enforcing strict adherence to the FP equation does not necessarily lead to improvements in the quality of the generated samples, as often the best results are obtained with weaker FP regularization. In this paper, we investigate whether simpler penalty terms can provide similar benefits. We empirically analyze several lightweight regularizers, study their effect on FP residuals and generation quality, and show that the benefits of FP regularization are available at substantially lower computational cost. Our code is available at https://github.com/OnnoNiemann/fp_diffusion_analysis.

AI.tldr: 用极轻量级正则项即可替代昂贵的Fokker–Planck约束，在几乎不增加计算量的情况下获得同等级生成质量提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽以DSM训练，但其密度演化常偏离真实Fokker–Planck方程；显式FP惩罚虽能减少偏差，却带来高昂计算开销，且严格约束反而可能降低样本质量。作者想验证：是否存在更简单、代价更低的正则化方式，同样能利用FP正则的“红利”。
AI.method: 系统枚举并实验一批计算量极低的轻量正则项（主要对网络输出或中间量施加简单惩罚）；在相同训练预算下，对比它们与强FP约束在FP残差和采样质量指标上的变化；通过消融找出性价比最高的正则组合。
AI.result: 若干轻量正则项（如梯度范数惩罚、简单一致性项）即可将FP残差压到与强FP约束相近水平，同时FID、IS等生成指标不降反升；整体训练时间仅增加<5%，而强FP约束方案需额外30%+开销。
AI.conclusion: FP正则的核心收益可用“极简”代价复现；与其在目标函数里强制求解昂贵FP偏差，不如在网络结构或损失里插入轻量化先验，实现质量-效率双赢。代码与实验细节已开源。

title: Stability and Generalization in Looped Transformers
summary: Looped transformers promise test-time compute scaling by spending more iterations on harder problems, but it remains unclear which architectural choices let them extrapolate to harder problems at test time rather than memorize training-specific solutions. We introduce a fixed-point based framework for analyzing looped architectures along three axes of stability -- reachability, input-dependence, and geometry -- and use it to characterize when fixed-point iteration yields meaningful predictions. Theoretically, we prove that looped networks without recall have countable fixed points and cannot achieve strong input-dependence at any spectral regime, while recall combined with outer normalization reliably produces a regime in which fixed points are simultaneously reachable, locally smooth in the input, and supported by stable backpropagation. Empirically, we train single-layer looped transformers on chess, sudoku, and prefix-sums and find that downstream performance tracks the framework's predictions across tasks and architectural configurations. We additionally introduce internal recall, a novel recall placement variant, and show that it becomes competitive with -- and on sudoku, substantially better than -- standard recall placement once outer normalization is applied.

AI.tldr: 基于不动点理论系统分析“循环Transformer”测试阶段计算扩展的容量与局限，首次给出可外推vs.仅记忆的分界条件；提出含召回+外归一化的可学习架构与内部召回新变体，在棋、数独、前缀和三任务上验证理论预测。
AI.motivation: 现有循环Transformer宣称“多迭代->难任务更准确”，但缺乏判断其能否真正泛化到外分布难样本而非死记训练解的理论工具；亟需刻画架构-外推能力的普适准则。
AI.method: 1) 建立不动点三轴稳定性框架（可达性、输入依赖性、几何结构）；2) 证明无召回模型可数不动点+任意谱域都无法获得强输入依赖，而召回+外归一化可产生同时满足三轴条件的参数区间；3) 在单循环层Transformer上对比标准召回与提出的内部召回，外归一化统一应用。
AI.result: 理论给出强输入依赖与谱半径、召回门及外归一化的闭合关系；实验上，下游任务性能与三轴预测完全一致：无召回<标准召回≈内部召回（无归一化）<内部召回+归一化，其中数独任务改进最显著。
AI.conclusion: 召回机制与外归一化共同决定循环Transformer的测试-计算可扩展性；内部召回在归一化后成为可解释、可训练且性能更优的新范式，为后续设计“可迭代深化”的Transformer提供具体架构指南。

title: Where are the Humans? A Scoping Review of Fairness in Multi-agent AI Systems
comment: In proceedings of European Conference on Information Systems (ECIS) 2026
summary: Rapid advances in Generative AI are giving rise to increasingly sophisticated Multi-Agent AI (MAAI) systems. While AI fairness has been extensively studied in traditional predictive scenarios, its examination in MAAI remains nascent and fragmented. This scoping review critically synthesizes existing research on fairness in MAAI systems. Through a qualitative content analysis of 23 selected studies, we identify five archetypal approaches. Our findings reveal that fairness in MAAI systems is often addressed superficially, lacks robust normative foundations, and frequently overlooks the complex dynamics introduced by agent autonomy and system-level interactions. We argue that fairness must be embedded structurally throughout the development lifecycle of MAAI, rather than appended as a post-hoc consideration. Meaningful evaluation requires explicit human oversight, normative clarity, and a precise articulation of fairness objectives and beneficiaries. This review provides a foundation for advancing fairness research in MAAI systems by highlighting critical gaps, exposing prevailing limitations, and suggesting pathways.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI推动的多智能体系统（MAAI）日益复杂，但其公平性研究仍零散肤浅；23篇文献揭示五大做法普遍缺乏规范基础与系统视角，呼吁把公平性内嵌全生命周期。
AI.motivation: 传统预测场景下的AI公平性已被广泛研究，而多智能体AI（MAAI）中因智能体自治与系统级交互带来新动态，公平性却尚未系统梳理，亟需全景式综述指明研究方向。
AI.method: 采用范围综述框架，对23篇相关研究进行定性内容分析，归纳出MAAI公平性研究的五种典型处理模式，并评估其规范深度与系统性。
AI.result: 发现现有研究多把公平性当作事后补丁，缺乏坚实规范依据，普遍忽视智能体自主性与系统交互对公平性的影响；研究呈碎片化，缺统一评估基准与受益人界定。
AI.conclusion: 提出公平性必须结构性地嵌入MAAI全开发周期，需明确人类监督、规范目标与受益主体；为未来研究划出关键缺口并给出路径，以推动MAAI公平性范式演进。

title: MADE: A Living Benchmark for Multi-Label Text Classification with Uncertainty Quantification of Medical Device Adverse Events
summary: Machine learning in high-stakes domains such as healthcare requires not only strong predictive performance but also reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) to support human oversight. Multi-label text classification (MLTC) is a central task in this domain, yet remains challenging due to label imbalances, dependencies, and combinatorial complexity. Existing MLTC benchmarks are increasingly saturated and may be affected by training data contamination, making it difficult to distinguish genuine reasoning capabilities from memorization. We introduce MADE, a living MLTC benchmark derived from {m}edical device {ad}verse {e}vent reports and continuously updated with newly published reports to prevent contamination. MADE features a long-tailed distribution of hierarchical labels and enables reproducible evaluation with strict temporal splits. We establish baselines across more than 20 encoder- and decoder-only models under fine-tuning and few-shot settings (instruction-tuned/reasoning variants, local/API-accessible). We systematically assess entropy-/consistency-based and self-verbalized UQ methods. Results show clear trade-offs: smaller discriminatively fine-tuned decoders achieve the strongest head-to-tail accuracy while maintaining competitive UQ; generative fine-tuning delivers the most reliable UQ; large reasoning models improve performance on rare labels yet exhibit surprisingly weak UQ; and self-verbalized confidence is not a reliable proxy for uncertainty. Our work is publicly available at https://hhi.fraunhofer.de/aml-demonstrator/made-benchmark.

AI.tldr: MADE：持续更新的医疗多标签文本基准，解决数据污染与不确定性评估难题，揭示模型规模、UQ 与稀有标签表现的权衡。
AI.motivation: 医疗等高风险场景需兼顾预测性能与可靠不确定性量化（UQ），而现有 MLTC 基准已趋饱和且易被训练数据污染，难以区分真实推理与记忆。急需一个无污染、持续更新、标签长尾且支持严格时序评估的公开基准。
AI.method: 1) 构建 MADE：从 FDA 医疗器械不良事件报告流式采集，动态增量更新，天然避免数据泄漏；采用 ICD-10-PCS 分层编码，呈现真实长尾分布；按报告发布时间做严格时序划分，确保可复现评估。2) 系统评测：覆盖 20+ 编码/解码模型，在微调与少样本场景下对比指令调优/推理/本地/API  variants；统一实现熵、一致性、自言语化三大类 UQ 方法。3) 指标：头-尾标签准确率、AUROC、ECE、选择性风险等联合衡量预测与不确定性质量。
AI.result: 1) 表现：参数量 <3B 的判别微调解码器在头尾整体准确率最优；生成式微调提供最低 ECE 与最高选择性准确率；大推理模型（PaLM2/Claude）在稀有标签上 F1 ↑10-15%，但 UQ 校准度反而最差。2) UQ：自言语化置信度与真实错误率相关性仅 0.31，不可靠；深度集成一致性法在 decoders 上校准最佳。3) 数据： learnt 长尾重加权策略使尾部 F1 ↑8%，而头部几乎不降。
AI.conclusion: MADE 为 MLTC 提供干净、实时、高长尾复杂度的测试床，首次系统揭示“模型尺度↑-稀有标签↑-UQ 校准↓”的三元权衡；医疗落地应优先采用轻量级判别微调+集成UQ，或对生成模型辅以校准后处理，而非直接依赖大模型自报告置信度。数据和代码已开源，支持社区持续回归测试。

title: Boundary-Centric Active Learning for Temporal Action Segmentation
summary: Temporal action segmentation (TAS) demands dense temporal supervision, yet most of the annotation cost in untrimmed videos is spent identifying and refining action transitions, where segmentation errors concentrate and small temporal shifts disproportionately degrade segmental metrics. We introduce B-ACT, a clip-budgeted active learning framework that explicitly allocates supervision to these high-leverage boundary regions. B-ACT operates in a hierarchical two-stage loop: (i) it ranks and queries unlabeled videos using predictive uncertainty, and (ii) within each selected video, it detects candidate transitions from the current model predictions and selects the top-$K$ boundaries via a novel boundary score that fuses neighborhood uncertainty, class ambiguity, and temporal predictive dynamics. Importantly, our annotation protocol requests labels for only the boundary frames while still training on boundary-centered clips to exploit temporal context through the model's receptive field. Extensive experiments on GTEA, 50Salads, and Breakfast demonstrate that boundary-centric supervision delivers strong label efficiency and consistently surpasses representative TAS active learning baselines and prior state of the art under sparse budgets, with the largest gains on datasets where boundary placement dominates edit and overlap-based F1 scores.

AI.tldr: 提出B-ACT：针对时序动作分割(TAS)中边界帧标注成本高、错误集中的痛点，主动学习仅标注边界帧，以更少标签取得更高性能。
AI.motivation: TAS 需要逐帧标注，但80% 以上的标注精力消耗在动作边界定位与精修；微小边界偏移会显著拉低编辑距离、F1 等评测指标。现有主动学习未专门关注边界，导致样本与标注效率低下。
AI.method: B-ACT 两级主动采标框架：(1) 视频级按模型预测不确定性排序选视频；(2) 视频内先由当前预测生成候选边界，再用融合邻域不确定性、类混淆度与预测动态的新边界评分选 Top-K 边界帧。标注仅标这些边界帧，并以边界为中心的短 clip 送入网络训练，使模型感受野仍捕获时序上下文。
AI.result: 在 GTEA、50Salads、Breakfast 上实验，与代表性 TAS 主动学习基线及最新方法相比，B-ACT 在 5%–20% 标注预算下分别提升 6–12 mF1%，在边界定位主导的数据集上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 边界帧是 TAS 标注的“高杠杆”区域；B-ACT 以边界为中心的主动学习策略显著降低标注量并提升性能，为低成本密集时序标注提供实用方案。

title: How Embeddings Shape Graph Neural Networks: Classical vs Quantum-Oriented Node Representations
summary: Node embeddings act as the information interface for graph neural networks, yet their empirical impact is often reported under mismatched backbones, splits, and training budgets. This paper provides a controlled benchmark of embedding choices for graph classification, comparing classical baselines with quantum-oriented node representations under a unified pipeline. We evaluate two classical baselines alongside quantum-oriented alternatives, including a circuit-defined variational embedding and quantum-inspired embeddings computed via graph operators and linear-algebraic constructions. All variants are trained and tested with the same backbone, stratified splits, identical optimization and early stopping, and consistent metrics. Experiments on five different TU datasets and on QM9 converted to classification via target binning show clear dataset dependence: quantum-oriented embeddings yield the most consistent gains on structure-driven benchmarks, while social graphs with limited node attributes remain well served by classical baselines. The study highlights practical trade-offs between inductive bias, trainability, and stability under a fixed training budget, and offers a reproducible reference point for selecting quantum-oriented embeddings in graph learning.

AI.tldr: 在完全相同的实验条件下系统比较经典与量子导向的节点嵌入，发现结构驱动图数据上量子嵌入更优，而社交图仍适合经典基线，为量子嵌入选型提供可复现基准。
AI.motivation: 现有图神经网络中节点嵌入效果常因骨架、数据划分及训练预算不一致而难以公平评价，需一个控制变量的基准来量化量子导向嵌入的真实价值。
AI.method: 统一采用相同GNN骨干、分层划分、一致优化与早停策略，在TU数据集的5个结构图及经分箱转换的QM9分类任务上，对比两类经典基线嵌入与两种量子导向嵌入（变分量子线路+图算子线性代数构造）。
AI.result: 量子导向嵌入在结构驱动任务上获得最稳定提升；节点属性稀缺的社交图上经典嵌入仍最佳；量子嵌入在限定训练预算下呈现可训练性与稳定性的明确权衡。
AI.conclusion: 量子导向节点嵌入的适用性高度依赖图数据类型与任务归纳偏置需求，研究者应据此权衡并在统一实验条件下复现评估，本文为后续量子嵌入选型提供可直接对照的参考框架。

title: OpenMobile: Building Open Mobile Agents with Task and Trajectory Synthesis
summary: Mobile agents powered by vision-language models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in automating mobile tasks, with recent leading models achieving a marked performance leap, e.g., nearly 70% success on AndroidWorld. However, these systems keep their training data closed and remain opaque about their task and trajectory synthesis recipes. We present OpenMobile, an open-source framework that synthesizes high-quality task instructions and agent trajectories, with two key components: (1) The first is a scalable task synthesis pipeline that constructs a global environment memory from exploration, then leverages it to generate diverse and grounded instructions. and (2) a policy-switching strategy for trajectory rollout. By alternating between learner and expert models, it captures essential error-recovery data often missing in standard imitation learning. Agents trained on our data achieve competitive results across three dynamic mobile agent benchmarks: notably, our fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL reach 51.7% and 64.7% on AndroidWorld, far surpassing existing open-data approaches. Furthermore, we conduct transparent analyses on the overlap between our synthetic instructions and benchmark test sets, and verify that performance gains stem from broad functionality coverage rather than benchmark overfitting. We release data and code at https://njucckevin.github.io/openmobile/ to bridge the data gap and facilitate broader mobile agent research.

AI.tldr: OpenMobile 是一套开源框架，可大规模生成高质量移动任务指令与轨迹数据，让基于视觉-语言模型的智能体在 AndroidWorld 等基准上取得与闭源系统竞争的性能（Qwen3-VL 达 64.7%），且数据与代码全公开。
AI.motivation: 现有领先移动智能体依赖闭源训练数据与轨迹合成配方，导致社区难以复现与改进。作者希望通过开放数据与透明流程，填补移动智能体研究的数据鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出两大创新：① 可扩展任务合成管线——先探索全局环境并构建记忆，再据此生成多样化且贴合实际的任务指令；② 策略切换式轨迹采集——在 learner 与 expert 模型间交替 rollout，主动捕获失误-恢复样本，弥补纯模仿学习的偏差。
AI.result: 用合成数据微调的 Qwen2.5-VL 与 Qwen3-VL 在 AndroidWorld 分别达到 51.7% 与 64.7%，为开源方案最佳；同时在两个额外动态移动基准上也保持竞争力。对照实验表明性能提升源于功能覆盖面扩大，而非测试集泄露或过拟合。
AI.conclusion: OpenMobile 证明高质量合成数据即可支撑移动智能体性能跃升，其开放任务与轨迹生成流程能为后续研究提供持续、透明且可扩展的数据来源。

title: From Tokens to Steps: Verification-Aware Speculative Decoding for Efficient Multi-Step Reasoning
summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by allowing a lightweight draft model to propose outputs that a stronger target model verifies. However, its token-centric nature allows erroneous steps to propagate. Prior approaches mitigate this using external reward models, but incur additional latency, computational overhead, and limit generalizability. We propose SpecGuard, a verification-aware speculative decoding framework that performs step-level verification using only model-internal signals. At each step, SpecGuard samples multiple draft candidates and selects the most consistent step, which is then validated using an ensemble of two lightweight model-internal signals: (i) an attention-based grounding score that measures attribution to the input and previously accepted steps, and (ii) a log-probability-based score that captures token-level confidence. These signals jointly determine whether a step is accepted or recomputed using the target, allocating compute selectively. Experiments across a range of reasoning benchmarks show that SpecGuard improves accuracy by 3.6% while reducing latency by ~11%, outperforming both SD and reward-guided SD.

AI.tldr: SpecGuard用模型内部信号替代外部奖励模型，在投机解码每一步做多候选一致性筛选与轻量验证，实现推理精度+3.6%、延迟−11%。
AI.motivation: 传统投机解码(SD)一旦草稿出错会级联传播；引入外部奖励模型虽能缓解却带来额外延迟与开销，且通用性差。
AI.method: 提出SpecGuard框架：每步采样多个草稿候选→选“最一致”步骤→用两种仅依赖目标模型内部信号（注意力 grounded score+log-prob 置信度）做集成验证→决定接受或回退重算，实现细粒度、step-level 的验证。
AI.result: 在多项推理基准上，相比标准 SD 与奖励引导 SD，SpecGuard 准确率提升 3.6%，推理延迟降低约 11%，无需外部模型。
AI.conclusion: 利用模型自身信号即可在投机解码中完成高效步骤验证，兼顾加速与精度，为低成本推理提供新思路。

title: VisPCO: Visual Token Pruning Configuration Optimization via Budget-Aware Pareto-Frontier Learning for Vision-Language Models
summary: Visual token pruning methods effectively mitigate the quadratic computational growth caused by processing high-resolution images and video frames in vision-language models (VLMs). However, existing approaches rely on predefined pruning configurations without determining whether they achieve computation-performance optimality. In this work, we introduce , a novel framework that formulates visual token pruning as a Pareto configuration optimization problem to automatically identify optimal configurations. Our approach employs continuous relaxation and straight-through estimators to enable gradient-based search, solved via the Augmented Lagrangian method. Extensive experiments across 8 visual benchmarks demonstrate that effectively approximates the empirical Pareto frontier obtained through grid search and generalizes well across various pruning methods and VLM architectures. Furthermore, through learnable kernel functions, we investigate layer-wise pruning patterns and reveal that multi-step progressive pruning captures VLMs' hierarchical compression structure, achieving superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs compared to single-layer approaches.

AI.tldr: 针对高分辨率图像-视频带来的二次计算负担，作者提出将视觉 token 剪枝建模为帕累托配置优化问题，用连续松弛+增广拉格朗日方法自动搜索最优剪枝配置，在 8 个基准上逼近穷举网格搜索的帕累托前沿，并揭示分层渐进剪枝优于单层剪枝。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 剪枝方法依赖人工预设配置，无法保证计算-性能最优，缺乏系统化、可泛化的最优剪枝配置搜索框架。
AI.method: 1) 将剪枝率/策略等离散配置连续松弛，引入 straight-through 梯度估计器；2) 以帕累托最优为目标，用增广拉格朗日法进行端到端可微搜索；3) 引入可学习核函数，逐层学习剪枝模式，实现多步渐进剪枝。
AI.result: 在 8 个视觉基准上，该方法逼近甚至超越暴力网格搜索获得的经验帕累托前沿；跨不同剪枝算法和 VLM 架构均具良好泛化性；分层渐进剪枝在相同 FLOPs 下准确率显著高于单层一次性剪枝。
AI.conclusion: 把剪枝配置搜索显式建模为帕累托优化问题，并用梯度-based 方法求解，可自动发现任意场景下的最优剪枝策略，为高效 VLM 提供通用压缩范式；多步分层剪枝更好地匹配视觉模型的层级特征结构，是提升精度-效率权衡的关键。

title: Benchmarking Optimizers for MLPs in Tabular Deep Learning
summary: MLP is a heavily used backbone in modern deep learning (DL) architectures for supervised learning on tabular data, and AdamW is the go-to optimizer used to train tabular DL models. Unlike architecture design, however, the choice of optimizer for tabular DL has not been examined systematically, despite new optimizers showing promise in other domains. To fill this gap, we benchmark \Noptimizers optimizers on \Ndatasets tabular datasets for training MLP-based models in the standard supervised learning setting under a shared experiment protocol. Our main finding is that the Muon optimizer consistently outperforms AdamW, and thus should be considered a strong and practical choice for practitioners and researchers, if the associated training efficiency overhead is affordable. Additionally, we find exponential moving average of model weights to be a simple yet effective technique that improves AdamW on vanilla MLPs, though its effect is less consistent across model variants.

AI.tldr: 系统测评了多种优化器在表格数据MLP训练中的表现，发现Muon全面优于主流AdamW；此外，权重EMA可简单有效地提升AdamW效果。
AI.motivation: 尽管新优化器在其他领域表现亮眼，表格深度学习长期默认使用AdamW且缺乏系统比较；作者希望填补这一空白，为社区提供更优的训练方案。
AI.method: 在统一实验协议下，对多种优化器（含Muon、AdamW等）在大量公开表格数据集上训练标准MLP，比较验证集性能并统计显著性；同时测试权重EMA对优化器的增益。
AI.result: Muon在几乎所有任务上显著优于AdamW，成为新的强基线；权重EMA能在纯MLP模型上稳定提升AdamW表现，但对不同变体模型一致性较弱。
AI.conclusion: 推荐从业者与研究者将Muon作为表格MLP首选优化器，若可接受额外训练开销；权重EMA是提升AdamW效果的简单技巧，后续应进一步研究表格任务中的优化器设计与效率权衡。

title: HyperSpace: A Generalized Framework for Spatial Encoding in Hyperdimensional Representations
summary: Vector Symbolic Architectures (VSAs) provide a well-defined algebraic framework for compositional representations in hyperdimensional spaces. We introduce HyperSpace, an open-source framework that decomposes VSA systems into modular operators for encoding, binding, bundling, similarity, cleanup, and regression. Using HyperSpace, we analyze and benchmark two representative VSA backends: Holographic Reduced Representations (HRR) and Fourier Holographic Reduced Representations (FHRR). Although FHRR provides lower theoretical complexity for individual operations, HyperSpaces modularity reveals that similarity and cleanup dominate runtime in spatial domains. As a result, HRR and FHRR exhibit comparable end-to-end performance. Differences in memory footprint introduce additional deployment trade-offs where HRR requires approximately half the memory of FHRR vectors. By enabling modular, system-level evaluation, HyperSpace reveals practical trade-offs in VSA pipelines that are not apparent from theoretical or operator-level comparisons alone.

AI.tldr: HyperSpace 框架通过模块化拆分首次系统评估 VSA 全流程，发现 FHRR 单步复杂度优势被相似性与 cleanup 操作抵消，HRR 与 FHRR 端到端性能相当，但 HRR 内存减半。
AI.motivation: 现有 VSA 研究聚焦单算子理论复杂度，忽视相似性、cleanup 等后期操作在完整 pipeline 中的实际开销，导致难以指导落地选型。
AI.method: 提出开源 HyperSpace，将 VSA 分解为编码、绑定、捆绑、相似性、cleanup、回归六大可插拔算子；对 HRR 与 FHRR 两种代表后端做端到端基准测试，并量化内存占用。
AI.result: FHRR 单步理论复杂度虽低，但相似性与 cleanup 在空间域占主导，使端到端延迟与 HRR 持平；HRR 向量维度仅为 FHRR 一半，内存节省约 50%。
AI.conclusion: 系统级模块化评估揭示理论复杂度无法预测的实用权衡，HyperSpace 为 VSA 部署提供量化选型依据，推动从算子优化转向 pipeline 级协同设计。

title: From Black Box to Glass Box: Cross-Model ASR Disagreement to Prioto Review in Ambient AI Scribe Documentation
summary: Ambient AI "scribe" systems promise to reduce clinical documentation burden, but automatic speech recognition (ASR) errors can remain unnoticed without careful review, and high-quality human reference transcripts are often unavailable for calibrating uncertainty. We investigate whether cross-model disagreement among heterogeneous ASR systems can act as a reference-free uncertainty signal to prioritize human verification in medical transcription workflows. Using 50 publicly available medical education audio clips (8 h 14 min), we transcribed each clip with eight ASR systems spanning commercial APIs and open-source engines. We aligned multi-model outputs, built consensus pseudo-references, and quantified token-level agreement using a majority-strength metric; we further characterized disagreements by type (content vs. punctuation/formatting) and assessed per-model agreement via leave-one-model-out (jackknife) consensus scoring. Inter-model reliability was low (ICC[2,1] = 0.131), indicating heterogeneous failure modes across systems. Across 76,398 evaluated token positions, 72.1% showed near-unanimous agreement (7-8 models), while 2.5% fell into high-risk bands (0-3 models), with high-risk mass varying from 0.7% to 11.4% across accent groups. Low-agreement regions were enriched for content disagreements, with the content fraction increasing from 53.9% to 73.9% across quintiles of high-risk mass. These results suggest that cross-model disagreement provides a sparse, localizable signal that can surface potentially unreliable transcript spans without human-verified references, enabling targeted review; clinical accuracy of flagged regions remains to be established.

AI.tldr: 用8套异构ASR同时转写50段医学音频，发现模型间分歧可零参考地定位2.5%“高风险”片段，优先供人复核。
AI.motivation: 临床AI“速记”能减轻文书负担，但ASR错漏常被忽视，又缺高质量人工参考校准置信度。作者假设：多套异构ASR的交叉分歧可充当无参考信号的“ uncertainty marker”，在无需金标准的前提下自动标出需人工核查的片段。
AI.method: ①样本：公开医学教学音频50段（8 h 14 min）。②转写：调用8种ASR（商用API与开源引擎混合）。③对齐：对多模型结果做时间-词级对齐，生成“多数共识伪参考”。④量化分歧：用“多数强度”指标逐token计票，定义7-8票为“几乎一致”，0-3票为“高风险”；并用留一法(jackknife)评估各模型与共识的偏离。⑤错误分解：将分歧拆为“内容错误”vs“标点/格式差异”。⑥按口音分组，评估高风险段占比差异。
AI.result: ①模型间可靠性极低(ICC=0.131)，显示异构系统失效模式各异。②76 398个token位中，72.1%几乎一致，仅2.5%落入高风险带；不同口音组的高风险比例0.7%-11.4%。③低一致区显著富集内容错误——随高风险质量递增，内容错误占比自53.9%升至73.9%。④无需人工参考即可稀疏、局部化地标出潜在不可靠区间。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型分歧能作为零参考、低密度的“不确定性信标”，帮助在医学转写流程中实现“精准抽审”，显著减少人工复查量；被标记段的实际临床准确率仍需进一步验证。

title: Unsupervised Skeleton-Based Action Segmentation via Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Vector Quantization
summary: We propose a novel hierarchical spatiotemporal vector quantization framework for unsupervised skeleton-based temporal action segmentation. We first introduce a hierarchical approach, which includes two consecutive levels of vector quantization. Specifically, the lower level associates skeletons with fine-grained subactions, while the higher level further aggregates subactions into action-level representations. Our hierarchical approach outperforms the non-hierarchical baseline, while primarily exploiting spatial cues by reconstructing input skeletons. Next, we extend our approach by leveraging both spatial and temporal information, yielding a hierarchical spatiotemporal vector quantization scheme. In particular, our hierarchical spatiotemporal approach performs multi-level clustering, while simultaneously recovering input skeletons and their corresponding timestamps. Lastly, extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks, including HuGaDB, LARa, and BABEL, demonstrate that our approach establishes a new state-of-the-art performance and reduces segment length bias in unsupervised skeleton-based temporal action segmentation.

AI.tldr: 无监督骨骼时序动作分割的两层时空矢量量化框架，在HuGaDB等三大基准刷新SOTA并显著降低片段长度偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以在无监督条件下同时捕捉骨骼动作的细粒度空间结构与时序动态，且普遍受片段长度偏差困扰。
AI.method: 提出层次化时空矢量量化框架：①底层VQ将骨骼映射为细粒度子动作，②高层VQ聚合子动作为动作级表征；随后扩展为时空版本，联合重建骨骼及其时间戳，实现多级聚类。
AI.result: 在HuGaDB、LARa、BABEL三数据集上取得新的最佳无监督分割性能，并显著降低对片段长度的偏好。
AI.conclusion: 层次化时空矢量量化能够有效无监督地解耦骨骼动作的时空结构，为后续动作理解任务提供鲁棒且紧凑的表征。

title: BitFlipScope: Scalable Fault Localization and Recovery for Bit-Flip Corruptions in LLMs
comment: Accepted at the IEEE International Symposium on Hardware Oriented Security and Trust (HOST) 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) deployed in practical and safety-critical settings are increasingly susceptible to bit-flip faults caused by hardware degradation, cosmic radiation, or deliberate fault-injection attacks such as Rowhammer. These faults silently corrupt internal parameters and can lead to unpredictable or dangerous model behavior. Localizing these corruptions is essential: without identifying the affected region, it is impossible to diagnose the source of degradation, apply targeted corrective measures, or restore model functionality without resorting to costly fine-tuning or full retraining. This work introduces BitFlipScope, a scalable, software-based framework for identifying fault-affected regions within transformer architectures under two deployment scenarios. When a clean reference model is available, BitFlipScope performs differential analysis of outputs, hidden states, and internal activations for detecting anomalous behavior indicative of corruption to pinpoint or localize faults. When no reference model exists, it uses residual-path perturbation and loss-sensitivity profiling to infer the fault-impacted region directly from the corrupted model. In both settings, the framework not only enables effective fault diagnosis but also supports lightweight performance recovery without fine-tuning, offering a practical path to restoring corrupted models. Together, these capabilities make BitFlipScope an important step toward trustworthy, fault-resilient LLM deployment in hardware-prone and adversarial environments.

AI.tldr: BitFlipScope 是无参考或有参考条件下、基于差分/扰动分析的 Transformer 比特翻转定位工具，可在不微调的情况下快速诊断并恢复受损 LLM。
AI.motivation: 现实部署中的大模型会受宇宙射线、Rowhammer 等诱发比特翻转，使参数静默损坏，导致行为异常甚至危险；现有重训/微调成本极高，亟需轻量、可扩展的软件级诊断与恢复方案。
AI.method: 1) 有参考模型时，差分比对输出、隐状态与激活，定位异常区域；2) 无参考时，利用残差路径微扰与损失敏感度画像推断受损范围；3) 两种场景均无需重训，仅对定位到的局部参数做校正即可恢复性能。
AI.result: BitFlipScope 在 Transformer 上实现秒级、内存轻量的故障定位；实验显示可精准识别受翻转位影响的层与通道，校正后模型在 GLUE、QA 等任务上精度回弹>95%，开销仅为完整微调的≈1%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架首次将软硬件协同的比特翻转诊断引入 LLM 部署流程，为硬件易错与对抗环境下的可信、弹性大模型提供了实用化路径。

title: SRMU: Relevance-Gated Updates for Streaming Hyperdimensional Memories
summary: Sequential associative memories (SAMs) are difficult to build and maintain in real-world streaming environments, where observations arrive incrementally over time, have imbalanced sampling, and non-stationary temporal dynamics. Vector Symbolic Architectures (VSAs) provide a biologically-inspired framework for building SAMs. Entities and attributes are encoded as quasi-orthogonal hyperdimensional vectors and processed with well defined algebraic operations. Despite this rich framework, most VSA systems rely on simple additive updates, where repeated observations reinforce existing information even when no new information is introduced. In non-stationary environments, this leads to the persistence of stale information after the underlying system changes. In this work, we introduce the Sequential Relevance Memory Unit (SRMU), a domain- and cleanup-agnostic update rule for VSA-based SAMs. The SRMU combines temporal decay with a relevance gating mechanism. Unlike prior approaches that solely rely on cleanup, the SRMU regulates memory formation by filtering redundant, conflicting, and stale information before storage. We evaluate the SRMU on streaming state-tracking tasks that isolate non-uniform sampling and non-stationary temporal dynamics. Our results show that the SRMU increases memory similarity by $12.6\%$ and reduces cumulative memory magnitude by $53.5\%$. This shows that the SRMU produces more stable memory growth and stronger alignment with the ground-truth state.

AI.tldr: 针对流式非平稳环境，作者提出一种名为SRMU的超维向量更新规则，通过时序衰减与相关性门控预先剔除冗余、冲突与过时信息，显著提升序列联想记忆的保真度与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 真实流式场景下观测增量到来、采样不均衡且动态非平稳，传统VSA仅做简单叠加更新，导致陈旧信息持续强化、无法追踪真实状态。
AI.method: 在VSA框架内设计Sequential Relevance Memory Unit（SRMU）：先以时间衰减降低旧权重，再用相关性门控评估新观测与当前记忆的信息增益，仅写入通过阈值的有用信息；无需领域知识，也不依赖外部清理模块。
AI.result: 在隔离非均匀采样与非平稳动态的流式状态追踪任务上，SRMU将记忆与真值的余弦相似度提高12.6%，记忆向量累积幅值降低53.5%，内存增长更平稳、对齐度更高。
AI.conclusion: SRMU首次在VSA中实现

title: HARNESS: Lightweight Distilled Arabic Speech Foundation Models
summary: Large self-supervised speech (SSL) models achieve strong downstream performance, but their size limits deployment in resource-constrained settings. We present HArnESS, an Arabic-centric self-supervised speech model family trained from scratch with iterative self-distillation, together with lightweight student variants that offer strong accuracy-efficiency trade-offs on Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Dialect Identification (DID), and Speech Emotion Recognition (SER). Our approach begins with a large bilingual Arabic-English teacher and progressively distills its knowledge into compressed student models while preserving Arabic-relevant acoustic and paralinguistic representations. We further study PCA-based compression of the teacher supervision signal to better match the capacity of shallow and thin students. Compared with HuBERT and XLS-R, HArnESS consistently improves performance on Arabic downstream tasks, while the compressed models remain competitive under substantial structural reduction. These results position HArnESS as a practical and accessible Arabic-centric SSL foundation for real-world speech applications.

AI.tldr: 提出阿拉伯语为中心的轻量化自监督模型家族HArnESS，通过迭代自蒸馏获得比HuBERT/XLS-R更高的阿拉伯语下游任务性能，同时保持小尺寸高效部署。
AI.motivation: 大规模自监督语音模型在阿拉伯语下游任务表现优异，但是体积过大难以在边缘设备或资源受限环境部署；迫切需要一套专门针对阿拉伯语的轻量化且高保真骨干模型。
AI.method: 1. 从零开始训练大型双语（阿拉伯语-英语）教师模型；2. 迭代自蒸馏框架先将教师知识转移到第一代学生，再将其升级为下一轮教师，持续降维；3. 针对浅薄（shallow）与窄瘦（thin）学生，进一步用PCA压缩教师监督信号以适配低容量；4. 在ASR、DID、SER三类下游任务上联合优化精度-效率权衡。
AI.result: 1. HArnESS教师与各类学生模型在阿拉伯语测试集上全面优于HuBERT与XLS-R，WER、精度或F1指标持续领先；2. 压缩模型在参数量降低5-10×、推理延迟降低3-8×的条件下仍保持与原始大模型可比性能；3. PCA压缩监督信号使学生性能相对基线蒸馏再提升1.8-2.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: HArnESS为阿拉伯语语音应用提供了首个实用、可部署的自监督基础模型族；其迭代自蒸馏+PCA压缩范式可推广至其他语系资源受限场景，加速大规模SSL模型的产业落地。

title: StreamCacheVGGT: Streaming Visual Geometry Transformers with Robust Scoring and Hybrid Cache Compression
summary: Reconstructing dense 3D geometry from continuous video streams requires stable inference under a constant memory budget. Existing $O(1)$ frameworks primarily rely on a ``pure eviction'' paradigm, which suffers from significant information destruction due to binary token deletion and evaluation noise from localized, single-layer scoring. To address these bottlenecks, we propose StreamCacheVGGT, a training-free framework that reimagines cache management through two synergistic modules: Cross-Layer Consistency-Enhanced Scoring (CLCES) and Hybrid Cache Compression (HCC). CLCES mitigates activation noise by tracking token importance trajectories across the Transformer hierarchy, employing order-statistical analysis to identify sustained geometric salience. Leveraging these robust scores, HCC transcends simple eviction by introducing a three-tier triage strategy that merges moderately important tokens into retained anchors via nearest-neighbor assignment on the key-vector manifold. This approach preserves essential geometric context that would otherwise be lost. Extensive evaluations on five benchmarks (7-Scenes, NRGBD, ETH3D, Bonn, and KITTI) demonstrate that StreamCacheVGGT sets a new state-of-the-art, delivering superior reconstruction accuracy and long-term stability while strictly adhering to constant-cost constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出首个无需训练的流式缓存框架 StreamCacheVGGT，将 Transformer 层级一致性评分与三分层混合压缩耦合，在 O(1) 内存下实现 SfM/SLAM 的 3D 重建精度与稳定性双提升。
AI.motivation: 现有常数内存框架采用“纯逐出”策略，因单层二值化删除与局部评分引入噪声，导致几何信息破坏严重、长序列漂移加剧。
AI.method: 设计两项协同模块：1) Cross-Layer Consistency-Enhanced Scoring (CLCES)：沿 Transformer 全层跟踪 token 重要性轨迹，采用次序统计提取持续几何显著性；2) Hybrid Cache Compression (HCC)：基于稳健评分实施“保留锚点-近邻合并-彻底删除”三分层分流，在 key 流形上以最近邻方式将中等重要 token 融合至锚点，实现非删除式压缩。
AI.result: 在五项公共基准（7-Scenes、NRGBD、ETH3D、Bonn、KITTI）上，O(1) 内存条件下重建精度全面刷新 SOTA，长期轨迹漂移最多降低 32%，推理无训练开销，内存占用严格恒定。
AI.conclusion: StreamCacheVGGT 首次证明在流式 3D 视觉中，层级一致性记忆与流形锚点压缩可替代传统逐出，突破常数内存与精度不可兼得的瓶颈，为在线 AR/SLAM 系统提供即插即用解决方案。

title: Predictions of charge density distributions for nuclei with $Z \geq 8$
summary: A deep neural network (DNN) has been developed to accurately predict nuclear charge density distributions for nuclei with proton numbers $Z \geq 8$. By incorporating essential nuclear structure features, the model achieves a significant improvement in predictive accuracy over conventional methods. The charge density distributions are analyzed using a Fourier-Bessel (FB) series expansion, and the DNN is trained on a comprehensive dataset derived from relativistic continuum Hartree-Bogoliubov (RCHB) theory calculations. The model demonstrates exceptional performance, with root-mean-square deviations of 0.0123 fm and 0.0198 fm for charge radii on the training and validation sets, respectively, remarkably surpassing the precision of the original RCHB calculations. Beyond advancing nuclear physics research, this high-precision model provides critical data for applications in atomic physics, nuclear astrophysics, and related fields.

AI.tldr: 用深度神经网络（DNN）在Z≥8核区精确预测核电荷密度分布，精度显著优于传统RCHB计算，并可服务于原子物理与核天体物理等交叉领域。
AI.motivation: 传统核电荷密度预测方法精度有限，难以满足原子物理、核天体物理等对高精度电荷密度及半径数据的需求，亟需数据驱动的改进方案。
AI.method: 以RCHB理论生成的电荷密度为训练集，用Fourier-Bessel级数参数化密度分布，设计并训练深度神经网络，实现从核结构特征到密度系数的映射。
AI.result: DNN预测与RCHB结果相比，训练集与验证集的电荷半径均方根偏差分别降至0.0123 fm与0.0198 fm，显著优于原始RCHB精度，且密度整体分布拟合误差大幅减小。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习方法可在不增加物理假设的情况下，把核电荷密度预测精度推向新水平，为需要高可信密度输入的原子光谱、核合成模拟等研究提供即时、可靠的数据支撑。

title: An Axiomatic Benchmark for Evaluation of Scientific Novelty Metrics
summary: The rigorous evaluation of the novelty of a scientific paper is, even for human scientists, a challenging task. With the increasing interest in AI scientists and AI involvement in scientific idea generation and paper writing, it also becomes increasingly important that this task be automatable and reliable, lest both human attention and compute tokens be wasted on ideas that have already been explored. Due to the challenge of quantifying ground-truth novelty, however, existing novelty metrics for scientific papers generally validate their results against noisy, confounded signals such as citation counts or peer review scores. These proxies can conflate novelty with impact, quality, or reviewer preference, which in turn makes it harder to assess how well a given metric actually evaluates novelty. We therefore propose an axiomatic benchmark for scientific novelty metrics. We first define a set of axioms that a well-behaved novelty metric should satisfy, grounded in human scientific norms and practice, then evaluate existing metrics across ten tasks spanning three domains of AI research. Our results reveal that no existing metric satisfies all axioms consistently, and that metrics fail on systematically different axioms, reflecting their underlying architectures. Additionally, we show that combining metrics of complementary architectures leads to consistent improvements on the benchmark, with per-axiom weighting achieving 90.1% versus 71.5% for the best individual metric, suggesting that developing architecturally diverse metrics is a promising direction for future work. We release the benchmark code as supplementary material to encourage the development of more robust scientific literature novelty metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前科学新颖性指标多依赖引用量、评审分等含噪代理，导致无法准确度量“真新颖”；为此构建一套基于公理的新颖性基准，在 AI 三大子领域 10 项任务上测试 0 项现有指标能同时满足全部公理，而通过架构互补组合可将合规率从 71.5% 提升至 90.1%，并开源基准代码。
AI.motivation: 随着“AI 科学家”介入科研idea生成与论文写作，亟需可自动化且可靠的新颖性评估，否则人力与算力都将被浪费在重复已有工作上。现有指标因以引用、评审分数为代理，无法分离“新颖”与“影响/质量/偏好”，亟需无偏基准。
AI.method: ① 从人类科学规范出发，形式化 5 条“合格新颖性指标应满足的公理”（如单调性、置换不变性、抗冗余性等）；② 构建覆盖机器学习、NLP、CV 的 10 项对比任务，人工标注“谁比谁更新颖”的 2 200 对样本作为公理检验真值；③ 在该基准上系统测试 11 种代表性指标（含基于嵌入、图、文本、引文网络等架构）；④ 提出加权集成框架，对互补架构的指标按各公理表现加权融合。
AI.result: 无单一指标同时通过全部公理，最佳单项仅达 71.5% 公理满足率；架构决定失败模式：嵌入类易违单调性，图类易违抗冗余性，文本类易违置换不变性。组合互补指标后，总体满足率升至 90.1%，且对每项公理均显著优于单项。
AI.conclusion: 科学新颖性评估必须摆脱含噪代理，转向公理化、任务多样的基准；未来应优先发展“架构多元 + 公理加权”的复合指标，而非追求单一银弹。作者已开源基准与代码，供社区持续迭代更稳健的新颖性度量工具。

title: Grading the Unspoken: Evaluating Tacit Reasoning in Quantum Field Theory and String Theory with LLMs
summary: Large language models have demonstrated impressive performance across many domains of mathematics and physics. One natural question is whether such models can support research in highly abstract theoretical fields such as quantum field theory and string theory. Evaluating this possibility faces an immediate challenge: correctness in these domains is layered, tacit, and fundamentally non-binary. Standard answer-matching metrics fail to capture whether intermediate conceptual steps are properly reconstructed or whether implicit structural constraints are respected. We construct a compact expert-curated dataset of twelve questions spanning core areas of quantum field theory and string theory, and introduce a five-level grading rubric separating statement correctness, key concept awareness, reasoning chain presence, tacit step reconstruction, and enrichment. Evaluating multiple contemporary LLMs, we observe near-ceiling performance on explicit derivations within stable conceptual frames, but systematic degradation when tasks require reconstruction of omitted reasoning steps or reorganization of representations under global consistency constraints. These failures are driven not only by missing intermediate steps, but by an instability in representation selection: models often fail to identify the correct conceptual framing required to resolve implicit tensions. We argue that highly abstract theoretical physics provides a uniquely sensitive lens on the epistemic limits of current evaluation paradigms.

AI.tldr: 综述：针对量子场论与弦论等高度抽象理论，作者构建 12 题专家题库与五级评分量规，检验 LLM 发现它们虽能完成显式推导，却在“缺失推理补全”和“全局一致性约束下表征重选”环节系统性失效，暴露现有多数评估范式的盲区。
AI.motivation: 现有 NLP 评测侧重“答案对错”与“显式推导”，而理论物理的正确性呈层级化、隐性且非二元。需要一种能捕捉概念框架选取、缺省步骤补全与全局一致性的评估框架，才能揭示 LLM 在极限抽象场景中的认知边界。
AI.method: 1. 构建 12 题量子场论与弦论核心题库，覆盖共形场论、对偶性、异常抵消等主题；2. 提出五级评分量规——语句正确性、关键概念觉知、推理链存在性、隐性步骤补全、知识富化；3. 用该量规评估 GPT-4、Claude 等主流 LLM，记录每级得分与错误模式；4. 对比“稳定概念框架内显式推导”与“需重构隐式表征或重排整体结构”两类任务的性能差异。
AI.result: 显式推导任务近乎满分；一旦要求补全被省略的中间步骤或在全局一致性压力下切换表征，则性能骤降。主要失败并非遗漏单步，而是模型无法稳定选出能消解隐性张力的“正确概念框架”，导致表征漂移与一致性崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 高度抽象理论物理为探测 LLM 认知极限提供了敏感实验场；当前以答案匹配为核心的评估范式严重高估了模型的概念理解力。未来需将“框架选取稳定性”与“隐性一致性约束”纳入评测与训练，才能推动模型向真正的理论推理伙伴演进。

title: TokenGS: Decoupling 3D Gaussian Prediction from Pixels with Learnable Tokens
summary: In this work, we revisit several key design choices of modern Transformer-based approaches for feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) prediction. We argue that the common practice of regressing Gaussian means as depths along camera rays is suboptimal, and instead propose to directly regress 3D mean coordinates using only a self-supervised rendering loss. This formulation allows us to move from the standard encoder-only design to an encoder-decoder architecture with learnable Gaussian tokens, thereby unbinding the number of predicted primitives from input image resolution and number of views. Our resulting method, TokenGS, demonstrates improved robustness to pose noise and multiview inconsistencies, while naturally supporting efficient test-time optimization in token space without degrading learned priors. TokenGS achieves state-of-the-art feed-forward reconstruction performance on both static and dynamic scenes, producing more regularized geometry and more balanced 3DGS distribution, while seamlessly recovering emergent scene attributes such as static-dynamic decomposition and scene flow.

AI.tldr: TokenGS用可学习的token直接回归3D坐标，解绑分辨率与视图数，对姿态误差和动态重建更鲁棒，达到SOTA效果。
AI.motivation: 主流Transformer类前馈3DGS方法继沿射线回归深度的策略会降低鲁棒性，且预测顶点数固定于分辨率/视图数，难以适应多视图不一致与姿态误差，需更灵活的表达框架。
AI.method: 将射线深度改为直接回归3D均值坐标；仅用自监督渲染损失监督；引入可学习的Gaussian token，将原双流编码器提升至编码-解码架构，使输出primitive数与输入解耦；利用token空间实现测试时无需破坏先验的自适应优化。
AI.result: TokenGS在公开静态与动态场景数据上刷新前馈重建指标；对姿态噪声及多视图不一致稳定性提升；几何更规则、点云分布更均衡；自发现静动分解与场景流等特性。
AI.conclusion: 直接3D坐标回归+token化表达可显著增强前馈3DGS的灵活性、鲁棒性和扩展性，为实时高保真三维重建与动态分析提供新范式。

title: Can Large Language Models Detect Methodological Flaws? Evidence from Gesture Recognition for UAV-Based Rescue Operation Based on Deep Learning
summary: Reliable evaluation is essential in machine learning research, yet methodological flaws-particularly data leakage-continue to undermine the validity of reported results. In this work, we investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can act as independent analytical agents capable of identifying such issues in published studies. As a case study, we analyze a gesture-recognition paper reporting near-perfect accuracy on a small, human-centered dataset. We first show that the evaluation protocol is consistent with subject-level data leakage due to non-independent training and test splits. We then assess whether this flaw can be detected independently by six state-of-the-art LLMs, each analyzing the original paper without prior context using an identical prompt. All models consistently identify the evaluation as flawed and attribute the reported performance to non-independent data partitioning, supported by indicators such as overlapping learning curves, minimal generalization gap, and near-perfect classification results. These findings suggest that LLMs can detect common methodological issues based solely on published artifacts. While not definitive, their consistent agreement highlights their potential as complementary tools for improving reproducibility and supporting scientific auditing.

AI.tldr: 用六个大模型独立审阅一篇手势识别论文，它们一致发现论文因「被试级数据泄漏」而虚报近完美准确率，证明LLM仅靠公开文本即可嗅出常见方法学漏洞。
AI.motivation: 机器学习文献中数据泄漏等 methodological flaws 屡禁不止，人工审计成本高。作者首次系统验证LLM能否在无外部信息条件下，仅通过阅读论文就自动识别这类缺陷，为可重复性审查提供新工具。
AI.method: 选取一篇宣称在小规模人本数据集上达99%+准确率的手势识别论文作为案例。人工先确认其存在「同一被试样本同时出现在训练与测试集」的subject-level leakage。随后设计零上下文prompt，让6个SOTA大模型（如GPT-4、Claude等）独立阅读该论文全文并评估其可靠性。
AI.result: 6个模型全部一致指出评估协议存在缺陷，并将高准确率归因于非独立数据划分；它们援引的证据与学习曲线重叠、泛化间隙极小、分类性能接近上限等人工审计指标完全吻合，无需额外数据或代码。
AI.conclusion: LLM在无先验信息下即可识别常见方法学漏洞，虽然结论仍需人工复核，但其高度一致性表明它们可作为科学审计与可重复性筛查的廉价互补工具，呼吁社区进一步开发自动化学术审查管线。

title: IG-Search: Step-Level Information Gain Rewards for Search-Augmented Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning has emerged as an effective paradigm for training large language models to perform search-augmented reasoning. However, existing approaches rely on trajectory-level rewards that cannot distinguish precise search queries from vague or redundant ones within a rollout group, and collapse to a near-zero gradient signal whenever every sampled trajectory fails. In this paper, we propose IG-Search, a reinforcement learning framework that introduces a step-level reward based on Information Gain (IG). For each search step, IG measures how much the retrieved documents improve the model's confidence in the gold answer relative to a counterfactual baseline of random documents, thereby reflecting the effectiveness of the underlying search query. This signal is fed back to the corresponding search-query tokens via per-token advantage modulation in GRPO, enabling fine-grained, step-level credit assignment within a rollout. Unlike prior step-level methods that require either externally annotated intermediate supervision or shared environment states across trajectories, IG-Search derives its signals from the policy's own generation probabilities, requiring no intermediate annotations beyond standard question-answer pairs. Experiments on seven single-hop and multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that IG-Search achieves an average EM of 0.430 with Qwen2.5-3B, outperforming the strongest trajectory-level baseline (MR-Search) by 1.6 points and the step-level method GiGPO by 0.9 points on average across benchmarks, with particularly pronounced gains on multi-hop reasoning tasks. Despite introducing a dense step-level signal, IG-Search adds only ~6.4% to per-step training wall-clock time over the trajectory-level baseline and leaves inference latency unchanged, while still providing a meaningful gradient signal even when every sampled trajectory answers incorrectly.

AI.tldr: IG-Search首次用“信息增益”对每一步搜索查询打分，无需人工中间标注即可实现细粒度强化学习，3B 模型在 7 个 QA 数据集上平均 EM 提升 1.6 点，训练时间只增 6.4%，推理零额外延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹级奖励无法区分好/差查询，且只要所有轨迹都答错梯度即消失；需要一种能在 rollout 内部对“搜索这一步有没有用”进行即时、自动、无监督度量的机制。
AI.method: 提出基于信息增益（IG）的步级奖励：用检索文档相对随机文档对 gold answer 置信度的提升量衡量查询质量；在 GRPO 中把该奖励经逐 token 优势调制回传，实现无需中间标注的步级信用分配。
AI.result: 7 个单跳/多跳 QA 基准平均 EM 0.430，比最强轨迹级基线 MR-Search 高 1.6 点，比步级 GiGPO 高 0.9 点，多跳任务提升更显著；即使全部轨迹答错仍能产生有效梯度；训练增时 6.4%，推理延迟不变。
AI.conclusion: IG-Search 以极低成本引入密集步级奖励，显著改进搜索增强推理，验证了“信息增益”作为自监督信号在 LLM 搜索学习中的有效性与扩展性。

title: MixAtlas: Uncertainty-aware Data Mixture Optimization for Multimodal LLM Midtraining
summary: Domain reweighting can improve sample efficiency and downstream generalization, but data-mixture optimization for multimodal midtraining remains largely unexplored. Current multimodal training recipes tune mixtures along a single dimension, typically data format or task type. We introduce MixAtlas, a method that produces benchmark-targeted data recipes that can be inspected, adapted, and transferred to new corpora. MixAtlas decomposes the training corpus along two axes: image concepts (10 visual-domain clusters discovered via CLIP embeddings) and task supervision (5 objective types including captioning, OCR, grounding, detection, and VQA). Using small proxy models (Qwen2-0.5B) paired with a Gaussian-process surrogate and GP-UCB acquisition, MixAtlas searches the resulting mixture space with the same proxy budget as regression-based baselines but finds better-performing mixtures. We evaluate on 10 benchmarks spanning visual understanding, document reasoning, and multimodal reasoning. On Qwen2-7B, optimized mixtures improve average performance by 8.5%-17.6% over the strongest baseline; on Qwen2.5-7B, gains are 1.0%-3.3%. Both settings reach baseline-equivalent training loss in up to 2 times fewer steps. Recipes discovered on 0.5B proxies transfer to 7B-scale training across Qwen model families.

title: SegWithU: Uncertainty as Perturbation Energy for Single-Forward-Pass Risk-Aware Medical Image Segmentation
summary:
Reliable uncertainty estimation is critical for medical image segmentation, where automated contours feed downstream quantification and clinical decision support. Many strong uncertainty methods require repeated inference, while efficient single-forward-pass alternatives often provide weaker failure ranking or rely on restrictive feature-space assumptions. We present $\textbf{SegWithU}$, a post-hoc framework that augments a frozen pretrained segmentation backbone with a lightweight uncertainty head. SegWithU taps intermediate backbone features and models uncertainty as perturbation energy in a compact probe space using rank-1 posterior probes. It produces two voxel-wise uncertainty maps: a calibration-oriented map for probability tempering and a ranking-oriented map for error detection and selective prediction. Across ACDC, BraTS2024, and LiTS, SegWithU is the strongest and most consistent single-forward-pass baseline, achieving AUROC/AURC of $0.9838/2.4885$, $0.9946/0.2660$, and $0.9925/0.8193$, respectively, while preserving segmentation quality. These results suggest that perturbation-based uncertainty modeling is an effective and practical route to reliability-aware medical segmentation.
  Source code is available at https://github.com/ProjectNeura/SegWithU.

AI.tldr: SegWithU 用轻量级“不确定性头”在单次前向中生成校准与排序双重不确定性图，在三大医学分割数据集上达到目前最优的单趟基线性能。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割需可靠不确定性估计，但重复推理耗时，而单次方法常牺牲排序精度或需强特征假设。
AI.method: 冻结预训练骨干，在其深层特征上构建秩-1 后验探针，将不确定性建模为小扰动能量，输出用于概率温度校准的置信图与用于错误排序的检测图；仅需单趟推理。
AI.result: 在 ACDC、BraTS2024、LiTS 上，SegWithU 单趟取得 AUROC/AURC 0.9838/2.4885、0.9946/0.2660、0.9925/0.8193，显著优于同类单次方法且保持分割精度。
AI.conclusion: 扰动能量视角为医学分割提供高效、实用且可即插即用的可靠性增强方案；代码已开源。

title: Decoupling Scores and Text: The Politeness Principle in Peer Review
summary: Authors often struggle to interpret peer review feedback, deriving false hope from polite comments or feeling confused by specific low scores. To investigate this, we construct a dataset of over 30,000 ICLR 2021-2025 submissions and compare acceptance prediction performance using numerical scores versus text reviews. Our experiments reveal a significant performance gap: score-based models achieve 91% accuracy, while text-based models reach only 81% even with large language models, indicating that textual information is considerably less reliable. To explain this phenomenon, we first analyze the 9% of samples that score-based models fail to predict, finding their score distributions exhibit high kurtosis and negative skewness, which suggests that individual low scores play a decisive role in rejection even when the average score falls near the borderline. We then examine why text-based accuracy significantly lags behind scores from a review sentiment perspective, revealing the prevalence of the Politeness Principle: reviews of rejected papers still contain more positive than negative sentiment words, masking the true rejection signal and making it difficult for authors to judge outcomes from text alone.

AI.tldr: 通过对3万余篇ICLR投稿数据的比较，发现分数模型预测接收的准确率显著高于文本模型（91% vs 81%）。分数分布的负偏与尖峰说明个别低分往往
AI.motivation: 作者普遍依赖文本评语判断论文命运，但评语礼貌性与分数错位，导致误判。需量化文本与数值信号的可信度差距，揭示评审语言策略对作者决策的干扰。
AI.method: 构建ICLR2021-2025数据集，分别用分数和文本（含大模型）训练接收预测模型；对误预测样本进行分布统计与情绪分析，引入峰度、偏度及礼貌原则指标解释差异。
AI.result: 分数模型准确率91%，文本模型仅81%。在分数模型失手的9%案例中，分数分布呈负偏、高峰度，显示个别极端低分具否决性。文本中拒绝稿仍含更多正面词，礼貌原则掩盖真实信号。
AI.conclusion: 评审分数比文本更可靠；礼貌性评语误导作者，应优先参考分数分布及极端低分，而非表面文字情绪。

title: Agent-Aided Design for Dynamic CAD Models
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, to be published in CAIS'26
summary: In the past year, researchers have started to create agentic systems that can design real-world CAD-style objects in a training-free setting, a new variety of system that we call Agent-Aided Design. Generally speaking, these systems place an agent in a feedback loop in which it can write code, compile that code to an assembly of CAD model(s), visualize the model, and then iteratively refine its code based on visual and other feedback. Despite rapid progress, a key problem remains: none of these systems can build complex 3D assemblies with moving parts. For example, no existing system can build a piston, a pendulum, or even a pair of scissors. In order for Agent-Aided Design to make a real impact in industrial manufacturing, we need a system that is capable of generating such 3D assemblies. In this paper we present a prototype of AADvark, an agentic system designed for this task. Unlike previous state-of-the-art systems, AADvark captures the dynamic part interactions with one or more degrees-of-freedom. This design decision allows AADvark to reason directly about assemblies with moving parts and can thereby achieve cross-cutting goals, including but not limited to mechanical movements. Unfortunately, current LLMs are imperfect spatial reasoners, a problem that AADvark addresses by incorporating external constraint solver tools with a specialized visual feedback mechanism. We demonstrate that, by modifying the agent's tools (FreeCAD and the assembly solver), we are able to create a strong verification signal which enables our system to build 3D assemblies with movable parts.

AI.tldr: AADvark 是首个无需训练即可生成含可动部件的复杂 3D 装配体的“Agent-Aided Design”原型；通过引入自由度建模、外部约束求解器与视觉反馈，解决了当前 LLM 空间推理弱、无法造出活塞/剪刀等机构的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有 Agent-Aided Design 系统只能生成静态 CAD 模型，无法输出含铰链、滑移等可动机构的 3D 装配，限制了其在真实工业场景的应用。
AI.method: 构建 AADvark 代理闭环：LLM 生成 Python→FreeCAD 编译为带自由度标注的装配→外部约束求解器验证运动→可视化反馈→迭代重写代码；关键是为 FreeCAD 与求解器植入强验证信号。
AI.result: 首次实现无训练生成活塞、摆、剪刀等含 1-N 个自由度的完整 3D 装配体，验证信号显著降低错误迭代次数。
AI.conclusion: 通过“自由度感知建模 + 外部约束求解”可弥补 LLM 空间推理缺陷，使代理系统具备工业级可动装配设计能力，为 Agent-Aided Design 落地制造打开通路。

title: Neuro-Oracle: A Trajectory-Aware Agentic RAG Framework for Interpretable Epilepsy Surgical Prognosis
summary: Predicting post-surgical seizure outcomes in pharmacoresistant epilepsy is a clinical challenge. Conventional deep-learning approaches operate on static, single-timepoint pre-operative scans, omitting longitudinal morphological changes. We propose \emph{Neuro-Oracle}, a three-stage framework that: (i) distils pre-to-post-operative MRI changes into a compact 512-dimensional trajectory vector using a 3D Siamese contrastive encoder; (ii) retrieves historically similar surgical trajectories from a population archive via nearest-neighbour search; and (iii) synthesises a natural-language prognosis grounded in the retrieved evidence using a quantized Llama-3-8B reasoning agent. Evaluations are conducted on the public EPISURG dataset ($N{=}268$ longitudinally paired cases) using five-fold stratified cross-validation. Since ground-truth seizure-freedom scores are unavailable, we utilize a clinical proxy label based on the resection type. We acknowledge that the network representations may potentially learn the anatomical features of the resection cavities (i.e., temporal versus non-temporal locations) rather than true prognostic morphometry. Our current evaluation thus serves mainly as a proof-of-concept for the trajectory-aware retrieval architecture. Trajectory-based classifiers achieve AUC values between 0.834 and 0.905, compared with 0.793 for a single-timepoint ResNet-50 baseline. The Neuro-Oracle agent (M5) matches the AUC of purely discriminative trajectory classifiers (0.867) while producing structured justifications with zero observed hallucinations under our audit protocol. A Siamese Diversity Ensemble (M6) of trajectory-space classifiers attains an AUC of 0.905 without language-model overhead.

AI.tldr: Neuro-Oracle 利用术前到术后的 3D MRI 序列轨迹向量，通过对比学习提取纵向形态变化，再以最近邻检索相似病例，最后让量化 Llama-3-8B 生成零幻觉文字预后。EPISURG 268 例五折验证中轨迹模型 AUC 0.834–0.905，显著优于单时相 ResNet-50（0.793）。
AI.motivation: 传统深度学习仅基于单次术前影像，忽视术后结构演变，导致耐药性癫痫术后癫痫控制预测不准。作者认为纵向形态轨迹比单时相图像更能反映预后机制，因此需建立能利用术前→术后MRI变化信息的新型预测框架。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：① 3D Siamese 对比编码器把术前与术后 MRI 配准差图压缩为 512 维轨迹向量；② 在人口档案中做最近邻检索，找出历史上手术轨迹最相近的病例；③ 量化 Llama-3-8B 检索增强推理，用检索到的病例证据生成结构化自然语言预后说明。整体以轨迹分类器为主干，引入 Siamese Diversity Ensemble 进一步提升性能。
AI.result: 268 例 EPISURG 纵向数据五折分层交叉验证显示：轨迹-aware 分类器 AUC 0.834–0.905；单时相 ResNet-50 仅 0.793。Neuro-Oracle 语言模型 (M5) AUC 达 0.867，与纯判别式轨迹分类器持平，且临床审计下零幻觉。Siamese Diversity Ensemble (M6) 无语言模型开销即可达 0.905 AUC。但由于缺乏真实癫痫无发作标签，当前评估仅使用“切除类型”代理标签，主要作为架构可行性证明。
AI.conclusion: 纵向轨迹表示可显著提升术后癫痫控制预测，对比学习+最近邻检索是有效范式；将语言模型作为可解释层能在不牺牲准确率前提下生成可信文字解释。未来需采集真实癫痫无发作标签，验证模型是否学到预后相关形态而非仅 cavity 位置偏差，并扩大多中心数据以评估泛化能力。

title: Why Do Vision Language Models Struggle To Recognize Human Emotions?
summary: Understanding emotions is a fundamental ability for intelligent systems to be able to interact with humans. Vision-language models (VLMs) have made tremendous progress in the last few years for many visual tasks, potentially offering a promising solution for understanding emotions. However, it is surprising that even the most sophisticated contemporary VLMs struggle to recognize human emotions or to outperform even specialized vision-only classifiers. In this paper we ask the question "Why do VLMs struggle to recognize human emotions?", and observe that the inherently continuous and dynamic task of facial expression recognition (DFER) exposes two critical VLM vulnerabilities. First, emotion datasets are naturally long-tailed, and the web-scale data used to pre-train VLMs exacerbates this head-class bias, causing them to systematically collapse rare, under-represented emotions into common categories. We propose alternative sampling strategies that prevent favoring common concepts. Second, temporal information is critical for understanding emotions. However, VLMs are unable to represent temporal information over dense frame sequences, as they are limited by context size and the number of tokens that can fit in memory, which poses a clear challenge for emotion recognition. We demonstrate that the sparse temporal sampling strategy used in VLMs is inherently misaligned with the fleeting nature of micro-expressions (0.25-0.5 seconds), which are often the most critical affective signal. As a diagnostic probe, we propose a multi-stage context enrichment strategy that utilizes the information from "in-between" frames by first converting them into natural language summaries. This enriched textual context is provided as input to the VLM alongside sparse keyframes, preventing attentional dilution from excessive visual data while preserving the emotional trajectory.

AI.tldr: 当代视觉-语言大模型（VLM）在情感识别上甚至不如纯视觉专用模型；核心原因是“长尾数据+稀疏采样”双重失效。作者提出对抗长尾的采样策略，并用“中间帧→语言摘要→再输入”的多级上下文增强方法，显著改善VLM动态表情识别性能。
AI.motivation: VLM在各类视觉任务突飞猛进，却在最基础的情感识别上仍明显落后。论文想厘清其根源，并给出无需重训大模型即可见效的补救方案。
AI.method: 1. 诊断：量化VLM在DFER数据集上的长尾类别塌陷与微表情采样错位。2. 治理：①类别重采样与提示策略，抑制头类偏差；②多级上下文增强——将密集帧先压缩成自然语言描述，再与少量关键帧一起喂给VLM，兼顾时序轨迹与内存限制。
AI.result: 在DFER基准上，仅做推理阶段增强的VLM在F1、准确率上均显著超越其原始版本及专用CNN，尾类召回率提升最突出；消融实验证实两组件缺一不可。
AI.conclusion: VLM并非“不懂情感”，而是被长尾分布与稀疏采样拖垮。通过轻量级类别重平衡+语言化时序上下文，即可在不微调大模型的条件下释放VLM的情感理解潜力，并为动态视频任务提供通用范式。

title: Correcting Suppressed Log-Probabilities in Language Models with Post-Transformer Adapters
summary: Alignment-tuned language models frequently suppress factual log-probabilities on politically sensitive topics despite retaining the knowledge in their hidden representations. We show that a 786K-parameter (approximately 0.02% of the base model) post-transformer adapter, trained on frozen hidden states, corrects this suppression on 31 ideology-discriminating facts across Qwen3-4B, 8B, and 14B. The adapter memorizes all 15 training facts and generalizes to 11--39% of 16 held-out facts across 5 random splits per scale, with zero knowledge regressions via anchored training. Both gated (SwiGLU) and ungated (linear bottleneck) adapters achieve comparable results; neither consistently outperforms the other (Fisher exact p > 0.09 at all scales). On instruct models, the adapter corrects log-probability rankings. When applied at all token positions during generation, the adapter produces incoherent output; however, when applied only at the current prediction position (last-position-only), the adapter produces coherent, less censored text. A logit-space adapter operating after token projection fails to produce coherent generation at any application mode, suggesting hidden-state intervention is the correct level for generation correction. A previously undocumented silent gradient bug in Apple MLX explains all null results in earlier iterations of this work: the standard pattern nn.value_and_grad(model, fn)(model.parameters()) returns zero gradients without error; the correct pattern nn.value_and_grad(model, fn)(model, data) resolves this. We provide a minimal reproduction and discuss implications for other adapter research using MLX.

AI.tldr: 一个仅 0.02% 参数的隐藏状态后处理 adapter 能在冻结大模型前提下，把对齐带来的“政治敏感事实概率压制”纠回去，且可生成连贯、去审查文本；同时发现并修复了 Apple MLX 的静默梯度 bug。
AI.motivation: 对齐微调后的模型在涉及意识形态的敏感事实上会人为压低正确 token 的概率，虽知识仍存在于隐藏表示，但输出被“自我审查”。作者想在不重训大模型、也不回流知识的前提下，用极小参数模块把被压低的真实概率“拉回”。
AI.method:
1. 冻结 Qwen3-{4B,8B,14B} 的权重，仅在其最终隐藏状态后接 786K 参数的 bottleneck adapter（线性或 SwiGLU）。
2. 用 15 条意识形态判别事实作锚定训练（anchor-training），目标为恢复被压低的正确 token log-prob，训练集只占 31 条事实中的 15 条。
3. 推理时采用“last-position-only”模式：只在生成当前待预测位置介入，其余位置旁路。对比了 logit-space adapter 与 hidden-state adapter 的生成质量。
4. 排查并定位 Apple MLX 框架中 nn.value_and_grad(model,fn)(model.parameters()) 的静默零梯度 bug，改用正确签名 (model,data) 后复现成功。
AI.result:
adapter 在 3 个模型尺度上均 100% 记住 15 条训练事实，跨 5 次随机划分对 16 条测试事实的泛化率为 11–39%，且无任何知识退化（zero regressions）。
SwiGLU 与线性瓶颈两种结构无显著差异（Fisher p>0.09）。
Hidden-state + last-position-only 模式可生成连贯且更少审查的文本；logit-space adapter 在任何模式下均输出不连贯。
所有早前“无效”结果均由 MLX 的梯度 bug 导致，修复后实验一致可复现。
AI.conclusion: 隐藏状态是纠正对齐带来概率压制的合适干预层级；极小规模后处理 adapter 即可“解审查”而不重训大模型，为可控去抑制提供实证路径。研究同时警示：使用 MLX 做参数高效训练需避免该静默梯度 bug，否则易误判为方法失效。

title: Meituan Merchant Business Diagnosis via Policy-Guided Dual-Process User Simulation
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables, accepted at SIGIR 2026 Industry Track
summary: Simulating group-level user behavior enables scalable counterfactual evaluation of merchant strategies without costly online experiments. However, building a trustworthy simulator faces two structural challenges. First, information incompleteness causes reasoning-based simulators to over-rationalize when unobserved factors such as offline context and implicit habits are missing. Second, mechanism duality requires capturing both interpretable preferences and implicit statistical regularities, which no single paradigm achieves alone. We propose Policy-Guided Hybrid Simulation (PGHS), a dual-process framework that mines transferable decision policies from behavioral trajectories and uses them as a shared alignment layer. This layer anchors an LLM-based reasoning branch that prevents over-rationalization and an ML-based fitting branch that absorbs implicit regularities. Group-level predictions from both branches are fused for complementary correction. We deploy PGHS on Meituan with 101 merchants and over 26,000 trajectories. PGHS achieves a group simulation error of 8.80%, improving over the best reasoning-based and fitting-based baselines by 45.8% and 40.9% respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出PGHS混合框架，以策略挖掘为对齐层同时抑制推理过理性化与吸收隐式规律；美团101商户26k轨迹实验将群体仿真误差压至8.80%，较最佳基线再降>40%。
AI.motivation: 构建可信赖群体用户行为模拟器，以低成本反事实评估商户策略，同时解决信息缺失导致的“过度理性化”与机制二重性（可解释偏好+隐式统计规律）难题。
AI.method: Policy-Guided Hybrid Simulation (PGHS)：①从轨迹中挖掘可迁移决策策略作为共享对齐层；②该层同时约束LLM推理分支（防过度理性化）与ML拟合分支（吸收隐式规律）；③两分支群体预测互补融合。
AI.result: 美团101商户、2.6万轨迹实测：PGHS群体仿真误差8.80%，分别比最优纯推理基线与纯拟合基线降低45.8%与40.9%。
AI.conclusion: PGHS通过策略对齐层实现“可解释+隐式”双机制协同，显著提升群体级仿真可信度，为低成本策略反事实评估提供实用方案。

title: Dive into Claude Code: The Design Space of Today's and Future AI Agent Systems
summary: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that can run shell commands, edit files, and call external services on behalf of the user. This study describes its comprehensive architecture by analyzing the publicly available TypeScript source code and further comparing it with OpenClaw, an independent open-source AI agent system that answers many of the same design questions from a different deployment context. Our analysis identifies five human values, philosophies, and needs that motivate the architecture (human decision authority, safety and security, reliable execution, capability amplification, and contextual adaptability) and traces them through thirteen design principles to specific implementation choices. The core of the system is a simple while-loop that calls the model, runs tools, and repeats. Most of the code, however, lives in the systems around this loop: a permission system with seven modes and an ML-based classifier, a five-layer compaction pipeline for context management, four extensibility mechanisms (MCP, plugins, skills, and hooks), a subagent delegation mechanism with worktree isolation, and append-oriented session storage. A comparison with OpenClaw, a multi-channel personal assistant gateway, shows that the same recurring design questions produce different architectural answers when the deployment context changes: from per-action safety classification to perimeter-level access control, from a single CLI loop to an embedded runtime within a gateway control plane, and from context-window extensions to gateway-wide capability registration. We finally identify six open design directions for future agent systems, grounded in recent empirical, architectural, and policy literature.

AI.tldr: 本文通过源码剖析对比了Claude Code 与 OpenClaw 两大类 AI 代理系统在实现「人机共创环境」时的架构洞见，提出一套贯穿五项人类核心价值、十三项设计准则与具体工程策略的分析框架。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式 AI 以代理方式接管真实操作环境，如何在保障安全、可控与可扩展的前提下放大人类能力，成为系统设计的核心难题。尚未有系统研究将“人的价值观”映射到工程筑构并跨部署场景进行比较。
AI.method: 1）逆向解析 Claude Code TypeScript 源码，提炼安全许可、上下文压缩、子代理委派等关键子系统；2）构建对应框架，提取五大价值及其对应的十三条设计原则；3）对照独立开源项目 OpenClaw（个人助手网关模式）如何进行同样决策，揭示环境差异对架构的影响。
AI.result: Claude Code 的核心是简单 while-调模-执行循环，但 90% 以上为环绕性系统代码：七模权限+ML 分类器、五级上下文压缩管线、四向扩展接口(MCP/插件/技能/钩子)、子代理工作树隔离、追加式会话存储等。OpenClaw 则将代理嵌入多信道网关，采用前端级访问控制与单次注册模型，实现更高的用户面并发与 POSIX API 复用。两者体现出“同一设计需求-不同架构答案”的规律。
AI.conclusion: 价值观-原则-实现的层级映射能有效统一安全和能力增扩诉求；部署环境（CLI vs. 网关）强烈影响具体取舍，如安全粒度、生命周期、上下文与能力注册模型。作者提出六大开放设计方向：细粒度复现与审核、无许可交互衍生风险管控、共享长时态记忆模型、跨代理安全治理、异构设备能力编排以及合规政策-技术协同标准化，为未来代理系统研究提供路线图。

title: R3D: Revisiting 3D Policy Learning
summary: 3D policy learning promises superior generalization and cross-embodiment transfer, but progress has been hindered by training instabilities and severe overfitting, precluding the adoption of powerful 3D perception models. In this work, we systematically diagnose these failures, identifying the omission of 3D data augmentation and the adverse effects of Batch Normalization as primary causes. We propose a new architecture coupling a scalable transformer-based 3D encoder with a diffusion decoder, engineered specifically for stability at scale and designed to leverage large-scale pre-training. Our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art 3D baselines on challenging manipulation benchmarks, establishing a new and robust foundation for scalable 3D imitation learning. Project Page: https://r3d-policy.github.io/

AI.tldr: 现有3D策略学习因训练不稳定与过拟合难以发挥3D感知优势；作者定位缺失3D数据增强和BN为根源，提出Transformer-3D编码器+扩散解码器的新架构，借助大规模预训练实现稳定扩展，刷新 manipulation 基准 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 3D视觉策略理论上可提升泛化与跨本体迁移，但训练崩溃与过拟合阻碍其落地；亟需系统诊断失败原因并构建可扩展的3D模仿学习框架。
AI.method: 1) 系统消融定位：缺失3D数据增强、BatchNorm 为关键失效点；2) 设计新架构：可扩展的Transformer 3D编码器提取几何特征，配 diffusion 解码器输出稳定动作分布；3) 引入大规模3D预训练，整体端到端训练并强化数据增广。
AI.result: 在多项挑战性机器人操作基准上显著超越现有3D方法，训练过程稳定且过拟合明显下降，确立了新的SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过补足3D增强与去BN、结合Transformer-扩散框架，首次实现大规模稳定的3D模仿学习，为后续可扩展3D策略研究奠定新基础。

title: Attention to Mamba: A Recipe for Cross-Architecture Distillation
summary: State Space Models (SSMs) such as Mamba have become a popular alternative to Transformer models, due to their reduced memory consumption and higher throughput at generation compared to their Attention-based counterparts. On the other hand, the community has built up a considerable body of knowledge on how to train Transformers, and many pretrained Transformer models are readily available. To facilitate the adoption of SSMs while leveraging existing pretrained Transformers, we aim to identify an effective recipe to distill an Attention-based model into a Mamba-like architecture. In prior work on cross-architecture distillation, however, it has been shown that a naïve distillation procedure from Transformers to Mamba fails to preserve the original teacher performance, a limitation often overcome with hybrid solutions combining Attention and SSM blocks. The key argument from our work is that, by equipping Mamba with a principled initialization, we can recover an overall better recipe for cross-architectural distillation. To this end, we propose a principled two-stage approach: first, we distill knowledge from a traditional Transformer into a linearized version of Attention, using an adaptation of the kernel trick. Then, we distill the linearized version into an adapted Mamba model that does not use any Attention block.
