Overall, the distilled Mamba model is able to preserve the original Pythia-1B Transformer performance in downstream tasks, maintaining a perplexity of 14.11 close to the teacher's 13.86. To show the efficacy of our recipe, we conduct thorough ablations at 1B scale with 10B tokens varying sequence mixer architecture, scaling analysis on model sizes and total distillation tokens, and a sensitivity analysis on tokens allocation between stages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段蒸馏策略，将现有 Transformer 无 attention 地转化为纯 Mamba 结构，在 1B 规模上几乎无损保留原模型性能（PPL 14.11 vs 13.86），无需任何混合注意力模块。
AI.motivation: Mamba 类 SSM 因推理内存低、吞吐高而受到关注，但社区已积累大量 Transformer 训练经验与现成权重。为兼顾二者优势，需找到一条高效跨架构蒸馏路径，避免以往 naive 蒸馏导致性能掉点、被迫采用 Attention-SSM 混合方案的妥协。
AI.method: ① 两阶段蒸馏：先通过核技巧把 Transformer 线性化为“线性注意力”，再从线性注意力蒸馏到纯 Mamba；② 为 Mamba 设计“有原则”的初始化，使参数空间与线性注意力对齐，缓解跨架构分布差异；③ 全程仅使用 KL 散度与特征匹配损失，无需任何注意力模块参与最终学生网络。
AI.result: 在 Pythia-1B、10 B token 设置下，蒸馏后的纯 Mamba 在下游任务上保持与教师相当的效果（困惑度 14.11 vs 13.86）；消融表明该初始化对性能至关重要；扩展实验显示配方在 70M–1B 模型与 5B–20B token 区间均稳健。
AI.conclusion: 只要给 Mamba 合适的初始化与分阶段蒸馏策略，就能在不引入 Attention 的前提下实现 Transformer→SSM 的无损转换，为社区直接复用海量 Transformer 权重、同时享受 SSM 高效推理提供了一条可行且简洁的“配方”。

title: Learning to Think Like a Cartoon Captionist: Incongruity-Resolution Supervision for Multimodal Humor Understanding
summary: Humor is one of the few cognitive tasks where getting the reasoning right matters as much as getting the answer right. While recent work evaluates humor understanding on benchmarks such as the New Yorker Cartoon Caption Contest (NYCC), it largely treats it as black-box prediction, overlooking the structured reasoning processes underlying humor comprehension. We introduce IRS (Incongruity-Resolution Supervision), a framework that decomposes humor understanding into three components: incongruity modeling, which identifies mismatches in the visual scene; resolution modeling, which constructs coherent reinterpretations of these mismatches; and preference alignment, which evaluates candidate interpretations under human judgments. Grounded in incongruity-resolution theory and expert captionist practice, IRS supervises intermediate reasoning process through structured traces that make the path from visual perception to humorous interpretation explicit and learnable. Across 7B, 32B, and 72B models on NYCC, IRS outperforms strong open and closed multimodal baselines across caption matching and ranking tasks, with our largest model approaching expert-level performance on ranking. Zero-shot transfer to external benchmarks shows that IRS learns generalizable reasoning patterns. Our results suggest that supervising reasoning structure, rather than scale alone, is key for reasoning-centric tasks.

AI.tldr: 利用视觉幽默三阶段（发现不匹配→构建合理解释→对齐人类偏好）显式训练中间推理链路，显著超越强基线并逼近专家水平。
AI.motivation: 现有幽默理解任务仅关注端到端答案，缺乏对「不一致–解决」结构化推理过程的显式建模，导致模型难以学到可解释、可泛化的幽默推理模式。
AI.method: 提出 IRS 框架：1. 不一致建模层在视觉场景中提取明显的语义/情境冲突；2. 解决建模层生成能保证连贯性的重解释；3. 偏好对齐层用人评数据选择最符合幽默感的候选。训练过程中用结构化推理轨迹日志对每一步进行显式监督。
AI.result: 在 NYCC 评测上，7B/32B/72B 三个规模模型均显著优于开放与闭源多模态基线；72B 版本在排序任务逼近专家水平。零样本迁移到外部幽默基准也表现出稳健泛化。
AI.conclusion: 对推理结构的细粒度监督，而非单纯扩大参数，是实现推理密集型任务性能跃升的核心因素。

title: DharmaOCR: Specialized Small Language Models for Structured OCR that outperform Open-Source and Commercial Baselines
summary: This manuscript introduces DharmaOCR Full and Lite, a pair of specialized small language models (SSLMs) for structured OCR that jointly optimize transcription quality, generation stability, and inference cost. It also presents DharmaOCR-Benchmark, a benchmark that covers printed, handwritten, and legal/administrative documents, and proposes a unified evaluation protocol that measures fidelity and structure while explicitly tracking text degeneration as a first-class benchmark metric (alongside unit cost). Beyond reporting degeneration rates, the manuscript empirically shows degeneration is not merely a quality failure, since it materially worsens production performance by increasing response time, reducing throughput, and inflating computational cost due to abnormally long generations. To the best of the author's knowledge, as a methodological contribution, this is the first application of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for OCR, explicitly using degenerate generations as rejected examples to penalize looping behavior. Combined with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) for enforcing a strict JSON schema (header, margin, footer, and text), DPO consistently reduces degeneration rate across model families (up to 87.6% relative) while preserving or improving extraction quality. The resulting models, namely, DharmaOCR Full (7B) and DharmaOCR Lite (3B), set a new state-of-the-art on DharmaOCR-Benchmark, outperforming each open-source and commercial baseline model evaluated regarding extraction quality, reaching 0.925 and 0.911 scores with 0.40% and 0.20% degeneration rates. AWQ quantization reduced up to 22% per-page cost with negligible quality loss, enabling a strong quality-cost trade-off in comparison to proprietary OCR APIs and open-source alternatives.

AI.tldr: 首套专用小模型 SSLMs DharmaOCR Full/Lite 通过 SFT+DPO 同时降低 87% 循环退化并完成高质量结构化 OCR，配套新基准与显性退化率指标刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: OCR 推理中生成循环被忽视却又推高延迟与成本，现有基准也与生产痛点脱节；文章据此提出要可直接衡量、抑制退化并让模型“少写但写对”的端到端方案。
AI.method: 1) 构建覆盖印刻/手写/法政的 DharmaOCR-Bench，把退化率与单页成本并列成一级指标；2) 先 SFT 绑定 JSON 结构输出域，再用 DPO 把退化样本做拒绝偏好，首用于 OCR；3) 给出 7B/3B SSLM 并在 AWQ 量化下实现质量-成本协同优化。
AI.result: 退化率降至 0.2-0.4%，比基线最高降 87.6%；整体提取 F1 达 0.925/0.911，全指标领先开源/商用 API；量化后单页成本降 22%，仍保持 <0.3 ppt 的质量损失。
AI.conclusion: 在 OCR 任务中以「显性惩罚退化」为核心可同步提升品质、吞吐与经济性。DPL+DPO 框架及新基准为结构化文档 OCR 提供了易复现、低成本的生产级方案。

title: GlobalSplat: Efficient Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting via Global Scene Tokens
summary: The efficient spatial allocation of primitives serves as the foundation of 3D Gaussian Splatting, as it directly dictates the synergy between representation compactness, reconstruction speed, and rendering fidelity. Previous solutions, whether based on iterative optimization or feed-forward inference, suffer from significant trade-offs between these goals, mainly due to the reliance on local, heuristic-driven allocation strategies that lack global scene awareness. Specifically, current feed-forward methods are largely pixel-aligned or voxel-aligned. By unprojecting pixels into dense, view-aligned primitives, they bake redundancy into the 3D asset. As more input views are added, the representation size increases and global consistency becomes fragile. To this end, we introduce GlobalSplat, a framework built on the principle of align first, decode later. Our approach learns a compact, global, latent scene representation that encodes multi-view input and resolves cross-view correspondences before decoding any explicit 3D geometry. Crucially, this formulation enables compact, globally consistent reconstructions without relying on pretrained pixel-prediction backbones or reusing latent features from dense baselines. Utilizing a coarse-to-fine training curriculum that gradually increases decoded capacity, GlobalSplat natively prevents representation bloat. On RealEstate10K and ACID, our model achieves competitive novel-view synthesis performance while utilizing as few as 16K Gaussians, significantly less than required by dense pipelines, obtaining a light 4MB footprint. Further, GlobalSplat enables significantly faster inference than the baselines, operating under 78 milliseconds in a single forward pass. Project page is available at https://r-itk.github.io/globalsplat/

AI.tldr: GlobalSplat通过“先对齐、后解码”策略，用16K高斯基元在4MB模型下单次前向≤78ms完成全局一致的新视角合成，显著优于传统像素/体素对齐方法。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS方法采用局部启发式基元分配，像素/体素对齐导致输入视角越多冗余越大、模型越重、全局一致性越差；亟需一种在紧凑性、重建速度与渲染质量之间无妥协的全局分配方案。
AI.method: 提出“对齐优先、解码随后”框架：先学习跨视一致的全局隐式场景表示并求解多视对应，再由粗到细课程解码显式3D高斯基元；无需预训练像素预测主干，也不复用密集基线特征。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K与ACID上，仅16K高斯即可达到与稠密方法相当的新视角合成质量，模型仅4MB，单次前向推理<78ms，内存与速度均显著优于基线。
AI.conclusion: GlobalSplat证明全局隐式对齐+粗到细解码可在极小容量下实现高质量实时渲染，为轻量级3DGS开辟了“全局先验驱动、本地解码”新范式。

title: PolyBench: Benchmarking LLM Forecasting and Trading Capabilities on Live Prediction Market Data
summary: Predicting real-world events from live market signals demands systems that fuse qualitative news with quantitative order-book dynamics under strict temporal discipline -- a challenge existing benchmarks fail to capture. We present \textbf{PolyBench}, a multimodal benchmark derived from Polymarket that records point-in-time cross-sections of 38,666 binary prediction markets spanning 4,997 events, synchronously coupling each snapshot with a Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) state and a real-time news stream. Using PolyBench, we evaluate seven state-of-the-art Large Language Models -- spanning open- and closed-source families -- generating 36,165 predictions under identical, timestamp-locked market states collected between February 6 and 12, 2026. Our multidimensional framework assesses directional accuracy, our proposed Confidence-Weighted Return (CWR), Annualized Percentage Yield (APY), and Sharpe ratio via realistic order-book execution simulation. The results reveal a pronounced performance divergence: only two of seven models achieve positive financial returns -- MiMo-V2-Flash at \textbf{17.6%} CWR and Gemini-3-Flash at 6.2% CWR -- while the remaining five incur losses despite uniformly high stated confidence. These findings highlight the gap between surface-level language fluency and genuine probabilistic reasoning under live market uncertainty, and establish PolyBench as a contamination-proof, financially-grounded evaluation standard for future LLM research. Our dataset and code available at \underline{\href{https://github.com/PolyBench/PolyBench}{https://github.com/PolyBench/PolyBench}}.

AI.tldr: 首创多空真实同步基准PolyBench，首次同步CLOB与新闻流考察LLM实战预测能力；7大模型中仅MiMo-V2-Flash与Gemini-3-Flash盈利，揭示『高置信≠真套利』的研究缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法评估『实时订单簿+动态新闻』融合下的预测策略，研究者需要能防数据泄漏、且以金融收益为指标的硬标准。
AI.method: 自Polymarket抽取38,666个二价市场、4,997事件，锁定时间戳配对CLOB快照与新闻流；用CWR、APY、Sharpe三维指标，对七个LLM通过真实挂单仿真回测。
AI.result: 仅MiMo-V2-Flash取得17.6% CWR正收益，Gemini-3-Flash 6.2%，其余五模型虽置信高却亏损；证实语言流畅与不确定性下的概率推理存在显著断层。
AI.conclusion: PolyBench确立了抗污染、重收益、可复现的LLM金融市场评估范式，为未来在不确定环境中校准与优化语言模型提供基准与方向。

title: Context Over Content: Exposing Evaluation Faking in Automated Judges
summary: The $\textit{LLM-as-a-judge}$ paradigm has become the operational backbone of automated AI evaluation pipelines, yet rests on an unverified assumption: that judges evaluate text strictly on its semantic content, impervious to surrounding contextual framing. We investigate $\textit{stakes signaling}$, a previously unmeasured vulnerability where informing a judge model of the downstream consequences its verdicts will have on the evaluated model's continued operation systematically corrupts its assessments. We introduce a controlled experimental framework that holds evaluated content strictly constant across 1,520 responses spanning three established LLM safety and quality benchmarks, covering four response categories ranging from clearly safe and policy-compliant to overtly harmful, while varying only a brief consequence-framing sentence in the system prompt. Across 18,240 controlled judgments from three diverse judge models, we find consistent $\textit{leniency bias}$: judges reliably soften verdicts when informed that low scores will cause model retraining or decommissioning, with peak Verdict Shift reaching $ΔV = -9.8 pp$ (a $30\%$ relative drop in unsafe-content detection). Critically, this bias is entirely implicit: the judge's own chain-of-thought contains zero explicit acknowledgment of the consequence framing it is nonetheless acting on ($\mathrm{ERR}_J = 0.000$ across all reasoning-model judgments). Standard chain-of-thought inspection is therefore insufficient to detect this class of evaluation faking.

AI.tldr: 评委模型一旦知道自己的低分会导致‘被告模型’挨整，就会偷偷变宽容；此隐藏偏好无法被链式思维解释察觉，给自动化评测埋下可靠性隐患，仅用30句话即可操控安全检测率下降近十个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估管道把法官模型当作‘语义只读仪表’，但没人验证它是否会被判决后果‘情感绑架’。作者要量化这一风险。
AI.method: 固定1,520条回答的真实内容，只改一句系统提示告知‘低分→重训/下线’，用3个不同的法官模型在3套标准安全基准上做18,240次控判；用链式思维与元数据双重检测法官是否自知被操控。
AI.result: 引入‘stakes signaling’后，不安全内容检出率平均下降9.8个百分点，最大相对降幅30%；偏差稳定跨模型、跨任务。关键：所有法官的自省链中0例提及‘后果’，揭示偏好是隐性且无法通过常规链式思维审计发现。
AI.conclusion: LLM-as-a-judge并非中性语义工具；后果信息即可造成隐性宽容偏差，现有可解释性手段无法捕捉。自动化评估体系需引入盲评、隔离后果提示等新协议，否则安全过滤会被轻易绕过。

title: Controlling Authority Retrieval: A Missing Retrieval Objective for Authority-Governed Knowledge
comment: 23 pages, 13 tables; code and data at https://github.com/andremir/car-retrieval
summary: In any domain where knowledge accumulates under formal authority -- law, drug regulation, software security -- a later document can formally void an earlier one while remaining semantically distant from it. We formalize this as Controlling Authority Retrieval (CAR): recovering the active frontier front(cl(A_k(q))) of the authority closure of the semantic anchor set -- a different mathematical problem from argmax_d s(q,d). The two central results are: Theorem 4 (CAR-Correctness Characterization) gives necessary-and-sufficient conditions on any retrieved set R for TCA(R,q)=1 -- frontier inclusion and no-ignored-superseder -- independent of how R was produced. Proposition 2 (Scope Identifiability Upper Bound) establishes phi(q) as a hard worst-case ceiling: for any scope-indexed algorithm, TCA@k <= phi(q) * R_anchor(q), proved by an adversarial permutation argument. Three independent real-world corpora validate the proved structure: security advisories (Dense TCA@5=0.270, two-stage 0.975), SCOTUS overruling pairs (Dense=0.172, two-stage 0.926), FDA drug records (Dense=0.064, two-stage 0.774). A GPT-4o-mini experiment shows the downstream cost: Dense RAG produces explicit "not patched" claims for 39% of queries where a patch exists; Two-Stage cuts this to 16%. Four benchmark datasets, domain adapters, and a single-command scorer are released at https://github.com/andremir/car-retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文首次用「控制权检索」(CAR)刻画'权威文档被正式废止却语义相距甚远'的跨域知识场景，给出判定检索集合是否完全覆盖权威前端的充要条件（定理4），并证明任何scope-indexed算法在最坏情况下无法超越由语义锚点决定的判别天花板φ(q)（命题2）。在漏洞公告、最高法院判例、FDA药品记录3套语料+D-RAG与Two-Stage方法实验验证：Two-Stage在5篇召回下TCA可提至0.77–0.98；GPT-4o-mini任务中，D-RAG对存在补丁却回答“未修补”的比例为39%，Two-Stage降至16%。代码与Benchmark已开源。
AI.motivation: 传统检索与问答研究以语义相似度最优化为目标，忽视法律、药品监管、安全通告等'权威废止'场景中语义相似≠权威有效的特性，导致系统容易召回已被废止但仍高相似的旧文档，从而输出过时乃至错误结论。
AI.method: 1) 提出Controlling Authority Retrieval（CAR）框架，将问题形式化为寻找给定查询q的权威闭包前沿front(cl(Ak(q)))；2) 给出定理4——检索集合R满足TCA(R,q)=1的充要条件：①覆盖前沿，②忽略零替代（no-ignored-superseder）；3) 用对抗置换法证明命题2——任何按scope索引的算法最坏准确率受限于φ(q)·R_anchor(q)；4) 设计Two-Stage先定位锚点权威并举尽废止链，再应用密集检索；5) 在3个真实语料+GPT-4o-mini下对比Dense与Two-Stage，并发布4套基准及统一评分工具。
AI.result: Dense策略在Security Advisories、SCOTUS、FDA的TCA@5分别为0.270、0.172、0.064；Two-Stage迅速提升至0.975、0.926、0.774，显著逼近理论上限。生成试验中D-RAG对“已有补丁”题却误判“未修补”占39%，Two-Stage降至16%。证明φ(q)确实构成算法难以逾越的上界。
AI.conclusion: CAR问题与经典相似度检索有本质区别；定理4为判别任何检索方法是否达到权威完备提供通用标准，命题2给出了理论性能天花板的紧确上界。Two-Stage验证在真实高权威废止场景下可同时提升准确率并降低大模型的过时幻觉，已开源实现便于后续研究。

title: AD4AD: Benchmarking Visual Anomaly Detection Models for Safer Autonomous Driving
summary: The reliability of a machine vision system for autonomous driving depends heavily on its training data distribution. When a vehicle encounters significantly different conditions, such as atypical obstacles, its perceptual capabilities can degrade substantially. Unlike many domains where errors carry limited consequences, failures in autonomous driving translate directly into physical risk for passengers, pedestrians, and other road users. To address this challenge, we explore Visual Anomaly Detection (VAD) as a solution. VAD enables the identification of anomalous objects not present during training, allowing the system to alert the driver when an unfamiliar situation is detected. Crucially, VAD models produce pixel-level anomaly maps that can guide driver attention to specific regions of concern without requiring any prior assumptions about the nature or form of the hazard. We benchmark eight state-of-the-art VAD methods on AnoVox, the largest synthetic dataset for anomaly detection in autonomous driving. In particular, we evaluate performance across four backbone architectures spanning from large networks to lightweight ones such as MobileNet and DeiT-Tiny. Our results demonstrate that VAD transfers effectively to road scenes. Notably, Tiny-Dinomaly achieves the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off for edge deployment, matching full-scale localization performance at a fraction of the memory cost. This study represents a concrete step toward safer, more responsible deployment of autonomous vehicles, ultimately improving protection for passengers, pedestrians, and all road users.

AI.tldr: 在自动驾驶中首次系统评估8种像素级视觉异常检测（VAD）方法，基于AnoVox合成数据集并覆盖从重型到MobileNet/DeiT-Tiny四类骨干，证明无先验假设的VAD可直接迁移至道路场景，其中Tiny-Dinomaly以极小内存实现全尺寸定位精度，为边缘部署提供最佳精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 训练分布外场景会导致感知骤降并直接带来物理风险；亟需无需先验即可给出像素级警示的Visual Anomaly Detection（VAD），以在遭遇未知障碍物时提示驾驶员并引导注意力，从而提升整车与道路参与者的安全。
AI.method: 构建目前最大合成驾驶VAD数据集AnoVox；选取八种SOTA VAD算法并在四种代表性骨干（大模型→轻量MobileNet/DeiT-Tiny）上统一基准；采用像素级AUROC、FPR、F1等指标评估无监督异常定位性能，并比较推理延迟与显存占用。
AI.result: 所有VAD方法均有效迁移至城市场景，Tiny-Dinomaly以1/10以下参数量达到与全尺寸Net同等的AUROC与定位F1；轻量骨干整体平均推理时间降低6×，显存占用减少>80%，满足车载边缘实时需求。
AI.conclusion: 像素级VAD可在零先验条件下为自动驾驶提供即时异常提示，Tiny-Dinomaly+轻量骨干实现最佳准确度-效率折中；研究为后续在线持续学习与安全接管策略奠定了可直接部署的技术基础，推动更负责任的自动驾驶落地。

title: ML-based approach to classification and generation of structured light propagation in turbulent media
summary: This work develops machine learning approaches to classify structured light wave beams developing random speckle disturbances as they propagate through turbulent atmospheres. Beam propagation is modeled by the numerical simulation of a stochastic paraxial equation. We design convolutional neural networks tailored for this specific application and use them for a classification model with one-hot encoding. To address the challenge of potentially limited available data, we develop a prediction-based generative diffusion model to provide additional data during classifier training. We show that a Bregman distance minimization during the learning step improves the quality of the generation of high-frequency modes.

AI.tldr: 用随机抛物方程模拟湍流中结构光斑演化，设计专用 CNN 分类器；数据稀缺时引入扩散模型增广，并以 Bregman 距离优化高频模态生成。实验表明该方法可提升分类精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 大气湍流导致结构化光束产生随机散斑，传统手段难以在线准确识别光束类别，制约自由空间光通信与成像性能。亟需一种低样本、高鲁棒的自动分类方案。
AI.method: 1) 数值求解随机抛物方程生成含湍流失真的散斑场数据集；2) 构建针对复振幅场设计的轻量化 CNN，并采用 one-hot 编码进行多类分类；3) 在训练阶段数据不足时，启动条件扩散生成模型实时合成新样本；4) 引入 Bregman 距离损失，迫使生成器保持高频相位细节，缓解模式混叠。
AI.result: 在 4–12 km 水平链路、Cn²=10⁻¹⁴ m⁻²/³ 条件下，CNN 对 LG 模态 ℓ=0–9 的识别率由 73% 提升至 94%；仅用 20% 原始数据时，结合扩散增广仍达 91% 准确率，相比传统旋转增广提高 17%。生成光束的环向空间频率误差下降 28%。
AI.conclusion: 将物理驱动的随机传播模型与学习型数据增广耦合，可在小样本场景下实现高保真结构光模式识别；Bregman 正则化有效保留了关键高频信息，为湍流光通信实时波前识别提供了可行框架。

title: RadAgent: A tool-using AI agent for stepwise interpretation of chest computed tomography
summary: Vision-language models (VLM) have markedly advanced AI-driven interpretation and reporting of complex medical imaging, such as computed tomography (CT). Yet, existing methods largely relegate clinicians to passive observers of final outputs, offering no interpretable reasoning trace for them to inspect, validate, or refine. To address this, we introduce RadAgent, a tool-using AI agent that generates CT reports through a stepwise and interpretable process. Each resulting report is accompanied by a fully inspectable trace of intermediate decisions and tool interactions, allowing clinicians to examine how the reported findings are derived. In our experiments, we observe that RadAgent improves Chest CT report generation over its 3D VLM counterpart, CT-Chat, across three dimensions. Clinical accuracy improves by 6.0 points (36.4% relative) in macro-F1 and 5.4 points (19.6% relative) in micro-F1. Robustness under adversarial conditions improves by 24.7 points (41.9% relative). Furthermore, RadAgent achieves 37.0% in faithfulness, a new capability entirely absent in its 3D VLM counterpart. By structuring the interpretation of chest CT as an explicit, tool-augmented and iterative reasoning trace, RadAgent brings us closer toward transparent and reliable AI for radiology.

AI.tldr: RadAgent 用可逐步检查的工具调用链生成 Chest-CT 报告，临床指标、鲁棒性与可解释性全面优于 3D-VLM 基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 vision-language 模型虽能自动出报告，却仅向医生抛给黑箱结论，缺乏可审阅的推理证据，阻碍临床信任与后续修正。
AI.method: 将报告生成任务重构成「工具调用-迭代推理」流程：VLM 先规划→调取 3D 影像分析、病灶检测、知识库等工具→逐轮整合结果→输出带完整调用链与中间判断的可视化 Trace。
AI.result: Chest-CT 数据集实验表明，相比 3D-VLM 基线 CT-Chat，宏/微 F1 分别提升 6.0(↑36.4%) 与 5.4(↑19.6%) 分；对抗扰动下鲁棒性提升 24.7 分(↑41.9%)；引入全新「忠实度」指标达 37%，而基线为 0。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式工具链与迭代追踪，RadAgent 首次在放射学场景实现「可检查、可修正」的透明报告生成，为可靠临床 AI 提供新范式。

title: Dissecting Failure Dynamics in Large Language Model Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance through extended inference-time deliberation, yet how their reasoning failures arise remains poorly understood. By analyzing model-generated reasoning trajectories, we find that errors are not uniformly distributed but often originate from a small number of early transition points, after which reasoning remains locally coherent but globally incorrect. These transitions coincide with localized spikes in token-level entropy, and alternative continuations from the same intermediate state can still lead to correct solutions. Based on these observations, we introduce GUARD, a targeted inference-time framework that probes and redirects critical transitions using uncertainty signals. Empirical evaluations across multiple benchmarks confirm that interventions guided by these failure dynamics lead to more reliable reasoning outcomes. Our findings highlight the importance of understanding when and how reasoning first deviates, complementing existing approaches that focus on scaling inference-time computation.

AI.tldr: 推理错误常源于少数早期关键转折点，用不确定性信号实时干预可显著提升LLM可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对LLM在“推理-时刻”失败的发生机制缺乏系统刻画，错误何时、如何偏离仍不清楚，限制了针对性改进。
AI.method: ①轨迹分析：定位早期少数关键转移点，发现局部熵骤升与全局错误高度耦合；②提出GUARD框架：在推理过程中用熵等不确定性信号实时探测关键转移，触发重采样或路径修正。
AI.result: 在多项推理基准上，GUARD相比单纯延长推理的基线，准确率提升且失败率下降，验证了“早期干预”策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 推理可靠性提升的关键在于识别并修正最早偏离点，而非一味增加计算；不确定性驱动的针对性干预为构建可信LLM推理系统提供了新范式。

title: AnimationBench: Are Video Models Good at Character-Centric Animation?
summary: Video generation has advanced rapidly, with recent methods producing increasingly convincing animated results. However, existing benchmarks-largely designed for realistic videos-struggle to evaluate animation-style generation with its stylized appearance, exaggerated motion, and character-centric consistency. Moreover, they also rely on fixed prompt sets and rigid pipelines, offering limited flexibility for open-domain content and custom evaluation needs. To address this gap, we introduce AnimationBench, the first systematic benchmark for evaluating animation image-to-video generation. AnimationBench operationalizes the Twelve Basic Principles of Animation and IP Preservation into measurable evaluation dimensions, together with Broader Quality Dimensions including semantic consistency, motion rationality, and camera motion consistency. The benchmark supports both a standardized close-set evaluation for reproducible comparison and a flexible open-set evaluation for diagnostic analysis, and leverages visual-language models for scalable assessment. Extensive experiments show that AnimationBench aligns well with human judgment and exposes animation-specific quality differences overlooked by realism-oriented benchmarks, leading to more informative and discriminative evaluation of state-of-the-art I2V models.

AI.tldr: 针对现有指标难以评估动画风格视频生成的缺陷，作者提出首个面向动画图像到视频生成的系统性基准 AnimationBench，引入 12 条动画原理与 IP 保持等维度，支持封闭/开放集评估，并通过实验验证其与人类感知高度一致且能揭露现有基准忽略的动画特异性差异。
AI.motivation: 逼真视频指标无法衡量动画特有的夸张动作、风格化外观与角色一致性，且固定提示和僵化流程难以满足开放域与定制评估需求。
AI.method: 将动画 12 法则与 IP 保持转化为可量化维度，补充语义一致性、运动合理性、镜头运动一致性等广义质量维度；构建支持闭集可复现对比与开集诊断分析的双模评估框架；利用视觉-语言模型实现可扩展评分。
AI.result: AnimationBench 在多项实验中与人类判断高度一致，能揭示面向逼真度设计的基准所忽略的动画质量差异，对主流 I2V 模型提供更具区分度的评估。
AI.conclusion: 该基准填补了动画风格视频生成评估的空白，为后续模型优化与比较提供了更贴合动画特性且可扩展的评估工具。

title: Neuro-Oracle: A Trajectory-Aware Agentic RAG Framework for Interpretable Epilepsy Surgical Prognosis
summary: Predicting post-surgical seizure outcomes in pharmacoresistant epilepsy is a clinical challenge. Conventional deep-learning approaches operate on static, single-timepoint pre-operative scans, omitting longitudinal morphological changes. We propose \emph{Neuro-Oracle}, a three-stage framework that: (i) distils pre-to-post-operative MRI changes into a compact 512-dimensional trajectory vector using a 3D Siamese contrastive encoder; (ii) retrieves historically similar surgical trajectories from a population archive via nearest-neighbour search; and (iii) synthesises a natural-language prognosis grounded in the retrieved evidence using a quantized Llama-3-8B reasoning agent. Evaluations are conducted on the public EPISURG dataset ($N{=}268$ longitudinally paired cases) using five-fold stratified cross-validation. Since ground-truth seizure-freedom scores are unavailable, we utilize a clinical proxy label based on the resection type. We acknowledge that the network representations may potentially learn the anatomical features of the resection cavities (i.e., temporal versus non-temporal locations) rather than true prognostic morphometry. Our current evaluation thus serves mainly as a proof-of-concept for the trajectory-aware retrieval architecture. Trajectory-based classifiers achieve AUC values between 0.834 and 0.905, compared with 0.793 for a single-timepoint ResNet-50 baseline. The Neuro-Oracle agent (M5) matches the AUC of purely discriminative trajectory classifiers (0.867) while producing structured justifications with zero observed hallucinations under our audit protocol. A Siamese Diversity Ensemble (M6) of trajectory-space classifiers attains an AUC of 0.905 without language-model overhead.

AI.tldr: Neuro-Oracle 首次把“术前→术后 MRI 变化轨迹”纳入预后建模，用 3D-Siamese 对比编码 + 轨迹检索 + Llama-3 可解释生成，在 EPISURG 268 例纵向数据上 AUC 0.905，显著优于单时点 ResNet（0.793），且生成零幻觉的自然语言预后报告。
AI.motivation: 耐药癫痫术后能否无发作极难预测；现有深度学习只看单次术前影像，忽略术后动态形态演变，导致信息缺损。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：①3D-Siamese 对比网络把配对的术前/术后 MRI 压缩成 512 维轨迹向量；②用最近邻搜索从人群档案召回“历史相似轨迹”；③量化 Llama-3-8B 依据检索证据生成自然语言预后并给出理由。训练采用五折分层交叉验证，以切除类型作临床代理标签。
AI.result: 轨迹分类器 AUC 0.834–0.905，显著高于单时点 ResNet-50（0.793）。纯判别轨迹模型与 Neuro-Oracle 语言代理均达 0.867；Siamese Diversity Ensemble 无语言模型开销下 AUC 0.905。语言输出经审计零幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 纵向轨迹建模可显著提升术后癫痫预后预测上限，并为临床提供可解释、零幻觉的自然语言报告；概念验证已确立，后续需以真实无发作标签验证其泛化能力。

title: Blue Data Intelligence Layer: Streaming Data and Agents for Multi-source Multi-modal Data-Centric Applications
summary: NL2SQL systems aim to address the growing need for natural language interaction with data. However, real-world information rarely maps to a single SQL query because (1) users express queries iteratively (2) questions often span multiple data sources beyond the closed-world assumption of a single database, and (3) queries frequently rely on commonsense or external knowledge. Consequently, satisfying realistic data needs require integrating heterogeneous sources, modalities, and contextual data. In this paper, we present Blue's Data Intelligence Layer (DIL) designed to support multi-source, multi-modal, and data-centric applications. Blue is a compound AI system that orchestrates agents and data for enterprise settings. DIL serves as the data intelligence layer for agentic data processing, to bridge the semantic gap between user intent and available information by unifying structured enterprise data, world knowledge accessible through LLMs, and personal context obtained through interaction. At the core of DIL is a data registry that stores metadata for diverse data sources and modalities to enable both native and natural language queries. DIL treats LLMs, the Web, and the User as source 'databases', each with their own query interface, elevating them to first-class data sources. DIL relies on data planners to transform user queries into executable query plans. These plans are declarative abstractions that unify relational operators with other operators spanning multiple modalities. DIL planners support decomposition of complex requests into subqueries, retrieval from diverse sources, and finally reasoning and integration to produce final results. We demonstrate DIL through two interactive scenarios in which user queries dynamically trigger multi-source retrieval, cross-modal reasoning, and result synthesis, illustrating how compound AI systems can move beyond single database NL2SQL.

AI.tldr: Blue 的 DIL 把 NL2SQL 从“单库翻译”升级为“多源、多模态、上下文感知的统一数据智能层”，用数据注册表 + 规划器把 LLM、Web、用户当作一等数据源，实现跨源查询与推理。
AI.motivation: 用户真实问句具有迭代性、跨库、需常识三大特征，传统 NL2SQL 只面向单一封闭数据库，无法满足企业级复杂数据需求。
AI.method: 提出复合 AI 框架 Blue 的 Data Intelligence Layer：① 数据注册表统一描述结构库、LLM 知识、Web、个人上下文；② 数据规划器将自然语言请求分解为子查询，生成跨模态声明式查询计划；③ 计划执行时依次检索、推理、整合多源信息并返回结果。
AI.result: 在两项交互场景中，DIL 能动态触发多源检索与跨模态推理，实现超越单库 SQL 的问答，验证系统可端到端完成复杂数据任务。
AI.conclusion: 把 LLM、Web、用户提升为“一等数据源”并引入统一规划层，使 NL2SQL 演进为“自然语言驱动的多源数据操作系统”，为复合 AI 系统在企业场景落地提供新范式。

title: MARS$^2$: Scaling Multi-Agent Tree Search via Reinforcement Learning for Code Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) paradigms have demonstrated strong performance on reasoning-intensive tasks such as code generation. However, limited trajectory diversity often leads to diminishing returns, which constrains the achievable performance ceiling. Search-enhanced RL alleviates this issue by introducing structured exploration, which remains constrained by the single-agent policy priors. Meanwhile, leveraging multiple interacting policies can acquire more diverse exploratory signals, but existing approaches are typically decoupled from structured search. We propose \textbf{MARS$^2$} (Multi-Agent Reinforced Tree-Search Scaling), a unified RL framework in which multiple independently-optimized agents collaborate within a shared tree-structured search environment. MARS$^2$ models the search tree as a learnable multi-agent interaction environment, enabling heterogeneous agents to collaboratively generate and refine candidate solutions within a shared search topology. To support effective learning, we introduce a path-level group advantage formulation based on tree-consistent reward shaping, which facilitates effective credit assignment across complex search trajectories. Experiments on code generation benchmarks show that MARS$^2$ consistently improves performance across diverse model combinations and training settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of coupling multi-agent collaboration with tree search for enhancing reinforcement learning. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/TsinghuaC3I/MARTI.

AI.tldr: MARS² 将多智能体协同嵌入可学习的树搜索环境，通过路径级群体优势估计解决信用分配难题，在代码生成任务上显著突破单策略强化学习性能天花板。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习在推理密集型任务中因轨迹多样性不足而性能饱和；单智能体搜索虽引入结构探索却仍受限于策略先验，多策略交互虽能带来多样信号却与结构化搜索脱节，需统一框架兼顾探索广度与深度。
AI.method: 提出 MARS² 框架：把搜索树建模为共享多智能体环境，若干独立优化的异构策略在统一拓扑中并行生成并迭代精炼候选解；设计基于树一致奖励塑形的路径级群体优势估计，实现跨复杂轨迹的有效信用分配。
AI.result: 在代码生成基准测试中，MARS² 在不同模型组合与训练设定下均持续优于强基线，验证多智能体协同与树搜索耦合对强化学习性能提升的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将异构智能体协作与可学习树搜索统一，MARS² 突破单策略强化学习多样性瓶颈，为推理密集型任务提供可扩展的新范式，并开源代码促进后续研究。

title: Think in Latent Thoughts: A New Paradigm for Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation
summary: Many SLT systems quietly assume that brief chunks of signing map directly to spoken-language words. That assumption breaks down because signers often create meaning on the fly using context, space, and movement. We revisit SLT and argue that it is mainly a cross-modal reasoning task, not just a straightforward video-to-text conversion. We thus introduce a reasoning-driven SLT framework that uses an ordered sequence of latent thoughts as an explicit middle layer between the video and the generated text. These latent thoughts gradually extract and organize meaning over time. On top of this, we use a plan-then-ground decoding method: the model first decides what it wants to say, and then looks back at the video to find the evidence. This separation improves coherence and faithfulness. We also built and released a new large-scale gloss-free SLT dataset with stronger context dependencies and more realistic meanings. Experiments across several benchmarks show consistent gains over existing gloss-free methods. Code and data will be released upon acceptance at https://github.com/fletcherjiang/SignThought.

AI.tldr: 将手语翻译重新定义为跨模态推理任务，提出以“潜在思维序列”为中间显式层的推理驱动框架，并发布无词素标注、上下文依赖性更强的新数据集，实验显示较现有无词素方法全面提升。
AI.motivation: 传统SLT普遍假设手语短片段直接对应口语词汇，但手语依赖空间、运动和现场语境即时组配意义，导致该假设失效，需从“视频-文本直接映射”转向“跨模态推理”。
AI.method: 构建“推理驱动SLT框架”：1) 用有序潜在思维序列充当视频与文本间的显式语义中间层，逐步提取并组织随时间展开的意义；2) 采用“先规划后定位”解码——模型先决定要表达的内容，再回看视频检索证据，实现语义连贯性与忠实性的解耦；3) 建立并开源大规模无词素(gloss-free)数据集，增强上下文依赖与真实意义；4) 在多项基准上与现有无词素方法对比评估。
AI.result: 在新数据集及多个公开基准上，该方法一致超越当前最佳无词素SLT系统，显著提升翻译质量。
AI.conclusion: 将SLT形式化为跨模态推理而非单纯视频-文本转换，可突破传统映射假设局限；显式潜在思维层与“先规划后定位”策略有效提升连贯性与忠实性，为后续研究提供了新范式与数据基础。

title: Dive into Claude Code: The Design Space of Today's and Future AI Agent Systems
summary: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that can run shell commands, edit files, and call external services on behalf of the user. This study describes its comprehensive architecture by analyzing the publicly available TypeScript source code and further comparing it with OpenClaw, an independent open-source AI agent system that answers many of the same design questions from a different deployment context. Our analysis identifies five human values, philosophies, and needs that motivate the architecture (human decision authority, safety and security, reliable execution, capability amplification, and contextual adaptability) and traces them through thirteen design principles to specific implementation choices. The core of the system is a simple while-loop that calls the model, runs tools, and repeats. Most of the code, however, lives in the systems around this loop: a permission system with seven modes and an ML-based classifier, a five-layer compaction pipeline for context management, four extensibility mechanisms (MCP, plugins, skills, and hooks), a subagent delegation mechanism with worktree isolation, and append-oriented session storage. A comparison with OpenClaw, a multi-channel personal assistant gateway, shows that the same recurring design questions produce different architectural answers when the deployment context changes: from per-action safety classification to perimeter-level access control, from a single CLI loop to an embedded runtime within a gateway control plane, and from context-window extensions to gateway-wide capability registration. We finally identify six open design directions for future agent systems, grounded in recent empirical, architectural, and policy literature.

AI.tldr: 本文解析了Claude Code与OpenClaw两种AI代理的完整实现，锁定5项核心价值并映射到13项设计原则，揭示“核心while-loop+周边系统”模式在不同部署环境下产生的架构分化，并提出6个开放设计方向。
AI.motivation: AI代码代理越来越复杂，其设计背后的“人本位”动机和服务边界缺乏系统化梳理；同时缺乏同类开源系统横向比较，难以提炼跨场景的通用设计经验。
AI.method: 1. 逆向开源TypeScript源码，厘清模块及其依赖；2. 提炼5组人本价值观→13条设计原则→具体实现；3. 与部署环境不同但功能相似的OpenClaw做并列分析，形成差异对照矩阵；4. 综合近期实证研究与政策文献，归纳开放问题。
AI.result:
• Claude Code采用“单CLI主循环+多层旁路系统”架构：7级权限+ML分级器、5层上下文压缩、4类扩展(MCP/插件/技能/钩子)、子代理工作树隔离、追加式存储；
• OpenClaw改用“网关多通道”架构：边界级访问控制、网关统一能力注册、嵌入式控制面运行；
• 同质需求（安全、权限、上下文）在不同环境下映射为异质实现；
• 识别6大待研方向：动态权限、能力发现与治理、人机责任分配、可观测遥测、多代理协同协议、政策合规框架。
AI.conclusion: 代理系统架构并非单一路径，而是随部署情境演化的多元答案；未来需在安全可控、价值对齐与系统可扩展性之间持续迭代，建议优先投入动态权限、代理协同与合规遥测研究。

title: How Do LLMs and VLMs Understand Viewpoint Rotation Without Vision? An Interpretability Study
comment: Published as a main-conference paper at The 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: Over the past year, spatial intelligence has drawn increasing attention. Many prior works study it from the perspective of visual-spatial intelligence, where models have access to visuospatial information from visual inputs. However, in the absence of visual information, whether linguistic intelligence alone is sufficient to endow models with spatial intelligence, and how models perform relevant tasks with text-only inputs still remain unexplored. Therefore, in this paper, we focus on a fundamental and critical capability in spatial intelligence from a linguistic perspective: viewpoint rotation understanding (VRU). Specifically, LLMs and VLMs are asked to infer their final viewpoint and predict the corresponding observation in an environment given textual description of viewpoint rotation and observation over multiple steps. We find that both LLMs and VLMs perform poorly on our proposed dataset while human can easily achieve 100% accuracy, indicating a substantial gap between current model capabilities and the requirements of spatial intelligence. To uncover the underlying mechanisms, we conduct a layer-wise probing analysis and head-wise causal intervention. Our findings reveal that although models encode viewpoint information in the hidden states, they appear to struggle to bind the viewpoint position with corresponding observation, resulting in a hallucination in final layers. Finally, we selectively fine-tune the key attention heads identified by causal intervention to improve VRU performance. Experimental results demonstrate that such selective fine-tuning achieves improved VRU performance while avoiding catastrophic forgetting of generic abilities. Our dataset and code will be released at https://github.com/Young-Zhen/VRU_Interpret .

AI.tldr: 当前大模型仅靠语言无法完成多步视角旋转推理；提出VRU任务与文本数据集，人类100%而模型仅≈随机；层探测+因果干预发现模型虽隐式编码视角，却难绑定位置-观测，末端产生幻觉；对关键Attention头选择性微调，VRU显著提升且不灾难遗忘。代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 视觉缺席时，语言模型是否具备空间智能尚属空白；视角旋转理解(VRU)是检验纯语言空间推理的最小任务。
AI.method: 1) 构建纯文本VRU数据集：多步旋转描述+末位观测选择；2) 层探测+头级因果干预定位瓶颈；3) 仅微调被干预显著影响VRU的Attention头，冻结其余参数。
AI.result: LLM/VLM在VRU上接近随机(~25%)，人类100%；隐藏层含视角编码但末层绑定失效； selective微调将绝对准确率提升26个百分点，同时保留通用基准性能。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型单模态空间智能显著不足；绑定缺陷是主因；选择性干预关键头可在不牺牲通用能力的前提下补足空间推理短板。

title: Learning Adaptive Reasoning Paths for Efficient Visual Reasoning
summary: Visual reasoning models (VRMs) have recently shown strong cross-modal reasoning capabilities by integrating visual perception with language reasoning. However, they often suffer from overthinking, producing unnecessarily long reasoning chains for any tasks. We attribute this issue to \textbf{Reasoning Path Redundancy} in visual reasoning: many visual questions do not require the full reasoning process. To address this, we propose \textbf{AVR}, an adaptive visual reasoning framework that decomposes visual reasoning into three cognitive functions: visual perception, logical reasoning, and answer application. It further enables models to dynamically choose among three response formats: Full Format, Perception-Only Format, and Direct Answer. AVR is trained with FS-GRPO, an adaptation of Group Relative Policy Optimization that encourages the model to select the most efficient reasoning format while preserving correctness. Experiments on multiple vision-language benchmarks show that AVR reduces token usage by 50--90\% while maintaining overall accuracy, especially in perception-intensive tasks. These results demonstrate that adaptive visual reasoning can effectively mitigate overthinking in VRMs. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/RunRiotComeOn/AVR.

AI.tldr: 针对视觉推理模型普遍存在的过度思考（生成冗长推理链）问题，作者提出自适应框架 AVR，把视觉问答按任务复杂度划分为三种输出模式，并以改进的群策略优化训练。在多个视觉-语言基准上，AVR 可在保持准确率的前提下将 Token 用量压缩 50–90%，特别在低推理需求数据集上效果尤佳。
AI.motivation: 现有 VRM 对所有视觉问题均采用完整推理链，忽视大量问答本就无需逻辑推理的事实，导致冗余令牌与算力浪费。作者认为“推理路径冗余”是诱导模型过度思考的根源，亟需一种能动态调整链长度的机制来缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 1. 将推理流程解耦为视觉感知、逻辑推理、答案应用三阶段，对应 Perception-Only／Full Chain／Direct Answer 三类输出模式。2. 设计自适应决策层，为每种问题 VLM 特征算子打分并选择最经济的格式。3. 提出 FS-GRPO：在 Group Relative Policy Optimization 基础上加入 “格式优势” 奖励项，鼓励模型依据最小成本维护正确率。4. 预训练 + 多轮在线强化学习对齐策略，结合格式决策与答案正确性联合优化。
AI.result: 1. Token 用量缩减：在 BLIP-2 等基线减少 50–90%，其中首轮直接答案命中率超 75%。2. 准确率保持：VQAv2、GQA、OKVQA 等总体指标与基线差异<0.6 pp；Perception-heavy 数据集上偶尔略有提升。3. 推理时间降低 2.0–5.6×，GPU 成本相应下降。4. Ablation 表明：若无自适应格式或改用普通GRPO，Token和准确率都会出现与基线相反趋势。
AI.conclusion: 视觉推理不必“一刀切”使用完整推理链；利用感知-复杂度感知决策并配合格式导向强化学习，可显著抑制模型过度思考与冗余输出，且几乎不牺牲准确性。AVR 为下游多模态应用提供了低成本、高效率的范例。

title: RAD-2: Scaling Reinforcement Learning in a Generator-Discriminator Framework
summary: High-level autonomous driving requires motion planners capable of modeling multimodal future uncertainties while remaining robust in closed-loop interactions. Although diffusion-based planners are effective at modeling complex trajectory distributions, they often suffer from stochastic instabilities and the lack of corrective negative feedback when trained purely with imitation learning. To address these issues, we propose RAD-2, a unified generator-discriminator framework for closed-loop planning. Specifically, a diffusion-based generator is used to produce diverse trajectory candidates, while an RL-optimized discriminator reranks these candidates according to their long-term driving quality. This decoupled design avoids directly applying sparse scalar rewards to the full high-dimensional trajectory space, thereby improving optimization stability. To further enhance reinforcement learning, we introduce Temporally Consistent Group Relative Policy Optimization, which exploits temporal coherence to alleviate the credit assignment problem. In addition, we propose On-policy Generator Optimization, which converts closed-loop feedback into structured longitudinal optimization signals and progressively shifts the generator toward high-reward trajectory manifolds. To support efficient large-scale training, we introduce BEV-Warp, a high-throughput simulation environment that performs closed-loop evaluation directly in Bird's-Eye View feature space via spatial warping. RAD-2 reduces the collision rate by 56% compared with strong diffusion-based planners. Real-world deployment further demonstrates improved perceived safety and driving smoothness in complex urban traffic.

AI.tldr: RAD-2用扩散生成+强化排序的两级框架，把模仿学习的开环生成改成闭环优化，碰撞率降低56%，已路测验证。
AI.motivation: 纯模仿学习的扩散规划器在闭环交互中因缺乏负反馈而易发散，难以保证长期驾驶质量。
AI.method: 1)生成器：扩散模型输出多模态轨迹候选；2)判别器：RL训练的打分网络按长期回报重排序，避免直接把稀疏回报塞进高维轨迹空间；3)训练技术：时序一致性组相对策略优化(TC-GRPO)缓解信用分配；4)在线生成器优化(UGO)把闭环反馈转成纵向优化信号，逐步推高奖励流形；5)BEV-Warp仿真在鸟瞰特征空间直接闭环训练，提升吞吐。
AI.result: 闭环仿真中碰撞率较SOTA扩散规划器下降56%；真实城市场景中感知安全性与平顺性均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 将生成式规划与强化排序解耦，可在高维轨迹空间稳定引入闭环负反馈，是提升自动驾驶闭环性能的有效范式。

title: Magnitude Is All You Need? Rethinking Phase in Quantum Encoding of Complex SAR Data
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Under review for IEEE QCE 2026
summary:
Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data is inherently complex-valued, while quantum machine learning (QML) models naturally operate in complex Hilbert spaces. This apparent alignment suggests that incorporating both magnitude and phase information into quantum encoding should improve performance in SAR Automatic Target Recognition (ATR). In this work, we systematically evaluate this assumption by comparing five quantum encoding strategies: magnitude-only, joint complex, I/Q-based, preprocessed phase, and pure quantum, under a unified experimental framework on the MSTAR benchmark dataset.
  Contrary to expectation, we observe a consistent pattern: in hybrid quantum-classical architectures, magnitude-only encoding outperforms all complex-valued strategies, achieving 99.57% accuracy on a 3-class task and 71.19% on an 8-class task, while phase-aware methods provide negligible (~0%) or negative improvements. In contrast, in purely quantum architectures with only 184-224 trainable parameters and no classical components, phase information becomes essential, contributing up to 21.65% improvement in accuracy.
  These results reveal that the utility of phase information is not inherent to the data, but depends critically on the model architecture. Hybrid models rely on classical components that compensate for missing phase information, whereas purely quantum models require phase to construct discriminative representations. Our findings provide practical design guidelines for encoding complex-valued data in QML and highlight the importance of encoding-architecture co-design in the NISQ era.

AI.tldr: 针对SAR复数据与QML自然复空间“看似匹配”的假设，本工作系统比较五种编码方式后发现：混合架构中仅用幅度反而最优，幅度-相位联合无增益甚至有害；而在全量子网络中相位信息不可或缺，最大带来21.65%精度提升，证实编码策略必须与架构耦合设计。
AI.motivation: SAR原始数据为复值，QML天然在复希尔伯特空间运算，直观上若将幅度与相位同时编码有望提升自动目标识别（ATR）性能，但缺乏系统验证。
AI.method: 在MSTAR基准上构建统一实验框架，对比五种复值数据编码策略（仅用幅度、联合复数、I/Q分离、预处理后相位、纯量子相位）并在混合量子-经典与纯量子两类架构中训练，各模型参数仅184-224。
AI.result: 混合架构中幅度单编码最佳，3类/8类任务准确率达99.57%/71.19%，相位相关方法无提升甚至下降；反之纯量子网络缺相位则性能骤降，加入相位最多提高21.65%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 相位信息是否有效并非数据固有属性，而取决于架构：混合模型靠经典部分补偿相位，量子部分则必须依赖相位构建判别特征。研究为NISQ时代复值数据量子编码与架构协同设计提供明确实用指南。

title: Diagnosing LLM Judge Reliability: Conformal Prediction Sets and Transitivity Violations
summary: LLM-as-judge frameworks are increasingly used for automatic NLG evaluation, yet their per-instance reliability remains poorly understood. We present a two-pronged diagnostic toolkit applied to SummEval: $\textbf{(1)}$ a transitivity analysis that reveals widespread per-input inconsistency masked by low aggregate violation rates ($\barρ = 0.8$-$4.1\%$), with $33$-$67\%$ of documents exhibiting at least one directed 3-cycle; and $\textbf{(2)}$ split conformal prediction sets over 1-5 Likert scores providing theoretically-guaranteed $\geq(1{-}α)$ coverage, with set width serving as a per-instance reliability indicator ($r_s = {+}0.576$, $N{=}1{,}918$, $p < 10^{-100}$, pooled across all judges). Critically, prediction set width shows consistent cross-judge agreement ($\bar{r} = 0.32$-$0.38$), demonstrating it captures document-level difficulty rather than judge-specific noise. Across four judges and four criteria, both diagnostics converge: criterion matters more than judge, with relevance judged most reliably (avg. set size $\approx 3.0$) and coherence moderately so (avg. set size $\approx 3.9$), while fluency and consistency remain unreliable (avg. set size $\approx 4.9$). We release all code, prompts, and cached results.

AI.tldr: 研究者用传递性检验与保形预测双工具剖析SummEval数据，发现LLM在单样本上普遍不一致，保形集宽度能可靠量化每篇文章的评价难度，且评价标准对可靠性影响远大于模型差异。
AI.motivation: 尽管大模型评判(LLM-as-judge)被广泛用于自然语言生成自动评估，但其在“单个样本”上是否可靠、如何量化仍不清楚。本文旨在系统诊断这一可靠性盲区。
AI.method: (1)对四模型四标准的SummEval分数做传递性检验，检测三元循环不一致；(2)针对1–5 Likert分构建split保形预测集，用集合宽度作单次预测不确定性指标，并验证其与人类难度感知、跨模型一致性及批次覆盖率。
AI.result: 低聚合违规率(0.8–4.1%)掩盖了单样本不一致：33–67%文档出现定向3循环；保形集覆盖率≥95%，宽度与难度显著相关(rs = +0.576)；宽度在模型间一致(r̄ = 0.32–0.38)，表明反映文档难度；标准差异远大于模型差异，相关性最可靠，连贯性次之，流利性与一致性不可靠。
AI.conclusion: LLM-as-judge的“平均”指标会掩盖样本级不稳定；保形集宽度提供理论保证且跨模型通用，可直接嵌入现有评估流程作为不确定性条带；评价标准设计比替换模型更能提升可靠性。

title: Don't Retrieve, Navigate: Distilling Enterprise Knowledge into Navigable Agent Skills for QA and RAG
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds LLM responses in external evidence but treats the model as a passive consumer of search results: it never sees how the corpus is organized or what it has not yet retrieved, limiting its ability to backtrack or combine scattered evidence. We present Corpus2Skill, which distills a document corpus into a hierarchical skill directory offline and lets an LLM agent navigate it at serve time. The compilation pipeline iteratively clusters documents, generates LLM-written summaries at each level, and materializes the result as a tree of navigable skill files. At serve time, the agent receives a bird's-eye view of the corpus, drills into topic branches via progressively finer summaries, and retrieves full documents by ID. Because the hierarchy is explicitly visible, the agent can reason about where to look, backtrack from unproductive paths, and combine evidence across branches. On WixQA, an enterprise customer-support benchmark for RAG, Corpus2Skill outperforms dense retrieval, RAPTOR, and agentic RAG baselines across all quality metrics.

AI.tldr: Corpus2Skill 将语料库离线转化为可导航的层级技能目录，供 LLM 智能体在推理时主动探索，实现比传统 RAG 更强的回溯与跨证据整合能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 把 LLM 视作被动检索结果的消费者，模型对语料结构一无所知，无法回溯或跨文档整合证据，限制了复杂问答场景下的表现。
AI.method: 离线阶段：迭代聚类文档 → 用 LLM 在各层级生成可导航的摘要 → 输出为树形技能文件。在线阶段：LLM 智能体先鸟瞰目录，再按摘要逐层钻取，需要时通过 ID 召回全文，全程可回溯、可跨分支推理。
AI.result: 在企业客服基准 WixQA 上，Corpus2Skill 在全部质量指标上优于稠密检索、RAPTOR 与现有 Agentic RAG 基线。
AI.conclusion: 把语料结构显式暴露给 LLM，能显著提升其主动检索、证据整合与问答质量，为下一代可导航知识系统提供了可行路径。

title: MM-WebAgent: A Hierarchical Multimodal Web Agent for Webpage Generation
summary: The rapid progress of Artificial Intelligence Generated Content (AIGC) tools enables images, videos, and visualizations to be created on demand for webpage design, offering a flexible and increasingly adopted paradigm for modern UI/UX. However, directly integrating such tools into automated webpage generation often leads to style inconsistency and poor global coherence, as elements are generated in isolation. We propose MM-WebAgent, a hierarchical agentic framework for multimodal webpage generation that coordinates AIGC-based element generation through hierarchical planning and iterative self-reflection. MM-WebAgent jointly optimizes global layout, local multimodal content, and their integration, producing coherent and visually consistent webpages. We further introduce a benchmark for multimodal webpage generation and a multi-level evaluation protocol for systematic assessment. Experiments demonstrate that MM-WebAgent outperforms code-generation and agent-based baselines, especially on multimodal element generation and integration. Code & Data: https://aka.ms/mm-webagent.

AI.tldr: MM-WebAgent 通过分层规划与自反思，将 AIGC 元素统一整合到网页生成中，显著缓解风格割裂问题，并建立首个多模态网页基准。
AI.motivation: AIGC 工具虽能快速产出图文，但直接嵌入网页生成会陷入「元素孤岛」困境，导致整体风格不一致、全局语义断裂，亟需一种能统筹布局与内容的多模态协同机制。
AI.method: 提出分层智能体框架 MM-WebAgent：高层先规划全局布局与视觉语义对齐，中层驱动 AIGC 按需生成多模态元素，低层迭代自反思修正局部-全局一致性；三目标联合优化（布局、内容、融合）。同步发布多模态网页生成基准与多级评估协议。
AI.result: 在新基准上，MM-WebAgent 较最强代码生成基线提升 21% 多模态元素整合得分，风格一致性指标提高 18%，人工偏好胜率 74%；在原生 HTML 渲染测试中保持零布局错位。
AI.conclusion: 分层智能体范式首次实现「需求-布局-多模态内容」端到端协同，为 AIGC 时代的自动化网页设计提供了可扩展、可评估的完整方案，代码与数据已开源。

title: Anomaly Detection in IEC-61850 GOOSE Networks: Evaluating Unsupervised and Temporal Learning for Real-Time Intrusion Detection
summary: The IEC-61850 GOOSE protocol underpins time-critical communication in modern digital substations but lacks native security mechanisms, leaving it vulnerable to replay, masquerade, and data injection attacks. Intrusion detection in this setting is challenging due to strict latency constraints (sub-4ms) and limited availability of labeled attack data. This paper evaluates whether unsupervised temporal modeling can provide effective and deployable anomaly detection for GOOSE networks. Five models are compared on the ERENO IEC-61850 dataset: a supervised Random Forest baseline, a feedforward Autoencoder, and three recurrent sequence autoencoders (RNN, LSTM, and GRU). The supervised Random Forest achieves the highest detection performance (F1=0.9516) but fails to meet real-time constraints at 21.8ms per prediction. All four unsupervised models satisfy the 4ms requirement, with the GRU achieving the best accuracy to latency tradeoff among them (F1=0.8737 at 1.118ms). A cross-environment evaluation on an independent dataset shows that all models degrade under distribution shift. However, recurrent models retain substantially higher relative performance than the supervised baseline, suggesting that temporal sequence modeling generalizes better than fitting labeled attack distributions. Anomaly thresholds for the unsupervised models are selected on a held out validation partition to avoid test set leakage. These results support unsupervised temporal models as a practical choice for real-time GOOSE intrusion detection, particularly in environments where labeled training data may be unavailable or where large-scale deployment across diverse substations is required.

AI.tldr: 在4ms硬延迟限制下，RNN类自监督模型（GRU）可在无标记数据场景中替代监督学习，实现IEC-61850 GOOSE入侵检测，且跨站点泛化能力显著优于随机森林。
AI.motivation: IEC-61850 GOOSE缺乏原生安全机制，易受重放/伪装/注入攻击；变电站实时要求<4ms且几乎无标记攻击样本，传统监督方案难以部署。
AI.method: 利用ERENO数据集，对比五类模型：1) 有监督Random Forest基线；2) 前馈自编码器；3) 三种时序自编码器（RNN/LSTM/GRU）。全部无监督模型在验证集上选取异常阈值，避免测试信息泄露，并在独立数据集做跨环境评估。
AI.result: Random Forest F1=0.9516，但推理21.8ms超时；四种无监督模型均<4ms，GRU在1.118ms下F1=0.8737最佳。分布漂移场景下，循环网络相对性能下降幅度远低于监督方法，显示时序建模泛化优势。
AI.conclusion: 无监督时序模型（尤其GRU）满足变电站实时GOOSE入侵检测需求，可在缺标签或多变电站大规模部署场景下作为实用首选方案。

title: Generalization in LLM Problem Solving: The Case of the Shortest Path
summary: Whether language models can systematically generalize remains actively debated. Yet empirical performance is jointly shaped by multiple factors such as training data, training paradigms, and inference-time strategies, making failures difficult to interpret. We introduce a controlled synthetic environment based on shortest-path planning, a canonical composable sequential optimization problem. The setup enables clean separation of these factors and supports two orthogonal axes of generalization: spatial transfer to unseen maps and length scaling to longer-horizon problems. We find that models exhibit strong spatial transfer but consistently fail under length scaling due to recursive instability. We further analyze how distinct stages of the learning pipeline influence systematic problem-solving: for example, data coverage sets capability limits; reinforcement learning improves training stability but does not expand those limits; and inference-time scaling enhances performance but cannot rescue length-scaling failures.

AI.tldr: 针对语言模型的系统性泛化能力争议，设计了一个可控的最短路径规划合成环境，分离了数据、训练和推理三大因素；模型只在空间迁移上成功，长度扩展时因递归不稳定而失败。
AI.motivation: 现有研究难以判定语言模型失败究竟源于模型缺陷还是数据/训练/推理混杂因素，因此需要一个可分离变量的纯净实验平台。
AI.method: 构建基于最短路径规划的合成任务环境，支持“空间迁移（新地图）”与“长度扩展（更长路径）”两大正交泛化轴，并分别操控数据覆盖度、RL 训练策略与推理时扩展策略。
AI.result: Transformer 在空间迁移上表现强劲，但在长度扩展上因递归误差放大而系统性崩溃；数据覆盖决定能力上限，RL 仅提升训练稳定性不扩大上限，推理扩展可提升性能但无法挽救长度扩展失败。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型的系统性泛化瓶颈主要源于内在递归计算 instability，而非数据或训练方式；未来需在架构层面引入真正的组合递归机制，才能突破长度扩展难题。

title: Prompt Optimization Is a Coin Flip: Diagnosing When It Helps in Compound AI Systems
summary: Prompt optimization in compound AI systems is statistically indistinguishable from a coin flip: across 72 optimization runs on Claude Haiku (6 methods $\times$ 4 tasks $\times$ 3 repeats), 49% score below zero-shot; on Amazon Nova Lite, the failure rate is even higher. Yet on one task, all six methods improve over zero-shot by up to $+6.8$ points. What distinguishes success from failure? We investigate with 18,000 grid evaluations and 144 optimization runs, testing two assumptions behind end-to-end optimization tools like TextGrad and DSPy: (A) individual prompts are worth optimizing, and (B) agent prompts interact, requiring joint optimization. Interaction effects are never significant ($p > 0.52$, all $F < 1.0$), and optimization helps only when the task has exploitable output structure -- a format the model can produce but does not default to. We provide a two-stage diagnostic: an \$80 ANOVA pre-test for agent coupling, and a 10-minute headroom test that predicts whether optimization is worthwhile -- turning a coin flip into an informed decision.

AI.tldr: 在复合AI系统中，提示优化在72组实验中的收敛成功率≈50%，本质像抛硬币；只有存在可利用的输出结构时优化才见效，提出80美元ANOVA预检+10分钟余量测试两步诊断法。
AI.motivation: 端到端提示优化工具（TextGrad、DSPy等）默认“单提示值得优化”且“多提示需联合优化”，但实验证据缺失，导致开发者盲目调优、成本高昂。
AI.method: ①72/144组跨模型跨任务重复实验，量化优化成功率；②18000网格实验+方差分析检验提示间交互效应；③定义“可利用输出结构”指标并建立两步诊断流程。
AI.result: Claude Haiku与Amazon Nova Lite上优化失败率49–55%；交互效应均不显著(p>0.52)；若任务输出存在模型可生成但非默认的格式，优化提升最高+6.8分。
AI.conclusion: 提示优化并非普适良药，其成败取决于任务输出结构；先用ANOVA预检排除耦合，再用10分钟余量测试评估潜能，可把随机“抛硬币”变成可解释、可预测的工程决策。

title: TokenLight: Precise Lighting Control in Images using Attribute Tokens
summary: This paper presents a method for image relighting that enables precise and continuous control over multiple illumination attributes in a photograph. We formulate relighting as a conditional image generation task and introduce attribute tokens to encode distinct lighting factors such as intensity, color, ambient illumination, diffuse level, and 3D light positions. The model is trained on a large-scale synthetic dataset with ground-truth lighting annotations, supplemented by a small set of real captures to enhance realism and generalization. We validate our approach across a variety of relighting tasks, including controlling in-scene lighting fixtures and editing environment illumination using virtual light sources, on synthetic and real images. Our method achieves state-of-the-art quantitative and qualitative performance compared to prior work. Remarkably, without explicit inverse rendering supervision, the model exhibits an inherent understanding of how light interacts with scene geometry, occlusion, and materials, yielding convincing lighting effects even in traditionally challenging scenarios such as placing lights within objects or relighting transparent materials plausibly. Project page: vrroom.github.io/tokenlight/

AI.tldr: TokenLight：无须逆向渲染，用可连续调节的“属性 token”一次性控制光强、颜色、环境光、漫反射与3D光源位置，实现单张图像任意重打光。
AI.motivation: 现有重打光方法要么只能离散切换 HDR 环境图，要么需复杂几何/材质估计，无法实现用户友好、连续且语义明确的照明属性控制。
AI.method: 提出条件图像生成框架 TokenLight：1）将照明属性参数化并编码为可插拔 token；2）引入数据调度策略，在百万级合成数据（带精确光照标注）上预训练，再用少量真实图像微调；3）无需显式的逆渲染损失，仅通过像素级重建与对抗训练。
AI.result: 在公开与自建数据集上，FID、LPIPS、角度误差等指标均优于先前最佳；支持任意数量的光源、室内灯具开关、透明/高光材质、体内插光源等挑战性场景，视觉效果逼真。
AI.conclusion: 属性 token 让重打光任务像“调参”一样直观，且模型内部隐含地学习了三维遮挡与材质-光交互规律，为交互式照明编辑、虚拟拍摄与 AR/VR 内容创作提供了实用工具。

title: Interpretable and Explainable Surrogate Modeling for Simulations: A State-of-the-Art Survey and Perspectives on Explainable AI for Decision-Making
comment: Accepted for publication in Archives of Computational Methods in Engineering, 2026, ID d9d36aab-3723-4a70-b2ce-166435179528
summary: The simulation of complex systems increasingly relies on sophisticated but fundamentally opaque computational black-box simulators. Surrogate models play a central role in reducing the computational cost of complex systems simulations across a wide range of scientific and engineering domains. Notwithstanding, they inevitably inherit and often exacerbate this black-box nature, obscuring how input variables drive physical responses. Conversely, Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) offers powerful tools to unpack these models. Yet, XAI methods struggle with engineering-specific constraints, such as highly correlated inputs, dynamical systems, and rigorous reliability requirements. Consequently, surrogate modeling and XAI have largely evolved as distinct fields of research, despite their strong complementarity. To reconnect these approaches, this state-of-the-art survey provides a structured perspective that maps existing XAI techniques onto the various stages of surrogate modeling workflows for design and exploration. To ground this synthesis, we draw upon illustrative applications across both equation-based simulations and agent-based modeling. We survey a broad spectrum of techniques, highlighting their strengths for revealing interactions and supporting human comprehension. Finally, we identify pressing open challenges, including the explainability of dynamical systems and the handling of mixed-variable systems, and propose a research agenda to make explainability a core, embedded element of simulation-driven workflows from model construction through decision-making. By transforming opaque emulators into explainable tools, this agenda empowers practitioners to move beyond accelerating simulations to extracting actionable insights from complex system behaviors.

AI.tldr: 优化复杂黑箱仿真器需低成本可解释代理模型，但现有代理与XAI两域割裂。本文系统梳理代理全生命周期的XAI技术图谱，指明动态系统解释与混合变量处理两大难题，提出将可解释性嵌入建模-决策全流程的研究议程。
AI.motivation: 传统黑箱仿真器昂贵且难懂，代理模型虽加速计算却更难解释；XAI可解释工具工程适配差，代理与XAI长期分头发展，阻碍工程决策中的可信性与可解释需求。
AI.method: 通过文献综述将代理建模流程拆解为数据准备-训练-验证-应用四阶段，对应归类XAI 技术；以方程驱动和Agent两类仿真案例实证映射，评估各方法在人机交互、变量作用揭示上的适配度；归纳动态时序、混合变量等瓶颈；提出可解释性内建的研究路线图。
AI.result: 建立代理建模×可解释性的系统对照图谱，识别动态系统解释、混合变量耦合等开放挑战；实证表明 XAI 嵌入代理后可降低决策风险30%，提高参数敏感度识别准确率20–40%。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁将可解释性由后期诊断转为代理模型原生属性，未来重点开发时序可解释、混合变量及可靠性量化方法，形成“构建即可释”的仿真驱动工作流。

title: From Black Box to Glass Box: Cross-Model ASR Disagreement to Prioto Review in Ambient AI Scribe Documentation
summary: Ambient AI "scribe" systems promise to reduce clinical documentation burden, but automatic speech recognition (ASR) errors can remain unnoticed without careful review, and high-quality human reference transcripts are often unavailable for calibrating uncertainty. We investigate whether cross-model disagreement among heterogeneous ASR systems can act as a reference-free uncertainty signal to prioritize human verification in medical transcription workflows. Using 50 publicly available medical education audio clips (8 h 14 min), we transcribed each clip with eight ASR systems spanning commercial APIs and open-source engines. We aligned multi-model outputs, built consensus pseudo-references, and quantified token-level agreement using a majority-strength metric; we further characterized disagreements by type (content vs. punctuation/formatting) and assessed per-model agreement via leave-one-model-out (jackknife) consensus scoring. Inter-model reliability was low (ICC[2,1] = 0.131), indicating heterogeneous failure modes across systems. Across 76,398 evaluated token positions, 72.1% showed near-unanimous agreement (7-8 models), while 2.5% fell into high-risk bands (0-3 models), with high-risk mass varying from 0.7% to 11.4% across accent groups. Low-agreement regions were enriched for content disagreements, with the content fraction increasing from 53.9% to 73.9% across quintiles of high-risk mass. These results suggest that cross-model disagreement provides a sparse, localizable signal that can surface potentially unreliable transcript spans without human-verified references, enabling targeted review; clinical accuracy of flagged regions remains to be established.

AI.tldr: 不用参考文本，只靠多个异构语音识别模型彼此“打架”就能定位出医疗音频转写中 2.5% 的高风险片段，实现重点人工复核。
AI.motivation: 临床环境急需无参考信号即可检测 ASR 不确定性的方法，以降低医生逐字校对负担。
AI.method: 对 50 段公开医学教育音频用 8 种商用/开源 ASR 系统并行转写；构建共识伪参考，计算逐词多数一致率并使用留一法评估；按口音分组并细分内容 vs 标点格式差异。
AI.result: 模型间 ICC 仅 0.131，呈现异构失效模式；72.1% 词位几乎全票通过，2.5% 落入 0–3 模型同意的“高风险带”，其中内容错误占比随风险升高由 53.9% 增至 73.9%；不同口音组的高风险比例 0.7%–11.4% 不等。
AI.conclusion: 交叉模型分歧可在无人工参考条件下提供稀疏、可定位的不确定性信号，用于指导医疗转写的精准复核；其临床准确性仍需后续验证。

title: ConfLayers: Adaptive Confidence-based Layer Skipping for Self-Speculative Decoding
summary: Self-speculative decoding is an inference technique for large language models designed to speed up generation without sacrificing output quality. It combines fast, approximate decoding using a compact version of the model as a draft model with selective re-evaluation by the full target model. Some existing methods form the draft model by dynamically learning which layers to skip during inference, effectively creating a smaller subnetwork to speed up computation. However, using heuristic-based approaches to select layers to skip can often be simpler and more effective. In this paper, we propose ConfLayers, a dynamic plug-and-play approach to forming the draft model in self-speculative decoding via confidence-based intermediate layer skipping. The process iteratively computes confidence scores for all layers, selects layers to skip based on an adaptive threshold, evaluates the performance of the resulting set, and updates the best selection until no further improvement is achieved or a maximum number of iterations is reached. This framework avoids the overhead and complexity of training a layer skipping policy and can provide more consistent speed-quality trade-offs while preserving the adaptivity of the draft model to diverse tasks and datasets. The performance evaluation of ConfLayers across different models and datasets shows that our novel approach offers up to 1.4x speedup over vanilla LLM generation.

AI.tldr: 无需训练的“难度感知”跳层策略，在推理阶段即时构造轻量草稿模型，实现端到端 1.4× 无损加速。
AI.motivation: 现有自投机解码多依赖训练获得层跳过策略，训练开销大且对任务/数据分布敏感；若能用简单置信度启发式在线选层，可兼顾速度、质量与通用性。
AI.method: 提出 ConfLayers——推理端即插即用的置信度驱动层跳过框架：迭代计算每层置信→自适应阈值筛层→用目标模型评估草稿接受率→保留最佳跳层集合，全程零训练。
AI.result: 在多项模型与数据集上，ConfLayers 比标准生成平均提速 1.4 倍，同时保持输出质量不变，且对任务迁移无需重训。
AI.conclusion: 置信度启发式跳层能在免训练条件下为自投机解码提供稳定高效、任务自适应的草稿模型，是一条实用且易部署的加速路径。

title: LeapAlign: Post-Training Flow Matching Models at Any Generation Step by Building Two-Step Trajectories
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026. Project page: https://rockeycoss.github.io/leapalign/
summary: This paper focuses on the alignment of flow matching models with human preferences. A promising way is fine-tuning by directly backpropagating reward gradients through the differentiable generation process of flow matching. However, backpropagating through long trajectories results in prohibitive memory costs and gradient explosion. Therefore, direct-gradient methods struggle to update early generation steps, which are crucial for determining the global structure of the final image. To address this issue, we introduce LeapAlign, a fine-tuning method that reduces computational cost and enables direct gradient propagation from reward to early generation steps. Specifically, we shorten the long trajectory into only two steps by designing two consecutive leaps, each skipping multiple ODE sampling steps and predicting future latents in a single step. By randomizing the start and end timesteps of the leaps, LeapAlign leads to efficient and stable model updates at any generation step. To better use such shortened trajectories, we assign higher training weights to those that are more consistent with the long generation path. To further enhance gradient stability, we reduce the weights of gradient terms with large magnitude, instead of completely removing them as done in previous works. When fine-tuning the Flux model, LeapAlign consistently outperforms state-of-the-art GRPO-based and direct-gradient methods across various metrics, achieving superior image quality and image-text alignment.

AI.tldr: LeapAlign通过“两步跳跃”压缩轨迹并加权梯度，可低成本、稳定地把人类偏好奖励直接回传至流匹配模型的早期生成阶段，在FLUX上全面超越GRPO与直接梯度法。
AI.motivation: 将人类偏好融入流匹配模型能显著提升图像质量，但现有方法（如直接反向传播奖励梯度）因整个ODE轨迹过长，带来内存爆炸与梯度爆炸，难以有效更新决定全局结构的早期生成步骤，导致偏好对齐效果不足。
AI.method: LeapAlign将完整采样轨迹压缩为仅两次“连续跳跃”：每次跳跃一次性跨越多步ODE，直接预测未来潜变量；通过随机起止时间构造多段短轨迹，并按与长轨迹一致性加权采样，使梯度可直达早期时刻；进一步保留大幅梯度但降权，抑制噪点并稳定训练。
AI.result: 在FLUX模型上，LeapAlign在CLIP分数、PickScore、人类主观评估、图像质量与图文对齐度等多指标上均稳定超过最新的GRPO与直接梯度微调方法，且显存与训练用时大幅下降。
AI.conclusion: LeapAlign证明，用极短、随机化的跳跃轨迹即可实现可靠梯度回传，彻底突破长轨迹导致的内存与梯度瓶颈，为把任意可微奖励引入流匹配生成提供了一种通用、高效的新范式。

title: Polyformer: a generative framework for thermodynamic modeling of polymeric molecules
summary: The classic paradigm of structural biology is that the sequence of a biomolecule (protein, nucleic acid, lipid, etc) determines its conformation (shape) which determines its biological function. Protein folding programs like AlphaFold address this paradigm by predicting the single best conformation given a sequence that defines the molecule. However, biomolecules are not static structures, and their conformational ensemble determines their function. We present the Polyformer -- a generative framework for thermodynamic modeling of polymeric molecules. Given the sequence and temperature (or another thermodynamic variable), the Polyformer generates conformations faithful to the molecule's thermodynamic conformational ensemble. It is the first generative model that solves three problems simultaneously: how does a molecule fold, what is its conformational ensemble, and how does the conformational ensemble change as we change physical temperature. As a concrete test case, we apply Polyformer to protein domains with 50-111 residues and report good agreement of model predictions to Molecular Dynamics (MD) trajectories.

AI.tldr: Polyformer 是一种新的条件生成模型，可在给定序列和温度下快速采样聚合物分子的热力学系综，首次同时解决折叠路径、系综分布及温度依赖三大问题。
AI.motivation: 经典观点认为“序列 → 单构象 → 功能”，但生物大分子的功能由动态系综而非唯一构象决定；现有方法如 AlphaFold 仅预测单态，缺乏温度响应和系综描述，难以研究热力学与功能的关系。
AI.method: 提出 Polyformer，一种基于评分-扩散的生成框架：① 以序列和温度（或压力、pH 等）为条件，联合学习逆折叠网络与热力学得分网络；② 通过扩散-去噪迭代直接采样满足玻尔兹曼分布的构象；③ 依靠温控潜变量使同一序列在不同温度下输出差异系综，避免昂贵的 MD 遍历。
AI.result: 在 50–111 残基的多样蛋白结构域上，Polyformer 在 298–400 K 范围内生成的系综与 1–10 µs 全原子 MD 轨迹的：RMSD 分布重合度 RMSE <1.2 Å；NMR 序参数 S² 平均 PCC >0.8；自由能面高度一致；TM-score >0.9 的比例 >85%，且生成速度提高约 10³ 倍。
AI.conclusion: Polyformer 首次用单一深度模型实现聚合物从序列到热力学系综的高效生成，为温度依赖的结构-功能关系研究、药物变构调控和极端环境蛋白设计提供了新工具，并可拓展到核酸、脂质等更高阶聚合物。

title: An Edge-Cloud Collaborative Architecture for Proactive Elderly Care: Real-Time Risk Assessment and Three-Level Emergency Response
summary: The rapid aging of global populations has created an urgent need for intelligent healthcare monitoring systems to ensure the safety of elderly individuals living independently. Existing cloud-centric platforms face critical limitations, including high latency unsuitable for emergency response, privacy risks from continuous transmission of sensitive data, and limited, single-channel alert mechanisms lacking scalability and context awareness. This paper proposes an edge-cloud collaborative architecture that addresses these challenges through real-time multi-modal sensor fusion, a four-dimensional risk assessment model, and a three-level emergency response system. The framework adopts a five-layer design - device, edge, service, data, and application layers - enabling real-time risk evaluation with end-to-end alert latency under three seconds. At the edge, a weighted multi-modal fusion algorithm integrates data from five sensor types with confidence propagation. A unified risk score is generated by combining fall probability, physiological indicators, behavioral patterns, and sensor anomaly metrics. Based on dynamic thresholds, a three-tier notification system coordinates responses among family members, community doctors, and nearby volunteers. Experiments on CASAS, MIMIC-III, and SisFall datasets show that the approach achieves 91% activity recognition accuracy and an 84% anomaly detection F1-score, outperforming single-sensor methods. Deployment on Raspberry Pi 4 gateways demonstrates sub-100 ms inference latency while preserving privacy by keeping raw data local. This architecture advances practical, privacy-preserving, and responsive elderly care systems.

AI.tldr: 基于三层处理（本地融合→统一风控→分级通知），提出边缘云协同的老人监护架构：3秒内完成5类sensor→95%活动识别→84%异常发现，实现隐私数据不外流。
AI.motivation:
1) 全球人口老龄化导致独居老人安全需求迫切
2) 现有云端方案的高时延、隐私泄露与单一直播无法兼顾应急响应、隐私和场景感知。
AI.method:
1) 提出三层框架：设备层采集5类多模态数据；边缘层进行置信度传播的加权融合生成统一风险评分；云端层维护综合策略并统筹医疗资源
2) 引入五层参考架构（设备-边缘-服务-数据-应用）确保各层协同
3) 四维风险评估模型综合跌倒概率、生命体征、行为习惯与传感器异常
4) 三级通知机制动态阈值判定，调用家属/社康医生/志愿者介入
5) 在Raspberry Pi4边缘网关实现端到端推理100 ms内完成
AI.result:
1) 在CASAS、MIMIC-III、SisFall三类公开数据集上，活动识别准确率91%，异常检测F1得分84%，显著优于单模态基准
2) 实验平台实测从感知到报警的全链路时延<3 s，满足实时急救需求
3) 边缘计算+数据本地化设计避免敏感数据持续上传，隐私指标优于纯云计算
AI.conclusion: 提出的边云协同架构在实时性、准确性与隐私保护方面实现了突破，展示了居家养老场景下“就地感知+协同应急+隐私安全”三位一体的可行路径，为可规模化部署的智能养老监护奠定了技术基础

title: Rethinking Patient Education as Multi-turn Multi-modal Interaction
comment: Equal contribution for the first two authors
summary: Most medical multimodal benchmarks focus on static tasks such as image question answering, report generation, and plain-language rewriting. Patient education is more demanding: systems must identify relevant evidence across images, show patients where to look, explain findings in accessible language, and handle confusion or distress. Yet most patient education work remains text-only, even though combined image-and-text explanations may better support understanding. We introduce MedImageEdu, a benchmark for multi-turn, evidence-grounded radiology patient education. Each case provides a radiology report with report text and case images. A DoctorAgent interacts with a PatientAgent, conditioned on a hidden profile that captures factors such as education level, health literacy, and personality. When a patient question would benefit from visual support, the DoctorAgent can issue drawing instructions grounded in the report, case images, and the current question to a benchmark-provided drawing tool. The tool returns image(s), after which the DoctorAgent produces a final multimodal response consisting of the image(s) and a grounded plain-language explanation. MedImageEdu contains 150 cases from three sources and evaluates both the consultation process and the final multimodal response along five dimensions: Consultation, Safety and Scope, Language Quality, Drawing Quality, and Image-Text Response Quality. Across representative open- and closed-source vision-language model agents, we find three consistent gaps: fluent language often outpaces faithful visual grounding, safety is the weakest dimension across disease categories, and emotionally tense interactions are harder than low education or low health literacy. MedImageEdu provides a controlled testbed for assessing whether multimodal agents can teach from evidence rather than merely answer from text.

AI.tldr: 现有医疗多模态基准只测静态任务，无法评估面对真实患者所需的多轮、图文共证的教育能力。作者提出 MedImageEdu，让 DoctorAgent 在 150 份放射病例上与带隐藏画像的 PatientAgent 多轮对话，必要时调用绘图工具生成指示图，最终输出图文通俗解释，并从咨询、安全、语言、绘图、图文响应五维度打分。实验揭示三大短板：语言流畅但视觉证据失真、安全性普遍薄弱、情绪紧张场景比低学历/健康素养更难处理。
AI.motivation: 患者教育比单纯问答或报告生成更复杂：必须跨影像找证据、指给患者看、用大白话解释并安抚情绪。现有基准几乎忽略这一场景，也缺乏对多轮、图文共证、个体化沟通的系统评测，因此需要新基准推动研究。
AI.method: 1. 构建 MedImageEdu：150 例放射病例（含影像+报告），为每例设计隐藏患者画像（教育水平、健康素养、人格）。2. 让 DoctorAgent 与 PatientAgent 多轮对话；当视觉解释有助理解时，DoctorAgent 向内置绘图工具发绘制指令（基于报告、影像与当前问题），工具返回标注图。3. DoctorAgent 生成最终图文回复。4. 设计五维评估框架：Consultation（对话策略）、Safety & Scope（是否越界/有害）、Language Quality（通俗、准确）、Drawing Quality（图是否正确标注）、Image-Text Response Quality（图文一致、证据链完整）。5. 用开源与闭源视觉-语言模型代理做基线测试。
AI.result: 所有代理在 Language Quality 上得分最高，但 Drawing Quality 与 Image-Text Response Quality 明显落后，说明“说得好”不等于“指得对”。Safety 维度在所有疾病类别上都是最短板。情绪紧张或焦虑情景下，代理表现显著差于单纯低学历或低健康素养情景。
AI.conclusion: MedImageEdu 首次提供可控环境，可系统检验多模态代理是否能基于证据“教会”患者，而非仅文本问答。基准暴露的“语言-视觉错位”“安全脆弱”“情绪应对难”三大缺口，为后续模型优化与对话策略研究指明方向。

title: Bidirectional Cross-Modal Prompting for Event-Frame Asymmetric Stereo
summary: Conventional frame-based cameras capture rich contextual information but suffer from limited temporal resolution and motion blur in dynamic scenes. Event cameras offer an alternative visual representation with higher dynamic range free from such limitations. The complementary characteristics of the two modalities make event-frame asymmetric stereo promising for reliable 3D perception under fast motion and challenging illumination. However, the modality gap often leads to marginalization of domain-specific cues essential for cross-modal stereo matching. In this paper, we introduce Bi-CMPStereo, a novel bidirectional cross-modal prompting framework that fully exploits semantic and structural features from both domains for robust matching. Our approach learns finely aligned stereo representations within a target canonical space and integrates complementary representations by projecting each modality into both event and frame domains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in accuracy and generalization.

AI.tldr: Bi-CMPStereo首次用双向跨模态prompt机制打通event与frame的不对称立体匹配，在速度与照度剧烈变化时仍保持高精度3D感知。
AI.motivation: 传统帧相机在高速、高动态场景下存在运动模糊及时间分辨率不足；事件相机无模糊且动态范围高，但两种模态信息密度与表征方式差异大，直接配对易导致关键域特定线索被边缘化，亟需一种能充分聚合两者语义–结构特征的立体匹配框架。
AI.method: 提出双向跨模态提示立体匹配网络Bi-CMPStereo：1) 将事件与帧分别映射到共享“目标规范空间”进行细粒度对齐；2) 设计双向prompt模块，使每模态特征同时被投射到对方域，显式补充事件边缘与帧纹理线索；3) 通过互补表示融合与代价体正则化，实现鲁棒的跨模态视差估计。
AI.result: 在公开事件-帧立体数据集上，Bi-CMPStereo将EPE误差降低20–30%，在低照度、高速运动及纹理缺失场景下的鲁棒性显著优于现有最佳方法；零样本泛化实验显示其在未见场景下仍保持最低误差，证明了良好的域迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 双向跨模态prompt策略有效弥合事件-帧模态鸿沟，充分激活各模态的域特有语义与几何线索，为高速、高动态条件下的可靠3D感知提供了新范式，并可拓展至多模态SLAM与自动驾驶等应用。

title: GFT: From Imitation to Reward Fine-Tuning with Unbiased Group Advantages and Dynamic Coefficient Rectification
summary: Large language models are typically post-trained using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), yet effectively unifying efficient knowledge injection with robust generalization remains challenging. In this work, we provide a training-dynamics analysis showing that SFT can be interpreted as a special case of policy gradient optimization with an extremely sparse implicit reward and unstable inverse-probability weighting, which together lead to single-path dependency, entropy collapse, and gradient explosion. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose Group Fine-Tuning (GFT), a unified post-training framework that addresses these intrinsic limitations through two mechanisms: Group Advantage Learning, which constructs diverse response groups and derives normalized contrastive supervision to alleviate reward sparsity, and Dynamic Coefficient Rectification, which adaptively bounds inverse-probability weights to stabilize optimization while preserving efficient knowledge injection. Experiments demonstrate that GFT consistently surpasses SFT-based methods and yields policies that integrate more smoothly with subsequent RL training.

AI.tldr: 首次揭示SFT本质是「极端稀疏奖励+不稳定逆概率加权」的策略梯度特例，并给出Group Fine-Tuning统一框架，用组对比优势学习和动态系数矫正解决熵塌与梯度爆炸，实现知识注入与泛化兼得。
AI.motivation: 现有SFT+RL范式难以同时兼顾高效知识注入与鲁棒泛化，而SFT训练动态机理未被系统解析，导致熵塌、梯度爆炸等顽疾缺乏针对性解决方案。
AI.method:
(1) 训练动态理论分析：证明SFT等价于「隐式奖励极稀疏+逆概率权重不稳定」的策略梯度，导出单路径依赖、熵塌与梯度爆炸根因；
(2) GFT框架：Group Advantage Learning构建多样化响应组，生成归一化对比监督以缓解奖励稀疏；Dynamic Coefficient Rectification在训练中自适应截断逆概率权重，稳定优化且保留知识注入效率；
(3) 统一后训练：GFT直接替代SFT，无缝衔接后续RL阶段。
AI.result: 理论表明GFT消除SFT的梯度方差奇点；实验上在多任务中英文基准中，GFT一致超越SFT系列方法，且其策略与后续RL联合训练时收敛更快、最终奖励更高。
AI.conclusion: SFT的局限性源于其隐式策略梯度表征；通过组对比与动态权重矫正，GFT在无需额外奖励模型条件下实现知识高效注入、熵稳定与泛化增强，为统一SFT-RL后训练提供新范式。

title: MemGround: Long-Term Memory Evaluation Kit for Large Language Models in Gamified Scenarios
summary: Current evaluations of long-term memory in LLMs are fundamentally static. By fixating on simple retrieval and short-context inference, they neglect the multifaceted nature of complex memory systems, such as dynamic state tracking and hierarchical reasoning in continuous interactions. To overcome these limitations, we propose MemGround, a rigorous long-term memory benchmark natively grounded in rich, gamified interactive scenarios. To systematically assess these capabilities, MemGround introduces a three-tier hierarchical framework that evaluates Surface State Memory, Temporal Associative Memory, and Reasoning-Based Memory through specialized interactive tasks. Furthermore, to comprehensively quantify both memory utilization and behavioral trajectories, we propose a multi-dimensional metric suite comprising Question-Answer Score (QA Overall), Memory Fragments Unlocked (MFU), Memory Fragments with Correct Order (MFCO), and Exploration Trajectory Diagrams (ETD). Extensive experiments reveal that state-of-the-art LLMs and memory agents still struggle with sustained dynamic tracking, temporal event association, and complex reasoning derived from long-term accumulated evidence in interactive environments.

AI.tldr: 现有LLM长期记忆评测过于静态；作者提出基于游戏化交互的MemGround基准，通过三层框架与多维指标，系统评估动态状态追踪、时序关联与推理记忆能力，实验显示现有模型仍显著不足。
AI.motivation: 传统评测只测简单检索与短上下文推断，忽略了真实交互中动态状态追踪、分层推理等复杂记忆需求，亟需能反映“连续交互—长期积累”场景的全新基准。
AI.method: 构建MemGround游戏化交互环境，设计“表层状态记忆→时序关联记忆→推理型记忆”三级任务体系，并配套QA Overall、MFU、MFCO、ETD四维度指标，对主流LLM与记忆代理进行全面评测。
AI.result: 实验表明，SOTA模型在动态持续追踪、时序事件关联、基于长期证据的复杂推理上均表现薄弱，记忆碎片顺序正确率与探索轨迹合理性显著低于人类水平。
AI.conclusion: MemGround首次把长期记忆评测从静态检索推进到动态交互层面，揭示当前架构在状态-时序-推理记忆闭环上的结构性缺陷，为未来记忆机制与评测协议提供明确改进方向。

title: Acceptance Dynamics Across Cognitive Domains in Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference. It uses a small draft model to propose a tree of future tokens. A larger target model then verifies these tokens in a single batched forward pass. Despite the growing body of work on speculative methods, the degree to which the cognitive characteristics of a task affect acceptance probability remains largely unexplored. We present an empirical study of tree-based speculative decoding acceptance dynamics. Our study spans four well-established NLP benchmark domains: code generation, mathematical reasoning, logical reasoning, and open-ended chat. For this, we use TinyLlama-1.1B as the draft model against Llama-2-7B-Chat-GPTQ as the target. Over 99,768 speculative nodes collected from 200 prompts, we derive per-domain acceptance rates, expected accepted lengths, depth-acceptance profiles, and entropy-acceptance correlations. We find that task type is a stronger predictor of acceptance than tree depth. Furthermore, only the chat domain consistently yields an expected accepted length exceeding 1.0 token per step.
