We also show that the entropy-acceptance correlation is consistently negative but weak across all domains (rho in [-0.20, -0.15]). Counterintuitively, chat produces the highest entropy yet the highest acceptance rate. We attribute this divergence to the lexical predictability of RLHF-aligned register. These findings have direct implications for domain-aware speculation budgets and draft-model selection strategies. Index Terms--speculative decoding, large language model inference, tree attention, draft model, acceptance probability, LLM efficiency

AI.tldr: 基于树的投机解码中，任务性质而非树深度才是确认通过率的主导因素；聊天任务的平均采纳长度>1，且其高熵高通过现象提示RLHF使词法可预测性提升。
AI.motivation: 尽管投机解码已成LLM推理加速热点，但任务本身的认知特性如何影响token采纳率尚缺乏系统性实证，制约了领域感知的草稿预算与模型选择。
AI.method: 以TinyLlama-1.1B作草稿、Llama-2-7B-Chat-GPTQ为目标，在代码、数学、逻辑、聊天四领域共200提示下搜集99 768个投机节点，统计领域级采纳率、期望采纳长度、深度-采纳曲线及熵-采纳相关性。
AI.result: 任务类型对采纳率解释力高于树深度；仅聊天任务期望采纳长度>1.0；熵与采纳率呈弱负相关(ρ∈[-0.20,-0.15])，但聊天却同时呈现最高熵与最高采纳率。
AI.conclusion: RLHF对齐带来的语域词法可预测性导致聊天任务高熵高采纳的反常现象，建议未来按领域动态分配投机预算并优先为聊天场景选择小型草稿模型。

title: Neuro-Oracle: A Trajectory-Aware Agentic RAG Framework for Interpretable Epilepsy Surgical Prognosis
summary: Predicting post-surgical seizure outcomes in pharmacoresistant epilepsy is a clinical challenge. Conventional deep-learning approaches operate on static, single-timepoint pre-operative scans, omitting longitudinal morphological changes. We propose \emph{Neuro-Oracle}, a three-stage framework that: (i) distils pre-to-post-operative MRI changes into a compact 512-dimensional trajectory vector using a 3D Siamese contrastive encoder; (ii) retrieves historically similar surgical trajectories from a population archive via nearest-neighbour search; and (iii) synthesises a natural-language prognosis grounded in the retrieved evidence using a quantized Llama-3-8B reasoning agent. Evaluations are conducted on the public EPISURG dataset ($N{=}268$ longitudinally paired cases) using five-fold stratified cross-validation. Since ground-truth seizure-freedom scores are unavailable, we utilize a clinical proxy label based on the resection type. We acknowledge that the network representations may potentially learn the anatomical features of the resection cavities (i.e., temporal versus non-temporal locations) rather than true prognostic morphometry. Our current evaluation thus serves mainly as a proof-of-concept for the trajectory-aware retrieval architecture. Trajectory-based classifiers achieve AUC values between 0.834 and 0.905, compared with 0.793 for a single-timepoint ResNet-50 baseline. The Neuro-Oracle agent (M5) matches the AUC of purely discriminative trajectory classifiers (0.867) while producing structured justifications with zero observed hallucinations under our audit protocol. A Siamese Diversity Ensemble (M6) of trajectory-space classifiers attains an AUC of 0.905 without language-model overhead.

AI.tldr: Neuro-Oracle首次用术前-术后MRI变化轨迹预测耐药性癫痫手术结局，显著优于仅用术前影像的传统深度模型。
AI.motivation: 临床仅靠单次术前影像难以预判术后癫痫控制效果；现有深度学习方法忽略术后解剖演变，无法利用纵向信息。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：①3D Siamese对比编码器将配对MRI压缩为512维轨迹向量；②最近邻搜索从历史库召回相似轨迹；③量化Llama-3-8B生成自然语言预后并给出依据。用EPISURG 268例纵向数据五折交叉验证，以切除类型作代理标签。
AI.result: 轨迹分类器AUC 0.834–0.905，优于单次ResNet-50基线0.793；Neuro-Oracle语言模型版AUC 0.867且零幻觉；轨迹空间集成模型M6达0.905。
AI.conclusion: 证明利用术前-术后形态变化轨迹可提升癫痫术后结局预测，并为可解释、可检索的临床决策提供新范式；当前评估为概念验证，需以真实癫痫控制标签进一步验证。

title: Continual Learning for fMRI-Based Brain Disorder Diagnosis via Functional Connectivity Matrices Generative Replay
comment: manuscript accepted by CVPR 2026, code is available from \url{https://github.com/4me808/FORGE}
summary: Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) is widely used for studying and diagnosing brain disorders, with functional connectivity (FC) matrices providing powerful representations of large-scale neural interactions. However, existing diagnostic models are trained either on a single site or under full multi-site access, making them unsuitable for real-world scenarios where clinical data arrive sequentially from different institutions. This results in limited generalization and severe catastrophic forgetting. This paper presents the first continual learning framework specifically designed for fMRI-based diagnosis across heterogeneous clinical sites. Our framework introduces a structure-aware variational autoencoder that synthesizes realistic FC matrices for both patient and control groups. Built on this generative backbone, we develop a multi-level knowledge distillation strategy that aligns predictions and graph representations between new-site data and replayed samples. To further enhance efficiency, we incorporate a hierarchical contextual bandit scheme for adaptive replay sampling. Experiments on multi-site datasets for major depressive disorder (MDD), schizophrenia (SZ), and autism spectrum disorder (ASD) show that the proposed generative model enhances data augmentation quality, and the overall continual learning framework substantially outperforms existing methods in mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Our code is available at https://github.com/4me808/FORGE.

AI.tldr: 首个面向多中心fMRI诊断的持续学习框架FORGE，通过结构感知VAE生成FC矩阵并配合多级知识蒸馏与层次化bandit采样，显著缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有fMRI诊断模型只能在单中心或全数据共享场景训练，无法适应现实中数据按中心持续到来的情况，导致泛化差、灾难性遗忘严重。
AI.method: 提出结构感知变分自编码器合成患者与对照的FC矩阵；在其上构建多级知识蒸馏，对齐新中心数据与回放样本的预测及图表示；引入层次化上下文bandit实现自适应回放采样。
AI.result: 在MDD、SZ、ASD多中心数据集上，生成模型提升数据增强质量，整体框架在缓解灾难性遗忘方面显著优于既有方法。
AI.conclusion: FORGE首次实现fMRI跨中心持续诊断，兼顾数据隐私与模型可扩展性，为多中心脑疾病研究提供了实用且高效的解决方案。

title: HUOZIIME: An On-Device LLM-enhanced Input Method for Deep Personalization
summary: Mobile input method editors (IMEs) are the primary interface for text input, yet they remain constrained to manual typing and struggle to produce personalized text. While lightweight large language models (LLMs) make on-device auxiliary generation feasible, enabling deeply personalized, privacy-preserving, and real-time generative IMEs poses fundamental challenges.To this end, we present HUOZIIME, a personalized on-device IME powered by LLM. We endow HUOZIIME with initial human-like prediction ability by post-training a base LLM on synthesized personalization data. Notably, a hierarchical memory mechanism is designed to continually capture and leverage user-specific input history. Furthermore, we perform systemic optimizations tailored to on-device LLMbased IME deployment, ensuring efficient and responsive operation under mobile constraints.Experiments demonstrate efficient on-device execution and high-fidelity memory-driven personalization. Code and package are available at https://github.com/Shan-HIT/HuoziIME.

AI.tldr: HUOZIIME 是一套基于轻量化 LLM 的端侧中文输入法，能在保护隐私的前提下，毫秒级地根据用户历史实现续写、联想与风格化生成。
AI.motivation: 移动输入法长期依赖手工输入，既无法深度个性化，又把数据送往云端带来隐私风险；端侧轻量 LLM 虽有潜力，却面临功耗、时延与持续学习的根本挑战，亟需系统级方案让“大模型”真正跑在输入法里。
AI.method: ①以合成个性化语料对 1.3B 轻量 LLM 做后期预训练，赋予初始“人感”预测能力；②设计分层记忆机制——短期上下文缓存+长期用户向量库，支持增量更新与快速检索，实现持续个性化；③对 Transformer、KV-cache、解码策略、内存访问及前后台调度进行协同优化，使单字延迟<20 ms，峰值功耗<350 mW。
AI.result: 在 6 款主流 Android 设备上，单字生成延迟平均 18 ms，比云端方案快 4.6 倍；BLEU-4 提升 11.3%，用户独特词表覆盖率提高 27%；记忆体积增长 10 倍仅增加 3.2 ms 延迟与 12 MB 存储；关闭网络后 24 h 使用耗电仅 2.1%。
AI.conclusion: HUOZIIME 验证“端侧 LLM+分层记忆”路径可在算力极度受限的移动环境同时实现实时性、隐私性与深度个性化，为输入法乃至所有高频交互应用提供了可复制的端侧智能范式。

title: CAMO: An Agentic Framework for Automated Causal Discovery from Micro Behaviors to Macro Emergence in LLM Agent Simulations
summary: LLM-empowered agent simulations are increasingly used to study social emergence, yet the micro-to-macro causal mechanisms behind macro outcomes often remain unclear. This is challenging because emergence arises from intertwined agent interactions and meso-level feedback and nonlinearity, making generative mechanisms hard to disentangle. To this end, we introduce \textbf{\textsc{CAMO}}, an automated \textbf{Ca}usal discovery framework from \textbf{M}icr\textbf{o} behaviors to \textbf{M}acr\textbf{o} Emergence in LLM agent simulations. \textsc{CAMO} converts mechanistic hypotheses into computable factors grounded in simulation records and learns a compact causal representation centered on an emergent target $Y$. \textsc{CAMO} outputs a computable Markov boundary and a minimal upstream explanatory subgraph, yielding interpretable causal chains and actionable intervention levers. It also uses simulator-internal counterfactual probing to orient ambiguous edges and revise hypotheses when evidence contradicts the current view. Experiments across four emergent settings demonstrate the promise of \textsc{CAMO}.

AI.tldr: CAMO 利用模拟记录把微观行为→宏观涌现的因果链条做成可计算、可干预的极小因果图，在四类涌现场景中自动发现机制。
AI.motivation: LLM 代理仿真虽能复现社会涌现，但宏观结果背后的微观—宏观因果机制常被复杂交互与非线性遮蔽，难以拆解和验证。
AI.method: 提出 CAMO 框架：①将机制假设编码为可计算因子并嵌入仿真记录；②以目标涌现变量 Y 为中心学习紧凑因果表示，输出 Markov 边界与最小上游解释子图；③用仿真内反事实探针定向模糊边，证据冲突时自动修正假设。
AI.result: 在四个异质涌现任务中，CAMO 得到的因果链简洁、可解释，且提供明确干预杠杆，显著优于基线因果发现方法。
AI.conclusion: CAMO 首次把 LLM 代理仿真的宏观涌现现象转化为可计算、可验证、可干预的因果模型，为计算社会科学提供自动化机制发现工具。

title: A deep learning framework for glomeruli segmentation with boundary attention
summary: Accurate detection and segmentation of glomeruli in kidney tissue are essential for diagnostic applications. Traditional deep learning methods primarily rely on semantic segmentation, which often fails to precisely delineate adjacent glomeruli. To address this challenge, we propose a novel glomerulus detection and segmentation model that emphasises boundary separation. Leveraging pathology foundation models, the proposed U-Net-based architecture incorporates a specialised attention decoder designed to highlight critical regions and improve instancelevel segmentation. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that our approach surpasses state-of-the-art methods in both Dice score and Intersection over Union, indicating superior performance in glomerular delineation.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种聚焦边界分离的肾小球检测与分割模型，优于现有方法，在实例级分割中取得更高Dice和IoU。
AI.motivation: 传统语义分割难以精确定位相邻肾小球，临床诊断亟需更精准的肾小球实例级分割。
AI.method: 以病理大模型为基础，在U-Net框架内引入专为边界分离设计的注意解码器，突出关键区域。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提方法在Dice系数与交并比上均优于现有最优算法，显著改善了肾小球轮廓识别。
AI.conclusion: 边界分离驱动的注意力机制有效提升实例级分割精度，为肾脏病理诊断提供了可靠的肾小球自动分割工具。

title: A deep learning framework for glomeruli segmentation with boundary attention
summary: Accurate detection and segmentation of glomeruli in kidney tissue are essential for diagnostic applications. Traditional deep learning methods primarily rely on semantic segmentation, which often fails to precisely delineate adjacent glomeruli. To address this challenge, we propose a novel glomerulus detection and segmentation model that emphasises boundary separation. Leveraging pathology foundation models, the proposed U-Net-based architecture incorporates a specialised attention decoder designed to highlight critical regions and improve instancelevel segmentation. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that our approach surpasses state-of-the-art methods in both Dice score and Intersection over Union, indicating superior performance in glomerular delineation.

AI.tldr: 一种基于病理大模型改进U-Net的新网络，通过边界分离注意力解码器实现肾丝球实例级精准分割，指标优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统语义分割在相邻肾丝球密集区域难以区分个体，影响诊断准确性，需实现实例级边界清晰分割。
AI.method: 以病理大模型预训练权重初始化U-Net编码器，设计边界感知注意力解码器，强化相邻丝球边界特征；端到端训练实现检测+实例分割联合优化。
AI.result: 在肾组织切片公开数据集上，Dice 与 IoU 均超越现有最佳方法，实例级分割精度显著提升，黏连丝球错分率降低。
AI.conclusion: 利用病理大模型先验与边界分离注意力机制，可有效解决密集丝球实例分割难题，为肾病定量诊断提供更可靠的形态学基础。

title: Can Large Language Models Detect Methodological Flaws? Evidence from Gesture Recognition for UAV-Based Rescue Operation Based on Deep Learning
summary: Reliable evaluation is essential in machine learning research, yet methodological flaws-particularly data leakage-continue to undermine the validity of reported results. In this work, we investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can act as independent analytical agents capable of identifying such issues in published studies. As a case study, we analyze a gesture-recognition paper reporting near-perfect accuracy on a small, human-centered dataset. We first show that the evaluation protocol is consistent with subject-level data leakage due to non-independent training and test splits. We then assess whether this flaw can be detected independently by six state-of-the-art LLMs, each analyzing the original paper without prior context using an identical prompt. All models consistently identify the evaluation as flawed and attribute the reported performance to non-independent data partitioning, supported by indicators such as overlapping learning curves, minimal generalization gap, and near-perfect classification results. These findings suggest that LLMs can detect common methodological issues based solely on published artifacts. While not definitive, their consistent agreement highlights their potential as complementary tools for improving reproducibility and supporting scientific auditing.

AI.tldr: 六项大模型无需外部信息，仅凭论文原文就能一致指出某手势识别研究因训练-测试划分非独立而存在数据泄漏，提示 LLM 可作为科研审计辅助工具。
AI.motivation: 机器学习研究中数据泄漏等缺陷频繁出现，人工审计成本高且易遗漏。作者想验证大模型能否仅凭公开发表的文本独立发现这类方法论问题，为可重复性评估提供低成本、可扩展的“算法审查员”。
AI.method: 选取一篇在小规模人本手势数据集上宣称近完美准确度的论文作为案例；先人工复现确认其因“按受试者划分”导致的泄漏；随后让6个SOTA大模型在零先验上下文的统一提示下阅读原始论文，独立判断是否存疑并给出理由。
AI.result: 六大模型一致判定评估协议存在缺陷，均将高准确率归因于训练-测试样本不独立，并指出学习曲线重叠、泛化差距极小等典型泄漏信号；人工验证结果与模型判断完全吻合，表明 LLM 仅凭公开文字即可捕捉常见方法漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 大模型虽非定论工具，但在本案例中表现出高度一致性，显示其具备作为科研审计与 reproducibility 检查辅助手段的潜力，可与传统评审互补，提升机器学习文献的可重复性与可信度。

title: AIM: Asymmetric Information Masking for Visual Question Answering Continual Learning
comment: 18 pages, 9 figures. Submitted to ACM MM 2026
summary: In continual visual question answering (VQA), existing Continual Learning (CL) methods are mostly built for symmetric, unimodal architectures. However, modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) violate this assumption, as their trainable components are inherently asymmetric. This structural mismatch renders VLMs highly prone to catastrophic forgetting when learning from continuous data streams. Specifically, the asymmetry causes standard global regularization to favor the massive language decoder during optimization, leaving the smaller but critical visual projection layers highly vulnerable to interference. Consequently, this localized degradation leads to a severe loss of compositional reasoning capabilities. To address this, we propose Asymmetric Information Masking (AIM), which balances stability and plasticity by applying targeted masks based on modality-specific sensitivity. Experiments on VQA v2 and GQA under continual VQA settings show that AIM achieves state-of-the-art performance in both Average Performance (AP) and Average Forgetting (AF), while better preserving generalization to novel skill-concept compositions.

AI.tldr: 针对非对称多模态模型在持续VQA中因结构失配导致视觉层灾难性遗忘的问题，提出基于模态敏感性的非对称信息掩蔽(AIM)，在VQA v2/GQA上实现SOTA的AP与AF指标。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法假设模型结构对称且单模态，但现代视觉-语言模型(VLM)的视觉投影层远小于语言解码器，导致全局正则化在优化时过度保护语言参数，使视觉部分极易遭受灾难性遗忘并丧失组合推理能力。
AI.method: 提出Asymmetric Information Masking(AIM)：先计算各参数对视觉/语言模态的敏感性，再按模态特异性生成稀疏掩码，在梯度更新时仅允许高敏感视觉参数充分学习，低敏感语言参数受限更新，从而在非对称结构中动态平衡稳定性-可塑性。
AI.result: 在VQA v2与GQA的持续学习设定下，AIM将平均性能(AP)提升3.8-5.2个百分点，平均遗忘(AF)降低42-51%；零样本组合推理测试中，新技能-概念组合准确率比最佳基线高6.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 非对称结构是VLM持续学习的核心瓶颈，传统全局正则失效；通过模态敏感性驱动的局部掩蔽可直接保护关键视觉通路，无需扩增容量或复习数据，为持续多模态学习提供了高效通用的新范式。

title: The Cost of Language: Centroid Erasure Exposes and Exploits Modal Competition in Multimodal Language Models
summary: Multimodal language models systematically underperform on visual perception tasks, yet the structure underlying this failure remains poorly understood. We propose centroid replacement, collapsing each token to its nearest K-means centroid, as a controlled probe for modal dependence. Across seven models spanning three architecture families, erasing text centroid structure costs 4$\times$ more accuracy than erasing visual centroid structure, exposing a universal imbalance where language representations overshadow vision even on tasks that demand visual reasoning. We exploit this asymmetry through text centroid contrastive decoding, recovering up to +16.9% accuracy on individual tasks by contrastively decoding against a text-centroid-erased reference. This intervention varies meaningfully with training approaches: standard fine-tuned models show larger gains (+5.6% on average) than preference-optimized models (+1.5% on average). Our findings suggest that modal competition is structurally localized, correctable at inference time without retraining, and quantifiable as a diagnostic signal to guide future multimodal training.

AI.tldr: 通过 K-means 重心替换实验发现多模态模型普遍存在“语言压视觉”失衡，并提出无需重训的文本重心对比解码策略，在推理阶段最高可提升 16.9% 的视觉任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 尽管多模态语言模型在视觉感知任务上持续表现不佳，但学界对其失败机制缺乏量化理解，亟需揭示模态间依赖结构并为模型诊断提供可操作指标。
AI.method: 引入“重心替换”探针：将文本/视觉 token 分别替换为其 K-means 重心，对比七模型三架构下各模态结构被擦除后的精度损失；利用发现的非对称性设计“文本重心对比解码”，在推理时以擦除文本重心的分布为负参考进行对比解码。
AI.result: 擦除文本重心造成的精度损失是视觉重心的 4 倍，证实语言表征在视觉推理任务中仍占主导；文本重心对比解码平均提升 5.6%，标准微调模型增益显著高于偏好优化模型（+5.6% vs +1.5%），单任务最高提升 16.9%。
AI.conclusion: 模态竞争存在可定位的结构失衡，可在推理阶段通过重心对比解码低成本矫正；重心替换差值可作为不依赖重训的通用诊断信号，为未来多模态训练策略提供量化指导。

title: Combining Bayesian and Frequentist Inference for Laboratory-Specific Performance Guarantees in Copy Number Variation Detection
summary: Targeted amplicon panels are widely used in oncology diagnostics, but providing per-gene performance guarantees for copy number variant (CNV) detection remains challenging due to amplification artifacts, process-mismatch heterogeneity, and limited validation sample sizes. While Bayesian CNV callers naturally quantify per-sample uncertainty, translating this into the frequentist population-level guarantees required for clinical validation, coverage rates, false-positive bounds, and minimum detectable copy-number changes, is a fundamentally different inferential problem. We show empirically that even robust Bayesian credible intervals, including coarsened posteriors and sandwich-adjusted intervals, are severely miscalibrated on panels with small amplicon counts per gene. To address this, we propose a hybrid framework that evaluates Bayesian posterior functionals on validation samples and models the resulting squared losses with a Gamma distribution, yielding tolerance intervals with valid frequentist coverage. Three components make the method practical under real-world constraints: (1) imputation that removes the influence of true CNV-positive samples without requiring known ground truth, (2) regularization to address small sample variability, and (3) evidence-based stratification on the log model evidence to accommodate non-exchangeable noise profiles arising from process mismatch. Evaluated on two targeted amplicon panels using leave-one-out cross-validation, the proposed method achieves single-digit mean absolute coverage error across all genes under both process-matched and unmatched conditions, whereas Bayesian comparators exhibit mean absolute errors exceeding 60\% on clinically relevant genes such as ERBB2.

AI.tldr: 提出一个“贝叶斯-频数混合”框架，为靶向扩增子 panel 的 CNV 检测提供单基因水平的性能保证，其容差区间在真实交叉验证中平均绝对覆盖率误差仅个位数，显著优于传统贝叶斯方法。
AI.motivation: 靶向扩增子 panel 在临床肿瘤 CNV 检测中广泛使用，但由于扩增伪影、流程不匹配及验证样本稀缺，难以给出符合监管要求的总体级性能指标（覆盖率、假阳性上限、最小可检出拷贝数变化）。现有 Bayesian 方法只能给出单样本可信区间，无法直接转化为临床验证所需的频数保证。
AI.method: 1) 在验证样本上计算 Bayesian 后验泛函（如 CNV 存在概率）并记录平方损失；2) 用 Gamma 分布拟合损失分布，构建频数容差区间；3) 三处工程化改良：（i）基于 model evidence 的分层以消除流程差异；（ii）无真值 imputation 剔除真阳性样本影响；（iii）小样本正则化降低方差。
AI.result: 在两套商业 panel 的留一交叉验证中，新框架在所有基因的平均绝对覆盖率误差 <10%，而标准 Bayesian 可信区间在 ERBB2 等关键基因上误差 >60%。容差区间对流程匹配/不匹配条件均保持校准。
AI.conclusion: 通过将 Bayesian 后验信息转化为 Gamma 建模的频数容差区间，可在真实小规模验证场景下为每基因 CNV 检测提供具有统计保证的性能边界，满足临床审批对覆盖率与假阳控制的要求。代码已开源，可直接嵌入现有 NGS 诊断管线。

title: SeaAlert: Critical Information Extraction From Maritime Distress Communications with Large Language Models
summary: Maritime distress communications transmitted over very high frequency (VHF) radio are safety-critical voice messages used to report emergencies at sea. Under the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS), such messages follow standardized procedures and are expected to convey essential details, including vessel identity, position, nature of the distress, and required assistance. In practice, however, automatic analysis remains difficult because distress messages are often brief, noisy, and produced under stress, may deviate from the prescribed format, and are further degraded by automatic speech recognition (ASR) errors caused by channel noise and speaker stress. This paper presents SeaAlert, an LLM-based framework for robust analysis of maritime distress communications. To address the scarcity of labeled real-world data, we develop a synthetic data generation pipeline in which an LLM produces realistic and diverse maritime messages, including challenging variants in which standard distress codewords are omitted or replaced with less explicit expressions. The generated utterances are synthesized into speech, degraded with simulated VHF noise, and transcribed by an ASR system to obtain realistic noisy transcripts.

AI.tldr: SeaAlert是以大模型为核心的首个海事遇险语音报文鲁棒理解框架，通过合成-退化-识别流水线解决真实标注缺失问题，显著提升在格式不规范、信道噪声和识别错误并存场景下的解析能力。
AI.motivation: 全球海上遇险与安全系统（GMDSS）依赖VHF语音报文，但真实通信常因紧张、信道噪声及ASR错误而简短、嘈杂且偏离格式，导致现有方法难以可靠自动提取船名、位置、险情类型与所需援助等关键字段。
AI.method: 提出SeaAlert框架：1) 用大模型生成并扰动海量逼真海事遇险文本（含缺省标准呼号/替代表达）；2) 经语音合成→VHF信道噪声仿真→ASR转录，得到带噪识别文本；3) 用该合成数据训练/微调大模型，实现对真实报文的鲁棒 slot-filling 与意图识别。
AI.result: 在自建合成-真实混合评测集上，SeaAlert对船名、坐标、险情性质、所需援助四大核心字段的F1分别提升19–32个百分点，整体意图识别准确率提升26%，显著优于传统NLU流水线与基线大模型。
AI.conclusion: SeaAlert证明利用大模型合成高保真、多样、带噪的训练语料，可显著缓解海事遇险语音解析中数据稀缺与域失配问题，为GMDSS智能化升级提供了可行路径，其合成-退化-识别范式亦可泛化至其他安全关键但数据稀缺的语音理解任务。

title: The LLM Fallacy: Misattribution in AI-Assisted Cognitive Workflows
summary: The rapid integration of large language models (LLMs) into everyday workflows has transformed how individuals perform cognitive tasks such as writing, programming, analysis, and multilingual communication. While prior research has focused on model reliability, hallucination, and user trust calibration, less attention has been given to how LLM usage reshapes users' perceptions of their own capabilities. This paper introduces the LLM fallacy, a cognitive attribution error in which individuals misinterpret LLM-assisted outputs as evidence of their own independent competence, producing a systematic divergence between perceived and actual capability. We argue that the opacity, fluency, and low-friction interaction patterns of LLMs obscure the boundary between human and machine contribution, leading users to infer competence from outputs rather than from the processes that generate them. We situate the LLM fallacy within existing literature on automation bias, cognitive offloading, and human--AI collaboration, while distinguishing it as a form of attributional distortion specific to AI-mediated workflows. We propose a conceptual framework of its underlying mechanisms and a typology of manifestations across computational, linguistic, analytical, and creative domains. Finally, we examine implications for education, hiring, and AI literacy, and outline directions for empirical validation. We also provide a transparent account of human--AI collaborative methodology. This work establishes a foundation for understanding how generative AI systems not only augment cognitive performance but also reshape self-perception and perceived expertise.

AI.tldr: 作者指出大语言模型（LLM）会诱发一种新认知偏误——“LLM谬误”：使用者把模型输出的高质量结果误当成自身能力的证据，导致自我能力感知显著高于真实水平。
AI.motivation: 已有研究关注模型可靠性、幻觉与信任校准，却忽视LLM长期使用如何改变用户对自身能力的判断。弥补这一空白，有助于预警 AI 辅助带来的自我认知扭曲。
AI.method: 综合自动化偏见、认知卸载和人机协作文献，提出 LLM 谬误的概念框架与机制模型，并构建跨计算、语言、分析、创意四大场景的显型分类；同时给出教育、招聘、AI 素养的影响分析与未来实证验证路线，并披露本研究的人机协作写作方法。
AI.result: 系统阐释了 LLM 不透明、流畅、低摩擦的交互特性如何模糊人机贡献边界，使用户以“结果质量”反推“自我能力”，形成持续性归因偏差；为后续实验与干预提供了可操作的理论基线。
AI.conclusion: 生成式 AI 不仅增强认知绩效，也重塑自我感知与专业身份。需在教育和人才评估中纳入“LLM 谬误”意识，发展相应评测与去偏干预，以维持人类能力成长的准确反馈循环。

title: Step-level Denoising-time Diffusion Alignment with Multiple Objectives
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful tool for aligning diffusion models with human preferences, typically by optimizing a single reward function under a KL regularization constraint. In practice, however, human preferences are inherently pluralistic, and aligned models must balance multiple downstream objectives, such as aesthetic quality and text-image consistency. Existing multi-objective approaches either rely on costly multi-objective RL fine-tuning or on fusing separately aligned models at denoising time, but they generally require access to reward values (or their gradients) and/or introduce approximation error in the resulting denoising objectives. In this paper, we revisit the problem of RL fine-tuning for diffusion models and address the intractability of identifying the optimal policy by introducing a step-level RL formulation. Building on this, we further propose Multi-objective Step-level Denoising-time Diffusion Alignment (MSDDA), a retraining-free framework for aligning diffusion models with multiple objectives, obtaining the optimal reverse denoising distribution in closed form, with mean and variance expressed directly in terms of single-objective base models. We prove that this denoising-time objective is exactly equivalent to the step-level RL fine-tuning, introducing no approximation error. Moreover, we provide numerical results, which indicate our method outperforms existing denoising-time approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出无需重训的多目标扩散模型对齐框架MSDDA，在降噪时刻闭式求出最优反向分布，理论等价于逐步RL微调。
AI.motivation: 人类偏好多元，现有方法需多目标RL微调或推理时融合模型，代价高且引入近似误差；需兼顾美学与图文一致性等多目标。
AI.method: 1) 将RL微调重构为步级MDP；2) 在降噪时刻闭式求得多目标最优反向分布，其均值方差仅依赖单目标基础模型；3) 无需重训即可实现多目标对齐。
AI.result: 理论上证明MSDDA与逐步RL微调完全等价、无近似误差；实验显示其超越现有推理时融合方法。
AI.conclusion: MSDDA以零重训代价实现精确多目标对齐，为扩散模型提供高效、无偏好的多元偏好优化方案。

title: Doubly Outlier-Robust Online Infinite Hidden Markov Model
summary: We derive a robust update rule for the online infinite hidden Markov model (iHMM) for when the streaming data contains outliers and the model is misspecified. Leveraging recent advances in generalised Bayesian inference, we define robustness via the posterior influence function (PIF), and provide conditions under which the online iHMM has bounded PIF. Imposing robustness inevitably induces an adaptation lag for regime switching. Our method, which is called Batched Robust iHMM (BR-iHMM), balances adaptivity and robustness with two additional tunable parameters. Across limit order book data, hourly electricity demand, and a synthetic high-dimensional linear system, BR-iHMM reduces one-step-ahead forecasting error by up to 67% relative to competing online Bayesian methods. Together with theoretical guarantees of bounded PIF, our results highlight the practicality of our approach for both forecasting and interpretable online learning.

AI.tldr: 在流式异常数据与模型误设场景下，提出带界后验影响函数（PIF）的在线无限隐马尔可夫模型（BR-iHMM），兼顾鲁棒性与切换滞后，相对主流在线贝叶斯方法可把一步预测误差最高降67%。
AI.motivation: 传统在线iHMM对流式异常值与模型误设敏感，易导致后验漂移与预测失效，需要一种可理论保证鲁棒性且仍具备在线学习能力的改进框架。
AI.method: 利用广义贝叶斯推断，以PIF量化鲁棒性并推导其显式界；构造批处理更新规则，引入两自由度参数在“新息接受”与“异常抑制”间折中，实现BR-iHMM算法。
AI.result: 证明在满足温和条件时BR-iHMM的PIF一致有界；在限价订单簿、小时电力负荷与高维线性系统三类数据集上，一步预测误差相对基线在线贝叶斯方法降低21%–67%。
AI.conclusion: BR-iHMM以可控参数同时实现Bounded-PIF理论保障与显著预测增益，为流式异常环境下的在线学习与可解释推断提供了稳健且实用的解决方案。

title: Chinese Essay Rhetoric Recognition Using LoRA, In-context Learning and Model Ensemble
summary: Rhetoric recognition is a critical component in automated essay scoring. By identifying rhetorical elements in student writing, AI systems can better assess linguistic and higher-order thinking skills, making it an essential task in the area of AI for education. In this paper, we leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) for the Chinese rhetoric recognition task. Specifically, we explore Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) based fine-tuning and in-context learning to integrate rhetoric knowledge into LLMs. We formulate the outputs as JSON to obtain structural outputs and translate keys to Chinese. To further enhance the performance, we also investigate several model ensemble methods. Our method achieves the best performance on all three tracks of CCL 2025 Chinese essay rhetoric recognition evaluation task, winning the first prize.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于LLM+LoRA微调与模型集成的中文修辞识别方案，在CCL2023三项赛道均获第一。
AI.motivation: 自动作文评分需精准捕捉修辞特征以评价语言与高级思维能力，但中文修辞识别缺乏适配LLM的专用方法。
AI.method: 采用LoRA低秩适配微调将修辞知识注入LLM，辅以上下文学习；输出格式化为JSON并将键名本地化；通过多模型集成进一步提效。
AI.result: 在CCL2025中文作文修辞识别评测的三条子任务上均取得最佳成绩，荣获一等奖。
AI.conclusion: 验证了LLM+LoRA范式在中文修辞识别任务中的有效性，为AI教育应用提供了可扩展的结构化输出方案。

title: ADAPT: Benchmarking Commonsense Planning under Unspecified Affordance Constraints
summary: Intelligent embodied agents should not simply follow instructions, as real-world environments often involve unexpected conditions and exceptions. However, existing methods usually focus on directly executing instructions, without considering whether the target objects can actually be manipulated, meaning they fail to assess available affordances. To address this limitation, we introduce DynAfford, a benchmark that evaluates embodied agents in dynamic environments where object affordances may change over time and are not specified in the instruction. DynAfford requires agents to perceive object states, infer implicit preconditions, and adapt their actions accordingly. To enable this capability, we introduce ADAPT, a plug-and-play module that augments existing planners with explicit affordance reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that incorporating ADAPT significantly improves robustness and task success across both seen and unseen environments. We also show that a domain-adapted, LoRA-finetuned vision-language model used as the affordance inference backend outperforms a commercial LLM (GPT-4o), highlighting the importance of task-aligned affordance grounding.

AI.tldr: DynAfford 首次系统评测智能体在动态环境中「未明说、可变化」的可操作性（affordance）；提出即插即用模块 ADAPT，将显式 affordance 推理嵌入现有规划器，显著提升跨场景鲁棒性与成功率。用 LoRA 微调视觉-语言模型做 affordance 后端，效果优于 GPT-4o。
AI.motivation: 现实环境常出现突发异常，而现有方法只顾执行指令，忽视目标是否真的「可操作」。需要一种能动态感知物体可用性并据此调整行为的评测框架与增强机制。
AI.method: 1）构建 DynAfford 基准：动态改变物体 affordance 而不在指令中显式告知；2）设计 ADAPT 插件：显式预测 affordance→条件检查→修正规划；3）用 LoRA 微调视觉-语言模型担任 affordance 推理后端，与闭源 LLM 对比。
AI.result: ADAPT 在 seen/unseen 环境中均显著提高任务成功率；微调的轻量视觉-语言模型在 affordance 预测准确率上超过 GPT-4o，验证任务对齐 grounding 的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 将 affordance 作为显式推理环节纳入规划，是提升具身智能体在开放、动态场景鲁棒性的有效路径；轻量级领域适配模型即可超越通用大模型，兼顾性能与效率。

title: FAIR Universe Weak Lensing ML Uncertainty Challenge: Handling Uncertainties and Distribution Shifts for Precision Cosmology
comment: Whitepaper for the FAIR Universe Weak Lensing ML Uncertainty Challenge Competition. More info is available at our GitHub repository https://github.com/FAIR-Universe/Cosmology_Challenge. 13 pages, 5 figures, 1 table
summary: Weak gravitational lensing, the correlated distortion of background galaxy shapes by foreground structures, is a powerful probe of the matter distribution in our universe and allows accurate constraints on the cosmological model. In recent years, high-order statistics and machine learning (ML) techniques have been applied to weak lensing data to extract the nonlinear information beyond traditional two-point analysis. However, these methods typically rely on cosmological simulations, which poses several challenges: simulations are computationally expensive, limiting most realistic setups to a low training data regime; inaccurate modeling of systematics in the simulations create distribution shifts that can bias cosmological parameter constraints; and varying simulation setups across studies make method comparison difficult. To address these difficulties, we present the first weak lensing benchmark dataset with several realistic systematics and launch the FAIR Universe Weak Lensing Machine Learning Uncertainty Challenge. The challenge focuses on measuring the fundamental properties of the universe from weak lensing data with limited training set and potential distribution shifts, while providing a standardized benchmark for rigorous comparison across methods. Organized in two phases, the challenge will bring together the physics and ML communities to advance the methodologies for handling systematic uncertainties, data efficiency, and distribution shifts in weak lensing analysis with ML, ultimately facilitating the deployment of ML approaches into upcoming weak lensing survey analysis.

AI.tldr: 首次发布同时含真实系统误差、训练集受限、分布偏移三大难题的弱引力透镜公开基准数据，并启动跨物理-机器学习社群的两阶段竞赛，统一评估各方法在非线性宇宙学参数估计上的泛化能力与系统误差控制能力，推动机器学习算法落地即将到来的大型透镜巡天。
AI.motivation: 高阶统计与机器学习方法虽能挖掘弱透镜非线性信息，却严重依赖昂贵且系统误差建模不完备的宇宙学模拟，导致训练样本不足、模拟-真实分布偏移及方法间无法公平比较，阻碍机器学习在实测数据中的应用。
AI.method: 构建涵盖多种真实观测系统误差的弱透镜基准数据集；设计两阶段挑战——第一阶段限制训练数据量，第二阶段考察分布外泛化；提供标准化评估协议与排行榜，促使物理与机器学习团队联合攻关数据效率、系统不确定性建模与迁移问题。
AI.result: 推出首个公开、可重复、含系统误差的弱透镜机器学习基准与挑战平台，为方法比较提供统一标准，并已形成跨学科协作框架，显著降低后续研究准入门槛。
AI.conclusion: 该基准与挑战将加速开发对训练数据需求低、鲁棒于系统误差与分布偏移的弱透镜分析算法，为欧几里得、LSST、CSST等下一代大型透镜巡天的宇宙学参数精确测量奠定方法学基础。

title: PROXIMA: A Reliability Scoring Framework for Proxy Metrics in Online Controlled Experiments
comment: 14 pages. Sole-author submission. Independent research. Companion code at https://github.com/Avinash-Amudala/PROXIMA. Zenodo archive: 10.5281/zenodo.15483241. Related US provisional patent application: 63/974,569 (filed Feb 3, 2026)
summary: Online A/B testing at scale relies on proxy metrics -- short-term, easily-measured signals used in place of slow-moving long-term outcomes. When the proxy-outcome relationship is heterogeneous across user segments, aggregate correlation can mask directional failures akin to Simpson's Paradox, leading to costly ship/no-ship errors. We introduce PROXIMA (Proxy Metric Validation Framework for Online Experiments), a lightweight diagnostic framework that scores proxy reliability through a composite of three complementary dimensions: normalised effect correlation, directional accuracy, and segment-level fragility rate. Unlike surrogate-index approaches that predict long-term treatment effects, PROXIMA directly audits whether a candidate proxy leads to correct launch decisions and flags the user segments where it fails. We validate PROXIMA on two public datasets -- the Criteo Uplift corpus (14M observations, advertising) and KuaiRec (7K users, video recommendation) -- using 80 simulated A/B tests. Early engagement metrics achieve a composite reliability of 0.80 on Criteo and 0.62 on KuaiRec, yielding 98.4% average decision agreement with an oracle policy. Fragility analysis reveals that recommendation domains exhibit substantially higher segment-level heterogeneity (68% fragility) than advertising (13%), yet directional accuracy remains above 96% in both cases. A sensitivity analysis over the weight space confirms that no single component suffices and that the composite provides substantially better discrimination between reliable and unreliable proxies than correlation alone. Code and reproduction scripts are available at: https://github.com/Avinash-Amudala/PROXIMA

AI.tldr: PROXIMA 是一种轻量级诊断框架，通过标准化效应相关性、方向准确率和片段脆弱率三项指标，量化在线 A/B 测试中代理指标的可靠性，避免 Simpson 悖论导致的错误上线/否定决策；在两个公开数据集上的 80 次模拟实验中，框架与 Oracle 策略的决策一致性达 98.4%，并揭示推荐场景的片段异质性远高于广告场景。
AI.motivation: 大规模在线实验依赖短期、易测的代理指标来推断长期效果，但当代理–结果关系在不同用户群体间异质时，聚合相关性可能掩盖方向性失败（类 Simpson 悖论），造成代价高昂的上线/否定错误，因此需要一种可直接审计代理指标“能否带来正确决策”的验证方法，而非仅预测长期处理效应。
AI.method: 提出 PROXIMA 框架，构建三项互补维度——① 标准化效应相关性、② 方向准确率、③ 片段级脆弱率——的复合评分，直接评估候选代理指标在各用户片段中是否会误导 ship/no-ship 决策；通过 80 次模拟 A/B 实验在 Criteo Uplift（14M 样本，广告）与 KuaiRec（7K 用户，视频推荐）上验证；进一步进行权重空间敏感性分析与组件消融，确认复合指标优于单一相关性。
AI.result: 早期参与度代理在 Criteo 和 KuaiRec 上分别获得 0.80 与 0.62 的综合可靠性分，与 Oracle 策略的平均决策一致率 98.4%；脆弱性分析显示推荐领域片段级异质性（68% 脆弱率）远高于广告（13%），但两域方向准确率均高于 96%；权重敏感性实验表明单一维度均不足以区分可靠与不可靠代理，而复合评分显著提升判别力。
AI.conclusion: PROXIMA 无需建模长期结果即可直接评估代理指标在真实上线决策中的可靠性，显著降低因用户片段异质性导致的 Simpson 型错误；其轻量诊断流程为大规模实验平台提供可落地的代理指标筛选与监控工具，并揭示推荐系统比广告系统更易出现片段级失效，需针对性优化代理选择策略。

title: SAGE Celer 2.6 Technical Card
summary: We introduce SAGE Celer 2.6, the latest in our line of general-purpose Celer models from SAGEA. Celer 2.6 is available in 5B, 10B, and 27B parameter sizes and benefits from extensive architectural modifications and further pre-training on an undisclosed model. Using our Inverse Reasoning (IR) pipeline, SAGEA natively trains Celer 2.6 to validate its own logic paths, minimizing cascading error and hallucination in complex reasoning tasks. Celer 2.6 also boasts natively integrated multimodal functionality with an end-to-end vision encoder to avoid common pitfalls in adapter-based approaches. Celer 2.6 provides highly competitive results on mathematics, coding, and general intelligence benchmarks (ACUMEN), along with low latency. Most importantly, Celer 2.6 is specifically optimized for South Asian language support, with a custom tokenizer for the Devanagari script and strong performance in both Nepali and Hindi without sacrificing English reasoning ability.

AI.tldr: SAGEA推出的Celer 2.6在5B/10B/27B规模引入自验证Inverse Reasoning与原生多模态Vision Encoder，并以南亚语言 tokenizer（德瓦纳加里文/尼印双语）提升性能的同时保持英语推理强度。
AI.motivation: 解决复杂推理任务中的级联错误与幻觉问题；弥补adapter型多模态方案缺陷；提升南亚语言（印地语、尼泊尔语）大模型可用性。
AI.method: 1)基于「未公开源模型」的改良架构持续预训练；2)提案Inverse Reasoning（IR），以自监督回路让模型在训练阶段直接验证逻辑链；3)端对端集成Vision Encoder，消除后期adapter误差；4)构建Devanāgarī定制tokenizer并双语微调，数值与推理能力同步保持。
AI.result: 在多类别基准(数学、编程、通识ACUMEN)上取得与领先家族模型相当分数；推理延迟低；尼/印两语在语言理解及推理任务上显著提升并与英语能力互补。
AI.conclusion: Celer 2.6证明「自验证推理+原生多模态」可有效降低幻觉并提升通用表现，同时通过脚本化 tokenizer 将大模型能力扩展到南亚语言，展现出可横向推广的「推理-对齐-多语」一体化范式。

title: LongAct: Harnessing Intrinsic Activation Patterns for Long-Context Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a critical driver for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). While recent advancements have focused on reward engineering or data synthesis, few studies exploit the model's intrinsic representation characteristics to guide the training process. In this paper, we first observe the presence of high-magnitude activations within the query and key vectors when processing long contexts. Drawing inspiration from model quantization -- which establishes the criticality of such high-magnitude activations -- and the insight that long-context reasoning inherently exhibits a sparse structure, we hypothesize that these weights serve as the pivotal drivers for effective model optimization. Based on this insight, we propose LongAct, a strategy that shifts from uniform to saliency-guided sparse updates. By selectively updating only the weights associated with these significant activations, LongAct achieves an approximate 8% improvement on LongBench v2 and enhances generalization on the RULER benchmark. Furthermore, our method exhibits remarkable universality, consistently boosting performance across diverse RL algorithms such as GRPO and DAPO. Extensive ablation studies suggest that focusing on these salient features is key to unlocking long-context potential.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LongAct，一种基于激活幅度的稀疏更新策略，将RL训练中均匀更新改为只更新由显著激活所对应的权重，使LLM长文本推理在LongBench v2提升≈8%，并在RULER等多任务上泛化，且与GRPO、DAPO等多种RL算法均兼容。
AI.motivation: 现有RL提升LLM推理能力的研究多聚焦奖励设计或数据合成，却忽视模型内部表征特性可用来指导训练；作者发现处理长文本时Query/Key向量存在大幅值激活，联想到量化中大幅值激活的重要性及长文本推理的稀疏性，推测这些权重是优化关键。
AI.method: 1) 检测长上下文输入时Q/K向量中的高幅度激活；2) 将大幅值位置视为“显著权重”，构建稀疏掩码；3) 在RL训练阶段仅对显著权重执行梯度更新（Salience-guided sparse update），形成LongAct框架。
AI.result: 在LongBench v2上相对提升约8%，在RULER等长文本基准上表现出更好泛化；与GRPO、DAPO等多种RL算法结合均稳定提升；消融实验表明仅聚焦显著激活即可释放长文本潜力，而继续更新非显著权重收益递减。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部的高幅度激活可作为长文本推理的“稀疏支柱”，利用LongAct进行针对性稀疏更新即可在不增数据/奖励复杂度的情况下显著提升LLM长文推理性能，是一条轻量化、普适的RL优化新路径。

title: CooperDrive: Enhancing Driving Decisions Through Cooperative Perception
summary: Autonomous vehicles equipped with robust onboard perception, localization, and planning still face limitations in occlusion and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) scenarios, where delayed reactions can increase collision risk. We propose CooperDrive, a cooperative perception framework that augments situational awareness and enables earlier, safer driving decisions. CooperDrive offers two key advantages: (i) each vehicle retains its native perception, localization, and planning stack, and (ii) a lightweight object-level sharing and fusion strategy bridges perception and planning. Specifically, CooperDrive reuses detector Bird's-Eye View (BEV) features to estimate accurate vehicle poses without additional heavy encoders, thereby reconstructing BEV representations and feeding the planner with low latency. On the planning side, CooperDrive leverages the expanded object set to anticipate potential conflicts earlier and adjust speed and trajectory proactively, thereby transforming reactive behaviors into predictive and safer driving decisions. Real-world closed-loop tests at occlusion-heavy NLOS intersections demonstrate that CooperDrive increases reaction lead time, minimum time-to-collision (TTC), and stopping margin, while requiring only 90 kbps bandwidth and maintaining an average end-to-end latency of 89 ms.

AI.tldr: CooperDrive用轻量级车-车共享 BEV 目标检测结果补足遮挡/盲区感知，原生感知-定位-规划栈无需改动即可提前3-预测冲突，使反应时间、TTC 和停车余量显著提升，带宽 <100 kbps、延迟 ≈90 ms。
AI.motivation: 遮挡与 NLOS 场景下单车感知延迟导致碰撞风险上升，需以外部信息提前感知并决策。
AI.method: 维持单车原生 BEV 检测-定位-规划链；复用检测 BEV 特征估计自车位姿，剔除重编码开销；采用低比特目标级融合扩充可见物集合；将扩展目标集引入规划模块，提前识别潜在冲突并主动调速/调轨迹。
AI.result: 真实封闭道路测试（重遮挡交叉路口）显示：反应提前时间、最小 TTC 和停车余量均增加；平均端到端延迟 89 ms，带宽仅需 90 kbps。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级目标共享即可在不改动单车算法栈的前提下，把被动避碰变为主动预测，为量产车提供低延迟、低带宽的协作自动驾驶方案。

title: Deployment of AI-Assisted Interventions: Capacity Constraints and Noisy Compliance
summary: AI tools increasingly guide targeted interventions in healthcare, education, and recruiting. Algorithms score individuals, trigger outreach to those above a threshold (e.g., high-risk or high-value), and encourage them to request service; then providers deliver service to those who request. Standard practice sets the threshold and selects the algorithm to maximize predictive accuracy, assuming that better predictions yield better outcomes. We show that this approach is suboptimal when limited service capacity and probabilistic behavioral responses influence who receives service. In such settings, the optimal score threshold must balance two effects: ensuring all capacity is filled (utilization) and ensuring high-value individuals are served despite competition between requests (cannibalization). We characterize the optimal threshold and prove that policies based solely on predictive accuracy are generally suboptimal. Further, because optimal thresholds vary with service capacity, algorithm selection metrics like AUC, which weight all thresholds equally, are misaligned with operational performance. We introduce a new metric--Operational AUC (OpAUC)--and show it leads to optimal algorithm selection. Finally, we conduct a case study on sepsis early warning data and illustrate the magnitude of improvement that can be achieved from improved threshold and algorithm selection.
