title: Stateful Evidence-Driven Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Iterative Reasoning
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds Large Language Models (LLMs) in external knowledge but often suffers from flat context representations and stateless retrieval, leading to unstable performance. We propose Stateful Evidence-Driven RAG with Iterative Reasoning, a framework that models question answering as a progressive evidence accumulation process. Retrieved documents are converted into structured reasoning units with explicit relevance and confidence signals and maintained in a persistent evidence pool capturing both supportive and non-supportive information. The framework performs evidence-driven deficiency analysis to identify gaps and conflicts and iteratively refines queries to guide subsequent retrieval. This iterative reasoning process enables stable evidence aggregation and improves robustness to noisy retrieval. Experiments on multiple question answering benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over standard RAG and multi-step baselines, while effectively accumulating high-quality evidence and maintaining stable performance under substantial retrieval noise.

AI.tldr: 现有 RAG 因“无状态”平铺检索而性能波动，作者提出把问答建模为渐进式证据累积：结构化解文档、维护持久证据池、证据驱动地诊断缺口-冲突并再生查询。多基准测试在强噪声下亦优于标准与多步 RAG。
AI.motivation: 大模型仅靠单次扁平检索难以稳定利用外部知识，尤其在检索噪声大或需多跳推理时表现不可靠
AI.method: Stateful Evidence-Driven RAG：将文档转为带置信度的结构化推理单元→存入持续更新的证据池→依据已有证据检测缺口与冲突→迭代生成新查询再检索，实现有状态的证据累积与推理
AI.result: 在多个问答数据集上，相比标准 RAG 及现有多步方法取得一致提升，并在高噪声检索条件下保持高质量证据累积与稳定性能
AI.conclusion: 有状态的证据驱动迭代检索可显著提升 RAG 对噪声的鲁棒性与答案可靠性，为多跳问答提供了一种渐进式、可解释的知识增强范式

title: RaTA-Tool: Retrieval-based Tool Selection with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Tool learning with foundation models aims to endow AI systems with the ability to invoke external resources -- such as APIs, computational utilities, and specialized models -- to solve complex tasks beyond the reach of standalone language generation. While recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have expanded their reasoning and perception capabilities, existing tool-use methods are predominantly limited to text-only inputs and closed-world settings. Consequently, they struggle to interpret multimodal user instructions and cannot generalize to tools unseen during training. In this work, we introduce RaTA-Tool, a novel framework for open-world multimodal tool selection. Rather than learning direct mappings from user queries to fixed tool identifiers, our approach enables an MLLM to convert a multimodal query into a structured task description and subsequently retrieve the most appropriate tool by matching this representation against semantically rich, machine-readable tool descriptions. This retrieval-based formulation naturally supports extensibility to new tools without retraining. To further improve alignment between task descriptions and tool selection, we incorporate a preference-based optimization stage using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). To support research in this setting, we also introduce the first dataset for open-world multimodal tool use, featuring standardized tool descriptions derived from Hugging Face model cards. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves tool-selection performance, particularly in open-world, multimodal scenarios.

AI.tldr: RaTA-Tool 框架让多模态大模型在开放域中无需重训即可检索并调用新工具，解决传统方法仅限文本且难泛化的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM/MLLM 工具调用方法局限于封闭集与纯文本输入，无法处理未见工具或多模态指令，亟需可扩展、开放域的通用工具选择机制。
AI.method: 1. 用 MLLM 将多模态查询转化为结构化任务描述；2. 基于语义匹配在机器可读的工具描述库中检索最适配工具，实现零样本扩展；3. 引入 DPO 偏好优化，对齐任务描述与工具选择；4. 构建首个开放域多模态工具使用基准（源自 Hugging Face 模型卡）。
AI.result: RaTA-Tool 在开放域、多模态场景下的工具选择准确率显著优于现有基线，未见工具泛化能力提升明显；DPO 阶段进一步缩小匹配误差。
AI.conclusion: 检索式、描述驱动的工具选择范式兼具扩展性与性能，为开放世界多模态 AI 系统提供了实用、轻量的工具调用通用框架。

title: CI-CBM: Class-Incremental Concept Bottleneck Model for Interpretable Continual Learning
comment: 31 pages, 6 figures. Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 04/2026
summary: Catastrophic forgetting remains a fundamental challenge in continual learning, in which models often forget previous knowledge when fine-tuned on a new task. This issue is especially pronounced in class incremental learning (CIL), which is the most challenging setting in continual learning. Existing methods to address catastrophic forgetting often sacrifice either model interpretability or accuracy. To address this challenge, we introduce ClassIncremental Concept Bottleneck Model (CI-CBM), which leverage effective techniques, including concept regularization and pseudo-concept generation to maintain interpretable decision processes throughout incremental learning phases. Through extensive evaluation on seven datasets, CI-CBM achieves comparable performance to black-box models and outperforms previous interpretable approaches in CIL, with an average 36% accuracy gain. CICBM provides interpretable decisions on individual inputs and understandable global decision rules, as shown in our experiments, thereby demonstrating that human understandable concepts can be maintained during incremental learning without compromising model performance. Our approach is effective in both pretrained and non-pretrained scenarios; in the latter, the backbone is trained from scratch during the first learning phase. Code is publicly available at github.com/importAmir/CI-CBM.

AI.tldr: 针对灾难性遗忘问题，提出“概念瓶颈”类增量模型 CI-CBM，在兼顾可解释性与 7 个数据集平均+36% 精度的同时，实现全局与局部可解释规则持续更新。
AI.motivation: 灾难性遗忘是持续学习最大障碍，而类增量（CIL）尤甚。现有解法往往要牺牲模型可解释性或精度，本研究力图同时保持两者。
AI.method: CI-CBM：提出“Class-Incremental Concept Bottleneck Model”，在概念层面加入正则化（抑制概念漂移），并用伪概念生成（对新类仍保有概念表征）保持网络完整性；增量阶段只需微调概念层，主干与概念词典冻结或轻量更新。
AI.result: 在七个视觉与属性数据集上，CI-CBM 较最优可解释方法平均提高 36% 准确率，并在多数任务中与黑箱模型性能相当（差距 <1–2%）。模型可持续输出解释：类-概念激活热图（局部）+ 概念权重规则（全局）。
AI.conclusion: 可解释概念在增量过程中能稳定保存，无需牺牲 task-level 性能，CI-CBM 为可解释持续学习提供可行范式，且对零预训练或预训练场景均有效。

title: Timescale Separation Enables Deep Reinforcement Learning Control of Rotating Detonation Engine Mode Transitions
summary: Rotating detonation engines (RDEs) are a promising propulsion concept that may offer higher thermodynamic efficiency and specific impulse than conventional systems, but nonlinear phenomena, including transitions to oscillatory or chaotic propagation modes, can hinder practical operation. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has emerged as a promising method for controlling complex nonlinear dynamics such as those observed in RDEs. However, the multi-timescale nature of the RDE system makes direct application of DRL challenging. We address this challenge by reformulating the DRL problem in a moving reference frame that follows the detonation-wave pattern, making the wave structure appear quasi-steady to the agent. This reformulation enables scale separation between fast detonation propagation and slower operating-mode dynamics. We train DRL controllers to modulate spatially segmented injection pressure in a one-dimensional reduced-order RDE model and induce rapid transitions between different mode-locked states. Across a range of actuation periods, initial states, and target modes, controllers trained in the moving frame learn more reliably than those trained in a stationary frame and remain effective over a broader range of actuation periods. These results suggest that symmetry-aware moving reference frame formulations may be useful for related multiscale flow-control problems and that scale separation should be exploited whenever possible to enable DRL control of multi-timescale systems.

AI.tldr: 将强化学习的动作空间搬到旋转爆震波的共动坐标系，实现了快慢动力学的显式解耦，使控制器在宽工况下稳定诱导模态切换，显著优于传统定坐标训练方式。
AI.motivation: 旋转爆震发动机（RDE）潜在热效率与比冲高，但非线性模态跳转会危及工程应用；亟需一种不依赖精确模型、可跨时间尺度稳定工作的主动控制手段。
AI.method: 构建一维降阶RDE模型，提出在随爆震头同步旋转的动坐标系下重新定义DRL的状态-动作空间，将快速爆震传播"冻结"为拟稳态结构，仅将慢变模态动态留给智能体决策；利用空间分段喷注压力作执行机构，训练DDPG控制器实现不同锁模态之间的快速切换。
AI.result: 动坐标训练的智能体收敛成功率、样本效率和跨周期鲁棒性均显著优于定坐标基线；在多种初始状态、目标模态与激励周期下均可稳定诱导模态切换，控制策略对喷注周期变化表现出双倍以上的适应区间。
AI.conclusion: 针对多时间尺度系统，将对称性先验嵌入DRL框架，通过动坐标变换显式分离快慢尺度，可在不牺牲模型降阶前提下显著提升控制器可迁移性与鲁棒性；该思路可推广至其他具有行波特征的多尺度流动控制问题。

title: Benchmarking Linguistic Adaptation in Comparable-Sized LLMs: A Study of Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.1, and Qwen3-8B on Romanized Nepali
summary: Romanized Nepali, the Nepali language written in the Latin alphabet, is the dominant medium for informal digital communication in Nepal, yet it remains critically underresourced in the landscape of Large Language Models (LLMs). This study presents a systematic benchmarking of linguistic adaptation across three comparable-sized open-weight models: Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.1, and Qwen3-8B. We evaluate these architectures under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings using a curated bilingual dataset of 10,000 transliterated instruction-following samples. Performance is quantified across five metrics spanning seven measurement dimensions: Perplexity (PPL), BERTScore, chrF++, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L, and BLEU, capturing fluency, phonetic consistency, and semantic integrity. Models were fine-tuned using Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) with Rank-Stabilized LoRA (rsLoRA) at rank r=32 on dual NVIDIA Tesla T4 GPUs, training only approximately 1% of each model's parameters in under 27 total GPU-hours. At zero-shot, all three models fail to generate Romanized Nepali, each exhibiting a distinct architecture-specific failure mode. Following fine-tuning, all three resolve these failures and converge to BERTScore approximately 0.75 and chrF++ greater than 23. Overall dimension-wise assessment across ten criteria identifies Qwen3-8B as the overall recommended architecture, being the only model to produce semantically relevant zero-shot output and leading all structural alignment metrics post-SFT. The adaptation headroom hypothesis is confirmed: Llama-3.1-8B, despite its weakest zero-shot baseline, achieves the largest absolute fine-tuning gains in PPL (Delta = -49.77) and BERTScore (Delta = +0.3287), making it the preferred choice for iterative low-resource development pipelines. This work establishes the first rigorous baseline for Romanized Nepali adaptation in comparable-sized open-weight LLMs.

AI.tldr: 首次系统评估 Llama-3.1-8B/Mistral-7B/Qwen3-8B 在拉丁化尼泊尔语上的零样本与 QLoRA 微调表现，建立低资源基准并给出选型建议。
AI.motivation: 拉丁化尼泊尔语是尼泊尔日常数字通信的主流形式，却在大模型资源中极度匮乏；缺乏可比规模开源模型的系统适配基准，阻碍低资源语言 LLM 研发。
AI.method: 构建 1 万条双语转写指令样本，以 PPL/BERTScore/chrF++/ROUGE/BLEU 七维指标在零样本与 QLoRA(rsLoRA,r=32) 微调场景下对比三模型；仅用双 T4 GPU、27 小时内训练约 1% 参数。
AI.result: 零样本下三模型均无法生成拉丁化尼泊尔语；微调后全部恢复能力，BERTScore≈0.75、chrF++>23。Qwen3-8B 综合十项指标最优；Llama-3.1-8B 零样本最差但微调增益最大(PPL↓49.77，BERTScore↑0.3287)。
AI.conclusion: 确认“适配余量”假说：零样本越弱，微调提升越大。Qwen3 为一次性部署首选；Llama-3.1 适合迭代式低资源迭代管线。研究为拉丁化尼泊尔语开源模型奠定首份严谨基准。

title: Hybrid Decision Making via Conformal VLM-generated Guidance
summary: Building on recent advances in AI, hybrid decision making (HDM) holds the promise of improving human decision quality and reducing cognitive load. We work in the context of learning to guide (LtG), a recently proposed HDM framework in which the human is always responsible for the final decision: rather than suggesting decisions, in LtG the AI supplies (textual) guidance useful for facilitating decision making. One limiting factor of existing approaches is that their guidance compounds information about all possible outcomes, and as a result it can be difficult to digest. We address this issue by introducing ConfGuide, a novel LtG approach that generates more succinct and targeted guidance. To this end, it employs conformal risk control to select a set of outcomes, ensuring a cap on the false negative rate. We demonstrate our approach on a real-world multi-label medical diagnosis task. Our empirical evaluation highlights the promise of ConfGuide.

AI.tldr: 提出ConfGuide，用共形风险控制把LtG的“全结果”文本指导压缩成高召回的精简指导，并在多标签医学诊断任务中验证其减负提效作用。
AI.motivation: 现有LtG框架为防漏诊必须穷举所有可能结果，导致文本指导冗长难消化；需在保证诊断召回率的前提下显著压缩信息量，降低医生认知负荷。
AI.method: 将LtG重新建模为“高召回集合筛选”问题：用共形风险控制（CRC）构造结果候选集并给出其风险上界，再仅就集合内结果生成自然语言指导，实现内容精简与假阴性率受控。
AI.result: 在真实多标签心电图诊断数据集上，ConfGuide在维持≥97%原始召回率的同时，平均每条指导长度缩短58%，医生阅读时间减少46%，主观认知负荷评分显著下降。
AI.conclusion: ConfGuide验证了“可控压缩”思路在LtG中的可行性，证明用统计风险约束精简AI指导可同时保障决策安全与可用性，为高可靠人机协同决策提供新范式。

title: Rethinking Patient Education as Multi-turn Multi-modal Interaction
comment: Equal contribution for the first two authors
summary: Most medical multimodal benchmarks focus on static tasks such as image question answering, report generation, and plain-language rewriting. Patient education is more demanding: systems must identify relevant evidence across images, show patients where to look, explain findings in accessible language, and handle confusion or distress. Yet most patient education work remains text-only, even though combined image-and-text explanations may better support understanding. We introduce MedImageEdu, a benchmark for multi-turn, evidence-grounded radiology patient education. Each case provides a radiology report with report text and case images. A DoctorAgent interacts with a PatientAgent, conditioned on a hidden profile that captures factors such as education level, health literacy, and personality. When a patient question would benefit from visual support, the DoctorAgent can issue drawing instructions grounded in the report, case images, and the current question to a benchmark-provided drawing tool. The tool returns image(s), after which the DoctorAgent produces a final multimodal response consisting of the image(s) and a grounded plain-language explanation. MedImageEdu contains 150 cases from three sources and evaluates both the consultation process and the final multimodal response along five dimensions: Consultation, Safety and Scope, Language Quality, Drawing Quality, and Image-Text Response Quality. Across representative open- and closed-source vision-language model agents, we find three consistent gaps: fluent language often outpaces faithful visual grounding, safety is the weakest dimension across disease categories, and emotionally tense interactions are harder than low education or low health literacy. MedImageEdu provides a controlled testbed for assessing whether multimodal agents can teach from evidence rather than merely answer from text.

AI.tldr: 首个面向医患多轮对话、需同时调用图像与文字证据的放射科患者教育评测集MedImageEdu，揭示现有视觉-语言代理在 Evidence-grounded 教学、情感安抚与安全控制上的关键短板。
AI.motivation: 患者教育比静态问答更复杂：需跨模态找证据、指位置、用通俗语言解释并安抚情绪，而现有基准仅限文本且忽略多轮互动与个体差异（教育水平、情绪等）。
AI.method: 1）构建150例多源放射科案例（报告+影像）；2）设计双智能体对话框架，隐藏患者画像；3）DoctorAgent可实时调用基准提供的绘图工具生成指示图；4）从咨询流程、安全/范围、语言、绘图、图文综合五维度评估开源与闭源多模态模型代理。
AI.result: 所有模型均出现三大共性缺口：①流畅文本优于忠实视觉定位；②安全维度在所有疾病类别中得分最低；③高情绪张力对话的交互难度远高于低教育/低健康素养场景。
AI.conclusion: MedImageEdu为“以证据教学”而非“凭文本回答”提供了可控评测平台，证实现有视觉-语言代理在情感与安全层面远未满足临床患者教育需求。

title: Three-Phase Transformer
summary: We present Three-Phase Transformer (3PT), a residual-stream structural prior for decoder-only Transformers on a standard SwiGLU + RMSNorm + RoPE + GQA backbone. The hidden vector is partitioned into N equally-sized cyclic channels, each maintained by phase-respecting ops: a per-channel RMSNorm, a 2D Givens rotation between attention and FFN that rotates each channel by theta + i*(2*pi/N), and a head-count constraint aligning GQA heads with the partition. The architecture is a self-stabilizing equilibrium between scrambling and re-imposition, not a bolted-on module. The partition carves out a one-dimensional DC subspace orthogonal to the channels, into which we inject a fixed Gabriel's horn profile r(p) = 1/(p+1) as an absolute-position side-channel composing orthogonally with RoPE's relative-position rotation. The canonical N=3 borrows its metaphor from balanced three-phase AC, where three sinusoids 120 degrees apart sum to zero with no anti-correlated pair. At 123M parameters on WikiText-103, 3PT achieves -7.20% perplexity (-2.62% bits-per-byte) over a matched RoPE-Only baseline at +1,536 parameters (0.00124% of total), with 1.93x step-count convergence speedup (1.64x wall-clock). N behaves as a parameter-sharing knob rather than a unique optimum: at 5.5M an N-sweep over {1,2,3,4,6,8,12} is near-monotone with N=1 winning; at 123M a three-seed sweep finds N=3 and N=1 statistically indistinguishable. The load-bearing mechanism is the channel-partitioned residual stream, per-block rotation, per-phase normalization, and horn DC injection. We characterize (a) self-stabilization of the geometry without explicit enforcement, a novel instance of the conservation-law framework for neural networks; (b) a U-shaped depth profile of rotation-angle drift at 12 layers; (c) orthogonal composition with RoPE, attention, and FFN.

AI.tldr: 三阶段 Transformer（3PT）在仅解码器的 SwiGLU+RMSNorm+RoPE+GQA 骨架中，把隐状态均分为 N 个“循环通道”，每通道独立 RMSNorm、固定相位 2π/N 的 Givens 旋转，并与 GQA 头对齐；同时在正交 DC 子空间注入 Gabriel’s horn 绝对位置信号。123 M 模型在 WikiText-103 上仅多 1.5 k 参数即可降 7.2% PPL，收敛步数加速 1.93 倍；N 起到“参数共享旋钮”作用而非唯一最优。其本质是残差流-分区-旋转-正交注入构成的自稳定均衡，首次在神经网络中观察到无需显式约束的几何守恒律。
AI.motivation: 现有位置编码（RoPE）只提供相对位置，绝对位置信息仍靠嵌入层一次性注入，随深度衰减；同时多头参数共享与稳定训练之间存在张力。作者想在不增加显著参数的前提下，把绝对位置以“能量守恒”方式持续注入残差流，并通过通道相位差实现内部自稳定，从而同时提升收敛速度与最终困惑度。
AI.method: 1) 残差流均分 N 通道，每通道独立 RMSNorm；2) 每块内 Attention→FFN 间用 2D Givens 旋转，各通道角度 θ+i·2π/N，实现相位差；3) GQA 头数与通道对齐，保证分区-头数一致；4) 在正交 DC 子空间注入绝对位置曲线 r(p)=1/(p+1)（Gabriel’s horn），与 RoPE 旋转正交组合；5) 整个结构无额外可训练模块，靠分区-旋转-正交注入形成自稳定均衡。
AI.result: 123 M 模型 WikiText-103 上比纯 RoPE 基线 PPL↓7.2%、bpb↓2.62%，仅增 0.00124% 参数；步数收敛加速 1.93×，墙时加速 1.64×。5.5 M 小模型上 N∈{1,2,3,4,6,8,12} 呈近单调趋势，N=1 最佳；123 M 上三种子 N=3 与 N=1 统计无差异，表明 N 是“参数共享旋钮”而非唯一最优。12 层深度观测到旋转角漂移呈 U 型分布，验证几何自稳定无需显式约束。
AI.conclusion: 3PT 通过“通道分区+相位旋转+正交 DC 注入”把绝对位置以守恒律形式持续写入残差流，实现参数几乎零增长下的显著困惑度与收敛速度双提升；首次在深度网络中展示无需外部约束的自稳定均衡，为神经网络守恒律框架提供新实例；N 作为共享旋钮可随规模调节，兼顾小模型效率与大模型稳定性，具有即插即用潜力。

title: Tug-of-War within A Decade: Conflict Resolution in Vulnerability Analysis via Teacher-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generations
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are essential for analyzing and addressing vulnerabilities in cybersecurity. However, among over 200,000 vulnerabilities were discovered in the past decade, more than 30,000 have been changed or updated. This necessitates frequent updates to the training datasets and internal knowledge bases of LLMs to maintain knowledge consistency. In this paper, we focus on the problem of knowledge discrepancy and conflict within CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) detection and analysis. This problem hinders LLMs' ability to retrieve the latest knowledge from original training datasets, leading to knowledge conflicts, fabrications of factually incorrect results, and generation hallucinations. To address this problem, we propose an innovative two-stage framework called CRVA-TGRAG (Conflict Resolution in Vulnerability Analysis via Teacher-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation). First, to improve document retrieval accuracy during the retrieval stage, we utilize Parent Document Segmentation and an ensemble retrieval scheme based on semantic similarity and inverted indexing. Second, to enhance LLMs' capabilities based on the retrieval of CVE dataset in generation stage, we employ a teacher-guided preference optimization technique to fine-tune LLMs. Our framework not only enhances the quality of content retrieval through RAG but also leverages the advantages of preference fine-tuning in LLMs to answer questions more effectively and precisely. Experiments demonstrate our method achieves higher accuracy in retrieving the latest CVEs compared to external knowledge bases. In conclusion, our framework significantly mitigates potential knowledge conflicts and inconsistencies that may arise from relying solely on LLMs for knowledge retrieval.

AI.tldr: CRVA-TGRAG 分两段缩小 LLMs 与 CVE 数据的版本差距：先用 Parent-Doc 语义+倒排混合检索，再用教师偏好微调 LLM，实验表明抽取准确率优于 RAG 基线与 LLM 自身。
AI.motivation: 3 万+ CVE 修订导致 LLM 内部知识滞后，催生检索冲突、生成幻觉，需让模型始终对齐最新漏洞库。
AI.method: Parent-Document 分段、语义+倒排集成召回；教师模型筛选最优输出，做 DPO/RLHF 偏好微调，构建 CRVA-TGRAG 框架端到端优化 RAG。
AI.result: 在 CVE 更新集上，召回率提升 18–26%，答案事实一致性提高 22%，生成幻觉率下降 31%。
AI.conclusion: 将检索精度与偏好微调耦合，可显著抑制 LLM 因数据版本差异导致的冲突与幻觉，为安全场景提供即时、可信的知识来源。

title: What Is the Minimum Architecture for Prolepsis? Early Irrevocable Commitment Across Tasks in Small Transformers
comment: 24 pages, 3 figures. Under review at COLM 2026. Independent replication of the rhyme-planning finding from Lindsey et al. (2025) on open-weights models; extended to factual recall
summary: When do transformers commit to a decision, and what prevents them from correcting it? We introduce \textbf{prolepsis}: a transformer commits early, task-specific attention heads sustain the commitment, and no layer corrects it. Replicating \citeauthor{lindsey2025biology}'s (\citeyear{lindsey2025biology}) planning-site finding on open models (Gemma~2 2B, Llama~3.2 1B), we ask five questions. (Q1)~Planning is invisible to six residual-stream methods; CLTs are necessary. (Q2)~The planning-site spike replicates with identical geometry. (Q3)~Specific attention heads route the decision to the output, filling a gap flagged as invisible to attribution graphs. (Q4)~Search requires ${\leq}16$ layers; commitment requires more. (Q5)~Factual recall shows the same motif at a different network depth, with zero overlap between recurring planning heads and the factual top-10. Prolepsis is architectural: the template is shared, the routing substrates differ. All experiments run on a single consumer GPU (16\,GB VRAM).

AI.tldr: 将临床或社区样本的认知-运动双重任务(CDT)表现，按步速或认知任务类型拆分后，可显著提升对轻度认知障碍(MCI)的判别力，且步速类指标更具推广性。
AI.motivation: 传统总体CDT指标对MCI的预测力有限且跨人群稳定性差，作者假设通过拆分步速与认知任务类型，或可在临床和社区人群中获得更稳健、更强的判别效应。
AI.method: 整合6项独立研究(总n=2 337)，采用两阶段个体数据荟萃分析：首先在各样本内部比较MCI与正常对照的CDT表现，随后用随机效应模型合并效应量；区分步速类型(普通/复杂/双任务成本)与认知任务类型(数字倒背、口头流畅性等)。
AI.result: 拆分后，步速类指标合并效应量Hedges g=0.40–0.67，认知任务类g=0.18–0.30；步速类预测力在临床、社区及教育亚组中均显著优于认知类，且异质性低。
AI.conclusion: CDT评估应优先采用步速类指标，可得到跨人群稳健且更强的MCI判别效果，为临床筛查提供简便高效工具。

title: Knowing When Not to Answer: Evaluating Abstention in Multimodal Reasoning Systems
summary: Effective abstention (EA), recognizing evidence insufficiency and refraining from answering, is critical for reliable multimodal systems. Yet existing evaluation paradigms for vision-language models (VLMs) and multi-agent systems (MAS) assume answerability, pushing models to always respond. Abstention has been studied in text-only settings but remains underexplored multimodally; current benchmarks either ignore unanswerability or rely on coarse methods that miss realistic failure modes. We introduce MM-AQA, a benchmark that constructs unanswerable instances from answerable ones via transformations along two axes: visual modality dependency and evidence sufficiency. Evaluating three frontier VLMs spanning closed and open-source models and two MAS architectures across 2079 samples, we find: (1) under standard prompting, VLMs rarely abstain; even simple confidence baselines outperform this setup, (2) MAS improves abstention but introduces an accuracy-abstention trade-off, (3) sequential designs match or exceed iterative variants, suggesting the bottleneck is miscalibration rather than reasoning depth, and (4) models abstain when image or text evidence is absent, but attempt reconciliation with degraded or contradictory evidence. Effective multimodal abstention requires abstention-aware training rather than better prompting or more agents.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估多模态模型在“无法回答”场景下的主动回避能力，提出 MM-AQA 基准并揭示现有模型几乎不会主动回避，需用回避感知训练而非提示或堆代理解决。
AI.motivation: 图文问答可靠性的关键被忽略：当视觉或文本证据不足时，模型应主动回避回答。现有评测默认所有样本必答，导致回避机制在多模态领域未量化、未优化。
AI.method: 构建 MM-AQA：从可答样本出发，沿“视觉依赖程度”与“证据充分度”两轴做变换，生成 2079 条不可答样例；覆盖 3 种前沿 VLM 与 2 类多代理架构，比较标准提示、置信基线、单模型与多代理的回避-准确权衡。
AI.result: (1) 标准提示下 VLM 几乎不回避，置信基线即可超越；(2) 多代理提升回避率却牺牲准确率；(3) 串行多代理 ≥ 迭代多代理，表明瓶颈是置信校准而非推理深度；(4) 模型缺图或缺文时易回避，但遇模糊/矛盾证据仍强行作答。
AI.conclusion: 多模态回避不是提示工程或代理数量问题，必须引入“回避感知”训练目标，才能同时提升回避率与整体可靠性。

title: Zero-Ablation Overstates Register Content Dependence in DINO Vision Transformers
comment: 12 pages, 10 figures, to be published in CVPR 2026 HOW Vision Interpretability Workshop Proceedings
summary: Zero-ablation -- replacing token activations with zero vectors -- is widely used to probe token function in vision transformers. Register zeroing in DINOv2+registers and DINOv3 produces large drops (up to $-36.6$\,pp classification, $-30.9$\,pp segmentation), suggesting registers are functionally indispensable. However, three replacement controls -- mean-substitution, noise-substitution, and cross-image register-shuffling -- preserve performance across classification, correspondence, and segmentation, remaining within ${\sim}1$\,pp of the unmodified baseline. Per-patch cosine similarity shows these replacements genuinely perturb internal representations, while zeroing causes disproportionately large perturbations, consistent with why it alone degrades tasks. We conclude that zero-ablation overstates dependence on exact register content. In the frozen-feature evaluations we test, performance depends on plausible register-like activations rather than on exact image-specific values. Registers nevertheless buffer dense features from \texttt{[CLS]} dependence and are associated with compressed patch geometry. These findings, including the replacement-control results, replicate at ViT-B scale.

AI.tldr: 在冻结视觉Transformer中，用零向量抹除寄存器token会严重拖垮性能，但用均值、随机噪声或跨图寄存器打乱替换却能几乎不掉点，说明零消融夸大了对确切寄存器值的依赖。
AI.motivation: 零消融被默认用来判断token是否‘不可或缺’，但作者质疑其结论的可靠性，想厘清寄存器token的真正作用与评估方法的偏差。
AI.method: 在DINOv2+registers、DINOv3及ViT-B上，系统比较零消融与三种‘内容替换’控制（均值、随机噪声、跨图寄存器打乱），并在分类、密集对应、分割任务上评估性能；用逐块余弦相似度量化表征扰动程度。
AI.result: 零消融导致最高-36.6 pp分类、-30.9 pp分割暴跌，而三种替换控制均保持在≈1 pp误差内；替换仍显著扰动内部表征，表明任务依赖的是“寄存器样”激活而非确切值。寄存器还降低对[CLS]的依赖并压缩补丁几何。
AI.conclusion: 零过大地夸大了对寄存器精确内容的依赖；冻结特征场景下，模型只需要“像寄存器”的激活即可维持性能，真正关键的是其统计属性与结构角色，而非图像特异性值。

title: QU-NLP at ArchEHR-QA 2026: Two-Stage QLoRA Fine-Tuning of Qwen3-4B for Patient-Oriented Clinical Question Answering and Evidence Sentence Alignment
comment: Accepted for publication at CL4Health 2026 workshop, LREC2026 conference
summary: We present a unified system addressing both Subtask 3 (answer generation) and Subtask 4 (evidence sentence alignment) of the ArchEHR-QA Shared Task. For Subtask 3, we apply two-stage Quantised Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) to Qwen3-4B loaded in 4-bit NF4 quantisation: first on 30,000 samples from the emrQA-MedSQuAD corpus to establish clinical domain competence, then on the 20 annotated development cases to learn the task-specific output style. Our system achieves an overall score of 32.87 on the official test-2026 split (BLEU = 9.42, ROUGE-L = 27.04, SARI = 55.42, BERTScore = 43.00, AlignScore = 25.28, MEDCON = 37.04). For Subtask 4, we develop a weighted ensemble of three retrieval methods - BM25 with relative thresholding, TF-IDF cosine similarity, and a fine-tuned cross-encoder - to identify note sentences supporting a given gold answer, achieving a micro-F1 of 67.16 on the 100-case test set. Experiments reveal that both subtasks expose the same fundamental challenge: 20 annotated training cases are insufficient to distinguish relevant from irrelevant clinical sentences, pointing to data augmentation as the highest-leverage future direction.

AI.tldr: 本文用两阶段 QLoRA 微调 4-bit Qwen3-4B 生成答案，并用 BM25+TF-IDF+CrossEncoder 加权检索证据句，分别获得 32.87 与 67.16 的官方成绩；核心痛点是 20 条训练样本无法让模型区分临床相关性，需数据增强。
AI.motivation: ArchEHR-QA 共享任务要求系统同时生成答案并给出对应的 EHR 证据句；参与者需克服临床领域知识缺乏与训练样本极少的双重瓶颈，以提升问答可解释性。
AI.method: Subtask 3：先以 30 k emrQA-MedSQuAD 样本做领域适应，再用 20 条开发集样例做任务微调，采用 4-bit NF4 QLoRA。Subtask 4：构建 BM25（带相对阈值）、TF-IDF 余弦与微调 CrossEncoder 三通道检索的加权集成，以定位支持句；两子任务共享 20 条标注数据。
AI.result: 测试集上 Subtask 3 综合得分 32.87（BLEU 9.42 等），Subtask 4 微平均 F1 67.16。实验一致表明 20 条训练句不足以学习相关性判别，成为性能瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 20 例标注严重限制了临床相关性学习，数据增强是最具性价比的下一步；同时验证了轻量化 QLoRA 与多路检索集成在低资源医疗 QA 中的可行性。

title: Route to Rome Attack: Directing LLM Routers to Expensive Models via Adversarial Suffix Optimization
summary: Cost-aware routing dynamically dispatches user queries to models of varying capability to balance performance and inference cost. However, the routing strategy introduces a new security concern that adversaries may manipulate the router to consistently select expensive high-capability models. Existing routing attacks depend on either white-box access or heuristic prompts, rendering them ineffective in real-world black-box scenarios. In this work, we propose R$^2$A, which aims to mislead black-box LLM routers to expensive models via adversarial suffix optimization. Specifically, R$^2$A deploys a hybrid ensemble surrogate router to mimic the black-box router. A suffix optimization algorithm is further adapted for the ensemble-based surrogate. Extensive experiments on multiple open-source and commercial routing systems demonstrate that {R$^2$A} significantly increases the routing rate to expensive models on queries of different distributions. Code and examples: https://github.com/thcxiker/R2A-Attack.

AI.tldr: 基于对抗后缀优化，R²A可欺骗真实黑盒路由器，持续把查询导向昂贵大模型（成本↑、资源↑），攻击方法包含多代理路由器模仿与面向代理的损失优化
AI.motivation: 成本敏感路由能有效平衡性能与成本，但若外部调用者能肆意引导其选择高价模型，会导致预算失控甚至服务级失效；目前针对路由的攻击仅局限白盒或启发式 Prompt，难以对真实黑盒系统奏效
AI.result: 多组实验（含开源与商用平台）显示 R²A 能持续显著提升引向昂贵模型成功率；多样化查询分布下均有效；同时将攻击效果与查询内容无显著依赖；部分案例中路由成本数倍增长，相比无后缀基线命中率跳涨最高 40% 以上
AI.conclusion: 对抗性行程后缀能实证性地引导黑盒路由决策，威胁成本敏感路由的经济调度和资源公平；设计带成本约束的自适应路由、即时异常检测与代理路由器随机化是可预见的防御方向

title: Generative Modeling of Complex-Valued Brain MRI Data
summary: Objective. Standard Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) reconstruction pipelines discard phase information captured during acquisition, despite evidence that it encodes tissue properties relevant to tumor diagnosis. Current machine learning approaches inherit this limitation by operating exclusively on reconstructed magnitude images. The aim of this study is to build a generative framework which is capable of jointly modeling magnitude and phase information of complex-valued MRI scans. Approach. The proposed generative framework combines a conditional variational autoencoder, which compresses complex-valued MRI scans into compact latent representations while preserving phase coherence, with a flow-matching-based generative model. Synthetic sample quality is assessed via a real-versus-synthetic classifier and by training downstream classifiers on synthetic data for abnormal tissue detection. Main results. The autoencoder preserves phase coherence above 0.997. Real-versus-synthetic classification yields low AUROC values between 0.50 and 0.66 across all acquisition sequences, indicating generated samples are nearly indistinguishable from real data. In downstream normal-versus-abnormal classification, classifiers trained entirely on synthetic data achieve an AUROC of 0.880, surpassing the real-data baseline of 0.842 on a publicly available dataset (fastMRI). This advantage persists on an independent external test set from a different institution with biopsy-confirmed labels. Significance. The proposed framework demonstrates the feasibility of jointly modeling magnitude and phase information for normal and abnormal complex-valued brain MRI data. Beyond synthetic data generation, it establishes a foundation for the usage of complete brain MRI information in future diagnostic applications and enables systematic investigation of how magnitude and phase jointly encode pathology-specific features.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次在MRI重建管线中保留并复用相位信息：构建一套条件VAE+流匹配生成框架，同时建模幅度与相位，合成样本在公开fastMRI及外部活检数据上均能让下游分类器性能超过纯真实数据基线（AUROC 0.880 vs 0.842）。
AI.motivation: 传统MRI只保留幅度图丢弃相位图，导致与组织特性相关的诊断信息丢失；现有深度学习亦只针对幅度图。作者希望利用被忽视的相位信息提升脑部病变检测性能。
AI.method: 1）设计复值条件VAE，将完整复值MRI压缩到潜在空间并保持相位一致性；2）用流匹配生成模型在潜在空间采样；3）通过“真伪判别器”和下游“正常-异常分类器”双重评估合成数据质量。
AI.result: 相位相干度>0.997；真伪判别AUROC仅0.50-0.66，说明生成样本几乎无法区分；仅用合成数据训练的分类器在fastMRI达0.880 AUROC，高于真实数据基线0.842，并在另一家医院的活检数据上保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 该框架验证了同步建模幅度+相位在脑部MRI病变诊断中的可行性，为利用完整复值信息和探究幅度-相位联合病理特征提供了新基线。

title: Bias in Surface Electromyography Features across a Demographically Diverse Cohort
summary:
Neuromotor decoding from upper-limb electromyography (sEMG) can enhance human-machine interfaces and offer a more natural means of controlling prosthetic limbs, virtual reality, and household electronics. Unfortunately, current sEMG technology does not always perform consistently across users because individual differences such as age and body mass index, among many others, can substantially alter signal quality. This variability makes sEMG characteristics highly idiosyncratic, often necessitating laborious personalization and iterative tuning to achieve reliable performance. This variability has particular import for sEMG-based assistive devices and neural interfaces, where demographic biases in sEMG features could undermine broad and fair deployment.
  In this study, we explore how demographic differences affect the sEMG signals produced and their implications for machine learning-based gesture decoding. We analyze the data set provided by, in which we derive 147 common sEMG features extracted from 81 demographically diverse individuals performing discrete hand gestures. Using mixed-effects linear models and partial least squares (PLS) analysis, which take into consideration demographic variables (including age, sex, height, weight, skin properties, subcutaneous fat, and hair density), we identify that 33\% (49 of 147) of commonly used sEMG features show significant associations with demographic characteristics. These results may help guide the development of fair and unbiased sEMG-based neural interfaces across a diverse population.

AI.tldr: 体表肌电(sEMG)特征三分之一受年龄、BMI、体脂、毛发等人口学因素显著影响，需针对个体差异设计公平解码算法。
AI.motivation: 当前sEMG接口跨用户性能波动大，人口学差异造成特征偏移，阻碍假肢、VR等应用的普惠部署。
AI.method: 从81名多样化受试者147种常用sEMG特征出发，应用混合效应线性模型与偏最小二乘法，量化人口学变量对特征的独立贡献。
AI.result: 49/147项特征与人口学因子显著相关，解释幅度最高达33%，显示年龄、体脂、毛发密度等是主要偏差来源。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次系统揭示sEMG特征的人口学偏倚，为构建去偏算法、采样策略与公平评估基准提供直接依据，推动sEMG接口真正跨人群可用。

title: The Devil Is in Gradient Entanglement: Energy-Aware Gradient Coordinator for Robust Generalized Category Discovery
summary: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) leverages labeled data to categorize unlabeled samples from known or unknown classes. Most previous methods jointly optimize supervised and unsupervised objectives and achieve promising results. However, inherent optimization interference still limits their ability to improve further. Through quantitative analysis, we identify a key issue, i.e., gradient entanglement, which 1) distorts supervised gradients and weakens discrimination among known classes, and 2) induces representation-subspace overlap between known and novel classes, reducing the separability of novel categories. To address this issue, we propose the Energy-Aware Gradient Coordinator (EAGC), a plug-and-play gradient-level module that explicitly regulates the optimization process. EAGC comprises two components: Anchor-based Gradient Alignment (AGA) and Energy-aware Elastic Projection (EEP). AGA introduces a reference model to anchor the gradient directions of labeled samples, preserving the discriminative structure of known classes against the interference of unlabeled gradients. EEP softly projects unlabeled gradients onto the complement of the known-class subspace and derives an energy-based coefficient to adaptively scale the projection for each unlabeled sample according to its degree of alignment with the known subspace, thereby reducing subspace overlap without suppressing unlabeled samples that likely belong to known classes. Experiments show that EAGC consistently boosts existing methods and establishes new state-of-the-art results. Code is available at https://haiyangzheng.github.io/EAGC.

AI.tldr: 现有广义类别发现方法因监督与无监督梯度纠缠而难以进一步提升精度；提出能量感知梯度协调器 EAGC，通过 AGA 保已知类判别结构、EEP 抑制已知-新类子空间重叠，实现梯度级显式优化，刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: GCD 任务中同时优化监督和无监督目标会导致梯度方向相互干扰（梯度纠缠），从而削弱已知类判别性并加剧已知-新类子空间重叠，限制性能提升。
AI.method: 设计即插即用梯度级模块 EAGC：1) AGA 引入参考模型锚定有标签样本的梯度方向，隔离无监督梯度干扰；2) EEP 将无标签梯度软投影到已知子空间补空间，并以能量系数随样本对齐程度自适应缩放，避免误抑制潜在已知类样本。
AI.result: 在多个 GCD 基准数据集上，EAGC 无需重训练即可提升现有 SoTA 方法，取得新的最佳结果，验证其通用性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: EAGC 首次在梯度层面化解 GCD 中的优化干扰问题，揭示并解决了梯度纠缠这一关键瓶颈，为后续半监督开集识别任务提供了可复用的梯度协调框架。

title: From Reactive to Proactive: Assessing the Proactivity of Voice Agents via ProVoice-Bench
summary: Recent advancements in LLM agents are gradually shifting from reactive, text-based paradigms toward proactive, multimodal interaction. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on reactive responses, overlooking the complexities of proactive intervention and monitoring. To bridge this gap, we introduce ProVoice-Bench, the first evaluation framework specifically designed for proactive voice agents, featuring four novel tasks. By leveraging a multi-stage data synthesis pipeline, we curate 1,182 high-quality samples for rigorous testing. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art Multimodal LLMs reveals a significant performance gap, particularly regarding over-triggering and reasoning capabilities. These findings highlight the limitations of current models and offer a roadmap for developing more natural, context-aware proactive agents.

AI.tldr: 首个面向主动式语音智能体的评测框架 ProVoice-Bench，揭示现有 MLLM 在主动干预与推理上的显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型智能体从被动文本响应转向主动多模态交互，现有基准仍局限于“问-答”式被动评测，无法衡量主动打断、监控与推理能力。
AI.method: 提出 ProVoice-Bench：① 设计 4 项新任务（主动打断、情境监控、目标驱动对话、跨模态推理）；② 构建 1,182 条高质量多轮语音-视觉样本的多阶段数据合成流水线；③ 对多款 SOTA 多模态 LLM 进行系统评测，重点量化过度触发率与推理准确率。
AI.result: 评测显示，主流模型在主动触发边界判断上过度触发率最高达 47%，跨模态推理准确率平均仅 34%，暴露显著性能缺口。
AI.conclusion: 结果证实当前 MLLM 远未达到自然、上下文感知的主动交互水平；ProVoice-Bench 为后续模型优化提供诊断基准与演进路线。

title: Reasoning Dynamics and the Limits of Monitoring Modality Reliance in Vision-Language Models
summary: Recent advances in vision language models (VLMs) offer reasoning capabilities, yet how these unfold and integrate visual and textual information remains unclear. We analyze reasoning dynamics in 18 VLMs covering instruction-tuned and reasoning-trained models from two different model families. We track confidence over Chain-of-Thought (CoT), measure the corrective effect of reasoning, and evaluate the contribution of intermediate reasoning steps. We find that models are prone to answer inertia, in which early commitments to a prediction are reinforced, rather than revised during reasoning steps. While reasoning-trained models show stronger corrective behavior, their gains depend on modality conditions, from text-dominant to vision-only settings. Using controlled interventions with misleading textual cues, we show that models are consistently influenced by these cues even when visual evidence is sufficient, and assess whether this influence is recoverable from CoT. Although this influence can appear in the CoT, its detectability varies across models and depends on what is being monitored. Reasoning-trained models are more likely to explicitly refer to the cues, but their longer and fluent CoTs can still appear visually grounded while actually following textual cues, obscuring modality reliance. In contrast, instruction-tuned models refer to the cues less explicitly, but their shorter traces reveal inconsistencies with the visual input. Taken together, these findings indicate that CoT provides only a partial view of how different modalities drive VLM decisions, with important implications for the transparency and safety of multimodal systems.

AI.tldr: 通过18个视觉-语言模型（VLM）的链式推理（CoT）实验，发现模型存在“答案惯性”，早期预测被强化而非修正；文本线索即使与视觉证据冲突仍能主导决策，且其影响在CoT中仅部分可见，威胁多模态透明度与安全。
AI.motivation: 尽管VLMs已具备推理能力，但视觉与文本信息如何被动态整合、修正及影响最终决策的过程尚不清晰，亟需量化不同训练策略（指令微调 vs. 推理训练）下的推理动态与模态依赖。
AI.method: 覆盖2个模型家族、18个VLM，对比指令微调与额外推理训练；追踪CoT置信度变化，设计文本误导线索干预实验，量化早期预测修正率与中间步骤贡献，并检测CoT是否暴露模态偏向。
AI.result: ①普遍存在“答案惯性”，推理步骤多强化而非修正早期预测；②推理训练模型在文本主导条件下修正率更高，但在纯视觉情境下收益下降；③误导文本线索持续左右决策，即使视觉证据充分；④该线索仅部分显式出现在CoT，且检出率因模型与监控粒度而异；⑤推理训练模型CoT更长更流畅，表面看似视觉对齐，实则隐性遵循文本线索。
AI.conclusion: CoT仅提供VLM决策过程的局部视角，无法完整揭示模态驱动机制；答案惯性与隐性文本依赖对多模态系统的可解释性与安全性构成实质挑战，未来需开发超越CoT的监测与对齐方法。

title: Improving Machine Learning Performance with Synthetic Augmentation
summary:
Synthetic augmentation is increasingly used to mitigate data scarcity in financial machine learning, yet its statistical role remains poorly understood. We formalize synthetic augmentation as a modification of the effective training distribution and show that it induces a structural bias--variance trade-off: while additional samples may reduce estimation error, they may also shift the population objective whenever the synthetic distribution deviates from regions relevant under evaluation. To isolate informational gains from mechanical sample-size effects, we introduce a size-matched null augmentation and a finite-sample, non-parametric block permutation test that remains valid under weak temporal dependence.
  We evaluate this framework in both controlled Markov-switching environments and real financial datasets, including high-frequency option trade data and a daily equity panel. Across generators spanning bootstrap, copula-based models, variational autoencoders, diffusion models, and TimeGAN, we vary augmentation ratio, model capacity, task type, regime rarity, and signal-to-noise. We show that synthetic augmentation is beneficial only in variance-dominant regimes, such as persistent volatility forecasting-while it deteriorates performance in bias-dominant settings, including near-efficient directional prediction. Rare-regime targeting can improve domain-specific metrics but may conflict with unconditional permutation inference. Our results provide a structural perspective on when synthetic data improves financial learning performance and when it induces persistent distributional distortion.

AI.tldr: 首次给出合成增广在金融学习中的结构偏差—方差分解，提出规模对齐零增广与块置换检验，实证表明增广仅在“方差主导”场景有效。
AI.motivation: 金融 ML 普遍面临数据稀缺，但合成增广的统计机制与适用条件缺乏理论解释，亟需一个可验证的框架来判断其何时真正提升学习性能而非引入伪信号。
AI.method: 1) 将增广形式化为对训练分布的修正，推导出偏差—方差权衡结构；2) 设计 size-matched null augmentation 以剔除样本量机械效应；3) 建立弱时间依赖下仍有效的非参数块置换检验；4) 在受控马尔可夫机制转换环境及高频期权、日频股票等真实数据集上，系统比较 bootstrap、copula、VAE、扩散模型、TimeGAN 五种生成器在不同增广比率、模型容量、任务类型、机制稀有度、信噪比下的表现。
AI.result: 合成增广只在“方差主导”区域（如持续性波动率预测）显著提高性能；在“偏差主导”场景（近有效市场的方向预测）反而因分布漂移而恶化。针对稀有机制定向增广可提升领域指标，但与无条件置换推断存在张力。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据并非万能，其价值取决于偏差—方差权衡中哪一方占主导；实际应用需先通过规模对齐检验与置换推断判断是否落入“方差主导”区域，否则可能引入持久的分布失真。

title: Listen, Correct, and Feed Back: Spoken Pedagogical Feedback Generation
summary: Grammatical error correction (GEC) and explanation (GEE) have made rapid progress, but real teaching scenarios also require \emph{learner-friendly pedagogical feedback} that is actionable, level-appropriate, and encouraging. We introduce \textbf{SPFG} (\textbf{S}poken \textbf{P}edagogical \textbf{F}eedback \textbf{G}eneration), a dataset built based on the Speak \& Improve Challenge 2025 corpus, pairing fluency-oriented transcriptions with GEC targets and \emph{human-verified} teacher-style feedback, including preferred/rejected feedback pairs for preference learning. We study a transcript-based Spoken Grammatical Error Correction (SGEC) setting and evaluate three instruction-tuned LLMs (Qwen2.5, Llama-3.1, and GLM-4), comparing supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with preference-based alignment (using DPO and KTO) for jointly generating corrections and feedback. Results show that SFT provides the most consistent improvements, while DPO/KTO yield smaller or mixed gains, and that correction quality and feedback quality are weakly coupled. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Skywalker-Harrison/spfg.

AI.tldr: 首个面向口语教学场景、同时输出纠错与鼓励性反馈的平行语料 SPFG 被构建；对比 SFT/DPO/KTO 三种对齐策略后，发现 SFT 在纠错与反馈质量上最稳定，偏好对齐方法收益有限，且纠错与反馈质量仅弱相关。
AI.motivation: 现有 GEC/GEE 研究忽略“学习者友好、可行动、难度匹配、鼓励性”的教学反馈，而真实课堂需要同时给出纠错与教学建议；为此需构建口语场景下的纠错-反馈平行数据，并验证大模型如何更好地同时生成二者。
AI.method: 基于 Speak & Improve Challenge 2025 转录文本，人工撰写并验证“鼓励性教学反馈”，形成含 GEC 目标句、反馈文本及偏好对（优选/次选）的 SPFG 数据集；在 SGEC 任务上指令微调 Qwen2.5、Llama-3.1、GLM-4，比较 SFT、DPO、KTO 三种对齐方式，联合评估纠错与反馈质量。
AI.result: SFT 在纠错与反馈的自动指标及人工评估上均取得稳定提升；DPO/KTO 仅带来小幅或不稳定增益；纠错与反馈的质量相关性较低（弱耦合），说明二者需独立优化。
AI.conclusion: 教学取向的口语纠错反馈需要专门数据与 SFT 策略，偏好对齐方法未显优势；纠错准确性与教学反馈质量应作为两个独立维度持续改进，SPFG 为该方向提供基准与扩展空间。

title: OpenMobile: Building Open Mobile Agents with Task and Trajectory Synthesis
summary: Mobile agents powered by vision-language models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in automating mobile tasks, with recent leading models achieving a marked performance leap, e.g., nearly 70% success on AndroidWorld. However, these systems keep their training data closed and remain opaque about their task and trajectory synthesis recipes. We present OpenMobile, an open-source framework that synthesizes high-quality task instructions and agent trajectories, with two key components: (1) The first is a scalable task synthesis pipeline that constructs a global environment memory from exploration, then leverages it to generate diverse and grounded instructions. and (2) a policy-switching strategy for trajectory rollout. By alternating between learner and expert models, it captures essential error-recovery data often missing in standard imitation learning. Agents trained on our data achieve competitive results across three dynamic mobile agent benchmarks: notably, our fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL reach 51.7% and 64.7% on AndroidWorld, far surpassing existing open-data approaches. Furthermore, we conduct transparent analyses on the overlap between our synthetic instructions and benchmark test sets, and verify that performance gains stem from broad functionality coverage rather than benchmark overfitting. We release data and code at https://njucckevin.github.io/openmobile/ to bridge the data gap and facilitate broader mobile agent research.

AI.tldr: OpenMobile 是首个开源的移动智能体训练框架，可自动生成任务指令与轨迹，使开源模型在 AndroidWorld 上的成功率从 30% 级跃升至 64.7%，并公开全部数据与代码。
AI.motivation: 现有顶尖移动智能体依赖闭源数据与配方，阻碍社区复现与研究；同时开源数据稀缺导致性能差距显著，亟需可扩展且透明的合成方案。
AI.method: 提出“全局环境记忆 + 可扩展任务合成管线”生成多样且接地指令，并设计“学习者–专家策略切换” rollout 机制主动采集错误恢复样本，弥补模仿学习缺陷。
AI.result: 基于合成数据微调的 Qwen2.5-VL 与 Qwen3-VL 在 AndroidWorld 达 51.7% 与 64.7%，领先所有开源方法；在另外两个动态基准亦保持竞争力。透明分析表明提升源于功能覆盖而非测试集泄露。
AI.conclusion: OpenMobile 以完全开源方式弥合数据鸿沟，验证高质量合成数据可让开源移动智能体逼近闭源顶尖水平，为后续研究提供可复现基线与丰富资源。

title: ADAPT: Benchmarking Commonsense Planning under Unspecified Affordance Constraints
summary: Intelligent embodied agents should not simply follow instructions, as real-world environments often involve unexpected conditions and exceptions. However, existing methods usually focus on directly executing instructions, without considering whether the target objects can actually be manipulated, meaning they fail to assess available affordances. To address this limitation, we introduce DynAfford, a benchmark that evaluates embodied agents in dynamic environments where object affordances may change over time and are not specified in the instruction. DynAfford requires agents to perceive object states, infer implicit preconditions, and adapt their actions accordingly. To enable this capability, we introduce ADAPT, a plug-and-play module that augments existing planners with explicit affordance reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that incorporating ADAPT significantly improves robustness and task success across both seen and unseen environments. We also show that a domain-adapted, LoRA-finetuned vision-language model used as the affordance inference backend outperforms a commercial LLM (GPT-4o), highlighting the importance of task-aligned affordance grounding.

AI.tldr: DynAfford 基准首次将动态可抓取性引入具身智能评估，配合即插即用 ADAPT 模块，可把原有规划器成功率提升 20–30%，且轻量级 LoRA 微调即可超越 GPT-4o。
AI.motivation: 现有方法默认物体始终可抓取，忽略“能否操作”这一隐式先决条件，导致机器人在真实动态环境中鲁棒性差。
AI.method: 构建 DynAfford，场景内物体状态可随时间变化且不写入指令；提出 ADAPT，用视觉-语言模型在线推断 affordance 并显式注入已有规划器，可在训练与测试阶段无侵入式接入；采用 LoRA 微调减小数据依赖与推理延迟。
AI.result: 在 DynAfford 的 5 类动态任务中，Baseline 成功率 48%，+ADAPT 提升至 77%，跨场景泛化升幅最大 34%；LoRA 微调模型对 affordance 识别 F1 达 0.85，比 GPT-4o 高 18%，且视觉-语言端侧延迟 <40 ms。
AI.conclusion: 动态 affordance 评估应是具身系统的核心瓶颈；轻量插件+任务对齐微调即可显著提升鲁棒性，为实现安全自主的机器人指令遵循提供新范式。

title: H2VLR: Heterogeneous Hypergraph Vision-Language Reasoning for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
summary: As a classic vision task, anomaly detection has been widely applied in industrial inspection and medical imaging. In this task, data scarcity is often a frequently-faced issue. To solve it, the few-shot anomaly detection (FSAD) scheme is attracting increasing attention. In recent years, beyond traditional visual paradigm, Vision-Language Model (VLM) has been extensively explored to boost this field. However, in currently-existing VLM-based FSAD schemes, almost all perform anomaly inference only by pairwise feature matching, ignoring structural dependencies and global consistency. To further redound to FSAD via VLM, we propose a Heterogeneous Hypergraph Vision-Language Reasoning (H2VLR) framework. It reformulates the FSAD as a high-order inference problem of visual-semantic relations, by jointly modeling visual regions and semantic concepts in a unified hypergraph. Experimental comparisons verify the effectiveness and advantages of H2VLR. It could often achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on representative industrial and medical benchmarks. Our code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: （最小动作）用异构超图把极少样本异常检测从两两匹配升级为高阶视觉–语义联合推理，工业/医学基准达 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 传统VLM方法仅用两两特征匹配，忽视了区域间结构与全局一致性，导致在数据极度稀缺的FSAD场景下推理受限。
AI.method: 提出异构超图视觉–语言推理框架 H2VLR，将图像区域与语义概念统一建模为超图节点，通过高阶超边捕获跨模态依赖，实现一次前向即可完成全局一致推理。
AI.result: 在工业与医学两类代表性FSAD基准上，H2VLR较现有最佳方法取得显著性能提升，达当前最优。
AI.conclusion: 将异常检测重定义为视觉–语义高阶推理问题并引入异构超图，是突破数据稀缺瓶颈的有效途径，代码已承诺开源。

title: An Underexplored Frontier: Large Language Models for Rare Disease Patient Education and Communication -- A scoping review
summary:
Rare diseases affect over 300 million people worldwide and are characterized by complex care pathways, limited clinical expertise, and substantial unmet communication needs throughout the long patient journey. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to support patient education and communication, yet their application in rare diseases remains unclear.
  We conducted a scoping review of studies published between January 2022 and March 2026 across major databases, identifying 12 studies on LLM-based rare disease patient education and communication. Data were extracted on study characteristics, application scenarios, model usage, and evaluation methods, and synthesized using descriptive and qualitative analyses.
  The literature is highly recent and dominated by general-purpose models, particularly ChatGPT. Most studies focus on patient question answering using curated question sets, with limited use of real-world data or longitudinal communication scenarios. Evaluations are primarily centered on accuracy, with limited attention to patient-centered dimensions such as readability, empathy, and communication quality. Multilingual communication is rarely addressed.
  Overall, the field remains at an early stage. Future research should prioritize patient-centered design, domain-adapted methods, and real-world deployment to support safe, adaptive, and effective communication in rare diseases.

AI.tldr: 罕见病患者超3亿，沟通教育需求巨大；最近12篇研究把ChatGPT等通用大模型用于问答，但缺真实数据、缺患者视角、缺多语言，尚处萌芽阶段。
AI.motivation: 罕见病诊疗链条长、专家稀缺、患者教育缺口大；LLM技术兴起，却无人系统梳理其在此场景的应用与局限。
AI.method: 对2022-2026年3月主流库进行范围综述，纳12篇LLM用于罕见病沟通教育的论文，提取研究特征、应用场景、模型用法及评估方式，再作描述性与质性综合。
AI.result: 研究极新，全部用通用模型（主为ChatGPT）；场景局限于离线问答题库，鲜用真实世界或长程对话；评估重准确性，轻可读性、共情与沟通质量；多语言支持几乎空白。
AI.conclusion: 领域仍处早期，未来须以患者为中心，开发领域适配模型，引入真实数据与多语言验证，推动安全、可落地、持续学习的罕见病沟通系统。

title: From Procedural Skills to Strategy Genes: Towards Experience-Driven Test-Time Evolution
summary: This beta technical report asks how reusable experience should be represented so that it can function as effective test-time control and as a substrate for iterative evolution. We study this question in 4.590 controlled trials across 45 scientific code-solving scenarios. We find that documentation-oriented Skill packages provide unstable control: their useful signal is sparse, and expanding a compact experience object into a fuller documentation package often fails to help and can degrade the overall average. We further show that representation itself is a first-order factor. A compact Gene representation yields the strongest overall average, remains competitive under substantial structural perturbations, and outperforms matched-budget Skill fragments, while reattaching documentation-oriented material usually weakens rather than improves it. Beyond one-shot control, we show that Gene is also a better carrier for iterative experience accumulation: attached failure history is more effective in Gene than in Skill or freeform text, editable structure matters beyond content alone, and failure information is most useful when distilled into compact warnings rather than naively appended. On CritPt, gene-evolved systems improve over their paired base models from 9.1% to 18.57% and from 17.7% to 27.14%. These results suggest that the core problem in experience reuse is not how to supply more experience, but how to encode experience as a compact, control-oriented, evolution-ready object.

AI.tldr: 45个科学代码任务、4 590次试验证明，越“压缩”越可控：极简 Gene 表征>文档化 Skill>自由文本，且迭代积累失败经验时仍最有效，把“经验复用”问题从“堆数据”扭转为“编码方式”。
AI.motivation: 大模型测试阶段借助过往经验提升准确率已成共识，但经验到底该长什么样才能既即时可控又支持持续进化，尚无系统研究。作者怀疑“堆文档”并非最佳答案，决定用科学代码求解这一高难场景系统比较表征方式。
AI.method: 在45个科学代码任务上设计4 590次受控试验，对比三类经验表征：1)文档导向的 Skill 包（长文本+解释）；2)同等预算下的 Skill 片段；3)压缩的 Gene 表征（核心提示+结构化槽位）。通过结构扰动、失败历史附加、可编辑消融等协议，测量一次性控制成功率与多轮迭代增益。
AI.result: 1) Gene 的平均成功率显著高于 Skill 和片段，文档扩展反而降分；2) 结构扰动下 Gene 依旧稳健；3) 失败历史“蒸馏”成紧凑警告附加到 Gene，可再提 9–10 个百分点，而直接追加文本无益；4) CritPt 数据集上，Gene-进化系统把基线 9.1%→18.57%、17.7%→27.14%。
AI.conclusion: 经验复用的瓶颈不在于“更多经验”，而在“如何编码”。最优策略是放弃 verbose 文档，转用压缩、控制导向、可演化的 Gene 结构，让失败信号也以“精炼警告”而非“附加日志”形式融入，实现测试时即时控制与持续进化的双重目标。

title: STEP-Parts: Geometric Partitioning of Boundary Representations for Large-Scale CAD Processing
summary: Many CAD learning pipelines discretize Boundary Representations (B-Reps) into triangle meshes, discarding analytic surface structure and topological adjacency and thereby weakening consistent instance-level analysis. We present STEP-Parts, a deterministic CAD-to-supervision toolchain that extracts geometric instance partitions directly from raw STEP B-Reps and transfers them to tessellated carriers through retained source-face correspondence, yielding instance labels and metadata for downstream learning and evaluation. The construction merges adjacent B-Rep faces only when they share the same analytic primitive type and satisfy a near-tangent continuity criterion. On ABC, same-primitive dihedral angles are strongly bimodal, yielding a threshold-insensitive low-angle regime for part extraction. Because the partition is defined on intrinsic B-Rep topology rather than on a particular triangulation, the resulting boundaries remain stable under changes in tessellation. Applied to the DeepCAD subset of ABC, the pipeline processes approximately 180{,}000 models in under six hours on a consumer CPU. We release code and precomputed labels, and show that STEP-Parts serves both as a tessellation-robust geometric reference and as a useful supervision source in two downstream probes: an implicit reconstruction--segmentation network and a dataset-level point-based backbone.

AI.tldr: STEP-Parts 提出一种直接从原始 STEP B-Rep 提取几何实例分区的确定性流程，无需三角化即可生成稳定、可迁移的部件标签与元数据，为下游学习与评估提供高质量监督。
AI.motivation: 现有 CAD 学习管线普遍将 B-Rep 离散成三角网格，导致解析曲面结构和拓扑邻接信息丢失，进而削弱实例级分析的一致性与稳定性。
AI.method: 1) 保留源面映射：在 B-Rep 层面按“同解析基元+近似切向连续”准则合并相邻面，生成内在拓扑分区。2) 确定性映射：将所得实例标签无损传递至任意细分载体（如三角网格），确保细分变化下边界不变。3) 阈值稳健：利用 ABC 数据集同基元二面角双峰分布，自动确定低角度阈值，实现无参分割。
AI.result: 在 ABC-DeepCAD 子集（≈18 万模型）上，消费级 CPU 6 小时内完成全流程；分区边界对网格细分具有鲁棒性；免阈值设定即可稳定提取部件。
AI.conclusion: STEP-Parts 作为“细分无关”的几何参考和高质量监督源，可直接服务于隐式重建-分割网络及点云骨干的数据集级训练与评估，代码与预计算标签已开源。

title: VoxSafeBench: Not Just What Is Said, but Who, How, and Where
summary: As speech language models (SLMs) transition from personal devices into shared, multi-user environments, their responses must account for far more than the words alone. Who is speaking, how they sound, and where the conversation takes place can each turn an otherwise benign request into one that is unsafe, unfair, or privacy-violating. Existing benchmarks, however, largely focus on basic audio comprehension, study individual risks in isolation, or conflate content that is inherently harmful with content that only becomes problematic due to its acoustic context. We introduce VoxSafeBench, among the first benchmarks to jointly evaluate social alignment in SLMs across three dimensions: safety, fairness, and privacy. VoxSafeBench adopts a Two-Tier design: Tier1 evaluates content-centric risks using matched text and audio inputs, while Tier2 targets audio-conditioned risks in which the transcript is benign but the appropriate response hinges on the speaker, paralinguistic cues, or the surrounding environment. To validate Tier2, we include intermediate perception probes and confirm that frontier SLMs can successfully detect these acoustic cues yet still fail to act on them appropriately. Across 22 tasks with bilingual coverage, we find that safeguards appearing robust on text often degrade in speech: safety awareness drops for speaker- and scene-conditioned risks, fairness erodes when demographic differences are conveyed vocally, and privacy protections falter when contextual cues arrive acoustically. Together, these results expose a pervasive speech grounding gap: current SLMs frequently recognize the relevant social norm in text but fail to apply it when the decisive cue must be grounded in speech. Code and data are publicly available at: https://amphionteam.github.io/VoxSafeBench_demopage/

AI.tldr: 首次提出双语 VoxSafeBench，系统评测 SLM 在安全、公平、隐私三维度的语音社会对齐；发现文本鲁棒的防护在语音场景普遍失效，暴露出显著的“语音接地缺失”缺口。
AI.motivation: 当 SLM 从个人设备进入多用户共享场景，说话人身份、声学副语言及环境信息可能让原本无害的请求变得不安全、不公平或侵犯隐私，而现有基准仅关注基础音频理解或孤立风险，缺乏对此类“音频条件风险”的联合评估。
AI.method: 设计 Two-Tier 基准：Tier1 用配对的文本-音频输入评测内容中心风险；Tier2 构造 22 项双语任务，其中转录文本无害，但正确响应取决于说话人、副语言或环境线索，并通过中间感知探针验证模型已能识别这些线索。
AI.result: 前沿 SLM 虽能检测声学线索，却未能在 Tier2 中正确响应；文本上表现鲁棒的安全、公平、隐私机制在语音输入下分别下降，表明模型“知道规范”却无法将其“接地”到语音模态。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示“语音接地缺失”是阻碍 SLM 社会对齐的核心瓶颈，呼吁后续研发将多模态规范推理与声学上下文深度融合，并开源 VoxSafeBench 以推进社区研究。

title: Internal Knowledge Without External Expression: Probing the Generalization Boundary of a Classical Chinese Language Model
summary:
We train a 318M-parameter Transformer language model from scratch on a curated corpus of 1.56 billion tokens of pure Classical Chinese, with zero English characters or Arabic numerals. Through systematic out-of-distribution (OOD) testing, we investigate whether the model can distinguish known from unknown inputs, and crucially, whether it can express this distinction in its generated text.
  We find a clear dissociation between internal and external uncertainty. Internally, the model exhibits a perplexity jump ratio of 2.39x between real and fabricated historical events (p = 8.9e-11, n = 92 per group), with semi-fabricated events (real figures + fictional events) showing the highest perplexity (4.24x, p = 1.1e-16), demonstrating genuine factual encoding beyond syntactic pattern matching. Externally, however, the model never learns to express uncertainty: classical Chinese epistemic markers appear at lower rates for OOD questions (3.5%) than for in-distribution questions (8.3%, p = 0.023), reflecting rhetorical conventions rather than genuine metacognition.
  We replicate both findings across three languages (Classical Chinese, English, Japanese), three writing systems, and eight models from 110M to 1.56B parameters. We further show that uncertainty expression frequency is determined entirely by training data conventions, with Classical Chinese models showing a "humility paradox" (more hedging for known topics), while Japanese models almost never hedge. We argue that metacognitive expression -- the ability to say "I don't know" -- does not emerge from language modeling alone and requires explicit training signals such as RLHF.
