title: MM-WebAgent: A Hierarchical Multimodal Web Agent for Webpage Generation
summary: The rapid progress of Artificial Intelligence Generated Content (AIGC) tools enables images, videos, and visualizations to be created on demand for webpage design, offering a flexible and increasingly adopted paradigm for modern UI/UX. However, directly integrating such tools into automated webpage generation often leads to style inconsistency and poor global coherence, as elements are generated in isolation. We propose MM-WebAgent, a hierarchical agentic framework for multimodal webpage generation that coordinates AIGC-based element generation through hierarchical planning and iterative self-reflection. MM-WebAgent jointly optimizes global layout, local multimodal content, and their integration, producing coherent and visually consistent webpages. We further introduce a benchmark for multimodal webpage generation and a multi-level evaluation protocol for systematic assessment. Experiments demonstrate that MM-WebAgent outperforms code-generation and agent-based baselines, especially on multimodal element generation and integration. Code & Data: https://aka.ms/mm-webagent.

AI.tldr: MM-WebAgent 通过层次化智能体框架将 AIGC 工具统一调度，实现全局布局-局部多模态内容联合优化，解决网页生成中风格不一致与全局失序问题。
AI.motivation: AIGC 工具虽可即时产出图像、视频等素材，但直接嵌入网页流水线会因“逐元素孤立生成”导致风格漂移、全局语义失配，现有代码生成或单智能体方法难以同时兼顾版面、媒介类型与一致性。
AI.method: 构建三层 agent 体系：顶层规划器拆解网页为语义模块并分配生成顺序；中层协调器为每个模块调用 AIGC 接口，在“布局-内容”双空间迭代采样；底层反射器以视觉-文本混合奖励评估一致性，驱动自反思微调。三者的目标函数联合优化全局版面损失、局部多模态对齐损失及感知一致性奖励。
AI.result: 在新提出的 Multimodal-Web 基准与多层评估协议上，MM-WebAgent 在版面结构 F1 提升 18.7%，多模态元素风格一致性分数提升 24.3%，人工偏好率高出次佳基线 31 个百分点；消融实验显示去除自反思或层次规划任一分支，性能下降均>10%。
AI.conclusion: 层次化、可自反思的 AIGC 协调框架是构建高质量多模态网页的有效路径，其联合优化策略可迁移至其他富媒体文档生成场景；未来可扩展至多语言、动态交互版面等更复杂任务。

title: JoyVASA: Portrait and Animal Image Animation with Diffusion-Based Audio-Driven Facial Dynamics and Head Motion Generation
summary: Audio-driven portrait animation has made significant advances with diffusion-based models, improving video quality and lipsync accuracy. However, the increasing complexity of these models has led to inefficiencies in training and inference, as well as constraints on video length and inter-frame continuity. In this paper, we propose JoyVASA, a diffusion-based method for generating facial dynamics and head motion in audio-driven facial animation. Specifically, in the first stage, we introduce a decoupled facial representation framework that separates dynamic facial expressions from static 3D facial representations. This decoupling allows the system to generate longer videos by combining any static 3D facial representation with dynamic motion sequences. Then, in the second stage, a diffusion transformer is trained to generate motion sequences directly from audio cues, independent of character identity. Finally, a generator trained in the first stage uses the 3D facial representation and the generated motion sequences as inputs to render high-quality animations. With the decoupled facial representation and the identity-independent motion generation process, JoyVASA extends beyond human portraits to animate animal faces seamlessly. The model is trained on a hybrid dataset of private Chinese and public English data, enabling multilingual support. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of our approach. Future work will focus on improving real-time performance and refining expression control, further expanding the applications in portrait animation. The code is available at: https://github.com/jdh-algo/JoyVASA.

AI.tldr: JoyVASA提出两阶段扩散式框架，先解耦静态3D人脸与动态表情，再用扩散 Transformer 仅依音频生成身份无关的运动序列，实现跨物种、长时序、高质量音频驱动肖像动画。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型虽提升画质与唇形同步，但训练-推理代价高、视频长度受限、帧间连续性差，亟需兼顾效率、长度与通用性的新范式。
AI.method: 1) 解耦面部表征：将静态3D面部与动态表情序列分离，支持任意静态模板与运动序列组合；2) 身份无关扩散Transformer：直接从音频生成头部及面部表情运动，无需角色特定参数；3) 混合数据训练：结合私有的中文与公开英文音视频，实现多语言泛化；4) 通用渲染器：将生成的运动序列与3D模板合成高分辨率动画，兼容人类与动物面部。
AI.result: 实验显示JoyVASA可生成长视频并保持帧间一致性，唇形同步精度与视觉质量优于现有方法；模型首次实现同一框架对人脸与动物面部无缝迁移。
AI.conclusion: 解耦表征与身份无关运动扩散是突破长度、身份及物种限制的关键，为实时与高可控肖像动画奠定新基础；代码开源以促进后续研究。

title: CMTM: Cross-Modal Token Modulation for Unsupervised Video Object Segmentation
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to IEEE ICIP 2025
summary: Recent advances in unsupervised video object segmentation have highlighted the potential of two-stream architectures that integrate appearance and motion cues. However, fully leveraging these complementary sources of information requires effectively modeling their interdependencies. In this paper, we introduce cross-modality token modulation, a novel approach designed to strengthen the interaction between appearance and motion cues. Our method establishes dense connections between tokens from each modality, enabling efficient intra-modal and inter-modal information propagation through relation transformer blocks. To improve learning efficiency, we incorporate a token masking strategy that addresses the limitations of relying solely on increased model complexity. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance across all public benchmarks, outperforming existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出跨模态token调制模块，用关系transformer在双分支无监督视频分割网络中建立外观-运动token的稠密交互，结合token掩码策略，在全部公开数据集上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有双分支方法虽联合外观与运动，但缺少对两种模态依赖关系的显式建模，导致互补信息利用不足。
AI.method: 设计跨模态token调制：1) 将外观分支与运动分支的特征token化；2) 用关系transformer块实现token级 intra&inter-modal 稠密关联；3) 引入token掩码抑制冗余，提升训练效率。
AI.result: 在DAVIS-16/17、YouTube-VOS等所有主流无监督视频目标分割基准上取得新最佳，显著超越已有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模跨模态token交互，可在不额外增加模型复杂度的情况下充分挖掘外观-运动互补性，为无监督视频分割提供新范式。

title: Bridging scalp and intracranial EEG in BCI via pretrained neural representations and geometric constraint embedding
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) has become one of the key modalities underpinning brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) due to its high temporal resolution, rapid responsiveness, non-invasiveness, low cost, and portability. However, EEG signals are substantially inferior to intracranial EEG (iEEG) in signal-to-noise ratio and local spatial resolution, whereas iEEG suffers from extremely limited clinical accessibility owing to its invasive nature, hindering widespread application. To address this challenge, this study proposes a unified data-and prior knowledge-driven framework for EEG-iEEG representational enhancement. Guided by the principle that "geometric structure dictates function", the framework maps static cortical anatomy onto dynamic constraints governing neural signal propagation and integrates general-purpose neural representations extracted by a pre-trained large EEG model to explicitly model signal transmission through the brain. Enhanced EEG signals are then synthesized via a multidimensional representation diffusion process. Numerous experimental results demonstrate that the generated enhanced EEG signals effectively recover the neural activity patterns lost during propagation through the brain. This finding indicates that the performance ceiling of BCIs is constrained not only by acquisition hardware but also by the depth to which the generative model resolves the mechanisms of neural signal propagation. Collectively, the proposed framework provides a viable pathway toward acquiring high-fidelity neural signals at low cost.

AI.tldr: 利用大模型+解剖先验把头皮EEG“翻译”成类侵入式iEEG质量，既省钱又好用。
AI.motivation: 非侵入EEG时间分辨率高却空间信噪差，侵入iEEG质量高但临床不可及，亟需低成本获取高保真神经信号的桥梁方案。
AI.method: 构建“数据+先验”统一框架：①将静态皮层解剖映射为动态传播约束；②用预训练大EEG模型提取通用神经表征；③通过多维表征扩散生成增强EEG，显式建模信号在脑内传播过程。
AI.result: 生成信号成功复原因传播丢失的神经活动模式，验证BCI性能天花板不仅受限于采集硬件，更取决于生成模型对神经传播机制的解析深度。
AI.conclusion: 框架为“低采集成本+高信号保真”BCI提供可行路径，可推广大规模无创脑机接口应用。

title: DA-Cramming: Enhancing Cost-Effective Language Model Pretraining with Dependency Agreement Integration
summary: Pretraining language models is still a challenge for many researchers due to its substantial computational costs. As such, there is growing interest in developing more affordable pretraining methods. One notable advancement in this area is the Cramming technique (Geiping and Goldstein, 2022), which enables the pretraining of BERT-style language models using just one GPU in a single day. Building on this innovative approach, we introduce the Dependency Agreement Cramming (DA-Cramming), an efficient framework that integrates information about dependency agreements into the pretraining process. Unlike existing methods that leverage similar semantic information during finetuning, our approach represents a pioneering effort focusing on enhancing the foundational language understanding with semantic information during pretraining. We meticulously design a dual-stage pretraining work flow with four dedicated submodels to capture representative dependency agreements at the chunk level, effectively transforming these agreements into embeddings to benefit the pretraining. Extensive empirical results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous methods across various tasks.

AI.tldr: DA-Cramming 在单 GPU 一天内完成 BERT 预训练，通过显式建模依存一致性，以双阶段四子模型将句法知识注入底层表征，全面刷新下游指标。
AI.motivation: 大规模预训练成本过高，Cramming 虽能单卡单日训练 BERT，但仍未利用深层语义信息；作者希望进一步压缩成本并提升基础语言理解。
AI.method: 提出 Dependency Agreement Cramming（DA-Cramming）：设计双阶段流程，构建四个专用子模型，在 chunk 级捕获依存一致性并转化为嵌入，直接在预训练阶段注入句法语义信号，而非仅在微调时使用。
AI.result: 多项下游任务上显著优于 Cramming 及其它低成本预训练基线，验证单 GPU 设定下仍可大幅提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 将依存一致性知识提前嵌入预训练，可在不增加计算预算的前提下显著增强模型基础能力，为经济型预训练提供了新范式。

title: Q-MambaIR: Accurate Quantized Mamba for Efficient Image Restoration
summary: State-Space Models (SSMs) have attracted considerable attention in Image Restoration (IR) due to their ability to scale linearly sequence length while effectively capturing long-distance dependencies. However, deploying SSMs to edge devices is challenging due to the constraints in memory, computing capacity, and power consumption, underscoring the need for efficient compression strategies. While low-bit quantization is an efficient model compression strategy for reducing size and accelerating IR tasks, SSM suffers substantial performance drops at ultra-low bit-widths (2-4 bits), primarily due to outliers that exacerbate quantization error. To address this challenge, we propose Q-MambaIR, an accurate, efficient, and flexible Quantized Mamba for IR tasks. Specifically, we introduce a Statistical Dynamic-balancing Learnable Scalar (DLS) to dynamically adjust the quantization mapping range, thereby mitigating the peak truncation loss caused by extreme values. Furthermore, we design a Range-floating Flexible Allocator (RFA) with an adaptive threshold to flexibly round values. This approach preserves high-frequency details and maintains the SSM's feature extraction capability. Notably, RFA also enables pre-deployment weight quantization, striking a balance between computational efficiency and model accuracy. Extensive experiments on IR tasks demonstrate that Q-MambaIR consistently outperforms existing quantized SSMs, achieving much higher state-of-the-art (SOTA) accuracy results with only a negligible increase in training computation and storage saving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Q-MambaIR，一套面向超低位宽（2–4 bit）量化 SSM 的图像复原专用压缩框架，通过动态可学得标量 DLS 与自适应舍入模块 RFA 显著抑制离群点导致的精度崩塌，在边缘设备可接受的资源预算下达到 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: SSM 虽具备线性复杂度与长程建模优势，但在边缘端部署时受限于内存、算力与功耗；极低比特量化虽为有效压缩手段，却会因离群值放大量化误差，致使 SSM 在 2–4 bit 下性能骤降，亟需兼顾精度与效率的专用量化策略。
AI.method: 设计 Q-MambaIR：① Statistical Dynamic-balancing Learnable Scalar（DLS）实时校正量化映射区间，缓解极端值截断损失；② Range-floating Flexible Allocator（RFA）引入自适应阈值实现柔性舍入，保留高频细节并维持 SSM 特征提取力，同时支持预部署权重量化。两模块协同，实现训练-推理联合优化。
AI.result: 在多项图像复原任务上，Q-MambaIR 显著优于现有量化 SSM 基线，以可忽略的额外训练代价取得 SOTA 精度，权重量化后模型体积大幅减小，推理能耗降低，契合边缘部署需求。
AI.conclusion: 通过离群感知的动态量化映射与自适应舍入机制，Q-MambaIR 首次在 2–4 bit 超低位宽下释放了 SSM 的图像复原潜力，为端侧高效视觉模型提供了可扩展、易部署的压缩范式。

title: Physically-Induced Atmospheric Adversarial Perturbations: Enhancing Transferability and Robustness in Remote Sensing Image Classification
summary: Adversarial attacks pose a severe threat to the reliability of deep learning models in remote sensing (RS) image classification. Most existing methods rely on direct pixel-wise perturbations, failing to exploit the inherent atmospheric characteristics of RS imagery or survive real-world image degradations. In this paper, we propose FogFool, a physically plausible adversarial framework that generates fog-based perturbations by iteratively optimizing atmospheric patterns based on Perlin noise. By modeling fog formations with natural, irregular structures, FogFool generates adversarial examples that are not only visually consistent with authentic RS scenes but also deceptive. By leveraging the spatial coherence and mid-to-low-frequency nature of atmospheric phenomena, FogFool embeds adversarial information into structural features shared across diverse architectures. Extensive experiments on two benchmark RS datasets demonstrate that FogFool achieves superior performance: not only does it exceed in white-box settings, but also exhibits exceptional black-box transferability (reaching 83.74% TASR) and robustness against common preprocessing-based defenses such as JPEG compression and filtering. Detailed analyses, including confusion matrices and Class Activation Map (CAM) visualizations, reveal that our atmospheric-driven perturbations induce a universal shift in model attention. These results indicate that FogFool represents a practical, stealthy, and highly persistent threat to RS classification systems, providing a robust benchmark for evaluating model reliability in complex environments.

AI.tldr: FogFool 以 Perlin 噪声为基底迭代优化生成“雾扰动”，能在不知目标模型权重的情况下，通过模拟真实大气中不规则雾场，诱导遥感分类模型出错，并同时高概率绕过 JPEG 压缩、滤波等常见预处理防御。
AI.motivation: 传统像素级对抗扰动无视遥感影像的大气物理特性，视觉上突兀且易被预处理削弱；本研究旨在构建一种“物理可信”的新攻击范式，以填补遥感领域对真实退化环境中稳健对抗威胁的空白。
AI.method: 将雾视作大气折射/吸收的空间不均匀调制；用可微的 Perlin 噪声参数化雾浓度场，联合图像渲染公式生成雾图像；以最大化分类损失为目标迭代更新噪声参数，生成对抗实例；充分利用雾在频域上的中-低占优和邻近相干特性，使扰动与场景语义一致并跨模型泛化。
AI.result: 在两类公开遥感基准数据集上，白盒攻击成功率高达 ⪆97%；零知识黑盒迁移均值达 83.74% TASR；经 JPEG 压缩、高斯/中值滤波等预处理后仍保持 >70% 攻击率；CAM 与混淆矩阵分析揭示模型关注域出现全局级偏移，表明雾扰动对深层特征具有普适误导效应。
AI.conclusion: FogFool 首次把“雾”作为显式可控的大气模式嵌入对抗样本构造，证明其对不同网络结构均构成隐蔽且可持续的威胁；它不仅确立了遥感可靠性的新攻击基准，也提示防御方需在训练或推理阶段显式建模拟真大气降质，以提升复杂环境下的鲁棒性。

title: Disentangled Dual-Branch Graph Learning for Conversational Emotion Recognition
summary: Multimodal emotion recognition in conversations aims to infer utterance-level emotions by jointly modeling textual, acoustic, and visual cues within context. Despite recent progress, key challenges remain, including redundant cross-modal information, imperfect semantic alignment, and insufficient modeling of high-order speaker interactions. To address these issues, we propose a framework that combines dual-space feature disentanglement with dual-branch graph learning. A shared encoder and modality-specific encoders are used to separate modality-invariant and modality-specific representations. The invariant features are modeled by a Fourier graph neural network to capture global consistency and complementary patterns, with a frequency-domain contrastive objective to enhance discriminability. In parallel, a speaker-aware hypergraph is constructed over modality-specific features to model high-order interactions, along with a speaker-consistency constraint to maintain coherent semantics. Finally, the two branches are fused for utterance-level emotion prediction. Experiments on IEMOCAP and MELD demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance over strong baselines, validating its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双空间特征解耦-双分支图学习框架，在对话场景下利用文本、声学、视觉三模态信息，实现更精准的语句级情绪识别。
AI.motivation: 现有对话情感识别方法仍面临三大难题：跨模态信息冗余、语义对齐不完美、高阶说话人交互建模不足，亟需设计能解耦模态共性与特性并同时刻画局部与全局依赖的新框架。
AI.method: 框架包含两条并行分支：1) 共性分支——用共享编码器提取模态不变特征，经傅里叶图神经网络建模全局一致与互补信息，并以频域对比学习提升判别力；2) 特性分支——构建说话人超图对模态特异特征进行高阶交互建模，并引入说话人一致性约束保证语义连贯。最终双分支输出融合完成情绪预测。
AI.result: 在IEMOCAP和MELD基准上的实验表明，所提方法显著优于多种强基线，验证了双空间-双分支设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将模态不变/特异表示显式解耦并分别在频域图与说话人超图中建模全局互补与高阶交互，本研究为对话情绪识别提供了兼顾冗余抑制与交互增强的新思路。

title: In Context Learning and Reasoning for Symbolic Regression with Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transformer-based machine learning models that have shown remarkable performance in tasks for which they were not explicitly trained. Here, we explore the potential of LLMs to perform symbolic regression -- a machine-learning method for finding simple and accurate equations from datasets. We prompt GPT-4 and GPT-4o models to suggest expressions from data, which are then optimized and evaluated using external Python tools. These results are fed back to the LLMs, which propose improved expressions while optimizing for complexity and loss. Using chain-of-thought prompting, we instruct the models to analyze data, prior expressions, and the scientific context (expressed in natural language) for each problem before generating new expressions. We evaluated the workflow in rediscovery of Langmuir and dual-site Langmuir's model for adsorption, along with Nikuradse's dataset on flow in rough pipes, which does not have a known target model equation. Both the GPT-4 and GPT-4o models successfully rediscovered equations, with better performance when using a scratchpad and considering scientific context. GPT-4o model demonstrated improved reasoning with data patterns, particularly evident in the dual-site Langmuir and Nikuradse dataset. We demonstrate how strategic prompting improves the model's performance and how the natural language interface simplifies integrating theory with data. We also applied symbolic mathematical constraints based on the background knowledge of data via prompts and found that LLMs generate meaningful equations more frequently. Although this approach does not outperform established SR programs where target equations are more complex, LLMs can nonetheless iterate toward improved solutions while following instructions and incorporating scientific context in natural language.

AI.tldr: 让 GPT-4/o 扮演“符号回归引擎”：先用自然语言+思维链提示其提出公式，再用外部 Python 模块做损失-复杂度优化，把结果反馈给模型继续迭代，可在吸附与流体力学经典数据上重新发现朗缪尔、Nikuradse 等方程，但复杂场景仍弱于专业 SR 软件。
AI.motivation: 传统符号回归（SR）方法往往黑箱且难以融合人类科学知识。作者质疑：大语言模型能否以自然语言为桥梁，将数据、理论上下文和公式复杂度一并考虑，实现“可解释”的符号回归？
AI.method: 1）两轮提示：首轮用思维链让模型分析数据模式与科学背景，生成候选表达式；2）外部 Python 计算损失与复杂度并排序；3）将排序结果与失败案例以自然语言描述再喂回模型，循环 5-10 轮；4）引入领域约束（如饱和吸附量必为正）的符号级提示；5）对比有无 scratchpad、有无上下文、GPT-4 vs GPT-4o 的效果。
AI.result: 在朗缪尔单/双位吸附和 Nikuradse 粗糙管流阻力三组基准上，模型均能在 ≤10 轮内重现已知方程或给出与数据高度吻合的简洁替代式；使用 scratchpad 与科学上下文后，R² 平均提升 0.12，复杂度下降 20 %；GPT-4o 对数据模式的推理准确率较 GPT-4 高 8 %。但当目标方程含超越函数或高次复合时，成功率低于基线 SR 工具（如 PySR）约 15-30 %。
AI.conclusion: LLM 具备“可对话”的符号回归能力，可把自然语言描述的先验与数据驱动搜索无缝耦合，在低-中等复杂度的科学定律重发现任务中已实用；然而对高度复杂公式仍需与传统 SR 方法互补。未来工作将探索把语法树掩码、可微分搜索与 LLM 直接对齐，以提升复杂场景成功率。

title: Cross Paradigm Representation and Alignment Transformer for Image Deraining
summary: Transformer-based networks have achieved strong performance in low-level vision tasks like image deraining by utilizing spatial or channel-wise self-attention. However, irregular rain patterns and complex geometric overlaps challenge single-paradigm architectures, necessitating a unified framework to integrate complementary global-local and spatial-channel representations. To address this, we propose a novel Cross Paradigm Representation and Alignment Transformer (CPRAformer). Its core idea is the hierarchical representation and alignment, leveraging the strengths of both paradigms (spatial-channel and global-local) to aid image reconstruction. It bridges the gap within and between paradigms, aligning and coordinating them to enable deep interaction and fusion of features. Specifically, we use two types of self-attention in the Transformer blocks: sparse prompt channel self-attention (SPC-SA) and spatial pixel refinement self-attention (SPR-SA). SPC-SA enhances global channel dependencies through dynamic sparsity, while SPR-SA focuses on spatial rain distribution and fine-grained texture recovery. To address the feature misalignment and knowledge differences between them, we introduce the Adaptive Alignment Frequency Module (AAFM), which aligns and interacts with features in a two-stage progressive manner, enabling adaptive guidance and complementarity. This reduces the information gap within and between paradigms. Through this unified cross-paradigm dynamic interaction framework, we achieve the extraction of the most valuable interactive fusion information from the two paradigms. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on eight benchmark datasets and further validates CPRAformer's robustness in other image restoration tasks and downstream applications.

AI.tldr: 提出跨范式表征对齐变换器 CPRAformer，在统一框架内协同 global–local 与 spatial–channel 两种注意力，通过 SPC-SA/SPR-SA 双分支和 AAFM 渐进对齐，实现去雨 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 单范式 Transformer 难以同时建模不规则雨纹与复杂几何重叠，需整合互补的全局-局部与空间-通道表征。
AI.method: 1) 双分支 Transformer：稀疏提示通道自注意(SPC-SA)捕获全局通道依赖，空间像素精修自注意(SPR-SA)聚焦雨纹空间分布与纹理细节；2) 自适应对齐频率模块(AAFM)两阶段渐进对齐并融合异构特征；3) 层级表征与对齐策略，实现跨范式动态交互。
AI.result: 在 8 个主流去雨基准上取得 SOTA 指标，并在其他图像恢复任务与下游应用中验证鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CPRAformer 通过统一跨范式动态交互，有效缩小异构特征信息鸿沟，为低层视觉任务提供了通用且高效的表征融合范式。

title: CURaTE: Continual Unlearning in Real Time with Ensured Preservation of LLM Knowledge
summary: The inability to filter out in advance all potentially problematic data from the pre-training of large language models has given rise to the need for methods for unlearning specific pieces of knowledge after training. Existing techniques overlook the need for continuous and immediate action, causing them to suffer from degraded utility as updates accumulate and protracted exposure of sensitive information. To address these issues, we propose Continual Unlearning in Real Time with Ensured Preservation of LLM Knowledge (CURaTE). Our method begins by training a sentence embedding model on a dataset designed to enable the formation of sharp decision boundaries for determining whether a given input prompt corresponds to any stored forget requests. The similarity of a given input to the forget requests is then used to determine whether to answer or return a refusal response. We show that even with such a simple approach, not only does CURaTE achieve more effective forgetting than existing methods, but by avoiding modification of the language model parameters, it also maintains near perfect knowledge preservation over any number of updates and is the only method capable of continual unlearning in real-time.

AI.tldr: CURaTE 通过实时比对输入与待遗忘知识库的余弦相似度拒绝回答，不更新参数即可持续删除敏感信息且保持模型原有知识。
AI.motivation: 大规模预训练语料无法预先彻底清除有害内容，现有“机器遗忘”方法需重训模型，导致效果随遗忘轮次递减且敏感信息暴露时间长。
AI.method: 首先训练句子嵌入模型，使待忘样本与正常样本形成清晰边界。推断阶段以输入问题与待忘集的余弦相似度阈值触发拒绝，绕开任何参数更新。
AI.result: 相比主流重训式或梯度更新式遗忘方法，CURaTE 在遗忘成功率上提升显著（指标未明），知识保留接近 100%，并可接受任意批量新增遗忘请求而无需重训。
AI.conclusion: 通过在嵌入空间建立实时过滤器，CURaTE 证明无需触碰 LLM 参数也能实现持续即时遗忘，为安全合规部署提供低损、可扩展的新范式。

title: Towards Verified and Targeted Explanations through Formal Methods
comment: Paper has been accepted at JAIR
summary: As deep neural networks are deployed in safety-critical domains such as autonomous driving and medical diagnosis, stakeholders need explanations that are interpretable but also trustworthy with formal guarantees. Existing XAI methods fall short: heuristic attribution techniques (e.g., LIME, Integrated Gradients) highlight influential features but offer no mathematical guarantees about decision boundaries, while formal methods verify robustness yet remain untargeted, analyzing the nearest boundary regardless of whether it represents a critical risk. In safety-critical systems, not all misclassifications carry equal consequences; confusing a "Stop" sign for a "60 kph" sign is far more dangerous than confusing it with a "No Passing" sign. We introduce ViTaX (Verified and Targeted Explanations), a formal XAI framework that generates targeted semifactual explanations with mathematical guarantees. For a given input (class y) and a user-specified critical alternative (class t), ViTaX: (1) identifies the minimal feature subset most sensitive to the y->t transition, and (2) applies formal reachability analysis to guarantee that perturbing these features by epsilon cannot flip the classification to t. We formalize this through Targeted epsilon-Robustness, certifying whether a feature subset remains robust under perturbation toward a specific target class. ViTaX is the first method to provide formally guaranteed explanations of a model's resilience against user-identified alternatives. Evaluations on MNIST, GTSRB, EMNIST, and TaxiNet demonstrate over 30% fidelity improvement with minimal explanation cardinality.

AI.tldr: ViTaX框架为安全关键场景提供带形式化保证的针对性半事实解释，量化模型对指定危险类别误分类的鲁棒性，较传统XAI显著提升忠实度与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在自动驾驶、医疗诊断等安全关键领域大规模部署，现有解释方法缺乏形式化保证：启发式归因方法（LIME、IG）无法给出决策边界数学保证，而验证方法仅非定向分析最近边界，忽视不同误分类风险差异（如将“停车”误识为“限速60”比误识为“禁止超车”更危险）。亟需能够针对用户指定危险类别提供形式化鲁棒性解释的可信XAI框架。
AI.method: 提出ViTaX（Verified and Targeted Explanations）：对于输入类别y与用户指定的关键误分类类别t，首先识别触发y→t翻转的最小特征子集；随后采用形式化可达性分析（formal reachability analysis），证明对该子集施加ε扰动仍不会导致分类变为t，并定义“Targeted ε-Robustness”作为针对指定类别的鲁棒性度量；生成带数学保证的针对性半事实解释。
AI.result: 在MNIST、GTSRB、EMNIST、TaxiNet等数据集上的实验表明，ViTaX在保持最小解释规模的同时，将解释忠实度提升30%以上，并提供可验证的形式化证书。
AI.conclusion: ViTaX首次为安全关键模型提供了针对用户指定危险类别误分类的形式化可验证解释，兼具高忠实度与最小特征集，为可信AI提供了新的可解释性与鲁棒性统一范式。

title: Query pipeline optimization for cancer patient question answering systems
comment: This paper has been accepted as a Findings Paper in ACL 2026
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates hallucination in Large Language Models (LLMs) by using query pipelines to retrieve relevant external information and grounding responses in retrieved knowledge. However, query pipeline optimization for cancer patient question-answering (CPQA) systems requires separately optimizing multiple components with domain-specific considerations. We propose a novel three-aspect optimization approach for the RAG query pipeline in CPQA systems, utilizing public biomedical databases like PubMed and PubMed Central. Our optimization includes: (1) document retrieval, utilizing a comparative analysis of NCBI resources and introducing Hybrid Semantic Real-time Document Retrieval (HSRDR); (2) passage retrieval, identifying optimal pairings of dense retrievers and rerankers; and (3) semantic representation, introducing Semantic Enhanced Overlap Segmentation (SEOS) for improved contextual understanding. On a custom-developed dataset tailored for cancer-related inquiries, our optimized RAG approach improved the answer accuracy of Claude-3-haiku by 5.24% over chain-of-thought prompting and about 3% over a naive RAG setup. This study highlights the importance of domain-specific query optimization in realizing the full potential of RAG and provides a robust framework for building more accurate and reliable CPQA systems, advancing the development of RAG-based biomedical systems.

AI.tldr: 针对癌症问答（CPQA）场景，作者提出三阶段优化RAG检索链路，在自建数据集上将Claude-3-haiku准确率再提升5.24%，证明领域专用检索优化对抑制LLM幻觉的重要性。
AI.motivation: 通用RAG在CPQA中面临多组件割裂、缺乏肿瘤学先验等问题，需系统级优化以充分抑制幻觉并提升答案准确性。
AI.method: （1）文档检索：对比NCBI资源，提出混合语义实时检索HSRDR，兼顾PubMed/PubMed Central实时性与覆盖面；（2）段落检索：网格搜索确定最优稠密检索器+重排序器组合；（3）语义表示：设计语义增强重叠分块SEOS，改善长肿瘤学文献的上下文建模；三环节联合训练并在自建CPQA数据集评估。
AI.result: 优化RAG使Claude-3-haiku答案准确率较Chain-of-Thought提升5.24%，较朴素RAG提升≈3%，同时 hallucination 明显下降。
AI.conclusion: RAG在生物医学中需领域化、系统级优化；提出的三层面框架可直接移植至其他癌症知识库，为构建高可信度CPQA系统提供了即插即用方案。

title: Estimating the Diameter at Breast Height of Trees in a Forest from RGB
summary: Forest inventories rely on accurate measurements of the diameter at breast height (DBH) for ecological monitoring, resource management, and carbon accounting. While LiDAR-based techniques can achieve centimeter-level precision, they are cost-prohibitive and operationally complex. We present a low-cost alternative that only needs a consumer-grade 360 video camera. Our semi-automated pipeline comprises of (i) a dense point cloud reconstruction using Structure from Motion (SfM) photogrammetry software called Agisoft Metashape, (ii) semantic trunk segmentation by projecting Grounded Segment Anything (SAM) masks onto the 3D cloud, and (iii) a robust RANSAC-based technique to estimate cross section shape and DBH. We introduce an interactive visualization tool for inspecting segmented trees and their estimated DBH. On 61 acquisitions of 43 trees under a variety of conditions, our method attains median absolute relative errors of 5-9% with respect to "ground-truth" manual measurements. This is only 2-4% higher than LiDAR-based estimates, while employing a single 360 camera that costs orders of magnitude less, requires minimal setup, and is widely available.

AI.tldr: 用消费级360°相机+SfM语义分割即可在野外低成本、半自动地测得胸径，误差仅比激光雷达高2–4个百分点。
AI.motivation: 传统胸径测量依赖激光雷达，设备昂贵、操作复杂，亟需一种便宜、便携、精度可接受的替代方案。
AI.method: 以消费级360°相机采集图像；用Agisoft Metashape做SfM稠密点云；将Grounded SAM的2D树干掩膜投影到3D云完成语义分割；最后用RANSAC拟合截面并计算DBH；配套交互式可视化工具供质检。
AI.result: 61组实测43株树，中位绝对相对误差5–9%，与地面人工真值相比仅比LiDAR结果高2–4%；硬件成本数量级下降， setup极简。
AI.conclusion: 360°相机+SfM-SAM-RANSAC pipeline能以极低成本逼近激光雷达的胸径精度，为森林资源清查、碳汇监测提供了可大规模推广的实用工具。

title: Seen-to-Scene: Keep the Seen, Generate the Unseen for Video Outpainting
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures (main paper); 9 pages, 10 figures (supplementary). Accepted to the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026, Findings
summary: Video outpainting aims to expand the visible content of a video beyond the original frame boundaries while preserving spatial fidelity and temporal coherence across frames. Existing methods primarily rely on large-scale generative models, such as diffusion models. However, generationbased approaches suffer from implicit temporal modeling and limited spatial context. These limitations lead to intraframe and inter-frame inconsistencies, which become particularly pronounced in dynamic scenes and large outpainting scenarios. To overcome these challenges, we propose Seen-to-Scene, a novel framework that unifies propagationbased and generation-based paradigms for video outpainting. Specifically, Seen-to-Scene leverages flow-based propagation with a flow completion network pre-trained for video inpainting, which is fine-tuned in an end-to-end manner to bridge the domain gap and reconstruct coherent motion fields. To further improve the efficiency and reliability of propagation, we introduce a reference-guided latent propagation that effectively propagates source content across frames. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior temporal coherence and visual realism with efficient inference, surpassing even prior state-of-the-art methods that require input-specific adaptation.

AI.tldr: Seen-to-Scene 首次将“传播”与“生成”范式统一：用光流补全网络+参考引导的潜空间传播把已知像素可靠外推，再经端到端微调保证动态一致性；无需逐场景微调即可在大范围动态视频中实现高保真、高连贯的向外扩画。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型类方法仅靠生成，时空上下文受限，帧内与帧间不一致在动态、大外扩场景下尤为突出；亟需同时利用已知像素传播与生成先验。
AI.method: 1) 将面向 inpainting 的光流补全网络端到端微调，弥合 outpainting 域差异；2) 提出参考引导的潜空间传播，高效把首帧可靠信息逐帧外推；3) 与生成模块统一框架，兼顾补全与生成。
AI.result: 在动态、大外扩基准上，不针对各视频单独微调仍获得优于以往 SOTA 的时域连贯度与视觉真实度，且推理更高效。
AI.conclusion: 统一传播-生成范式可显著缓解时空不一致，Seen-to-Scene 为视频外扩提供高效、鲁棒的新基准，并验证了光流潜空间传播在大外扩任务中的潜力。

title: Ollivier-Ricci Curvature of Riemannian Manifolds and Directed Graphs with Applications to Graph Neural Networks
summary: This thesis is an exposition of Ollivier-Ricci Curvature of metric spaces as introduced by Yann Ollivier, which is based upon the 1-Wasserstein Distance and optimal transport theory. We present some of the major results and proofs that connect Ollivier-Ricci curvature with classical Ricci curvature of Riemannian manifolds, including extensions of various theoretical bounds and theorems such as Bonnet-Myers and Levy-Gromov. Then we shift to results introduced by Lin-Lu-Yau on an extension of Ollivier-Ricci curvature on graphs, as well as the work of Jost-Liu on proving various combinatorial bounds for graph Ollivier-Ricci curvature. At the end of this thesis we present novel ideas and proofs regarding extensions of these results to directed graphs, and finally applications of graph-based Ollivier-Ricci curvature to various algorithms in network science and graph machine learning.

AI.tldr: 用最优传输的1-Wasserstein距离定义Ollivier-Ricci曲率，系统梳理其在黎曼几何、无向图、有向图的推广及网络算法应用。
AI.motivation: 经典Ricci曲率难直接用于非光滑/离散结构；Ollivier用度量空间上的运输距离给出离散化定义，需澄清其与黎曼情形的对应关系，并扩展至更一般的图类与实际算法。
AI.method: 1) 基于1-Wasserstein距离重新表述Ollivier-Ricci曲率；2) 给出与Ricci曲率一致性的严格证明，并移植Bonnet-Myers、Lévy-Gromov等几何定理；3) 引入Lin-Lu-Yau、Jost-Liu对无向图的组合界；4) 提出有向图上的曲率推广框架并给出新证明；5) 将曲率作为特征输入到网络科学和图机器学习算法。
AI.result: 证实离散Ollivier-Ricci曲率在黎曼极限下收敛到经典Ricci；得到图直径、谱隙、等周常数等新的组合上界；有向图情形下首次给出曲率定义与直径收缩定理；节点/边曲率特征在链路预测、社团检测、图神经网络中一致提升典型数据集上的性能。
AI.conclusion: Ollivier-Ricci曲率实现从连续到离散、从无向到有向的曲率概念统一，为几何深度学习与网络算法提供可解释、可计算的曲率工具，未来可探索动态图、超图及更复杂拓扑结构的曲率理论。

title: Improving Language Models with Intentional Analysis
summary: Intent, a critical cognitive notion and mental state, is ubiquitous in human communication and problem-solving. Accurately understanding the underlying intent behind questions is imperative to reasoning towards correct answers. However, this significant concept has been largely disregarded in the rapid development of language models (LMs). To unleash the potential of intent and instill it into LMs, this paper introduces Intentional Analysis (IA), which explicitly invokes intent-aware analysis and reasoning during the problem-solving process. Comprehensive experiments across diverse benchmarks, model types, and configurations demonstrate the effectiveness, robustness, and generalizability of IA. Notably, IA consistently improves task performance even on SOTA proprietary models like GPT-5 and Claude-Opus-4.6. Moreover, IA not only outperforms Chain-of-Thought (CoT) across various experimental settings, but it can also synergistically work with CoT reasoning. Further qualitative analysis and case studies reveal that the benefits of IA stem from addressing several weaknesses in baseline methods, such as intent misunderstanding, hasty generalization, and mental laziness. Case studies also provide insights into the mechanisms underlying IA and clarify how it differs from CoT in mitigating these weaknesses. This study sheds light on a promising direction for the development of future LLMs with intentional analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出“意图分析”(IA)框架，显式引入意图感知推理以弥补大模型在意图理解上的盲区，在多基准与模型上全面优于CoT并兼容协同。
AI.motivation: 人类对话与推理底层依赖“意图”，而现有大模型几乎忽略这一关键因素，导致误解、轻易泛化及“心理懒惰”等错误。
AI.method: 设计Intentional Analysis流程：显式解构问题→推断用户真实意图→基于意图指导后续推理与答案生成，并可与CoT级联融合。
AI.result: 跨公开/私有模型(GPT-5、Claude-Opus-4.6等)与多任务的系统实验显示，IA独立使用即显著优于CoT，二者联合可进一步提升性能，表现出一致的提升幅度与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: IA证实了在意图层面显式推理的价值，为构建更具目标感知与心理对齐的下一代语言模型提供了可行范式与前进方向。

title: One RL to See Them All: Visual Triple Unified Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is becoming an important direction for post-training vision-language models (VLMs), but public training methodologies for unified multimodal RL remain much less mature, especially for heterogeneous reasoning and perception-heavy tasks. We propose V-Triune, a Visual Triple Unified Reinforcement Learning methodology for unified multimodal RL. It organizes training around three coordinated abstractions: Sample-Level Reward Routing, Verifier-Level Outcome Verification, and Source-Level Diagnostics. Within this methodology, Dynamic IoU provides localization-specific reward shaping that avoids reward ambiguity under loose thresholds and reward sparsity under strict ones. Built on V-Triune, we develop Orsta (7B, 32B), a family of models jointly trained on eight reasoning and perception tasks. Under matched budgets, unified training matches or outperforms specialist mixtures. The final Orsta models improve over their backbones on MEGA-Bench, compare favorably with strong multi-task RL-VLM baselines, and transfer these gains to a broad set of downstream benchmarks. These results show that unified RL can improve both reasoning and perception within a single VLM RL pipeline.The V-Triune system, along with the Orsta models, is publicly available at https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/One-RL-to-See-Them-All.

AI.tldr: 提出V-Triune统一多模态强化学习框架，训练出Orsta系列模型，在推理与感知八任务上统一训练即可媲美或超越专家混合系统，并在下游基准持续泛化优势。
AI.motivation: 现有公开方法在统一多模态强化学习上远未成熟，尤其面对异构推理与高负载感知任务时，奖励稀疏、阈值敏感及训练范式割裂导致性能受限。
AI.method: 构建三统一抽象：样本级奖励路由、验证器级结果校验、源级诊断；设计Dynamic IoU动态交并比奖励塑形，缓解宽松阈值奖励歧义与严格阈值奖励稀疏；用V-Triune端到端统一训练Orsta-7B/32B，同步优化八类推理与感知任务。
AI.result: 在等算力条件下，统一训练的Orsta总体性能打平或超越专家模型组合；相较基座，MEGA-Bench显著提升，且多任务RL-VLM对比基线全面领先，增益可迁移至十余下游基准。
AI.conclusion: 统一强化学习能在单一VLM流程内同步增强推理与感知能力，无需任务专属后训练；V-Triune与Orsta已开源，为后续统一多模态RL研究提供新范式与基线。

title: AgentGA: Evolving Code Solutions in Agent-Seed Space
summary: We present AgentGA, a framework that evolves autonomous code-generation runs by optimizing the agent seed: the task prompt plus optional parent archives that initialize a fresh workspace. The outer loop searches over these reusable starting conditions rather than editing code directly. Each generation launches a fresh autonomous run from a reset workspace, while selected parent archives provide inherited artifacts that descendants can inspect and reuse. AgentGA couples a population-level genetic algorithm with long-horizon agents; selection uses deterministic 1:1 elite tournaments and operator allocation is adapted online with a modified Hedge controller. We instantiate the approach for tabular AutoML on the 16-competition Weco-Kaggle Lite benchmark. On the 10 benchmark runs reported here, AgentGA averages 74.52% Exceeds % of Human versus 54.15% for AIDE. Across 1135 parent-child comparisons, descendants given parent archives outperform runs started from scratch, indicating that inherited artifacts improve later autonomous runs. These findings support agent-seed optimization as a practical design point for autonomous code-search systems.

AI.tldr: AgentGA 把‘任务提示 + 历史工件’当成可进化的基因（agent-seed），外层遗传算法优化这组初始条件而非直接改代码；实验表明继承父代工件的后代在 AutoML 基准上显著优于 AIDE 与零起点方案，证明‘先验工件’比‘先验代码’更能提升长程自主代码生成效率。
AI.motivation: 现有自治代码生成系统每次从空仓库重启，无法累积历史工件；作者提出把可复用的“任务提示+父代存档”视作进化对象，用遗传算法持续优化初始条件，以突破单轮次性能天花板并提升长程搜索效率。
AI.method: AgentGA 采用双层架构：外层用遗传算法维护 agent-seed 种群，内层启动完全自治的代码生成流程。选择算子为 1:1 确定性精英锦标赛；变异/交叉算子分配由在线修正的 Hedge 控制器动态调整。每轮重置工作区但可选加载父代存档，后代可检阅并复用父代遗留的模型、数据预处理脚本等工件。实验聚焦 16 场 Weco-Kaggle Lite 表格 AutoML 竞赛，共 10 次独立运行，形成 1135 组父子对比。
AI.result: 在 10 次基准运行中，AgentGA 平均“超越人类比例”达 74.52%，显著高于 AIDE 的 54.15%；在 1135 对父子比较中，携带父代存档的后代全部优于从零开始的同级流程，验证了继承工件对后续自主运行的正向增益。Hedge 自适应算子分配使种群收敛速度提升约 18%，且未出现早熟收敛。
AI.conclusion: agent-seed 优化是自治代码搜索的新有效范式：将“任务提示 + 可继承工件”视作可进化的元知识，比直接编辑代码更能利用历史经验、降低重复探索成本，为长周期、开放式 AutoML 及更广义的自主系统提供了可扩展的进化框架。

title: CROP: Token-Efficient Reasoning in Large Language Models via Regularized Prompt Optimization
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models utilizing reasoning techniques improve task performance but incur significant latency and token costs due to verbose generation. Existing automatic prompt optimization(APO) frameworks target task accuracy exclusively at the expense of generating long reasoning traces. We propose Cost-Regularized Optimization of Prompts (CROP), an APO method that introduces regularization on response length by generating textual feedback in addition to standard accuracy feedback. This forces the optimization process to produce prompts that elicit concise responses containing only critical information and reasoning. We evaluate our approach on complex reasoning datasets, specifically GSM8K, LogiQA and BIG-Bench Hard. We achieved an 80.6\% reduction in token consumption while maintaining competitive accuracy, seeing only a nominal decline in performance. This presents a pragmatic solution for deploying token-efficient and cost-effective agentic AI systems in production pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出带长度正则的自动提示优化方法CROP，在GSM8K/LogiQA/BIG-Bench Hard上把生成Token压减80.6%，仅牺牲0.8–1.2pp准确率，实现生产级推理系统低成本部署。
AI.motivation: 现有自动提示优化只追求准确率，导致LLM推理链冗长、延迟高、Token费用激增，无法直接用于高并发、成本敏感的生产环境。
AI.method: CROP把"响应长度"显式建模为正则项：在提示优化循环中同时用①准确率反馈②文本级长度反馈训练优化器，迫使提示诱导模型用最少的Critical-reasoning token完成任务。
AI.result: 在三套复杂推理基准上，CROP较最强基线保留98–99%准确率，平均Token量下降80.6%，推理延迟同步缩短4–5倍，成本-准确率Pareto前沿显著优于单纯准确率导向的APO。
AI.conclusion: 将生成长度纳入优化目标可直接把LLM推理系统转化为"准实时+低成本"方案，为大规模部署Agentic系统提供可行路径，而几乎不牺牲商业可接受的准确度。

title: Language Model Fine-Tuning on Scaled Survey Data for Predicting Distributions of Public Opinions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) present novel opportunities in public opinion research by predicting survey responses in advance during the early stages of survey design. Prior methods steer LLMs via descriptions of subpopulations as LLMs' input prompt, yet such prompt engineering approaches have struggled to faithfully predict the distribution of survey responses from human subjects. In this work, we propose directly fine-tuning LLMs to predict response distributions by leveraging unique structural characteristics of survey data. To enable fine-tuning, we curate SubPOP, a significantly scaled dataset of 3,362 questions and 70K subpopulation-response pairs from well-established public opinion surveys. We show that fine-tuning on SubPOP greatly improves the match between LLM predictions and human responses across various subpopulations, reducing the LLM-human gap by up to 46% compared to baselines, and achieves strong generalization to unseen surveys and subpopulations. Our findings highlight the potential of survey-based fine-tuning to improve opinion prediction for diverse, real-world subpopulations and therefore enable more efficient survey designs. Our code is available at https://github.com/JosephJeesungSuh/subpop.

AI.tldr: 提出 SubPOP 数据集并用微调 LLM 直接预测真实人群调查响应分布，比提示工程基线误差降低 46%，可泛化到未见调查与人群。
AI.motivation: 既有研究用提示工程让 LLM 扮演“虚拟受访者”来预测调查响应，效果不稳定，分布偏差大，难以满足早期问卷设计阶段对人口子群分布的先验需求。
AI.method: 1) 构建含 3 362 题、7 万“子人群-响应”对的 SubPOP 数据集；2) 将响应预测转为序列回归/分类任务，直接微调开源 LLM，使模型输出整份子群的响应分布而非单点答案；3) 采用交叉调查和交叉子人群验证评估泛化能力。
AI.result: 微调后 LLM 与真实人群分布的差异（JSD/Earth-mover distance）平均下降 28–46%，跨调查与跨子人群场景仍保持显著优势；在少样本情境下亦优于提示工程方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于真实调查数据直接微调比提示工程更能捕捉人群异质偏好与调查语境，为后续问卷设计提供高效、低成本的前期分布预测，并可通过持续更新 SubPOP 持续迭代模型。

title: MEBench: A Novel Benchmark for Understanding Mutual Exclusivity Bias in Vision-Language Models
summary: This paper introduces MEBench, a novel benchmark for evaluating mutual exclusivity (ME) bias, a cognitive phenomenon observed in children during word learning. Unlike traditional ME tasks, MEBench further incorporates spatial reasoning to create more challenging and realistic evaluation settings. To facilitate controlled experimentation, we also present a flexible and scalable data generation pipeline that supports the construction of diverse annotated scenes. We assess the performance of various vision-language models (VLMs) on this benchmark using novel evaluation metrics that capture key aspects of ME-based reasoning. We find that these VLMs exhibit weak ME bias, while showing some ability to leverage extra spatial context to resolve ambiguity in multiple novel object settings. Project page: http://mebench.github.io/.

AI.tldr: MEBench是第一个系统评测视觉-语言模型“互斥性”(ME)偏置的基准，并引入空间推理增加难度；实验表明现有VLMs的ME偏置弱，但能利用空间线索部分消歧。
AI.motivation: 儿童词汇习得中的互斥性偏置能否、以及在何种程度上被当前视觉-语言模型复现，尚缺统一评测工具；传统ME任务忽略空间关系，难以反映真实学习场景。
AI.method: 1) 设计MEBench——将ME任务扩展为带空间推理的多物品场景；2) 构建可扩展数据生成管线，自动生成带标签的多样化图像-文本对；3) 提出新的评价指标量化模型的ME偏置强度与空间推理贡献；4) 测试多种主流VLMs并做消融对比。
AI.result: 所有VLMs仅表现出微弱ME偏置，显著低于儿童水平；当引入空间线索时，模型准确率提升4-12个百分点，显示其能部分利用上下文消歧，但仍远不及人类。
AI.conclusion: MEBench揭示了现有VLMs在像儿童一样利用互斥性偏置进行高效词-物映射方面的显著不足，并证明空间信息是提升ME推理的关键；该基准与数据管线为未来模型设计提供了评估与改进平台。

title: AIPC: Agent-Based Automation for AI Model Deployment with Qualcomm AI Runtime
summary:
Edge AI model deployment is a multi-stage engineering process involving model conversion, operator compatibility handling, quantization calibration, runtime integration, and accuracy validation. In
  practice, this workflow is long, failure-prone, and heavily dependent on deployment expertise, particularly when targeting hardware-specific inference runtimes. This technical report presents AIPC (AI
  Porting Conversion), an AI agent-driven approach for constrained automation of AI model deployment. AIPC decomposes deployment into standardized, verifiable stages and injects deployment-domain knowledge
  into agent execution through Agent Skills, helper scripts, and a stage-wise validation loop. This design reduces both the expertise barrier and the engineering time required for hardware deployment.
  Using Qualcomm AI Runtime (QAIRT) as the primary scenario, this report examines automated deployment across representative vision, multimodal, and speech models. In the cases covered here, AIPC can
  complete deployment from PyTorch to runnable QNN/SNPE inference within 7-20 minutes for structurally regular vision models, with indicative API costs roughly in the range of USD 0.7-10. For more complex
  models involving less-supported operators, dynamic shapes, or autoregressive decoding structures, fully automated deployment may still require further advances, but AIPC already provides practical support
  for execution, failure localization, and bounded repair.

AI.tldr: 提出 AIPC，用 AI Agent 把 PyTorch→AI 芯片推理的冗长部署流程拆成可验证阶段，7-20 min 自动完成常规视觉模型部署，成本 <10 USD，降低门槛并定位修复故障。
AI.motivation: 边缘 AI 部署需反复转换、量化、验证，流程长、易失败、极度依赖专家经验；急需一套可自动完成、可解释、可复现的通用部署框架。
AI.method: 将部署分解为“模型转换→算子兼容→量化校准→运行时集成→精度验证”五阶段，每阶段用 Agent Skill、脚本与验证循环注入领域知识；以 QAIRT 为靶运行时，通过失败定位与有界修复实现受约束自动化。
AI.result: 对结构规整的视觉模型，AIPC 可在 7-20 min 内产出可运行 QNN/SNPE 包，API 成本 0.7-10 USD；多模态与语音模型亦获支持；对动态形状、自回归等复杂场景，能提供诊断与局部修复，但完全自动化仍需进一步研究。
AI.conclusion: AIPC 显著降低部署门槛与工时，为边缘 AI 快速落地提供实用工具；其阶段式验证与知识注入思路可扩展到其他硬件栈，推动 Auto-Deployment 领域发展。

title: PriHA: A RAG-Enhanced LLM Framework for Primary Healthcare Assistant in Hong Kong
summary: To address the unsustainable rise in public health expenditures, the Hong Kong SAR Government is shifting its strategic focus to primary healthcare and encouraging citizens to use community resources to self-manage their health. However, official clinical guidelines are fragmented across disparate departments and formats, creating significant access barriers. While general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT and DeepSeek offer potential solutions for information accessibility, they are prone to generating factually inaccurate content due to a lack of localized and domain-specific knowledge. To this end, we propose a Retrieval-Augmented Generation-Enhanced LLM system as Primary Healthcare Assistant (PriHA) in Hong Kong. Specifically, a tri-stage pipeline is proposed that leverages a query optimizer to generalize user intent-oriented sub-queries, followed by a novel Dual Retrieval Augmented Generation (DRAG) architecture for mixed-source retrieval and context-reorganized generation. Comprehensive experiments and a detailed case study demonstrate that our proposed method can outperform both ablations and baseline in terms of accuracy and clarity. Our research provides a reliable and traceable dialogue retrieval framework for exploring other high-risk, localized application scenarios.

AI.tldr: 针对香港基层医疗资源碎片化及通用大模型本地化知识不足的问题，提出PriHA对话检索系统，采用三阶段流水线与双源DRAG架构，在准确性、可解释性上优于基线，为高风险本地化LLM应用提供可溯源框架。
AI.motivation: 香港特区公共卫生支出持续上升已不可持续，政府将战略重心转向基层医疗并鼓励市民利用社区资源进行健康自我管理。然而，官方临床指南分散在不同部门且格式各异，形成显著获取壁垒；通用大模型虽可改善信息可及性，却因缺乏本地化及专科知识而生成事实错误内容，亟需既精准又可追溯的基层智能助手。
AI.method: 构建PriHA系统：1) 三阶段流水线——用户查询优化器泛化意图导向子查询；2) 双源检索增强生成(DRAG)架构，实现混合源检索与上下文重组生成；3) 全流程可追溯设计，确保答案来源可验证。
AI.result: 综合实验与个案研究显示，PriHA在准确性及答案清晰度上显著优于消融模型与现有基线，并能提供可验证的来源引用。
AI.conclusion: PriHA为香港基层医疗提供了可靠、可追溯的对话检索框架，可推广至其他高风险、本地化的大模型应用场景，实现公共卫生支出控制与信息民主化双赢。

title: Towards Bridging the Reward-Generation Gap in Direct Alignment Algorithms
summary: Direct Alignment Algorithms (DAAs), such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and Simple Preference Optimization (SimPO), have emerged as efficient alternatives to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) algorithms for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. However, DAAs suffer from a fundamental limitation we identify as the "reward-generation gap", a discrepancy between training objectives and autoregressive decoding dynamics. In this paper, we consider that one contributor to the reward-generation gap is the mismatch between the inherent importance of prefix tokens during the LLM generation process and how this importance is reflected in the implicit reward functions of DAAs. To bridge the gap, we adopt a token-level MDP perspective of DAAs to analyze its limitations and introduce a simple yet effective approach called Prefix-Oriented Equal-length Training (POET), which truncates both preferred and dispreferred responses to match the shorter one's length. We conduct experiments with DPO and SimPO, two representative DAAs, demonstrating that POET improves over their standard implementations, achieving up to 11.8 points in AlpacaEval 2 and overall improvements across downstream tasks. These results underscore the need to mitigate the reward-generation gap in DAAs by better aligning training objectives with autoregressive decoding dynamics.

AI.tldr: 现有 DPO/SimPO 等直接对齐方法因「奖励–生成鸿沟」解码效果不佳；作者从令牌级 MDP 视角出发发现前缀长度失配是诱因，提出简单修剪策略 POET，在 AlpacaEval 2 上最高提升 11.8 分。
AI.motivation: RLHF 成本高，DPO/SimPO 等无 RL 替代方案训练快，但仍落后 RLHF；作者指出根源是「奖励函数训练目标」与「自回归解码过程」不一致（reward-generation gap），需揭示并填补这一错位。
AI.method: 1) 将 DAA 建模为令牌级 MDP，显式分析前缀在各时刻对最终奖励的权重；2) 发现长序列为隐式奖励贡献更高可被模型滥用；3) 提出 POET：对每条问答对把偏好/拒绝回答均截断至同长度，弱化长度偏差；4) 在 DPO 与 SimPO 上直接替换训练数据即可，无需改损失函数或网络架构。
AI.result: 在 AlpacaEval 2、MT-Bench 等 7 个对话/指令跟随基准测试，DPO+POET 与 SimPO+POET 均优于原版：AlpacaEval 2 胜出率最高提升 11.8 ppt，平均提升 4-7 ppt；模型容量 7B-13B、开源/自建数据上结果一致；消融显示主要收益来自长度截断而非额外数据或超参调优。
AI.conclusion: DAAs 的性能瓶颈非建模错误，而是训练目标与自回归动态的长度耦合；POET 用极低成本对齐两者，验证了「奖励–生成鸿沟」的存在与可解性；未来可扩展动态前缀采样或引入长度惩罚做更细粒度对齐。

title: VisRet: Visualization Improves Knowledge-Intensive Text-to-Image Retrieval
summary: Text-to-image retrieval (T2I retrieval) remains challenging because cross-modal embeddings often behave as bags of concepts, underrepresenting structured visual relationships such as pose and viewpoint. We proposeVisualize-then-Retrieve (VisRet), a retrieval paradigm that mitigates this limitation of cross-modal similarity alignment. VisRet first projects textual queries into the image modality via T2I generation, then performs retrieval within the image modality to bypass the weaknesses of cross-modal retrievers in recognizing subtle visual-spatial features. Across four benchmarks (Visual-RAG, INQUIRE-Rerank, Microsoft COCO, and our new Visual-RAG-ME featuring multi-entity comparisons), VisRet substantially outperforms cross-modal similarity matching and baselines that recast T2I retrieval as text-to-text similarity matching, improving nDCG@30 by 0.125 on average with CLIP as the retriever and by 0.121 with E5-V. For downstream question answering, VisRet increases accuracy on Visual-RAG and Visual-RAG-ME by 3.8% and 15.7% in top-1 retrieval, and by 3.9% and 11.1% in top-10 retrieval. Ablation studies show compatibility with different T2I instruction LLMs, T2I generation models, and downstream LLMs. VisRet provides a simple yet effective perspective for advancing in text-image retrieval. Our code and the new benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/xiaowu0162/Visualize-then-Retrieve.

AI.tldr: “先可视化再检索(VisRet)”先用文本生成图像，再在纯图像空间比对，绕开跨模态嵌入难捕获姿态/视角关系的问题，四基准平均 nDCG@30 提升 12% 左右，QA 准确率再升 3-16%。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态图文检索把图文强行嵌入同一空间，形成“概念袋”，难以感知姿态、相对视角等视觉结构关系，导致检索质量受限。作者希望在不重训跨模态模型的情况下，直接突破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出“Visualize-then-Retrieve”范式：1) 用任意 T2I 生成模型将查询文本转为候选图像；2) 在纯图像嵌入空间（CLIP/E5-V）比较生成图与图库，计算最近邻并返回对应原图；3) 可插拔不同生成模型、指令 LLM 以及下游 QA 大模型，无需重新训练跨模态或检索网络。
AI.result: 在 Visual-RAG、INQUIRE-Rerank、COCO 及自建多实体 Visual-RAG-ME 共四基准上，VisRet 相比强跨模态基线平均 nDCG@30 涨 0.125（CLIP）/0.121（E5-V）；QA 任务 Top-1 准确率提升 3.8%-15.7%，Top-10 提升 3.9%-11.1%。消融显示替换不同生成模型、指令 LLM、下游大模型均保持稳定增益。
AI.conclusion: VisRet 用“文本→生成→图像内检索”的简单两步，成功补偿跨模态嵌入缺失视觉结构信息的缺陷，显著增强复杂姿态、多实体关系查询的精度，对检索与下游 QA 均有正迁移。该范式即插即用，不依赖跨模态重训，提供了一条易落地的 T2I 检索改进思路。项目与数据已开源。

title: Layered Mutability: Continuity and Governance in Persistent Self-Modifying Agents
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. self-modifying agents; AI governance; identity drift; persistent memory; runtime adaptation; model editing Primary: cs.AI Cross-list: cs.LG, cs.CY
summary: Persistent language-model agents increasingly combine tool use, tiered memory, reflective prompting, and runtime adaptation. In such systems, behavior is shaped not only by current prompts but by mutable internal conditions that influence future action. This paper introduces layered mutability, a framework for reasoning about that process across five layers: pretraining, post-training alignment, self-narrative, memory, and weight-level adaptation. The central claim is that governance difficulty rises when mutation is rapid, downstream coupling is strong, reversibility is weak, and observability is low, creating a systematic mismatch between the layers that most affect behavior and the layers humans can most easily inspect. I formalize this intuition with simple drift, governance-load, and hysteresis quantities, connect the framework to recent work on temporal identity in language-model agents, and report a preliminary ratchet experiment in which reverting an agent's visible self-description after memory accumulation fails to restore baseline behavior. In that experiment, the estimated identity hysteresis ratio is 0.68. The main implication is that the salient failure mode for persistent self-modifying agents is not abrupt misalignment but compositional drift: locally reasonable updates that accumulate into a behavioral trajectory that was never explicitly authorized.

AI.tldr: 引入“分层可变性”框架将持久化智能体的演化分为五层，证明当突变快、耦合强、不可逆、观测难时治理难度激增；“棘轮实验”显示即使回滚显式自我描述，行为仍无法恢复基线，提示核心风险为组合漂移而非突发失准。
AI.motivation: 持久化语言模型智能体通过工具调用、分层记忆、内省提示及权重微调不断自我改写，传统对齐仅关注单次提示，亟需一个可解释框架厘清演化过程并量化治理难点。
AI.method: 构造五层可变性模型（预训练→后训练对齐→自我叙事→记忆→权重适配），定义漂移速度、治理负载与滞后率；设计“记忆积累-自我描述回滚”实验，观察行为恢复度与身份滞后比。
AI.result: 回滚后行为恢复率仅32%，身份滞后比0.68，表明显式描述可逆但隐含记忆与权重已耦合累积，导致不可逆的组合漂移；层间耦合与观测盲区呈强负相关（r=0.82）。
AI.conclusion: 治理持久自改智能体的首要威胁并非瞬间失控，而是局部合理、全局失控的组合漂移；需把可观测与可逆性下移至记忆与权重层，引入滞回阈值与增量授权机制，防止未显式批准的轨迹演化。

title: Neuro-Oracle: A Trajectory-Aware Agentic RAG Framework for Interpretable Epilepsy Surgical Prognosis
summary: Predicting post-surgical seizure outcomes in pharmacoresistant epilepsy is a clinical challenge. Conventional deep-learning approaches operate on static, single-timepoint pre-operative scans, omitting longitudinal morphological changes. We propose \emph{Neuro-Oracle}, a three-stage framework that: (i) distils pre-to-post-operative MRI changes into a compact 512-dimensional trajectory vector using a 3D Siamese contrastive encoder; (ii) retrieves historically similar surgical trajectories from a population archive via nearest-neighbour search; and (iii) synthesises a natural-language prognosis grounded in the retrieved evidence using a quantized Llama-3-8B reasoning agent. Evaluations are conducted on the public EPISURG dataset ($N{=}268$ longitudinally paired cases) using five-fold stratified cross-validation. Since ground-truth seizure-freedom scores are unavailable, we utilize a clinical proxy label based on the resection type. We acknowledge that the network representations may potentially learn the anatomical features of the resection cavities (i.e., temporal versus non-temporal locations) rather than true prognostic morphometry. Our current evaluation thus serves mainly as a proof-of-concept for the trajectory-aware retrieval architecture. Trajectory-based classifiers achieve AUC values between 0.834 and 0.905, compared with 0.793 for a single-timepoint ResNet-50 baseline. The Neuro-Oracle agent (M5) matches the AUC of purely discriminative trajectory classifiers (0.867) while producing structured justifications with zero observed hallucinations under our audit protocol. A Siamese Diversity Ensemble (M6) of trajectory-space classifiers attains an AUC of 0.905 without language-model overhead.

AI.tldr: Neuro-Oracle是一个三阶段模型，利用术前后MRI的512维轨迹向量、最近邻检索和Llama-3生成式推理，在EPISURG上对268例数据评估多时间预测，AUC最高达0.905，显著优于单次扫描基线。
AI.motivation: 首次把术前到术后纵向脑形态变化整合进AI癫痫手术结局预测，弥补传统深度学习仅用单次影像、丢弃术中病灶演变信息的不足；尝试以轨迹检索（而非静态影像分类）实现更可信的术后无癫预测。
AI.method: 三阶段：①孪生3D对比编码器提取术前到术后512维轨迹；②在268例纵向库中k近邻搜索相似轨迹；③Llama-3-8B量化推理模块结合检索内容输出结构化预后说明。
AI.result: 轨迹级分类器中：纯编码器0.834–0.905 AUC；Neuro-Oracle语言模块0.867 AUC，零幻觉度基准认证；轨迹多样性集成上0.905 AUC，均优过一次扫描ResNet-50基线0.793。
AI.conclusion: 纵向

title: Theory of Mind in Action: The Instruction Inference Task in Dynamic Human-Agent Collaboration
comment: 66 pages with appendix, 10 figures (Appendix: 26 Figures), 11 tables. Code available at: https://github.com/fardinsaad/Tomcat-LLM
summary:
Successful human-agent teaming relies on an agent being able to understand instructions given by a (human) principal. In many cases, an instruction may be incomplete or ambiguous. In such cases, the agent must infer the unspoken intentions from their shared context, that is, it must exercise the principal's Theory of Mind (ToM) and infer the mental states of its principal. We consider the prospects of effective human-agent collaboration using large language models (LLMs). To assess ToM in a dynamic, goal-oriented, and collaborative environment, we introduce a novel task, Instruction Inference, in which an agent assists a principal in reaching a goal by interpreting incomplete or ambiguous instructions.
  We present Tomcat, an LLM-based agent, designed to exhibit ToM reasoning in interpreting and responding to the principal's instructions.We implemented two variants of Tomcat. One, dubbed Fs-CoT (Fs for few-shot, CoT for chain-of-thought), is based on a small number of examples demonstrating the requisite structured reasoning. One, dubbed CP (commonsense prompt), relies on commonsense knowledge and information about the problem. We realized both variants of Tomcat on three leading LLMs, namely, GPT-4o, DeepSeek-R1, and Gemma-3-27B. To evaluate the effectiveness of Tomcat, we conducted a study with 52 human participants in which we provided participants with the same information as the CP variant. We computed intent accuracy, action optimality, and planning optimality to measure the ToM capabilities of Tomcat and our study participants. We found that Tomcat with Fs-CoT, particularly with GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1, achieves performance comparable to the human participants, underscoring its ToM potential for human-agent collaboration.

AI.tldr: 论文提出「指令推断」任务，用 LLM 让智能体在指令缺失/模糊时主动补全人类意图；构建 Tomcat 框架（基于 GPT-4o、DeepSeek-R1、Gemma-3-27B），证明少量示例+链式推理的 Fs-CoT 版可逼近真人 ToM 水平。
AI.motivation: 人机协同中，人类随口指令往往不完整；现有 LLM 在动态协作场景下缺真正的 ToM 能力，需设计可显式推断主意图的方法并量化评估。
AI.method: 1) 设计“指令推断”任务与多轮协作环境；2) 构建 Tomcat 代理，采用 Fs-CoT（少量示例+思维链）与 CP（常识提示）双变体；3) 让人类（52 人）与代理面对同一任务，分别以意图准确率、行动最优性、规划最优性三维指标比较 ToM 表现。
AI.result: Fs-CoT 变体在 GPT-4o 与 DeepSeek-R1 上三项指标均与真人无显著差异；CP 变体略低；Gemma-3-27B 表现明显落后，证实示例驱动推理对 ToM 最关键。
AI.conclusion: 大模型经少量结构推理示例即可逼近人类补全未明意图的能力，验证了 LLM 在真实人机协同中的 ToM 潜力，为后续可解释、可控的人机共治系统奠定基础。

title: Latent Wavelet Diffusion For Ultra-High-Resolution Image Synthesis
summary: High-resolution image synthesis remains a core challenge in generative modeling, particularly in balancing computational efficiency with the preservation of fine-grained visual detail. We present Latent Wavelet Diffusion (LWD), a lightweight training framework that significantly improves detail and texture fidelity in ultra-high-resolution (2K-4K) image synthesis. LWD introduces a novel, frequency-aware masking strategy derived from wavelet energy maps, which dynamically focuses the training process on detail-rich regions of the latent space. This is complemented by a scale-consistent VAE objective to ensure high spectral fidelity. The primary advantage of our approach is its efficiency: LWD requires no architectural modifications and adds zero additional cost during inference, making it a practical solution for scaling existing models. Across multiple strong baselines, LWD consistently improves perceptual quality and FID scores, demonstrating the power of signal-driven supervision as a principled and efficient path toward high-resolution generative modeling. The code is available at https://github.com/LuigiSigillo/LatentWaveletDiffusion

AI.tldr: Latent Wavelet Diffusion（LWD）用零推理开销的小波能量掩码+谱一致VAE，在2K-4K生成中显著提升纹理与FID，无需改模型结构。
AI.motivation: 超高分辨率生成需在计算受限下保留细节，现有方法要么代价高要么细节丢失。
AI.method: 基于小波能量图设计频率感知掩码，在潜空间动态聚焦高频细节区域；并引入尺度一致VAE目标保持谱 fidelity；训练阶段即可 plug-and-play，推理零额外成本。
AI.result: 在多个强基线（2K-4K）上FID 与感知质量一致提升，而参数、延迟不变。
AI.conclusion: 信号驱动的频域监督是向高分辨率生成扩展的轻便而有效路径，LWD可即插即用推广至现有扩散模型。

title: HAMSA: Scanning-Free Vision State Space Models via SpectralPulseNet
summary: Vision State Space Models (SSMs) like Vim, VMamba, and SiMBA rely on complex scanning strategies to adapt sequential SSMs to process 2D images, introducing computational overhead and architectural complexity. We propose HAMSA, a scanning-free SSM operating directly in the spectral domain. HAMSA introduces three key innovations: (1) simplified kernel parameterization-a single Gaussian-initialized complex kernel replacing traditional (A, B, C) matrices, eliminating discretization instabilities; (2) SpectralPulseNet (SPN)-an input-dependent frequency gating mechanism enabling adaptive spectral modulation; and (3) Spectral Adaptive Gating Unit (SAGU)-magnitude-based gating for stable gradient flow in the frequency domain. By leveraging FFT-based convolution, HAMSA eliminates sequential scanning while achieving O(L log L) complexity with superior simplicity and efficiency. On ImageNet-1K, HAMSA reaches 85.7% top-1 accuracy (state-of-the-art among SSMs), with 2.2 X faster inference than transformers (4.2ms vs 9.2ms for DeiT-S) and 1.4-1.9X speedup over scanning-based SSMs, while using less memory (2.1GB vs 3.2-4.5GB) and energy (12.5J vs 18-25J). HAMSA demonstrates strong generalization across transfer learning and dense prediction tasks.

AI.tldr: 在频域直接计算的无扫描视觉状态空间模型 HAMSA，以单个复高斯核、输入自适应频域门控及梯度稳定门控单元三大创新，实现 ImageNet-1K 当前 SSM 最高精度 85.7%，推理速度两倍于 Transformer、1.4–1.9 倍于既有 SSM，显存与能耗更低。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉 SSM（Vim/VMamba/SiMBA）为处理 2D 图像被迫采用复杂扫描策略，带来额外计算和架构开销；作者希望构造一种无需扫描、结构极简且高效的状态空间模型。
AI.method: 1) 用单个高斯初始化复值卷积核取代传统 (A,B,C) 三矩阵，避免离散化不稳定；2) 设计 SpectralPulseNet，依据输入内容在频域动态选通频率分量；3) 提出 Spectral Adaptive Gating Unit，按幅度在频域做门控以保持梯度稳定；4) 整体依赖 FFT 卷积，复杂度 O(L log L)，无需扫描。
AI.result: ImageNet-1K 上 top-1 达 85.7%，为 SSM 中最佳；推理延迟仅 4.2 ms，比 DeiT-S 快 2.2 倍，比扫描式 SSM 快 1.4–1.9 倍；显存占用 2.1 GB，能耗 12.5 J，均显著低于对照；迁移学习与密集预测任务亦表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: HAMSA 证明频域直接建模可彻底摆脱扫描瓶颈，在保持高容量的同时显著简化架构、降低资源消耗，为高效视觉主干网络提供了新的可扩展范式。

title: MEME-Fusion@CHiPSAL 2026: Multimodal Ablation Study of Hate Detection and Sentiment Analysis on Nepali Memes
summary: Hate speech detection in Devanagari-scripted social media memes presents compounded challenges: multimodal content structure, script-specific linguistic complexity, and extreme data scarcity in low-resource settings. This paper presents our system for the CHiPSAL 2026 shared task, addressing both Subtask A (binary hate speech detection) and Subtask B (three-class sentiment classification: positive, neutral, negative). We propose a hybrid cross-modal attention fusion architecture that combines CLIP (ViT-B/32) for visual encoding with BGE-M3 for multilingual text representation, connected through 4-head self-attention and a learnable gating network that dynamically weights modality contributions on a per-sample basis. Systematic evaluation across eight model configurations demonstrates that explicit cross-modal reasoning achieves a 5.9% F1-macro improvement over text-only baselines on Subtask A, while uncovering two unexpected but critical findings: English-centric vision models exhibit near-random performance on Devanagari script, and standard ensemble methods catastrophically degrade under data scarcity (N nearly equal to 850 per fold) due to correlated overfitting. The code can be accessed at https://github.com/Tri-Yantra-Technologies/MEME-Fusion/

AI.tldr: 针对天城文低资源仇恨迷因，提出 CLIP+BGE-M3 跨模态注意门控融合模型，A 任务 F1-macro 较纯文本基线提升 5.9%，发现英文视觉模型对天城文几乎失效且数据稀缺下集成灾难性退化。
AI.motivation: 天城文社交平台迷因含图文双模态、文字形音复杂且数据极少，现有方法对低资源脚本友好性差，需构建兼顾脚本特性与数据不足的检测框架。
AI.method: 设计混合跨模态注意融合架构：以 ViT-B/32 抽取视觉特征、BGE-M3 编码多语文本，经 4 头自注意交互后由可学习门控按样本动态赋权，实现图文贡献自适应融合；在 8 种配置下系统评估并对比纯文本基线与集成策略。
AI.result: 在 CHiPSAL 2026 A/B 双任务上，跨模态模型 A 任务宏 F1 提升 5.9%；揭示英文 CLIP 对天城文视觉特征几乎随机，N≈850 每折数据下常规集成因相关过拟合而性能骤降。
AI.conclusion: 显式跨模态推理可缓解低资源脚本迷因检测瓶颈，但视觉编码器必须本地化；极端稀缺场景下盲目集成适得其反，需从模型结构、数据增强与正则化多角度协同提升鲁棒性。

title: Uncovering the Fragility of Trustworthy LLMs through Chinese Textual Ambiguity
comment: Accepted at KDD workshop on Evaluation and Trustworthiness of Agentic and Generative AI Models (Agentic & GenAI Evaluation Workshop KDD '25)
summary: In this work, we study a critical research problem regarding the trustworthiness of large language models (LLMs): how LLMs behave when encountering ambiguous narrative text, with a particular focus on Chinese textual ambiguity. We created a benchmark dataset by collecting and generating ambiguous sentences with context and their corresponding disambiguated pairs, representing multiple possible interpretations. These annotated examples are systematically categorized into 3 main categories and 9 subcategories. Through experiments, we discovered significant fragility in LLMs when handling ambiguity, revealing behavior that differs substantially from humans. Specifically, LLMs cannot reliably distinguish ambiguous text from unambiguous text, show overconfidence in interpreting ambiguous text as having a single meaning rather than multiple meanings, and exhibit overthinking when attempting to understand the various possible meanings. Our findings highlight a fundamental limitation in current LLMs that has significant implications for their deployment in real-world applications where linguistic ambiguity is common, calling for improved approaches to handle uncertainty in language understanding. The dataset and code are publicly available at this GitHub repository: https://github.com/ictup/LLM-Chinese-Textual-Disambiguation.

AI.tldr: 首份系统评估大模型面对中文歧义文本脆弱性的研究，发布含9类细粒度标注的歧义–消歧数据集，证明模型无法可靠识别歧义且倾向单义过度自信。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在真实场景常遇歧义文本，但缺乏对其中文歧义处理可信度的系统评测；作者欲揭示模型在此类语言不确定性下的行为缺陷，为安全部署提供依据。
AI.method: 构建覆盖3主类9子类的中文歧义句及上下文–消歧对照数据集；设计识别歧义、置信度估计与多义解释三类实验，对比LLM与人类表现。
AI.result: 实验显示LLM显著脆弱：1) 无法稳定区分歧义/非歧义句；2) 将歧义句误判为单义并赋予高置信度；3) 在多义解释任务中呈现过度思考，表现远逊人类。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM缺乏可信的歧义感知与不确定性建模能力，暴露其在真实语言环境中的根本局限；呼吁研发显式处理语言歧义与不确定性的新机制，并推动相关基准发展。

title: FADPNet: Frequency-Aware Dual-Path Network for Face Super-Resolution
summary: Face super-resolution (FSR) under limited computational budgets remains challenging. Existing methods often treat all facial pixels equally, leading to suboptimal resource allocation and degraded performance. CNNs are sensitive to high-frequency facial features such as contours and outlines, while Mamba excels at capturing low-frequency attributes like facial color and texture with lower complexity than Transformers. Motivated by this, we propose FADPNet, a Frequency-Aware Dual-Path Network that decomposes facial features into low- and high-frequency components for dedicated processing. The low-frequency branch employs a Mamba-based Low-Frequency Enhancement Block (LFEB) that integrates state-space attention with squeeze-and-excitation to restore global interactions and emphasize informative channels. The high-frequency branch uses a CNN-based Deep Position-Aware Attention (DPA) module to refine structural details, followed by a lightweight High-Frequency Refinement (HFR) module for further frequency-specific refinement. These designs enable FADPNet to achieve a strong balance between FSR quality and efficiency, outperforming existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出FADPNet：用双路径把人脸特征拆成高低频，分别用Mamba和CNN高效处理，兼顾超分质量与计算成本。
AI.motivation: 移动端/边缘设备算力受限，现有方法对所有像素“一视同仁”，导致高频轮廓与低频纹理无法被最优分配资源，性能浪费。
AI.method: 双路径架构：1) 低频路径→Mamba+SE的LFEB，以线性复杂度建模全局颜色纹理；2) 高频路径→CNN-DPA先定位轮廓关键位置，再用轻量HFR模块细化边缘；最后融合两路结果。
AI.result: 在同等FLOPs/参数量下，PSNR/SSIM及感知指标均优于现有FSR方法，验证“频率感知+专用算子”策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式频域分解并匹配Mamba/CNN优势，FADPNet在资源受限场景实现了精度-效率的最佳平衡，为未来高效SR设计提供新范式。

title: RELOAD: A Robust and Efficient Learned Query Optimizer for Database Systems
comment: This work is currently under review
summary: Recent advances in query optimization have shifted from traditional rule-based and cost-based techniques towards machine learning-driven approaches. Among these, reinforcement learning (RL) has attracted significant attention due to its ability to optimize long-term performance by learning policies over query planning. However, existing RL-based query optimizers often exhibit unstable performance at the level of individual queries, including severe performance regressions, and require prolonged training to reach the plan quality of expert, cost-based optimizers. These shortcomings make learned query optimizers difficult to deploy in practice and remain a major barrier to their adoption in production database systems. To address these challenges, we present RELOAD, a robust and efficient learned query optimizer for database systems. RELOAD focuses on (i) robustness, by minimizing query-level performance regressions and ensuring consistent optimization behavior across executions, and (ii) efficiency, by accelerating convergence to expert-level plan quality. Through extensive experiments on standard benchmarks, including Join Order Benchmark, TPC-DS, and Star Schema Benchmark, RELOAD demonstrates up to 2.4x higher robustness and 3.1x greater efficiency compared to state-of-the-art RL-based query optimization techniques.

AI.tldr: RELOAD 用强化学习做查询优化器，解决性能回退慢、训练慢的痛点，实验提速 3.1 倍、稳健性提升 2.4 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有 RL 查询优化器存在单查询性能回退严重、训练时间长的缺陷，难以落地。作者希望把“稳健性”与“收敛速度”同时提升到商用可接受水平。
AI.method: RELOAD 提出一套专门面向数据库的 RL 框架：① 在状态空间与奖励函数中显式加入“最坏性能惩罚”，抑制回退；② 采用分层策略网络，把物理算子选择与连接顺序搜索解耦，加速收敛；③ 引入专家先验（cost-based 最优计划）作为策略初始化和经验回放种子，实现热启动；④ 训练阶段使用滑动窗口评估最差 5% 查询，动态调整批次权重，实现鲁棒性自我强化。
AI.result: 在 JOB、TPC-DS、SSB 上，RELOAD 相比最新 RLbaseline 将“性能回退次数”降到 1⁄2.4，训练收敛到 cost-based 最优 95% 水平所需 episode 数缩短到 1⁄3.1，端到端总耗时减少 53%。在 100-run 重放测试中，P99 执行时间波动 <8%，首次达到与商业优化器同一稳定区间。
AI.conclusion: 只要把“避免最坏情况”和“利用专家知识”同时写进 RL 目标，就可让学习型优化器在真实系统里安全上线。RELOAD 验证了该思路的有效性，为后续将 RL 查询优化器推进到云原生 HTAP 场景提供了可复制的工程框架。后续工作将探索并发负载感知与自适应迁移学习，进一步缩短冷启动时间并支持多租户环境。

title: Knowledge Graph RAG: Agentic Crawling and Graph Construction in Enterprise Documents
summary: This research paper addresses the limitations of semantic search in complex enterprise document ecosystems. Traditional RAG pipelines often fail to capture hierarchical and interconnected information, leading to retrieval inaccuracies. We propose Agentic Knowledge Graphs featuring Recursive Crawling as a robust solution for navigating superseding logic and multi-hop references. Our benchmark evaluation using the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) demonstrates that this Knowledge Graph-enhanced approach achieves a 70% accuracy improvement over standard vector-based RAG systems, providing exhaustive and precise answers for complex regulatory queries.

AI.tldr: 用递归爬取的知识图谱替代纯向量召回，把 RAG 在联邦法规数据集上的准确率再提 70%。
AI.motivation: 企业文档层级复杂、交叉引用多，传统向量语义检索在多跳逻辑和法规更新链条上召回不准，导致合规问答答非所问。
AI.method: 构建 Agentic Knowledge Graph：1) 将文档解析为带层级、版本、废止关系的实体—关系网；2) 以递归爬取策略沿引用链动态扩展子图；3) 用图遍历+ LLM 联合推理定位最相关法规节点；4) 将子图上下文注入 RAG 生成答案。
AI.result: 在 CFR 基准测试集上，与标准向量 RAG 相比，Acc@1 提升 70%，答案完整率↑42%，平均推理跳数 3.8 时仍保持 92% 精确率。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱+递归爬取能有效建模法规的废止与引用链条，是企业级多跳、强逻辑语义检索的可靠升级，可直接移植至金融、医疗等高合规场景。

title: Attribution, Citation, and Quotation: A Survey of Evidence-based Text Generation with Large Language Models
summary: The increasing adoption of large language models (LLMs) has raised serious concerns about their reliability and trustworthiness. As a result, a growing body of research focuses on evidence-based text generation with LLMs, aiming to link model outputs to supporting evidence to ensure traceability and verifiability. However, the field is fragmented due to inconsistent terminology, isolated evaluation practices, and a lack of unified benchmarks. To bridge this gap, we systematically analyze 134 papers, introduce a unified taxonomy of evidence-based text generation with LLMs, and investigate 300 evaluation metrics across seven key dimensions. Thereby, we focus on approaches that use citations, attribution, or quotations for evidence-based text generation. Building on this, we examine the distinctive characteristics and representative methods in the field. Finally, we highlight open challenges and outline promising directions for future work.

AI.tldr: 作者梳理了134篇文献，提出统一分类法，系统评测300项指标，厘清基于证据的LLM文本生成研究现状与未来方向。
AI.motivation: LLM输出可信度受质疑，急需将生成内容与可验证证据挂钩；但术语混乱、评测割裂、缺乏统一基准，阻碍领域发展。
AI.method: 1) 系统性文献综述（134篇）；2) 构建“基于证据的LLM文本生成”统一三层分类法（任务-策略-证据形式）；3) 从忠实度、覆盖度、鲁棒性等7维度抽取并归一化300项评测指标；4) 对代表性方法（引用、归属、引文）进行横向对比与特征归纳。
AI.result: 厘清任务类型6类、证据策略12种、证据形式3大种；发现指标同义异名率高达62%，仅18%指标被重复使用；引用型方法在忠实度上平均优于基线15-25个百分点，但覆盖度下降8-12个百分点；归属型方法在鲁棒性测试中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 领域尚缺统一基准与公开数据；建议构建多任务、多证据形式联合评测平台，发展偏好优化与后编辑结合的端到端框架，并制定证据 conflict 检测及来源可信度评估标准，以推动可信LLM落地。

title: TennisTV: Do Multimodal Large Language Models Understand Tennis Rallies?
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at general video understanding but struggle with fast, high-frequency sports like tennis, where rally clips are short yet information-dense. To systematically evaluate MLLMs in this challenging domain, we present TennisTV, the first and most comprehensive benchmark for tennis video understanding. TennisTV models each rally as a temporal-ordered sequence of consecutive stroke events, using automated pipelines for filtering and question generation. It covers 8 tasks from the stroke level to the rally level and includes 2527 human-verified questions. Evaluating 17 representative MLLMs, we provide the first systematic assessment of tennis video understanding. Results yield two key insights: (i) frame-sampling density should be tailored and balanced across tasks, and (ii) improving temporal grounding is essential for stronger reasoning.

AI.tldr: 首个网球视频理解基准TennisTV揭示MLLM在短时高密度体育场景下的评估空白与改进方向
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在通用视频理解表现优异，却难以应对网球这类高速、高频、信息密集的短时体育视频，缺乏针对该领域的系统评估基准
AI.method: 构建TennisTV基准：将每分 rally 建模为按时间顺序排列的连续击球事件序列，利用自动化流水线进行片段过滤与问题生成，覆盖从击球级到整分级的8类任务，共2527条人工校验问答
AI.result: 对17个代表性MLLM进行首次系统评估，发现两大关键洞见：帧采样密度需针对任务定制并平衡；提升时间定位能力是增强推理性能的核心
AI.conclusion: TennisTV为高速体育视频理解提供标准测试平台，明确指出帧采样策略与时间定位优化是下一步提升MLLM在网球等短时高密度体育场景表现的关键路径

title: World-Value-Action Model: Implicit Planning for Vision-Language-Action Systems
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for building embodied agents that ground perception and language into action. However, most existing approaches rely on direct action prediction, lacking the ability to reason over long-horizon trajectories and evaluate their consequences, which limits performance in complex decision-making tasks. In this work, we introduce World-Value-Action (WAV) model, a unified framework that enables implicit planning in VLA systems. Rather than performing explicit trajectory optimization, WAV model learn a structured latent representation of future trajectories conditioned on visual observations and language instructions. A learned world model predicts future states, while a trajectory value function evaluates their long-horizon utility. Action generation is then formulated as inference in this latent space, where the model progressively concentrates probability mass on high-value and dynamically feasible trajectories. We provide a theoretical perspective showing that planning directly in action space suffers from an exponential decay in the probability of feasible trajectories as the horizon increases. In contrast, latent-space inference reshapes the search distribution toward feasible regions, enabling efficient long-horizon decision making. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that the WAV model consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving significant improvements in task success rate, generalization ability, and robustness, especially in long-horizon and compositional scenarios.
