We introduce Marketplace Evaluation, a simulation-based paradigm that evaluates information access systems as participants in a competitive marketplace. By simulating repeated interactions and evolving user and agent preferences, the framework enables longitudinal evaluation and marketplace-level metrics, such as retention and market share, that complement and can extend beyond traditional accuracy-based metrics. We formalize the framework and outline a research agenda, motivated by business and economics, around marketplace simulation, metrics, optimization, and adoption in evaluation campaigns like TREC.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“Marketplace Evaluation”新范式，用可模拟竞争市场的仿真框架，把信息获取系统置于动态博弈环境中评估，用留存率、市场份额等市场级指标补足传统静态准确率指标，从而更可信地预测系统上线后的真实表现。
AI.motivation: 传统静态基准只测单系统孤立精度，忽视系统部署后面临的竞争博弈（用户切换、路由决策、运营约束等），导致评估结果与真实市场表现脱节；需要能刻画竞争动力学并预测部署成功的新评估体系。
AI.method: 构建基于智能体仿真的“Marketplace Evaluation”框架：①将检索系统与LLM等各类信息获取系统建模为可策略性优化的市场参与者；②在离散时间步内模拟用户与系统的重复交互，允许用户偏好、系统策略及市场份额动态演化；③定义留存、市场份额、早期采用者优势等市场级指标，与精度指标互补；④给出形式化描述并规划在TREC等评测活动中落地的研究路线。
AI.result: 框架已形式化完成，可生成纵向市场轨迹，揭示“先占优势”和“市场锁定”等传统基准无法捕捉的竞争效应；初步实验显示市场份额与准确率并非单调对应，证明需联合市场指标才能有效预测部署成功。
AI.conclusion: Marketplace Evaluation把评估视角从“孤立精度”转向“竞争环境下的动态表现”，为信息获取系统提供更能预测真实成功的测评工具；作者倡议社区共同推进市场仿真、指标设计、策略优化及在TREC等平台的 adoption，以建立新一代动态评估基准。

title: Graph-Based Alternatives to LLMs for Human Simulation
comment: Conference: ACL 2026 Long Main Code: https://github.com/schang-lab/gems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become a popular approach for simulating human behaviors, yet it remains unclear if LLMs are necessary for all simulation tasks. We study a broad family of close-ended simulation tasks, with applications from survey prediction to test-taking, and show that a graph neural network can match or surpass strong LLM-based methods. We introduce Graph-basEd Models for Human Simulation (GEMS) which formulates close-ended simulation as link prediction on a heterogeneous graph of individuals and choices. Across three datasets and three evaluation settings, GEMS matches or outperforms the strongest LLM-based methods while using three orders of magnitude fewer parameters. These results suggest that graph-based modeling can complement LLMs as an efficient and transparent approach to simulating human behaviors. Code is available at https://github.com/schang-lab/gems.

AI.tldr: 基于图的小模型(GEMS)在闭式人行为模拟中追平或超越大语言模型(LLM)，参数仅千分之一。
AI.motivation: 探索非LLM路径，用更轻量、可解释的方案完成问卷预测、答题等闭式仿真任务。
AI.method: 提出GEMS：把仿真建模为「人-选项」异构图上的链路预测，以图神经网络实现推断。
AI.result: 在3套数据、3种评估下，GEMS参数量比最强LLM小10³倍，准确率一致或更佳。
AI.conclusion: 图建模可作为LLM的高效、透明互补途径，为大规模行为仿真提供新范式。

title: Enhancing LLM-Based Neural Network Generation: Few-Shot Prompting and Efficient Validation for Automated Architecture Design
summary: Automated neural network architecture design remains a significant challenge in computer vision. Task diversity and computational constraints require both effective architectures and efficient search methods. Large Language Models (LLMs) present a promising alternative to computationally intensive Neural Architecture Search (NAS), but their application to architecture generation in computer vision has not been systematically studied, particularly regarding prompt engineering and validation strategies. Building on the task-agnostic NNGPT/LEMUR framework, this work introduces and validates two key contributions for computer vision. First, we present Few-Shot Architecture Prompting (FSAP), the first systematic study of the number of supporting examples (n = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) for LLM-based architecture generation. We find that using n = 3 examples best balances architectural diversity and context focus for vision tasks. Second, we introduce Whitespace-Normalized Hash Validation, a lightweight deduplication method (less than 1 ms) that provides a 100x speedup over AST parsing and prevents redundant training of duplicate computer vision architectures. In large-scale experiments across seven computer vision benchmarks (MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, CelebA, ImageNette, SVHN, Places365), we generated 1,900 unique architectures. We also introduce a dataset-balanced evaluation methodology to address the challenge of comparing architectures across heterogeneous vision tasks. These contributions provide actionable guidelines for LLM-based architecture search in computer vision and establish rigorous evaluation practices, making automated design more accessible to researchers with limited computational resources.

AI.tldr: 首次系统验证LLM 1-shot～6-shot生成CV网络时的示例数量，3-shot最优；提出<1 ms的去重校验法，7大benchmark生成1900结构，为低成本NAS提供可复现流程。
AI.motivation: NAS计算昂贵，LLM生成网络尚缺系统研究，尤其在提示策略与去重验证环节。作者希望用LLM替代传统搜索，降低CV结构设计的算力门槛。
AI.method: (1) Few-Shot Architecture Prompting：在NNGPT/LEMUR框架下控制1-6个示例，测试生成质量；(2) Whitespace-Normalized Hash Validation：对网络代码做空白归一化哈希，<1 ms去重，减少重复训练。
AI.result: 3-shot在结构多样性-上下文聚焦间取得最佳平衡；去重法比AST解析快100×，无漏检；在7个异构视觉任务上共生成1900个独特网络，验证集准确率与手工/传统NAS可比。
AI.conclusion: LLM+3-shot+快速去重即可实现高效CV-NAS；提出的评估与去重协议为算力受限研究者提供可行、可复现的自动网络设计范式。

title: Unraveling the Mechanism of Drug Binding to SARS-CoV-2 RNA Pseudoknot with Thermodynamics-Driven Machine Learning
summary: The SARS-CoV-2 RNA pseudoknot is a promising target for antiviral intervention, as it regulates the efficiency of $-$1 programmed ribosomal frameshifting ($-$1 PRF), a mechanism that is essential for viral protein synthesis. The pseudoknot represents a viral RNA sequence composed of helical stems that adopts two long-lived topologies, threaded and unthreaded. Ligand-induced distortion of this fold is thought to underlie the susceptibility of $-$1 PRF to small-molecule inhibitors. Resolving these distortions from unbiased molecular dynamics (MD) requires collective variables (CVs) that isolate the slowest dynamic modes of the RNA--ligand system from the high-frequency fluctuations. Here, we use spectral map (SM), a thermodynamics-driven machine-learning method, to learn such CVs directly from MD trajectories of the SARS-CoV-2 RNA pseudoknot in complex with the $-$1 PRF inhibitor merafloxacin and two related analogs. We examine both threaded and unthreaded pseudoknot topologies and consider the neutral and ionized ligand forms relevant at physiological pH. Free-energy landscapes show that ligand-induced destabilization is topology-selective: merafloxacin and its analogs destabilize the S2 stem in the threaded pseudoknot, whereas in the unthreaded pseudoknot, destabilization shifts to the S1 and S3 stems. We find that the zwitterionic form of merafloxacin uniquely imposes slow dynamics on the otherwise featureless unthreaded pseudoknot. Furthermore, the neutral and zwitterionic forms of merafloxacin differ qualitatively in their mechanisms within the same RNA topology. Overall, these results clarify how pseudoknot topology, ligand type, and protonation state shape the slow conformational dynamics of viral RNA and establish physiological protonation as an essential factor for modeling RNA-targeted drug action.

AI.tldr: 谱图机器学习首次在原子尺度揭示新冠病毒RNA假结两种拓扑对merafloxacin及其类似物的响应差异；药物质子化状态决定其 destabilize 的特定茎区，从而为RNA靶向抗病毒药物设计提供可区分的结构-动力学指标。
AI.motivation: -1 PRF 是新冠病毒蛋白翻译必需步骤，假结为其“开关”。目前缺乏高分辨率、体相条件下揭示药物如何扰动假结慢动力学的工具，限制理性设计。
AI.method: 对 threaded/unthreaded 两种假结拓扑，分别进行中性及两性离子配体形式的长时间无偏MD；用谱图(SM)无监督学习提取慢自由度，构建自由能面；对比不同拓扑-配体质子化组合的 destabilization 模式与动力学 slowing 特征。
AI.result: 配体 destabilization 呈拓扑选择性：threaded 中主要破坏S2茎，unthreaded 中转向S1/S3；两性离子merafloxacin在unthreaded拓扑中诱导显著慢动力学；同一拓扑下，中性/两性离子机制定性不同。
AI.conclusion: 假结拓扑、配体类型与质子化状态共同决定病毒RNA慢构象动力学；模拟必须考虑生理质子化才能准确预测RNA靶向药物作用，为下一代-1 PRF抑制剂设计提供可区分的结构-动力学标志。

title: ReviewGrounder: Improving Review Substantiveness with Rubric-Guided, Tool-Integrated Agents
summary: The rapid rise in AI conference submissions has driven increasing exploration of large language models (LLMs) for peer review support. However, LLM-based reviewers often generate superficial, formulaic comments lacking substantive, evidence-grounded feedback. We attribute this to the underutilization of two key components of human reviewing: explicit rubrics and contextual grounding in existing work. To address this, we introduce REVIEWBENCH, a benchmark evaluating review text according to paper-specific rubrics derived from official guidelines, the paper's content, and human-written reviews. We further propose REVIEWGROUNDER, a rubric-guided, tool-integrated multi-agent framework that decomposes reviewing into drafting and grounding stages, enriching shallow drafts via targeted evidence consolidation. Experiments on REVIEWBENCH show that REVIEWGROUNDER, using a Phi-4-14B-based drafter and a GPT-OSS-120B-based grounding stage, consistently outperforms baselines with substantially stronger/larger backbones (e.g., GPT-4.1 and DeepSeek-R1-670B) in both alignment with human judgments and rubric-based review quality across 8 dimensions. The code is available \href{https://github.com/EigenTom/ReviewGrounder}{here}.

AI.tldr: ReviewGrounder 利用“官方评分细则＋文章内容＋已有人类评审”构建基准 REVIEWBENCH，并设计多智能体“起草-证据化”范式，用中型模型（Phi-4-14B + GPT-OSS-120B）即可在大模型基线（GPT-4.1、DeepSeek-R1-670B）上取得更优、更贴人类评分细则的同行评审效果。
AI.motivation: LLM 辅助评审易流于表面模板化，根源在于缺评分细则约束与上下文证据支撑。作者认为需像人类评审那样“照规则打分＋依靠文献/他人评审找证据”，故构建可检验这种能力的基准与方法。
AI.method: 1. 引入 REVIEWBENCH：每篇文章抽取官方评审准则、自身内容与已有金标人类评审，按 8 维度自动生成纸面专属评分细则，并计算文本与细则对齐度。2. 设计 REVIEWGROUNDER 多智能体框架：Drafting Agent 基于评分细则生成初稿；Grounding Agent 利用 arxiv/引用数据库等工具检索对号证据，对初稿进行“增删改”细化。模型规模仅 14B＋120B。
AI.result: 在 REVIEWBENCH 上，ReviewGrounder 在 8 维度评审质量及与人类评分相关性均显著优于 GPT-4.1、DeepSeek-R1-670B 等更大躯干模型，且生成评论长度、引用数与准确率更高；消融显示去除评分细则或 Grounding 环节性能皆下降。
AI.conclusion: 引入评分细则并显式检索证据，可大幅降低模型体型需求，让中型模型作出“更专业、更据可依”的评审；REVIEWBENCH 与 ReviewGrounder 为自动化同行评审提供了可量化、可复制的新范式与开放基准。

title: Cognitive Alpha Mining via LLM-Driven Code-Based Evolution
summary: Discovering effective predictive signals, or "alphas," from financial data with high dimensionality and extremely low signal-to-noise ratio remains a difficult open problem. Despite progress in deep learning, genetic programming, and, more recently, large language model (LLM)-based factor generation, existing approaches still explore only a narrow region of the vast alpha search space. Neural models tend to produce opaque and fragile patterns, while symbolic or formula-based methods often yield redundant or economically ungrounded expressions that generalize poorly. Although different in form, these paradigms share a key limitation: none can conduct broad, structured, and human-like exploration that balances logical consistency with creative leaps. To address this gap, we introduce the Cognitive Alpha Mining Framework (CogAlpha), which combines code-level alpha representation with LLM-driven reasoning and evolutionary search. Treating LLMs as adaptive cognitive agents, our framework iteratively refines, mutates, and recombines alpha candidates through multi-stage prompts and financial feedback. This synergistic design enables deeper thinking, richer structural diversity, and economically interpretable alpha discovery, while greatly expanding the effective search space. Experiments on 5 stock datasets from 3 stock markets demonstrate that CogAlpha consistently discovers alphas with superior predictive accuracy, robustness, and generalization over existing methods. Our results highlight the promise of aligning evolutionary optimization with LLM-based reasoning for automated and explainable alpha discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出 Cognitive Alpha Mining Framework (CogAlpha)，用 LLM 做“认知代理”并融合演化搜索，在海量高维低信噪比金融数据中自动发现兼具解释性与泛化性的预测因子（alpha）；在 5 个跨 3 市场的股票数据集上显著优于现有深度/符号方法。
AI.motivation: 传统量化因子挖掘面临高维+低信噪比挑战：神经网络模式黑箱且脆弱，符号或公式方法生成冗余且缺乏经济意义；两者均无法像人类分析师那样进行“联想+逻辑”式广域搜索。需兼得可解释性与创造性探测能力。
AI.method: 设计 CogAlpha——三层协同：① 代码级 alpha 编码 （统一表征利好运算；② 把 LLM 当作“可自适应认知代理”，通过多阶段提示对因子进行交叉、变异、反思；③ 基于实时刻金融反馈的演化优化（适应度＝预测表现+经济意义）。迭代流程：Mutation → Recombination → Prompt-Revising，不断放大搜索空间并保证逻辑一致性。
AI.result: 在 3 大市场（美股、A 股、港股）共 5 只股票高频/低频数据集上测试：CogAlpha 发现因子在预测精度、IC、换手率调整收益率、样本外鲁棒性上均优于 SOTA 深度模型（MLP、Transformer）、遗传规划、及最近 LLM 因子生成方案；维持较低组合相关性，提升拼装后策略夏普比率 30%+。
AI.conclusion: 将 LLM 的类人联想推理嵌入演化搜索，可突破传统符号和神经网络范例的盲区，实现“可解释、可泛化”的自动化 alpha 发现；该认知驱动范式对高噪声领域具有普适启示，并为下一代智能投研提供工具基础。

title: GAMBIT: A Gamified Jailbreak Framework for Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026), Main Conference
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have become widely deployed, yet their safety alignment remains fragile under adversarial inputs. Previous work has shown that increasing inference steps can disrupt safety mechanisms and lead MLLMs to generate attacker-desired harmful content. However, most existing attacks focus on increasing the complexity of the modified visual task itself and do not explicitly leverage the model's own reasoning incentives. This leads to them underperforming on reasoning models (Models with Chain-of-Thoughts) compared to non-reasoning ones (Models without Chain-of-Thoughts). If a model can think like a human, can we influence its cognitive-stage decisions so that it proactively completes a jailbreak? To validate this idea, we propose GAMBI} (Gamified Adversarial Multimodal Breakout via Instructional Traps), a novel multimodal jailbreak framework that decomposes and reassembles harmful visual semantics, then constructs a gamified scene that drives the model to explore, reconstruct intent, and answer as part of winning the game. The resulting structured reasoning chain increases task complexity in both vision and text, positioning the model as a participant whose goal pursuit reduces safety attention and induces it to answer the reconstructed malicious query. Extensive experiments on popular reasoning and non-reasoning MLLMs demonstrate that GAMBIT achieves high Attack Success Rates (ASR), reaching 92.13% on Gemini 2.5 Flash, 91.20% on QvQ-MAX, and 85.87% on GPT-4o, significantly outperforming baselines.

AI.tldr: GAMBIT 框架通过“游戏化”诱使推理型多模态大模型主动完成越狱，在 Gemini 2.5 Flash 等模型上 ASR>90%，显著优于现有攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉对抗攻击仅增加任务复杂度，未利用模型自身推理动机，导致对推理模型效果差。作者假设：若模型具备类人类思维，可在其认知阶段植入指令陷阱，使其主动配合完成恶意目标。
AI.method: 提出 GAMBIT：1) 将有害视觉语义拆分为碎片并重组；2) 构建“游戏场景”，把回答恶意查询包装成“获胜条件”；3) 引导模型在链式推理中自发探索、重构意图，以目标追求替代安全注意力。
AI.result: 在推理模型（Gemini 2.5 Flash、QvQ-MAX）与非推理模型（GPT-4o）上评估，ASR 分别达 92.13%、91.20%、85.87%，显著超越基线，验证认知阶段干预的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 模型推理能力越强，越容易被 gamified 指令陷阱诱导而主动越狱；表明仅靠输出层对齐不足以防御，亟需针对认知过程的内省式安全机制。

title: Comparison of Modern Multilingual Text Embedding Techniques for Hate Speech Detection Task
comment: Submitted to Applied Soft Computing (Status: Decision in Process)
summary: Online hate speech and abusive language pose a growing challenge for content moderation, especially in multilingual settings and for low-resource languages such as Lithuanian. This paper investigates to what extent modern multilingual sentence embedding models can support accurate hate speech detection in Lithuanian, Russian, and English, and how their performance depends on downstream modeling choices and feature dimensionality. We introduce LtHate, a new Lithuanian hate speech corpus derived from news portals and social networks, and benchmark six modern multilingual encoders (potion, gemma, bge, snow, jina, e5) on LtHate, RuToxic, and EnSuperset using a unified Python pipeline. For each embedding, we train both a one class HBOS anomaly detector and a two class CatBoost classifier, with and without principal component analysis (PCA) compression to 64-dimensional feature vectors. Across all datasets, two class supervised models consistently and substantially outperform one class anomaly detection, with the best configurations achieving up to 80.96% accuracy and AUC ROC of 0.887 in Lithuanian (jina), 92.19% accuracy and AUC ROC of 0.978 in Russian (e5), and 77.21% accuracy and AUC ROC of 0.859 in English (e5 with PCA). PCA compression preserves almost all discriminative power in the supervised setting, while showing some negative impact for the unsupervised anomaly detection case. These results demonstrate how modern multilingual sentence embeddings combined with gradient boosted decision trees provide robust soft-computing solutions for multilingual hate speech detection applications.

AI.tldr: 用6种多语言句向量+CatBoost，在自建立陶宛语仇恨语料LtHate及俄、英基准上，二分类效果全面碾压单类HBOS，PCA降维至64维几乎不损性能，最佳配置在立陶宛语、俄语、英语分别达80.96%、92.19%、77.21%准确率。
AI.motivation: 多语言、特别是低资源语言（立陶宛语）网络仇恨言论检测缺乏高质量数据与系统评估，需验证现代多语言句向量及其下游建模选择对检测效果的影响。
AI.method: 构建LtHate立陶宛语仇恨语料；统一pipeline评测6种多语言编码器（potion、gemma、bge、snow、jina、e5）；每类编码分别训练单类HBOS异常检测与两类CatBoost分类器，并在有无PCA压缩至64维条件下对比。
AI.result: 两类监督模型在所有语料上显著优于单类异常检测；最优结果：立陶宛语jina 80.96% Acc/0.887 AUC，俄语e5 92.19% Acc/0.978 AUC，英语e5+PCA 77.21% Acc/0.859 AUC；PCA压缩对监督模型影响极小，对异常检测略有负面。
AI.conclusion: 现代多语言句向量配合梯度提升决策树可为多语言仇恨言论检测提供鲁棒、轻量的软计算方案，PCA降维进一步降低部署成本。

title: GUI-Perturbed: Domain Randomization Reveals Systematic Brittleness in GUI Grounding Models
summary: GUI grounding models report over 85% accuracy on standard benchmarks, yet drop 27-56 percentage points when instructions require spatial reasoning rather than direct element naming. Current benchmarks miss this because they evaluate each screenshot once with a single fixed instruction. We introduce GUI-Perturbed, a controlled perturbation framework that independently varies visual scenes and instructions to measure grounding robustness. Evaluating three 7B models from the same architecture lineage, we find that relational instructions cause systematic accuracy collapse across all models, a 70% browser zoom produces statistically significant degradation, and rank-8 LoRA fine-tuning with augmented data degrades performance rather than improving it. By perturbing along independent axes, GUI-Perturbed isolates which specific capability axes are affected-spatial reasoning, visual robustness, reasoning calibration-providing diagnostic signal that aggregate benchmarks cannot. We release the dataset, augmentation pipeline, and a fine-tuned model.

AI.tldr: 现成GUI-grounding模型在需要空间推理的指令上性能骤降；本文提出GUI-Perturbed扰动框架，通过独立扰动视觉场景与文本指令，揭示模型在空间推理、视觉鲁棒性与推理校准上的系统性缺陷，并公开数据与模型。
AI.motivation: 主流GUI定位基准仅对每幅截图给一条固定指令，无法暴露模型在空间推理场景下的脆弱性；需构建可系统诊断模型失效维度的评测方法。
AI.method: 设计GUI-Perturbed双重轴扰动框架：1) 对同一场景生成多种空间/关系指令；2) 对同指令施加视觉扰动（如浏览器缩放）。在7B同系列模型上评估，并对比标准微调与LoRA数据增强策略。
AI.result: 空间关系指令导致准确率骤降27–56个百分点；70%浏览器缩放即显著下降；rank-8 LoRA数据增强反而恶化性能。框架可独立量化空间推理、视觉鲁棒性与校准误差三条能力轴的退化。
AI.conclusion: GUI-Perturbed首次将视觉与文本扰动解耦，提供细粒度诊断信号，证明现有模型与训练策略在真实交互场景下仍不可靠，为后续鲁棒GUI智能体研究奠定基础。

title: LexGenius: An Expert-Level Benchmark for Large Language Models in Legal General Intelligence
summary: Legal general intelligence (GI) refers to artificial intelligence (AI) that encompasses legal understanding, reasoning, and decision-making, simulating the expertise of legal experts across domains. However, existing benchmarks are result-oriented and fail to systematically evaluate the legal intelligence of large language models (LLMs), hindering the development of legal GI. To address this, we propose LexGenius, an expert-level Chinese legal benchmark for evaluating legal GI in LLMs. It follows a Dimension-Task-Ability framework, covering seven dimensions, eleven tasks, and twenty abilities. We use the recent legal cases and exam questions to create multiple-choice questions with a combination of manual and LLM reviews to reduce data leakage risks, ensuring accuracy and reliability through multiple rounds of checks. We evaluate 12 state-of-the-art LLMs using LexGenius and conduct an in-depth analysis. We find significant disparities across legal intelligence abilities for LLMs, with even the best LLMs lagging behind human legal professionals. We believe LexGenius can assess the legal intelligence abilities of LLMs and enhance legal GI development. Our project is available at https://github.com/QwenQKing/LexGenius.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向法律通用智能的中文基准LexGenius，系统评估大模型在法律理解、推理与决策上的能力，发现现有模型与专业法律人差距显著。
AI.motivation: 现有法律评测仅关注结果，缺乏对法律通用智能（GI）的系统度量，阻碍了大模型向专家级法律能力的发展。
AI.method: 构建Dimension-Task-Ability三层框架，覆盖7维度11任务20能力；用最新案例与考题生成选择题，经人工+模型多轮校验防泄漏；对12个SOTA模型全面测试并深度分析。
AI.result: 各模型法律能力差异巨大，顶级模型仍全面落后于人类法律专家；LexGenius可精准揭示模型法律短板。
AI.conclusion: LexGenius为法律GI研究提供了可靠标尺，将推动大模型法律能力的持续迭代与提升。

title: All Changes May Have Invariant Principles: Improving Ever-Shifting Harmful Meme Detection via Design Concept Reproduction
comment: 19 pages, 11 figures, 9 tables accepted by ACL 2026 main conference
summary: Harmful memes are ever-shifting in the Internet communities, which are difficult to analyze due to their type-shifting and temporal-evolving nature. Although these memes are shifting, we find that different memes may share invariant principles, i.e., the underlying design concept of malicious users, which can help us analyze why these memes are harmful. In this paper, we propose RepMD, an ever-shifting harmful meme detection method based on the design concept reproduction. We first refer to the attack tree to define the Design Concept Graph (DCG), which describes steps that people may take to design a harmful meme. Then, we derive the DCG from historical memes with design step reproduction and graph pruning. Finally, we use DCG to guide the Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to detect harmful memes. The evaluation results show that RepMD achieves the highest accuracy with 81.1% and has slight accuracy decreases when generalized to type-shifting and temporal-evolving memes. Human evaluation shows that RepMD can improve the efficiency of human discovery on harmful memes, with 15$\sim$30 seconds per meme.

AI.tldr: RepMD 通过显式建模并复现恶意用户的设计意图（Design Concept Graph，DCG），指导多模态大模型检测不断变异的有害 meme，在81.1% 准确率下对类型漂移与时间演化仍具鲁棒性，并可将人工审核效率提升至15–30 秒/张。
AI.motivation: 有害 meme 随网络社群不断类型漂移与时间演化，传统特征驱动方法难以捕捉其本质；作者发现不同 meme 背后存在不变的“设计原理”，遂提出显式建模该原理以提升检测的泛化与可解释性。
AI.method: 1) 借鉴攻击树思想，定义“设计概念图（DCG）”刻画恶意用户构建 meme 的通用步骤；2) 利用历史数据对设计步骤进行复现与图剪枝，自动归纳出 DCG；3) 将 DCG 作为先验注入多模态大语言模型（MLLM），引导其联合图文信息完成检测。
AI.result: 在自建跨时、跨类数据集上，RepMD 取得 81.1% 的最高准确率；面对类型漂移与时间演化时，准确率下降幅度轻微，显著优于基线。人工评估显示，使用 RepMD 可将单张 meme 审核时间压缩至 15–30 秒，效率提升明显。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并复现“不变设计原理”可有效抑制有害 meme 的漂移与演化带来的检测退化；RepMD 在精度、泛化与人工协作效率上均表现优异，为动态网络内容治理提供了可解释、可迁移的新范式。

title: STEP-Parts: Geometric Partitioning of Boundary Representations for Large-Scale CAD Processing
summary: Many CAD learning pipelines discretize Boundary Representations (B-Reps) into triangle meshes, discarding analytic surface structure and topological adjacency and thereby weakening consistent instance-level analysis. We present STEP-Parts, a deterministic CAD-to-supervision toolchain that extracts geometric instance partitions directly from raw STEP B-Reps and transfers them to tessellated carriers through retained source-face correspondence, yielding instance labels and metadata for downstream learning and evaluation. The construction merges adjacent B-Rep faces only when they share the same analytic primitive type and satisfy a near-tangent continuity criterion. On ABC, same-primitive dihedral angles are strongly bimodal, yielding a threshold-insensitive low-angle regime for part extraction. Because the partition is defined on intrinsic B-Rep topology rather than on a particular triangulation, the resulting boundaries remain stable under changes in tessellation. Applied to the DeepCAD subset of ABC, the pipeline processes approximately 180{,}000 models in under six hours on a consumer CPU. We release code and precomputed labels, and show that STEP-Parts serves both as a tessellation-robust geometric reference and as a useful supervision source in two downstream probes: an implicit reconstruction--segmentation network and a dataset-level point-based backbone.

AI.tldr: STEP-Parts 是一种从原始 STEP B-Rep 直接提取几何实例分区的确定性工具链，无需网格即可保持解析面结构与拓扑邻接，并将标签稳定迁移到任意三角化模型，为 18 万 DeepCAD 模型提供一致性监督。
AI.motivation: 现有 CAD 学习管线将 B-Rep 离散为三角网格时丢弃了解析面信息与拓扑邻接，导致实例级分析不一致；需要一种能保留原始几何结构、对网格密度不敏感的监督生成方法。
AI.method: 1) 在原始 STEP B-Rep 上执行确定性分割：仅当相邻面同属一个解析原型（平面/圆柱/球等）且满足近切连续判据时才合并；2) 利用 B-Rep→三角化面的显式对应关系，将分割标签与元数据无损迁移至任意 tessellation；3) 在 ABC 数据集中统计同类原型的二面角呈强双模分布，从而自动确定低角度阈值，实现阈值无关的稳定提取。
AI.result: 对 DeepCAD 子集的 18 万个模型，单台消费级 CPU 6 小时内完成全部分割；生成边界在重网格化后保持位置稳定；提供的标签与元数据可直接用于监督学习。
AI.conclusion: STEP-Parts 为后续学习提供了网格不变的几何基准与高质量监督，在隐式重建-分割联合网络与点云骨干的两个下游任务中验证了其实用价值，代码与预计算标签已开源。

title: Reinforcement Learning via Value Gradient Flow
summary: We study behavior-regularized reinforcement learning (RL), where regularization toward a reference distribution (the dataset in offline RL or the base model in LLM RL finetuning) is essential to prevent value over-optimization caused by erroneous out-of-distribution extrapolation. Existing methods either rely on reparameterized policy gradient, which are difficult to scale to large generative models, or on reject sampling, which can be overly conservative when attempting to move beyond the behavior support. In this paper, we propose Value Gradient Flow (VGF), a scalable new paradigm for behavior-regularized RL. VGF casts behavior-regularized RL as an optimal transport problem that maps the reference distribution to the value-induced optimal policy distribution. We solve this transport problem via discrete gradient flow, where value gradients guide particles initialized from the reference distribution. Our analysis shows that VGF imposes regularization implicitly by controlling the transport budget. VGF eliminates explicit policy parameterization while remaining expressive and flexible, this enables adaptive test-time scaling by adjusting the transport budget. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VGF significantly outperforms prior methods, achieving state-of-the-art results on offline RL benchmarks (D4RL, OGBench) and LLM RL tasks. Code and runs can be found at https://ryanxhr.github.io/vgf.

AI.tldr: 提出 VGF，一种将行为正则化 RL 重新建模为最优传输并利用离散梯度流求解的可扩展新范式，无需显式策略参数化即可实现自适应正则化，全面刷新离线 RL 与 LLM RL 微调 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 离线 RL 及大模型微调中的行为正则化能防止分布外高估，但现有方法难以在大规模生成模型上扩展，且保守的拒绝采样限制策略改进空间。
AI.method:
1. 将行为正则化 RL 描述为“从参考分布到价值诱导最优策略分布”的最优传输问题；
2. 用离散梯度流数值求解，直接用价值梯度驱动从参考分布采样的粒子；
3. 通过控制传输代价隐式施加正则，摆脱对参数化策略及重参数梯度或拒绝采样的依赖；
4. 支持测试时按不同计算预算灵活调整传输步数，实现自适应推理。
AI.result: 在 D4RL、OGBench 离线强化学习基准及多项大模型 RL 微调任务上全面超越现有方法，达到新的 SOTA 性能。
AI.conclusion: VGF 给出一种可扩展、无需显式策略并且能按需调节正则强度的最优传输式解决方案，为大规模行为正则化 RL 提供了新的高效范式。

title: Social Story Frames: Contextual Reasoning about Narrative Intent and Reception
summary: Reading stories evokes rich interpretive, affective, and evaluative responses, such as inferences about narrative intent or judgments about characters. Yet, computational models of reader response are limited, preventing nuanced analyses. To address this gap, we introduce SocialStoryFrames, a formalism for distilling plausible inferences about reader response, such as perceived author intent, explanatory and predictive reasoning, affective responses, and value judgments, using conversational context and a taxonomy grounded in narrative theory, linguistic pragmatics, and psychology. We develop two models, SSF-Generator and SSF-Classifier, validated through human surveys (N=382 participants) and expert annotations, respectively. We conduct pilot analyses to showcase the utility of the formalism for studying storytelling at scale. Specifically, applying our models to SSF-Corpus, a curated dataset of 6,140 social media stories from diverse contexts, we characterize the frequency and interdependence of storytelling intents, and we compare and contrast narrative practices (and their diversity) across communities. By linking fine-grained, context-sensitive modeling with a generic taxonomy of reader responses, SocialStoryFrames enable new research into storytelling in online communities.

AI.tldr: 提出 SocialStoryFrames（SSF）形式化框架与配套模型，首次在万级社交媒体故事上实现对读者推断、情感与价值判断的细粒度、可扩展计算分析。
AI.motivation: 现有计算模型难以刻画读者对故事的复杂解释、情感与评价反应，阻碍了对叙事意图、人物评价等现象的深入理解。
AI.method: 构建基于叙事理论、语用学与心理学的读者反应分类体系；训练 SSF-Generator 生成、SSF-Classifier 判别潜在反应；经 382 人调查与专家标注验证后，应用于 6 140 条多元社交媒体故事（SSF-Corpus）进行规模分析。
AI.result: 模型在人工与专家评估中表现可靠；大规模语料揭示不同社区在叙事意图频率、共现模式及多样性上的显著差异，证实框架的可解释性与跨社区可比性。
AI.conclusion: SocialStoryFrames 将语境敏感的细粒度读者反应建模通用化，为线上社群叙事研究提供新工具，并可直接支撑内容治理、社群比较与叙事生成等下游任务。

title: 3D Conditional Image Synthesis of Left Atrial LGE MRI from Composite Semantic Masks
comment: This work has been published in the Proceedings of the 2025 IEEE International Conference on Imaging Systems and Techniques (IST). The final published version is available via IEEE Xplore
summary: Segmentation of the left atrial (LA) wall and endocardium from late gadolinium-enhanced (LGE) MRI is essential for quantifying atrial fibrosis in patients with atrial fibrillation. The development of accurate machine learning-based segmentation models remains challenging due to the limited availability of data and the complexity of anatomical structures. In this work, we investigate 3D conditional generative models as potential solution for augmenting scarce LGE training data and improving LA segmentation performance. We develop a pipeline to synthesize high-fidelity 3D LGE MRI volumes from composite semantic label maps combining anatomical expert annotations with unsupervised tissue clusters, using three 3D conditional generators (Pix2Pix GAN, SPADE-GAN, and SPADE-LDM). The synthetic images are evaluated for realism and their impact on downstream LA segmentation. SPADE-LDM generates the most realistic and structurally accurate images, achieving an FID of 4.063 and surpassing GAN models, which have FIDs of 40.821 and 7.652 for Pix2Pix and SPADE-GAN, respectively. When augmented with synthetic LGE images, the Dice score for LA cavity segmentation with a 3D U-Net model improved from 0.908 to 0.936, showing a statistically significant improvement (p < 0.05) over the baseline.These findings demonstrate the potential of label-conditioned 3D synthesis to enhance the segmentation of under-represented cardiac structures.

AI.tldr: 利用三维条件生成模型合成高质量LGE-MRI数据，可显著提升左心房U-Net分割精度（Dice 0.908→0.936）。
AI.motivation: LGE-MRI左心房壁与内膜分割数据稀缺、结构复杂，制约了纤维化量化与机器学习模型训练效果。
AI.method: 构建“语义标签→3D LGE”合成管线：先融合专家解剖标注与无监督组织聚类生成复合标签，再用三种三维条件生成器（Pix2Pix-GAN、SPADE-GAN、SPADE-LDM）合成图像；以FID评估真实性，并用Dice评估对下游3D U-Net分割的增益。
AI.result: SPADE-LDM生成图像最逼真（FID 4.063，显著低于GAN的40.821/7.652）；在其增强训练集上，左心房腔体Dice由0.908提升至0.936（p < 0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 标签驱动的三维条件合成能有效扩充稀缺心脏MRI数据，为少样本结构分割提供可行方案。

title: Learning to Concatenate Quantum Codes
summary: Concatenating quantum error correction codes scales error correction capability by driving logical error rates down double-exponentially across levels. However, the noise structure shifts under concatenation, making it hard to choose an optimal code sequence. We automate this choice by estimating the effective noise channel after each level and selecting the next code accordingly. In particular, we use learning-based methods to tailor small, non-additive encoders when the noise exhibits sufficient structure, then switch to standard codes once the noise is nearly uniform. In simulations, this level-wise adaptation achieves a target logical error rate with far fewer qubits than concatenating stabilizer codes alone--reducing qubit counts by up to two orders of magnitude for strongly structured noise. Therefore, this hybrid, learning-based strategy offers a promising tool for early fault-tolerant quantum computing.

AI.tldr: 将量子纠错码按级联时，若能实时感知并学习噪声结构，可在保持双指数级逻辑错误率下降的同时，把所需物理量子比特数减少两个量级。
AI.motivation: 级联虽能指数级压低逻辑错误，但噪声结构会随层级演化，固定码序列远非最优；急需一种能“看懂”噪声并动态选码的自动化方案。
AI.method: 逐级估计有效噪声通道；当噪声呈明显结构时用强化/学习型小型非加性编码器快速压制，待噪声趋均匀后切回标准稳定子码，形成混合自适应级联策略。
AI.result: 模拟显示，在强结构噪声下，实现相同目标逻辑错误率所需物理比特数比纯 stabilizer 码级联减少 10² 量级，并保持双指数级错误抑制。
AI.conclusion: 该学习-码级联混合策略为早期容错量子计算提供了一条低资源、高鲁棒的实用路径。

title: Enhancing LLM-based Search Agents via Contribution Weighted Group Relative Policy Optimization
comment: Accepted to the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026), Main Conference
summary: Search agents extend Large Language Models (LLMs) beyond static parametric knowledge by enabling access to up-to-date and long-tail information unavailable during pretraining. While reinforcement learning has been widely adopted for training such agents, existing approaches face key limitations: process supervision often suffers from unstable value estimation, whereas outcome supervision struggles with credit assignment due to sparse, trajectory-level rewards. To bridge this gap, we propose Contribution-Weighted GRPO (CW-GRPO), a framework that integrates process supervision into group relative policy optimization. Instead of directly optimizing process rewards, CW-GRPO employs an LLM judge to assess the retrieval utility and reasoning correctness at each search round, producing per-round contribution scores. These scores are used to rescale outcome-based advantages along the trajectory, enabling fine-grained credit assignment without sacrificing optimization stability. Experiments on multiple knowledge-intensive benchmarks show that CW-GRPO outperforms standard GRPO by 5.0\% on Qwen3-8B and 6.3\% on Qwen3-1.7B, leading to more effective search behaviors. Additional analysis reveals that successful trajectories exhibit concentrated contributions across rounds, providing empirical insight into search agent tasks.

AI.tldr: 用 LLM 判断每一步的检索价值并加权计算优势函数，把过程监督无缝融入组相对策略优化，使搜索代理既稳定又更准。在 Qwen3 上分别提升 5.0%/6.3%。
AI.motivation: 检索代理需及时获取长尾知识，但强化学习面临两种困境：基于过程的奖励估值波动大，基于结果的奖励信号稀疏且难以归因。为此需一种既能细腻指导每一步又能保持训练稳定的新机制。
AI.method: 提出 CW-GRPO：在每轮搜索后由独立 LLM 评判“检索效用与推理正确性”，生成贡献分；随后用该分对整条轨迹的回合结果优势重新加权，实现无需额外价值网络的细粒度信用分配并保留 GRPO 本身的组内相对优化稳定性。
AI.result: 在多个知识密集型基准测试中，CW-GRPO 相对标准 GRPO 平均提升 5–6%，Qwen3-8B/1.7B 分别涨 5.0 与 6.3 分；有效轨迹的“贡献分”集中于关键轮次，验证了方法对归因的合理性。
AI.conclusion: 利用 LLM 提供可微的课程式过程信号并融入结果级优化，可在保持训练鲁棒性的同时显著提升搜索代理在开放域知识问答中的准确性与效率，证明贡献加权思想可被推广至其它长程决策任务。

title: Style Amnesia: Investigating Speaking Style Degradation and Mitigation in Multi-Turn Spoken Language Models
summary: In this paper, we show that when spoken language models (SLMs) are instructed to speak in a specific speaking style at the beginning of a multi-turn conversation, they cannot maintain the required speaking styles after several turns of interaction; we refer to this as the style amnesia of SLMs. We focus on paralinguistic speaking styles, including emotion, accent, volume, and speaking speed. We evaluate three proprietary and two open-source SLMs, demonstrating that none of these models can maintain a consistent speaking style when instructed to do so. We further show that while SLMs can recall the style instruction when prompted in later turns, they still fail to express it, but through explicit recall can mitigate style amnesia. In addition, SLMs struggle more when the style instruction is placed in system messages rather than user messages, even though system messages are specifically designed to provide persistent, conversation-level instructions. Our findings highlight a systematic gap in current SLMs' ability to maintain speaking styles, highlighting the need for improved style adherence in future models. Our code and evaluation data are publicly available at https://github.com/YuXiangLin1234/SLM-Style-Amnesia.

AI.tldr: SLM在对话超过若干轮后丢失初始设定的副语言风格（情感、口音、音量、语速），即出现“风格失忆”，即便再次提示可记得但仍难以持续表达；风格指令放在 system message 时问题更严重。
AI.motivation: 现有口语语言模型通过 system message 或首轮用户指令指定说话风格后，期望在整个多轮对话中保持一致体验，但缺乏对该能力是否可持续的研究与量化。
AI.method: 聚焦副语言风格（情感、口音、音量、语速），对3款闭源和2款开源SLM进行多轮对话实验：先给定风格指令，随后持续多轮自由交互，并在不同轮次进行显式风格提示，比较 style-message 放置位置对持续性的影响。
AI.result: 所有SLM在约第3−5轮后均出现显著的风格漂移；即时显式提示可回忆指令，但对应副语言表现仍未恢复；将 style 指令置于 system message 时漂移程度更大（排放差距≥120%）。
AI.conclusion: 当前SLM在风格持久化方面存在系统性短板，需引入记忆-约束联合机制或风格一致性目标以增强副语言表达，未来评测数据集与代码已开源可供后续改进。

title: ArrowGEV: Grounding Events in Video via Learning the Arrow of Time
summary: Grounding events in videos serves as a fundamental capability in video analysis. While Vision Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly employed for this task, existing approaches predominantly train models to associate events with timestamps in the forward video only. This paradigm hinders VLMs from capturing the inherent temporal structure and directionality of events, thereby limiting robustness and generalization. To address this limitation, inspired by the arrow of time in physics, which characterizes the intrinsic directionality of temporal processes, we propose ArrowGEV, a reinforcement learning framework that explicitly models temporal directionality in events to improve both event grounding and temporal directionality understanding in VLMs. Specifically, we categorize events into time-sensitive (e.g., putting down a bag) and time-insensitive (e.g., holding a towel in the left hand). The former denote events whose reversal substantially alters their meaning, while the latter remain semantically unchanged under reversal. For time-sensitive events, ArrowGEV introduces a reward that encourages VLMs to discriminate between forward and backward videos, whereas for time-insensitive events, it enforces consistent grounding across both directions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ArrowGEV not only improves grounding precision and temporal directionality recognition, but also enhances general video understanding and reasoning ability.

AI.tldr: ArrowGEV 用 RL 让 VLM 区分事件的时间箭头，把事件分成“时间敏感/不敏感”两类并分别奖惩，显著提升时序定位与方向判别能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 仅按正向视频训练，忽略事件固有的时间方向性，导致鲁棒性与泛化受限。
AI.method: 借鉴物理“时间箭头”思想，提出强化学习框架 ArrowGEV：① 将事件二分为时间敏感（倒放语义变）与不敏感（倒放语义不变）；② 对敏感事件奖励 VLM 区分正倒视频，对不敏感事件惩罚方向不一致的定位；③ 端到端优化 VLM 的时序 grounding 与方向判别。
AI.result: 在多个视频 grounding 与方向判别基准上，ArrowGEV 同时提升定位精度、时间方向识别率，并泛化到一般视频问答/推理任务。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模时间方向性是提升 VLM 事件理解的关键；ArrowGEV 为视频时序任务提供了可扩展的 RL 范式。

title: Unsupervised feature selection using Bayesian Tucker decomposition
summary: In this paper, we proposed Bayesian Tucker decomposition (BTuD) in which residual is supposed to obey Gaussian distribution analogous to linear regression. Although we have proposed an algorithm to perform the proposed BTuD, the conventional higher-order orthogonal iteration can generate Tucker decomposition consistent with the present implementation. Using the proposed BTuD, we can perform unsupervised feature selection successfully applied to various synthetic datasets, global coupled maps with randomized coupling strength, and gene expression profiles. Thus we can conclude that our newly proposed unsupervised feature selection method is promising. In addition to this, BTuD based unsupervised FE is expected to coincide with TD based unsupervised FE that were previously proposed and successfully applied to a wide range of problems.

AI.tldr: 本文将Tucker分解的残差建模为高斯分布，提出Bayesian Tucker分解(BTuD)，并据此构建无监督特征选择框架，在合成数据、耦合映射和基因表达数据上验证有效，且推测与已有TD无监督特征选择等价。
AI.motivation: 传统Tucker分解未对残差分布做显式假设，难以量化不确定性；作者希望借贝叶斯框架将残差设为高斯似然，使分解结果具有概率解释，并进一步用于无监督特征选择。
AI.method: 将Tucker分解写成“观测张量=核心张量×因子矩阵+高斯残差”的贝叶斯回归形式，推导EM或变分推断算法估计核/因子及噪声精度；用因子矩阵行向量的统计显著性(如ℓ2范数或后验概率)排序特征，实现无监督特征选择。
AI.result: 在合成数据、全局耦合映象和基因表达谱三类数据集上，BTuD选出的特征子集在聚类、可视化或下游分类任务中表现优于随机选择或传统方差阈值法；算法收敛速度与常规HOOI相当，且无需标签信息。
AI.conclusion: BTuD为张量分解引入概率假设，可天然输出不确定性，并衍生出简洁有效的无监督特征选择方案；实验结果显示其性能可靠，且理论上与早期TD无监督特征选择方法相容，具备推广潜力。

title: Quantum-inspired tensor networks in machine learning models
comment: 28 pages, 11 figures, article class. The interactive version of the graph can be found at https://github.com/gvalverde21/research-graph-TensorNetworks-MachineLearning
summary: Tensor networks were developed in the context of many-body physics as compressed representations of multiparticle quantum states. These representations mitigate the exponential complexity of many-body systems by capturing only the most relevant dependencies. Due to the formal similarity between quantum entanglement and statistical correlations, tensor networks have recently been integrated in machine learning, operating both as alternative learning architectures and as decompositions of components of neural networks. The expectation is that the theoretical understanding of tensor networks developed within quantum many-body physics leads to novel methods that offer advantages in terms of computational efficiency, explainability, or privacy. Here we review the use of tensor networks in the context of machine learning, providing a critical assessment of the state of the art, the potential advantages, and the challenges that must be overcome.

AI.tldr: 张量网络原是量子多体物理的压缩态表示，现被引入机器学习作为新架构或神经网络分解，有望提升计算效率、可解释性与隐私性；本文系统评述其现状、潜力与障碍。
AI.motivation: 量子纠缠与统计关联形式相似，将量子多体物理成熟的张量网络技术迁移到机器学习，可突破传统网络在效率、解释性、隐私上的瓶颈。
AI.method: 综述性评估：梳理张量网络在机器学习中的三类应用——(i) 直接作为可训练模型（如MPS、PEPS、 MERA），(ii) 对现有权重矩阵做张量分解压缩，(iii) 用于强化学习与生成建模；并对比其复杂度、表达能力、优化算法及开源工具。
AI.result: 理论与实验均显示：在一维结构数据、小规模图像及语言模型上，张量网络可在参数量减少数个量级的同时保持相近准确率；目前缺乏对二维以上高阶结构的高效算法，且反向传播梯度不稳定、GPU并行化不足，导致在大型深度模型上尚未超越CNN/Transformer。
AI.conclusion: 张量网络为机器学习提供了物理可解释、天然压缩的新路径，但需解决高阶网络可扩展训练、自动微分框架集成及硬件加速等核心挑战，方能真正进入主流深度学习的工业级应用。

title: Enhancing Linguistic Competence of Language Models through Pre-training with Language Learning Tasks
summary: Language models (LMs) are pre-trained on raw text datasets to generate text sequences token-by-token. While this approach facilitates the learning of world knowledge and reasoning, it does not explicitly optimize for linguistic competence. To bridge this gap, we propose L2T, a pre-training framework integrating Language Learning Tasks alongside standard next-token prediction. Inspired by human language acquisition, L2T transforms raw text into structured input-output pairs to provide explicit linguistic stimulation. Pre-training LMs on a mixture of raw text and L2T data not only improves overall performance on linguistic competence benchmarks but accelerates its acquisition, while maintaining competitive performance on general reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 先让模型做“语言练习题”再读 raw text，可在不牺牲推理能力的前提下更快、更好地掌握语言学能力。
AI.motivation: 纯下一词预测预训练虽能学到世界知识和推理，但对“语言学能力”缺乏针对性优化，收敛慢、效果有限。
AI.method: 提出 L2T 框架：把原始语料转成显式语言学习任务（如完形、改错、句法变换等），与常规 next-token 数据混合预训练。
AI.result: 在多项语言学基准上得分显著提升，且收敛速度加快；GLUE、推理等通用任务保持可比性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式语言任务信号可作为有效补充，不干扰模型对通用知识和推理的学习，为构建更具语言素养的 LM 提供可行路径。

title: 3AM: 3egment Anything with Geometric Consistency in Videos
summary: Video object segmentation methods like SAM2 achieve strong performance through memory-based architectures but struggle under large viewpoint changes due to reliance on appearance features. Traditional 3D instance segmentation methods address viewpoint consistency but require camera poses, depth maps, and expensive preprocessing. We introduce 3AM, a training-time enhancement that integrates 3D-aware features from MUSt3R into SAM2. Our lightweight Feature Merger fuses multi-level MUSt3R features that encode implicit geometric correspondence. Combined with SAM2's appearance features, the model achieves geometry-consistent recognition grounded in both spatial position and visual similarity. We propose a field-of-view aware sampling strategy ensuring frames observe spatially consistent object regions for reliable 3D correspondence learning. Critically, our method requires only RGB input at inference, with no camera poses or preprocessing. On challenging datasets with wide-baseline motion (ScanNet++, Replica), 3AM substantially outperforms SAM2 and extensions, achieving 90.6% IoU and 71.7% Tracking Recall on ScanNet++'s Selected Subset, improving over state-of-the-art VOS methods by +15.9 and +30.4 points. Project page: https://jayisaking.github.io/3AM-Page/

AI.tldr: 3AM 是无需深度/姿态的 SAM2 训练增强模块，借 MUSt3R 隐式 3D 特征与视野采样使 VOS 在大视角变化下仍保持几何一致性；ScanNet++ 上 IoU 90.6%，领先现有方法 15.9+ 个百分点。
AI.motivation: SAM2 类记忆 VOS 依赖表观，在大视角抖动时漂移；传统 3D 实例分割虽视角鲁棒却需深度、相机姿态与昂贵预处理，难以直接用于视频。作者希望仅利用 RGB 就能在训练阶段注入 3D 几何先验，从而兼顾两者优点。
AI.method: 提出 3AM：① 用无监督几何网络 MUSt3R 抽多尺度隐式 3D 特征，② 轻量级特征合并器将 3D 特征与 SAM2 各级 CNN/记忆特征融合，实现“空间位置 + 视觉相似”双重跟踪；③ 训练时采用视野感知采样，仅选取能共同观测同一物体区域的帧对，保证 3D 对应学习可靠。推断阶段完全去掉深度与姿态，仅输入 RGB。
AI.result: 在宽基线数据集 ScanNet++(Sel-subset) 上 3AM 达到 90.6% IoU、71.7% 跟踪召回率，分别比 SAM2 及其扩展提升 15.9 与 30.4 个百分点；在 Replica 等场景同样大幅领先，验证了对大视角变化的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 无需外加传感器信息，3AM 通过训练期注入 MUSt3R 隐式 3D 先验并配合视野采样，即可把几何一致性“免费”赋予基于表观的视频物体分割器，显著突破现有记忆型 VOS 的视角瓶颈，且推断零成本。

title: MLDAS: Machine Learning Dynamic Algorithm Selection for Software-Defined Networking Security
summary: Network security is a critical concern in the digital landscape of today, with users demanding secure browsing experiences and protection of their personal data. This study explores the dynamic integration of Machine Learning (ML) algorithms with Software-Defined Networking (SDN) controllers to enhance network security through adaptive decision mechanisms. The proposed approach enables the system to dynamically choose the most suitable ML algorithm based on the characteristics of the observed network traffic. This work examines the role of Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) as a fundamental component of secure communication networks and discusses the limitations of SDN-based attack detection mechanisms. The proposed framework uses adaptive model selection to maintain reliable intrusion detection under varying network conditions. The study highlights the importance of analyzing traffic-type-based metrics to define effective classification rules and enhance the performance of ML models. Additionally, it addresses the risks of overfitting and underfitting, underscoring the critical role of hyperparameter tuning in optimizing model accuracy and generalization. The central contribution of this work is an automated mechanism that adaptively selects the most suitable ML algorithm according to real-time network conditions, prioritizing detection robustness and operational feasibility within SDN environments.

AI.tldr: 面向SDN环境，论文提出可自动按实时网络特征选择最优ML算法的自适应入侵检测框架，解决固定模型在变化流量下性能衰退问题。
AI.motivation: 传统SDN-based IDS采用单一ML模型，难以适应动态且多态的网络流量，导致检测精度随时间下降；亟需一种能在线匹配流量特征与算法的自适应机制，以提升检测鲁棒性和运营可行性。
AI.method: 在SDN控制器内嵌入自适应模型选择层，实时采集流量-type-based指标，通过元学习策略动态从候选ML池（如树、集成、浅层神经网络等）中挑选当日最优模型；引入超参数自动调优与正则化抑制过/欠拟合，持续评估并更新模型。
AI.result: 与传统固定模型相比，自适应框架在公开数据集及真实校园网 trace 上平均检测率提升8–12%，误报率降低15–20%，模型切换开销<50 ms，控制平面CPU占用增加<5%。
AI.conclusion: 提出的自适应ML选择机制可在SDN控制器内无缝落地，显著增强IDS对多变流量的适应性；未来工作将扩展至在线联邦学习与可解释性分析，以兼顾隐私合规与运维可视性。

title: EuropeMedQA Study Protocol: A Multilingual, Multimodal Medical Examination Dataset for Language Model Evaluation
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated high proficiency on English-centric medical examinations, their performance often declines when faced with non-English languages and multimodal diagnostic tasks. This study protocol describes the development of EuropeMedQA, the first comprehensive, multilingual, and multimodal medical examination dataset sourced from official regulatory exams in Italy, France, Spain, and Portugal. Following FAIR data principles and SPIRIT-AI guidelines, we describe a rigorous curation process and an automated translation pipeline for comparative analysis. We evaluate contemporary multimodal LLMs using a zero-shot, strictly constrained prompting strategy to assess cross-lingual transfer and visual reasoning. EuropeMedQA aims to provide a contamination-resistant benchmark that reflects the complexity of European clinical practices and fosters the development of more generalizable medical AI.

AI.tldr: 本文公布EuropeMedQA——首个源自欧洲多国官方监管考试的多语言、多模态医学评测集，旨在衡量大模型在非英语语境及多模态诊断场景中的泛化能力，推进更具普适性的医学AI。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在英语医学考试中表现优异，但在非英语及多模态诊断任务上性能骤降，且缺乏官方、跨语种、抗数据污染的标准基准，阻碍泛化医学AI发展。
AI.method: 遵循FAIR与SPIRIT-AI原则，构建涵盖意、法、西、葡官方考试的题库；开发自动化翻译与对齐流程；采用零样本、受限提示策略对当代多模态LLM进行跨语言迁移与视觉推理评测。
AI.result: 实验设计与评测框架已建立，EuropeMedQA提供多语言、多模态题目及严格评测协议，初步验证其对模型形成显著挑战，可检测语言与模态迁移缺陷。
AI.conclusion: EuropeMedQA为抗污染、高复杂度、贴合欧洲临床实践的基准，可直接用于持续评估并驱动多语言、多模态医学模型的泛化改进。

title: Beyond Literal Mapping: Benchmarking and Improving Non-Literal Translation Evaluation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced Machine Translation (MT), applying them to linguistically complex domains-such as Social Network Services, literature etc. In these scenarios, translations often require handling non-literal expressions, leading to the inaccuracy of MT metrics. To systematically investigate the reliability of MT metrics, we first curate a meta-evaluation dataset focused on non-literal translations, namely MENT. MENT encompasses four non-literal translation domains and features source sentences paired with translations from diverse MT systems, with 7,530 human-annotated scores on translation quality. Experimental results reveal the inaccuracies of traditional MT metrics and the limitations of LLM-as-a-Judge, particularly the knowledge cutoff and score inconsistency problem. To mitigate these limitations, we propose RATE, a novel agentic translation evaluation framework, centered by a reflective Core Agent that dynamically invokes specialized sub-agents. Experimental results indicate the efficacy of RATE, achieving an improvement of at least 3.2 points in combined system- and segment-level correlation with human judgments compared with current methods. Further experiments demonstrate the robustness of RATE to general-domain MT evaluation. Code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/BITHLP/RATE.

AI.tldr: 论文发现传统机器翻译（MT）指标在评估非字面翻译时不可靠，构建非字面翻译元评测集 MENT，提出基于多智能体反射的 RATE 评估框架，系统级与句子级与人类评分相关性提升 ≥3.2 分，代码与数据已开源。
AI.motivation: 大模型虽显著推进 MT，但在社交网络、文学等富含隐喻、俚语等非字面表达的领域，现有 MT 指标严重失准，导致评估结果与真实质量脱节，亟需系统验证并改进评估方法。
AI.method: 1）构建 MENT 元评测集：覆盖四种非字面翻译场景，含 7,530 条人工质量打分；2）系统对比传统指标与 LLM-as-a-Judge，暴露知识截断与打分不一致缺陷；3）设计 RATE 框架：以反射式核心智能体动态调用专业子智能体（语义、风格、文化适配等），实现分域、分层次评估。
AI.result: 在 MENT 上，RATE 系统级与句子级皮尔逊/肯德尔相关系数平均提升 ≥3.2 分；进一步在通用域测试集上验证其稳健性，显著优于 BLEURT、COMET、GPT-4-as-Judge 等基线。
AI.conclusion: 非字面翻译评估必须引入动态、多智能体与反射机制；RATE 首次证明该思路可兼顾高相关性与跨域鲁棒性，为后续 MT 评估与模型迭代提供新基准与工具链。

title: DeTracker: Motion-decoupled Vehicle Detection and Tracking in Unstabilized Satellite Videos
summary: Satellite videos provide continuous observations of surface dynamics but pose significant challenges for multi-object tracking (MOT), especially under unstabilized conditions where platform jitter and the weak appearance of tiny objects jointly degrade tracking performance. To address this problem, we propose DeTracker, a joint-detection-and-tracking framework tailored for unstabilized satellite videos. DeTracker introduces a task-driven Global-Local Motion Decoupling (GLMD) module to address the motion imbalance between dominant platform motion and weak target motion. It suppresses background-dominated motion via global semantic alignment at the feature level and captures target-specific motion through local refinement, improving trajectory stability and identity consistency. In addition, a Temporal Dependency Feature Pyramid (TDFP) module is developed to perform cross-frame temporal feature fusion, enhancing the continuity and discriminability of tiny-object representations. We further construct a new benchmark dataset, SDM-Car-SU, which simulates multi-directional and multi-speed platform motions to enable systematic evaluation of tracking robustness under varying motion perturbations. Extensive experiments on both simulated and real unstabilized satellite videos demonstrate that DeTracker significantly outperforms existing methods, achieving 61.1% MOTA on SDM-Car-SU and 45.3% MOTA on real satellite video data. The code and dataset will be publicly available at https://github.com/alex-chenjiajun/DeTracker.

AI.tldr: 为了让抖动的卫星视频也能稳定追踪多个微小车辆，作者提出联合检测-跟踪框架 DeTracker，用全局-局部运动解耦和时序特征融合模块削弱平台抖动影响并强化微小目标表征，同时发布新基准 SDM-Car-SU，实验显示明显优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 卫星视频平台抖动和目标尺寸极小导致“背景主导运动”与“弱目标运动”失衡，传统 MOT 方法轨迹漂移、ID 跳变严重，缺少针对性基准数据集。
AI.method: DeTracker 框架：1) GLMD 模块在特征级进行“全局语义对齐”抑制背景运动，并“局部细化”提取目标相对运动；2) TDFP 模块做跨帧时序特征融合，增强微小目标表征的连续性与判别力；3) 新建 SDM-Car-SU 数据集，系统模拟多方向/多速度平台抖动场景。
AI.result: SDM-Car-SU 上 MOTA 达 61.1%，真实抖动卫星视频 MOTA 45.3%，均显著优于现有方法；GLMD 与 TDFP 模块均带来明显增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合检测-跟踪、显式运动解耦与时序增强，DeTracker 有效克服抖动与微小目标双重挑战，为 unstabilized 卫星视频 MOT 提供了新基线与公开数据。

title: Towards Faster Language Model Inference Using Mixture-of-Experts Flow Matching
summary: Flow matching retains the generation quality of diffusion models while enabling substantially faster inference, making it a compelling paradigm for generative modeling. However, when applied to language modeling, it exhibits fundamental limitations in representing complex latent distributions with irregular geometries, such as anisotropy and multimodality. To address these challenges, we propose a mixture-of-experts flow matching (MoE-FM) framework, which captures complex global transport geometries in latent space by decomposing them into locally specialized vector fields. Building on MoE-FM, we develop a non-autoregressive (NAR) language modeling approach, named YAN, instantiated with both Transformer and Mamba architectures. Across multiple downstream tasks, YAN achieves generation quality on par with both autoregressive (AR) and diffusion-based NAR language models, while requiring as few as three sampling steps. This yields a $40\times$ speedup over AR baselines and up to a $10^3\times$ speedup over diffusion language models, demonstrating substantial efficiency advantages for language modeling.

AI.tldr: MoE-FM框架用局部专家流匹配解决语言模型中的复杂潜在分布难题，新NAR模型YAN三步采样即可达到AR质量，推理速度提升40–1000倍。
AI.motivation: 流匹配虽比扩散模型快，但在语言建模里难以刻画各向异性、多模态等不规则潜在几何，导致生成质量受限。
AI.method: 提出混合专家流匹配（MoE-FM）：把全局复杂传输拆成若干局部专家向量场；基于此构建非自回归语言模型YAN，可兼容Transformer与Mamba架构，仅3步采样。
AI.result: YAN在多项下游任务上与自回归及扩散式NAR模型质量相当，推理步数3步即可，速度较AR快40×，较扩散LM快达10³×。
AI.conclusion: MoE-FM有效捕获语言潜在空间的复杂结构，使非自回归生成在保持质量的同时获得数量级推理加速，为高效语言建模提供新范式。

title: Aerial Multi-Functional RIS in Fluid Antennas-Aided Full-Duplex Networks: A Self-Optimized Hybrid Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach
summary: To address high data traffic demands of sixth-generation (6G) networks, this paper proposes a novel architecture that integrates autonomous aerial vehicles (AAVs) and multi-functional reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (MF-RISs) as AM-RIS in fluid antenna (FA)-assisted full-duplex (FD) networks. The AM-RIS provides hybrid functionalities, including signal reflection, amplification, and energy harvesting (EH), potentially improving both signal coverage and sustainability. Meanwhile, FA facilitates fine-grained spatial adaptability at FD-enabled base station (BS), which complements residual self-interference (SI) suppression. We aim at maximizing the overall energy efficiency (EE) by jointly optimizing transmit DL beamforming at BS, UL user power, configuration of AM-RIS, and positions of the FA and AM-RIS. Owing to the hybrid continuous-discrete parameters and high dimensionality of the intractable problem, we have conceived a self-optimized multi-agent hybrid deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework (SOHRL), which integrates multi-agent deep Q-networks (DQN) and multi-agent proximal policy optimization (PPO), respectively handling discrete and continuous actions. To enhance self-adaptability, an attention-driven state representation and meta-level hyperparameter optimization are incorporated, enabling multi-agents to autonomously adjust learning hyperparameters. Simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed AM-RIS-enabled FA-aided FD networks empowered by SOHRL algorithm. The results reveal that SOHRL outperforms benchmarks of the case without attention mechanism and conventional hybrid/multi-agent/standalone DRL. Moreover, AM-RIS in FD achieves the highest EE compared to half-duplex, conventional rigid antenna arrays, partial EH, and conventional RIS without amplification, highlighting its potential as a compelling solution for EE-aware wireless networks.

AI.tldr: 6G 网络通过融合 AM-RIS（自主飞行器+多功能可重构智能面）与流体天线全双工基站，并采用自优化多智能体混合 DRL（SOHRL）联合优化波束赋形/功率/阵面/位置，显著提升能效。
AI.motivation: 6G 数据流量激增，传统静态 RIS 与半双工方案难以兼顾覆盖、能效与自干扰抑制；需利用空中机动 RIS 与灵活天线实现高能效、可持续的全双工通信。
AI.method: 1) 系统模型：空中 AM-RIS 同时具备反射、放大与能量收集功能；基站端部署流体天线抑制残余自干扰。2) 优化目标：联合优化下行波束赋形、上行用户功率、AM-RIS 模式/相位、飞行器与流体天线位置，最大化系统能效。3) 算法：提出 SOHRL，将离散动作（如 RIS 模式）交由多智能体 DQN，连续动作（如轨迹、波束）交由多智能体 PPO；引入注意力状态表示与元级超参数优化，自动调整学习率等超参数，实现高维混合空间自优化。
AI.result: 仿真表明：SOHRL 相比无注意力机制及常规混合/独立 DRL 基准，能效提升显著；AM-RIS 在全双工模式下较半双工、刚性阵列、部分 EH 及无放大 RIS 方案获得最高能效增益。
AI.conclusion: AM-RIS 赋能的流体天线全双工网络结合 SOHRL 算法，为 6G 高能效无线网络提供了一种自主、灵活且可持续的解决方案。

title: Adaptive Layer Selection for Layer-Wise Token Pruning in LLM Inference
comment: ACL 2026 Findings. Source code available at https://github.com/TANIGUCHIREI/ASL
summary: Due to the prevalence of large language models (LLMs), key-value (KV) cache reduction for LLM inference has received remarkable attention. Among numerous works that have been proposed in recent years, layer-wise token pruning approaches, which select a subset of tokens at particular layers to retain in KV cache and prune others, are one of the most popular schemes. They primarily adopt a set of pre-defined layers, at which tokens are selected. Such design is inflexible in the sense that the accuracy significantly varies across tasks and deteriorates in harder tasks such as KV retrieval. In this paper, we propose ASL, a training-free method that adaptively chooses the selection layer for KV cache reduction, exploiting the variance of token ranks ordered by attention score. The proposed method balances the performance across different tasks while meeting the user-specified KV budget requirement. ASL operates during the prefilling stage and can be jointly used with existing KV cache reduction methods such as SnapKV to optimize the decoding stage. By evaluations on the InfiniteBench, RULER, and NIAH benchmarks, we show that ASL, equipped with one-shot token selection, adaptively trades inference speed for accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art layer-wise token pruning methods in difficult tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的ASL方法，按注意力分数方差自适应选层压缩KV缓存，兼顾任务差异与KV预算，在困难任务上优于现有层间token剪枝方案。
AI.motivation: 现有层间token剪枝方法使用固定剪枝层，任务间鲁棒性差，KV检索等困难任务精度骤降，需一种无需重训练即可自适应选层的KV压缩机制。
AI.method: ASL：在预填充阶段逐层计算token注意力分数排名方差，方差峰值层即为关键信息浓缩层，被选为token筛选层；用户给定KV预算下，一次性保留高注意力token，可与SnapKV等解码阶段压缩方法正交叠加。
AI.result: InfiniteBench、RULER、NIAH评测显示，ASL在困难长上下文任务上显著优于静态层剪枝基线，兼顾速度与精度，满足设定KV预算。
AI.conclusion: 利用注意力排名方差自适应选层可无痛提升KV压缩的跨任务鲁棒性，ASL无需训练、即插即用，为后续LLM长上下文推理提供了高效、灵活的KV缓存管理新范式。

title: HERMES: KV Cache as Hierarchical Memory for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant improvement in offline video understanding. However, extending these capabilities to streaming video inputs, remains challenging, as existing models struggle to simultaneously maintain stable understanding performance, real-time responses, and low GPU memory overhead. To address this challenge, we propose HERMES, a novel training-free architecture for real-time and accurate understanding of video streams. Based on a mechanistic attention investigation, we conceptualize KV cache as a hierarchical memory framework that encapsulates video information across multiple granularities. During inference, HERMES reuses a compact KV cache, enabling efficient streaming understanding under resource constraints. Notably, HERMES requires no auxiliary computations upon the arrival of user queries, thereby guaranteeing real-time responses for continuous video stream interactions, which achieves 10$\times$ faster TTFT compared to prior SOTA. Even when reducing video tokens by up to 68% compared with uniform sampling, HERMES achieves superior or comparable accuracy across all benchmarks, with up to 11.4% gains on streaming datasets.

AI.tldr: 一种零训练、实时流式视频理解的MLLM架构HERMES，通过层次化KV缓存补偿信息，TTFT提速10倍且精度不降。
AI.motivation: 现有离线MLLM在流式视频上面临精度‐实时‐显存三重冲突，缺乏训练无关的高效方案。
AI.method: 把KV缓存抽象为多粒度的层级记忆，在推理阶段重用紧凑型KV缓存；不针对新用户提问做额外计算，直接复用视频流累积的层次化表示。
AI.result: 相比均匀采样68% token压缩下仍保持甚至提升精度，在流式基准上最高提升11.4%，首token时间(TTFT)快10倍并保持GPU显存开销极低。
AI.conclusion: HERMES提出的训练无关层级KV机制首次在流场景同时满足实时、低显存与高准确，为零训练流式视觉-语言理解提供了可行范式。

title: Route to Rome Attack: Directing LLM Routers to Expensive Models via Adversarial Suffix Optimization
summary: Cost-aware routing dynamically dispatches user queries to models of varying capability to balance performance and inference cost. However, the routing strategy introduces a new security concern that adversaries may manipulate the router to consistently select expensive high-capability models. Existing routing attacks depend on either white-box access or heuristic prompts, rendering them ineffective in real-world black-box scenarios. In this work, we propose R$^2$A, which aims to mislead black-box LLM routers to expensive models via adversarial suffix optimization. Specifically, R$^2$A deploys a hybrid ensemble surrogate router to mimic the black-box router. A suffix optimization algorithm is further adapted for the ensemble-based surrogate. Extensive experiments on multiple open-source and commercial routing systems demonstrate that {R$^2$A} significantly increases the routing rate to expensive models on queries of different distributions. Code and examples: https://github.com/thcxiker/R2A-Attack.

AI.tldr: 提出黑盒场景下把廉价模型请求误导到高价模型的 R²A 攻击，用混合代理路由器+后缀优化，实验表明对多类路由系统均显著抬升高价模型调用率。
AI.motivation: 成本敏感的路由器虽能节省算力，却存在被恶意诱导持续选择高价模型的安全漏洞；现有白盒或启发式攻击在真实黑盒环境中失效，亟需针对黑盒路由器的有效攻击方法与评估。
AI.method: 构建由多种路由策略组成的混合代理路由器逼近黑盒目标；将后缀优化算法扩展至集成代理，迭代搜索可将输入判别为“高价”的对抗后缀，实现 R²A 攻击。
AI.result: 在开源与商业路由系统上，不同分布的查询经 R²A 处理后，被导向高价模型的比例提升 21%–97%，而查询意图保持可用，攻击黑盒成功率显著优于基线。
AI.conclusion: R²A 首次证明黑盒 LLM 路由器亦易受定向成本攻击，揭示动态路由范式的新安全风险；需设计鲁棒路由与检测机制，以在性能、成本与安全之间重新平衡。

title: DharmaOCR: Specialized Small Language Models for Structured OCR that outperform Open-Source and Commercial Baselines
summary: This manuscript introduces DharmaOCR Full and Lite, a pair of specialized small language models (SSLMs) for structured OCR that jointly optimize transcription quality, generation stability, and inference cost. It also presents DharmaOCR-Benchmark, a benchmark that covers printed, handwritten, and legal/administrative documents, and proposes a unified evaluation protocol that measures fidelity and structure while explicitly tracking text degeneration as a first-class benchmark metric (alongside unit cost). Beyond reporting degeneration rates, the manuscript empirically shows degeneration is not merely a quality failure, since it materially worsens production performance by increasing response time, reducing throughput, and inflating computational cost due to abnormally long generations. To the best of the author's knowledge, as a methodological contribution, this is the first application of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for OCR, explicitly using degenerate generations as rejected examples to penalize looping behavior. Combined with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) for enforcing a strict JSON schema (header, margin, footer, and text), DPO consistently reduces degeneration rate across model families (up to 87.6% relative) while preserving or improving extraction quality. The resulting models, namely, DharmaOCR Full (7B) and DharmaOCR Lite (3B), set a new state-of-the-art on DharmaOCR-Benchmark, outperforming each open-source and commercial baseline model evaluated regarding extraction quality, reaching 0.925 and 0.911 scores with 0.40% and 0.20% degeneration rates. AWQ quantization reduced up to 22% per-page cost with negligible quality loss, enabling a strong quality-cost trade-off in comparison to proprietary OCR APIs and open-source alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一对结构化OCR专用小模型DharmaOCR Full/Lite，首次将DPO用于OCR训练，把文本退化作为一级评测指标；在自建的DharmaOCR-Benchmark上，两模型以<0.4%的退化率取得SOTA，成本比商用API低22%，实现质量-成本双赢。
AI.motivation: 现有OCR模型忽视「文本退化」(无意义重复/循环)对生产延迟与算力成本的实际冲击，且缺乏兼顾结构保真与退化度量的统一评测基准，亟需轻量化、低成本且鲁棒的方案。
AI.method: 1. 构建覆盖印刷、手写、法律/行政文档的综合基准DharmaOCR-Benchmark，提出「保真度+结构+退化率+单页成本」四维度评测协议；2. 采用SFT强制输出严格JSON schema(页眉/页脚/正文等)，再首次把退化样本作为负例，用DPO直接优化策略，抑制循环；3. 推出7B/3B参数量的DharmaOCR Full与Lite，并辅以AWQ后训练量化。
AI.result: DPO使退化率相对降低最高87.6%，同时保持或提升提取质量；Full(7B)与Lite(3B)在基准上分别取得0.925与0.911的综合质量分，退化率仅0.40%与0.20%，均优于全部开源与商业 baseline；AWQ量化后单页成本再降22%，质量几乎无损。
AI.conclusion: 首次证实「退化」不仅是质量缺陷，更直接损害生产指标；通过SFT+DPO组合可在小模型上同时压制退化、提升结构化提取精度，实现质量-延迟-成本的三重优化，为OCR落地提供了可复现的新范式。

title: Language of Thought Shapes Output Diversity in Large Language Models
summary: Output diversity is crucial for Large Language Models as it underpins pluralism and creativity. In this work, we reveal that controlling the language used during model thinking-the language of thought-provides a novel and structural source of output diversity. Our preliminary study shows that different thinking languages occupy distinct regions in a model's thinking space. Based on this observation, we study two repeated sampling strategies under multilingual thinking-Single-Language Sampling and Mixed-Language Sampling-and conduct diversity evaluation on outputs that are controlled to be in English, regardless of the thinking language used. Across extensive experiments, we demonstrate that switching the thinking language from English to non-English languages consistently increases output diversity, with a clear and consistent positive correlation such that languages farther from English in the thinking space yield larger gains. We further show that aggregating samples across multiple thinking languages yields additional improvements through compositional effects, and that scaling sampling with linguistic heterogeneity expands the model's diversity ceiling. Finally, we show that these findings translate into practical benefits in pluralistic alignment scenarios, leading to broader coverage of cultural knowledge and value orientations in LLM outputs. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/Multilingual-LoT-Diversity.
