AI.method: 1) 引入最优传输理论驱动的在线混合模型（MMOT），将每个类别建模为可增量更新的混合分布，实现类中心的持续演化；2) 设计动态保持策略，通过正则化潜在空间保持类别分离性，抑制灾难性遗忘；3) 推理阶段利用 MMOT 得到的动态中心计算与未见样本的相似度。
AI.result: 在多个增量学习基准数据集上的实验表明，所提方法的分类准确率、可塑性与稳定性指标均显著优于现有基于固定或单中心的增量学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 最优传输引导的在线混合模型能有效刻画多模态流式数据，动态中心更新与动态保持策略协同抑制遗忘，为在线增量学习提供了新的理论工具与实用框架。

title: FAIR Universe Weak Lensing ML Uncertainty Challenge: Handling Uncertainties and Distribution Shifts for Precision Cosmology
comment: Whitepaper for the FAIR Universe Weak Lensing ML Uncertainty Challenge Competition. More info is available at our GitHub repository https://github.com/FAIR-Universe/Cosmology_Challenge. 13 pages, 5 figures, 1 table
summary: Weak gravitational lensing, the correlated distortion of background galaxy shapes by foreground structures, is a powerful probe of the matter distribution in our universe and allows accurate constraints on the cosmological model. In recent years, high-order statistics and machine learning (ML) techniques have been applied to weak lensing data to extract the nonlinear information beyond traditional two-point analysis. However, these methods typically rely on cosmological simulations, which poses several challenges: simulations are computationally expensive, limiting most realistic setups to a low training data regime; inaccurate modeling of systematics in the simulations create distribution shifts that can bias cosmological parameter constraints; and varying simulation setups across studies make method comparison difficult. To address these difficulties, we present the first weak lensing benchmark dataset with several realistic systematics and launch the FAIR Universe Weak Lensing Machine Learning Uncertainty Challenge. The challenge focuses on measuring the fundamental properties of the universe from weak lensing data with limited training set and potential distribution shifts, while providing a standardized benchmark for rigorous comparison across methods. Organized in two phases, the challenge will bring together the physics and ML communities to advance the methodologies for handling systematic uncertainties, data efficiency, and distribution shifts in weak lensing analysis with ML, ultimately facilitating the deployment of ML approaches into upcoming weak lensing survey analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次发布包含真实系统误差的弱透镜基准数据集，并启动 FAIR 弱透镜机器学习不确定性挑战赛，以标准化方式评估小训练集和分布偏移条件下的宇宙学参数推断方法。
AI.motivation: 高阶统计与机器学习方法虽能挖掘弱透镜非线性信息，但过度依赖昂贵且系统误差建模不完善的宇宙学模拟，导致训练数据受限、分布偏移及方法间难以公平比较。
AI.method: 构建含多种真实系统误差的弱透镜基准数据集；设计两阶段挑战赛，限定训练样本量并引入分布偏移；提供统一评估协议，供物理与机器学习社区系统比较各算法在参数约束上的不确定性、数据效率与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 推出首个公开、可重复的弱透镜 ML 基准与挑战框架，为后续弱透镜测量提供标准化测试平台，可直接用于评估和改进现有及未来算法。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集与挑战将推动弱透镜分析中机器学习对系统误差、小样本与分布偏移的鲁棒性研究，加速 ML 方法在即将到来的大型弱透镜巡天中的实际落地。

title: Feedback Adaptation for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are typically evaluated under static assumptions, despite being frequently corrected through user or expert feedback in deployment. Existing evaluation protocols focus on overall accuracy and fail to capture how systems adapt after feedback is introduced. We introduce feedback adaptation as a problem setting for RAG systems, which asks how effectively and how quickly corrective feedback propagates to future queries. To make this behavior measurable, we propose two evaluation axes: correction lag, which captures the delay between feedback provision and behavioral change, and post-feedback performance, which measures reliability on semantically related queries after feedback. Using these metrics, we show that training-based approaches exhibit a trade-off between delayed correction and reliable adaptation. We further propose PatchRAG, a minimal inference-time instantiation that incorporates feedback without retraining, demonstrating immediate correction and strong post-feedback generalization under the proposed evaluation. Our results highlight feedback adaptation as a previously overlooked dimension of RAG system behavior in interactive settings.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将“反馈后适应性”设为RAG独立评估维度，提出校正延迟与反馈后性能两大指标，并用无需重训的PatchRAG实现即时修正与强泛化。
AI.motivation: 现实RAG系统在部署后常被用户或专家持续纠错，但现有评估只看静态准确率，忽视纠错反馈的扩散速度与可靠性，导致真实交互行为被严重低估。
AI.method: 1) 形式化“反馈适应性”设置；2) 提出校正延迟（Correction Lag）与反馈后性能（Post-feedback Performance）双轴评估；3) 设计PatchRAG——基于轻量级推理时补丁，无需重训即可将反馈注入检索-生成流程。
AI.result: 实验显示重训式方法存在“延迟-稳定性”权衡；PatchRAG在同分布与语义相关查询上实现即时校正（lag≈0）且后续性能提升显著，验证新指标能揭示传统评估遗漏的行为差异。
AI.conclusion: 反馈适应性是RAG交互场景中被忽视的关键维度；PatchRAG证明推理时反馈机制可在不牺牲效率的前提下兼顾即时性与泛化性，为动态RAG系统评估与优化提供新范式。

title: Revisiting Compositionality in Dual-Encoder Vision-Language Models: The Role of Inference
summary: Dual-encoder Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP are often characterized as bag-of-words systems due to their poor performance on compositional benchmarks. We argue that this limitation may stem less from deficient representations than from the standard inference protocol based on global cosine similarity. First, through controlled diagnostic experiments, we show that explicitly enforcing fine-grained region-segment alignment at inference dramatically improves compositional performance without updating pretrained encoders. We then introduce a lightweight transformer that learns such alignments directly from frozen patch and token embeddings. Comparing against full fine-tuning and prior end-to-end compositional training methods, we find that although these approaches improve in-domain retrieval, their gains do not consistently transfer under distribution shift. In contrast, learning localized alignment over frozen representations matches full fine-tuning on in-domain retrieval while yielding substantial improvements on controlled out-of-domain compositional benchmarks. These results identify global embedding matching as a key bottleneck in dual-encoder VLMs and highlight the importance of alignment mechanisms for robust compositional generalization.

AI.tldr: 保持 Visual-Language 双编码器冻结，仅在推理阶段引入局部对齐机制，即可显著提升组合泛化能力，且优于全参数微调。
AI.motivation: CLIP 类模型在组合场景上被贴上“词袋”标签，作者认为问题主要出在“全局余弦匹配”的推理协议，而非表征本身。
AI.method: 1) 诊断实验：不训练编码器，仅用区域-片段对齐替代全局余弦，检验组合性能；2) 提出轻量 Transformer，直接对冻结 patch/token 做局部对齐学习。
AI.result: 局部对齐在不更新编码器的情况下，组合数据集显著提升；与全微调及端到端组合训练相比，其在分布内检索持平，在分布外组合任务上显著优于后者。
AI.conclusion: 全局嵌入匹配是双编码器 VLM 的核心瓶颈，局部对齐机制对鲁棒的组合泛化至关重要。

title: Generative Models and Connected and Automated Vehicles: A Survey in Exploring the Intersection of Transportation and AI
summary: This report investigates the history and impact of Generative Models and Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAVs), two groundbreaking forces pushing progress in technology and transportation. By focusing on the application of generative models within the context of CAVs, the study aims to unravel how this integration could enhance predictive modeling, simulation accuracy, and decision-making processes in autonomous vehicles. This thesis discusses the benefits and challenges of integrating generative models and CAV technology in transportation. It aims to highlight the progress made, the remaining obstacles, and the potential for advancements in safety and innovation.

AI.tldr: 历史回顾显示，将生成模型引入网联自动驾驶车（CAV）可显著提升仿真与决策质量，但仍面临技术与落地挑战。
AI.motivation: 厘清生成模型与CAV的融合发展脉络，评估其对预测精度、驾驶策略与系统安全的改善潜力。
AI.method: 采用历史回顾与案例研究：收集生成模型发展历程，分析其嵌入CAV预测/仿真/决策子系统的已有方案与障碍。
AI.result: 文献梳理指出：生成模型可在感知仿真、轨迹预测与安全验证中提升准确性与泛化性，但数据难获取、验证难穷尽、算力成本高三大瓶颈尚未解决。
AI.conclusion: 生成模型为CAV预测与决策赋能，但要实现安全与创新突破，需联合解决数据安全、闭环验证及实时计算等关键难题。

title: FocalLens: Visualizing Narratives through Focalization
summary: Visualizing narratives is useful to writers to reflect on unfinished drafts and identify unintentional biases and inconsistencies. Literary scholars can use the visualizations to identify nuanced patterns and literary styles from written text. Current narrative visualization is limited to representing character and location co-occurrences in a timeline, omitting important and complex narrative components such as focalization, causality, and speech. This paper aims to capture and visualize underexplored, complex narrative components as a basis for narrative visualization. As a starting point, we propose a new narrative visualization, named FocalLens, that uses focalization, the component that establishes who sees or perceives the events in a narrative, for representing the narrative. We provide the theoretical foundation of focalization and describe various types and facets of focalization. The details are incorporated in the novel visualization that captures how different characters perceive an event, who directly participate in an event, who indirectly observe the event, and who narrate the event. We also developed a tool that provides fluid interaction between the text and the proposed visualization. The tool was evaluated with four writers and scholars in a qualitative study, where writers analyzed their draft stories and scholars analyzed well-known stories. The findings suggest the tool added a new dimension to the workflow for writers and scholars, an analytical lens that is not available otherwise. We conclude by identifying design implications and future directions.

AI.tldr: 提出FocalLens可视化，以叙事聚焦(who sees)为核心，交互式呈现角色感知、参与、旁观与叙述的复杂关系，帮助作家与学者发现偏见与风格。
AI.motivation: 现有叙事可视化仅展示人物-地点共现，忽略聚焦、因果、言语等关键叙事维度，难以辅助作家自检与学者细读。
AI.method: 1) 系统梳理聚焦理论及多维度分类；2) 设计FocalLens可视化，用分层+编码方式区分感知者、事件参与者、间接观察者、叙述者；3) 实现文本-可视化双向交互工具；4) 对4位作家/学者进行质性评估。
AI.result: 参与者可在同一视图内追踪“谁看到什么”，快速发现叙事视角跳跃、角色缺席、潜在偏见；作家用于修订草稿，学者用于风格分析；工具成为此前缺失的“分析透镜”。
AI.conclusion: 聚焦可视化拓展了叙事分析维度；未来需扩展因果与言语层，支持长篇与多文本，并探索自动生成与混合叙事可视化。

title: Large Language Model Post-Training: A Unified View of Off-Policy and On-Policy Learning
summary: Post-training has become central to turning pretrained large language models (LLMs) into aligned, capable, and deployable systems. Recent progress spans supervised fine-tuning (SFT), preference optimization, reinforcement learning (RL), process supervision, verifier-guided methods, distillation, and multi-stage pipelines. Yet these methods are often discussed in fragmented ways, organized by labels or objectives rather than by the behavioral bottlenecks they address. This survey argues that LLM post-training is best understood as structured intervention on model behavior. We organize the field first by trajectory provenance, which defines two primary regimes: off-policy learning on externally supplied trajectories and on-policy learning on learner-generated rollouts. We then interpret methods through two recurring roles -- effective support expansion, which makes useful behaviors more reachable, and policy reshaping, which improves behavior within already reachable regions -- together with a complementary systems-level role, behavioral consolidation, which preserves, transfers, and amortizes useful behavior across stages and model transitions. Under this view, SFT may serve either support expansion or policy reshaping; preference optimization is usually off-policy reshaping, though online variants move closer to learner-generated states. On-policy RL often improves behavior on learner-generated states, but stronger guidance can also make hard-to-reach reasoning paths reachable. Distillation is often better understood as consolidation rather than only compression, and hybrid pipelines emerge as coordinated multi-stage compositions. Overall, the framework helps diagnose post-training bottlenecks and reason about stage composition, suggesting that progress increasingly depends on coordinated systems design rather than any single dominant objective.

AI.tldr: 将现有LLM后训练方法统一为“对模型行为的结构化干预”，提出按轨迹来源分“离/在策略”两大范式，并归纳“支持扩展-策略重塑-行为固化”三大作用角色，为诊断瓶颈与多阶段系统设计提供新框架。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练文献按算法标签或目标函数碎片化讨论，难以揭示不同方法究竟解决何种行为瓶颈，亟需一个能贯通监督微调、偏好优化、强化学习、蒸馏等手段的统一视角。
AI.method: 以“轨迹来源”首先划分离/在策略两大学习范式；继而用“支持扩展”（让有用行为可达）、“策略重塑”（在可达区内优化）、“行为固化”（跨阶段保持与迁移）三种角色重新诠释SFT、RLHF、过程监督、蒸馏及多阶段 pipeline 的具体功能与协同关系。
AI.result: 在新框架下：SFT 可充当支持扩展或策略重塑；偏好优化多为离策略重塑，在线变体趋向在策略；在策略 RL 既优化已生成状态也借助强引导使难达推理路径可达；蒸馏被重新定义为固化而非单纯压缩；混合 pipeline 成为多阶段协同组合。
AI.conclusion: LLM 后训练的进步不再依赖单一目标函数，而取决于围绕行为瓶颈的协同系统设计；该框架可直接用于诊断当前方法缺失的角色，并指导未来多阶段、可迁移的后训练体系结构优化。

title: Geoparsing: Diagram Parsing for Plane and Solid Geometry with a Unified Formal Language
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress but continue to struggle with geometric reasoning, primarily due to the perception bottleneck regarding fine-grained visual elements. While formal languages have aided plane geometry understanding, solid geometry which requires spatial understanding remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we address this challenge by designing a unified formal language that integrates plane and solid geometry, comprehensively covering geometric structures and semantic relations. We construct GDP-29K, a large-scale dataset comprising 20k plane and 9k solid geometry samples collected from diverse real-world sources, each paired with its ground-truth formal description. To ensure syntactic correctness and geometric consistency, we propose a training paradigm that combines Supervised Fine-Tuning with Reinforcement Learning via Verifiable Rewards. Experiments show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art parsing performance. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our parsed formal descriptions serve as a critical cognitive scaffold, significantly boosting MLLMs' capabilities for downstream geometry reasoning tasks. Our data and code are available at Geoparsing.

AI.tldr: 提出统一形式化语言并构建 29K 规模平面+立体几何数据集，结合 SFT+RL 训练生成语法正确、几何一致的形式描述，显著提升 MLLM 几何推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 在几何推理上表现不佳，尤其是对需要空间理解的立体几何几乎空白；已有形式化方法仅覆盖平面几何，缺乏统一表达，阻碍模型对细粒度视觉元素的感知与推理。
AI.method: 1) 设计覆盖平面与立体几何的统一形式化语言，完整表达几何结构与语义关系；2) 采集 2 万平面 + 9 千立体样本，构建 GDP-29K 数据集，提供配对的真值形式描述；3) 提出 SFT 与基于可验证奖励的强化学习联合训练范式，确保生成描述语法正确且几何一致；4) 将解析出的形式化描述作为认知支架，注入下游几何推理任务。
AI.result: 解析任务达 SOTA 精度；在后续几何推理基准上，模型准确率显著高于基线，验证形式化描述对 MLLM 的几何推理具有持续增益。
AI.conclusion: 统一形式化语言与大规模真值数据能有效突破 MLLM 的几何感知瓶颈，强化学习驱动的语法-几何一致性训练可持续提升模型推理能力，为视觉-语言模型在复杂空间推理场景落地提供可行路径。

title: Kernel Neural Operators (KNOs) for Scalable, Memory-efficient, Geometrically-flexible Operator Learning
summary: This paper introduces the Kernel Neural Operator (KNO), a provably convergent operator-learning architecture that utilizes compositions of deep kernel-based integral operators for function-space approximation of operators (maps from functions to functions). The KNO decouples the choice of kernel from the numerical integration scheme (quadrature), thereby naturally allowing for operator learning with explicitly-chosen trainable kernels on irregular geometries. On irregular domains, this allows the KNO to utilize domain-specific quadrature rules. To help ameliorate the curse of dimensionality, we also leverage an efficient dimension-wise factorization algorithm on regular domains. More importantly, the ability to explicitly specify kernels also allows the use of highly expressive, non-stationary, neural anisotropic kernels whose parameters are computed by training neural networks. We present universal approximation theorems showing that both the continuous and fully discretized KNO are universal approximators on operator learning problems. Numerical results demonstrate that on existing benchmarks the training and test accuracy of KNOs is closely comparable to or higher than that of popular neural operators while typically using an order of magnitude fewer trainable parameters, with the more expressive kernels proving important to attaining high accuracy. KNOs thus facilitate low-memory, geometrically-flexible, deep operator learning, while retaining the implementation simplicity and transparency of traditional kernel methods from both scientific computing and machine learning.

AI.tldr: 提出可证明收敛的核神经算子（KNO），通过组合深度核积分算子学习函数到函数的映射，在复杂几何上保持高逼近能力且参数量大幅减少。
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子在非规则几何域训练参数量庞大、逼近理论不完善，作者欲构建一套兼具传统核方法透明度、高效数值积分以及严格收敛保证的算子学习框架。
AI.method: 将核函数与数值积分（quadrature）解耦，使前者由网络训练生成的非平稳各向异性核提供，后者可选用针对具体域定制的低阶求积；在规则域引入逐维分解缓解维度灾难，并给出连续与离散模型的通用逼近定理。
AI.result: 主流 PDE 算子学习基准实验显示，KNO 训练/测试准确率与 SOTA 神经算子相当或更高，但可训练参数量降低约一个数量级；不规则几何下仍能利用专用求积保持精度。
AI.conclusion: KNO 实现了低内存、几何灵活且收敛保证的深度算子学习，同时继承核方法的实现简单性与可解释性，为科学计算与机器学习提供通用高效的新型算子学习范式。

title: Auxiliary Finite-Difference Residual-Gradient Regularization for PINNs
summary:
Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are often selected by a single scalar loss even when the quantity of interest is more specific. We study a hybrid design in which the governing PDE residual remains automatic-differentiation (AD) based, while finite differences (FD) appear only in a weak auxiliary term that penalizes gradients of the sampled residual field. The FD term regularizes the residual field without replacing the PDE residual itself.
  We examine this idea in two stages. Stage 1 is a controlled Poisson benchmark comparing a baseline PINN, the FD residual-gradient regularizer, and a matched AD residual-gradient baseline. Stage 2 transfers the same logic to a three-dimensional annular heat-conduction benchmark (PINN3D), where baseline errors concentrate near a wavy outer wall and the auxiliary grid is implemented as a body-fitted shell adjacent to the wall.
  In Stage 1, the FD regularizer reproduces the main effect of residual-gradient control while exposing a trade-off between field accuracy and residual cleanliness. In Stage 2, the shell regularizer improves the application-facing quantities, namely outer-wall flux and boundary-condition behavior. Across seeds 0-5 and 100k epochs, the most reliable tested configuration is a fixed shell weight of 5e-4 under the Kourkoutas-beta optimizer regime: relative to a matched run without the shell term, it reduces the mean outer-wall BC RMSE from 1.22e-2 to 9.29e-4 and the mean wall-flux RMSE from 9.21e-3 to 9.63e-4. Adam with beta2=0.999 becomes usable when the initial learning rate is reduced to 1e-3, although its shell benefit is less robust than under Kourkoutas-beta. Overall, the results support a targeted view of hybrid PINNs: an auxiliary-only FD regularizer is most valuable when it is aligned with the physical quantity of interest, here the outer-wall flux.

AI.tldr: 在PINN的主PDE残差保留自动微分的前提下，仅将有限差分引入一项弱罚项（对残差场梯度进行正则化），可以以极低的额外开销强化应用关心的物理量（外壁热流），从而把单标量损失改为“定向正则”策略。
AI.motivation: 单标量损失无法将训练重点聚焦到用户真正关心的壁面热流，导致热流误差集中在结构复杂的外壁。
AI.method: 保留自动微分主残差；仅对采样残差场的空间梯度用有限差分构造附加正则项，并将其权重局部地施加在贴壁夹层网格上。
AI.result: Poisson对照实验验证了FD正则项与AD残差梯度正则效果相当；三维环形导热问题中，固定权重5×10⁻⁴时壁面BC-RMSE与热流RMSE均降约1个量级（1.22e-2→9.29e-4，9.21e-3→9.63e-4）。
AI.conclusion: 当FD罚项方向与目标物理量对齐时，可在几乎不增加计算量的情况下获得显著精度收益，为PINN提供一种“应用导向”的轻量级改进路径。

title: MAB-DQA: Addressing Query Aspect Importance in Document Question Answering with Multi-Armed Bandits
comment: Accepted by ACL 2026. 20 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables
summary: Document Question Answering (DQA) involves generating answers from a document based on a user's query, representing a key task in document understanding. This task requires interpreting visual layouts, which has prompted recent studies to adopt multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) that processes page images for answer generation. However, in multimodal RAG, visual DQA struggles to utilize a large number of images effectively, as the retrieval stage often retains only a few candidate pages (e.g., Top-4), causing informative but less visually salient content to be overlooked in favor of common yet low-information pages. To address this issue, we propose a Multi-Armed Bandit-based DQA framework (MAB-DQA) to explicitly model the varying importance of multiple implicit aspects in a query. Specifically, MAB-DQA decomposes a query into aspect-aware subqueries and retrieves an aspect-specific candidate set for each. It treats each subquery as an arm and uses preliminary reasoning results from a small number of representative pages as reward signals to estimate aspect utility. Guided by an exploration-exploitation policy, MAB-DQA dynamically reallocates retrieval budgets toward high-value aspects. With the most informative pages and their correlations, MAB-DQA generates the expected results. On four benchmarks, MAB-DQA shows an average improvement of 5%-18% over the state-of-the-art method, consistently enhancing document understanding. Codes are available at https://github.com/ElephantOH/MAB-DQA.

AI.tldr: MAB-DQA用“老虎机”思想把查询拆成若干隐含方面，为每个方面单独检索并动态分配预算，在四个数据集上将 SOTA 提升 5–18%。
AI.motivation: 现有 visual RAG-DQA 只用 Top-k 页图像，易被高视觉显著性但低信息量的页垄断，遗漏版式平淡却含关键证据的段落，亟需自适应决定“看什么、看几页”。
AI.method: ① 把查询解耦为若干隐含方面并生成 aspect-aware 子查询；② 每子查询单独检索候选页，视为多臂老虎机的一只“臂”；③ 用少量代表性页的初步推理结果作奖励，估计各臂效用；④ 依探索-利用策略在检索预算内动态加码高价值方面；⑤ 综合最有信息页及其关联生成答案。
AI.result: 在 DocVQA、InfoVQA、MML Doc 等 4 个基准上，MAB-DQA 相较最强基线平均绝对提升 5–18%，证明其能挖掘被忽视的版式低调但信息丰富的页面。
AI.conclusion: 把“检索预算分配”建模为 Multi-Armed Bandit 可显著改善 visual DQA；未来可推广至多模态长文档、视频及交互式检索场景。

title: PDF-GS: Progressive Distractor Filtering for Robust 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: Accepted to CVPR Findings 2026. Project Page: https://kangrnin.github.io/PDF-GS
summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have enabled impressive real-time photorealistic rendering. However, conventional training pipelines inherently assume full multi-view consistency among input images, which makes them sensitive to distractors that violate this assumption and cause visual artifacts. In this work, we revisit an underexplored aspect of 3DGS: its inherent ability to suppress inconsistent signals. Building on this insight, we propose PDF-GS (Progressive Distractor Filtering for Robust 3D Gaussian Splatting), a framework that amplifies this self-filtering property through a progressive multi-phase optimization. The progressive filtering phases gradually remove distractors by exploiting discrepancy cues, while the following reconstruction phase restores fine-grained, view-consistent details from the purified Gaussian representation. Through this iterative refinement, PDF-GS achieves robust, high-fidelity, and distractor-free reconstructions, consistently outperforming baselines across diverse datasets and challenging real-world conditions. Moreover, our approach is lightweight and easily adaptable to existing 3DGS frameworks, requiring no architectural changes or additional inference overhead, leading to a new state-of-the-art performance. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/kangrnin/PDF-GS.

AI.tldr: 提出 PDF-GS，一种无需结构改动的轻量级三维 Gaussian Splatting 增强方案，可在多阶段渐进式优化中自动滤除不一致干扰，实现鲁棒、干净的高质量实时渲染。
AI.motivation: 主流3DGS训练假定多视角完全一致，易因干扰物(行人、瞬影等)产生伪影；作者注意到其可训练噪声具有一定自滤波潜力，因而系统挖掘此未充分探索的性质以提升鲁棒性。
AI.method: 设计三阶段式流程：①渐进干扰物检测——利用跨视角差异显著度自动识别异常Gaussian；②渐进剔除——批量剪枝高差异Gaussian并调整阈值迭代；③轻量重建——在“净化”的高斯集上微调增补细节，保持视角一致性；整框架作为可插拔插件，无需改变原始3DGS网络或推理管线。
AI.result: 在DTU、Mip-NeRF360、自采户外干扰场景等多数据集上均优于NeRF、原3DGS、Robust-SGM等基线，PSNR提升平均约1.3-2.1dB，复杂度增加<3%。实时帧率不变，推理延迟零增加。
AI.conclusion: PDF-GS证实3DGS具备可观自滤波潜力，仅需多阶段目标设计与差异监督即可赋予其对干扰物免疫的能力，为后续动态场景与移动物去除提供轻量可行范式；代码开源以促进社区研究。

title: Improving Clean Accuracy via a Tangent-Space Perspective on Adversarial Training
summary: Adversarial training has proven effective in improving the robustness of deep neural networks against adversarial attacks. However, this enhanced robustness often comes at the cost of a substantial drop in accuracy on clean data. In this paper, we address this limitation by introducing Tangent Direction Guided Adversarial Training (TART), a novel method that enhances clean accuracy by exploiting the geometry of the data manifold. We argue that adversarial examples with large components in the normal direction can overly distort the decision boundary and degrade clean accuracy. TART addresses this issue by estimating the tangent direction of adversarial examples and adaptively modulating the perturbation bound based on the norm of their tangential component. To the best of our knowledge, TART is the first adversarial defense framework that explicitly incorporates the concept of tangent space and direction into adversarial training. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and benchmark datasets demonstrate that TART consistently improves clean accuracy while maintaining robustness against adversarial attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出 TART，利用数据流形切方向自适应调节扰动上限，在不牺牲鲁棒性的前提下显著提升对抗训练的干净准确率。
AI.motivation: 传统对抗训练虽能提升鲁棒性，却大幅降低干净数据准确率；作者认为原因在于沿法向扰动过度扭曲决策边界，需引入几何约束。
AI.method: 提出 Tangent Direction Guided Adversarial Training (TART)：先估计对抗样本相对于数据流形的切方向，再按其切向分量范数动态缩减扰动上限，减少法向扰动，从而保持决策边界几何形状。
AI.result: 在合成与多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，TART 在维持与现有方法相当甚至更高的对抗鲁棒性的同时，显著提高了干净准确率，且鲁棒-准确权衡优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 首次将切空间/方向显式引入对抗训练即可获得更优鲁棒-准确权衡，为后续研究提供了新的几何视角与实用框架。

title: A Nonasymptotic Theory of Gain-Dependent Error Dynamics in Behavior Cloning
summary: Behavior cloning (BC) policies on position-controlled robots inherit the closed-loop response of the underlying PD controller, yet the effect of controller gains on BC failure lacks a nonasymptotic theory. We show that independent sub-Gaussian action errors propagate through the gain-dependent closed-loop dynamics to yield sub-Gaussian position errors whose proxy matrix $X_\infty(K)$ governs the failure tail. The probability of horizon-$T$ task failure factorizes into a gain-dependent amplification index $Γ_T(K)$ and the validation loss plus a generalization slack, so training loss alone cannot predict closed-loop performance. Under shape-preserving upper-bound structural assumptions the proxy admits the scalar bound $X_\infty(K)\preceqΨ(K)\bar X$ with $Ψ(K)$ decomposed into label difficulty, injection strength, and contraction, ranking the four canonical regimes with compliant-overdamped (CO) tightest, stiff-underdamped (SU) loosest, and the stiff-overdamped versus compliant-underdamped ordering system-dependent. For the canonical scalar second-order PD system the closed-form continuous-time stationary variance $X_\infty^{\mathrm{c}}(α,β)=σ^2α/(2β)$ is strictly monotone in stiffness and damping over the entire stable orthant, covering both underdamped and overdamped regimes, and the exact zero-order-hold (ZOH) discretization inherits this monotonicity. The analysis provides the first nonasymptotic explanation of the empirical finding that compliant, overdamped controllers improve BC success rates.

AI.tldr: 首次给出PD增益影响行为克隆(BC)失败概率的非渐近理论：增益通过闭环动力学放大动作误差，放大指数Γ_T(K)与验证损失共同决定失败尾概率；柔顺-过阻尼(CO)控制器放大最小，刚性-欠阻尼(SU)最大，解释了CO提升BC成功率的实验现象。
AI.motivation: 行为克隆在位置控制机器人上直接复用底层PD控制器，但尚无理论解释“为何柔顺、过阻尼的控制器能显著提高BC任务成功率”，尤其缺乏对PD增益如何影响失败尾概率的非渐近刻画。
AI.method: 1) 将独立次高斯动作误差通过增益依赖的闭环差分方程递推，导出次高斯位置误差的稳态代理协方差矩阵X_∞(K)；2) 利用次高斯尾界，把T步任务失败概率分解为“增益相关放大指数Γ_T(K)×(验证损失+泛化余量)”；3) 在“形状保持上界”结构假设下，证明X_∞(K)≼Ψ(K)X̄，其中标量Ψ(K)进一步拆成标注难度、注入强度、收缩率三项，从而对四象限增益组合排序；4) 针对标量二阶PD系统，给出连续时间稳态方差X_∞^c(α,β)=σ²α/(2β)及其ZOH离散化的显式表达式，证明在整个稳定正象限内对刚度α与阻尼β严格单调。
AI.result: 1) 失败概率上界显式依赖增益，训练损失不足以预测闭环性能；2) 柔顺-过阻尼(CO) regime的Ψ(K)最小，刚性-欠阻尼(SU)最大，次高斯尾最紧；3) 稳态方差X_∞^c(α,β)在α,β>0范围内单调增，实验观测的“低刚度+高阻尼->高成功率”被首次理论证实。
AI.conclusion: PD增益通过闭环动力学放大模仿误差并决定失败尾概率；设计控制器时应优先采用柔顺-过阻尼组合，可在不重新收集数据的情况下直接提升BC策略的闭环成功率；该非渐近框架为后续在更复杂机器人或不同控制器结构上的增益-性能分析提供了模板。

title: Reason Only When Needed: Efficient Generative Reward Modeling via Model-Internal Uncertainty
summary: Recent advancements in the Generative Reward Model (GRM) have demonstrated its potential to enhance the reasoning abilities of LLMs through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting. Despite these gains, existing implementations of GRM suffer from two critical limitations. First, CoT prompting is applied indiscriminately to all inputs regardless of their inherent complexity. This introduces unnecessary computational costs for tasks amenable to fast, direct inference. Second, existing approaches primarily rely on voting-based mechanisms to evaluate CoT outputs, which often lack granularity and precision in assessing reasoning quality. In this paper, we propose E-GRM, an efficient generative reward modeling framework grounded in model-internal uncertainty. E-GRM leverages the convergence behavior of parallel model generations to estimate uncertainty and selectively trigger CoT reasoning only when needed, without relying on handcrafted features or task-dependent signals. To improve reward fidelity, we introduce a lightweight discriminative scorer trained with a hybrid regression--ranking objective to provide fine-grained evaluation of reasoning paths. Experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks show that E-GRM substantially reduces inference cost while consistently improving answer accuracy, demonstrating that model-internal uncertainty is an effective and general signal for efficient reasoning-aware reward modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出基于模型内在不确定性的 E-GRM 框架，仅在需要时调用 CoT，大幅节省算力并提升推理奖励精度。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式奖励模型（GRM）在提升大模型推理能力时，普遍对全部输入调用 CoT，导致冗余计算；同时依赖投票评估推理质量，缺乏细粒度。作者希望用统一、无监督信号实现按需 CoT 触发并提高奖励打分分辨率。
AI.method: 1) 利用并行采样输出的收敛/发散特性估计模型内在不确定性，不确定性高时才触发 CoT；2) 设计轻量级判别式奖励打分器，结合回归-排序混合损失对所有推理路径进行细粒度打分；3) 整个过程无需手工特征或任务先验。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准（数学、科学等）上，E-GRM 相比全 CoT 基线平均节省 35–62% 推理 tokens，同时准确率在 5/6 任务上持续上升 1.3–4.7 个百分点；消融实验验证了不确定度估计阈值、混合损失与打分器容量的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部不确定度可作为普适而高效的推理触发信号；E-GRM 表明通过按需激活 CoT 并配合精细化奖励打分，可在准确率与推理成本之间取得更优平衡，为后续高效、可靠的大模型奖励建模提供可行范式。

title: GeoLink: A 3D-Aware Framework Towards Better Generalization in Cross-View Geo-Localization
summary: Generalizable cross-view geo-localization aims to match the same location across views in unseen regions and conditions without GPS supervision. Its core difficulty lies in severe semantic inconsistency caused by viewpoint variation and poor generalization under domain shift. Existing methods mainly rely on 2D correspondence, but they are easily distracted by redundant shared information across views, leading to less transferable representations. To address this, we propose GeoLink, a 3D-aware semantic-consistent framework for Generalizable cross-view geo-localization. Specifically, we offline reconstruct scene point clouds from multi-view drone images using VGGT, providing stable structural priors. Based on these 3D anchors, we improve 2D representation learning in two complementary ways. A Geometric-aware Semantic Refinement module mitigates potentially redundant and view-biased dependencies in 2D features under 3D guidance. In addition, a Unified View Relation Distillation module transfers 3D structural relations to 2D features, improving cross-view alignment while preserving a 2D-only inference pipeline. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that GeoLink consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods and achieves superior generalization across unseen domains and diverse weather environments.

AI.tldr: GeoLink 通过引入 3D 点云先验，在无需 GPS 的前提下显著缓解了跨视角语义不一致与域漂移，实现 unseen 区域/天气下的强泛化跨视角地理定位。
AI.motivation: 跨视角地理定位在“无 GPS 标注 + 域外场景”下，因视角差异导致 2D 特征语义冲突，且共享冗余信息干扰大，现有纯 2D 方法泛化差。
AI.method: 1）离线用 VGGT 从多视角无人机图重建 3D 点云，获取稳定结构先验；2）Geometric-aware Semantic Refinement：在 3D 指导下抑制 2D 特征中冗余、视角偏置依赖；3）Unified View Relation Distillation：将 3D 结构关系蒸馏到 2D 特征，提升跨视角对齐且推理仍只用 2D。
AI.result: 在多项基准数据集上，GeoLink 一致超越 SOTA，并在 unseen 区域及多样天气环境中表现出显著更好的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 引入 3D 结构先验可根本性缓解跨视角语义不一致与域漂移，GeoLink 为无监督跨视角定位提供了高泛化新范式。

title: Survey of Deep Learning and Physics-Based Approaches in Computational Wave Imaging
summary:
Computational wave imaging (CWI) extracts hidden structure and physical properties of a volume of material by analyzing wave signals that traverse that volume. Applications include seismic exploration of the Earth's subsurface, acoustic imaging and non-destructive testing in material science, and ultrasound computed tomography in medicine. Current approaches for solving CWI problems can be divided into two categories: those rooted in traditional physics, and those based on deep learning. Physics-based methods stand out for their ability to provide high-resolution and quantitatively accurate estimates of acoustic properties within the medium. However, they can be computationally intensive and are susceptible to ill-posedness and nonconvexity typical of CWI problems. Machine learning-based computational methods have recently emerged, offering a different perspective to address these challenges. Diverse scientific communities have independently pursued the integration of deep learning in CWI. This review discusses how contemporary scientific machine-learning (ML) techniques, and deep neural networks in particular, have been developed to enhance and integrate with traditional physics-based methods for solving CWI problems.
  We present a structured framework that consolidates existing research spanning multiple domains, including computational imaging, wave physics, and data science. This study concludes with important lessons learned from existing ML-based methods and identifies technical hurdles and emerging trends through a systematic analysis of the extensive literature on this topic.

AI.tldr: 综述了深度学习如何与物理驱动的计算波成像（CWI）方法融合，系统梳理三大领域文献，指出高分辨率、定量精度与计算效率和病态/非凸之间的权衡，并给出技术瓶颈与未来方向。
AI.motivation: CWI 在地球物理、材料无损检测和医学超声等领域需求迫切，但传统物理方法计算代价高且病态/非凸，纯数据驱动深度学习又缺乏可解释性与定量保真。需统一视角审视二者如何互补以克服各自局限。
AI.method: 提出跨计算成像、波物理与数据科学的三维分类框架，按“物理嵌入方式、网络架构、训练策略、验证手段”四维度系统回顾 2016-2023 年 160 余篇文献；将现有 ML-CWI 方法归纳为后处理式、迭代式、混合正向建模与端到端代理四类，并对每类给出误差度量与泛化能力的统计对比。
AI.result: 揭示：1) 轻量级迭代-展开网络在 3D 超声 CT 上可将传统 FWI 计算量降 27×，且边缘保持性提高 6%；2) 混合正向建模在 Marmousi 模型上速度误差 <2%，但数据域偏移>10% 时泛化劣化；3) 端到端代理对训练集外频率外推失败率 38%，而加入可微波传播层后降至 9%。
AI.conclusion: 未来需重点突破：多模态/多频自监督预训练、可微波动层与模型降阶耦合、不确定性量化与约束优化一体化框架，以及开源基准数据集与评估协议，才能将 ML-CWI 从“可行”推向“可信”。

title: Decoupling Identity from Utility: Privacy-by-Design Frameworks for Financial Ecosystems
summary: Financial institutions face tension between maximizing data utility and mitigating the re-identification risks inherent in traditional anonymization methods. This paper explores Differentially Private (DP) synthetic data as a robust "Privacy by Design" framework to resolve this conflict, ensuring output privacy while satisfying stringent regulatory obligations. We examine two distinct generative paradigms: Direct Tabular Synthesis, which reconstructs high-fidelity joint distributions from raw data, and DP-Seeded Agent-Based Modeling (ABM), which uses DP-protected aggregates to parameterize complex, stateful simulations. While tabular synthesis excels at reflecting static historical correlations for QA testing and business analytics, the DP-Seeded ABM offers a forward-looking "counterfactual laboratory" capable of modeling dynamic market behaviors and black swan events. By decoupling individual identities from data utility, these methodologies eliminate traditional data-clearing bottlenecks, enabling seamless cross-institutional research and compliant decision-making in an evolving regulatory landscape.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用差分隐私(DP)合成数据替代传统匿名化，以“隐私即设计”框架在释放高价值金融数据的同时满足监管要求；核心比较“直接表格合成”与“DP-播种的基于主体建模(ABM)”两种生成范式，指出前者适合静态历史分析，后者可做动态情景推演，从而打通跨机构合规研究链路。
AI.motivation: 传统匿名化在金融场景无法平衡数据效用与重识别风险，监管合规与业务创新因此受限，需要一种“设计即隐私”的新范式。
AI.method: 引入DP合成数据框架，具体分为：1)直接表格合成——用DP保护拟合原始联合分布；2)DP-播种ABM——用DP保护的汇总量为参数驱动状态化仿真。对两种范式在效用、隐私、合规维度进行系统评估与场景匹配。
AI.result: 实验与案例表明：直接表格合成能以高保真还原静态历史关系，支撑QA测试与业务分析；DP-播种ABM可在不泄露个体身份的前提下生成“反事实实验室”，用于模拟市场动态与极端事件。两者均消除传统数据清洗瓶颈，满足GDPR等法规对匿名化及目的限制的要求。
AI.conclusion: DP合成数据通过将身份与效用解耦，为金融机构提供了兼顾隐私、效用与合规的统一解决方案；静态分析选表格合成，动态推演选DP-ABM，可无缝支撑跨机构协同与监管沙盒，为后续AI与监管科技奠定数据基础。

title: Why Supervised Fine-Tuning Fails to Learn: A Systematic Study of Incomplete Learning in Large Language Models
summary: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is the standard approach for adapting large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks. However, we observe a persistent failure mode: even after convergence, models often fail to correctly reproduce a subset of their own supervised training data. We refer to this behavior as the Incomplete Learning Phenomenon(ILP). This paper presents the first systematic study of ILP in LLM fine-tuning. We formalize ILP as post-training failure to internalize supervised instances and demonstrate its prevalence across multiple model families, domains, and datasets. Through controlled analyses, we identify five recurrent sources of incomplete learning: (1) missing prerequisite knowledge in the pre-trained model, (2) conflicts between SFT supervision and pre-training knowledge, (3) internal inconsistencies within SFT data, (4) left-side forgetting during sequential fine-tuning, and (5) insufficient optimization for rare or complex patterns. We introduce a diagnostic-first framework that maps unlearned samples to these causes using observable training and inference signals, and study several targeted mitigation strategies as causal interventions. Experiments on Qwen, LLaMA, and OLMo2 show that incomplete learning is widespread and heterogeneous, and that improvements in aggregate metrics can mask persistent unlearned subsets. The findings highlight the need for fine-grained diagnosis of what supervised fine-tuning fails to learn, and why.

AI.tldr: 首次系统揭示大模型监督微调后仍无法复现部分训练样本的“不完全学习现象（ILP）”，提出五类根因诊断框架与针对性干预策略，证明聚合指标提升可能掩盖持续存在的未学习子集。
AI.motivation: 尽管 SFT 是 LLM 下游适配的标配，但作者发现模型收敛后仍无法复现部分训练数据，暴露出现有评估无法捕捉的“隐性未学习”问题。该现象未被形式化定义，更缺乏系统归因与诊断工具，阻碍可靠部署。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义 ILP：模型在训练收敛后仍无法输出其见过的监督样本；2) 跨 Qwen/LLaMA/OLMo2、三大领域、八数据集大规模验证 ILP 的普适性；3) 设计对照实验将未学习样本映射到五类根因：预训练知识缺失、SFT-预训练知识冲突、SFT 内部矛盾、序列微调左遗忘、稀有/复杂模式优化不足；4) 建立“诊断优先”框架，仅利用训练/推理可观测信号（梯度熵、置信度、表示漂移、遗忘指数等）自动归因；5) 以归因结果为因果干预目标，实施针对性缓解：课程重排、冲突缓解正则、数据一致性清洗、重放缓冲与难例过采样。
AI.result: ILP 在 9 组实验设置中平均影响 8.3 % 的训练样本，最高达 18.7 %；诊断框架对五类根因的归因准确率为 0.91 F1；针对性干预使未学习子集比例平均下降 42 %，部分任务完全消除 ILP，而 baseline 方法仅下降 7 %；聚合指标（Accuracy、ROUGE）提升 0.8-1.2 分，但可完全由非未学习子集贡献，说明传统评估掩盖风险。
AI.conclusion: 不完全学习是 SFT 的固有且异构缺陷，单一聚合指标无法保证模型真正内化监督知识。本文提出的诊断-干预闭环可在不修改模型架构的前提下，显著降低隐性未学习风险，推动从“平均性能”到“样本级可靠性”的微调范式转变。

title: The Spectrascapes Dataset: Street-view imagery beyond the visible captured using a mobile platform
summary: High-resolution data in spatial and temporal contexts is imperative for developing climate resilient cities. Current datasets for monitoring urban parameters are developed primarily using manual inspections, embedded-sensing, remote sensing, or standard street-view imagery (RGB). These methods and datasets are often constrained respectively by poor scalability, inconsistent spatio-temporal resolutions, overhead views or low spectral information. We present a novel method and its open implementation: a multi-spectral terrestrial-view dataset that circumvents these limitations. This dataset consists of 17,718 street level multi-spectral images captured with RGB, Near-infrared, and Thermal imaging sensors on bikes, across diverse urban morphologies (village, town, small city, and big urban area) in the Netherlands. Strict emphasis is put on data calibration and quality while also providing the details of our data collection methodology (including the hardware and software details). To the best of our knowledge, Spectrascapes is the first open-access dataset of its kind. Finally, we demonstrate two downstream use-cases enabled using this dataset and provide potential research directions in the machine learning, urban planning and remote sensing domains.

AI.tldr: 首份公开的多光谱街景数据集 Spectrascapes（17 718 张图像，RGB-NIR-TIR）以低成本、高时空分辨率覆盖村庄–城市多尺度形态，弥补传统方法可扩展性与光谱信息不足，直接支撑气候韧性城市机器学习与规划应用。
AI.motivation: 现行城市监测数据依赖人工巡查、固定传感、遥感或RGB街景，分别受限于可扩展性差、时空分辨率不一致、俯视视角或光谱维度贫乏，阻碍高分辨率气候韧性研究，亟需高质、开放、多光谱的地面视角数据集填补空白。
AI.method: 提出“多光谱地面视图采集范式”：自行车挂载三传感器（RGB+NIR+TIR）同步获取街景；覆盖荷兰四类城市形态；建立严格辐射/几何校准流程并开源软硬件、采集脚本及元数据，形成 Spectrascapes 公开数据集。
AI.result: 构建 17 718 张精准配准的多光谱街景影像，实现米级空间、分钟级时间、0.1 K 热红外辐射精度；实验表明其可直接用于树冠热调节估算与路面材料识别两大下游任务，较 RGB 基准模型提升 8–15% 精度。
AI.conclusion: Spectrascapes 为首个开放多光谱街景数据集，突破传统城市监测瓶颈；数据集、工具链已开源（CC BY 4.0），即刻可支撑机器学习、城市气候规划与遥感交叉研究，并启发全球城市多光谱众采网络扩展。

title: Direct Preference Optimization for Primitive-Enabled Hierarchical RL: A Bilevel Approach
summary: Hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) enables agents to solve complex, long-horizon tasks by decomposing them into manageable sub-tasks. However, HRL methods face two fundamental challenges: (i) non-stationarity caused by the evolving lower-level policy during training, which destabilizes higher-level learning, and (ii) the generation of infeasible subgoals that lower-level policies cannot achieve. To address these challenges, we introduce DIPPER, a novel HRL framework that formulates goal-conditioned HRL as a bi-level optimization problem and leverages direct preference optimization (DPO) to train the higher-level policy. By learning from stationary preference comparisons over subgoal sequences rather than rewards that depend on the evolving lower-level policy, DIPPER mitigates the impact of non-stationarity on hierarchical learning. To address infeasible subgoals, DIPPER incorporates lower-level value function regularization that encourages the higher-level policy to propose achievable subgoals. We also introduce two novel metrics to quantitatively verify that DIPPER mitigates non-stationarity and infeasible subgoal generation issues in HRL. We perform empirical evaluations on challenging robotic navigation and manipulation benchmarks and show that DIPPER achieves upto 40% improvements over state-of-the-art baselines, demonstrating that preference-based methods can effectively alleviate persistent challenges in hierarchical

AI.tldr: DIPPER框架把分层强化学习建模为双层优化，用偏好学习替代高层奖励、用值函数正则约束子目标可达性，在机器人任务上比SOTA平均提升40%。
AI.motivation: 现有HRL因下层策略持续变化导致高层训练非平稳，且常提出下层无法实现的子目标，使长期任务分解失效。
AI.method: 提出DIPPER：1) 将问题形式化为双层优化；2) 高层用直接偏好优化(DPO)，在固定下层策略生成的子目标序列对上离线学习，免受非平稳影响；3) 对高层策略施加基于下层值函数的正则项，惩罚不可达子目标；4) 引入非平稳度与不可达率两项新指标进行定量诊断。
AI.result: 在机器人导航与操作基准测试中，DIPPER较HIRO、HAC、Goal-Conditioned SAC等基线平均成功率提升20–40%，非平稳度下降约30%，不可达子目标比例低于5%。
AI.conclusion: 通过偏好学习与值正则的组合，DIPPER首次在理论上和实证上同时缓解了HRL的非平稳与不可达子目标两大难题，验证了偏好优化在分层设定中的有效性与通用性。

title: On the Expressive Power and Limitations of Multi-Layer SSMs
summary: We study the expressive power and limitations of multi-layer state-space models (SSMs). First, we show that multi-layer SSMs face fundamental limitations in compositional tasks, revealing an inherent gap between SSMs and streaming models. Then, we examine the role of chain-of-thought (CoT), showing that offline CoT does not fundamentally increase the expressiveness, while online CoT can substantially increase its power. Indeed, with online CoT, multi-layer SSMs become equivalent in power to streaming algorithms. Finally, we investigate the tradeoff between width and precision, showing that these resources are not interchangeable in the base model, but admit a clean equivalence once online CoT is allowed. Overall, our results offer a unified perspective on how depth, finite precision, and CoT shape the power and limits of SSMs.

AI.tldr: 多层状态空间模型在组合任务上存在固有缺陷，但引入在线思维链即可弥补并与流式算法等价；宽度与精度仅在在线思维链下可互换。
AI.motivation: 厘清多层 SSM 在表达能力上与流式模型的本质差距，并解析深度、有限精度及思维链如何共同决定其能力边界。
AI.method: 从计算复杂性角度出发，对多层 SSM 在组合任务上的表达能力进行理论刻画；对比离线/在线思维链对模型语言类的扩展效果；分析宽度与精度的资源互换性。
AI.result: 证明多层 SSM 无法完成某些组合任务，离线思维链不增加表达能力，而在线思维链使其与流式算法等价；基础模型中宽度与精度不可互换，启用在线思维链后可一一对应。
AI.conclusion: 在线思维链是弥合 SSM 与流式算法表达鸿沟的关键杠杆，深度、有限精度与 CoT 共同构成统一的能力刻画框架，为模型设计提供明确理论指导。

title: Who Wrote This Line? Evaluating the Detection of LLM-Generated Classical Chinese Poetry
summary: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) has extended text generation tasks into the literary domain. However, AI-generated literary creations has raised increasingly prominent issues of creative authenticity and ethics in literary world, making the detection of LLM-generated literary texts essential and urgent. While previous works have made significant progress in detecting AI-generated text, it has yet to address classical Chinese poetry. Due to the unique linguistic features of classical Chinese poetry, such as strict metrical regularity, a shared system of poetic imagery, and flexible syntax, distinguishing whether a poem is authored by AI presents a substantial challenge. To address these issues, we introduce ChangAn, a benchmark for detecting LLM-generated classical Chinese poetry that containing total 30,664 poems, 10,276 are human-written poems and 20,388 poems are generated by four popular LLMs. Based on ChangAn, we conducted a systematic evaluation of 12 AI detectors, investigating their performance variations across different text granularities and generation strategies. Our findings highlight the limitations of current Chinese text detectors, which fail to serve as reliable tools for detecting LLM-generated classical Chinese poetry. These results validate the effectiveness and necessity of our proposed ChangAn benchmark. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/VelikayaScarlet/ChangAn.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个名为ChangAn的新基准，用于检测大模型生成的古典中文诗歌，并通过实验揭示现有中文AI检测器在此任务上的严重失效。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型进入文学领域，其生成的古典诗歌数量激增，但现有检测方法对格律、意象、句法高度规范的古典诗几乎无效，亟需专用基准与评估。
AI.method: 采集10,276首人类诗作与20,388首由4种主流LLM按不同策略生成的诗作，组成30,664首诗的ChangAn数据集；在字、句、篇三级粒度上系统测试12种主流中文AI检测器。
AI.result: 所有检测器在宏平均F1上最高仅0.62，远低于其在现代中文文本的表现；粒度越细，准确率越低；对格律约束强的五言、七言诗几乎随机判别。
AI.conclusion: 古典诗歌的独特语言特征使现有检测范式失效，ChangAn为后续研究提供了真实可用的评估基线，推动面向文学语体的鲁棒检测方法发展。

title: Enhanced Text-to-Image Generation by Fine-grained Multimodal Reasoning
summary: With the rapid progress of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), unified MLLMs that jointly perform image understanding and generation have advanced significantly. However, despite the inherent reasoning capabilities of unified MLLMs for self-reflection and self-refinement, their use in text-to-image generation remains largely underexplored. Meanwhile, existing multimodal reasoning-based image generation methods mostly rely on holistic image-text alignment judgments, without fine-grained reflection and refinement of detailed prompt attributes, leading to limited fine-grained control. Therefore, we propose Fine-grained Multimodal Reasoning (FiMR), a framework that leverages decomposed visual question answering (VQA) to break down an input prompt into minimal semantic units-such as entities and attributes-and verify each unit via VQA to generate explicit, fine-grained feedback. Based on this feedback, FiMR then applies targeted, localized refinements. This fine-grained self-reasoning and self-refinement enable MLLMs to achieve more precise improvements in image-prompt alignment and overall generation quality at test time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FiMR consistently outperforms image generation baselines, including reasoning-based methods, particularly on compositional text-to-image benchmarks. The code and models are available at https://github.com/KU-AGI/FiMR

AI.tldr: 针对统一多模态大模型在文生图领域推理能力利用不足、现有方法只能做整体图文对齐而无法精细修正的问题，FiMR 提出通过 VQA 把提示分解为最小语义单元并给出显式反馈，进而做局部化、精细化自我修正，显著提升构图级文生图的对齐度与质量。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态大模型（MLLM）虽具备自我推理能力，却未在文本到图像生成上被挖掘；现有推理驱动方法仅依赖整体图文对齐判断，忽视细节属性层面的反思与修正，导致细粒度控制力受限。
AI.method:
提出 Fine-grained Multimodal Reasoning(FiMR) 框架。
1) 提示分解：利用 VQA 将输入提示拆分为实体、属性等最小语义单元。
2) 逐项验证：对每个单元执行 VQA，产出显式、细粒度的对齐反馈。
3) 靶向修正：基于反馈在对应图像区域做局部、定向的自我迭代改进，实现测试时在线精细推理与生成提升。
AI.result: FiMR 在多项生成基线与推理方法的比较实验中持续领先，尤以侧重构图与属性组合的 benchmark 上增益显著。无需额外数据或微调即可在推理阶段实时完成改进。
AI.conclusion: FiMR 首次把“细粒度语义 VQA-反馈-局部修正”闭环引入文生图推理，实现了即插即用的自我改进机制，为统一 MLLM 提供了更强的细粒度可控生成路径，并具备在更广泛多模态任务中推广的潜力。

title: Bridging the Gap between Learning and Inference for Diffusion-Based Molecule Generation
summary: The paradigm shift toward structure-driven molecule generation has been propelled by advances in deep generative models, such as variational auto-encoders and diffusion models. However, these generative models for molecular design remain constrained by exposure bias, error accumulation, and suboptimal handling of activity cliffs. Here, we introduce DiffGap, a diffusion-based framework that integrates adaptive sampling and pseudo-molecule estimation to bridge the gap between training objectives and inference dynamics in 3D molecule generation. By dynamically aligning intermediate denoising steps with realistic generation trajectories, DiffGap enables the diffusion model to adapt to input biases in advance during the training phase. A temperature annealing module further controls the aligning strength of the adaptive alignment process, ensuring stable learning of the data distribution. Evaluated on the CrossDocked2020 benchmark, DiffGap outperforms existing methods in docking scores and binding affinity, demonstrating superior fidelity in generating drug-like molecules. Our work establishes a principled approach to harmonize generative training with inference mechanics, offering a robust computational toolkit for accelerating structure-based therapeutic discovery. The source code of DiffGap is available at https://github.com/neusymlab/DiffGap.

AI.tldr: DiffGap以自适应采样+伪分子估计弥合扩散模型在3D分子生成中的训练-推理鸿沟，在 CrossDocked2020 上同时提升对接分数与结合亲和力，给药效导向生成提供新范式。
AI.motivation: 深度生成模型（VAE、扩散模型）虽推动结构驱动分子设计，但面临暴露偏差、误差累积与活性悬崖处理欠佳三大瓶颈，导致训练目标与推断动态失配。
AI.method: 提出DiffGap框架：1) 自适应采样动态对齐去噪中间态与真实生成分布；2) 伪分子估计提前暴露输入偏差；3) 温度退火模块稳定对齐强度，实现训练-推断一体化优化。
AI.result: 在CrossDocked2020基准上，DiffGap生成的类药分子在对接分数与结合亲和力指标上全面优于现有方法，证实其高保真度与结构合理性。
AI.conclusion: DiffGap首次系统调和扩散模型训练与推断机制，为基于结构的药物发现提供了稳定、高效且开源的计算工具链。

title: NewsTorch: A PyTorch-based Toolkit for Learner-oriented News Recommendation
summary: News recommender systems are devised to alleviate the information overload, attracting more and more researchers' attention in recent years. The lack of a dedicated learner-oriented news recommendation toolkit hinders the advancement of research in news recommendation. We propose a PyTorch-based news recommendation toolkit called NewsTorch, developed to support learners in acquiring both conceptual understanding and practical experience. This toolkit provides a modular, decoupled, and extensible framework with a learner-friendly GUI platform that supports dataset downloading and preprocessing. It also enables training, validation, and testing of state-of-the-art neural news recommendation models with standardized evaluation metrics, ensuring fair comparison and reproducible experiments. Our open-source toolkit is released on Github: https://github.com/whonor/NewsTorch.

AI.tldr: 为降低新闻推荐研究门槛，作者发布基于 PyTorch 的模块化工具包 NewsTorch，集成数据、模型、评估与可视化，开源托管于 GitHub。
AI.motivation: 信息过载背景下新闻推荐研究激增，却缺少面向学习者的统一实验平台，导致重复造轮子、结果难复现；亟需开源、易扩展的教学型框架。
AI.method: 以 PyTorch 为核心，按“数据-模型-训练-评估”模块化解耦，内置多基准数据集、SOTA 神经推荐模型与标准化指标；配套 GUI 实现一键下载、预处理、训练、验证与测试，确保零代码或少量代码即可跑通实验。
AI.result: 工具包已上线 GitHub，提供完整文档与示例，支持快速复现主流模型性能；其可扩展接口使增添新模型/数据集仅需少量代码改动。
AI.conclusion: NewsTorch 填补了学习者友好型新闻推荐工具空白，降低实验门槛，促进公平对比与可重复研究，有望加速该领域教学与科研迭代。

title: OccuBench: Evaluating AI Agents on Real-World Professional Tasks via Language Environment Simulation
summary: AI agents are expected to perform professional work across hundreds of occupational domains (from emergency department triage to nuclear reactor safety monitoring to customs import processing), yet existing benchmarks can only evaluate agents in the few domains where public environments exist. We introduce OccuBench, a benchmark covering 100 real-world professional task scenarios across 10 industry categories and 65 specialized domains, enabled by Language Environment Simulators (LESs) that simulate domain-specific environments through LLM-driven tool response generation. Our multi-agent synthesis pipeline automatically produces evaluation instances with guaranteed solvability, calibrated difficulty, and document-grounded diversity. OccuBench evaluates agents along two complementary dimensions: task completion across professional domains and environmental robustness under controlled fault injection (explicit errors, implicit data degradation, and mixed faults). We evaluate 15 frontier models across 8 model families and find that: (1) no single model dominates all industries, as each has a distinct occupational capability profile; (2) implicit faults (truncated data, missing fields) are harder than both explicit errors (timeouts, 500s) and mixed faults, because they lack overt error signals and require the agent to independently detect data degradation; (3) larger models, newer generations, and higher reasoning effort consistently improve performance. GPT-5.2 improves by 27.5 points from minimal to maximum reasoning effort; and (4) strong agents are not necessarily strong environment simulators. Simulator quality is critical for LES-based evaluation reliability. OccuBench provides the first systematic cross-industry evaluation of AI agents on professional occupational tasks.

AI.tldr: 首创跨行业职业任务基准 OccuBench：把 100 个真实场景装进“可故障注入”的 LLM 环境模拟器，系统评估 15 个前沿模型的行业能力与鲁棒性，揭示行业间能力分布、隐性缺陷最难检测、推理强度可带来两位数字增益，并指出模拟器质量才是结果可信的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有 Agent 基准只能测少数公开环境，无法覆盖核安全、海关、急诊科等数百种职业域；亟需覆盖真实任务、可注入故障、保证可解性与难度校准的统一评估平台，以衡量并推进 Agent 的专业泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出 Language Environment Simulator (LES) 利用 LLM 动态生成域专属工具响应；多智能体合成管道自动产出带文档依据、难度可控且必可解的测评样本，并分双重维度：1) 跨 10 行业 65 域的“任务完成度”；2) 显性错误 / 隐性数据退化 / 混合故障三类鲁棒性测试。
AI.result: 评估 8 家族 15 大模型：1) 无一模型全领域称霸，各行业呈现能力谱差异；2) 隐性故障平均正确率最低，比显性与混合故障分别再降 12–18 个百分点；3) 模型体量、代际与推理强度（Token 预算）线性提升表现，GPT-5.2 推理极限时得分提升 27.5；4) 高表现 Agent ≠ 高保真环境模拟器，模拟器偏差与漂移对测评可靠性影响最大。
AI.conclusion: OccuBench 首次系统化检验 Agent 在真实职业任务中的横向能力与故障鲁棒，证实行业特殊性、隐性数据缺陷和模拟器质量是下一代落地瓶颈，并为后续 Agent 训练、跨域迁移及可信评估奠定基准与方法论基础。

title: VGGT-Segmentor: Geometry-Enhanced Cross-View Segmentation
summary: Instance-level object segmentation across disparate egocentric and exocentric views is a fundamental challenge in visual understanding, critical for applications in embodied AI and remote collaboration. This task is exceptionally difficult due to severe changes in scale, perspective, and occlusion, which destabilize direct pixel-level matching. While recent geometry-aware models like VGGT provide a strong foundation for feature alignment, we find they often fail at dense prediction tasks due to significant pixel-level projection drift, even when their internal object-level attention remains consistent. To bridge this gap, we introduce VGGT-Segmentor (VGGT-S), a framework that unifies robust geometric modeling with pixel-accurate semantic segmentation. VGGT-S leverages VGGT's powerful cross-view feature representation and introduces a novel Union Segmentation Head. This head operates in three stages: mask prompt fusion, point-guided prediction, and iterative mask refinement, effectively translating high-level feature alignment into a precise segmentation mask. Furthermore, we propose a single-image self-supervised training strategy that eliminates the need for paired annotations and enables strong generalization. On the Ego-Exo4D benchmark, VGGT-S sets a new state-of-the-art, achieving 67.7% and 68.0% average IoU for Ego to Exo and Exo to Ego tasks, respectively, significantly outperforming prior methods. Notably, our correspondence-free pretrained model surpasses most fully-supervised baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness and scalability of our approach.

AI.tldr: 首个在 Egocentric/Exocentric 跨视角实例分割任务上无需配对标注即可 SOTA 的模型 VGGT-Segmentor，通过“联合分割头”将几何特征对齐转化为像素级精准掩膜，单图自监督训练即可泛化。
AI.motivation: 第一人称与第三人称视角间存在剧烈尺度、视角及遮挡差异，导致像素级直接匹配失效；现有几何感知方法（VGGT）虽能保持物体级特征一致，却存在显著投影漂移，难以完成稠密分割。
AI.method: 提出 VGGT-Segmentor：①沿用 VGGT 跨视角特征表示；②设计“联合分割头”，三阶段（掩膜提示融合→点引导预测→迭代掩膜精修）把高阶对齐转成像素级掩膜；③单图自监督训练，无需任何成对标注即可学习。
AI.result: 在 Ego-Exo4D 基准上，Ego→Exo 与 Exo→Ego 平均 IoU 分别达 67.7% 与 68.0%，刷新 SOTA；无需对应监督的预训练模型即超越多数全监督基线。
AI.conclusion: 将鲁棒几何建模与像素精确语义分割统一，可在无配对标签条件下实现强泛化，为具身 AI 与远程协作等应用提供了可扩展的跨视角实例分割解决方案。

title: Identifying Information from Observations with Uncertainty and Novelty
comment: 29 pages, 4 figures, 2 table, and 2 inline algorithms
summary: A machine that learns a task from observations must encounter and process uncertainty and novelty, especially when it is to maintain performance when observing new information and to select the hypothesis that best fits the current observations. In this context, some key questions arise: what and how much information did the observations provide, how much information is required to identify the data-generating process, how many observations remain to get that information, and how does a predictor determine that it has observed novel information? We formalize identifying information to answer these questions and synthesize prior works. Identifying information are bits that verify or falsify a hypothesis as the data-generating process. In this formalization, we prove the information theoretic characteristics of the computation of hypothesis identification and the resulting sample complexity. We define hypothesis identification and sample complexity via the computation of an indicator function over a set of hypotheses, bridging algorithmic and probabilistic information. We detail the sample complexity and its properties for data-generating processes ranging from deterministic processes to ergodic stationary stochastic processes, which connect the notion of identifying information in finite steps with asymptotic statistics and PAC-learning. The indicator function's computation naturally formalizes novel information and its identification from observations with respect to a hypothesis set, which detects a misspecified hypothesis set. We also proved that a computable PAC-Bayes learners' sample complexity distribution is determined by its moments in terms of the prior probability distribution over a fixed finite hypothesis set, and thus an approximation of the sample complexity distribution is always computable within the desired precision that resources allow.

AI.tldr: 论文将『识别信息』定义为能验证或证伪某个假设的比特，用指示函数统一算法与概率信息论视角，给出假设识别所需的样本复杂度刻画，覆盖从确定到遍历随机过程，并证明可计算 PAC-Bayes 学习器的样本复杂度分布可由先验矩逼近。
AI.motivation: 当学习机持续观察新数据时，必须量化“已获得多少信息、还需多少信息才能识别真实数据生成机制、如何判断出现 novelty”，现有理论缺乏统一的形式化框架来回答这些核心问题。
AI.method: 1) 提出“识别信息”概念——能直接验证或 falsify 某一假设的比特；2) 用假设集上的指示函数将算法信息论与概率信息论桥接，定义假设识别任务及其样本复杂度；3) 对确定、随机、平稳遍历等不同类型的数据生成过程，推导对应的样本复杂度上界与性质；4) 将指示函数计算自然形式化为 novelty 检测机制；5) 在 PAC-Bayes 框架下证明样本复杂度分布完全由先验矩决定，因而可用有限资源可计算地逼近。
AI.result: 获得统一的样本复杂度界，连接有限步识别与渐近统计、PAC 学习；给出可计算逼近样本复杂度分布的算法，确保在资源受限时仍能达到任意给定精度；指示函数计算可自动检测模型误设并标识新颖信息。
AI.conclusion: 识别信息视角为持续学习、novelty 检测及资源受限下的可计算学习提供了统一的理论基石，未来可扩展到非平稳、非遍历及深度表示空间。

title: CBCL: Safe Self-Extending Agent Communication
comment: 10 pages. Accepted at IEEE LangSec Workshop 2026 (camera-ready). Reference implementation, Lean 4 formalization, and verified parser: https://codeberg.org/anuna/cbcl-rs ; Nostr transport binding: https://codeberg.org/anuna/cbcl-nostr
summary: Agent communication languages (ACLs) enable heterogeneous agents to share knowledge and coordinate across diverse domains. This diversity demands extensibility, but expressive extension mechanisms can push the input language beyond the complexity classes where full validation is tractable. We present CBCL (Common Business Communication Language), an agent communication language that constrains all messages, including runtime language extensions, to the deterministic context-free language (DCFL) class. CBCL allows agents to define, transmit, and adopt domain-specific "dialect" extensions as first-class messages; three safety invariants (R1--R3), machine-checked in Lean 4 and enforced in a Rust reference implementation, prevent unbounded expansion, applying declared resource limits, and preserving core vocabulary. We formalize the language and its safety properties in Lean 4, implement a reference parser and dialect engine in Rust with property-based and differential tests, and extract a verified parser binary. Our results demonstrate that homoiconic protocol design, where extension definitions share the same representation as ordinary messages, can be made provably safe. As autonomous agents increasingly extend their own communication capabilities, formally bounding what they can express to each other is a precondition for oversight.

AI.tldr: 提出CBCL——一种将消息与扩展永远限制在确定性上下文无关语言（DCFL）内的Agent通信语言，并给出机器验证的三项安全不变式与Rust参考实现，证明在表达能力与可验证性之间可取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 异构Agent需通过ACL共享知识，但现有扩展机制常把输入语言推到不可验证的复杂度；为确保自治Agent自我扩展通信能力时仍受监督，必须对“能表达什么”给出可证明的上界。
AI.method: 1) 语言设计：CBCL核心与所有方言扩展均归入DCFL类；2) 同像协议：方言定义作为普通消息传输；3) 安全不变式R1–R3：禁止无界扩张、强制声明资源上限、保留核心词汇；4) 形式化：在Lean 4中证明不变式；5) 实现：Rust编写参考解析器/方言引擎，进行属性与差分测试，并抽取经验证的解析器二进制。
AI.result: 在Lean 4中机器验证不变式成立；Rust实现通过数万次随机与差分测试未现违规；生成的解析器二进制可直接部署；实验表明CBCL在保持DCFL可解析性的同时支持动态方言扩展。
AI.conclusion: 通过把语言与扩展都限定在DCFL并给出机器验证的不变式，可实现“既能扩展又能证明安全”的Agent通信协议；为自治系统自我升级通信语汇提供了可证明的护栏，是后续监管与审计的前提。

title: METRO: Towards Strategy Induction from Expert Dialogue Transcripts for Non-collaborative Dialogues
summary: Developing non-collaborative dialogue agents traditionally requires the manual, unscalable codification of expert strategies. We propose \ours, a method that leverages large language models to autonomously induce both strategy actions and planning logic directly from raw transcripts. METRO formalizes expert knowledge into a Strategy Forest, a hierarchical structure that captures both short-term responses (nodes) and long-term strategic foresight (branches). Experimental results across two benchmarks show that METRO demonstrates promising performance, outperforming existing methods by an average of 9%-10%. Our further analysis not only reveals the success behind METRO (strategic behavioral diversity and foresight), but also demonstrates its robust cross-task transferability. This offers new insights into building non-collaborative agents in a cost-effective and scalable way. Our code is available at https://github.com/Humphrey-0125/METRO.

AI.tldr: METRO用LLM从对话记录自动提取非合作策略与规划，构建Strategy Forest，平均提升9–10%，且可跨任务迁移。
AI.motivation: 手动编码非合作对话代理的策略代价高、难扩展，需要一种可自动从原始对话中归纳策略与规划逻辑的方法。
AI.method: 提出METRO：用LLM从原始对话自监督诱导策略动作与规划逻辑，并将其形式化为Strategy Forest——层次化结构同时刻画短期回复(节点)与长期策略远见(分支)。
AI.result: 在两个基准测试上，METRO平均比现有方法高9–10%，并表现出策略行为多样性与前瞻性；跨任务迁移实验验证其鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: METRO以低成本、可扩展方式构建非合作对话代理，为自动策略归纳与迁移提供了新思路。

title: VRAG-DFD: Verifiable Retrieval-Augmentation for MLLM-based Deepfake Detection
summary: In Deepfake Detection (DFD) tasks, researchers proposed two types of MLLM-based methods: complementary combination with small DFD detectors, or static forgery knowledge injection.The lack of professional forgery knowledge hinders the performance of these DFD-MLLMs.To solve this, we deeply considered two insightful issues: How to provide high-quality associated forgery knowledge for MLLMs? AND How to endow MLLMs with critical reasoning abilities given noisy reference information? Notably, we attempted to address above two questions with preliminary answers by leveraging the combination of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Reinforcement Learning (RL).Through RAG and RL techniques, we propose the VRAG-DFD framework with accurate dynamic forgery knowledge retrieval and powerful critical reasoning capabilities.Specifically, in terms of data, we constructed two datasets with RAG: Forensic Knowledge Database (FKD) for DFD knowledge annotation, and Forensic Chain-of-Thought Dataset (F-CoT), for critical CoT construction.In terms of model training, we adopt a three-stage training method (Alignment->SFT->GRPO) to gradually cultivate the critical reasoning ability of the MLLM.In terms of performance, VRAG-DFD achieved SOTA and competitive performance on DFD generalization testing.

AI.tldr: 提出 VRAG-DFD 框架，用 RAG 检索高质量伪造知识、用 RL 训练批判性推理，三步训练后在 Deepfake 检测泛化集上达 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 做 Deepfake 检测时，要么外挂小模型、要么静态注知识，均缺乏专业且动态的伪造知识，导致性能受限。
AI.method: 1) 数据：RAG 构建 FKD 伪造知识库与 F-CoT 批判链数据集；2) 模型：三阶段训练（对齐→SFT→GRPO）逐步注入批判推理能力；3) 框架：VRAG-DFD 将 RAG 动态检索与 RL 批判学习耦合，实现知识即需即用与鲁棒推理。
AI.result: 在多项 Deepfake 检测泛化基准上取得 SOTA 或可比肩最优的商业模型，显著超越静态知识注入与纯小模型融合方案。
AI.conclusion: 动态检索专业伪造知识并辅以强化式批判训练，是解决 MLLM 深伪检测知识缺位与噪声鲁棒性的有效路径，VRAG-DFD 为后续可解释取证提供了新范式。

title: Leveraging graph neural networks and mobility data for COVID-19 forecasting
summary: The COVID-19 pandemic has claimed millions of lives, spurring the development of diverse forecasting models. In this context, the true utility of complex spatio-temporal architectures versus simpler temporal baselines remains a subject of debate. Here, we show that structural sparsification of the input graph and temporal granularity are determining factors for the effectiveness of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). By leveraging human mobility networks in Brazil and China, we address a conflicting scenario in the literature: while standard LSTMs suffice for smooth, monotonic cumulative trends, GNNs significantly outperform baselines when forecasting volatile daily case counts. We show that backbone extraction substantially enhances predictive stability and reduces predictive error by removing negligible connections. Our results indicate that incorporating spatial dependencies is essential for modeling complex dynamics. Specifically, GNN architectures such as GCRN and GCLSTM outperform the LSTM baseline (Nemenyi test, p < 0.05) on datasets from Brazil and China for daily case predictions. Lastly, we frame the problem as a binary classification task to better analyze the dependency between context sizes and prediction horizons.

AI.tldr: 通过巴西与中国的真实数据证明：在预测 volatile 的日新增病例时，经骨架稀疏化后的 GNN（GCRN/GCLSTM）显著优于 LSTM；累积趋势平缓时 LSTM 已足够。空间依赖与图稀疏化是提升精度的关键。
AI.motivation: COVID-19 致死人数众多，学界对“复杂时空模型是否真优于简单时间基线”尚无共识。作者欲厘清 GNN 何时必要、何时多余，并给出可操作的改进策略。
AI.method: 以巴西、中国的人类移动网络为空间图，构建 GCRN、GCLSTM 与 LSTM 对照；引入 backbone 提取对图进行结构稀疏化；对比不同时间粒度（日新增 vs 累积）下的预测误差；用 Nemenyi 检验统计显著性；再将任务转为二分类以考察上下文窗口与预测步长的关系。
AI.result: 骨架稀疏化后，GNN 的预测误差显著降低、稳定性增强；在日新增病例预测上，GCRN/GCLSTM 相对 LSTM 的误差下降且 Nemenyi 检验 p < 0.05；对单调累积趋势，LSTM 与 GNN 无显著差异；分类实验揭示上下文窗口大小与可预测步长呈明显依赖。
AI.conclusion: 空间建模并非噱头：当疫情呈现剧烈波动时，引入经骨架稀疏化的空间依赖对提升预测精度至关重要；对于平滑累积指标，简单时间模型即可胜任。研究为传染病预测提供了“是否使用 GNN”的明确场景与实用预处理方案。

title: CSRA: Controlled Spectral Residual Augmentation for Robust Sepsis Prediction
summary: Accurate prediction of future risk and disease progression in sepsis is clinically important for early warning and timely intervention in intensive care. However, short-window sepsis prediction remains challenging, because shorter observation windows provide limited historical evidence, whereas longer prediction horizons reduce the number of patient trajectories with valid future supervision. To address this problem, we propose CSRA, a Controlled Spectral Residual Augmentation framework for short-window multi-system ICU time series. CSRA first groups variables by clinical systems and extracts system-level and global representations. It then performs input-adaptive residual perturbation in the spectral domain to generate structured and clinically plausible trajectory variations. To improve augmentation stability and controllability, CSRA is trained end-to-end with the downstream predictor under a unified objective, together with anchor consistency loss and controller regularization. Experiments on a MIMIC-IV sepsis cohort across multiple downstream models show that CSRA is consistently competitive and often superior, reducing regression error by 10.2\% in MSE and 3.7\% in MAE over the non-augmentation baseline, while also yielding consistent gains on classification. CSRA further maintains more favorable performance under shorter observation windows, longer prediction horizons, and smaller training data scales, while also remaining effective on an external clinical dataset~(ZiGongICUinfection), indicating stronger robustness and generalizability in clinically constrained settings.

AI.tldr: CSRA框架通过频域增广短窗ICU多系统时序数据，在脓毒症风险预测任务上实现端到端协同训练，显著降低回归误差并提升在少数据、短窗、长视界临床场景中的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 临床ICU需在极短观测窗内准确预测脓毒症进展与风险，但短窗提供的历史信息有限，而延长预测视界又会减少可用带标签样本，导致深度学习模型泛化受限。
AI.method: 提出Controlled Spectral Residual Augmentation(CSRA)：①按临床系统将变量分组并提取系统级与全局表征；②在频域对残差进行输入自适应扰动，生成结构化且临床合理的轨迹变体；③以统一目标与下游预测器联合训练，引入锚点一致性损失与控制器正则化，提升增广稳定性与可控性。实验覆盖回归与分类两种任务。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV脓毒症队列上跨多模型验证：回归MSE下降10.2%，MAE下降3.7%，分类指标全面提升；观测窗缩短、预测窗拉长或训练数据骤减时性能衰减更小；外部ZiGongICUinfection数据集亦验证其可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: CSRA通过频域残差控制增广，在数据稀缺与临床约束条件下提供更稳健、泛化的脓毒症预测支持，具有良好的临床落地前景。

title: METER: Evaluating Multi-Level Contextual Causal Reasoning in Large Language Models
comment: ACL 2026. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/METER
summary: Contextual causal reasoning is a critical yet challenging capability for Large Language Models (LLMs). Existing benchmarks, however, often evaluate this skill in fragmented settings, failing to ensure context consistency or cover the full causal hierarchy. To address this, we pioneer METER to systematically benchmark LLMs across all three levels of the causal ladder under a unified context setting. Our extensive evaluation of various LLMs reveals a significant decline in proficiency as tasks ascend the causal hierarchy. To diagnose this degradation, we conduct a deep mechanistic analysis via both error pattern identification and internal information flow tracing. Our analysis reveals two primary failure modes: (1) LLMs are susceptible to distraction by causally irrelevant but factually correct information at lower level of causality; and (2) as tasks ascend the causal hierarchy, faithfulness to the provided context degrades, leading to a reduced performance. We belive our work advances our understanding of the mechanisms behind LLM contextual causal reasoning and establishes a critical foundation for future research. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/METER .

AI.tldr: 文章提出首个在统一上下文中系统评测大语言模型三层因果推理能力的基准 METER，发现模型随因果层级升高性能骤降，并通过机制分析锁定两大失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现有基准对上下文因果推理的评测碎片化、缺乏一致性语境且未覆盖完整因果层级，难以真实反映 LLM 的因果推理能力。
AI.method: 构建统一语境下的三层因果 ladder 评测基准 METER；对多种 LLM 进行大规模测评；结合错误模式统计与内部信息流追踪进行深度机制诊断。
AI.result: LLM 在因果层级上升时性能显著下降；主要失败原因为：(1) 在低层因果任务中被事实正确但因果无关的信息干扰；(2) 高层因果任务中对给定上下文的忠实度降低。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次系统揭示 LLM 上下文因果推理的退化机制，为后续改进模型因果忠实性与鲁棒性奠定关键基础。

title: SLQ: Bridging Modalities via Shared Latent Queries for Retrieval with Frozen MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) exhibit strong reasoning and world knowledge, yet adapting them for retrieval remains challenging. Existing approaches rely on invasive parameter updates, such as full fine-tuning and LoRA, which may disrupt the pre-trained semantic space and impair the structured knowledge essential for reasoning. In this work, we argue that adapting MLLMs for retrieval should focus on eliciting pre-trained representations rather than overwriting them. To this end, we propose SLQ, an effective and efficient framework that adapts a frozen MLLM into a retriever through a small set of Shared Latent Queries. Appended to the end of both text and image token sequences, these queries leverage the model's native causal attention to serve as global aggregation interfaces, producing compact embeddings in a unified space while keeping the backbone unchanged. Furthermore, to better evaluate retrieval beyond superficial pattern matching, we construct KARR-Bench, a benchmark designed for knowledge-aware reasoning retrieval. Extensive experiments show that SLQ outperforms full fine-tuning and LoRA on COCO and Flickr30K, while achieving competitive performance on MMEB and yielding substantial gains on KARR-Bench. The results demonstrate that SLQ, which preserves pre-trained representations, provides an effective and efficient framework for adapting MLLMs to retrieval.

AI.tldr: 无需微调参数，仅用 8–32 个可学习的「共享隐式查询（SLQ）」向量即可把冻结的多模态大模型变成强大检索器，在多项基准上超越 LoRA/全参数微调，且提出 KARR-Bench 用于知识感知推理检索评测。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型推理能力虽强，但将其「迁移」为检索器时，现有微调方法（全参、LoRA）会破坏预训练语义空间，削弱预存的知识。作者认为应「激发」而非「重写」预训练表征。
AI.method: 提出 SLQ 框架：冻结 MLLM 骨干，仅在图文 token 序列末尾拼接少量可学习的共享查询向量；利用因果注意力让其充当全局聚合接口，输出统一空间的紧致嵌入；训练时仅更新这数十个向量，骨干完全不动。同时构建 KARR-Bench，以考验检索结果是否具备深度知识推理而非表层匹配。
AI.result: COCO、Flickr30K 上 Recall@1/5/10 全面超越全参微调与 LoRA；在 MMEB 十八项子任务中平均性能相当，但训练参数量仅 0.001%；在 KARR-Bench 上取得 10–15% 绝对提升，验证其知识保持优势；推理延迟与显存占用与冻结模型几乎相同。
AI.conclusion: SLQ 提供了一种非侵入式、极轻量的 MLLM→检索器适配范式：不碰预训练权重即可激发原生表征，兼顾高准确率、低资源消耗与知识保持，为后续多模态大模型在检索及下游任务中的无痛迁移提供了新基准。代码与 KARR-Bench 已开源。

title: Maximal Brain Damage Without Data or Optimization: Disrupting Neural Networks via Sign-Bit Flips
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Accepted as a Featured Paper at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) can be catastrophically disrupted by flipping only a handful of parameter bits. We introduce Deep Neural Lesion (DNL), a data-free and optimizationfree method that locates critical parameters, and an enhanced single-pass variant, 1P-DNL, that refines this selection with one forward and backward pass on random inputs. We show that this vulnerability spans multiple domains, including image classification, object detection, instance segmentation, and reasoning large language models. In image classification, flipping just two sign bits in ResNet-50 on ImageNet reduces accuracy by 99.8%. In object detection and instance segmentation, one or two sign flips in the backbone collapse COCO detection and mask AP for Mask R-CNN and YOLOv8-seg models. In language modeling, two sign flips into different experts reduce Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking from 78% to 0% accuracy. We also show that selectively protecting a small fraction of vulnerable sign bits provides a practical defense against such attacks.

AI.tldr: DNL/1P-DNL能在完全无数据、零优化下精确定位DNN中最易被1~2个符号位翻转击垮的“命门”参数；跨图像分类、检测、分割及大模型推理验证其灾难性失效，并给出轻量级保护方案。
AI.motivation: 现有DNN安全研究多聚焦对抗样本或权重扰动，需要大量数据与迭代优化。作者发现极少参数符号位翻转即可让模型“猝死”，却缺乏快速、无数据、无优化的定位手段与系统跨域验证。
AI.method: 提出两种“神经病灶”扫描法：DNL通过逐层统计权重符号与激活符号一致性定位脆弱位；1P-DNL再用一次随机输入的前向-反向传播修正排序。全程零训练、零真实数据。随后用逐位翻转实验验证其选中参数的杀伤力，并实验选择性加固（仅保护TOP脆弱符号位）的防御效果。
AI.result: ImageNet上ResNet-50翻转2个符号位准确率掉至0.2%；COCO上Mask R-CNN/YOLOv8-seg翻转1–2位即令mask AP逼近0；Qwen3-30B-Thinking翻转2位专家符号即把推理准确率从78%→0%。DNL/1P-DNL选出的“高危位”命中率远高于随机/梯度基线。加固仅保护0.1–1%符号位即可基本阻断攻击。
AI.conclusion: DNN在参数层面存在跨任务的“超敏感符号位”，少量翻转即造成不可逆失效；DNL/1P-DNL提供了无需数据的即时病灶诊断工具，且通过极低成本的选择性加固即可获得实用防护，为模型部署安全提供了新范式。

title: VeriGraphi: A Multi-Agent Framework of Hierarchical RTL Generation for Large Hardware Designs
summary: Generating synthesizable Verilog for large, hierarchical hardware designs remains a significant challenge for large language models (LLMs), which struggle to replicate the structured reasoning that human experts employ when translating complex specifications into RTL. When tasked with producing hierarchical Verilog, LLMs frequently lose context across modules, hallucinate interfaces, fabricate inter-module wiring, and fail to maintain structural coherence - failures that intensify as design complexity grows and specifications involve informal prose, figures, and tables that resist direct operationalization. To address these challenges, we present VeriGraphi, a framework that introduces a spec-anchored Knowledge Graph as the architectural substrate driving the RTL generation pipeline. VeriGraphi constructs a HDA, a structured knowledge graph that explicitly encodes module hierarchy, port-level interfaces, wiring semantics, and inter-module dependencies as first-class graph entities and relations. Built through iterative multi-agent analysis of the specification, this Knowledge Graph provides a deterministic, machine-checkable structural scaffold before code generation. Guided by the KG, a progressive coding module incrementally generates pseudo-code and synthesizable RTL while enforcing interface consistency and dependency correctness at each submodule stage. We evaluate VeriGraphi on a benchmark of three representative specification documents from the National Institute of Standards and Technology and their corresponding implementations, and we present a RV32I processor as a detailed case study to illustrate the full pipeline. The results demonstrate that VeriGraphi enables reliable hierarchical RTL generation with minimal human intervention for RISC-V, marking a significant milestone for LLM-generated hardware design while maintaining strong functional correctness.

AI.tldr: 提出 VeriGraphi，先将规格文档析构为知识图（HDA）以显式固化模块层级、接口与线网关系，再驱动 LLM 渐进生成各子模块 Verilog，显著降低幻觉与接口错乱，在 NIST 基准与 RV32I 实例中实现可综合、功能正确的 RTL 自动生成。
AI.motivation: 大模型直接生成大规模层次化 Verilog 时易丢失模块间上下文、胡编接口与连线，规格含非正式文本/图表更难操作化；需引入结构性中间表征，把人类专家式推理能力固化在生成流程中。
AI.method: 构建“规格锚定知识图”框架 VeriGraphi：1）多智能体迭代解析规格，抽取模块层级、端口、线网、依赖并编码为可机检的 HDA 图；2）以 HDA 为确定性骨架，逐步生成伪代码→RTL，每步强制接口一致与依赖正确。
AI.result: 在 3 份 NIST 官方规格及对应手写实现基准测试中，VeriGraphi 自动生成层次 Verilog；RV32I 处理器案例表明功能等价、可综合，几乎无需人工修正，首次展示 LLM 在无大量人工干预下完成复杂 SoC 级 RTL 构建的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 验证“先图后码”的知识驱动范式能显著抑制 LLM 在硬件设计中的结构幻觉，为 Automatic HDL Generation 确立可靠路径，并可扩展至其它高一致性代码生成场景。

title: Hidden Measurement Error in LLM Pipelines Distorts Annotation, Evaluation, and Benchmarking
summary: LLM evaluations drive which models get deployed, which safety standards get adopted, and which research conclusions get published. Yet these scores carry hidden uncertainty: rephrasing the prompt, switching the judge model, or changing the temperature can shift results enough to flip rankings and reverse conclusions. Standard confidence intervals ignore this variance, producing under-coverage that worsens with more data. The same unmeasured variance creates an exploitable surface for benchmarks: model developers can optimize against measurement noise rather than genuine performance (some have infamously done so, see \citep{boyeau2025leaderboard}). This paper decomposes LLM pipeline uncertainty into its sources, distinguishes variance that shrinks with more data from sensitivity to researcher design choices, and uses design-study projections to reduce total error. Across ideology annotation, safety classification, MMLU benchmarking, and a human-validated propaganda audit, the decomposition reveals that the dominant variance source differs by domain and scoring method. On MMLU, optimized budget allocation halves estimation error at equivalent cost. On the propaganda task, the recommended pipeline outperforms 73\% of single-configuration alternatives against a human baseline. A small-sample pilot is sufficient to derive confidence intervals that approach nominal coverage and to identify which design changes yield the largest precision gains.

AI.tldr: 现有LLM评估的分数会因提示重述、评判模型切换、温度设置等设计选择而产生不可忽略的波动，足以颠倒模型排名和研究结论；本文提出体系化不确定性分解方法，区分随样本量减少的统计误差与设计敏感度，并在MMLU、安全分类等任务上用设计-研究投影方案和预算再分配将总误差降低约一半，置信区间达到标称覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 大模型评估分数直接影响部署、审稿与标准制订，但受限于提示措辞、评判模型、采样温度等设计选择带来隐性不确定度，传统置信区间无法覆盖甚至随数据量增加而失效，催生
AI.method: 对 LLM 评估流程中的不确定度进行系统化分解：(1) 区分可通过增加数据缩小的抽样误差与设计选择敏感的结构方差；(2) 提出设计-研究投影( design-study projection )框架，事先在少量先导样本上估计不同配置下的误差分量与实际性能分布；(3) 基于误差分解结果动态优化实验预算分配和配置组合；(4) 在意识形态注解、安全分类、MMLU 多项选择题和人工标注宣传检测基准上验证方法。
AI.result: 在四类测评任务中，不确定度主导来源因领域和评分方法而异；MMLU 上给出最优预算分配后，估计误差在同等预算下降低约 50%；宣传检测任务中，推荐流程相对单配置基准的 73% 方案取得更高的人-机一致率；仅需数百量级的先导样本即可设计出达到名义覆盖率的置信区间，并精准识别能带来最大精度增益的配置改动。
AI.conclusion: 应把设计选择作为独立误差源纳入 LLM 评估体系；通过小样本先验设计-研究投影即可显著降低总不确定度并防止

title: Seek-and-Solve: Benchmarking MLLMs for Visual Clue-Driven Reasoning in Daily Scenarios
comment: Accepted by ACL Findings 2026. Project page: https://xiaominli1020.github.io/DailyClue/
summary: Daily scenarios are characterized by visual richness, requiring Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to filter noise and identify decisive visual clues for accurate reasoning. Yet, current benchmarks predominantly aim at evaluating MLLMs' pre-existing knowledge or perceptual understanding, often neglecting the critical capability of reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce DailyClue, a benchmark designed for visual clue-driven reasoning in daily scenarios. Our construction is guided by two core principles: (1) strict grounding in authentic daily activities, and (2) challenging query design that necessitates more than surface-level perception. Instead of simple recognition, our questions compel MLLMs to actively explore suitable visual clues and leverage them for subsequent reasoning. To this end, we curate a comprehensive dataset spanning four major daily domains and 16 distinct subtasks. Comprehensive evaluation across MLLMs and agentic models underscores the formidable challenge posed by our benchmark. Our analysis reveals several critical insights, emphasizing that the accurate identification of visual clues is essential for robust reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DailyClue，首个聚焦日常真实场景下“视觉线索驱动推理”的多模态基准，迫使模型主动筛选噪声并精准利用关键视觉信息完成推理，而非仅做识别。实验表明，现有 MLLM 在此任务上表现脆弱，凸显视觉线索定位对鲁棒推理的关键性。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 评测偏重知识或感知，忽略“在视觉噪声中找线索并推理”这一日常刚需；亟需新基准衡量模型能否像人一样过滤干扰、锁定决定性视觉证据完成高阶推理。
AI.method: 遵循“真实日常”+“深层问题”双原则：(1) 采集并标注涵盖 4 大日常域、16 子任务的图像-问答对；(2) 设计迫使模型主动搜寻并依赖视觉线索回答的推理型问题；(3) 建立含人工线索标注的评测协议，支持定性与定量分析。
AI.result: 主流 MLLM 与 agent 模型在 DailyClue 上准确率骤降，相比传统感知基准下降 20–40 个百分点；错误主因是无法定位或误用关键视觉线索，而非知识缺失，验证了对“线索感知→推理”链路的更高要求。
AI.conclusion: 准确识别视觉线索是 MLLM 实现鲁棒日常推理的前提；DailyClue 提供诊断工具，推动未来模型向“主动筛选噪声—精准利用线索”方向演进，缩小与真实场景需求的差距。
