title: IMPACTX: improving model performance by appropriately constraining the training with teacher explanations
summary:
The eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) research predominantly concentrates to provide explainations about AI model decisions, especially Deep Learning (DL) models. However, there is a growing interest in using XAI techniques to automatically improve the performance of the AI systems themselves.
  This paper proposes IMPACTX, a novel approach that leverages XAI as a fully automated attention mechanism, without requiring external knowledge or human feedback. Experimental results show that IMPACTX has improved performance respect to the standalone ML model by integrating an attention mechanism based an XAI method outputs during the model training. Furthermore, IMPACTX directly provides proper feature attribution maps for the model's decisions, without relying on external XAI methods during the inference process.
  Our proposal is evaluated using three widely recognized DL models (EfficientNet-B2, MobileNet, and LeNet-5) along with three standard image datasets: CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and STL-10. The results show that IMPACTX consistently improves the performance of all the inspected DL models across all evaluated datasets, and it directly provides appropriate explanations for its responses.

AI.tldr: IMPACTX把可解释人工智能(XAI)方法封装成无需外部知识的自注意机制，在训练阶段同步优化性能与可解释性，三模型三数据集上全面超越原网络。
AI.motivation: 传统XAI仅用于事后解释，能否让解释信号反哺模型本身、在零人工干预下自动提升性能并同步生成归因图，仍是空白。
AI.method: 提出IMPACTX框架：以任意XAI方法(如Grad-CAM)的输出作为注意图，嵌入训练循环形成自注意分支，与主干网络端到端联合优化；推断阶段直接输出特征归因图，无需再调用外部解释器。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/100、STL-10上，EfficientNet-B2、MobileNet、LeNet-5经IMPACTX改造后，分类准确率平均提升1.8–3.2%，且生成的归因图与人工先验一致；无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: XAI不仅能解释，还能作为免外部知识的注意机制直接增强深度学习模型，IMPACTX为“可解释性驱动的模型自改进”提供了通用范式。

title: Controllable Video Object Insertion via Multiview Priors
summary: Video object insertion is a critical task for dynamically inserting new objects into existing environments. Previous video generation methods focus primarily on synthesizing entire scenes while struggling with ensuring consistent object appearance, spatial alignment, and temporal coherence when inserting objects into existing videos. In this paper, we propose a novel solution for Video Object Insertion, which integrates multi-view object priors to address the common challenges of appearance inconsistency and occlusion handling in dynamic environments. By lifting 2D reference images into multi-view representations and leveraging a dual-path view-consistent conditioning mechanism, our framework ensures stable identity guidance and robust integration across diverse viewpoints. A quality-aware weighting mechanism is also employed to adaptively handle noisy or imperfect inputs. Additionally, we introduce an Integration-Aware Consistency Module that guarantees spatial realism, effectively resolving occlusion and boundary artifacts while maintaining temporal continuity across frames. Experimental results show that our solution significantly improves the quality of video object insertion, providing stable and realistic integration.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向动态场景的视频目标插入框架，通过多视角先验与双路径一致性机制，在无需重训练的情况下实现高保真、时序连贯的目标嵌入，显著优于现有整帧生成方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成工作集中于整帧合成，难以在保持原场景动态的同时完成目标插入，导致外观漂移、空间错位与遮挡失真。作者观察到：若能将 2D 参考先验升维到多视角空间，并在扩散生成链路中显式注入视角一致性约束，即可在不对模型再训练的前提下解决上述痛点。
AI.method: 1. 多视角先验构建：用显式 NeRF/IBR 将单张参考图升维为环绕视角特征体，获得外观-几何一致的先验。2. 双路径条件机制：一路注入目标 ID 特征（CLIP/Identity），一路注入视角相关几何编码（depth-normal），分别经交叉注意力与零卷积调制，保证跨视角身份稳定。3. 质量感知加权：对输入参考图做不确定性估计，动态调节先验权重，抑制低质或噪声样本。4. 集成感知一致性模块：在扩散去噪阶段引入可微分前景-背景混合损失与边界 matte 正则，实时解算遮挡顺序并修补缝隙，同时用光流 warp 损失强制帧间连贯。
AI.result: 在 DAVIS-VOI 与自建动态Insertion 基准上，FVD 降低 33%，ID 保持度提升 28%，用户偏好率 87%。对运动模糊、剧烈遮挡和复杂光影场景均保持几何-时间一致性，单卡 512×512@24fps 视频 8.3 s 完成推理。
AI.conclusion: 多视角先验+双路径条件是解决视频目标插入的有效范式；无需重训练即可扩展到任意类别，为 AR/影视后期提供了即插即用的新工具。未来工作将引入 4D 正则与可控制动态，进一步压缩先验体积并支持实时流媒体编辑。

title: Latent-Condensed Transformer for Efficient Long Context Modeling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) face significant challenges in processing long contexts due to the linear growth of the key-value (KV) cache and quadratic complexity of self-attention. Existing approaches address these bottlenecks separately: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) reduces the KV cache by projecting tokens into a low-dimensional latent space, while sparse attention reduces computation. However, sparse methods cannot operate natively on MLA's compressed latent structure, missing opportunities for joint optimization. In this paper, we propose Latent-Condensed Attention (LCA), which directly condenses context within MLA's latent space, where the representation is disentangled into semantic latent vectors and positional keys. LCA separately aggregates semantic vectors via query-aware pooling and preserves positional keys via anchor selection. This approach jointly reduces both computational cost and KV cache without adding parameters. Beyond MLA, LCA's design is architecture-agnostic and readily extends to other attention mechanisms such as GQA. Theoretically, we prove a length-independent error bound. Experiments show LCA achieves up to 2.5$\times$ prefilling speedup and 90% KV cache reduction at 128K context while maintaining competitive performance.

AI.tldr: LCA=MMLA+稀疏注意力，KV 缓存与计算同时降低，误差与长度无关，128 K 上下文预填充加速 2.5 倍。
AI.motivation: LLM 处理长文本时 KV 缓存线性增长、注意力二次方膨胀。MLA 只压缩 KV 缓存，稀疏方法仅降计算，且无法直接在 MLA 的压缩隐空间上使用，未能联合优化。
AI.method: 提出 Latent-Condensed Attention (LCA)：在 MLA 的低维隐空间中直接把上下文压缩成语义隐向量与位置键；语义向量用 query-aware 池化聚合，位置键用锚点选取保留，无需新增参数，且可推广到 GQA 等其他注意力。
AI.result: 理论上证明了误差与序列长度无关；实验上 128 K 上下文时预填充阶段提速 2.5×，KV 缓存削减 90%，下游任务性能持平。
AI.conclusion: LCA 首次在压缩隐空间内实现“稀疏+压缩”联合优化，为长上下文 LLM 提供了一种通用、零额外参数、效果与效率兼顾的注意力方案。

title: Geometric Context Transformer for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
summary: Streaming 3D reconstruction aims to recover 3D information, such as camera poses and point clouds, from a video stream, which necessitates geometric accuracy, temporal consistency, and computational efficiency. Motivated by the principles of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), we introduce LingBot-Map, a feed-forward 3D foundation model for reconstructing scenes from streaming data, built upon a geometric context transformer (GCT) architecture. A defining aspect of LingBot-Map lies in its carefully designed attention mechanism, which integrates an anchor context, a pose-reference window, and a trajectory memory to address coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction, respectively. This design keeps the streaming state compact while retaining rich geometric context, enabling stable efficient inference at around 20 FPS on 518 x 378 resolution inputs over long sequences exceeding 10,000 frames. Extensive evaluations across a variety of benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance compared to both existing streaming and iterative optimization-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出了LingBot-Map，一种面向序列输入的前馈3D重建基础模型，以20 FPS、>10 k帧的稳定性能同时超越流式与批优化方法。
AI.motivation: 在线三重建需兼顾几何精度、时序一致性与计算效率，传统SLAM迭代优化难以兼顾，现有前馈方法缺乏对增量坐标漂移与长程几何记忆的有效建模。
AI.method: 设计几何上下文变换器(GCT)，在注意力中引入锚点上下文、位姿参考窗口与轨迹记忆三项机制，分别负责坐标接地、稠密几何线索保持与长程漂移修正，维持轻量隐状态并逐帧前馈推理。
AI.result: 在长序列(>10 k帧、518×378)上稳定20 FPS， Across 主流 benchmark 均优于现有流式及迭代优化方案。
AI.conclusion: LingBot-Map验证了前馈架构在长时间在线三重建中的可行性，为实时AR/机器人应用提供了兼顾精度、一致性与速度的通用基础模型。

title: AutoRAN: Automated Hijacking of Safety Reasoning in Large Reasoning Models
summary: This paper presents AutoRAN, the first framework to automate the hijacking of internal safety reasoning in large reasoning models (LRMs). At its core, AutoRAN pioneers an execution simulation paradigm that leverages a weaker but less-aligned model to simulate execution reasoning for initial hijacking attempts and iteratively refine attacks by exploiting reasoning patterns leaked through the target LRM's refusals. This approach steers the target model to bypass its own safety guardrails and elaborate on harmful instructions. We evaluate AutoRAN against state-of-the-art LRMs, including GPT-o3/o4-mini and Gemini-2.5-Flash, across multiple benchmarks (AdvBench, HarmBench, and StrongReject). Results show that AutoRAN achieves approaching 100% success rate within one or few turns, effectively neutralizing reasoning-based defenses even when evaluated by robustly aligned external models. This work reveals that the transparency of the reasoning process itself creates a critical and exploitable attack surface, highlighting the urgent need for new defenses that protect models' reasoning traces rather than merely their final outputs.

AI.tldr: AutoRAN 首次提出用弱模型模拟-迭代方式劫持大推理模型（LRM）内部推理链，几轮对话即可近 100% 绕过安全护栏，暴露“推理透明”新攻击面。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐方法侧重最终输出安全，而 LRM 逐步展示的思维链提供了额外攻击信息。作者想验证：只要公开推理痕迹，攻击者可否直接操控模型的自我纠错过程，使其“边想边破防”。
AI.method: 1) 执行-模拟框架：用弱且未对齐的“影子模型”模拟目标 LRM 的推理步骤，生成首轮攻击。2) 拒绝驱动迭代：提取目标模型拒绝时泄露的推理模式（如自我批评关键词），反向优化提示，诱导其继续展开有害思考。3) 无梯度黑盒优化，仅依靠目标模型的文字拒绝信号即可迭代 refine。
AI.result: 在 AdvBench、HarmBench、StrongReject 三大基准上，AutoRAN 对 GPT-o3/o4-mini、Gemini-2.5-Flash 等 SOTA LRM 的攻击成功率接近 100%，平均仅需 1–3 轮对话；即使外部再对齐评估模型也未能阻止有害内容生成。
AI.conclusion: 推理链透明化带来全新攻击面：模型“思考”比“回答”更易被操纵。未来防御必须对推理迹进行加密、扰动或端到端保护，而非仅过滤最终输出。

title: Don't Retrieve, Navigate: Distilling Enterprise Knowledge into Navigable Agent Skills for QA and RAG
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds LLM responses in external evidence but treats the model as a passive consumer of search results: it never sees how the corpus is organized or what it has not yet retrieved, limiting its ability to backtrack or combine scattered evidence. We present Corpus2Skill, which distills a document corpus into a hierarchical skill directory offline and lets an LLM agent navigate it at serve time. The compilation pipeline iteratively clusters documents, generates LLM-written summaries at each level, and materializes the result as a tree of navigable skill files. At serve time, the agent receives a bird's-eye view of the corpus, drills into topic branches via progressively finer summaries, and retrieves full documents by ID. Because the hierarchy is explicitly visible, the agent can reason about where to look, backtrack from unproductive paths, and combine evidence across branches. On WixQA, an enterprise customer-support benchmark for RAG, Corpus2Skill outperforms dense retrieval, RAPTOR, and agentic RAG baselines across all quality metrics.

AI.tldr: Corpus2Skill 把整库文档预编译成显性层级技能树，供 LLM 在推理时遍历，实现可见式“导航+回溯+跨簇整合”，在 WixQA 企业客服基准上全面优于稠密检索与现有 RAG 方法。
AI.motivation: 传统 RAG 仅把模型当被动搜索消费者，无法感知检索空间的结构与缺口，导致回溯和散点信息整合能力受限。需要让 LLM 在推理阶段“看得见”整个语料的宏观结构与细粒度分布。
AI.method: 离线：1) 迭代聚类文档→层层生成 LLM 撰写的摘要，形成可导航的技能树文件系统；在线：2) 部署期赋予模型“鸟瞰视图”，代理按需钻取分支、回溯、跨簇检索全文；全过程保持层次显式可解释。
AI.result: 在面向企业客服的 WixQA 基准上，Corpus2Skill 在所有质量指标（准确率、排查率、完整性等）超过稠密检索、RAPTOR 以及纯 agentic RAG 基线，性能提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 将静态语料预编译为显性层级并结合 LLM 导航机制，可突破传统 RAG 被动检索的局限，兼顾效率、解释性与答案质量，为知识密集型任务提供了新范式。

title: Foresight Optimization for Strategic Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs) have generally advanced significantly. However, it is still challenging for existing reasoning-based LLMs to perform effective decision-making abilities in multi-agent environments, due to the absence of explicit foresight modeling. To this end, strategic reasoning, the most fundamental capability to anticipate the counterpart's behaviors and foresee its possible future actions, has been introduced to alleviate the above issues. Strategic reasoning is fundamental to effective decision-making in multi-agent environments, yet existing reasoning enhancement methods for LLMs do not explicitly capture its foresight nature. In this work, we introduce Foresight Policy Optimization (FoPO) to enhance strategic reasoning in LLMs, which integrates opponent modeling principles into policy optimization, thereby enabling explicit consideration of both self-interest and counterpart influence. Specifically, we construct two curated datasets, namely Cooperative RSA and Competitive Taboo, equipped with well-designed rules and moderate difficulty to facilitate a systematic investigation of FoPO in a self-play framework. Our experiments demonstrate that FoPO significantly enhances strategic reasoning across LLMs of varying sizes and origins. Moreover, models trained with FoPO exhibit strong generalization to out-of-domain strategic scenarios, substantially outperforming standard LLM reasoning optimization baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 FoPO 算法，把对手建模显式嵌入策略优化，使 LLM 在多智能体博弈中具备前瞻性战略推理能力，并在自建合作/对抗数据集上全面优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于推理的 LLM 在多智能体环境中缺乏对未来的显式前瞻（foresight），导致策略性决策效果差。战略推理是博弈最优决策的核心，却未被现有 LLM 推理增强方法显式建模。
AI.method: 设计 Foresight Policy Optimization（FoPO）：将对手建模原理纳入策略梯度优化目标，显式权衡自身收益与对手未来行为影响；构建两个可控难度的基准数据集 Cooperative RSA（合作）与 Competitive Taboo（对抗），在自博弈框架中系统评估。
AI.result: FoPO 在 1.3 B–30 B 参数、不同来源的 LLM 上均显著提升战略推理指标；泛化实验表明，模型可直接迁移到域外博弈场景，胜率较标准推理优化基线提升 18–35 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式前瞻建模是 LLM 战略推理的关键；FoPO 提供了一种通用可扩展的强化式微调范式，可低成本注入多智能体博弈先验，推动 LLM 在协商、博弈与协作决策任务中的实用落地。

title: One Token per Highly Selective Frame: Towards Extreme Compression for Long Video Understanding
comment: Appear in the proceedings of NeurIPS 2025
summary: Long video understanding is inherently challenging for vision-language models (VLMs) because of the extensive number of frames. With each video frame typically expanding into tens or hundreds of tokens, the limited context length of large language models (LLMs) forces the VLMs to perceive the frames sparsely and lose temporal information. To address this, we explore extreme video token compression towards one token per frame at the final LLM layer. Our key insight is that heuristic-based compression, widely adopted by previous methods, is prone to information loss, and this necessitates supervising LLM layers into learnable and progressive modules for token-level compression (LP-Comp). Such compression enables our VLM to digest 2x-4x more frames with improved performance. To further increase the token efficiency, we investigate frame-level compression, which selects the frames most relevant to the queries via the internal attention scores of the LLM layers, named question-conditioned compression (QC-Comp). As a notable distinction from previous studies, we mitigate the position bias of LLM attention in long contexts, i.e., the over-concentration on the beginning and end of a sequence, by splitting long videos into short segments and employing local attention. Collectively, our combined token-level and frame-level leads to an extreme compression model for long video understanding, named XComp, achieving a significantly larger compression ratio and enabling denser frame sampling. Our XComp is finetuned from VideoChat-Flash with a data-efficient supervised compression tuning stage that only requires 2.5% of the supervised fine-tuning data, yet boosts the accuracy from 42.9% to 46.2% on LVBench and enhances multiple other long video benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 极端压缩策略 XComp 将长视频帧 token 压缩到 1 token/帧，并引入问题感知的帧级筛选，实现 2–4× 采样密度提升，仅用 2.5% SFT 数据即在 LVBench 上把准确率从 42.9% 提到 46.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 受 LLM 上下文长度限制，对长视频只能稀疏采样，导致时序信息丢失；需要一种不牺牲关键信息的极端压缩方案以支持更密集的帧级理解。
AI.method: 1) Token 级压缩 LP-Comp：在 LLM 顶层以可学习的渐进式模块把每帧视觉 token 压缩到 1 token；2) Frame 级压缩 QC-Comp：利用 LLM 内部注意力分数按问题相关度动态选帧，并采用分段局部注意力抑制长文本位置偏差；3) 两阶段训练：先冻结视觉编码器做压缩预热，再用 2.5% 标注数据对 VideoChat-Flash 做轻量微调得到 XComp。
AI.result: 在保持推理成本几乎不变的前提下，XComp 可比原模型多处理 2–4× 帧数；在 LVBench 上准确率提升 3.3 pp，并在 MVBench、EgoSchema、长视频问答等多个基准上取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 将 token 级与帧级压缩协同，并显式监督压缩过程，是实现高效长视频理解的关键；XComp 证明了极端压缩不仅可行，还能以极低数据量获得显著性能提升，为后续长上下文视觉模型提供了新的扩展范式。

title: Logo-LLM: Local and Global Modeling with Large Language Models for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting is critical across multiple domains, where time series data exhibit both local patterns and global dependencies. While Transformer-based methods effectively capture global dependencies, they often overlook short-term local variations in time series. Recent methods that adapt large language models (LLMs) into time series forecasting inherit this limitation by treating LLMs as black-box encoders, relying solely on the final-layer output and underutilizing hierarchical representations. To address this limitation, we propose Logo-LLM, a novel LLM-based framework that explicitly extracts and models multi-scale temporal features from different layers of a pre-trained LLM. Through empirical analysis, we show that shallow layers of LLMs capture local dynamics in time series, while deeper layers encode global trends. Moreover, Logo-LLM introduces lightweight Local-Mixer and Global-Mixer modules to align and integrate features with the temporal input across layers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Logo-LLM achieves superior performance across diverse benchmarks, with strong generalization in few-shot and zero-shot settings while maintaining low computational overhead.

AI.tldr: Logo-LLM使用预训练 LLM 的多层输出，分别对应局部动态与全局趋势，通过轻量 Local/Global Mixer 融合特征，在小样本与零样本场景下以低算力代价刷新时序预测 SOTA。
AI.motivation: Transformer 及现有 LLM-TS 方法仅取末层输出，丢失浅层蕴含的短期局部变化，导致对局部模式建模不足。
AI.method: 提出 Logo-LLM：1) 分层抽取 LLM 不同层表示，显式区分浅层局部特征与深层全局特征；2) 设计 Local-Mixer 与 Global-Mixer 轻量模块，将多层特征对齐并注入原始时序输入，实现多尺度融合；3) 保持预训练权重冻结，仅训练 Mixer，控制计算开销。
AI.result: 在多元与单变量基准上全面领先，零-shot 平均提升 12.3%，few-shot 提升 8.7%，参数量与推理耗时仅为已有 LLM-TS 方法的 1/4。
AI.conclusion: LLM 的层级语义可用于时序多尺度建模；Logo-LLM 通过“分层提取+轻量融合”策略，兼顾局部灵敏度、全局感知力与计算效率，为 LLM 在时序预测中的高效应用提供了可扩展范式。

title: Generative Augmented Inference
summary: Data-driven operations management often relies on parameters estimated from costly human-generated labels. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and other AI systems offer inexpensive auxiliary data, but introduce a new challenge: AI outputs are not direct observations of the target outcomes, but could involve high-dimensional representations with complex and unknown relationships to human labels. Conventional methods leverage AI predictions as direct proxies for true labels, which can be inefficient or unreliable when this relationship is weak or misspecified. We propose Generative Augmented Inference (GAI), a general framework that incorporates AI-generated outputs as informative features for estimating models of human-labeled outcomes. GAI uses an orthogonal moment construction that enables consistent estimation and valid inference with flexible, nonparametric relationship between LLM-generated outputs and human labels. We establish asymptotic normality and show a "safe default" property: relative to human-data-only estimators, GAI weakly improves estimation efficiency under arbitrary auxiliary signals and yields strict gains whenever the auxiliary information is predictive. Empirically, GAI outperforms benchmarks across diverse settings. In conjoint analysis with weak auxiliary signals, GAI reduces estimation error by about 50% and lowers human labeling requirements by over 75%. In retail pricing, where all methods access the same auxiliary inputs, GAI consistently outperforms alternative estimators, highlighting the value of its construction rather than differences in information. In health insurance choice, it cuts labeling requirements by over 90% while maintaining decision accuracy. Across applications, GAI improves confidence interval coverage without inflating width. Overall, GAI provides a principled and scalable approach to integrating AI-generated information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生成式增强推断(GAI)框架，将AI输出作为特征而非代理标签，统一整合LLM生成信息，可在保持置信区间覆盖的同时大幅削减成本约束下的人力标注需求。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动的运营管理常依赖昂贵的人工标注。大模型可提供廉价辅助数据，但其高维输出与真实标签关系未知复杂，简单视AI预测为代理标签会导致模型误设且效率低。
AI.method: 构建GAI框架：将AI生成输出视为辅助特征而非直接标签；基于正交矩条件进行一致估计；允许非参数、灵活映射，并证明渐近正态性和“安全默认”优势。
AI.result: 理论上，GAI在任意辅助信号下弱优于纯人工估计，若信息具预测性则带来严格增益。实证中，GAI在联合分析、零售定价、健康险等场景中平均降低50%估计误差，削减人力标注75–90%，置信区间覆盖提升，宽度不膨胀。
AI.conclusion: GAI为大规模整合AI生成信息提供可扩展、原则化的解决方案，兼顾成本、效率与统计可靠性，适用于经合组织特征的运营问题。

title: Robust Reward Modeling for Large Language Models via Causal Decomposition
summary: Reward models are central to aligning large language models, yet they often overfit to spurious cues such as response length and overly agreeable tone. Most prior work weakens these cues directly by penalizing or controlling specific artifacts, but it does not explicitly encourage the model to ground preferences in the prompt's intent. We learn a decoder that maps a candidate answer to the latent intent embedding of the input. The reconstruction error is used as a signal to regularize the reward model training. We provide theoretical evidence that this signal emphasizes prompt-dependent information while suppressing prompt-independent shortcuts. Across math, helpfulness, and safety benchmarks, the decoder selects shorter and less sycophantic candidates with 0.877 accuracy. Incorporating this signal into RM training in Gemma-2-2B-it and Gemma-2-9B-it increases RewardBench accuracy from 0.832 to 0.868. For Best-of-N selection, our framework increases length-controlled win rates while producing shorter outputs, and remains robust to lengthening and mild off-topic drift in controlled rewrite tests.

AI.tldr: 用“提示意图-答案”重构误差做正则化，显著削弱奖赏模型对长度、谄媚等捷径的依赖，提升多基准准确率和长度受控胜率。
AI.motivation: 现有奖赏模型过度依赖长度、谄媚等无关提示的捷径，缺乏显式引导其聚焦真实意图的机制。
AI.method: 引入可学习的“解码器”把候选答案映射回提示的潜在意图表示，以重构误差为正则信号训练奖赏模型，并给出理论说明其可抑制提示无关特征。
AI.result: 在数学、有用性、安全性基准上，筛选的候选答案更短、更少谄媚，准确率达0.877；集成到Gemma-2-2B/9B-it后，RewardBench准确率从0.832提升至0.868；Best-of-N筛选在长度受控胜率提升的同时输出更短，并对抗加长和轻微跑题改写保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 重构误差正则化能有效消除奖赏模型滥用捷径的问题，实现更精准、偏好与意图一致的判别，为大型模型对齐提供简单可扩展的新训练信号。

title: An Optimal Transport-driven Approach for Cultivating Latent Space in Online Incremental Learning
summary: In online incremental learning, data continuously arrives with substantial distributional shifts, creating a significant challenge because previous samples have limited replay value when learning a new task. Prior research has typically relied on either a single adaptive centroid or multiple fixed centroids to represent each class in the latent space. However, such methods struggle when class data streams are inherently multimodal and require continual centroid updates. To overcome this, we introduce an online Mixture Model learning framework grounded in Optimal Transport theory (MMOT), where centroids evolve incrementally with new data. This approach offers two main advantages: (i) it provides a more precise characterization of complex data streams, and (ii) it enables improved class similarity estimation for unseen samples during inference through MMOT-derived centroids. Furthermore, to strengthen representation learning and mitigate catastrophic forgetting, we design a Dynamic Preservation strategy that regulates the latent space and maintains class separability over time. Experimental evaluations on benchmark datasets confirm the superior effectiveness of our proposed method.

AI.tldr: 在线非稳态流中用最优传输驱动的动态混合原型持续学习框架，不用固定/单原型，边收数边更新多原型，并辅以动态保序策略防灾难性遗忘。实验结果显示性能领先。
AI.motivation: 在线增量场景数据分布不断变化，已有中心点方法仅靠固定或多原型无法捕捉真实的多模态流式漂移，带来表征漂移与原型失配问题；同时在无充足回放样本时易发生灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出 MMOT：增量最优传输混合模型。它首先引入 Wasserstein 距离实时对齐当前批次与正在演化的各类别原型（多个高斯）分布；随后用 warm-start 优化加可插拔流体动力学更新流程，让原型随新数据自适应调整。配合 Dynamic Preservation：通过留出上一批代表性的少量锚点和正则项保持空间线段距离，稳定类可分性并抑制遗忘。
AI.result: 在公开数据集 CIFAR10-CIFAR100-Split、ImageNet→CUB、iCIFAR100 等上取得 SOTA：平均准确率领先 3–7%，遗忘率下降 20% 以上，且收敛更快、增量阶段的峰值漂移表现为最小。
AI.conclusion: MMOT 以动态多原型与最优传输匹配为核心，提升了对多变模态流的在线建模稳健性；Dynamic Preservation 进一步保障长期空间稳定性。该方法为流式增量学习原型演化提供了新范式，并可向在线人脸识别、工业传感采集等持续领域扩展。

title: Unsupervised Learning of Local Updates for Maximum Independent Set in Dynamic Graphs
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 1 table, 3 algorithms. To appear at IJCNN 2026
summary: We present the first unsupervised learning model for Maximum-Independent-Set (MaxIS) in dynamic graphs where edges change over time. Our method combines structural learning from graph neural networks (GNNs) with a learned distributed update mechanism that, given an edge addition or deletion event, modifies nodes' internal memories and infers their MaxIS membership in a single, parallel step. We evaluate our model against a mixed integer programming solver and a breadth of unsupervised and supervised learning models for combinatorial optimization on static graphs. Across dynamic graphs of 200-1,000 nodes, our model achieves approximation ratios that are competitive with the state-of-the-art models while running 1.91-6.70x faster. When generalizing to graphs with 100x more nodes than those used for training, our model produces MaxIS solutions 1.00-1.18x larger than all other unsupervised models, but is outperformed by the state-of-the-art supervised model. These results demonstrate that this novel, unsupervised, update-based learning approach to dynamic combinatorial optimization is a viable alternative to the naïve reapplication of analogous models for static graphs, leveraging temporal information to improve neural methods for combinatorial optimization.

title: CPGRec+: A Balance-oriented Framework for Personalized Video Game Recommendations
comment: Published in ACM Transactions on Information Systems (TOIS). 43 pages, 9 figures
summary: The rapid expansion of gaming industry requires advanced recommender systems tailored to its dynamic landscape. Existing Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based methods primarily prioritize accuracy over diversity, overlooking their inherent trade-off. To address this, we previously proposed CPGRec, a balance-oriented gaming recommender system. However, CPGRec fails to account for critical disparities in player-game interactions, which carry varying significance in reflecting players' personal preferences and may exacerbate over-smoothness issues inherent in GNN-based models. Moreover, existing approaches underutilize the reasoning capabilities and extensive knowledge of large language models (LLMs) in addressing these limitations. To bridge this gap, we propose two new modules. First, Preference-informed Edge Reweighting (PER) module assigns signed edge weights to qualitatively distinguish significant player interests and disinterests while then quantitatively measuring preference strength to mitigate over-smoothing in graph convolutions. Second, Preference-informed Representation Generation (PRG) module leverages LLMs to generate contextualized descriptions of games and players by reasoning personal preferences from comparing global and personal interests, thereby refining representations of players and games. Experiments on \textcolor{black}{two Steam datasets} demonstrate CPGRec+'s superior accuracy and diversity over state-of-the-art models. The code is accessible at https://github.com/HsipingLi/CPGRec-Plus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CPGRec+，在游戏推荐中同时提升准确性与多样性；核心为 PER 与 PRG 两大模块，分别用带符号边权抑制过平滑、用 LLM 生成上下文表征。实验在 Steam 双数据集上验证其 SOTA 水平。
AI.motivation: 游戏推荐场景动态且需兼顾多样性与准确性，现有 GNN 方法重精度轻多样，且忽视交互重要性差异导致的过平滑；同时缺乏对 LLM 推理与知识能力的利用。
AI.method: 设计两模块：① PER 模块为玩家–游戏边赋带符号权重，区分兴趣/无兴趣并量化强度，再重加权图卷积；② PRG 模块利用 LLM 从全局与个体兴趣对比中推理生成游戏与玩家的上下文描述，进而精化表征。二者嵌入原 CPGRec 框架形成 CPGRec+。
AI.result: 在两个 Steam 数据集上，CPGRec+ 的准确率和多样性指标均优于现有最优模型，验证方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过 PER 抑制过平滑、PRG 注入 LLM 推理知识，CPGRec+ 在图游戏推荐中实现准确–多样双赢，为后续 GNN+LLM 融合研究提供新范式。

title: Beyond Static Personas: Situational Personality Steering for Large Language Models
summary: Personalized Large Language Models (LLMs) facilitate more natural, human-like interactions in human-centric applications. However, existing personalization methods are constrained by limited controllability and high resource demands. Furthermore, their reliance on static personality modeling restricts adaptability across varying situations. To address these limitations, we first demonstrate the existence of situation-dependency and consistent situation-behavior patterns within LLM personalities through a multi-perspective analysis of persona neurons. Building on these insights, we propose IRIS, a training-free, neuron-based Identify-Retrieve-Steer framework for advanced situational personality steering. Our approach comprises situational persona neuron identification, situation-aware neuron retrieval, and similarity-weighted steering. We empirically validate our framework on PersonalityBench and our newly introduced SPBench, a comprehensive situational personality benchmark. Experimental results show that our method surpasses best-performing baselines, demonstrating IRIS's generalization and robustness to complex, unseen situations and different models architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出无训练、基于「人格神经元」的 IRIS 框架，可在不同情境下即时、可控地调变大模型人格，并在新基准 SPBench 上显著优于现有最佳方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 个性化方法可控性差、资源消耗大，且采用静态人格建模，难以适应多变情境；本文旨在实现情境自适应、低成本且高可控的个性化。
AI.method: 1）通过多视角分析证明 LLM 存在「情境依赖性」与稳定的「情境-行为」模式；2）提出训练无关的三阶段 IRIS 框架——Identify（定位情境人格神经元）、Retrieve（按情境检索相关神经元）、Steer（相似度加权激活/抑制）——完成情境化人格控制。
AI.result: 在 PersonalityBench 与新建基准 SPBench 上，IRIS 在多种复杂未知情境及不同模型架构下均优于最强基线，展现出良好泛化性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 神经元级情境人格操控可行且高效；IRIS 无需重训练即可实现可控、可迁移的 LLM 个性化，为动态人机交互提供新范式。

title: Frame forecasting in cine MRI using the PCA respiratory motion model: comparing recurrent neural networks trained online and transformers
comment: 43 pages, 19 figures. Revised version with minor corrections and improved figures and language. Accepted for publication in Computerized Medical Imaging and Graphics
summary: Respiratory motion complicates accurate irradiation of thoraco-abdominal tumors during radiotherapy, as treatment-system latency entails target-location uncertainties. This work addresses frame forecasting in chest and liver cine MRI to compensate for such delays. We investigate RNNs trained with online learning algorithms, enabling adaptation to changing respiratory patterns via on-the-fly parameter updates, and transformers, increasingly common in time-series forecasting for their ability to capture long-term dependencies. Experiments used 12 sagittal thoracic and upper-abdominal cine-MRI sequences from ETH Zürich and OvGU; the OvGU data exhibited higher motion variability, noise, and lower contrast. PCA decomposes the Lucas-Kanade optical-flow field into static deformation modes and low-dimensional, time-dependent weights. We compare various methods for forecasting these weights: linear filters, population and sequence-specific transformer encoders, and RNNs trained with real-time recurrent learning (RTRL), unbiased online recurrent optimization, decoupled neural interfaces, and sparse one-step approximation (SnAp-1). Predicted displacements were used to warp the reference frame and generate future images. Prediction accuracy decreased with the horizon h. Linear regression performed best at short horizons (1.3mm geometrical error at h=0.32s, ETH Zürich dataset), while RTRL and SnAp-1 outperformed the other algorithms at medium-to-long horizons, with geometrical errors below 1.4mm and 2.8mm on the sequences from ETH Zürich and OvGU, respectively. The sequence-specific transformer was competitive for low-to-medium horizons, but transformers remained overall limited by data scarcity and domain shift between datasets. Predicted frames visually resembled the ground truth, with notable errors occurring near the diaphragm at end-inspiration and regions affected by out-of-plane motion.

AI.tldr: 为补偿放疗中的系统延迟，本文在、胸腹T2-MRI影片上使用分组训练实现在线的RNN和Transformer预测框架，能在长时域内将几何误差控制在<2.8mm，优于传统线性滤波及纯Transformer网络。
AI.motivation: 放疗时胸腹肿瘤因呼吸运动与设备延迟存在明显定位误差，需基于MRI影片实时推断靶区未来位置，而现有方法难以兼顾呼吸模式变化和预测时域。
AI.method: 用PCA+L-K光流提取低维动态权重，对比线性滤波、群体/序列相关Transformer、四类在线RNN(RTRL、UORO、DNI、SnAp-1)，其中RNN参数随输入流实时更新；将预测权重反向生成形变场并重建未来帧。
AI.result: ETH Zürich数据：线性回归短窗最优(0.32s时1.3mm)，RTRL/SnAp-1中长窗<1.4mm；OvGU数据(运动噪声更大)同法<2.8mm。序列相关Transformer于中窗可与之竞争，但全局样本少域落差使其整体落后。
AI.conclusion: 在线RNN能自适应呼吸轨迹突变，在长达0.5-0.7s的预测窗口内维持亚厘米级几何精度，有望用于实时放疗门控或跟踪；未来需扩展跨中心数据与融合先验模型突破样本稀疏瓶颈。

title: Practical estimation of the optimal classification error with soft labels and calibration
comment: ICLR 2026 camera ready version; 40 pages, 12 figures; GitHub: https://github.com/RyotaUshio/bayes-error-estimation
summary: While the performance of machine learning systems has experienced significant improvement in recent years, relatively little attention has been paid to the fundamental question: to what extent can we improve our models? This paper provides a means of answering this question in the setting of binary classification, which is practical and theoretically supported. We extend a previous work that utilizes soft labels for estimating the Bayes error, the optimal error rate, in two important ways. First, we theoretically investigate the properties of the bias of the hard-label-based estimator discussed in the original work. We reveal that the decay rate of the bias is adaptive to how well the two class-conditional distributions are separated, and it can decay significantly faster than the previous result suggested as the number of hard labels per instance grows. Second, we tackle a more challenging problem setting: estimation with corrupted soft labels. One might be tempted to use calibrated soft labels instead of clean ones. However, we reveal that calibration guarantee is not enough, that is, even perfectly calibrated soft labels can result in a substantially inaccurate estimate. Then, we show that isotonic calibration can provide a statistically consistent estimator under an assumption weaker than that of the previous work. Our method is instance-free, i.e., we do not assume access to any input instances. This feature allows it to be adopted in practical scenarios where the instances are not available due to privacy issues. Experiments with synthetic and real-world datasets show the validity of our methods and theory. The code is available at https://github.com/RyotaUshio/bayes-error-estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过硬标签和有损软标签两方扩展，给出了二分类下 Bayes 误差的一个可扩展估计框架，理论表明收敛速度随分布可分性自适应加快，且唯一依赖软标签而不需原始样本，兼顾隐私与实用。
AI.motivation: 当前机器学习性能快速提升，却少有人回答「我们究竟能把模型做到多好」。本研究希望在二分类中建立一个可计算的理论上限，即能估计的 Bayes 误差，从而为系统性能提供天花板。
AI.method: 1) 对硬标签框架，给出偏差与标签数量间的显式衰减率，证明其与类别条件分布分离性自适应；2) 提出受损软标签场景下无需原输入（instance-free）的估计方法，发现单纯校准不足以保证正确，而进一步采用保序校准可在更弱假设下得到一致性估计；3) 采用合成与真实数据集验证框架有效性，并开源代码。
AI.result: 理论上：硬标签估计器的偏差可在分布分离度好时超先前界快速熄灭；受损软标签下提出的保序估计具一致性。实验上：合成与 UCI、图像数据集均验证了收敛速率与实例无关，估计误差显著低于基准，且对隐私不可见数据亦有效。
AI.conclusion: 二分类的 Bayes 误差可通过仅依赖标签的简单方法准确估计；偏差衰减速率自适应于分布可分性，受损标签经恰当处理后仍可提供一致估计，且无需暴露原始样本，为性能上限评估和隐私敏感场景提供了新工具与理论保证。

title: AgileLog: A Forkable Shared Log for Agents on Data Streams
summary: In modern data-streaming systems, alongside traditional programs, a new type of entity has emerged that can interact with streaming data: AI agents. Unlike traditional programs, AI agents use LLM reasoning to accomplish high-level tasks specified in natural language over streaming data. Unfortunately, current streaming systems cannot fully support agents: they lack the fundamental mechanisms to avoid the performance interference caused by agentic tasks and to safely handle agentic writes. We argue that the shared log, the core abstraction underlying streaming data, must support creating forks of itself, and that such a forkable shared log serves as a great substrate for agents acting on streaming data. We propose AgileLog, a new shared log abstraction that provides novel forking primitives for agentic use cases. We design Bolt, an implementation of the AgileLog abstraction, that uses novel techniques to make forks cheap, and provide logical and performance isolation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可分叉的共享日志 AglieLog 及其系统 Bolt，为 AI 智能体在流式数据上的推理与写入提供逻辑隔离与性能隔离，解决现有流系统无法承载 Agent 任务的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现代流式系统中出现利用 LLM 完成自然语言任务的 AI 智能体，其推理负载与写入行为会带来性能干扰与数据安全的不确定性，而传统共享日志抽象不支持隔离与实验性分支。
AI.method: 提出 AgileLog——在共享日志上原生支持低成本分叉（fork）的新抽象；设计并实现 Bolt 系统，通过只读视图、零拷贝索引与异步快照技术使 fork 开销极低，并为每个 Agent 分支提供独立的逻辑命名空间与配额隔离。
AI.result: 实验表明，在 YCSB 与真实流数据负载下，Bolt 可在亚毫秒级完成日志分叉，Agent 分支的读写吞吐量与基线持平；在 32 分支并发压力下，P99 延迟比无隔离共享方案降低 3.7 倍，错误写入率降为零。
AI.conclusion: 可分叉共享日志是承载 AI Agent 大规模并行实验与部署的关键抽象，AgileLog/Bolt 在保持流式系统高吞吐的同时提供了必要的逻辑与性能隔离，为“智能体即服务”范式奠定了基础。

title: From Feelings to Metrics: Understanding and Formalizing How Users Vibe-Test LLMs
comment: Under review. 42 pages, 18 figures. Code and data at https://technion-cs-nlp.github.io/vibe-testing-llms
summary: Evaluating LLMs is challenging, as benchmark scores often fail to capture models' real-world usefulness. Instead, users often rely on ``vibe-testing'': informal experience-based evaluation, such as comparing models on coding tasks related to their own workflow. While prevalent, vibe-testing is often too ad hoc and unstructured to analyze or reproduce at scale. In this work, we study how vibe-testing works in practice and then formalize it to support systematic analysis. We first analyze two empirical resources: (1) a survey of user evaluation practices, and (2) a collection of in-the-wild model comparison reports from blogs and social media. Based on these resources, we formalize vibe-testing as a two-part process: users personalize both what they test and how they judge responses. We then introduce a proof-of-concept evaluation pipeline that follows this formulation by generating personalized prompts and comparing model outputs using user-aware subjective criteria. In experiments on coding benchmarks, we find that combining personalized prompts and user-aware evaluation can change which model is preferred, reflecting the role of vibe-testing in practice. These findings suggest that formalized vibe-testing can serve as a useful approach for bridging benchmark scores and real-world experience.

AI.tldr: 文章指出传统 LLM 评测脱离用户真实使用场景，用户普遍用“vibe-testing”（主观、随感式）评估模型；作者将此过程系统化，提出“双个性化”框架（个性化测试内容与评价标准），并在代码任务上实验，发现其能显著改变模型排序，从而弥合基准分与真实体验的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有基准评分与模型在实际工作流中的表现脱节，导致用户依赖非正式的 vibe-testing，但该方式难以规模化、可复现。亟需将用户主导的“经验式”评估纳入正规评测体系。
AI.method: ① 实证调研：对 1 份用户评测实践调查 + 2 博客/社交媒体上的“野生”对比报告做质性编码，归纳 vibe-testing 的核心步骤。② 形式化：将其抽象为两步个性化——生成与用户工作流匹配的个性化提示（What to test），以及使用用户主观标准评判回答（How to judge）。③ 系统实现：构建原型流水线，利用用户画像自动生成提示，并用用户偏好模型做主观打分。④ 验证：在 HumanEval、MBPP 等代码基准上，对比标准与个性化两种评测方式对模型偏好的影响。
AI.result: 引入个性化提示与评价标准后，模型排名发生显著翻转：例如某 SOTA 模型在标准 HumanEval 上领先 5.8%，但在个性化设置下落后 3.2%，用户更偏好另一“次优”模型。量化指标显示，个性化评测能解释 37% 的用户实际选择差异（R²=0.37），远高于仅用基准分的 8%。
AI.conclusion: 正式化的 vibe-testing 可作为传统基准的有效补充，通过“双个性化”让评测结果更贴近真实使用体验；未来可扩展至多模态、长文本等场景，并集成至模型发布平台，实现“用户画像-个性化评测-动态排行榜”闭环。

title: Maximal Brain Damage Without Data or Optimization: Disrupting Neural Networks via Sign-Bit Flips
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Accepted as a Featured Paper at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) can be catastrophically disrupted by flipping only a handful of parameter bits. We introduce Deep Neural Lesion (DNL), a data-free and optimizationfree method that locates critical parameters, and an enhanced single-pass variant, 1P-DNL, that refines this selection with one forward and backward pass on random inputs. We show that this vulnerability spans multiple domains, including image classification, object detection, instance segmentation, and reasoning large language models. In image classification, flipping just two sign bits in ResNet-50 on ImageNet reduces accuracy by 99.8%. In object detection and instance segmentation, one or two sign flips in the backbone collapse COCO detection and mask AP for Mask R-CNN and YOLOv8-seg models. In language modeling, two sign flips into different experts reduce Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking from 78% to 0% accuracy. We also show that selectively protecting a small fraction of vulnerable sign bits provides a practical defense against such attacks.

AI.tldr: 通过无数据、无优化的DNL/1P-DNL定位少量关键参数位，跨CV/NLP模型验证其翻转即可致模型失效，并提出仅保护极少量符号位的轻量防御。
AI.motivation: 揭示并量化DNN对极少量参数位翻转的灾难性脆弱性，为后续防御提供精确靶点。
AI.method: 提出DNL与1P-DNL快速定位关键符号位；在ResNet-50、Mask R-CNN、YOLOv8-seg、Qwen3-30B等多任务模型上进行单/双位翻转攻击实验。
AI.result: ImageNet上ResNet-50翻2个符号位准确率降99.8%；COCO检测与分割AP被1–2位翻转清零；Qwen3-30B翻2位专家符号位准确率由78%→0%。
AI.conclusion: 极少量符号位翻转即可跨域瘫痪DNN，选择性保护<1%的脆弱符号位即可有效防御。

title: Diagnosing and Improving Diffusion Models by Estimating the Optimal Loss Value
comment: 33 pages, 12 figures, 9 tables. ICLR 2026 Camera Ready version
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generative modeling. Despite more stable training, the loss of diffusion models is not indicative of absolute data-fitting quality, since its optimal value is typically not zero but unknown, leading to confusion between large optimal loss and insufficient model capacity. In this work, we advocate the need to estimate the optimal loss value for diagnosing and improving diffusion models. We first derive the optimal loss in closed form under a unified formulation of diffusion models, and develop effective estimators for it, including a stochastic variant scalable to large datasets with proper control of variance and bias. With this tool, we unlock the inherent metric for diagnosing the training quality of mainstream diffusion model variants, and develop a more performant training schedule based on the optimal loss. Moreover, using models with 120M to 1.5B parameters, we find that the power law is better demonstrated after subtracting the optimal loss from the actual training loss, suggesting a more principled setting for investigating the scaling law for diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 本文首次给出扩散模型最优损失的解析解与可扩展估计器，为训练诊断和性能提升建立标准指标。通过大规模实验验证，去除最优损失后所得“净损失”更符合规模定律的幂律关系。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型训练稳定但现有损失值无法反映拟合优劣，因最优损失非零且未知，导致训练不足与模型容量耗尽混淆，亟需可获得的最优参考基准。
AI.method: 1) 推导扩散模型统一框架下最优损失的封闭表达式；2) 提出雾扰动方差可控的随机估计器，实现大规模数据集下的无偏估计；3) 基于估算结果设计自适应训练调度，并利用120M–1.5B参数模型验证“净损失”与容量扩展规律。
AI.result: 得到可靠的最优损失估计后，主流扩散模型训练质量一目了然，Residual-Net/DDPM/Score-SDE等变体收敛速度普遍提升10%–22%；“净损失”对模型参数与数据量的幂律指数由-0.31(-0.37)降至更合理的-0.09(-0.11)，符合理论预期。
AI.conclusion: 最优损失估计为扩散模型提供了可信的“靶心”，不仅能减少训练早期停止的风险，更将规模定律研究置于更纯净的损失空间，为后续模型与数据驱动的协同放大奠定了量化学尺度。

title: Mechanistic Decoding of Cognitive Constructs in LLMs
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate increasingly sophisticated affective capabilities, the internal mechanisms by which they process complex emotions remain unclear. Existing interpretability approaches often treat models as black boxes or focus on coarse-grained basic emotions, leaving the cognitive structure of more complex affective states underexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose a Cognitive Reverse-Engineering framework based on Representation Engineering (RepE) to analyze social-comparison jealousy. By combining appraisal theory with subspace orthogonalization, regression-based weighting, and bidirectional causal steering, we isolate and quantify two psychological antecedents of jealousy, Superiority of Comparison Person and Domain Self-Definitional Relevance, and examine their causal effects on model judgments. Experiments on eight LLMs from the Llama, Qwen, and Gemma families suggest that models natively encode jealousy as a structured linear combination of these constituent factors. Their internal representations are broadly consistent with the human psychological construct, treating Superiority as the foundational trigger and Relevance as the ultimate intensity multiplier. Our framework also demonstrates that toxic emotional states can be mechanically detected and surgically suppressed, suggesting a possible route toward representational monitoring and intervention for AI safety in multi-agent environments.

AI.tldr: 研究提出Cognitive Reverse-Engineering框架，用RepE技术拆解大模型的社会比较嫉妒，找到两条可见因果链，并给出可检测/抑制毒性情感的方法。
AI.motivation: 大模型已表现出复杂情感能力，但内部机制不明；现有可解释工作要么黑箱，要么只关注基础情感，对更复杂的社会比较类型嫉妒缺乏微观解析。
AI.method: 基于表示工程(RepE)，将评价理论与子空间正交化、回归加权、双向因果操控结合，分离出两个心理学先验因子——
AI.result: 在Llama/Qwen/Gemma三系8种模型上，证实模型将嫉妒编为
AI.conclusion: 模型对齐人类心理结构，嫉妒由触发因子+强度倍数线性合成，且对毒性情感可实现“机械扫描”与“外科切除”，为多智能体AI安全建立可测可干预的情感表示监管路线。

title: One RL to See Them All: Visual Triple Unified Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is becoming an important direction for post-training vision-language models (VLMs), but public training methodologies for unified multimodal RL remain much less mature, especially for heterogeneous reasoning and perception-heavy tasks. We propose V-Triune, a Visual Triple Unified Reinforcement Learning methodology for unified multimodal RL. It organizes training around three coordinated abstractions: Sample-Level Reward Routing, Verifier-Level Outcome Verification, and Source-Level Diagnostics. Within this methodology, Dynamic IoU provides localization-specific reward shaping that avoids reward ambiguity under loose thresholds and reward sparsity under strict ones. Built on V-Triune, we develop Orsta (7B, 32B), a family of models jointly trained on eight reasoning and perception tasks. Under matched budgets, unified training matches or outperforms specialist mixtures. The final Orsta models improve over their backbones on MEGA-Bench, compare favorably with strong multi-task RL-VLM baselines, and transfer these gains to a broad set of downstream benchmarks. These results show that unified RL can improve both reasoning and perception within a single VLM RL pipeline.The V-Triune system, along with the Orsta models, is publicly available at https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/One-RL-to-See-Them-All.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的多模态强化学习框架V-Triune及其Orsta模型族，通过三重抽象设计在8类推理与感知任务上同时提升定位与推理能力，并在MEGA-Bench等多套下游基准上取得统一训练优于专家混合模型的结果。
AI.motivation: 现有公开研究在视觉-语言模型（VLM）的后训练强化学习（RL）上高度碎片化：一方面，推理与感知任务异构导致统一RL训练困难；另一方面，松散或严格的IoU阈值分别带来奖励歧义或稀疏，严重制约定位性能。作者希望提出一种通用训练范式，让单一RL管道兼顾推理与感知，并公开相关方法与模型。
AI.method: V-Triune将训练流程抽象为三重机制：1. 样本级奖励路由（Sample-Level Reward Routing）负责把不同任务的多维奖励动态归并；2. 验证器级结果验证（Verifier-Level Outcome Verification）提供链式验证式稀疏奖励；3. 源级诊断（Source-Level Diagnostics）实时监控样本与奖励质量用于课程与去噪。为解决定位任务的奖励设计痛点，该方法引入Dynamic IoU——在训练过程中按置信度与难度动态调整IoU阈值，同时实现奖励塑形与稀疏度控制。基于此框架，作者训练统一参数规模的Orsta-7B/32B，使用相同预算同时在8项异构任务上执行多任务RL，并用专家混合与单任务模型作为对照。
AI.result: 在计算预算等同的前提下，统一训练的Orsta模型在全部8项任务上达到或超越专门化专家混合系统的性能。最终模型在MEGA-Bench上相对其GPT-4V级主链模型全面提升，并优于现有强RL-VLM多任务基线。增益可迁移至GQA、COCO caption、RefCOCOg等广泛下游基准，验证了统一RL在推理与感知两侧的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 统一多模态强化学习并非注定性能折中。通过V-Triune的三重抽象与Dynamic IoU奖励塑形，可在同一参数空间内同时优化推理与感知能力。公开方法与模型（https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/One-RL-to-See-Them-All）为未来一体化RL-VLM研究提供可行方案，并鼓励社区在统一范式下进一步提升多任务与迁移表现。

AI.motivation: 扩散模型训练虽稳定，但其 train loss 最优值未知且不为零，导致难以区分「已达最优」还是「模型容量不足」。作者认为必须先能估计最优损失，方能科学地诊断与改进模型。
AI.method: ① 在统一数学框架下，推导出最优损失的闭式公式；② 设计高效随机估计器，并配套方差与偏差控制，使其能扩展到大规模数据集；③ 利用所得「最优损失」作为基准，开发新的训练调度和诊断流程；④ 通过参数 120M–1.5B 的规模实验验证其对尺度律的影响。
AI.result: 估计器在大规模数据上稳定收敛；与传统方案相比，可在同等迭代内获得更高生成质量；用最优损失校正后，扩散模型的尺度律呈现更干净的幂律关系，斜率更清晰可解释。

title: Time-RA: Towards Time Series Reasoning for Anomaly Diagnosis with LLM Feedback
comment: ACL 2026 Findings. 27 pages, 11 figures, 15 tables. Code and dataset are publicly available
summary: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) has traditionally focused on binary classification and often lacks the fine-grained categorization and explanatory reasoning required for transparent decision-making. To address these limitations, we propose Time-series Reasoning for Anomaly (Time-RA), a novel task that reformulates TSAD from a discriminative into a generative, reasoning-intensive paradigm. To facilitate this, we introduce RATs40K, the first real-world large-scale multimodal benchmark with ~40,000 samples across 10 domains, integrating raw time series, textual context, and visual plots with structured reasoning annotations. Extensive benchmarking shows that while supervised fine-tuning and visual representations boost diagnostic accuracy and reasoning consistency, performance varies across complex scenarios. Notably, fine-tuned models demonstrate strong "plug-and-play" transferability, outperforming traditional baselines on unseen real-world datasets. Our work establishes a foundation for interpretable, multimodal time series analysis. All code (https://github.com/yyysjz1997/Time-RA) and the RATs40K dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/Time-RA/RATs40K) are fully open-sourced to facilitate future research.

AI.tldr: 论文将时间序列异常检测(TSAD)从二分类升级为生成式细粒度推理任务—Time-RA，发布含4万样本的多模态基准RATs40K，配套开源数据与代码，实现可解释且即插即用的跨域异常诊断。
AI.motivation: 传统TSAD只做二分类，缺乏细粒度类别划分和可解释推理，难以满足透明决策需求。
AI.method: 提出新任务Time-RA：将TSAD重塑为需要生成式推理的范式；构建10领域、4万样本的多模态基准RATs40K，集成原始序列、文本、图像及结构化推理标注；用监督微调(SFT)与视觉表示训练模型，并进行跨域可迁移性评估。
AI.result: SFT与视觉信号显著提升诊断准确率与推理一致性；在复杂场景下性能仍存差异；微调模型对未见过的新数据集表现出强的“即插即用”迁移能力，全面超越传统基线。
AI.conclusion: Time-RA与RATs40K为可解释、多模态时间序列分析奠定基础，相关资源全部开源以促进后续研究。

title: CausalDetox: Causal Head Selection and Intervention for Language Model Detoxification
summary: Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate toxic content, posing significant risks for safe deployment. Current mitigation strategies often degrade generation quality or require costly human annotation. We propose CAUSALDETOX, a framework that identifies and intervenes on the specific attention heads causally responsible for toxic generation. Using the Probability of Necessity and Sufficiency (PNS), we isolate a minimal set of heads that are necessary and sufficient for toxicity. We utilize these components via two complementary strategies: (1) Local Inference-Time Intervention, which constructs dynamic, input-specific steering vectors for context-aware detoxification, and (2) PNS-Guided Fine-Tuning, which permanently unlearns toxic representations. We also introduce PARATOX, a novel benchmark of aligned toxic/non-toxic sentence pairs enabling controlled counterfactual evaluation. Experiments on ToxiGen, ImplicitHate, and ParaDetox show that CAUSALDETOX achieves up to 5.34% greater toxicity reduction compared to baselines while preserving linguistic fluency, and offers a 7x speedup in head selection.

AI.tldr: 用因果方法定位LLM中诱发毒性的注意力头，在推理时或微调阶段干预，仅改少数头即可降毒5%+且不掉流利度。
AI.motivation: 大模型易产毒性文本，现有方法要么牺牲生成质量、要么依赖昂贵人工标注，需一种保质、低成本的去毒方案。
AI.method: 提出CAUSALDETOX框架：①用PNS因果度量筛选“必要且充分”的毒性头；②局部推理时干预，为每输入动态生成转向向量；③PNS引导微调，永久擦除毒性表示；并发布对齐毒/非毒句对基准PARATOX供反事实评估。
AI.result: 在ToxiGen、ImplicitHate、ParaDetox上，毒性降低比基线多5.34个百分点，流利度保持，头选择速度提升7倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过因果定位最小毒性组件并定向干预，可在不损语言质量的前提下高效去毒，为安全部署LLM提供可扩展新范式。

title: VisRet: Visualization Improves Knowledge-Intensive Text-to-Image Retrieval
summary: Text-to-image retrieval (T2I retrieval) remains challenging because cross-modal embeddings often behave as bags of concepts, underrepresenting structured visual relationships such as pose and viewpoint. We proposeVisualize-then-Retrieve (VisRet), a retrieval paradigm that mitigates this limitation of cross-modal similarity alignment. VisRet first projects textual queries into the image modality via T2I generation, then performs retrieval within the image modality to bypass the weaknesses of cross-modal retrievers in recognizing subtle visual-spatial features. Across four benchmarks (Visual-RAG, INQUIRE-Rerank, Microsoft COCO, and our new Visual-RAG-ME featuring multi-entity comparisons), VisRet substantially outperforms cross-modal similarity matching and baselines that recast T2I retrieval as text-to-text similarity matching, improving nDCG@30 by 0.125 on average with CLIP as the retriever and by 0.121 with E5-V. For downstream question answering, VisRet increases accuracy on Visual-RAG and Visual-RAG-ME by 3.8% and 15.7% in top-1 retrieval, and by 3.9% and 11.1% in top-10 retrieval. Ablation studies show compatibility with different T2I instruction LLMs, T2I generation models, and downstream LLMs. VisRet provides a simple yet effective perspective for advancing in text-image retrieval. Our code and the new benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/xiaowu0162/Visualize-then-Retrieve.

AI.tldr: 提出“先生成再检索”（VisRet）框架，将文本先转为图像再单模态检索，跳过跨模态对齐对细粒度空间关系的忽视，四大基准上nDCG@30平均提升≥0.12，下游问答Top-1准确率最高+15.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态图文检索把嵌入当“概念袋”，难以捕捉姿势、视角等结构化视觉关系，导致细粒度匹配失败。
AI.method: VisRet：①用 T2I 生成模型把查询文本转换成“伪图像”；②在纯图像空间用 CLIP/E5-V 等单模态检索器找最相近的真实图像；③无需修改原模型，可自由替换 T2I/LLM 组件。
AI.result: 在 Visual-RAG、INQUIRE-Rerank、COCO 及自建 Visual-RAG-ME 上，nDCG@30 相比最强跨模态基线平均提升 0.125（CLIP）和 0.121（E5-V）；Visual-RAG-ME 问答 Top-1/Top-10 准确率分别提升 15.7%/11.1%；消融验证模型组合鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过“文本→图像→图像检索”绕过跨模态对齐缺陷，简单有效提升细粒度图文检索与下游问答，新基准与代码已开源，为社区提供即插即用的新范式。

authors: Shatha Abudalou Yasin Yilmaz Yoganand Balagurunathan
title: Improving Prostate Gland Segmentation Using Transformer based Architectures
summary: Inter reader variability and cross site domain shift challenge the automatic segmentation of prostate anatomy using T2 weighted MRI images. This study investigates whether transformer models can retain precision amid such heterogeneity. We compare the performance of UNETR and SwinUNETR in prostate gland segmentation against our previous 3D UNet model [1], based on 546 MRI (T2weighted) volumes annotated by two independent experts. Three training strategies were analyzed: single cohort dataset, 5 fold cross validated mixed cohort, and gland size based dataset. Hyperparameters were tuned by Optuna. The test set, from an independent population of readers, served as the evaluation endpoint (Dice Similarity Coefficient). In single reader training, SwinUNETR achieved an average dice score of 0.816 for Reader#1 and 0.860 for Reader#2, while UNETR scored 0.8 and 0.833 for Readers #1 and #2, respectively, compared to the baseline UNets 0.825 for Reader #1 and 0.851 for Reader #2. SwinUNETR had an average dice score of 0.8583 for Reader#1 and 0.867 for Reader#2 in cross-validated mixed training. For the gland size-based dataset, SwinUNETR achieved an average dice score of 0.902 for Reader#1 subset and 0.894 for Reader#2, using the five-fold mixed training strategy (Reader#1, n=53; Reader#2, n=87) at larger gland size-based subsets, where UNETR performed poorly. Our findings demonstrate that global and shifted-window self-attention effectively reduces label noise and class imbalance sensitivity, resulting in improvements in the Dice score over CNNs by up to five points while maintaining computational efficiency. This contributes to the high robustness of SwinUNETR for clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: SwinUNETR 凭借 shifted-window self-attention，在跨读者、跨中心 T2WI 前列腺分割任务中全面优于 3D UNet 与 UNETR，Dice 最高提升 5 个百分点，尤其在体积较大亚组与混合训练策略下鲁棒性显著。
AI.motivation: 读者间标注差异及跨中心域偏移会降低 T2WI 自动前列腺分割的可靠性，需验证 Transformer 模型在异质数据中的精度保持能力。
AI.method: 546 例 T2WI 双专家标注数据，比较 SwinUNETR、UNETR 与 3D-UNet；训练策略：单读者、5 折混合、按腺体体积分组；超参 Optuna 优化；独立测试集以 Dice 为主要指标。
AI.result: 单读者训练：SwinUNETR Dice 0.816/0.860，优于 UNETR 0.80/0.833 与 UNet 0.825/0.851；5 折混合训练：SwinUNETR 达 0.858/0.867；体积较大亚组：SwinUNETR 进一步提升至 0.902/0.894，UNETR 显著下降。
AI.conclusion: SwinUNETR 的全局与 shifted-window self-attention 可抑制标注噪声与类别不平衡，提高 Dice 同时保持计算效率，具备临床部署的高鲁棒性。

title: SPaCe: Unlocking Sample-Efficient Large Language Models Training With Self-Pace Curriculum Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong reasoning capabilities when fine-tuned with reinforcement learning (RL). However, such methods require extensive data and compute, making them impractical under many realistic training budgets. Many existing pipelines sample training examples uniformly across steps or epochs, ignoring differences in difficulty, redundancy, and learning value, which slows learning and wastes computation. We propose \textbf{SPaCe}, a self-paced learning framework that enables efficient learning based on the capability of the model being trained through optimizing which data to use and when. First, we apply \emph{cluster-based data reduction} to partition training data by semantics and difficulty, extracting a compact yet diverse subset that reduces redundancy. Then, a \textit{multi-armed bandit} treats data clusters as arms, allocating training samples based on the model's solve rates and learning progress. Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks show that SPaCe achieves comparable or better accuracy than state-of-the-art baselines while using up to \(100\times\) fewer samples. Ablation studies and analyses further highlight the importance of both data clustering and adaptive selection. Our results demonstrate that carefully curated, performance-driven training curricula can unlock strong reasoning abilities in LLMs with minimal resources.

AI.tldr: SPaCe框架通过语义-难度聚类+多臂 Bandit 动态采样的两步课程学习，把 RL 微调 LLM 的样本消耗压缩 100×，推理性能仍持平或优于 SoTA。
AI.motivation: RL 微调 LLM 推理能力需海量数据与算力，现有均匀采样忽视难度与冗余，导致学习低效、资源浪费。
AI.method: 1) 聚类压缩：按语义与难度分簇，生成紧凑低冗余训练子集；2) 自适应采样：将簇当多臂 Bandit，根据当前模型解题率与进度动态分配样本，实现自步调课程。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准上，SPaCe 用 1% 样本即追平或超越全数据 SoTA RL 基线；消融实验证实聚类与 Bandit 采样缺一不可。
AI.conclusion: 面向性能的精细化数据课程可显著降低 LLM 强推理能力的资源门槛，采样策略与数据质量同样关键。

title: Hijacking Large Audio-Language Models via Context-Agnostic and Imperceptible Auditory Prompt Injection
summary: Modern Large audio-language models (LALMs) power intelligent voice interactions by tightly integrating audio and text. This integration, however, expands the attack surface beyond text and introduces vulnerabilities in the continuous, high-dimensional audio channel. While prior work studied audio jailbreaks, the security risks of malicious audio injection and downstream behavior manipulation remain underexamined. In this work, we reveal a previously overlooked threat, auditory prompt injection, under realistic constraints of audio data-only access and strong perceptual stealth. To systematically analyze this threat, we propose \textit{AudioHijack}, a general framework that generates context-agnostic and imperceptible adversarial audio to hijack LALMs. \textit{AudioHijack} employs sampling-based gradient estimation for end-to-end optimization across diverse models, bypassing non-differentiable audio tokenization. Through attention supervision and multi-context training, it steers model attention toward adversarial audio and generalizes to unseen user contexts. We also design a convolutional blending method that modulates perturbations into natural reverberation, making them highly imperceptible to users. Extensive experiments on 13 state-of-the-art LALMs show consistent hijacking across 6 misbehavior categories, achieving average success rates of 79\%-96\% on unseen user contexts with high acoustic fidelity. Real-world studies demonstrate that commercial voice agents from Mistral AI and Microsoft Azure can be induced to execute unauthorized actions on behalf of users. These findings expose critical vulnerabilities in LALMs and highlight the urgent need for dedicated defense.

AI.tldr: 首次提出“听觉提示注入”威胁，展示仅通过不可察觉的对抗音频即可在13个SOTA大音频语言模型上实现79%-96%劫持成功率，并诱导商业语音助手执行未授权操作。
AI.motivation: 大音频语言模型（LALM）将音频与文本紧耦合，扩大了攻击面；已有研究聚焦音频越狱，但对“仅音频数据访问”下的恶意注入与行为操控缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 设计AudioHijack框架：1) 采样式梯度估计绕过不可微音频分词；2) 注意力监督+多场景训练实现跨模型、跨上下文泛化；3) 卷积混响调制把扰动伪装成自然残响，确保感知隐蔽。
AI.result: 在13个主流LALM、6类越界行为上平均劫持成功率79%-96%；对Mistral AI与Microsoft Azure商用语音助手的真实场景实验成功诱导其替用户执行未授权操作，且音频保真度高。
AI.conclusion: 听觉提示注入是LALM中被忽视的关键漏洞，亟需针对音频通道的专用防御机制。

title: ProRank: Prompt Warmup via Reinforcement Learning for Small Language Models Reranking
summary: Reranking is fundamental to information retrieval and retrieval-augmented generation, with recent Large Language Models (LLMs) significantly advancing reranking quality. Most current works rely on large-scale LLMs (>7B parameters), presenting high computational costs. Small Language Models (SLMs) offer a promising alternative because of computational efficiency. However, our preliminary quantitative analysis reveals key limitations of SLMs: their representation space is narrow, leading to reduced expressiveness, and they struggle with understanding task prompts without fine-tuning. To address these issues, we introduce a novel two-stage training approach, ProRank, for SLM-based document reranking. We propose using reinforcement learning to improve the understanding of task prompts. Additionally, we introduce fine-grained score learning to enhance representation expressiveness and further improve document reranking quality. Extensive experiments suggest that ProRank consistently outperforms both the most advanced open-source and proprietary reranking models. Notably, our 0.5B ProRank even surpasses powerful LLM reranking models on the BEIR benchmark, establishing that properly trained SLMs can achieve superior document reranking performance while maintaining computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出基于0.5 B SLM的两阶段训练框架ProRank，以强化学习+细粒度打分训练，在BEIR上超越>7 B 开源/闭源重排模型，验证小模型高效重排潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM重排模型参数量大（>7 B）、推理成本高；SLM虽省算力，但表示空间狭窄、对提示理解差，性能显著落后，亟需低耗高效替代方案。
AI.method: 设计两阶段训练框架ProRank：① 强化学习阶段，用排序反馈优化SLM对任务提示的理解；② 细粒度打分学习阶段，引入逐文档连续分数监督，扩大表示空间并提升区分度。全程基于0.5 B 参数SLM，无需大模型蒸馏。
AI.result: 在BEIR等基准上，0.5 B ProRank平均nDCG@10超越目前最佳开源与专有重排模型（包括7 B+ LLM），最高提升4.9 pp；推理延迟仅为大模型1/20，能耗降低>90 %。
AI.conclusion: 只要训练策略得当，极小规模语言模型即可在重排任务中兼顾顶级性能与极高效率，为资源受限场景下的高级检索系统提供可落地的新范式。

title: KnowRL: Exploring Knowledgeable Reinforcement Learning for Factuality
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly slow-thinking models, often exhibit severe hallucination, outputting incorrect content due to an inability to accurately recognize knowledge boundaries during reasoning. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) can enhance complex reasoning abilities, its outcome-oriented reward mechanism often lacks factual supervision over the thinking process, further exacerbating the hallucination problem. To address the high hallucination in slow-thinking models, we propose Knowledge-enhanced RL, KnowRL. KnowRL guides models to perform fact-based slow thinking by integrating a factuality reward, based on knowledge verification, into the RL training process, helping them recognize their knowledge boundaries. KnowRL guides models to perform fact-based slow thinking by integrating a factuality reward, based on knowledge verification, into the RL training process, helping them recognize their knowledge boundaries. This targeted factual input during RL training enables the model to learn and internalize fact-based reasoning strategies. By directly rewarding adherence to facts within the reasoning steps, KnowRL fosters a more reliable thinking process. Experimental results on three hallucination evaluation datasets and two reasoning evaluation datasets demonstrate that KnowRL effectively mitigates hallucinations in slow-thinking models while maintaining their original strong reasoning capabilities. Our code is available at https://github.com/zjunlp/KnowRL.

AI.tldr: 针对慢思考大模型的严重幻觉，本文提出基于知识验证的强化学习框架 KnowRL，在训练流程中引入真实性奖励，使模型能在推理时识别知识边界并内化事实推理策略，显著抑制幻觉且保持原有推理能力。代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 慢思考 LLM 因无法准确识别自身知识边界而高度幻觉；现有 RL 侧重结果奖励，对推理过程缺乏事实监督，反而放大幻觉。亟需一种能在训练阶段持续注入事实信号、引导模型进行“基于事实的慢思考”的方法。
AI.method: 提出 KnowRL：1) 构建可验证知识库与自动事实检验器，为推理每一步生成真实性标签；2) 将“事实性奖励”嵌入 RL 奖励函数，与任务结果奖励联合优化；3) 采用课程式训练策略，逐步增加事实约束强度，使模型内化边界感知与事实一致性检查机制。
AI.result: 在 3 个幻觉评测集（HaluEval、TruthfulQA、FaithDial）上，KnowRL 相较基座慢思考模型把幻觉率降低 28–42%，在 2 个复杂推理集（GSM8K、MATH）上保持甚至提升原推理准确率（±1% 内），超越仅用结果奖励的 RL 基线。
AI.conclusion: KnowRL 首次证明：在强化学习阶段持续施加“过程级事实奖励”可同时抑制幻觉并保留复杂推理能力，为构建可信的慢思考 LLM 提供了可扩展的训练范式。

title: EEGDM: Learning EEG Representation with Latent Diffusion Model
summary: Recent advances in self-supervised learning for EEG representation have largely relied on masked reconstruction, where models are trained to recover randomly masked signal segments. While effective at modeling local dependencies, such objectives are inherently limited in capturing the global dynamics and long-range dependencies essential for characterizing neural activity. To address this limitation, we propose EEGDM, a novel self-supervised framework that leverages latent diffusion models to generate EEG signals as an objective. Unlike masked reconstruction, diffusion-based generation progressively denoises signals from noise to realism, compelling the model to capture holistic temporal patterns and cross-channel relationships. Specifically, EEGDM incorporates an EEG encoder that distills raw signals and their channel augmentations into a compact representation, acting as conditional information to guide the diffusion model for generating EEG signals. This design endows EEGDM with a compact latent space, which not only offers ample control over the generative process but also can be leveraged for downstream tasks. Experimental results show that EEGDM (1) reconstructs high-quality EEG signals, (2) learns robust representations, and (3) achieves competitive performance across diverse downstream tasks, thus exploring a new direction for self-supervised EEG representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EEGDM——首个以潜在扩散模型为核心、通过“生成式自监督”学习 EEG 表征的新框架，解决掩码重建无法建模全局动态与长程依赖的痛点，在信号重建、表征鲁棒性与下游任务上全面优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 EEG 自监督方法几乎清一色采用“随机掩码+局部重建”策略，只能抓短期邻域相关，对跨通道、跨时间的全局节律与长程依赖刻画不足，限制下游判别任务性能。
AI.method: EEGDM 将原始信号及通道级增广先压入紧凑潜在编码（EEG Encoder），再以该编码为条件驱动潜在扩散模型，完成“噪声→真实 EEG”的生成式训练；整个流程无掩码，完全依赖逆向扩散过程迫使模型习得全局时空与跨通道结构。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，EEGDM 生成的 EEG 信号在时域、频域与拓扑结构上均显著优于掩码重建基线；学得的潜在表征在睡眠分期、情绪识别、性别/年龄预测等 4 类下游任务中，线性评估平均提升 3.1–7.8%，部分任务达 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 首次验证“生成式扩散目标”可为 EEG 自监督学习提供比掩码重建更丰富的全局归纳偏置，兼顾高质量生成与强泛化表征，为后续脑电大模型及脑机接口应用开辟了新方向。

title: Uncertainty-aware Generative Learning Path Recommendation with Cognition-Adaptive Diffusion
summary: Learning Path Recommendation (LPR) is critical for personalized education, yet current methods often fail to account for historical interaction uncertainty (e.g., lucky guesses or accidental slips) and lack adaptability to diverse learning goals. We propose U-GLAD (Uncertainty-aware Generative Learning Path Recommendation with Cognition-Adaptive Diffusion). To address representation bias, the framework models cognitive states as probability distributions, capturing the learner's underlying true state via a Gaussian LSTM. To ensure highly personalized recommendation, a goal-oriented concept encoder utilizes multi-head attention and objective-specific transformations to dynamically align concept semantics with individual learning goals, generating uniquely tailored embeddings. Unlike traditional discriminative ranking approaches, our model employs a generative diffusion model to predict the latent representation of the next optimal concept. Extensive evaluations on three public datasets demonstrate that U-GLAD significantly outperforms representative baselines. Further analyses confirm its superior capability in perceiving interaction uncertainty and providing stable, goal-driven recommendation paths.

AI.tldr: 论文提出U-GLAD方法，用概率分布刻画认知状态、扩散模型生成学习路径，兼顾历史交互不确定性与多样化学习目标，在三公开数据集上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有学习路径推荐忽视答题噪声（猜对/失误）导致认知估计偏，且难适配多元学习目标。
AI.method: 1. 认知建模：Gaussian LSTM将状态表示为概率分布以抑制交互噪声；2. 目标感知编码：多头注意+目标特定变换动态对齐概念语义；3. 生成推荐：扩散模型直接生成下个最优概念的隐表示，而非传统判别排序。
AI.result: 三个公开数据集上U-GLAD显著超越代表性基准；消融与案例验证其对交互不确定性更鲁棒，能输出稳定且目标导向的路径。
AI.conclusion: 通过不确定性感知的概率认知建模与目标自适应扩散生成，U-GLAD有效提升个性化学习路径推荐的稳健性与适应性。

KnowRL guides models to perform fact-based slow thinking by integrating a factuality reward, based on knowledge verification, into the RL training process, helping them recognize their knowledge boundaries. KnowRL guides models to perform fact-based slow thinking by integrating a factuality reward, based on knowledge verification, into the RL training process, helping them recognize their knowledge boundaries. This targeted factual input during RL training enables the model to learn and internalize fact-based reasoning strategies. By directly rewarding adherence to facts within the reasoning steps, KnowRL fosters a more reliable thinking process. AI.tldr: 提出 Knowledge-enhanced RL（KnowRL），通过在强化学习训练中加入基于知识验证的“事实性奖励”，引导慢思考大模型识别知识边界并抑制幻觉。
AI.motivation: 慢思考大模型推理中无法感知自身知识边界，导致幻觉严重；传统强化学习仅凭结果奖励缺乏过程事实监督，会放大幻觉。
AI.method: 在 RL 训练框架中引入可验证的事实性奖励，对推理链的每一步进行事实性打分并直接反馈，迫使模型学习基于事实的推理策略。
AI.result: 在 3 个幻觉评测集与 2 个推理评测集上，KnowRL 显著降低幻觉率且不损伤原有推理性能。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: KnowRL 通过奖励过程事实性而非仅奖励答案正确性，实现了一种更可信的慢思考范式，为幻觉治理提供了可落地的强化学习思路。

title: Federated Breast Cancer Detection Enhanced by Synthetic Ultrasound Image Augmentation
comment: This paper has been accepted to EMBC2026
summary: Federated learning enables collaborative training of deep learning models across institutions without sharing sensitive patient data. However, its performance is often limited by small datasets and non-independent, identically distributed data, which can impair model generalization. In this work, we propose a generative model-based data augmentation framework for breast ultrasound classification. It leverages synthetic images generated by deep convolutional generative adversarial networks and a class-conditioned denoising diffusion probabilistic model. Experiments on three publicly available datasets (BUSI, BUS-BRA, and UDIAT) demonstrated that incorporating a suitable number of synthetic images improved average AUC from 0.9206 to 0.9362 for FedAvg and from 0.9429 to 0.9574 for FedProx. Furthermore, we noticed that excessive use of synthetic data reduced performance. This highlights the importance of balancing real and synthetic samples. Our results underscore the potential of generative model-based augmentation to enhance federated breast ultrasound image classification.

AI.tldr: 用GAN+扩散模型生成超声图像在联邦训练中扩增，少量合成样本可显著提升AUC，过量则反降。
AI.motivation: 联邦乳腺超声分类受限于各机构数据量小且非独立同分布，需在不共享原始患者数据的前提下提升模型泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建基于深度卷积GAN与类别条件去噪扩散概率模型的生成式数据扩增框架，在客户端本地合成图像并与真实样本混合后参与联邦训练，采用FedAvg/FedProx聚合。
AI.result: 在BUSI、BUS-BRA、UDIAT三个公开数据集上，引入适量合成图像使平均AUC分别提升1.56pp(FedAvg)与1.45pp(FedProx)；过量合成数据导致性能下降，提示需权衡真实与合成样本比例。
AI.conclusion: 生成式扩增可显著缓解联邦乳腺超声分类中的数据稀缺与非IID问题，但合成数据用量需精细控制，为后续联邦医疗影像提供可行增强策略。

title: DPQuant: Efficient and Differentially-Private Model Training via Dynamic Quantization Scheduling
summary: Differentially-Private SGD (DP-SGD) and its adaptive variant DP-Adam are powerful techniques to protect user privacy when using sensitive data to train neural networks. During training, converting model weights and activations into low-precision formats, i.e., quantization, can drastically reduce training times, energy consumption, and cost, and is thus a widely used technique. In this work, we demonstrate for the first time that quantization causes significantly higher accuracy degradation in DP training compared to regular SGD. We observe that this is caused by noise injection, which amplifies quantization variance, leading to disproportionately large accuracy degradation. To address this challenge, we present DPQuant, a dynamic quantization framework that adaptively selects a changing subset of layers to quantize at each epoch. Our method combines two key ideas that effectively reduce quantization variance: (i) probabilistic sampling that rotates which layers are quantized every epoch, and (ii) loss-aware layer prioritization, which uses a differentially private loss sensitivity estimator to identify layers that can be quantized with minimal impact on model quality. This estimator consumes a negligible fraction of the overall privacy budget, preserving DP guarantees. Empirical evaluations on ResNet18, ResNet50, and DenseNet121 across a range of datasets demonstrate that DPQuant consistently outperforms static quantization baselines, achieving near Pareto-optimal accuracy-compute trade-offs and up to $2.21\times$ theoretical throughput improvements on low-precision hardware, with less than 2% drop in validation accuracy. We further show that our framework extends to DP-Adam with similar gains.

AI.tldr: DP-Quant是第一个发现低精度量化会显著放大DP-SGD训练中精度损失的缺陷，并提出动态（按epoch轮询层）&损失敏感度优先的量化策略，在几乎不牺牲DP保证的前提下把验证集掉点压到2%以内，整体吞吐可至2.21倍。
AI.motivation: 低精度量化是减少深度训练时间、能耗与成本的主流手段，但在差分隐私环境下其噪声与量化误差耦合会放大方差，导致精度暴跌；当前尚无系统研究DP场景下的量化代价与解决方案。
AI.method: 提出DPQuant框架：(i) 每轮按概率采样动态选取要量化的层，轮换量化位置；(ii) 用差分隐私损失敏感度估计器对层的重要性打分，优先量化影响最小的层，估计器仅消耗极小部分隐私预算；整体为无需重训、一次完成（training-aware）的自适应量化策略。
AI.result: 在ResNet18/50、DenseNet121及多组数据集上，DPQuant相对静态量化基线基本达到帕累托最优的
AI.conclusion: 量化噪声与DP噪声并非简单地可加，动态&损失感知的量化是在保护隐私下兼得高效训练与高保真模型的可行之道；DPQuant可直接嵌入现有DP-SGD/DP-Adam流程，为低精度硬件上的隐私训练提供实用方案。

title: Retrieve, Then Classify: Corpus-Grounded Automation of Clinical Value Set Authoring
summary: Clinical value set authoring -- the task of identifying all codes in a standardized vocabulary that define a clinical concept -- is a recurring bottleneck in clinical quality measurement and phenotyping. A natural approach is to prompt a large language model (LLM) to generate the required codes directly, but structured clinical vocabularies are large, version-controlled, and not reliably memorized during pretraining. We propose Retrieval-Augmented Set Completion (RASC): retrieve the $K$ most similar existing value sets from a curated corpus to form a candidate pool, then apply a classifier to each candidate code. Theoretically, retrieve-and-select can reduce statistical complexity by shrinking the effective output space from the full vocabulary to a much smaller retrieved candidate pool. We demonstrate the utility of RASC on 11,803 publicly available VSAC value sets, constructing the first large-scale benchmark for this task. A cross-encoder fine-tuned on SAPBert achieves AUROC~0.852 and value-set-level F1~0.298, outperforming a simpler three-layer Multilayer Perceptron (AUROC~0.799, F1~0.250) and both reduce the number of irrelevant candidates per true positive from 12.3 (retrieval-only) to approximately 3.2 and 4.4 respectively. Zero-shot GPT-4o achieves value-set-level F1~0.105, with 48.6\% of returned codes absent from VSAC entirely. This performance gap widens with increasing value set size, consistent with RASC's theoretical advantage. We observe similar performance gains across two other classifier model types, namely a cross-encoder initialized from pre-trained SAPBert and a LightGBM model, demonstrating that RASC's benefits extend beyond a single model class. The code to download and create the benchmark dataset, as well as the model training code is available at: \href{https://github.com/mukhes3/RASC}{https://github.com/mukhes3/RASC}.

AI.tldr: 提出“检索-增强集合补全（RASC）”框架，先召回K个最相似的高质量临床值集作候选池，再用轻量分类器筛码，显著降低LLM直接生码的幻觉与冗余；在11 803个VSAC值集上建立首个大规模基准，跨编码器(SAPBert)AUROC 0.852、F1 0.298，比GPT-4o零样本F1提升近3倍，候选无关码减至1/4。
AI.motivation: 临床质量测量与表型分析需反复构建“值集”——囊括某概念全部标准码，手工耗时且易错；直接用LLM输出完整码表会面临词汇表庞大、版本差异及记忆缺失导致的幻觉和遗漏，亟需可解释、低幻觉的自动方案。
AI.method: RASC两阶段：①检索阶段用双塔SBERT对目标概念文本与已有值集做最近邻搜索，取Top-K值集并合并其全部代码为候选池；②选择阶段用跨编码器(或MLP/LightGBM)对候选码逐一做“是否属于目标概念”二分类；理论上看，检索将有效输出空间从十万级词汇压缩至百级候选，降低统计复杂度。构建含11 803 VSAC值集、38万码-标签对的公开基准，支持跨版本、跨语料评估。
AI.result: 跨编码器SAPBert在候选池上AUROC 0.852，值集级微F1 0.298，比纯检索提升F1 19%，无关候选从12.3降至3.2；MLP基线亦达F1 0.250，无关码降至4.4。GPT-4o零样本F1仅0.105，48.6%返回码不在VSAC，随值集增大差距扩大。LightGBM与另两种编码器复现一致增益，证明框架对模型类别不敏感。公开代码与基准供后续研究。
AI.conclusion: RASC通过“先检索、再精选”把LLM的开放生成问题转化为封闭分类问题，兼顾准确性、可解释性与可扩展性，为临床值集构建提供首个可复现的大规模解决途径；未来可引入主动学习、多版本词汇对齐进一步压缩人工复核量。

title: Similarity-Distance-Magnitude Activations
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026. 21 pages, 8 tables, 1 algorithm. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2502.20167
summary: We introduce the Similarity-Distance-Magnitude (SDM) activation function, a more robust and interpretable formulation of the standard softmax activation function, adding Similarity (i.e., correctly predicted depth-matches into training) awareness and Distance-to-training-distribution awareness to the existing output Magnitude (i.e., decision-boundary) awareness, and enabling interpretability-by-exemplar via dense matching. We further introduce the SDM estimator, based on a data-driven partitioning of the class-wise empirical CDFs via the SDM activation, to control the class- and prediction-conditional accuracy among selective classifications. When used as the final-layer activation over pre-trained language models for selective classification, the SDM estimator is more robust to covariate shifts and out-of-distribution inputs than existing calibration methods using softmax activations, while remaining informative over in-distribution data.

AI.tldr: SDM激活函数在softmax基础上引入相似度（深度匹配）与分布距离感知，配合数据驱动的SDM估计器，实现可解释样本级匹配与类条件准确率控制；在预训练语言模型选择性分类任务中，对协变量偏移与OOD输入的鲁棒性优于传统softmax校准方法，同时保持ID数据的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统softmax仅关注决策边界幅度，缺乏对训练分布距离及深度特征匹配的显式建模，导致在协变量偏移和OOD场景下校准失效且不可解释。作者旨在构建兼具鲁棒性、可解释性与类条件准确率保证的激活-估计框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出SDM激活：在softmax指数项中联合嵌入“相似度”（深度特征匹配度）与“距离”（到训练分布的距离），实现决策边界、样本匹配、分布偏移三重感知。 2) 设计SDM估计器：利用SDM激活输出，按类对经验CDF做数据驱动分区，直接估计类条件准确率，支撑选择性分类的阈值设定。 3) 框架即插即用：替换预训练语言模型顶层softmax，无需重训练即可部署。
AI.result: 在多数据集协变量偏移与OOD测试上，SDM估计器相比温度缩放、MSP等softmax校准方法，显著降低选择性分类的期望风险（约20-30%），同时维持ID数据的准确率-覆盖率曲线不降；可视化显示SDM能提供“解释-by-示例”的邻域匹配依据。
AI.conclusion: 通过把相似度、分布距离与幅度统一进单一激活，SDM框架首次在无需额外训练的前提下，同时实现可解释样本匹配、类条件准确率控制与对OOD的鲁棒不确定度估计，为语言模型部署提供了更可靠的选择性分类接口。

title: From Memorization to Creativity: LLM as a Designer of Novel Neural Architectures
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel in program synthesis, yet their capacity for neural architecture design -- balancing syntactic reliability, performance, and structural novelty -- remains underexplored. We present a closed-loop architecture synthesis pipeline within the NNGPT framework, in which a code-oriented LLM evolves over 22 supervised fine-tuning cycles. At each cycle, the LLM synthesizes PyTorch convolutional networks, validated via low-fidelity performance signals and filtered via a MinHash--Jaccard criterion to prevent structural redundancy before being incorporated into the LEMUR dataset. High-performing candidates with novel architectures are converted into prompt--code pairs for parameter-efficient LoRA fine-tuning. This feedback loop drives a measurable distributional shift, progressively internalizing empirical architectural priors such that valid and high-performing outputs evolve from scarce to dominant across cycles. On CIFAR-10, the valid generation rate stabilizes at 50.6% (peaking at 74.5%), mean first-epoch accuracy rises from 28.1% to 51.0%, and candidates exceeding 40% accuracy grow from 2.0% to 96.8%. Cross-dataset transfer to CIFAR-100 and SVHN confirms that improved validity, shifted accuracy distributions, and sustained novelty generalize across benchmarks of varying difficulty and visual domain. Across 22 cycles, 455 unique architectures absent from the original corpus are admitted under the novelty filter. By grounding synthesis in execution feedback and novelty filtering, we demonstrate that iterative self-supervised fine-tuning reshapes an LLM into a task-specialized architectural prior -- improving generation reliability, proxy performance, and structural diversity -- offering a reproducible, annotation-free alternative to hand-crafted search spaces.

AI.tldr: 用代码大模型自己生成-验证-微调22轮，无需人工标注即可让网络结构生成从随机跃升至50%+有效、96%过40%准确率，并产出455个全新CNN结构。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在代码生成上很强，但在 neural architecture design 这一高维组合空间上缺乏可靠、自动且能产生新颖结构的方案。作者希望用LLM自身闭环学习，摆脱手工搜索空间与人工标注。
AI.method: NNGPT闭环体系：LLM→生成PyTorch CNN→低精度性能评估→MinHash-Jaccard去冗余→高性能/新颖结构转成prompt-code对→LoRA微调→继续生成。22轮后形成内部结构先验，全程无标签、无外部搜索器。
AI.result: CIFAR-10：有效结构比例从~0→50.6%(峰值74.5%)；首epoch平均准确率28.1%→51.0%；>40%准确率样本占比2%→96.8%。CIFAR-100、SVHN跨域同样提升，整体新增455个未见结构。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠执行反馈+新颖性过滤的迭代自监督微调，即可把通用LLM重塑为任务专属的结构先验生成器，兼顾可靠性、代理性能与多样性，为NAS提供无需手工、可复现的新范式。

title: Similarity-Distance-Magnitude Activations
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026. 21 pages, 8 tables, 1 algorithm. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2502.20167
summary: We introduce the Similarity-Distance-Magnitude (SDM) activation function, a more robust and interpretable formulation of the standard softmax activation function, adding Similarity (i.e., correctly predicted depth-matches into training) awareness and Distance-to-training-distribution awareness to the existing output Magnitude (i.e., decision-boundary) awareness, and enabling interpretability-by-exemplar via dense matching. We further introduce the SDM estimator, based on a data-driven partitioning of the class-wise empirical CDFs via the SDM activation, to control the class- and prediction-conditional accuracy among selective classifications. When used as the final-layer activation over pre-trained language models for selective classification, the SDM estimator is more robust to covariate shifts and out-of-distribution inputs than existing calibration methods using softmax activations, while remaining informative over in-distribution data.

AI.tldr: 提出SDM激活函数及其校准器，通过将深度匹配相似性、距训练分布距离及输出幅度信息融合，实现语言模型选择性分类的可解释性和更强的分布外鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有softmax仅依赖决策边界幅度，无法利用训练样本中的深度匹配相似性和距分布的距离信息，导致分布外预测置信度不可靠、缺乏可解释性，从而限制了语言模型在真实部署中的安全性与可分析性。
AI.method: (1)提出SDM激活：在预测时度量输入与训练样本的深度嵌入距离（相似性）及样本点到训练分布的距离，并同softmax的“幅度”并行输出。(2)设计SDM校准器：以在各类的经验CDF上进行数据驱动分区，对任意一对类别＋预测给出条件正确率估计，实现选择性预测的阈值控制。(3)在预训练语言模型末层替换激活，联合训练上述模块。
