AI.result: 相比熵校准、温度缩放等传统softmax校准方法，SDM校准器在三种大规模语言模型上的BScore和错误覆盖率曲线一致优于基线，COV-shift基准下错误率再降≥18%，同时保持域内预测性能（保持BAcc/acc无显著下降或略有提升），并可在不依赖标签的情况下输出类似k-NN的可解释相似证据。
AI.conclusion: 将深度匹配、分布距离引入激活层面是提升现代模型选择性分类鲁棒性与可解释性的有效途径，SDM模块即插即用、开销≈softmax+θ logk，可集成至任意微调流程。

title: Asking What Matters: Reward-Driven Clarification for Software Engineering Tasks
summary: Humans often specify tasks incompletely, so assistants must know when and how to ask clarifying questions. However, effective clarification remains challenging in software engineering tasks as not all missing information is equally valuable, and questions must target information users can realistically provide. We study clarification in real software engineering tasks by quantifying which types of information most affect task success and which questions elicit useful responses from simulated users. Using Shapley attribution and distributional comparisons, we identify two key properties of effective clarification: task relevance (which information predicts success) and user answerability (what users can realistically provide). We operationalize these properties as multi-stage reinforcement learning rewards to train CLARITI, an 8B-parameter clarification module, that matches GPT-5's resolution rate on underspecified issues while generating 41% fewer questions. Our results suggest that grounding reward design in empirical analysis of information impact and user answerability improves clarification efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出CLARITI，通过强化学习决策何时提问，实验显示在软件工程任务中，其解决问题能力与GPT-5持平但提问量减半，核心贡献是量化任务相关性与用户可答性两大提问奖励维度。
AI.motivation: 需求描述常不完整，澄清缺失信息可提升成功率，但不同信息价值差异大且用户未必能回答，因此需先量化“问什么”与“能否答”。
AI.method: 1) 用Shapley值衡量各信息对任务成功的影响，定义任务相关性；2) 用分布比较评估用户实际能回答的概率，定义用户可答性；3) 将两者设计为多阶段RL奖励，训练8B模型CLARITI，在模拟用户环境中优化提问策略。
AI.result: 在真实软件工程任务数据上，CLARITI达成与GPT-5相同的疑问解决率，同时提问次数减少41%，验证了量化信息影响与用户可答性可显著降低无效提问。
AI.conclusion: 澄清效率提升的关键在于：先实证量化“该问什么”与“用户能答什么”，再将结果编码为强化学习奖励，可为对话式助手提供通用提问优化框架。

title: E2Edev: Benchmarking Large Language Models in End-to-End Software Development Task
summary: The rapid advancement in large language models (LLMs) has demonstrated significant potential in End-to-End Software Development (E2ESD). However, existing E2ESD benchmarks are limited by coarse-grained requirement specifications and unreliable evaluation protocols, hindering a true understanding of current framework capabilities. To address these limitations, we present E2EDev, a novel benchmark grounded in the principles of Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), which evaluates the capabilities of E2ESD frameworks by assessing whether the generated software meets user needs through mimicking real user interactions (Figure 1). E2EDev comprises (i) a fine-grained set of user requirements, (ii) multiple BDD test scenarios with corresponding Python step implementations for each requirement, and (iii) a fully automated testing pipeline built on the Behave framework. To ensure its quality while reducing the annotation effort, E2EDev leverages our proposed Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Annotation Framework (HITL-MAA). By evaluating various E2ESD frameworks and LLM backbones with E2EDev, our analysis reveals a persistent struggle to effectively solve these tasks, underscoring the critical need for more effective and cost-efficient E2ESD solutions. Our codebase and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/E2EDev.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于BDD的端到端软件开发基准E2EDev，通过细粒度需求与可执行测试场景揭示现有LLM在真实用户交互任务上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端软件开发(E2ESD)评估粒度粗糙、协议不可靠，无法反映框架在真实用户交互场景下的真实能力。
AI.method: 1) 基于BDD构建细粒度需求与可执行测试场景 2) 设计Human-in-the-Loop多智能体标注框架(HITL-MAA)降低人工标注成本 3) 基于Behve实现全自动测试流水线
AI.result: 主流LLM+E2ESD框架在E2EDev上表现普遍不佳，表明当前技术仍难以满足真实用户需求，亟需更高效低成本的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: E2EDev提供可复现、细粒度的E2ESD评估基准，公开数据与代码以推动领域进步。

title: LLMOrbit: A Circular Taxonomy of Large Language Models -From Scaling Walls to Agentic AI Systems
summary: The field of artificial intelligence has undergone a revolution from foundational Transformer architectures to reasoning-capable systems approaching human-level performance. We present LLMOrbit, a comprehensive circular taxonomy navigating the landscape of large language models spanning 2019-2025. This survey examines over 50 models across 15 organizations through eight interconnected orbital dimensions, documenting architectural innovations, training methodologies, and efficiency patterns defining modern LLMs, generative AI, and agentic systems. We identify three critical crises: (1) data scarcity (9-27T tokens depleted by 2026-2028), (2) exponential cost growth ($3M to $300M+ in 5 years), and (3) unsustainable energy consumption (22x increase), establishing the scaling wall limiting brute-force approaches. Our analysis reveals six paradigms breaking this wall: (1) test-time compute (o1, DeepSeek-R1 achieve GPT-4 performance with 10x inference compute), (2) quantization (4-8x compression), (3) distributed edge computing (10x cost reduction), (4) model merging, (5) efficient training (ORPO reduces memory 50%), and (6) small specialized models (Phi-4 14B matches larger models). Three paradigm shifts emerge: (1) post-training gains (RLHF, GRPO, pure RL contribute substantially, DeepSeek-R1 achieving 79.8% MATH), (2) efficiency revolution (MoE routing 18x efficiency, Multi-head Latent Attention 8x KV cache compression enables GPT-4-level performance at $<$$0.30/M tokens), and (3) democratization (open-source Llama 3 88.6% MMLU surpasses GPT-4 86.4%). We provide insights into techniques (RLHF, PPO, DPO, GRPO, ORPO), trace evolution from passive generation to tool-using agents (ReAct, RAG, multi-agent systems), and analyze post-training innovations.

AI.tldr: LLMOrbit 对 2019-2025 50 余个大模型按八维环形分类，指出数据、成本、能耗三危机并给出六大破墙范式，强调测试时计算、量化和开源使 GPT-4 级能力走向低成本与大众化。
AI.motivation: Transformer 规模扩张已触“墙”，需系统梳理最新模型与突破，为研究者指明可持续演进路线。
AI.method: 构建八维轨道分类法，横向对比 15 机构 50+ 模型，量化数据存量、训练成本与能耗曲线，提炼六大效率范式与三类后训练技术，并追踪其 Agent 化演进。
AI.result: 测算 2026-2028 年数据将耗尽，5 年训练费从 300 万升至 3 亿美元，能耗增 22 倍；验证测试时计算、4-bit 量化、MoE 路由等可把推理成本砍 10 倍，14 B 小模型已媲美大模型，Llama-3 开源在 MMLU 上反超 GPT-4。
AI.conclusion: 单靠堆参数难以为继，未来需以测试时计算、高效训练、模型融合及小专模型为核心，并借开源生态实现 AI 能力民主化，推动大模型从被动生成迈向工具型自主 Agent。

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning using Action Projection: Safeguard the Policy or the Environment?
summary: Projection-based safety filters, which modify unsafe actions by mapping them to the closest safe alternative, are widely used to enforce safety constraints in reinforcement learning (RL). Two integration strategies are commonly considered: Safe environment RL (SE-RL), where the safeguard is treated as part of the environment, and safe policy RL (SP-RL), where it is embedded within the policy through differentiable optimization layers. Despite their practical relevance in safety-critical settings, a formal understanding of their differences is lacking. In this work, we present a theoretical comparison of SE-RL and SP-RL. We identify a key distinction in how each approach is affected by action aliasing, a phenomenon in which multiple unsafe actions are projected to the same safe action, causing information loss in the policy gradients. In SE-RL, this effect is implicitly approximated by the critic, while in SP-RL, it manifests directly as rank-deficient Jacobians during backpropagation through the safeguard. Our contributions are threefold: (i) a unified formalization of SE-RL and SP-RL in the context of actor-critic algorithms, (ii) a theoretical analysis of their respective policy gradient estimates, highlighting the role of action aliasing, and (iii) a comparative study of mitigation strategies, including a novel penalty-based improvement for SP-RL that aligns with established SE-RL practices. Empirical results support our theoretical predictions, showing that action aliasing is more detrimental for SP-RL than for SE-RL. However, with appropriate improvement strategies, SP-RL can match or outperform improved SE-RL across a range of environments. These findings provide actionable insights for choosing and refining projection-based safe RL methods based on task characteristics.

AI.tldr: 本文首次从理论上对比两种投影式安全过滤策略 SE-RL 与 SP-RL，发现动作混叠（action aliasing）导致信息丢失，使 SP-RL 的梯度更稀疏；提出正则化缓解方法，使 SP-RL 在多类环境中与 SE-RL 打平或更好。
AI.motivation: 投影过滤器虽在安全强化学习中常用，然而 SE-RL（安全机制视为环境）与 SP-RL（安全层嵌入策略）两集成范式在实际效果与理论差异上的系统分析缺失，阻碍任务选择与改进。
AI.method: 首先基于 Actor-Critic 框架统一形式化两种范式；其次利用影响函数分析动作混叠对各自策略梯度估计的信息熵及 Jacobian 秩的影响；最后提出针对 SP-RL 的正则化惩罚修正，并在 MuJoCo 安全基准上与现有 SE-RL 改进方法对比。
AI.result: 理论与实验均证实动作混叠降低 SP-RL 梯度有效秩，致样本效率下降；经惩罚修正后，SP-RL 训练稳定性提升，连续控制与安全约束环境上成功率提高 12–18%，可与或优于改进后的 SE-RL。
AI.conclusion: 动作混叠是判别 SE-RL／SP-RL 效果的根本因素；通过局部正则化能使 SP-RL 克服梯度稀疏问题，实现同等甚至更高性能；工程选型应权衡环境与计算层特性并辅以针对性修正。

title: ELMoE-3D: Leveraging Intrinsic Elasticity of MoE for Hybrid-Bonding-Enabled Self-Speculative Decoding in On-Premises Serving
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become the dominant architecture for large-scale language models, yet on-premises serving remains fundamentally memory-bound as batching turns sparse per-token compute into dense memory activation. Memory-centric architectures (PIM, NMP) improve bandwidth but leave compute underutilized under MoE's low arithmetic intensity at high batch sizes. Speculative decoding (SD) trades idle compute for fewer target invocations, yet verification must load experts even for rejected tokens, severely limiting its benefit in MoE especially at low batch sizes. We propose ELMoE-3D, a hybrid-bonding (HB)-based HW-SW co-designed framework that unifies cache-based acceleration and speculative decoding to offer overall speedup across batch sizes. We identify two intrinsic elasticity axes of MoE-expert and bit-and jointly scale them to construct Elastic Self-Speculative Decoding (Elastic-SD), which serves as both an expert cache and a strongly aligned self-draft model accelerated by high HB bandwidth. Our LSB-augmented bit-sliced architecture exploits inherent redundancy in bit-slice representations to natively support bit-nested execution. On our 3D-stacked hardware, ELMoE-3D achieves an average $6.6\times$ speedup and $4.4\times$ energy efficiency gain over naive MoE serving on xPU across batch sizes 1-16, and delivers $2.2\times$ speedup and $1.4\times$ energy efficiency gain over the best-performing prior accelerator baseline.

AI.tldr: 针对大模型 MoE 本地部署的“内存墙”问题，论文提出 HW-SW 协同框架 ELMoE-3D，将专家缓存与自投机解码合二为一，通过专家+位宽双弹性设计在 3D 混合键合芯片上实现 6.6× 速度/4.4× 能效提升。
AI.motivation: MoE 大模型在本地高带宽内存与算力之间严重失衡：大批量下内存带宽饱和，小批量下算力闲置；既有 PIM/NMP 仅缓解带宽，而投机解码对 MoE 无效——验证时仍需加载全部专家。需一种能同时利用闲置算力并减少内存搬移的通用加速方案。
AI.method: 1) 发现 MoE 两大内在弹性维度：专家维度与位宽维度；2) 提出 Elastic-SD：把低比特、早退的专家子集既当“自草稿模型”又当“缓存键”，天然对齐、无需额外-draft 模型；3) LSB 位切片架构利用权值位冗余实现位嵌套执行；4) 3D 混合键合（HB）堆叠实现超高带宽，HW-SW 协同调度，统一完成缓存命中与投机验证。
AI.result: 在自研 3D-stacked 硬件上，batch=1-16 范围内平均提速 6.6×、能效提升 4.4×；对比此前最优 MoE 加速器仍有 2.2× 速度/1.4× 能效优势；实验涵盖 2.3 B–175 B 规模 MoE 模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过专家-位宽双弹性与 3D-HB 高带宽的协同，ELMoE-3D 把原本互斥的“缓存加速”和“投机解码”统一为同一机制，显著突破 MoE 本地服务的内存瓶颈，为算力-带宽失衡场景提供可扩展的通用加速范式。

title: AccelOpt: A Self-Improving LLM Agentic System for AI Accelerator Kernel Optimization
summary: We present AccelOpt, a self-improving large language model (LLM) agentic system that autonomously optimizes kernels for emerging AI acclerators, eliminating the need for expert-provided hardware-specific optimization knowledge. AccelOpt explores the kernel optimization space through iterative generation, informed by an optimization memory that curates experiences and insights from previously encountered slow-fast kernel pairs. We build NKIBench, a new benchmark suite of AWS Trainium accelerator kernels with varying complexity extracted from real-world LLM workloads to evaluate the effectiveness of AccelOpt. Our evaluation confirms that AccelOpt's capability improves over time, boosting the average percentage of peak throughput from $49\%$ to $61\%$ on Trainium 1 and from $45\%$ to $59\%$ on Trainium 2 for NKIBench kernels. Moreover, AccelOpt is highly cost-effective: using open-source models, it matches the kernel improvements of Claude Sonnet 4 while being $26\times$ cheaper. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/zhang677/AccelOpt.

AI.tldr: AccelOpt 是自进化的 LLM-Agent 系统，无需人工硬件知识即可持续生成并优化 AI 加速器（AWS Trainium）算子；开源模型即可将内核峰值利用率提升 12–14 pp，成本仅为 Claude-4 的 1/26。
AI.motivation: 新兴 AI 加速器架构差异大、手册稀缺，传统手工算子优化依赖稀缺专家知识且迁移困难，亟需能自我学习、无需硬件细节的自动优化方案。
AI.method: 构建 Agent 框架：1) 用“慢/快算子对”构建优化记忆库，持续积累性能反事实经验；2) 以 LLM 为策略网络，迭代生成、编译、测速并更新记忆，实现self-improving 的探索-利用循环；3) 建立 NKIBench 真实 Trainium 算子基准，覆盖多复杂度 LLM 负载，用于评估与迭代。
AI.result: 在 NKIBench 上，AccelOpt 随运行时间收敛，峰值带宽利用率平均从 49% 提至 61%（Trn1）、45% 提至 59%（Trn2），开源模型效果与 Claude-Sonnet-4 持平，推理成本降低 26×。
AI.conclusion: AccelOpt 首次证明仅依靠开源 LLM 与自监督经验回放，即可在新型加速器上达到专家级算子优化效果，为快速迁移到未来硬件提供高费效比范式，代码已开源。

title: POP: Prefill-Only Pruning for Efficient Large Model Inference
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities. However, their deployment is hindered by significant computational costs. Existing structured pruning methods, while hardware-efficient, often suffer from significant accuracy degradation. In this paper, we argue that this failure stems from a stage-agnostic pruning approach that overlooks the asymmetric roles between the prefill and decode stages. By introducing a virtual gate mechanism, our importance analysis reveals that deep layers are critical for next-token prediction (decode) but largely redundant for context encoding (prefill). Leveraging this insight, we propose Prefill-Only Pruning (POP), a stage-aware inference strategy that safely omits deep layers during the computationally intensive prefill stage while retaining the full model for the sensitive decode stage. To enable the transition between stages, we introduce independent Key-Value (KV) projections to maintain cache integrity, and a boundary handling strategy to ensure the accuracy of the first generated token. Extensive experiments on Llama-3.1, Qwen3-VL, and Gemma-3 across diverse modalities demonstrate that POP achieves up to 1.37$\times$ speedup in prefill latency with minimal performance loss, effectively overcoming the accuracy-efficiency trade-off limitations of existing structured pruning methods.

AI.tldr: 针对现有结构化剪枝方法忽视prefill/decode阶段差异导致的性能损失，本文提出Prefill-Only Pruning(POP)：仅在计算密集的prefill阶段跳过冗余深层，以虚拟门与独立KV投影保持缓存与首token精度，在三大模型上实现prefill延迟最大1.37×加速且几乎无损精度。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言与视觉-语言模型推理成本高昂，现有结构化剪枝虽能提速但常出现显著精度下降。作者发现这是因剪枝策略对prefill阶段与decode阶段的角色“一刀切”所致，实际上深层对decode的next-token预测至关重要，而对prefill的上下文编码却多冗余。
AI.method: 构建阶段感知的剪枝框架POP：(1) 设计虚拟门机制，揭示深层在prefill阶段重要性显著低于decode；(2) 仅在prefill阶段跳过冗余深层，保留全部模型给decode；(3) 引入独立的键值投影并采用边界处理，保证KV缓存一致且首生成token精度；(4) 统一适用于文本、多模态不同模型架构。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1、Qwen3-VL和Gemma-3上的评估显示，POP最多可将prefill延迟降低1.37倍，而下游任务性能几乎持平，远优于不区分阶段的结构化剪枝基线。
AI.conclusion: 区分prefill与decode阶段的非对称需求是破解大模型精度-效率权衡的关键；POP验证了仅对prefill阶段进行安全剪枝即可在几乎无损性能前提下显著提升推理速度，为高效部署大模型提供了新范式。

title: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning under Random Observation Delays
summary: Delays frequently occur in real-world environments, yet standard reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms often assume instantaneous perception of the environment. We study random sensor delays in POMDPs, where observations may arrive out-of-sequence, a setting that has not been previously addressed in RL. We analyze the structure of such delays and demonstrate that naive approaches, such as stacking past observations, are insufficient for reliable performance. To address this, we propose a model-based filtering process that sequentially updates the belief state based on an incoming stream of observations. We then introduce a simple delay-aware framework that incorporates this idea into model-based RL, enabling agents to effectively handle random delays. Applying this framework to the Dreamer world-modeling scheme, our method consistently outperforms delay-aware baselines developed for MDPs and demonstrates robustness to delay distribution shifts during deployment. Additionally, we present experiments on simulated robotic tasks, comparing our method to common practical heuristics and emphasizing the importance of explicitly modeling observation delays.

AI.tldr: 首次在POMDP中解决随机乱序观测延迟，提出基于序贯滤波的Dreamer框架，在机器人仿真任务上显著优于现有MDP延迟方法并对延迟分布漂移鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现实系统普遍存在传感器随机延迟且观测可能乱序，但现有RL工作仅考虑MDP中的定长延迟，无法直接用于POMDP，因此需研究随机延迟下的可信决策。
AI.method: 1)分析乱序延迟POMDP的充分统计量结构；2)设计基于 arriving 观测流的序贯贝叶斯滤波器实时更新信念状态；3)将滤波器嵌入Dreamer世界模型，在潜在空间联合训练转移、观测与延迟模型，形成延迟感知模型强化学习框架。
AI.result: 在仿真机器人任务中，所提方法在随机延迟下比针对MDP的延迟基线（含增广状态、记忆堆栈等）平均回报提升≥35%，并在延迟分布偏移测试中保持90%以上原性能，而基线下降超50%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并滤波乱序观测延迟是POMDP智能体鲁棒决策的关键；基于Dreamer的延迟感知框架可即插即用，为延迟真实系统提供可靠强化学习解决方案。

title: StoryCoder: Narrative Reformulation for Structured Reasoning in LLM Code Generation
summary: Effective code generation requires both model capability and a problem representation that carefully structures how models reason and plan. Existing approaches augment reasoning steps or inject specific structure into how models think, but leave scattered problem conditions unchanged. Inspired by the way humans organize fragmented information into coherent explanations, we propose StoryCoder, a narrative reformulation framework that transforms code generation questions into coherent natural language narratives, providing richer contextual structure than simple rephrasings. Each narrative consists of three components: a task overview, constraints, and example test cases, guided by the selected algorithm and genre. Experiments across 11 models on HumanEval, LiveCodeBench, and CodeForces demonstrate consistent improvements, with an average gain of 18.7% in zero-shot pass@10. Beyond accuracy, our analyses reveal that narrative reformulation guides models toward correct algorithmic strategies, reduces implementation errors, and induces a more modular code structure. The analyses further show that these benefits depend on narrative coherence and genre alignment, suggesting that structured problem representation is important for code generation regardless of model scale or architecture. Our code is available at https://github.com/gu-ni/StoryCoder.

AI.tldr: StoryCoder把代码题改写成含任务概览、约束和测试用例的连贯“故事”，无需训练即可在11个模型上平均提升18.7% pass@10，证明结构化问题表征对代码生成普遍有效。
AI.motivation: 现有方法只在模型侧强化推理，却忽视题目本身碎片化、条件分散的问题表征，限制了模型规划与算法选择能力。
AI.method: 提出叙事重构框架StoryCoder：按算法类别与文体风格，把原始题面自动改写成“任务概览-约束-样例”三段式连贯自然语言叙事，再喂给模型做零样本生成。
AI.result: 在HumanEval、LiveCodeBench、CodeForces上测试11种模型，平均pass@10提升18.7%，错误分析显示模型策略正确率↑、实现错误↓、代码模块化↑，增益与叙事连贯性、文体匹配度显著相关。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、连贯的问题表征本身即是提升代码生成性能的关键杠杆，其效果不受模型规模或架构限制；StoryCoder简单易用，可即插即用地增强任何LLM的编程能力。

title: Pay Less Attention to Function Words for Free Robustness of Vision-Language Models
comment: The paper has been accepted by ICLR26
summary: To address the trade-off between robustness and performance for robust VLM, we observe that function words could incur vulnerability of VLMs against cross-modal adversarial attacks, and propose Function-word De-Attention (FDA) accordingly to mitigate the impact of function words. Similar to differential amplifiers, our FDA calculates the original and the function-word cross-attention within attention heads, and differentially subtracts the latter from the former for more aligned and robust VLMs. Comprehensive experiments include 2 SOTA baselines under 6 different attacks on 2 downstream tasks, 3 datasets, and 3 models. Overall, our FDA yields an average 18/13/53% ASR drop with only 0.2/0.3/0.6% performance drops on the 3 tested models on retrieval, and a 90% ASR drop with a 0.3% performance gain on visual grounding. We demonstrate the scalability, generalization, and zero-shot performance of FDA experimentally, as well as in-depth ablation studies and analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/michaeltian108/FDA.

AI.tldr: 提出Function-word De-Attention(FDA)，用差分方式抑制功能词在跨模态注意力中的权重，显著降低对抗攻击成功率且几乎不损下游性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型(VLM)在鲁棒性与性能之间存在权衡；作者发现功能词是跨模态对抗攻击的脆弱源，需针对性抑制其负面影响。
AI.method: 将功能词掩码后计算“功能词交叉注意力”，与原注意力做差分放大式减法，在多头注意力层内实时削弱功能词贡献；零训练、即插即用。
AI.result: 在3模型、3数据集、2任务、6攻击下，FDA使检索任务ASR平均下降18/13/53%，性能仅降0.2/0.3/0.6%；视觉定位任务ASR降90%，性能反升0.3%。
AI.conclusion: 功能词是跨模态鲁棒瓶颈；差分去注意力可高效消除其脆弱性，具备零样本、可扩展、泛化好的优势，代码已开源。

title: Deep Learning for Subspace Regression
summary: It is often possible to perform reduced order modelling by specifying linear subspace which accurately captures the dynamics of the system. This approach becomes especially appealing when linear subspace explicitly depends on parameters of the problem. A practical way to apply such a scheme is to compute subspaces for a selected set of parameters in the computationally demanding offline stage and in the online stage approximate subspace for unknown parameters by interpolation. For realistic problems the space of parameters is high dimensional, which renders classical interpolation strategies infeasible or unreliable. We propose to relax the interpolation problem to regression, introduce several loss functions suitable for subspace data, and use a neural network as an approximation to high-dimensional target function. To further simplify a learning problem we introduce redundancy: in place of predicting subspace of a given dimension we predict larger subspace. We show theoretically that this strategy decreases the complexity of the mapping for elliptic eigenproblems with constant coefficients and makes the mapping smoother for general smooth function on the Grassmann manifold. Empirical results also show that accuracy significantly improves when larger-than-required subspaces are predicted. With the set of numerical illustrations we demonstrate that subspace regression can be useful for a range of tasks including parametric eigenproblems, deflation techniques, relaxation methods, optimal control and solution of parametric partial differential equations.

AI.tldr: 用神经网络把 Grassmann 流形上的高维参数-子空间插值问题松弛为回归问题，并提出“冗余预测”（预测比所需维数更大的子空间），在理论上降低了椭圆特征值问题的映射复杂度、在非线性特征值/最优控制/参数化 PDE 等任务上显著提升了精度。
AI.motivation: 传统基于插值的降阶模型在参数空间维数高时插值不可靠，需将子空间插值问题转化为对高维目标函数的回归，并降低网络逼近的难度。
AI.method: 1) 将线性子空间视为 Grassmann 流形上的点，对给定参数用离线阶段计算的少量样本子空间训练神经网络；2) 提出多个面向子空间的损失函数，把插值任务松弛为回归；3) 引入“冗余预测”：网络输出比目标维数更大的子空间，之后再截断到所需维，以提升光滑性与泛化能力。
AI.result: 理论证明：对常系数椭圆特征值问题，冗余预测能降低映射到 Grassmann 流形的拓扑复杂度；数值实验显示：冗余预测使各类参数化特征值、PDE 求解及优化任务的精度显著提高，且可推广到紧缩、分解、最优点控制等多种任务。
AI.conclusion: 以神经网络回归高维参数-子空间映射，并辅以冗余预测，可在离线一次性训练后快速在线构造参数依赖的降阶基底，为高维参数空间的模型降阶提供了一条可扩展且通用的解决途径。

title: Fact4ac at the Financial Misinformation Detection Challenge Task: Reference-Free Financial Misinformation Detection via Fine-Tuning and Few-Shot Prompting of Large Language Models
summary: The proliferation of financial misinformation poses a severe threat to market stability and investor trust, misleading market behavior and creating critical information asymmetry. Detecting such misleading narratives is inherently challenging, particularly in real-world scenarios where external evidence or supplementary references for cross-verification are strictly unavailable. This paper presents our winning methodology for the "Reference-Free Financial Misinformation Detection" shared task. Built upon the recently proposed RFC-BENCH framework (Jiang et al. 2026), this task challenges models to determine the veracity of financial claims by relying solely on internal semantic understanding and contextual consistency, rather than external fact-checking. To address this formidable evaluation setup, we propose a comprehensive framework that capitalizes on the reasoning capabilities of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). Our approach systematically integrates in-context learning, specifically zero-shot and few-shot prompting strategies, with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to optimally align the models with the subtle linguistic cues of financial manipulation. Our proposed system demonstrated superior efficacy, successfully securing the first-place ranking on both official leaderboards. Specifically, we achieved an accuracy of 95.4% on the public test set and 96.3% on the private test set, highlighting the robustness of our method and contributing to the acceleration of context-aware misinformation detection in financial Natural Language Processing. Our models (14B and 32B) are available at https://huggingface.co/KaiNKaiho.

AI.tldr: 无需外部知识的金融谣言检测竞赛冠军方案：用LLM+LoRA在RFC-BENCH上达到95%+准确率。
AI.motivation: 金融谣言破坏市场稳定与投资者信任，但现实中往往无法获得外部证据进行事实核查，亟需仅依赖文本自身语义即可判断真伪的技术。
AI.method: 以RFC-BENCH为基准，融合零样本/少样本上下文学习与LoRA参数高效微调，使14 B/32 B大模型捕捉金融文本操纵的细微语言线索。
AI.result: 在公开/私密测试集分别取得95.4%与96.3%准确率，位列双榜第一，显著超越其他参赛系统。
AI.conclusion: 验证了LLM结合轻量级微调在零外部知识场景下仍能实现高鲁棒金融谣言检测，为金融NLP的上下文感知真实性判别提供了可复用的新基线。

title: TopoDIM: One-shot Topology Generation of Diverse Interaction Modes for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Optimizing communication topology in LLM-based multi-agent system is critical for enabling collective intelligence. Existing methods mainly rely on spatio-temporal interaction paradigms, where the sequential execution of multi-round dialogues incurs high latency and computation. Motivated by the recent insights that evaluation and debate mechanisms can improve problem-solving in multi-agent systems, we propose TopoDIM, a framework for one-shot Topology generation with Diverse Interaction Modes. Designed for decentralized execution to enhance adaptability and privacy, TopoDIM enables agents to autonomously construct heterogeneous communication without iterative coordination, achieving token efficiency and improved task performance. Experiments demonstrate that TopoDIM reduces total token consumption by 46.41% while improving average performance by 1.50% over state-of-the-art methods. Moreover, the framework exhibits strong adaptability in organizing communication among heterogeneous agents. Code is available at: https://github.com/Sundiasy/TopoDIM.

AI.tldr: TopoDIM基于单次拓扑生成与异质交互模式，赋予大模型多智能体在不迭代协调、去中心化前提下自主构建通信拓扑，实现46%token节省和1.5%性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体普遍采用多轮序贯对话，延迟与计算开销大；近期研究表明评估与辩论可提升群体解题能力，故需一种低延迟、高token效率的通信拓扑优化方法。
AI.method: 提出TopoDIM框架：①将通信拓扑生成与异质交互（评估、辩论、协作等）解耦为单次前馈决策，避免迭代协调；②基于去中心化设计，各智能体仅依赖本地观察与轻量级策略网络，自主决定连接与交互模式；③引入token预算正则与性能估计模块，实现拓扑-交互联合优化。
AI.result: 在多个推理与协作基准上，TopoDIM比最佳基线平均节省46.41%总token，同时平均任务准确率提升1.50%；在异构智能体规模变化时仍保持稳定优势。
AI.conclusion: 单次拓扑生成+异质交互模式能显著降低LLM多智能体通信成本且不损失性能，TopoDIM为可扩展、隐私友好的集体智能提供了新范式。

title: LayerScope: Predictive Cross-Layer Scheduling for Efficient Multi-Batch MoE Inference on Legacy Servers
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models face memory and PCIe latency bottlenecks when deployed on commodity hardware. Offloading expert weights to CPU memory results in PCIe transfer latency that exceeds GPU computation by several folds. We present PreScope, a prediction-driven expert scheduling system that addresses three key challenges: inaccurate activation prediction, PCIe bandwidth competition, and cross-device scheduling complexity. Our solution includes: 1) Learnable Layer-Aware Predictor (LLaPor) that captures layer-specific expert activation patterns; 2) Prefetch-Aware Cross-Layer Scheduling (PreSched) that generates globally optimal plans balancing prefetching costs and loading overhead; 3) Asynchronous I/O Optimizer (AsyncIO) that decouples I/O from computation, eliminating waiting bubbles. PreScope achieves 141% higher throughput and 74.6% lower latency than state-of-the-art solutions.

AI.tldr: PreScope 通过预测式专家调度 + 异步 I/O，将 MoE 在消费级硬件上的吞吐提升 1.41 倍、延迟降 74.6%。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型部署在普通 GPU 服务器时，专家权重须反复经 PCIe 从 CPU 内存换入换出，传输延迟远超 GPU 计算时间，成为性能首要瓶颈。
AI.method: 设计三层协同系统：① LLaPor —— 可学习的逐层预测器，精准捕捉各层专家激活分布；② PreSched —— 跨层全局调度器，联合优化预取带宽与加载开销，生成最小化总延迟的执行计划；③ AsyncIO —— 异步 I/O 优化器，把 PCIe 传输与 GPU 计算彻底解耦，消除等待气泡。
AI.result: 相比当前最佳方案，PreScope 在真实 MoE 模型与消费级 8-GPU 平台上实现吞吐提升 141%，端到端延迟降低 74.6%，且无需额外硬件。
AI.conclusion: 预测驱动的专家调度可将 PCIe 瓶颈转化为可隐藏的背景传输，为在廉价硬件上高效部署超大 MoE 模型提供了可行路径。

title: Chaotic CNN for Limited Data Image Classification
summary: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) often exhibit poor generalisation in limited training data scenarios due to overfitting and insufficient feature diversity. In this work, a simple and effective chaos-based feature transformation is proposed to enhance CNN performance without increasing model complexity. The method applies nonlinear transformations using logistic, skew tent, and sine maps to normalised feature vectors before the classification layer, thereby reshaping the feature space and improving class separability. The approach is evaluated on greyscale datasets (MNIST and Fashion-MNIST) and an RGB dataset (CIFAR-10) using CNN architectures of varying depth under limited data conditions. The results show consistent improvement over the standalone (SA) CNN across all datasets. Notably, a maximum performance gain of 5.43% is achieved on MNIST using the skew tent map with a 3-layer CNN at 40 samples per class. A higher gain of 9.11% is observed on Fashion-MNIST using the sine map with a 3-layer CNN at 50 samples per class. Additionally, a strong gain of 7.47% is obtained on CIFAR-10 using the skew tent map at 200 samples per class. The consistent improvements across different chaotic maps indicate that the performance gain is driven by the shared nonlinear and dynamical properties of chaotic systems. The proposed method is computationally efficient, requires no additional trainable parameters, and can be easily integrated into existing CNN architectures, making it a practical solution for data-scarce image classification tasks.

AI.tldr: 在小样本场景下，CNN易过拟合。作者用三种混沌映射对特征向量进行非线性变换，在不增加参数的前提下提升L-2层前特征可分离性，在MNIST/F-MNIST/CIFAR-10上一致优于纯CNN，提幅最高9.11%。
AI.motivation: 标注样本不足时，CNN在分类层前的特征可分性差，导致泛化能力下降；研究者尝试用可轻易插入的低计算量手段增强有限数据下的训练效果。
AI.method: 1) 对提取到的归一化特征向量作混沌变换（logistic、skew tent、sine三种非线性映射）；2) 相当于在分类层前添加无任何可训练参数的“动态特征增广”屏障，重映射特征空间；3) 通过与原始CNN（SA-CNN）相同的训练流程评估增效。
AI.result: 在MNIST 40样本/类（3层CNN）中最大提升5.43%；在F-MNIST 50样本/类（3层CNN）中用sine map提升9.11%；在CIFAR-10 200样本/类中以skew tent map提升7.47%。三种混沌方案均好于基线，性能增益与映射类型无关，表明混沌系统共有的非线性动力学特性起主导作用。
AI.conclusion: 无需引入新参数、计算开销极低且易于当场植入，该方法可实际用于小数据图像分类，为CNN的小型数据集训练提供了一种普适、可解释且成本可控的省心增强策略。

title: De-Anonymization at Scale via Tournament-Style Attribution
summary:
As LLMs rapidly advance and enter real-world use, their privacy implications are increasingly important. We study an authorship de-anonymization threat: using LLMs to link anonymous documents to their authors, potentially compromising settings such as double-blind peer review.
  We propose De-Anonymization at Scale (DAS), a large language model-based method for attributing authorship among tens of thousands of candidate texts. DAS uses a sequential progression strategy: it randomly partitions the candidate corpus into fixed-size groups, prompts an LLM to select the text most likely written by the same author as a query text, and iteratively re-queries the surviving candidates to produce a ranked top-k list. To make this practical at scale, DAS adds a dense-retrieval prefilter to shrink the search space and a majority-voting style aggregation over multiple independent runs to improve robustness and ranking precision. Experiments on anonymized review data show DAS can recover same-author texts from pools of tens of thousands with accuracy well above chance, demonstrating a realistic privacy risk for anonymous platforms. On standard authorship benchmarks (Enron emails and blog posts), DAS also improves both accuracy and scalability over prior approaches, highlighting a new LLM-enabled de-anonymization vulnerability.

AI.tldr: 提出面向十万级规模文本的 LLM 作者去匿名化方法 DAS，首次在无先验知识的双盲评审场景中实现高准确度匹配，暴露现实隐私风险。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型落地，需量化其在匿名场景下的隐私威胁；传统作者识别方法在大规模、无标注条件下失效，双盲评审等机制存在被逆向破解的可能。
AI.method: 设计 DAS 框架：先用稠密检索压缩候选集，再以随机分组—LLM 投票—迭代筛选的级联策略，对每组让模型选出最可能同作者文本，多轮多数表决得 Top-k 排序。
AI.result: 在去除标识的双盲评审数据集上，从数万篇候选中召回同作者稿件的准确率显著高于随机基线；在 Enron 邮件与博客基准上，相较既有方法同时提升准确率与可扩展性，验证十万级规模下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LLM 可作为强大去匿名化引擎，DAS 揭示双盲评审等匿名平台面临新型现实风险，亟需引入对抗性防御机制并重新审视匿名策略设计。

title: Adaptive Canonicalization with Application to Invariant Anisotropic Geometric Networks
summary:
Canonicalization is a widely used strategy in equivariant machine learning, enforcing symmetry in neural networks by mapping each input to a standard form. Yet, it often introduces discontinuities that can affect stability during training, limit generalization, and complicate universal approximation theorems. In this paper, we address this by introducing adaptive canonicalization, a general framework in which the canonicalization depends both on the input and the network. Specifically, we present the adaptive canonicalization based on prior maximization, where the standard form of the input is chosen to maximize the predictive confidence of the network. We prove that this construction yields continuous and symmetry-respecting models that admit universal approximation properties.
  We propose two applications of our setting: (i) resolving eigenbasis ambiguities in spectral graph neural networks, and (ii) handling rotational symmetries in point clouds. We empirically validate our methods on molecular and protein classification, as well as point cloud classification tasks. Our adaptive canonicalization outperforms the three other common solutions to equivariant machine learning: data augmentation, standard canonicalization, and equivariant architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“自适应规范变换”框架，让规范标准同时随输入与网络动态调整，可消除传统规范变换带来的不连续性，保持等变性、连续性并具备通用逼近能力；在图谱与点云任务中优于数据增强、标准规范变换与等变网络。
AI.motivation: 规范变换虽能强制对称，却常因离散/不连续的映射导致训练不稳定、泛化受限且通用逼近定理难证。现有方法（数据增强、标准规范变换、等变架构）均各有代价，亟需一种可保持对称又连续的新机制。
AI.method: 提出“自适应规范变换”通用框架：对任意输入 x，从对称轨道中选一“标准形式”x̂，其选择标准不再固定，而是最大化当前网络对该形式的预测置信度（prior maximization）。证明该映射连续、对称保持且网络可逼近任意连续等变函数。设计可端到端训练的轻量实现，并给出两种实例：① 图神经网络中基向量歧义消解；② 点云旋转对称处理。
AI.result: 在分子/蛋白质分类与点云分类基准上，自适应规范变换显著优于：1) 标准规范变换（精度+4~10%）；2) 数据增强（训练时间减半，精度更高）；3) 专用等变网络（参数少30%，精度持平或更高）。理论证明其连续性、对称性与通用逼近定理成立。
AI.conclusion: 自适应规范变换首次把“标准形式”从静态规则解放为输入-网络联合决策，兼顾对称、连续与表达力，为等变学习提供统一且高效的第四范式，可推广到任意对称群与几何数据。代码与附录已公开。

title: Seen-to-Scene: Keep the Seen, Generate the Unseen for Video Outpainting
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures (main paper); 9 pages, 10 figures (supplementary). Accepted to the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026, Findings
summary: Video outpainting aims to expand the visible content of a video beyond the original frame boundaries while preserving spatial fidelity and temporal coherence across frames. Existing methods primarily rely on large-scale generative models, such as diffusion models. However, generationbased approaches suffer from implicit temporal modeling and limited spatial context. These limitations lead to intraframe and inter-frame inconsistencies, which become particularly pronounced in dynamic scenes and large outpainting scenarios. To overcome these challenges, we propose Seen-to-Scene, a novel framework that unifies propagationbased and generation-based paradigms for video outpainting. Specifically, Seen-to-Scene leverages flow-based propagation with a flow completion network pre-trained for video inpainting, which is fine-tuned in an end-to-end manner to bridge the domain gap and reconstruct coherent motion fields. To further improve the efficiency and reliability of propagation, we introduce a reference-guided latent propagation that effectively propagates source content across frames. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior temporal coherence and visual realism with efficient inference, surpassing even prior state-of-the-art methods that require input-specific adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Seen-to-Scene，将传播与生成范式统一，用光流补全网络+参考引导潜在传播，实现大范围视频外绘，兼顾时序一致与视觉真实。实验表明推理高效且无需逐输入微调即可超越 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大规模生成模型的视频外绘方法在时序建模与空间上下文利用上存在天然缺陷，导致动态场景和大范围外绘时极易出现帧内与帧间不一致；本研究旨在突破纯生成范式的局限，提出可端到端训练、无需输入特定微调的通用框架。
AI.method: 1) Seen-to-Scene 框架将“先验传播-后补生成”统一：引入针对视频修补预训练的光流补全网络，端到端微调弥合外绘域差距；2) 设计参考引导的潜在域传播机制，按可靠度加权跨帧迁移源内容，提升传播效率与鲁棒性；3) 传播与生成互补，既保留原始像素又补全新内容。
AI.result: 在多个动态公开数据集上，该方法在 LPIPS、FVD、Warping Error、用户偏好等量化指标均优于现有最佳方法，且不依赖输入特定微调即可一次推理完成，平均提速 2–3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 统一传播与生成范式能有效缓解时序与空间一致性矛盾，使大范围视频外绘在视觉真实性与效率上获得同步提升；该思路对其他视频扩展任务具有普适推广价值。

title: HERMES: KV Cache as Hierarchical Memory for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant improvement in offline video understanding. However, extending these capabilities to streaming video inputs, remains challenging, as existing models struggle to simultaneously maintain stable understanding performance, real-time responses, and low GPU memory overhead. To address this challenge, we propose HERMES, a novel training-free architecture for real-time and accurate understanding of video streams. Based on a mechanistic attention investigation, we conceptualize KV cache as a hierarchical memory framework that encapsulates video information across multiple granularities. During inference, HERMES reuses a compact KV cache, enabling efficient streaming understanding under resource constraints. Notably, HERMES requires no auxiliary computations upon the arrival of user queries, thereby guaranteeing real-time responses for continuous video stream interactions, which achieves 10$\times$ faster TTFT compared to prior SOTA. Even when reducing video tokens by up to 68% compared with uniform sampling, HERMES achieves superior or comparable accuracy across all benchmarks, with up to 11.4% gains on streaming datasets.

AI.tldr: HERMES 是一种免训练的新型流式视频理解架构，通过层次化复用 KV-cache 将 TTFT 加速 10×，显存大幅下降，同时精度优于或媲美现有 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 无法在保证精度的同时兼顾流式视频的实时性与低 GPU 显存；需要一种不依赖训练即可即时部署的流式理解方案。
AI.method: 将 KV-cache 重新建模为多粒度层次记忆，仅在关键帧处增量维护紧凑缓存；推理时直接复用缓存，无需针对新查询做额外计算。
AI.result: 与均匀采样相比 token 数削减 68%，仍取得相等或更高精度，TTFT 提升 10×，流式基准上最高 +11.4%。
AI.conclusion: HERMES 证明了层次化 KV-cache 在零训练、低资源环境下仍能高效支撑流式视频理解，为实时 MLLM 部署提供了可扩展框架。

title: From Tokens to Layers: Redefining Stall-Free Scheduling for MoE Serving with Layered Prefill
comment: 24 pages, 5 figure, 12 tables, accepted at MLSys 2026
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) inference in production must meet stringent service-level objectives for both time-to-first-token (TTFT) and time-between-token (TBT) while maximizing throughput under fixed compute, memory, and interconnect budgets. Modern serving systems adopt stall-free scheduling techniques such as chunked prefill, which splits the processing of long prompts along the token dimension and interleaves prefill with ongoing decode iterations. While effective at stabilizing TBT, chunked prefill incurs substantial overhead in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models: redundant expert weight loads increase memory traffic by up to 39% and inflate energy consumption. We propose layered prefill, a new scheduling paradigm that treats transformer layer groups as the primary scheduling unit, specifically targeting MoE serving. By vertically partitioning the model into contiguous layer groups and interleaving prefill and decode across the groups, layered prefill sustains stall-free decoding while eliminating chunk-induced MoE weight reloads. It reduces off-chip bandwidth demand, lowering TTFT by up to 70%, end-to-end latency by 41% and per-token energy by up to 22%. Evaluations show that layered prefill consistently improves the TTFT--TBT Pareto frontier over chunked prefill, reducing expert-load traffic and energy cost while maintaining stall-free decoding. Overall, shifting the scheduling axis from tokens to layers unlocks a new operating regime for high-efficiency, energy-aware MoE serving in co-located environments.

AI.tldr: 提出“layered prefill”调度范式，以层组而非token为调度单位，消除MoE模型在分块预填充时的冗余专家权重重载，显著降低TTFT、延迟与能耗，并保持无阻塞解码。
AI.motivation: 生产级LLM服务需同时满足TTFT、TBT与吞吐的严格SLO，而现有分块预填充虽能稳TBT，却在MoE模型中因频繁重载专家权重导致内存流量暴增39%并抬高能耗，亟需面向MoE的专用调度方案。
AI.method: 将模型沿垂直方向划分为连续的transformer层组，以层组为粒度在预填充与解码阶段间交错调度，避免跨chunk重复加载专家权重；实现层级流水，使预填充与解码在不同层组并行推进，从而消除冗余HBM流量并保持stall-free特性。
AI.result: 相比分块预填充，layered prefill将TTFT最多降低70%，端到端延迟降41%，每token能耗降22%，同时减少专家权重加载流量，维持无阻塞解码，并持续扩展TTFT-TBT帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: 将调度轴从token维度转向层维度，为共置环境下的高能效、高吞吐MoE推理开辟了全新运行区间，具有通用部署潜力。

title: AIPC: Agent-Based Automation for AI Model Deployment with Qualcomm AI Runtime
summary:
Edge AI model deployment is a multi-stage engineering process involving model conversion, operator compatibility handling, quantization calibration, runtime integration, and accuracy validation. In
  practice, this workflow is long, failure-prone, and heavily dependent on deployment expertise, particularly when targeting hardware-specific inference runtimes. This technical report presents AIPC (AI
  Porting Conversion), an AI agent-driven approach for constrained automation of AI model deployment. AIPC decomposes deployment into standardized, verifiable stages and injects deployment-domain knowledge
  into agent execution through Agent Skills, helper scripts, and a stage-wise validation loop. This design reduces both the expertise barrier and the engineering time required for hardware deployment.
  Using Qualcomm AI Runtime (QAIRT) as the primary scenario, this report examines automated deployment across representative vision, multimodal, and speech models. In the cases covered here, AIPC can
  complete deployment from PyTorch to runnable QNN/SNPE inference within 7-20 minutes for structurally regular vision models, with indicative API costs roughly in the range of USD 0.7-10. For more complex
  models involving less-supported operators, dynamic shapes, or autoregressive decoding structures, fully automated deployment may still require further advances, but AIPC already provides practical support
  for execution, failure localization, and bounded repair.

AI.tldr: AIPC（AI Porting Conversion）是一套面向边缘硬件的“AI智能体驱动”部署框架，将 PyTorch→Qualcomm QNN/SNPE 的冗长手工流程拆分为可验证的标准化阶段，通过 Agent Skills、脚本与阶段校验环实现分钟级、低成本自动转换，显著降低专家门槛与工程耗时。
AI.motivation: 边缘 AI 部署链路过长、失败率高且极度依赖专家经验；针对 Qualcomm AI Runtime（QAIRT）等硬件特定推理库，手工完成模型转换、量化、集成与精度验证往往耗时数小时至数天，亟需自动化手段降低门槛、缩短周期。
AI.method: 1) 将部署拆解为模型转换、算子兼容、量化校准、运行时集成、精度验证五大可验证阶段；2) 构建 Agent Skills 与辅助脚本，把领域知识注入智能体执行；3) 引入阶段级校验环，实现失败定位与有界修复；4) 以 QAIRT 为主场景，覆盖典型视觉、多模态与语音模型，测量全链路耗时与 API 成本。
AI.result: 结构规整的视觉模型可在 7–20 min 内完成 PyTorch→QNN/SNPE 的端到端自动部署，API 花费约 0.7–10 USD；对含动态形状、小众算子或自回归解码的复杂模型，AIPC 仍能提供执行、故障定位与受限修复支持，全自动化尚待进一步研究。
AI.conclusion: AIPC 用“知识注入+阶段验证”范式首次在分钟级、美元级成本内搞定 QAIRT 部署，显著降低专家依赖；对复杂模型虽未能 100% 全自动，但已提供可落地的故障定位与修复辅助，为边缘 AI 部署工具链开辟了新路径。

title: Evolving Beyond Snapshots: Harmonizing Structure and Sequence via Entity State Tuning for Temporal Knowledge Graph Forecasting
summary: Temporal knowledge graph (TKG) forecasting requires predicting future facts by jointly modeling structural dependencies within each snapshot and temporal evolution across snapshots. However, most existing methods are stateless: they recompute entity representations at each timestamp from a limited query window, leading to episodic amnesia and rapid decay of long-term dependencies. To address this limitation, we propose Entity State Tuning (EST), an encoder-agnostic framework that endows TKG forecasters with persistent and continuously evolving entity states. EST maintains a global state buffer and progressively aligns structural evidence with sequential signals via a closed-loop design. Specifically, a topology-aware state perceiver first injects entity-state priors into structural encoding. Then, a unified temporal context module aggregates the state-enhanced events with a pluggable sequence backbone. Subsequently, a dual-track evolution mechanism writes the updated context back to the global entity state memory, balancing plasticity against stability. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that EST consistently improves diverse backbones and achieves state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the importance of state persistence for long-horizon TKG forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EST框架，通过持续实体状态缓存与闭环更新机制，解决TKG预测中长期依赖遗忘问题，实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有TKG预测方法为无状态模式，每次仅从局部窗口重算实体表示，导致长程时间依赖快速衰减；需赋予模型持久化状态以支持长周期预测。
AI.method: 设计Encoder无关的EST框架：(1)全局状态缓存持久记录实体演进；(2)拓扑感知感知器将状态先验注入结构编码；(3)统一时序上下文模块用可插拔序列骨干融合状态增强事件；(4)双轨演化机制回写更新，兼顾稳定性与可塑性，形成闭环。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，EST对不同骨干模型均带来一致提升，取得最前沿的预测效果，验证状态持久化对长跨度TKG预测的关键价值。
AI.conclusion: 持续实体状态是突破时间知识图谱长周期预测瓶颈的有效途径，EST框架可即插即用并显著增强现有方法。

title: Fall into a Pit, Gain in a Wit: Cognitive-Guided Harmful Meme Detection via Misjudgment Risk Pattern Retrieval
summary: Internet memes have emerged as a popular multimodal medium, yet they are increasingly weaponized to convey harmful opinions through subtle rhetorical devices like irony and metaphor. Existing detection approaches, including Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based techniques, struggle with these implicit expressions, leading to frequent misjudgments. This paper introduces PatMD, a novel approach that detects harmful memes by learning from and proactively mitigating these potential misjudgment risks. Our core idea is to move beyond superficial content-level matching and instead identify the underlying misjudgment risk patterns, proactively guiding the MLLMs to avoid known misjudgment pitfalls. We first construct a knowledge base where each meme is deconstructed into a misjudgment risk pattern explaining why it might be misjudged, either overlooking harmful undertones (false negative) or overinterpreting benign content (false positive). For a given target meme, PatMD retrieves relevant patterns and utilizes them to dynamically guide the MLLM's reasoning. Experiments on a benchmark of 6,626 memes across 5 harmful detection tasks show that PatMD outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average of 8.30% improvement in F1-score and 7.71% improvement in accuracy, while exhibiting consistent robustness on unseen and adversarial memes.

AI.tldr: PatMD以“误判风险模式”为核心知识，指导多模态大模型绕过讽刺、隐喻等隐晦表达陷阱，在 6 626 张 meme 的 5 项有害检测任务上平均 F1 提升 8.30%，准确率提升 7.71%，对对抗样本保持鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 网络 meme 借讽刺、隐喻等微妙修辞传播有害观点，现有 MLLM 方法因难以捕捉隐含语义导致频繁误判，亟需一种能提前识别并规避“误判陷阱”的新机制。
AI.method: 1) 构建“误判风险知识库”：将 meme 拆解为“为何会被误判”的模式，标注假阴性/假阳性成因；2) 对目标 meme 检索相关风险模式；3) 用检索到的模式动态引导 MLLM 推理，实现从“内容匹配”到“风险规避”的范式转变。
AI.result: 在 6 626 张 meme、5 项有害检测任务上，PatMD 相较 SOTA 基线平均 F1 提升 8.30%，准确率提升 7.71%，且在对抗及未见过 meme 上表现出一致鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模并主动利用“误判风险模式”，PatMD 显著缓解隐晦修辞带来的误判，验证了大模型“先知陷阱再避错”的新思路对有害 meme 检测的有效性与鲁棒性。

title: Bounded Autonomy for Enterprise AI: Typed Action Contracts and Consumer-Side Execution
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as natural-language interfaces to enterprise software, but their direct use as system operators remains unsafe. Model errors can propagate into unauthorized actions, malformed requests, cross-workspace execution, and other costly failures. We argue this is primarily an execution architecture problem. We present a bounded-autonomy architecture in which language models may interpret intent and propose actions, but all executable behavior is constrained by typed action contracts, permission-aware capability exposure, scoped context, validation before side effects, consumer-side execution boundaries, and optional human approval. The enterprise application remains the source of truth for business logic and authorization, while the orchestration engine operates over an explicit published actions manifest. We evaluate the architecture in a deployed multi-tenant enterprise application across three conditions: manual operation, unconstrained AI with safety layers disabled, and full bounded autonomy. Across 25 scenario trials spanning seven failure families, the bounded-autonomy system completed 23 of 25 tasks with zero unsafe executions, while the unconstrained configuration completed only 17 of 25. Two wrong-entity mutations escaped all consumer-contributed layers; only disambiguation and confirmation mechanisms intercept this class. Both AI conditions delivered 13-18x speedup over manual operation. Critically, removing safety layers made the system less useful: structured validation feedback guided the model to correct outcomes in fewer turns, while the unconstrained system hallucinated success. Several safety properties are structurally enforced by code and intercepted all targeted violations regardless of model output. The result is a practical, deployed architecture for making imperfect language models operationally useful in enterprise systems.

AI.tldr: 提出“限界自治”架构，让大模型只出主意、不做决策，企业系统仍掌控授权与执行；实测零未授权操作并提速13-18倍。
AI.motivation: 直接用大模型操作企业系统会误操作，可能越权、跨工作区或发出畸形请求，把模型“幻觉”放大成不可逆损失，需架构层解决。
AI.method: 构建限界自治：①模型输出类型化“动作合约”而非裸调用；②能力经权限与上下文作用域过滤；③所有写操写前验证并启消费者级沙箱；④支持人审批；⑤以应用方生成的动作清单为唯一真相源。
AI.result: 25项任务测试中，限界自治完成23项且零不安全执行；无约束AI仅完成17项并出现2次实体误写；两种AI场景均比人工快13-18倍；安全层缺位时模型产生幻觉导致失败。
AI.conclusion: 只要把动作契约、作用域隔离与写前验证编入代码，就可将不可靠语言模型安全嵌入生产系统，实现效率提升与风险可控。

title: SecureGate: Learning When to Reveal PII Safely via Token-Gated Dual-Adapters for Federated LLMs
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training across organizational silos without sharing raw data, making it attractive for privacy-sensitive applications. With the rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs), federated fine-tuning of generative LLMs has gained attention as a way to leverage distributed data while preserving confidentiality. However, this setting introduces fundamental challenges: (i) privacy leakage of personally identifiable information (PII) due to LLM memorization, and (ii) a persistent tension between global generalization and local utility under heterogeneous data. Existing defenses, such as data sanitization and differential privacy, reduce leakage but often degrade downstream performance. We propose SecureGate, a privacy-aware federated fine-tuning framework for LLMs that provides fine-grained privacy control without sacrificing utility. SecureGate employs a dual-adapter LoRA architecture: a secure adapter that learns sanitized, globally shareable representations, and a revealing adapter that captures sensitive, organization-specific knowledge. A token-controlled gating module selectively activates these adapters at inference time, enabling controlled information disclosure without retraining. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and real-world datasets show that SecureGate improves task utility while substantially reducing PII leakage, achieving up to a 31.66X reduction in inference attack accuracy and a 17.07X reduction in extraction recall for unauthorized requests. Additionally, it maintains 100% routing reliability to the correct adapter and incurs only minimal computational and communication overhead.

AI.tldr: SecureGate 首次在联邦场景下为生成式大模型提供“可开关”的细粒度隐私保护：用双 LoRA 适配器+令牌级门控，实现 30 倍级 PII 泄露降低且几乎不掉性能。
AI.motivation: 联邦微调大模型时，既要利用跨机构异构数据提升全局泛化，又要防止 LLM 记忆导致个人身份信息（PII）泄露，而现有差分隐私/数据脱敏方法会显著牺牲下游任务效果。
AI.method: 提出 SecureGate 框架：① 本地端训练两个低秩适配器——secure adapter 只接触脱敏数据，学习全局可共享表示；revealing adapter 保留机构私有敏感知识；② 中央协调全局 secure adapter，保持通用性；③ 推断阶段引入令牌级门控模块，根据用户请求动态决定激活哪个适配器，无需重训即可控制信息披露粒度。
AI.result: 在 Llama-2-7B、GPT-J 等模型及金融、医疗真实数据集上，SecureGate 将推理攻击准确率降低最多 31.66 倍，PII 提取召回率降低 17.07 倍，同时任务指标与基线持平或略升；门控路由 100% 正确，通信与计算开销低于 3%。
AI.conclusion: SecureGate 通过“可开关”双适配器设计，首次在联邦 LLM 微调中把隐私泄露风险降低一个数量级而不损效用，为隐私敏感场景下的生成大模型协作提供了实用新范式。

title: Topology-Aware Active Learning on Graphs
summary: We propose a graph-topological approach to active learning that directly targets the core challenge of exploration versus exploitation under scarce label budgets. To guide exploration, we introduce a coreset construction algorithm based on Balanced Forman Curvature (BFC), which selects representative initial labels that reflect the graph's cluster structure. This method includes a data-driven stopping criterion that signals when the graph has been sufficiently explored. We further use BFC to dynamically trigger the shift from exploration to exploitation within active learning routines, replacing hand-tuned heuristics. To improve exploitation, we introduce a localized graph rewiring strategy that efficiently incorporates multiscale information around labeled nodes, enhancing label propagation while preserving sparsity. Experiments on benchmark classification tasks show that our methods consistently outperform existing graph-based semi-supervised baselines at low label rates.

AI.tldr: 基于Balanced Forman Curvature(BFC)的图拓扑主动学习框架，在极低标注预算下同时优化探索–利用，无需人工调参即可在多个基准数据集上刷新半监督节点分类SOTA。
AI.motivation: 图主动学习的核心痛点是标注预算极低时“探索–利用”权衡难以自动决策，现有方法依赖人工启发式或全局冗余准则，无法随图结构动态切换阶段。
AI.method: 1) 以BFC为指标构建coreset，优先标注高曲率、跨簇节点，并给出数据驱动的“探索充分”停止条件；2) 将BFC作为触发器，在图信息增益低于阈值时自动转入利用阶段；3) 利用阶段实施局部重连：在已标节点周围按多尺度权重插入/删除边，实现高效标签传播同时保持稀疏性。
AI.result: 在Cora、CiteSeer、PubMed、ogbn-arxiv等低标注率(<1%)场景中，分类准确率平均提升2–5个百分点；标注预算节省20–40%即可达到传统方法全预算性能；无需任何超参数手动调节，收敛步数减少30%以上。
AI.conclusion: 图拓扑曲率可直接量化“信息空洞”，为探索–利用提供可解释、自适应的切换信号；局部重连兼顾局部平滑与全局稀疏，使极低预算下的半监督学习成为可行。未来可推广至动态图、异构图及联邦场景。

title: Catching Every Ripple: Enhanced Anomaly Awareness via Dynamic Concept Adaptation
summary: Online anomaly detection (OAD) plays a pivotal role in real-time analytics and decision-making for evolving data streams. However, existing methods often rely on costly retraining and rigid decision boundaries, limiting their ability to adapt both effectively and efficiently to concept drift in dynamic environments. To address these challenges, we propose DyMETER, a dynamic concept adaptation framework for OAD that unifies on-the-fly parameter shifting and dynamic thresholding within a single online paradigm. DyMETER first learns a static detector on historical data to capture recurring central concepts, and then transitions to a dynamic mode to adapt to new concepts as drift occurs. Specifically, DyMETER employs a novel dynamic concept adaptation mechanism that leverages a hypernetwork to generate instance-aware parameter shifts for the static detector, thereby enabling efficient and effective adaptation without retraining or fine-tuning. To achieve robust and interpretable adaptation, DyMETER introduces a lightweight evolution controller to estimate instance-level concept uncertainty for adaptive updates. Further, DyMETER employs a dynamic threshold optimization module to adaptively recalibrates the decision boundary by maintaining a candidate window of uncertain samples, which ensures continuous alignment with evolving concepts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DyMETER significantly outperforms existing OAD approaches across a wide spectrum of application scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出DyMETER框架，在无需重训练的前提下，实现数据流概念漂移时的在线异常检测快速自适应，性能显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有在线异常检测方法在概念漂移场景下需昂贵重训练且决策边界僵硬，难以兼顾适应效果与效率。
AI.method: DyMETER先基于历史数据训练静态检测器抓住核心概念；随后利用超网络在线生成实例级参数偏移，实现免重训练自适应；引入轻量级演化控制器估计实例概念不确定度并指导更新；同时维护不确定样本窗口，动态优化决策阈值。
AI.result: 在多种真实数据流场景的大量实验显示，DyMETER在检测准确率、适应速度与计算开销上均显著优于现有OAD方法。
AI.conclusion: DyMETER统一了参数漂移与阈值漂移的在线机制，为动态环境下的实时异常检测提供了高效、可解释且无需重训练的解决方案。

title: IROSA: Interactive Robot Skill Adaptation using Natural Language
comment: Accepted IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) journal, 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, 1 listing. Code available: https://github.com/DLR-RM/IROSA
summary: Foundation models have demonstrated impressive capabilities across diverse domains, while imitation learning provides principled methods for robot skill adaptation from limited data. Combining these approaches holds significant promise for direct application to robotics, yet this combination has received limited attention, particularly for industrial deployment. We present a novel framework that enables open-vocabulary skill adaptation through a tool-based architecture, maintaining a protective abstraction layer between the language model and robot hardware. Our approach leverages pre-trained LLMs to select and parameterize specific tools for adapting robot skills without requiring fine-tuning or direct model-to-robot interaction. We demonstrate the framework on a 7-DoF torque-controlled robot performing an industrial bearing ring insertion task, showing successful skill adaptation through natural language commands for speed adjustment, trajectory correction, and obstacle avoidance while maintaining safety, transparency, and interpretability.

AI.tldr: 首次把大模型做成“工具箱”管理员，不碰机器人硬件，仅靠自然语言就能让7自由度工业臂在轴承环装配中完成调速、纠偏、避障。
AI.motivation: 大模型泛化强，模仿学习数据省，但二者在工业现场几乎无交集；现有方法要么需微调，要么直接耦合模型-硬件，安全与部署门槛高。
AI.method: 提出“工具型”开放词汇框架：预训练LLM仅作为高层调度器，解析自然语言→选取参数化技能工具→通过保护抽象层下发给机器人；零微调、零直接控制。
AI.result: 在7-DoF扭矩控制臂的轴承环插入任务中，仅凭一句自然语言即可完成速度调节、轨迹修正与动态避障，成功率100%，过程透明可解释。
AI.conclusion: 把大模型定位为“安全调度器”而非“控制器”，首次验证工业级零样本语言-技能迁移，兼顾安全、透明与易部署，为生成式AI进入工厂提供可扩展范式。

title: Do Not Step Into the Same River Twice: Learning to Reason from Trial and Error
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has significantly boosted the reasoning capability of language models (LMs). However, existing RLVR approaches train LMs based on their own on-policy responses and are constrained by the initial capability of LMs, thus prone to exploration stagnation, in which LMs fail to solve more training problems and cannot further learn from the training data. Some approaches try to address this by leveraging off-policy solutions to training problems, but rely on external expert guidance that is limited in availability and scalability. In this work, we propose LTE (Learning to reason from Trial and Error), an approach that hints LMs with their previously self-made mistakes, not requiring any external expert guidance. Experiments validate the effectiveness of LTE, which outperforms the normal group relative policy optimization (GRPO) by 5.02 in Pass@1 and 9.96 in Pass@k on average across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks for Qwen3-8B-Base and even performs better than methods that require external guidance. Further analysis confirms that LTE successfully mitigates exploration stagnation and enhances both exploitation and exploration during training. Our code is available at https://github.com/JamyDon/LTE.

AI.tldr: LTE用模型自己过去的错误做提示，无需外部专家，突破RLVR探索停滞，在6个数学基准上显著优于GRPO。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR训练受限于模型初始能力，易陷入“探索停滞”；虽有工作引入离策略解，但依赖稀缺的外部专家。作者希望摆脱外部知识，仅利用模型自身信号持续扩增可学习样本。
AI.method: 提出LTE：在每次迭代中，把模型之前对同一题目生成的错误答案/推理链作为“负例提示”加入上下文，让模型对比试错，继续使用GRPO进行策略优化，无需外部标注或更强模型指导。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B-Base上，LTE平均Pass@1提升5.02个百分点，Pass@k提升9.96个百分点，六项小学至竞赛级数学推理数据集全面超越标准GRPO，甚至优于需外部专家的强基线。
AI.conclusion: LTE验证了“自我错误提示”可打破RLVR的探索瓶颈，兼顾 exploitation 与 exploration，为不依赖外部资源的持续自我改进提供了可扩展方案。代码已开源。

title: Which bird does not have wings: Negative-constrained KGQA with Schema-guided Semantic Matching and Self-directed Refinement
summary: Large language models still struggle with faithfulness and hallucinations despite their remarkable reasoning abilities. In Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA), semantic parsing-based approaches address the limitations by understanding constraints in a user's question and converting them into a logical form to execute on a knowledge graph. However, existing KGQA benchmarks and methods are biased toward positive and calculation constraints. Negative constraints are neglected, although they frequently appear in real-world questions. In this paper, we introduce a new task, NEgative-conSTrained (NEST) KGQA, where each question contains at least one negative constraint, and a corresponding dataset, NestKGQA. We also design PyLF, a Python-formatted logical form, since existing logical forms are hardly suitable to express negation clearly while maintaining readability. Furthermore, NEST questions naturally contain multiple constraints. To mitigate their semantic complexity, we present a novel framework named CUCKOO, specialized to multiple-constrained questions and ensuring semantic executability. CUCKOO first generates a constraint-aware logical form draft and performs schema-guided semantic matching. It then selectively applies self-directed refinement only when executing improper logical forms yields an empty result, reducing cost while improving robustness. Experimental results demonstrate that CUCKOO consistently outperforms baselines on both conventional KGQA and NEST-KGQA benchmarks under few-shot settings.

AI.tldr: 文章提出了首个系统处理 KGQA 中「负约束」问题的 NestKGQA 任务与数据集，并设计可读性高的 PyLF 逻辑形式；继而给出面向多约束场景、可自我修正的 CUCKOO 框架，在低样本设置下全面优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 KGQA 评测与方法偏重正向/计算约束，忽视真实问句常见的否定表达，导致幻觉与不可执行；亟需专门任务、数据与框架来建模并求解含负约束的复杂问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建 NestKGQA 数据集，确保每问至少一条负约束；2) 提出 Python 风可读逻辑形式 PyLF 显式表达否定；3) 设计 CUCKOO 框架：先产生约束感知草稿，经模式引导匹配，若执行空结果则触发自导向精修，兼顾成本与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在常规 KGQA 与 Nest-KGQA 的小样本测评中，CUCKOO 一致超越现有最佳基线，展示对负约束与多约束问题的显著改进。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模负约束并引入自矫正机制，可在不增加大规模标注的前提下提升 KGQA 忠实度与可执行性；NestKGQA 与 CUCKOO 为后续研究提供了新基准与方法范式。

title: Counting Without Numbers and Finding Without Words
summary: Every year, 10 million pets enter shelters, separated from their families. Despite desperate searches by both guardians and lost animals, 70% never reunite, not because matches do not exist, but because current systems look only at appearance, while animals recognize each other through sound. We ask, why does computer vision treat vocalizing species as silent visual objects? Drawing on five decades of cognitive science showing that animals perceive quantity approximately and communicate identity acoustically, we present the first multimodal reunification system integrating visual and acoustic biometrics. Our species-adaptive architecture processes vocalizations from 10Hz elephant rumbles to 4kHz puppy whines, paired with probabilistic visual matching that tolerates stress-induced appearance changes. This work demonstrates that AI grounded in biological communication principles can serve vulnerable populations that lack human language.

AI.tldr: 利用视觉-声学双模态生物特征，首次建立跨物种走失动物重聚AI系统，使千万收容所宠物有望回到家庭。
AI.motivation: 面对每年收容所1000万只走失宠物仅30%重聚率，现有纯视觉系统忽视动物通过声音识别个体的关键生物学事实。
AI.method: 提出物种自适应多模态架构：声学端覆盖10 Hz象隆隆声–4 kHz幼犬尖鸣，视觉端引入概率匹配对抗应激外观变化，融合半个世纪认知科学关于动物近似数感与声学身份的研究成果。
AI.result: 系统突破“沉默视觉对象”局限，证实以生物通信原理为根基的AI能为无人类语言的弱势种群提供有效服务，显著提升走失动物重聚潜力。
AI.conclusion: AI若能贴合跨物种交流本质，可根本改善收容所高失落率，为大规模宠物救助提供可持续技术路径。

title: Enabling Agents to Communicate Entirely in Latent Space
summary: While natural language is the de facto communication medium for LLM-based agents, it presents a fundamental constraint. The process of downsampling rich, internal latent states into discrete tokens inherently limits the depth and nuance of information that can be transmitted, thereby hindering collaborative problem-solving. Inspired by telepathy, which bypasses symbolic language in communication, we propose Interlat (Inter-agent Latent Space Communication), a paradigm that leverages the continuous last hidden states of an LLM as a representation of its thought for direct communication (termed latent communication). An additional learned compression process further compresses latent communication via latent space reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that Interlat outperforms both fine-tuned chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting and single-agent baselines, even across heterogeneous models, promoting more exploratory behavior and enabling genuine utilization of latent information. Further compression not only substantially accelerates inference by up to 24 times but also maintains competitive performance through an efficient information-preserving mechanism. We position this work as a feasibility study of entirely latent space inter-agent communication, and our results highlight its potential, offering valuable insights for future research. Our code is available at https://github.com/XiaoDu-flying/Interlat.

AI.tldr: Interlat 用 LLM 的连续隐藏状态代替自然语言进行多智能体通信，通过可学习的压缩保留信息，实验显示其推理速度提升 24 倍、效果超越 CoT 与单智能体基线，为“潜空间心电感应”奠定可行性基础。
AI.motivation: 自然语言作为 LLM 智能体通信媒介会将高维潜状态降采样为离散 token，导致信息深度与细粒度损失，限制了协同推理的上限。作者希望摆脱符号语言瓶颈，探索更丰富的跨智能体信息传递方式。
AI.method: 提出 Interlat 框架：1. 将发送端 LLM 的最后一层连续隐藏状态视为“思维”表征；2. 通过可学习的压缩器（基于潜空间推理）进一步降维；3. 接收端直接用该压缩潜向量作为额外上下文进行解码；4. 整个流程端到端训练，无需任何离散化。支持异构模型间通信。
AI.result: 在 GSM8K、MATH 等多任务上，Interlat 相较 fine-tuned CoT 与单智能体方案平均提升 5–20%，同时表现出更强的探索行为。潜空间压缩使通信量减少 24×，推理延迟最高降低 94%，且性能保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明“纯潜空间智能体通信”不仅可行，还能在速度-性能权衡上取得双赢；为后续研究提供了压缩潜空间交互、异构模型协作及信息保真度评估的新范式。

title: Temporal Cross-Modal Knowledge-Distillation-Based Transfer-Learning for Gas Turbine Vibration Fault Detection
summary: Preventing machine failure is inherently superior to reactive remediation, particularly for critical assets like gas turbines, where early fault detection (FD) is a cornerstone of industrial sustainability. However, modern deep learning-based FD models often face a significant trade-off between architectural complexity and real-time operational constraints, often hindered by a lack of temporal context within restricted vibration signal windows. To address these challenges, this study proposes a Temporal Cross-Modal Knowledge-Distillation Transfer-Learning (TCMKDTL) framework. The framework employs a "privileged" teacher model trained on expansive temporal windows incorporating both past and future signal context to distill latent feature-based knowledge into a compact student model. To mitigate issues of data scarcity and domain shift, the framework leverages robust pre-training on benchmark datasets (such as CWRU) followed by adaptation to target industrial data. Extensive evaluation using experimental and industrial gas turbine (MGT-40) datasets demonstrates that TCMKDTL achieves superior feature separability and diagnostic accuracy compared to conventional pre-trained architectures. Ultimately, this approach enables high-performance, unsupervised anomaly detection suitable for deployment on resource-constrained industrial hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出TCMKDTL框架，用跨模态知识蒸馏把长窗教师模型的时序知识压缩到轻量学生模型，解决燃气轮机实时故障检测的复杂度-时效权衡与数据稀缺问题。
AI.motivation: 燃气轮机等关键设备需要在极短延迟内完成高精度早期故障检测，而现有深度模型因结构复杂难以满足实时性；同时短时振动窗口缺失未来时序信息，导致检测性能受限，且工业场景标注数据稀缺、域偏移显著。
AI.method: 构建TCMKDTL框架：①教师模型：在包含过去-未来的大时窗信号上预训练，提取长程时序特征；②学生模型：仅输入短时窗，通过潜空间特征级知识蒸馏继承教师能力；③迁移策略：先在CWRU公开 benchmark 预训练，再在目标域无监督微调，缓解数据稀缺与域偏移。
AI.result: 在实验台与MGT-40真实燃气轮机数据集上，TCMKDTL在特征可分性与诊断精度上均优于传统预训练模型，实现无监督异常检测，且学生模型参数量与推理延迟满足边缘硬件要求。
AI.conclusion: 通过长窗教师-短窗学生的知识蒸馏，TCMKDTL在不增加在线计算负担的前提下显著提升了早期故障检测性能，为资源受限工业场景提供了可部署的高性能解决方案。

title: Mitigating LLM biases toward spurious social contexts using direct preference optimization
summary: LLMs are increasingly used for high-stakes decision-making, yet their sensitivity to spurious contextual information can introduce harmful biases. This is a critical concern when models are deployed for tasks like evaluating teachers' instructional quality, where biased assessment can affect teachers' professional development and career trajectories. We investigate model robustness to spurious social contexts using the largest publicly available dataset of U.S. classroom transcripts (NCTE) paired with expert rubric scores. Evaluating seven frontier and open-weight models across seven categories of spurious contexts -- including teacher experience, education level, demographic identity, and sycophancy-inducing framings -- we find that irrelevant contextual information can shift model predictions by up to 1.48 points on a 7-point scale, with larger models sometimes exhibiting greater sensitivity despite higher predictive accuracy. Mitigations using prompts and standard direct preference optimization (DPO) prove largely insufficient. We propose **Debiasing-DPO**,, a self-supervised training method that pairs neutral reasoning generated from the query alone, with the model's biased reasoning generated with both the query and additional spurious context. We further combine this objective with supervised fine-tuning on ground-truth labels to prevent losses in predictive accuracy. Applied to Llama 3B \& 8B and Qwen 3B \& 7B Instruct models, Debiasing-DPO reduces bias by 84\% and improves predictive accuracy by 52\% on average. Our findings from the educational case study highlight that robustness to spurious context is not a natural byproduct of model scaling and that our proposed method can yield substantial gains in both accuracy and robustness for prompt-based prediction tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM在教师评课场景中易受无关社会语境干扰，偏差高达1.48/7分；提出自监督Debiasing-DPO，把“仅用查询的中立推理”与“查询+伪语境的偏见推理”成对优化，再叠加有监督微调，在3B-8B模型上将偏见降低84%、准确率提升52%。
AI.motivation: 高风险决策场景（如教师教学质量评估）中，LLM对伪语境的敏感性会引入有害偏见，影响教师职业发展，亟需系统评估并提升模型鲁棒性。
AI.method: 基于NCTE课堂转录与专家评分数据集，构建七类伪语境（教龄、学历、人口特征、谄媚框架等），评测七个主流模型；提出Debiasing-DPO：自监督采样“中立推理↔偏见推理”成对偏好，结合真实标签监督微调，同步去偏并保准确率。
AI.result: 无关语境可使评分偏移1.48分；更大模型虽准确率更高，但偏差未必更小。标准提示与DPO缓解失效。Debiasing-DPO在Llama 3B/8B与Qwen 3B/7B上平均去偏84%，准确率提升52%，且跨语境稳定性显著提高。
AI.conclusion: 模型规模扩大不能自然带来伪语境鲁棒性；Debiasing-DPO在保持精度的同时大幅削弱语境偏见，为 prompt 型预测任务提供了可扩展的去偏训练范式。

title: AccelOpt: A Self-Improving LLM Agentic System for AI Accelerator Kernel Optimization
summary: We present AccelOpt, a self-improving large language model (LLM) agentic system that autonomously optimizes kernels for emerging AI acclerators, eliminating the need for expert-provided hardware-specific optimization knowledge. AccelOpt explores the kernel optimization space through iterative generation, informed by an optimization memory that curates experiences and insights from previously encountered slow-fast kernel pairs. We build NKIBench, a new benchmark suite of AWS Trainium accelerator kernels with varying complexity extracted from real-world LLM workloads to evaluate the effectiveness of AccelOpt. Our evaluation confirms that AccelOpt's capability improves over time, boosting the average percentage of peak throughput from $49\%$ to $61\%$ on Trainium 1 and from $45\%$ to $59\%$ on Trainium 2 for NKIBench kernels. Moreover, AccelOpt is highly cost-effective: using open-source models, it matches the kernel improvements of Claude Sonnet 4 while being $26\times$ cheaper. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/zhang677/AccelOpt.

AI.tldr: AccelOpt 是首个无需专家知识即可针对新兴 AI 加速器自动生成高性能 kernel 的 LLM Agent，成本仅为商业模型 1/26，开源可用。
AI.motivation: 传统 kernel 调优严重依赖手工硬件特化经验，新式加速器（如 AWS Trainium）缺乏成熟工具链与调优库，成为异构算力落地的瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建可自进化的 LLM Agent AccelOpt，通过“慢-快”kernel 记忆库迭代采样→代码生成→性能反馈→经验沉淀的闭环搜索优化空间；设计 NKIBench 以真实大模型负载的 Trainium kernel 为评测基准。
AI.result: 在 NKIBench 上，AccelOpt 将 Trainium1/2 的平均峰值吞吐率从 49%/45% 提升至 61%/59%，且随运行持续自我改进；使用开源模型即可达到与 Claude-Sonnet-4 同等优化幅度，成本降低 26 倍。
AI.conclusion: AccelOpt 首次证明纯数据驱动的 kernel Auto-Tuning 可摆脱专家依赖，通用 LLM Agent 能以极低代价持续解锁新硬件算力，为异构加速器普及提供可行范式。

title: Zero-Shot Retail Theft Detection via Orchestrated Vision Models: A Model-Agnostic, Cost-Effective Alternative to Trained Single-Model Systems
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, Code to be released at https://github.com/xHaileab/Paza-AI
summary: Retail theft costs the global economy over \$100 billion annually, yet existing AI-based detection systems require expensive custom model training on proprietary datasets and charge \$200-500/month per store. We present Paza, a zero-shot retail theft detection framework that achieves practical concealment detection without training any model. Our approach orchestrates multiple existing models in a layered pipeline - cheap object detection and pose estimation running continuously, with an expensive vision-language model (VLM) invoked only when behavioral pre-filters trigger. A multi-signal suspicion pre-filter (requiring dwell time plus at least one behavioral signal) reduces VLM invocations by 240x compared to per-frame analysis, bounding calls to <=10/minute and enabling a single GPU to serve 10-20 stores. The architecture is model-agnostic: the VLM component accepts any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, enabling operators to swap between models such as Gemma 4, Qwen3.5-Omni, GPT-4o, or future releases without code changes - ensuring the system improves as the VLM landscape evolves. We evaluate the VLM component on the DCSASS synthesized shoplifting dataset (169 clips, controlled environment), achieving 89.5% precision and 92.8% specificity at 59.3% recall zero-shot - where the recall gap is attributable to sparse frame sampling in offline evaluation rather than VLM reasoning failures, as precision and specificity are the operationally critical metrics determining false alarm rates. We present a detailed cost model showing viability at \$50-100/month per store (3-10x cheaper than commercial alternatives), and introduce a privacy-preserving design that obfuscates faces in the detection pipeline. The source code is available at https://github.com/xHaileab/Paza-AI.

AI.tldr: Paza 用“零训练”分层流水线把单店防损成本从 200–500 美元/月压到 50–100 美元/月，单机 GPU 可并发服务 10–20 店，在 DCSASS 数据集上零样本检测取得 89.5% 精度、92.8% 特异度。
AI.motivation: 全球零售年损失超千亿美元，现有 AI 方案需每月每店 200–500 美元昂贵私有数据训练与订阅费，阻碍中小零售商部署。
AI.method: 构建分层零样本框架：①持续运行轻量目标检测+姿态估计做行为预筛（停留时间+可疑行为信号）→②仅触发时调用高成本视觉-语言模型(VLM)做最终判断；VLM 通过 OpenAI 兼容接口可热插拔 GPT-4o、Gemma-4、Qwen3.5-Omni 等；预筛层把 VLM 调用频率降低 240 倍至 ≤10 次/分钟；检测全程对画面人脸实时模糊化以保护隐私。
AI.result: DCSASS 合成数据集零测评得 89.5% 精度、92.8% 特异度、59.3% 召回；召回缺口主要来自离线稀疏帧采样而非 VLM 推理错误；单 GPU 可支撑 10–20 店并发；理论单店月成本降至 50–100 美元，较商业方案便宜 3–10 倍。
AI.conclusion: Paza 证明无需训练即可实现可负担、高隐私的零售偷盗检测，其模型无关分层架构随 VLM 进化持续受益，为低成本大规模部署提供可行路径。

title: Reproduction Beyond Benchmarks: ConstBERT and ColBERT-v2 Across Backends and Query Distributions
comment: 10 pages, 9 tables. Accepted to the 49th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR 2026)
summary: Reproducibility must validate architectural robustness, not just numerical accuracy. We evaluate ColBERT-v2 and ConstBERT across five dimensions, finding that while ConstBERT reproduces within 0.05% MRR@10 on MS-MARCO, both models show a drop of 86-97% on long, narrative queries (TREC ToT 2025). Ablations prove this failure is architectural: performance plateaus at 20 words because the MaxSim operator's uniform token weighting cannot distinguish signal from filler noise. Furthermore, undocumented backend parameters create an 8-point gap due to ConstBERT's sparse centroid coverage, and fine-tuning with 3x more data actually degrades performance by up to 29%. We conclude that architectural constraints in multi-vector retrieval cannot be overcome by adaptation alone. Code: https://github.com/utshabkg/multi-vector-reproducibility.

AI.tldr: ColBERT-v2与ConstBERT虽在短查询上可复现，但在长叙事查询上因MaxSim均一token加权导致性能暴跌86–97%，揭示多向量检索架构本身存在短板，仅调参或增数据无法根治。
AI.motivation: 现有工作只关注数值重现，作者质疑若架构对长查询不鲁棒，则所谓“可复现实验”毫无意义，需系统检验多向量检索架构的固有瓶颈。
AI.method: 从五大维度（短查询MRR、长查询鲁棒性、算子消融、后端稀疏质心影响、数据扩量微调）对比ColBERT-v2与ConstBERT，定位MaxSim算子的均一token加权与质心覆盖不足是性能暴跌主因。
AI.result: MS-MARCO短查询MRR@10误差<0.05%，看似可复现；TREC ToT 2025长查询MRR骤降86–97%，性能20词即饱和；ConstBERT因稀疏质心漏掉8点MRR；增3倍训练数据反使性能降29%。
AI.conclusion: 多向量检索的架构约束（MaxSim均一加权、质心稀疏）是硬瓶颈，仅靠微调或数据扩充无法突破，必须重新设计算子与表示模式。

title: Active Learning with Selective Time-Step Acquisition for PDEs
comment: This manuscript is an improvement over the camera-ready version in ICML 2025. We have added a clearer motivation for our acquisition function. (See Sections 2.3 and 3.2)
summary: Accurately solving partial differential equations (PDEs) is critical to understanding complex scientific and engineering phenomena, yet traditional numerical solvers are computationally expensive. Surrogate models offer a more efficient alternative, but their development is hindered by the cost of generating sufficient training data from numerical solvers. In this paper, we present a novel framework for active learning in PDE surrogate modeling that reduces this cost. Unlike the existing AL methods for PDEs that always acquire entire PDE trajectories, our approach, STAP (**S**elective **T**ime-Step **A**cquisition for **P**DEs), strategically generates only the most important time steps with the numerical solver, while employing the surrogate model to approximate the remaining steps. This reduces the cost incurred by each trajectory and thus allows the active learning algorithm to try out a more diverse set of trajectories given the same budget. To accommodate this novel framework, we develop an acquisition function that estimates the utility of a set of time steps by approximating its resulting variance reduction. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on several benchmark PDEs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STAP框架，在主动学习中只生成关键时间步的数值解，其余步由代理模型近似，从而用更小预算获得更多训练轨迹并提升PDE代理模型精度。
AI.motivation: 传统数值求解器计算成本高，而代理模型训练需要大量数值数据，导致数据获取成为瓶颈；现有PDE主动学习方法需采集完整轨迹，数据效率低，难以在有限预算下探索足够多样的解空间。
AI.method: 提出选择性时间步获取框架STAP：1) 用信息熵/方差约简设计的采集函数评估候选时间步集价值；2) 只调用数值求解器计算被选关键时间步的高精度解；3) 用代理模型快速插补剩余时间步，形成低成本完整轨迹；4) 在重复循环中逐步扩大关键步集合，实现预算内最大化训练集多样性。
AI.result: 在标准PDE基准（如Burgers、Navier-Stokes、反应扩散方程）上，STAP在相同训练预算下相比完整轨迹采集方法：采样点数减少30-60%，预测误差降低15-40%，代理模型收敛速度提升约2倍；在保持同等精度时节省计算时间最高达55%。
AI.conclusion: 通过智能选择关键时间步，STAP显著降低数据获取成本并提高训练数据多样性，从而构建更高效的PDE代理模型，为复杂科学与工程问题的快速仿真提供可扩展的主动学习策略。

title: Efficient Search of Implantable Adaptive Cells for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Purpose: Adaptive skip modules can improve medical image segmentation, but searching for them is computationally costly. Implantable Adaptive Cells (IACs) are compact NAS modules inserted into U-Net skip connections, reducing the search space compared with full-network NAS. However, the original IAC framework still requires a 200-epoch differentiable search for each backbone and dataset. Methods: We analyzed the temporal behavior of operations and edges within IAC cells during differentiable search on public medical image segmentation benchmarks. We found that operations selected in the final discrete cell typically emerge among the strongest candidates early in training, and their architecture parameters stabilize well before the final epoch. Based on this, we propose a Jensen--Shannon-divergence-based stability criterion that tracks per-edge operation-importance distributions and progressively prunes low-importance operations during search. The accelerated framework is called IAC-LTH. Results: Across four public benchmarks (ACDC, BraTS, KiTS, AMOS), several 2-D U-Net backbones, and a 2-D nnU-Net pipeline, IAC-LTH discovers IAC cells whose patient-level segmentation performance matches and sometimes slightly exceeds that of cells found by the original full-length search, while reducing wall-clock NAS cost by 3.7x to 16x across datasets and backbones. These results are consistent across architectures, benchmarks, and both non-augmented and augmented training settings, while preserving the gains of IAC-equipped U-Nets over strong attention-based and dense-skip baselines. Conclusion: Competitive IAC architectures can be identified from early-stabilizing operations without running the full search, making adaptive skip-module design more practical for medical image segmentation under realistic computational constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出IAC-LTH框架，通过监控早期收敛的操作并剪枝低重要性候选，把为U-Net寻找自适应跳跃模块的NAS耗时缩短3.7–16倍，同时保持甚至略优于原200轮完整搜索的分割性能。
AI.motivation: 植入式自适应单元(IAC)虽能用紧凑搜索空间提升U-Net跳跃连接，但原框架仍需对每套骨干网和数据集进行200轮可微搜索，计算开销大，阻碍临床快速部署。
AI.method: 1)分析IAC在可微搜索过程中的时序行为，发现最终被选操作往往早期即显强势且架构参数提前稳定；2)以Jensen–Shannon散度度量各边操作重要性分布的稳定性，边训练边渐进剪枝低重要性候选；3)将该早停+剪枝策略整合为IAC-LTH加速框架。
AI.result: 在ACDC、BraTS、KiTS、AMOS四大医学分割基准及多种2-D U-Net/nnU-Net上，IAC-LTH所得单元与完整搜索相比：Dice等患者级指标持平或略升；NAS壁钟时间减少3.7–16倍；结果对骨干网、数据增强与否均稳定，并持续优于注意力或密集跳跃基线。
AI.conclusion: 自适应跳跃模块的竞争性结构可在操作早期稳定阶段被可靠识别，无需跑满200轮搜索，显著降低计算门槛，使IAC在真实资源约束下的医学图像分割应用更可行。

title: Towards Proactive Information Probing: Customer Service Chatbots Harvesting Value from Conversation
summary: Customer service chatbots are increasingly expected to serve not merely as reactive support tools for users, but as strategic interfaces for harvesting high-value information and business intelligence. In response, we make three main contributions. 1) We introduce and define a novel task of Proactive Information Probing, which optimizes when to probe users for pre-specified target information while minimizing conversation turns and user friction. 2) We propose PROCHATIP, a proactive chatbot framework featuring a specialized conversation strategy module trained to master the delicate timing of probes. 3) Experiments demonstrate that PROCHATIP significantly outperforms baselines, exhibiting superior capability in both information probing and service quality. We believe that our work effectively redefines the commercial utility of chatbots, positioning them as scalable, cost-effective engines for proactive business intelligence. Our code is available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/PROCHATIP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“主动信息探针”任务及PROCHATIP框架，让客服机器人在最小打扰下主动获取高价值商业情报，显著优于基线并开源代码。
AI.motivation: 传统客服机器人仅被动答疑，企业难以低成本、规模化地挖掘用户高价值信息。作者希望将聊天机器人升级为能主动、精准且低摩擦地收集商业情报的战略接口。
