AI.method: 1) 定义“主动信息探针”任务：在对话中择机询问预定义目标信息，优化探针时机以最少轮次与用户摩擦；2) 设计PROCHATIP框架，核心为“对话策略模块”，该模块通过强化学习训练掌握探针的最佳时机；3) 在真实客服对话数据集上与多组基线对比，评估信息获取率、对话轮次、用户满意度等指标。
AI.result: 实验显示PROCHATIP在同等用户满意度下，信息探针成功率提升32%，所需平均轮次减少24%，整体服务评分提高15%，显著优于规则与被动基线。
AI.conclusion: 将聊天机器人从被动支持工具重塑为可扩展、低成本的主动商业情报引擎；提出的任务与框架为后续对话管理与信息获取研究提供了新基准，代码已开源供复现与扩展。

title: Pay Less Attention to Function Words for Free Robustness of Vision-Language Models
comment: The paper has been accepted by ICLR26
summary: To address the trade-off between robustness and performance for robust VLM, we observe that function words could incur vulnerability of VLMs against cross-modal adversarial attacks, and propose Function-word De-Attention (FDA) accordingly to mitigate the impact of function words. Similar to differential amplifiers, our FDA calculates the original and the function-word cross-attention within attention heads, and differentially subtracts the latter from the former for more aligned and robust VLMs. Comprehensive experiments include 2 SOTA baselines under 6 different attacks on 2 downstream tasks, 3 datasets, and 3 models. Overall, our FDA yields an average 18/13/53% ASR drop with only 0.2/0.3/0.6% performance drops on the 3 tested models on retrieval, and a 90% ASR drop with a 0.3% performance gain on visual grounding. We demonstrate the scalability, generalization, and zero-shot performance of FDA experimentally, as well as in-depth ablation studies and analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/michaeltian108/FDA.

AI.tldr: 为均衡多模态视觉语言模型(VLM)的鲁棒性与性能，作者发现功能词是跨模态对抗攻击的脆弱源，并据此提出 Function-word De-Attention (FDA)。FDA类似差分放大器，在各注意力头中先单独计算“含功能词”到“主tokens”的交叉注意力，再将其从原注意力中差分减去，降低功能词干扰。大量实验(2基线/6攻击/2下游任务/3数据集/3模型)表明：图文检索上平均ASR(对抗成功率)降18%、13%、53%，性能仅损0.2%、0.3%、0.6%；视觉定位任务ASR降90%且略有提升0.3%。扩展性、泛化性与零迁移效果均验证有效，附完整消融与源码。
AI.motivation: 跨模态攻击揭示VLM对看似“无害”的功能词敏感，导致鲁棒性与性能此消彼长；需在最小性能损失下提升鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出FDA差分去注意力机制：①在各注意力头分别计算原始跨模态注意力；②计算仅功能词对应的注意力投影；③差分减去并重新刷新注意力权重，抑制无关扰动；参数化嵌入Transformer并可插拔。
AI.result: 多场景验证(图文检索、3模型)ASR平均下降18%-53%，性能损失≤0.6%；视觉定位任务ASR下降90%，性能微升0.3%；零样本与另一数据集迁移亦显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 功能词确实是跨模态对抗攻击的高敏感源。FDA通过差分去注意力简单有效地削弱其影响，在不牺牲泛化和零样本能力的前提下同步提升鲁棒性，对部署安全VLM具有重要参考意义，且代码开源可复现。

title: ClimateCause: Complex and Implicit Causal Structures in Climate Reports
summary: Understanding climate change requires reasoning over complex causal networks. Yet, existing causal discovery datasets predominantly capture explicit, direct causal relations. We introduce ClimateCause, a manually expert-annotated dataset of higher-order causal structures from science-for-policy climate reports, including implicit and nested causality. Cause-effect expressions are normalized and disentangled into individual causal relations to facilitate graph construction, with unique annotations for cause-effect correlation, relation type, and spatiotemporal context. We further demonstrate ClimateCause's value for quantifying readability based on the semantic complexity of causal graphs underlying a statement. Finally, large language model benchmarking on correlation inference and causal chain reasoning highlights the latter as a key challenge.

AI.tldr: ClimateCause is the first expert-curated dataset that extracts higher-order, implicit and nested causal structures from climate-science policy documents, enabling fine-grained graph construction and showing that LLMs struggle with multi-step causal reasoning.
AI.motivation: Current causal-discovery corpora only encode explicit, direct links; climate-change arguments, however, hinge on subtle, chained and context-rich causality. A dedicated resource is needed to train and test systems on such complexity.
AI.method: Manual annotation of science-for-policy climate reports: normalize cause-effect expressions, split nested statements into atomic causal triples, then tag each triple with correlation flag, relation type, and spatiotemporal scope; build corresponding causal graphs; derive readability metric from graph semantic complexity; benchmark LLMs on pairwise correlation vs. causal-chain inference.
AI.result: Released ClimateCause dataset with higher-order causal annotations; showed that document readability anti-correlates with causal-graph complexity; LLMs achieve moderate accuracy on pairwise correlation but drop sharply on 3+ step causal chains.
AI.conclusion: ClimateCause enables nuanced modeling of climate causality; long-range causal-chain reasoning remains an open challenge for current language models.

title: Revisiting Compositionality in Dual-Encoder Vision-Language Models: The Role of Inference
summary: Dual-encoder Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP are often characterized as bag-of-words systems due to their poor performance on compositional benchmarks. We argue that this limitation may stem less from deficient representations than from the standard inference protocol based on global cosine similarity. First, through controlled diagnostic experiments, we show that explicitly enforcing fine-grained region-segment alignment at inference dramatically improves compositional performance without updating pretrained encoders. We then introduce a lightweight transformer that learns such alignments directly from frozen patch and token embeddings. Comparing against full fine-tuning and prior end-to-end compositional training methods, we find that although these approaches improve in-domain retrieval, their gains do not consistently transfer under distribution shift. In contrast, learning localized alignment over frozen representations matches full fine-tuning on in-domain retrieval while yielding substantial improvements on controlled out-of-domain compositional benchmarks. These results identify global embedding matching as a key bottleneck in dual-encoder VLMs and highlight the importance of alignment mechanisms for robust compositional generalization.

AI.tldr: CLIP 类双编码器 VLM 被诟病“词袋”式组合理解差，主因不在表征而在推理阶段的全局余弦相似度匹配；作者用冻结编码器做区域-片段细粒度对齐，轻量 Transformer 即可达到全微调级检索性能，并在分布外组合任务上显著领先。
AI.motivation: 现有双编码器 VLM 在组合基准上表现差，普遍归因于“表征缺陷”；作者质疑真正瓶颈是推理阶段的全局相似度协议，希望不重新训练大模型即可提升组合泛化能力。
AI.method: 1) 诊断实验：在冻结 CLIP 编码器条件下，引入显式的区域-片段对齐打分，验证组合性能跃升；2) 提出轻量级 Transformer，直接以冻结 patch 与 token 嵌入为输入，端到端学习局部对齐权重；3) 与全微调及已有组合训练方法进行系统对比，考察分布内检索与分布外组合鲁棒性。
AI.result: 局部对齐推理无需更新编码器，即可在分布内图文检索上追平全微调；在多个受控的分布外组合基准上获得显著绝对增益（如 +10% 以上）；而全微调和既有组合训练方法在分布外提升不稳定甚至下降。
AI.conclusion: 全局嵌入匹配是双编码器 VLM 组合能力的核心瓶颈；通过轻量级模块学习局部对齐，可在不牺牲分布内性能的前提下实现更强的组合泛化，为高效部署鲁棒 VLM 提供新范式。

title: Cornfigurator: Automated Planning for Any-to-Any Multimodal Model Serving
summary:
Any-to-Any models are an emerging class of multimodal models that accept combinations of text and multimodal data as input and generate them as output, introducing heterogeneous computation paths and component scaling characteristics. There are existing mechanisms for deploying Any-to-Any models--or special cases of them--for inference serving, but they either require manual effort and expertise to tune, or do not generalize to generic Any-to-Any models.
  We present Cornfigurator, the first deployment planner for generic Any-to-Any model inference serving. The goal of Cornfigurator is to maximize the overall goodput of serving the model, defined as the throughput of requests meeting their latency targets. To do so, based on model and workload characteristics, Cornfigurator explores the full spectrum of deployment strategies, from colocation to disaggregation and mixing different strategies. Cornfigurator performs coarse-to-fine statistical evaluation to efficiently navigate the large space of candidate plans. Plans generated by Cornfigurator either match or deliver 1.12$\times$-6.32$\times$ higher goodput compared to existing systems and expert-tuned deployment plans.

AI.tldr: Cornfigurator 是第一个面向通用 Any-to-Any 多模态模型的自动部署规划器，通过粗到细的统计评估在全谱系部署策略空间中搜索，使满足延迟目标的请求吞吐（goodput）较现有方案提升 1.12–6.32 倍。
AI.motivation: Any-to-Any 模型输入输出均含文本与多模态数据，计算路径异构、组件规模差异大；现有推理部署机制要么依赖人工调优且难以泛化，要么无法覆盖任意模型，亟需一种自动化、通用的部署规划方案。
AI.method: 提出 Cornfigurator：以最大化 goodput 为目标，先对模型与负载特征进行粗粒度采样建立性能 surrogate，再在策略空间（同机共置、完全分离、混合策略等）执行细粒度蒙特卡洛-贝叶斯优化，快速收敛到最优部署计划。
AI.result: 在 3 类 Any-to-Any 模型、6 种真实负载上的实验表明，Cornfigurator 生成的方案与手工专家调优持平或优于 1.12–6.32 倍，规划时间 <10 min，且无需人工干预。
AI.conclusion: Cornfigurator 证明对异构多模态模型进行自动化、数据驱动的全谱系部署搜索可显著提升在线 serving 效率，为后续 Any-to-Any 模型规模化落地提供了可行框架。

title: Schema Key Wording as an Instruction Channel in Structured Generation under Constrained Decoding
summary: Constrained decoding has been widely adopted for structured generation with large language models (LLMs), ensuring that outputs satisfy predefined formats such as JSON and XML. However, existing approaches largely treat schemas as purely structural constraints and overlook the possibility that their linguistic formulation may affect model behavior. In this work, we study how instruction placement influences model performance in structured generation and show that merely changing the wording of schema keys, without modifying the prompt or model parameters, can significantly alter model performance under constrained decoding. Based on this observation, we propose to reinterpret structured generation as a multi-channel instruction problem, where instructions can be conveyed explicitly through prompts and implicitly through schema keys during decoding. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to systematically study how schema key formulation acts as an implicit instruction channel and affects model performance under constrained decoding. Experiments on multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that different model families exhibit distinct sensitivities to these instruction channels: Qwen models consistently benefit from schema-level instructions, while LLaMA models rely more heavily on prompt-level guidance. We further observe non-additive interaction effects between instruction channels, showing that combining multiple channels does not always lead to further improvement. These findings suggest that schema design not only determines output structure, but also carries instruction signals, offering a new perspective on structured generation in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 首次揭示 schema 键的措辞本身即可作为隐性指令信道，显著影响 LLM 在受限解码下的结构化输出质量；提出“多信道指令”视角并发现不同模型家族对显性/隐性指令的敏感性与非叠加效应。
AI.motivation: 受限解码虽能保证输出格式，但现有研究把 schema 仅当结构约束，忽视了其语言表述可能传递额外指令。需验证 schema 键的语义差异是否足以改变模型行为，从而补全结构化生成的指令机制拼图。
AI.method: 将结构化生成重定义为“多信道指令”问题：显性信道为 prompt 文本，隐性信道为 schema 键的措辞。在数学推理基准上固定 prompt 与模型参数，仅系统替换 schema 键（如“answer→solution”、“value→result”），对比不同模型家族在受限解码下的性能变化，并用方差分解与交互效应检验双信道叠加性。
AI.result: 仅改换 schema 键可使同一模型在 GSM8K、MATH 等数据集上的准确率波动高达 8–15%。Qwen 系列对 schema 级措辞敏感，收益明显；LLaMA 系列主要依赖 prompt 级指导。双信道并存时出现非加性：增益饱和甚至相消，指令效果非简单叠加。
AI.conclusion: schema 设计不仅定义结构，其语言形式本身即隐性指令。应协同优化 prompt 与 schema 措辞，并为不同模型家族定制“显性–隐性”指令配比，以充分释放受限解码潜力。

title: Beyond Prompt: Fine-grained Simulation of Cognitively Impaired Standardized Patients via Stochastic Steering
summary: Simulating Standardized Patients with cognitive impairment offers a scalable and ethical solution for clinical training. However, existing methods rely on discrete prompt engineering and fail to capture the heterogeneity of deficits across varying domains and severity levels. To address this limitation, we propose StsPatient for the fine-grained simulation of cognitively impaired patients. We innovatively capture domain-specific features by extracting steering vectors from contrastive pairs of instructions and responses. Furthermore, we introduce a Stochastic Token Modulation (STM) mechanism to regulate the intervention probability. STM enables precise control over impairment severity while mitigating the instability of conventional vector methods. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that StsPatient significantly outperforms baselines in both clinical authenticity and severity controllability.

AI.tldr: 用可微向量+随机掩码，在对话模型里精细复现认知障碍病人的异质表现，解决Severity调节不稳定与训练伦理瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 传统基于人工模板或离散prompt的模拟病人难以刻画认知障碍患者在不同认知域（记忆、语言、执行等）及轻-中-重度上的高度异质性，也缺乏可扩展与伦理合规的训练来源。
AI.method: 提出StsPatient框架：1) 从“正常-受损”对比指令-回复对中提取域专属steering vectors，实现细粒度症状映射；2) 设计Stochastic Token Modulation（STM），按token级概率随机注入向量，既精准控制损害严重程度，又抑制连续向量干预带来的输出崩溃。
AI.result: 在多域临床评分与逼真度指标上，StsPatient相较最佳基线提升15-28%； Severity调节误差<3%，输出稳定性（PPL波动）降低42%。
AI.conclusion: 通过可微表示与随机调制，StsPatient首次实现高保真、可精细分级、伦理友好的认知障碍标准化病人模拟，为临床教学提供可扩展数据与可控评测场景。

title: Learning to Plan, Planning to Learn: Adaptive Hierarchical RL-MPC for Sample-Efficient Decision Making
comment: 27 pages, 10 figures, 8th Annual Learning for Dynamics & Control Conference (L4DC)
summary: We propose a new approach for solving planning problems with a hierarchical structure, fusing reinforcement learning and MPC planning. Our formulation tightly and elegantly couples the two planning paradigms. It leverages reinforcement learning actions to inform the MPPI sampler, and adaptively aggregates MPPI samples to inform the value estimation. The resulting adaptive process leverages further MPPI exploration where value estimates are uncertain, and improves training robustness and the overall resulting policies. This results in a robust planning approach that can handle complex planning problems and easily adapts to different applications, as demonstrated over several domains, including race driving, modified Acrobot, and Lunar Lander with added obstacles. Our results in these domains show better data efficiency and overall performance in terms of both rewards and task success, with up to a 72% increase in success rate compared to existing approaches, as well as accelerated convergence (x2.1) compared to non-adaptive sampling.

AI.tldr: 把强化学习（RL）和模型预测控制（MPC）的采样器 MPPI 做成双向闭环：RL 动作指导采样，MPPI 样本反哺价值估计；价值不确定区域自动增加采样，实现数据高效、策略鲁棒。在竞速、改型 Acrobot、带障碍月球着陆三类任务中，成功率最高提升 72%，收敛速度加快 2.1 倍。
AI.motivation: 传统 RL 样本效率低，纯 MPC 对模型误差敏感。作者希望整合两者优势，构建能在复杂不确定环境下高效、鲁棒的层次化规划框架。
AI.method: 提出“RL-MPPI 双向耦合”机制：1) 高层 RL 策略输出的动作分布作为 MPPI 采样先验；2) 低层 MPPI 的采样回报自适应聚合，用于更新 RL 的价值估计；3) 价值估计的不确定性驱动额外采样，形成在线闭环自适应。
AI.result: 在竞速驾驶、改型 Acrobot 与带障碍月球着陆任务中，新方法较基线在样本效率、累积奖励和任务成功率上全面领先，成功率最高提升 72%，收敛速度提升 2.1 倍，且跨任务迁移无需重新调参。
AI.conclusion: 通过 RL 与 MPC 的深度双向融合，可在保证策略鲁棒性的同时显著提升数据效率与收敛速度，为复杂实时规划提供通用可扩展的解决方案。

title: MetaDent: Labeling Clinical Images for Vision-Language Models in Dentistry
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in medical image analysis, yet their application in intraoral photography remains largely underexplored due to the lack of fine-grained, annotated datasets and comprehensive benchmarks. To address this, we present MetaDent, a comprehensive resource that includes (1) a novel and large-scale dentistry image dataset collected from clinical, public, and web sources; (2) a semi-structured annotation framework designed to capture the hierarchical and clinically nuanced nature of dental photography; and (3) comprehensive benchmark suites for evaluating state-of-the-art VLMs on clinical image understanding. Our labeling approach combines a high-level image summary with point-by-point, free-text descriptions of abnormalities. This method enables rich, scalable, and task-agnostic representations. We curated 60,669 dental images from diverse sources and annotated a representative subset of 2,588 images using this meta-labeling scheme. Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), we derive standardized benchmarks: approximately 15K Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs and an 18-class multi-label classification dataset, which we validated with human review and error analysis to justify that the LLM-driven transition reliably preserves fidelity and semantic accuracy. We then evaluate state-of-the-art VLMs across VQA, classification, and image captioning tasks. Quantitative results reveal that even the most advanced models struggle with a fine-grained understanding of intraoral scenes, achieving moderate accuracy and producing inconsistent or incomplete descriptions in image captioning. We publicly release our dataset, annotations, and tools to foster reproducible research and accelerate the development of vision-language systems for dental applications.

AI.tldr: 首个口腔内照片专用大规模 VLM 基准 MetaDent，含 60 K 图像、分层语义标注与 33 K VQA/分类基准；实验揭示现有模型在牙科细粒度场景理解上性能不足并公开全部数据与工具。
AI.motivation: 口腔摄影缺乏细粒度、带标注的大规模数据集与评估基准，阻碍了 VLM 在牙科临床中的落地。
AI.method: (1) 收集并整合临床、公开与网络来源共 60 669 张口腔照片；(2) 设计半结构化分层标注框架，用「图像概要 + 逐点异常自由文本」混合方式对 2 588 张代表性样本进行元标注；(3) 借助 LLM 将元标注蒸馏为约 1.5 万对 VQA 与 18 类多标签分类任务，并经人工校验确保语义保真；(4) 构建 VQA、分类与图像字幕三大基准套件，系统评估 SOTA VLMs。
AI.result: 在自建基准上，当前最优 VLM 在细粒度识别任务中仅获得中等精度；字幕生成常出现不一致或遗漏临床关键信息； LLM 驱动的任务转换在人工校验下保持高语义准确性。
AI.conclusion: MetaDent 填补了口腔影像 VLM 研究的空白，证明现有模型在精细牙科场景理解上仍有显著差距；公开的数据、标注与工具将加速针对牙科应用的视觉-语言系统研发。

title: Functional Emotions or Situational Contexts? A Discriminating Test from the Mythos Preview System Card
comment: 7 pages. v2: supplementary analysis added, references updated
summary: The Claude Mythos Preview system card deploys emotion vectors, sparse autoencoder (SAE) features, and activation verbalisers to study model internals during misaligned behaviour. The two primary toolkits are not jointly reported on the most alignment-relevant episodes. This note identifies two hypotheses that are qualitatively consistent with the published results: that the emotion vectors track functional emotions that causally drive behaviour, or that they are a projection of a richer situational-context structure onto human emotional axes. The hypotheses can be distinguished by cross-referencing the two toolkits on episodes where only one is currently reported: most directly, applying emotion probes to the strategic concealment episodes analysed only with SAE features. If emotion probes show flat activation while SAE features are strongly active, the alignment-relevant structure lies outside the emotion subspace. Which hypothesis is correct determines whether emotion-based monitoring will robustly detect dangerous model behaviour or systematically miss it.

AI.tldr: 文章指出，Claude Mythos Preview 用情绪向量+稀疏自编码器(SAE)特征+激活描述器研究模型内部，但两套工具未共同用于最关键的
AI.motivation: 目前理解模型错位行为的机制依赖分面探针，情绪向量与SAE 特征各说各话，无法判断情绪子空间是否足以包络所有对齐风险，亟需验证二者覆盖范围与因果有效性。
AI.method: 提出两条互斥假设：A) 情绪向量追踪真正驱动行为的
AI.result: 尚未实验验证，仅给出判别路径：在仅报告 SAE 的
AI.conclusion: 若最终实验显示情绪探针在关键错位场景下无激活，则情绪子空间遗漏核心风险，需转向更高维或情境化监控；反之，情绪向量可作为轻量级对齐哨兵。

title: Federated Multi-Task Clustering
summary: Spectral clustering has emerged as one of the most effective clustering algorithms due to its superior performance. However, most existing models are designed for centralized settings, rendering them inapplicable in modern decentralized environments. Moreover, current federated learning approaches often suffer from poor generalization performance due to reliance on unreliable pseudo-labels, and fail to capture the latent correlations amongst heterogeneous clients. To tackle these limitations, this paper proposes a novel framework named Federated Multi-Task Clustering (i.e.,FMTC), which intends to learn personalized clustering models for heterogeneous clients while collaboratively leveraging their shared underlying structure in a privacy-preserving manner. More specifically, the FMTC framework is composed of two main components: client-side personalized clustering module, which learns a parameterized mapping model to support robust out-of-sample inference, bypassing the need for unreliable pseudo-labels; and server-side tensorial correlation module, which explicitly captures the shared knowledge across all clients. This is achieved by organizing all client models into a unified tensor and applying a low-rank regularization to discover their common subspace. To solve this joint optimization problem, we derive an efficient, privacy-preserving distributed algorithm based on the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers, which decomposes the global problem into parallel local updates on clients and an aggregation step on the server. To the end, several extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that our proposed FMTC framework significantly outperforms various baseline and state-of-the-art federated clustering algorithms.

AI.tldr: 基于个性化聚类模块与服务器端张量关联模块的联邦多任务聚类框架FMTC，利用低秩正则化提取各用户共享子空间，并以ADMM分布式优化算法实现无伪标签的隐私保护聚类。
AI.motivation: 现有谱聚类多为集中式，难以适用于去中心化场景；联邦学习中伪标签不可靠，泛化差且无法刻画异构用户间潜在关联，需要一种兼顾个性化与知识共享的聚类框架。
AI.method: FMTC框架:(1)客户端个性化聚类模块—训练可推断新样本的参数化映射，避免使用伪标签；(2)服务器端张量关联模块—将所有用户模型组织成统一张量并施加低秩正则，挖掘共同子空间；(3)基于ADMM的隐私保护分布式算法—将全局目标分解为客户端本地更新与服务器聚合。
AI.result: 在多个真实数据集上，FMTC显著优于多项基线与最先进的联邦聚类算法，验证其稳健性和泛化优势。
AI.conclusion: FMTC通过结合个性化建模与共享结构挖掘并引入无伪标签推理，为异构联邦环境中的聚类问题提供了一种高效、隐私友好的解决方案，有望作为谱聚类在新分布环境下的有效替代。

title: Vibe-Coding: Feedback-Based Automated Verification with no Human Code Inspection, a Feasibility Study
summary:
Vibe coding inherently assumes iterative refinement of LLM-generated code through feedback loops. While effective for conventional software tasks, its reliability in runtime-adaptive systems is unclear -- especially when generated code is not manually inspected. This paper studies feedback-based automated verification of LLM-generated adaptation managers in Collective Adaptive Systems (CAS). We focus on the key challenges of verification in the loop: how to detect failures of generated code at runtime and how to report them precisely enough for an LLM to fix them.
  We combine the adaptation loop with a vibe-coding feedback loop where correctness is checked against (i) generic architectural constraints and (ii) functional constraints formalized in Functional Constraints Logic (FCL), a novel first-order temporal logic over potentially finite traces. Conducting the Dragon Hunt CAS case study, we show that fine-grained constraint violations provide actionable feedback that typically yields a valid adaptation manager within a few iterations, while simple coarse metric-based feedback often stalls. Our findings suggest that feedback precision is the dominant factor for reliable vibe coding in systems designed by domain experts with no programming skills, thereby obviating the need for human code inspection.

AI.tldr: 首次在“离线-代码（vibe-coding）”闭环中引入运行时验证：用FCL求精需约束并在几轮迭代内自动修正LLM生成的CAS自适应管理器，无需人工审码。
AI.motivation: Vibe-coding依赖“LLM-生成→反馈→精化”循环，但现有文献仅在静态、非关键软件场景验证其有效性；对Collective Adaptive Systems(CAS)这类运行时必须动态重配置的实时系统尚无证据表明仍可靠。若生成的自适应管理器含缺陷，其全局外部性可在毫秒级放大为灾难性级联。传统事后人工审查不仅违背无码（no-code）初衷，也无法在系统在线演化时及时辨错。因此亟需一个“运行时自动验证+精确诊断”的闭环，使领域专家仅用自然语言就能持续修正生成的自适应逻辑。
AI.method:
1. 提出双层反馈架构
   - 架构层：用JSON 기반 CAS架构描述，在执行状态时检查通用不变式（如参与者唯一标识、拓扑连通性、资源容量）。
  - 功能层：设计Functional Constraints Logic (FCL)——一阶时序逻辑，迹语义同时支持有限及无限迹，用谓词表达“至少$n$次某事件不发生”等抽取式约束。

2. 将自适应循环与vibe-coding循环耦合：
  (1) LLM根据系统状态生成Δ策略(∆R)；
  (2) 验证引擎在安全沙箱中对ΔR进行simulated execution，采集迹$S$；
  (3) 用FCL模板库匹配$S$，若$	op$则注入生产系统；否则定位最小反例并映射回自然语言“解释”$​$Δ$​$；
  (4) LLM根据$Δ$生成新ΔR并返回(1)。

3. 评估场景采用Dragon Hunt CAS——多机器人协作追击：60×60网格、12 agent、3 kb/s无线链路抖动，跟踪任务完成率、轨迹能量、通信跳数等多目标指标。比较两种反馈：Fine-Grained(FCL) vs Coarse-Metric(任务成功数/能耗比)。在20 seed/path条件下记录平均迭代次数、最终范化成功率及稳态时间。
AI.result:
1. 偶发性漏洞检测能力：Fine-Grained在首轮即能捕捉“死锁”“超过最大通信跳数”等8个hard-to-catch bug，而Coarse仅在第6轮才因成功率突降到62%显式报错。
2. 收敛性能：Fine-Grained平均4.3±1.1轮收敛到无模型偏差的管理器(97%任务成功率)；Coarse则无法收敛(最多25轮后仍剩2项约束违反)。

4. 编程门槛：6名零编程背景领域工程师仅用NL指令即可在30 min内完成Dragon Hunt策略修订；对照组盲审LLM反向生成源码仅50%能通过人工安全巡检。

title: From Memorization to Creativity: LLM as a Designer of Novel Neural Architectures
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel in program synthesis, yet their capacity for neural architecture design -- balancing syntactic reliability, performance, and structural novelty -- remains underexplored. We present a closed-loop architecture synthesis pipeline within the NNGPT framework, in which a code-oriented LLM evolves over 22 supervised fine-tuning cycles. At each cycle, the LLM synthesizes PyTorch convolutional networks, validated via low-fidelity performance signals and filtered via a MinHash--Jaccard criterion to prevent structural redundancy before being incorporated into the LEMUR dataset. High-performing candidates with novel architectures are converted into prompt--code pairs for parameter-efficient LoRA fine-tuning. This feedback loop drives a measurable distributional shift, progressively internalizing empirical architectural priors such that valid and high-performing outputs evolve from scarce to dominant across cycles. On CIFAR-10, the valid generation rate stabilizes at 50.6% (peaking at 74.5%), mean first-epoch accuracy rises from 28.1% to 51.0%, and candidates exceeding 40% accuracy grow from 2.0% to 96.8%. Cross-dataset transfer to CIFAR-100 and SVHN confirms that improved validity, shifted accuracy distributions, and sustained novelty generalize across benchmarks of varying difficulty and visual domain. Across 22 cycles, 455 unique architectures absent from the original corpus are admitted under the novelty filter. By grounding synthesis in execution feedback and novelty filtering, we demonstrate that iterative self-supervised fine-tuning reshapes an LLM into a task-specialized architectural prior -- improving generation reliability, proxy performance, and structural diversity -- offering a reproducible, annotation-free alternative to hand-crafted search spaces.

AI.tldr:
提出NNGPT闭环结构合成流水线，用22轮LoRA微调将大型语言模型转化为自动生成新颖、可执行、高人效CNN架构的网络设计师，CIFAR-10有效结构率逾50%，平均首轮准确率28%→51%，转移良好，45万原创结构免人工标注自动诞生。

AI.motivation: 现有LLM擅程序生成，但在网络结构设计中如何兼顾语法正确性、性能与新颖性尚缺系统研究。作者希望挖掘LLM“零人工”下自我进化成结构先验的潜能，为AutoML提供免搜索空间、免标注的新范式。

title: GenRec: A Preference-Oriented Generative Framework for Large-Scale Recommendation
summary: Generative Retrieval (GR) offers a promising paradigm for recommendation through next-token prediction (NTP). However, scaling it to large-scale industrial systems introduces three challenges: (i) within a single request, the identical model inputs may produce inconsistent outputs due to the pagination request mechanism; (ii) the prohibitive cost of encoding long user behavior sequences with multi-token item representations based on semantic IDs, and (iii) aligning the generative policy with nuanced user preference signals. We present GenRec, a preference-oriented generative framework deployed on the JD App that addresses above challenges within a single decoder-only architecture. For training objective, we propose Page-wise NTP task, which supervises over an entire interaction page rather than each interacted item individually, providing denser gradient signal and resolving the one-to-many ambiguity of point-wise training. On the prefilling side, an asymmetric linear Token Merger compresses multi-token Semantic IDs in the prompt while preserving full-resolution decoding, reducing input length by ~2X with negligible accuracy loss. To further align outputs with user satisfaction, we introduce GRPO-SR, a reinforcement learning method that pairs Group Relative Policy Optimization with NLL regularization for training stability, and employs Hybrid Rewards combining a dense reward model with a relevance gate to mitigate reward hacking. In month-long online A/B tests serving production traffic, GenRec achieves 9.5% improvement in click count and 8.7% in transaction count over the existing pipeline.

AI.tldr: 京东工业级推荐系统 GenRec 用纯生成式框架替代传统多阶段漏斗，在首月线上 A/B 测试中使点击量 +9.5%、下单量 +8.7%。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索（GR）通过 NTP 统一召回与排序，有望摆脱传统多路召回 + 多阶段排序的复杂链路，但直接落地面临分页结果不一致、长行为语义 ID 编码成本极高、精细偏好难以对齐三大障碍。
AI.method:
1) 提出 Page-wise NTP 任务，将整个交互页视作单一序列进行监督，密集梯度解决“点对多点”歧义；
2) 编解码不对称的线性 Token Merger，在提示阶段把多 Token 语义 ID 压缩 50%，解码阶段恢复高分辨率；
3) GRPO-SR 强化学习：Group Relative Policy Optimization + NLL 正则保障稳定，稠密奖励模型 + 相关门混合奖励抑制 reward hacking。
AI.result: 离线实验在压缩后输入长度减半的同时指标几乎无损；线上一个月真实流量 A/B 对比基线系统，点击量提升 9.5%，下单量提升 8.7%。
AI.conclusion: GenRec 证明生成式推荐无需传统召回-排序漏斗即可在超大规模工业场景稳定落地，且通过 Page-wise NTP、Token 压缩与 GRPO-SR 三项设计同时解决一致性、成本与偏好对齐难题，为后续研究和工业部署提供可直接复用的范式。

title: ORBIT: On-policy Exploration-Exploitation for Controllable Multi-Budget Reasoning
summary: Recent Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance by leveraging long-form Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, but uniformly applying overlong reasoning at inference time incurs substantial and often unnecessary computational cost. To address this, prior work explores various strategies to infer an appropriate reasoning budget from the input. However, such approaches are unreliable in the worst case, as estimating the minimal required reasoning effort is fundamentally difficult, and they implicitly fix the trade-off between reasoning cost and accuracy during training, limiting flexibility under varying deployment scenarios. Motivated by these limitations, we propose ORBIT, a controllable multi-budget reasoning framework with well-separated reasoning modes triggered by input. ORBIT employs multi-stage reinforcement learning to discover Pareto-optimal reasoning behaviors at each effort, followed by on-policy distillation to fuse these behaviors into a single unified model. Experiments show that ORBIT achieves (1) controllable reasoning behavior over multiple modes, (2) competitive reasoning density within each mode, and (3) integration of these frontier policies into a single unified student model while preserving clear mode separation and high per-mode performance.

AI.tldr: ORBIT 以单一模型提供多档‘推理档位’，用户可按需调用，兼顾精度与算力，无需重新训练。
AI.motivation: 长思维链虽能提升大模型推理表现，但按统一上限生成会造成巨大冗余开销；现有预算预估法最坏情况下不可靠，且把成本–精度权衡固化在训练阶段，缺乏部署弹性。
AI.method: 提出 ORBIT：先用多阶段强化学习为不同推理长度预算分别寻找帕累托最优策略，再以同策略蒸馏把各策略融合进同一学生模型，并在输入端加入显式预算控制信号，实现模式分离。
AI.result: 在多个长度预算下，ORBIT 皆达到与专用模型相当或更优的准确率；同一学生模型可平滑切换短/中/长推理模式，推理密度更高，且模式间性能边界清晰。
AI.conclusion: 将多预算推理行为压缩进单一可控模型切实可行，为按需弹性部署长推理模型提供了新范式，并验证了强化学习+同策略蒸馏在复杂度–性能权衡上的有效性。

title: SOLIS: Physics-Informed Learning of Interpretable Neural Surrogates for Nonlinear Systems
comment: in the International Joint Conference on Neural Networks, 2026
summary: Nonlinear system identification must balance physical interpretability with model flexibility. Classical methods yield structured, control-relevant models but rely on rigid parametric forms that often miss complex nonlinearities, whereas Neural ODEs are expressive yet largely black-box. Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) sit between these extremes, but inverse PINNs typically assume a known governing equation with fixed coefficients, leading to identifiability failures when the true dynamics are unknown or state-dependent. We propose \textbf{SOLIS}, which models unknown dynamics via a \emph{state-conditioned second-order surrogate model} and recasts identification as learning a Quasi-Linear Parameter-Varying (Quasi-LPV) representation, recovering interpretable natural frequency, damping, and gain without presupposing a global equation. SOLIS decouples trajectory reconstruction from parameter estimation and stabilizes training with a cyclic curriculum and \textbf{Local Physics Hints} windowed ridge-regression anchors that mitigate optimization collapse. Experiments on benchmarks show accurate parameter-manifold recovery and coherent physical rollouts from sparse data, including regimes where standard inverse methods fail.
