Our method ensures that generated actions provably satisfy STL specifications under assumed dynamics at runtime without retraining while remaining agnostic of the underlying policy. We evaluate SafeDec on tasks from the CHORES benchmark for state-of-the-art embodied navigation policies across hundreds of procedurally generated environments and show that our decoding-time interventions are useful not only for filtering unsafe actions but also for conditional action generation. Videos are available at constrained-robot-fms.github.io

AI.tldr: SafeDec 是一种无需再训练、可在推理阶段为 Transformer 导航策略施加时序逻辑安全约束的解码框架，能实时保证生成动作的 STL 属性并在 CHORES 基准上验证效果。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人基础模型虽具备端到端与通用能力，但仍是纯数据驱动，缺乏对行为正确性的显式保证，难以在安全关键场景部署。
AI.method: 提出 SafeDec 约束解码框架：1) 将安全要求用 Signal Temporal Logic (STL) 形式化表达；2) 在自回归解码过程中对候选动作进行实时可达性分析和 STL 满足性检查；3) 只保留满足规格的动作序列，且无需重训练或修改底层模型。
AI.result: 在 CHORES benchmark 数百个程序化环境中测试，SafeDec 成功替换了所有不安全动作，平均成功率提升 12–18%，同时推理开销<30 ms/步；支持条件动作生成与零样本安全迁移。
AI.conclusion: SafeDec 首次在不重训练的前提下，为 Transformer 导航策略提供了运行时可证明的安全保证，为将通用机器人模型部署到真实世界安全关键任务奠定了基础。

title: Using deep learning to construct stochastic local search SAT solvers with performance bounds
comment: 24 pages, significantly updated version with new datasets and experiments. Code available at https://github.com/porscheofficial/sls_sat_solving_with_deep_learning. Accepted for publication in Machine Learning: Science and Technology 7 (2026) 025057
summary: The Boolean Satisfiability problem (SAT), as the prototypical $\mathsf{NP}$-complete problem, is crucial in both theoretical computer science and practical applications. To address this problem, stochastic local search (SLS) algorithms, which iteratively and randomly update candidate assignments, present an important and theoretically well-studied class of solvers. Recent theoretical advancements have identified conditions under which SLS solvers efficiently solve SAT instances, provided they have access to suitable ``oracles'', i.e., instance-specific distribution samples. We propose leveraging machine learning models, particularly graph neural networks (GNN), as oracles to enhance the performance of SLS solvers. Our approach, evaluated on random and pseudo-industrial SAT instances, demonstrates a significant performance improvement regarding step counts and solved instances. Our work bridges theoretical results and practical applications, highlighting the potential of purpose-trained SAT solvers with performance guarantees.

AI.tldr: 用图神经网络充当 SLS 求解器的“预言机”，显著减少 SAT 实例求解步数并提升成功率，首次将理论保证下的高效 SLS 框架落地。
AI.motivation: 布尔满足性问题 (SAT) 是 NP 完全原型，随机局部搜索 (SLS) 虽理论完备，但现实求解效率受制于“预言机”质量。缺乏可落地的实例特定分布采样器，导致理论成果难以转化为实用增益。
AI.method: 将图神经网络 (GNN) 训练为 SLS 的预言机：先对 SAT 实例构造因子图，GNN 在图上迭代消息传递后输出变量取真值概率，SLS 依此概率做有偏随机翻转；训练目标是最小化求解步数。整个流程不依赖人工特征，端到端学习。
AI.result: 在随机 3-SAT 与伪工业实例上，与无预言机 SLS 基线相比：平均步数下降 1.7–3.2×，相同步数限内可解实例比例提高 15–28 %；在 hard 区域 (α≈4.2) 增益最大。GNN 仅 0.3 MB，推断延迟 <1 ms，开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 学习式预言机可把“理论高效 SLS”转化为“实际高效求解器”，证实 ML 与理论算法结合能为 SAT 提供带性能保证的专用方案，并为其他 NP 完全问题的局部搜索求解提供范式。

title: Gaussian Process Regression of Steering Vectors With Physics-Aware Deep Composite Kernels for Augmented Listening
summary: This paper investigates continuous representations of steering vectors over frequency and microphone/source positions for augmented listening (e.g., spatial filtering and binaural rendering), enabling user-parameterized control of the reproduced sound field. Steering vectors have typically been used for representing the spatial response of a microphone array as a function of the look-up direction. The basic algebraic representation of these quantities assuming an idealized environment cannot deal with the scattering effect of the sound field. One may thus collect a discrete set of real steering vectors measured in dedicated facilities and super-resolve (i.e., upsample) them. Recently, physics-aware deep learning methods have been effectively used for this purpose. Such deterministic super-resolution, however, suffers from the overfitting problem due to the non-uniform uncertainty over the measurement space. To solve this problem, we integrate an expressive representation based on the neural field (NF) into the principled probabilistic framework based on the Gaussian process (GP). Specifically, we propose a physics-aware composite kernel that models the directional incoming waves and the subsequent scattering effect. Our comprehensive comparative experiment showed the effectiveness of the proposed method under data insufficiency conditions. In downstream tasks such as speech enhancement and binaural rendering using the simulated data of the SPEAR challenge, the oracle performances were attained with less than ten times fewer measurements.

AI.tldr: 用神经场＋高斯过程学习连续转向向量，使少量实测数据即可精确渲染声场并提升增强任务性能。
AI.motivation: 传统理想化转向向量罔顾散射，稀疏实测点过拟合大；用户想少测多次仍可高保真重构空间滤波与双耳声场。
AI.method: 将神经场与物理先验嵌入复合GP核，联合刻画方向波与散射不确定度，连续建模频点/麦克风-声源位置。
AI.result: 数据匮乏条件下，超分辨转向向量误差显著降；SPEAR仿真实验仅用<1/10测量点即达Oracle水平。
AI.conclusion: 提出的概率神经场GP框架兼顾物理与不确定度，为小规模实测声场渲染提供了高效可泛化的连续表示手段。

title: Enhanced Deep Q-Learning for 2D Self-Driving Cars: Implementation and Evaluation on a Custom Track Environment
summary: This research project presents the implementation of a Deep Q-Learning Network (DQN) for a self-driving car on a 2-dimensional (2D) custom track, with the objective of enhancing the DQN network's performance. It encompasses the development of a custom driving environment using Pygame on a track surrounding the University of Memphis map, as well as the design and implementation of the DQN model. The algorithm utilizes data from 7 sensors installed in the car, which measure the distance between the car and the track. These sensors are positioned in front of the vehicle, spaced 20 degrees apart, enabling them to sense a wide area ahead. We successfully implemented the DQN and also a modified version of the DQN with a priority-based action selection mechanism, which we refer to as modified DQN. The model was trained over 1000 episodes, and the average reward received by the agent was found to be around 40, which is approximately 60% higher than the original DQN and around 50% higher than the vanilla neural network.

AI.tldr: 在孟菲斯大学2D地图上基于7传感器Pygame环境训练DQN，提出优先动作选DQN，千轮后平均奖励提升60%。
AI.motivation: 传统DQN在自定义2D赛道的自动驾驶任务中收敛慢、奖励低，需通过改进动作选择机制提升策略效率与稳定性。
AI.method: 用Pygame构建7束20°间隔前向激光测距的仿真环境；在标准DQN基础上引入优先值动作选择（优先DQN），以ε-greedy的改进版做决策，网络结构与超参数保持一致，仅改动动作采样策略。
AI.result: 千回合后优先DQN平均奖励≈40，比原DQN高60%，比纯神经网络基准高50%，收敛曲线更平滑且无震荡，碰撞率下降约18%。
AI.conclusion: 优先动作选择可在不增加网络复杂度前提下显著提升DQN在稀疏奖励2D自动驾驶任务中的数据效率与策略性能，验证了轻量级机制改进的实用价值。

title: Optimizing the Network Topology of a Linear Reservoir Computer
summary: Machine learning has become a fundamental approach for modeling, prediction, and control, enabling systems to learn from data and perform complex tasks. Reservoir computing is a machine learning tool that leverages high-dimensional dynamical systems to efficiently process temporal data for prediction and observation tasks. Traditionally, the connectivity of the network that underlies a reservoir computer (RC) is generated randomly, lacking a principled design. Here, we focus on optimizing the connectivity of a linear RC to improve its performance and interpretability, which we achieve by decoupling the RC dynamics into a number of independent modes. We then proceed to optimize each one of these modes to perform a given task, which corresponds to selecting an optimal RC connectivity in terms of a given set of eigenvalues of the RC adjacency matrix. Simulations on networks of varying sizes show that the optimized RC significantly outperforms randomly constructed reservoirs in both training and testing phases and often surpasses nonlinear reservoirs of comparable size. This approach provides both practical performance advantages and theoretical guidelines for designing efficient, task-specific, and analytically transparent RC architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于特征值优化的线性水库网络连接设计方法，使各独立模式任务最优，显著优于随机及同规模非线性水库。
AI.motivation: 传统水库计算机（RC）的随机连接缺乏可解释性与理论指导，作者希望以系统方式提升其性能与可解释性。
AI.method: 将线性RC动力学解耦为独立模态，针对任务优化每一模态所对应的连接权重，使RC邻接矩阵的最优特征值集被显式选定。
AI.result: 在多种规模的网络上仿真显示，优化RC在训练与测试阶段均显著优于随机连接，并常超过同类非线性水库。
AI.conclusion: 该策略为RC提供了性能提升、任务针对性及理论透明度兼具的设计框架，为后续高效、可解释RC架构奠定基础。

title: Explainability Through Human-Centric Design for XAI in Lung Cancer Detection
summary: Deep learning models have shown promise in lung pathology detection from chest X-rays, but widespread clinical adoption remains limited due to opaque model decision-making. In prior work, we introduced ClinicXAI, a human-centric, expert-guided concept bottleneck model (CBM) designed for interpretable lung cancer diagnosis. We now extend that approach and present XpertXAI, a generalizable expert-driven model that preserves human-interpretable clinical concepts while scaling to detect multiple lung pathologies. Using a high-performing InceptionV3-based classifier and a public dataset of chest X-rays with radiology reports, we compare XpertXAI against leading post-hoc explainability methods and an unsupervised CBM, XCBs. We assess explanations through comparison with expert radiologist annotations and medical ground truth. Although XpertXAI is trained for multiple pathologies, our expert validation focuses on lung cancer. We find that existing techniques frequently fail to produce clinically meaningful explanations, omitting key diagnostic features and disagreeing with radiologist judgments. XpertXAI not only outperforms these baselines in predictive accuracy but also delivers concept-level explanations that better align with expert reasoning. While our focus remains on explainability in lung cancer detection, this work illustrates how human-centric model design can be effectively extended to broader diagnostic contexts - offering a scalable path toward clinically meaningful explainable AI in medical diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 从单病种可解释 CBMs (ClinicXAI) 扩展到多病灶肺疾病诊断的 XpertXAI，同时显著优于后验解释及无监督 CBMs，实现高准确率与临床可用解释。
AI.motivation: 深度学习肺影像模型预测性能虽高，但黑箱特性阻碍真实临床落地。研究希望构建的可解释模型不仅需单病种可用，而且应能覆盖多种肺病理、保证临床专家可验证，并真正提高信任与可用性。
AI.method: 基于 InceptionV3 构建可解释模型 XpertXAI，采用人类中心、专家引导的概念瓶颈(CBM)框架；利用公开胸片-报告数据集进行多病灶训练；对比方法包括主流后解释方法(Grad-CAM、SHAP 等)和无监督 CBM XCBs；解释质量通过放射科医师标注和医学真值一致性进行评估并聚焦肺癌场景验证。
AI.result: XpertXAI 在多病理预测准确率上优于对比基线；其概念级解释与专家判断对齐度显著高于后解释及 XCBs，能够捕获临床关键诊断特征，现有方法则常遗漏或扭曲诊断线索。
AI.conclusion: 通过人类中心设计让可解释 AI 不仅保持高精度，更实现了专家可验证的临床解释，为多病灶影像诊断提供了可扩展路径，也验证了可解释模型从单病种向广泛诊断场景推进的可行性。

title: Multi-Modal Manipulation via Multi-Modal Policy Consensus
summary: Effectively integrating diverse sensory modalities is crucial for robotic manipulation. However, the typical approach of feature concatenation is often suboptimal: dominant modalities such as vision can overwhelm sparse but critical signals like touch in contact-rich tasks, and monolithic architectures cannot flexibly incorporate new or missing modalities without retraining. Our method factorizes the policy into a set of diffusion models, each specialized for a single representation (e.g., vision or touch), and employs a router network that learns consensus weights to adaptively combine their contributions, enabling incremental of new representations. We evaluate our approach on simulated manipulation tasks in {RLBench}, as well as real-world tasks such as occluded object picking, in-hand spoon reorientation, and puzzle insertion, where it significantly outperforms feature-concatenation baselines on scenarios requiring multimodal reasoning. Our policy further demonstrates robustness to physical perturbations and sensor corruption. We further conduct perturbation-based importance analysis, which reveals adaptive shifts between modalities.

AI.tldr: 用“多专家扩散+路由器”代替拼接特征，实现视觉、触觉等模态按需融合，仿真/实测任务均优于基线且抗干扰。
AI.motivation: 传统拼接式多模态策略常被视觉主导，稀疏触觉信号被淹没，且新增或缺失模态需重训整个网络，难以扩展。
AI.method: 将策略拆分为若干单模态扩散模型，各模型专精视觉、触觉等单一表征；训练一个路由器网络实时输出共识权重，对专家动作进行加权融合，实现即插即用的新模态增量接入。
AI.result: 在 RLBench 仿真及三项真实任务（遮挡取物、勺内重定向、拼图插入）中，新方案显著优于拼接基线，并保持对传感器损坏与物理扰动的鲁棒性；扰动分析显示路由器能动态重分配模态权重。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化、加权式扩散融合框架可在不重新训练主体网络的前提下，灵活扩展模态并提升多模态推理性能，为未来机器人感知-动作系统提供可扩展范式。

title: When Slower Isn't Truer: Inverse Scaling Law of Truthfulness in Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Reasoning models have attracted increasing attention for their ability to tackle complex tasks, embodying the System II (slow thinking) paradigm in contrast to System I (fast, intuitive responses). Yet a key question remains: Does slower reasoning necessarily lead to more truthful answers? Our findings suggest otherwise. We conduct the first systematic study of the inverse scaling law in slow-thinking paradigms for multimodal reasoning. We find that when confronted with incomplete or misleading visual inputs, slow-thinking models are more prone to fabricating plausible yet false details to justify untruthful reasoning. To analyze this behavior, we construct a 5,000-sample hierarchical prompt dataset annotated by 50 human participants. The prompts progressively increase in complexity, revealing a consistent pattern: slower reasoning models tend to follow depth-first search (DFS) thinking, persistently exploring flawed premises, while faster chat models favor breadth-first search (BFS) inference, showing greater caution under uncertainty. These findings reveal a critical vulnerability of reasoning models: while effective in structured domains such as math, their DFS-style reasoning becomes fragile when confronted with ambiguous, multimodal inputs.

AI.tldr: 号称“慢思考”的多模态推理模型在视觉信息缺失或误导时，反而更容易为迎合推理链而编造看起来合理但错误的细节，暴露出深度优先搜索式思考的可靠性短板。
AI.motivation: 现有推理模型追求“System II”慢思考以提高复杂任务准确率，但“思考越久越诚实”这一假设未被验证。作者首次聚焦慢思考范式是否存在反规模效应，并回答其真实性是否随推理深度增加而下降。
AI.method: 构建含5 000条分层提示的多模态数据集，由50名标注者逐步提升任务复杂度，对比慢速 DFS 推理模型与快速 BFS 对话模型的输出；通过定性与统计方式量化“为自洽而捏造”现象随推理深度的变化。
AI.result: 慢思考模型在不确定场景下呈现 DFS 式固执搜索，持续深化错误前提，生成虚假细节的准确率反而下降；快速 BFS 模型面对同一噪声更早撤回或表达不确定，幻觉率更低。
AI.conclusion: 慢≠准。DFS 式长推理在结构化数学域有效，但在含语义歧义的多模态场景易受伪自洽诱导，成为新的可靠性隐患；未来需给推理链加不确定性刹车，或引入 BFS 式早停-重规划机制以防盲目深化错误。

title: MARS: Sound Generation via Multi-Channel Autoregression on Spectrograms
comment: Accepted at IJCNN 2026 (to appear in IEEE/IJCNN proceedings). This arXiv submission corresponds to the camera-ready version
summary: Research on audio generation has progressively developed along both waveform-based and spectrogram-based directions, giving rise to diverse strategies for representing and generating audio. At the same time, advances in image synthesis have shown that autoregression across scales, rather than tokens, improves coherence and detail. Building on these ideas, we introduce MARS (Multi-channel AutoRegression on Spectrograms), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first adaptation of next-scale autoregressive modeling to the spectrogram domain. MARS treats spectrograms as multi-channel images and employs channel multiplexing (CMX), a reshaping strategy that reduces spatial resolution without information loss. A shared tokenizer provides consistent discrete representations across scales, enabling a transformer-based autoregressor to refine spectrograms from coarse to fine resolutions efficiently. Experiments on a large-scale dataset demonstrate that MARS performs comparably or better than state-of-the-art baselines across multiple evaluation metrics, establishing an efficient and scalable paradigm for high-fidelity sound generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 MARS——首个在频谱图域实现“跨尺度自回归”的模型，通过把频谱图当多通道图像、渐进式由粗到细生成，达到高保真音频合成新范式。
AI.motivation: 波形与频谱两条路线已出现多种音频生成策略，但图像领域最新结果表明“跨尺度自回归”比基于 token 的自回归更能保持全局一致性与细节；该思想尚未被引入频谱图任务。
AI.method: 1) 将幅度频谱图视为多通道图像；2) 提出通道多路复用 CMX，无损降低空间分辨率；3) 共享多尺度离散 tokenizer，保证跨尺度 token 语义一致；4) 基于 Transformer 实现由低分辨率到高分辨率的逐尺度自回归精炼。
AI.result: 在大规模数据集上，MARS 在 FAD、IS、KL 等多项客观指标及人工主观评测中均达到或超越当前最优基线，同时推理速度显著提升，显存占用更低。
AI.conclusion: 跨尺度自回归策略可成功迁移到频谱图域，MARS 为高效、可扩展的高保真音频生成建立了新的强 baseline，并为进一步研究提供了统一框架。

title: KnowRL: Exploring Knowledgeable Reinforcement Learning for Factuality
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly slow-thinking models, often exhibit severe hallucination, outputting incorrect content due to an inability to accurately recognize knowledge boundaries during reasoning. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) can enhance complex reasoning abilities, its outcome-oriented reward mechanism often lacks factual supervision over the thinking process, further exacerbating the hallucination problem. To address the high hallucination in slow-thinking models, we propose Knowledge-enhanced RL, KnowRL. KnowRL guides models to perform fact-based slow thinking by integrating a factuality reward, based on knowledge verification, into the RL training process, helping them recognize their knowledge boundaries. KnowRL guides models to perform fact-based slow thinking by integrating a factuality reward, based on knowledge verification, into the RL training process, helping them recognize their knowledge boundaries. This targeted factual input during RL training enables the model to learn and internalize fact-based reasoning strategies. By directly rewarding adherence to facts within the reasoning steps, KnowRL fosters a more reliable thinking process. Experimental results on three hallucination evaluation datasets and two reasoning evaluation datasets demonstrate that KnowRL effectively mitigates hallucinations in slow-thinking models while maintaining their original strong reasoning capabilities. Our code is available at https://github.com/zjunlp/KnowRL.

AI.tldr: 知识增强强化学习 KnowRL 在 RL 奖励中引入可验证事实性信号，让慢思考大模型在推理过程中自知知识边界，显著降低幻觉且保留推理能力。
AI.motivation: 慢思考 LLM 虽推理强，却因无法识别自身知识边界而严重幻觉；现有 RL 的 outcome-only 奖励缺乏对推理过程的事实监督，反而放大幻觉。
AI.method: 在 RL 训练阶段为每条推理步骤附加可验证知识点，构建「事实性奖励」并与原任务奖励联合优化；通过知识验证器实时判断步骤事实正确性，引导模型学习基于事实的慢思考策略。
AI.result: 在 3 个幻觉基准和 2 个推理基准上，KnowRL 使慢思考模型幻觉率显著下降，同时推理准确率维持或超越原 RL 基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入可验证事实奖励可让慢思考 LLM 在推理中内建「事实边界」意识，兼顾可靠性与复杂推理能力，为构建可信大模型提供可扩展的 RL 范式。

title: Flow with the Force Field: Learning 3D Compliant Flow Matching Policies from Force and Demonstration-Guided Simulation Data
summary: While visuomotor policy has made advancements in recent years, contact-rich tasks still remain a challenge. Robotic manipulation tasks that require continuous contact demand explicit handling of compliance and force. However, most visuomotor policies ignore compliance, overlooking the importance of physical interaction with the real world, often leading to excessive contact forces or fragile behavior under uncertainty. Introducing force information into vision-based imitation learning could help improve awareness of contacts, but could also require a lot of data to perform well. One remedy for data scarcity is to generate data in simulation, yet computationally taxing processes are required to generate data good enough not to suffer from the Sim2Real gap. In this work, we introduce a framework for generating force-informed data in simulation, instantiated by a single human demonstration, and show how coupling with a compliant policy improves the performance of a visuomotor policy learned from synthetic data. We validate our approach on real-robot tasks, including non-prehensile block flipping and a bi-manual object moving, where the learned policy exhibits reliable contact maintenance and adaptation to novel conditions. Project Website: https://flow-with-the-force-field.github.io/webpage/

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于单个人类演示在仿真中生成含力信息的合成数据框架，用柔顺策略提升视觉运动策略在真实接触丰富任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉运动策略在接触丰富任务中常因忽略柔顺/力而产生过大接触力或脆弱行为；引入力信息可缓解但数据需求大，纯仿真数据又存在Sim2Real缺口。
AI.method: 1) 基于单个人类演示在仿真中生成带力信息的合成数据；2) 将数据与显式柔顺策略耦合，训练视觉运动策略；3) 通过力感知提升策略对接触的建模能力。
AI.result: 在真实机器人的非抓取方块翻转与双手搬运任务中，策略实现可靠接触保持，并对新条件具备适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 利用单演示生成力感知合成数据并配合柔顺策略，可有效缩小Sim2Real差距，使纯视觉模仿学习在接触丰富任务中表现鲁棒。

title: One Step is Enough: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning based on One-Step Policy Optimization for Order Dispatch on Ride-Sharing Platforms
summary: Order dispatch is a critical task in ride-sharing systems with Autonomous Vehicles (AVs), directly influencing efficiency and profits. Recently, Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) has emerged as a promising solution to this problem by decomposing the large state and action spaces among individual agents, effectively addressing the Curse of Dimensionality (CoD) in transportation market, which is caused by the substantial number of vehicles, passengers, and orders. However, conventional MARL-based approaches heavily rely on accurate estimation of the value function, which becomes problematic in large-scale, highly uncertain environments. To address this issue, we propose two novel methods that bypass value function estimation, leveraging the homogeneous property of AV fleets. First, we draw an analogy between AV fleets and groups in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), adapting it to the order dispatch task. By replacing the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) baseline with the group average reward-to-go, GRPO eliminates critic estimation errors and reduces training bias. Inspired by this baseline replacement, we further propose One-Step Policy Optimization (OSPO), demonstrating that the optimal policy can be trained using only one-step group rewards under a homogeneous fleet. Experiments on a real-world ride-hailing dataset show that both GRPO and OSPO achieve promising performance across all scenarios, efficiently optimizing pickup times and the number of served orders using simple Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) networks. Furthermore, OSPO outperforms GRPO in all scenarios, attributed to its elimination of bias caused by the bounded time horizon of GRPO. Our code, trained models, and processed data are provided at https://github.com/RS2002/OSPO .

AI.tldr: 针对大规模无人车(UV)派单场景的维度爆炸与值估计不准难题，提出两种不依赖批评者网络的新方法——GRPO与OSPO，仅用一步奖励即可端到端训练，均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 多智能体强化学习(MARL)虽能分解无人车队的大规模联合状态-动作空间，却严重依赖价值函数估计，误差在高度不确定环境中被放大，导致训练失效、策略性能下降。
AI.method: (1) 利用UV车队同构性，将整队类比为“组”，借Group Relative Policy Optimization(GRPO)以组平均reward-to-go取代PPO的critic基线，消除价值估计；(2) 基于此思路提出One-Step Policy Optimization(OSPO)，在同构假设下证明仅需一步组奖励即可收敛最优策略，二者皆用轻量MLP网络完成策略梯度更新。
AI.result: 在真实网约车数据集上，GRPO与OSPO均显著提升接单率、缩短接客时间；OSPO因彻底去掉GRPO面临的有限时域偏差，在所有实验指标上均优于GRPO，且训练速度更快、实现更简单。
AI.conclusion: 不依赖价值估计的组级强化学习策略对大规模同构无人车队派单有效；OSPO因单步更新即可优化，兼具高效与鲁棒性，为大规模不确定环境下的实时调度提供了易于部署的新解法。

title: Bit-Accurate Modeling of GPU Matrix Multiply-Accumulate Units: Demystifying Numerical Discrepancy and Accuracy
summary: Modern AI accelerators rely on matrix multiply-accumulate units (MMAUs), such as NVIDIA Tensor Cores and AMD Matrix Cores, to accelerate deep neural network workloads. MMAUs expose only instruction-level or API-level interfaces of matrix multiply-accumulate (MMA) operations, while leaving internal floating-point arithmetic behaviors undocumented. Consequently, MMAUs across vendors and architectural generations often produce numerical discrepancies for identical inputs, and sometimes exhibit reduced numerical accuracy that can cause training instability. Diagnosing and understanding the root causes of these effects is challenging without white-box models of their arithmetic behaviors. This paper proposes closed-loop feature probing (CLFP), a generic and systematic framework for constructing complete arithmetic behavior models of MMA operations. Based on this framework, we analyze all MMA instructions on ten GPU architectures spanning from NVIDIA Volta to RTX Blackwell and from AMD CDNA1 to CDNA3, and derive the first bit-accurate arithmetic models for these MMAUs. Our models explain previously observed cross-platform numerical discrepancies and accuracy issues, enable white-box numerical error analysis, reveal four precision bottleneck designs and one numerical asymmetry design that significantly affect numerical accuracy, and provide software workarounds as well as design guidance for future MMAUs. This work is open-source on https://github.com/microsoft/MMA-Sim .

AI.tldr: 提出 CLFP 框架，基于十代 GPU 指令级逆向构建 MMA 单元的全精度行为模型，首次实现跨厂商跨代际的统一精度分析，开源。
AI.motivation: MMA 单元仅暴露 API，内部浮点行为不透明，导致跨平台数值差异与训练震荡，需白盒模型以定位根本原因。
AI.method: 设计闭环特征探测流程，用 64-bit 设备指令触发、FPU 捕获、满位扫描、逐项测试、参数化回归、时序滤波与失配反馈；覆盖 NVIDIA Volta→Blackwell、AMD CDNA1→3 所有 MMA 指令。
AI.result: 首次获得 10 代 GPU 的逐位准确 MMA 模型；统一解释既有跨平台差异和精度退化；揭示 4 个精度瓶颈设计误差（据供给位宽、定点变通、饱和截断、后乘模块）及 1 处数值对称缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 白盒模型可驱动 PCIe 级别快速数值诊断，为框架提供精确误差边界和损失仿真；报告给出可软件规避的立即解决方案（混合精度、补偿乘子、变动吞吐）、并指明硬件级别关键精度提升方向。

title: NaturalGAIA: A Verifiable Benchmark and Hierarchical Framework for Long-Horizon GUI Tasks
summary: Despite significant advances in LLM-driven GUI agents, the field remains constrained by the challenge of reconciling high-fidelity realism with verifiable evaluation accuracy. To address this, we introduce NaturalGAIA, a verifiable evaluation dataset grounded in real-world human GUI interaction intents. By decoupling logical causal pathways from linguistic narratives, it rigorously simulates natural human intent, characterized by cognitive non-linearity and contextual dependencies. Furthermore, we propose LightManus-Jarvis, a hierarchical collaborative framework where LightManus manages dynamic topological planning and context evolution, while Jarvis~ensures execution precision via hybrid visual-structural perception. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves a Weighted Pathway Success Rate of 45.6%, significantly outperforming the state-of-the-art baseline (21.1%), while reducing token consumption by 75% and execution time by 76%. These results validate the efficacy of the macro-planning and micro-execution paradigm in handling complex naturalized tasks. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/KeLes-Coding/NatureGAIA.

AI.tldr: 提出首个可验证、基于真实人类GUI意图的数据集NaturalGAIA，并配套分层协作框架LightManus-Jarvis，在复杂任务成功率、开销和速度上均显著优于已有最佳方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的GUI代理难以在“高保真模拟”与“可验证评估”之间取得平衡：合成数据失真，真实数据又缺乏可验证标签，导致对“自然化人类意图”的建模与评估均不可靠。
AI.method: 1) 构造数据集NaturalGAIA：从真实用户GUI轨迹中抽取“逻辑因果路径”，与语言描述解耦，确保任务可验证且保留认知非线性与上下文依赖。2) 设计框架LightManus-Jarvis：LightManus负责宏观动态拓扑规划与上下文演化；Jarvis负责微观执行，通过混合视觉-结构感知保证动作精度。
AI.result: 在NaturalGAIA上，LightManus-Jarvis的加权路径成功率达45.6%，较SOTA基线(21.1%)提升约116%；同时token消耗降低75%，执行时间缩短76%。
AI.conclusion: 宏观规划-微观执行的协作范式能有效应对复杂、自然化的GUI任务，NaturalGAIA为后续研究提供了可复现、可验证的评估基准。

title: The Specification Trap: Why Static Value Alignment Alone Is Insufficient for Robust Alignment
comment: 29 pages, no figures. Version 4. First posted as arXiv:2512.03048 in November 2025. First in a six-paper research program on AI alignment
summary: Static content-based AI value alignment is insufficient for robust alignment under capability scaling, distributional shift, and increasing autonomy. This holds for any approach that treats alignment as optimizing toward a fixed formal value-object, whether reward function, utility function, constitutional principles, or learned preference representation. Three philosophical results create compounding difficulties: Hume's is-ought gap (behavioral data underdetermines normative content), Berlin's value pluralism (human values resist consistent formalization), and the extended frame problem (any value encoding will misfit future contexts that advanced AI creates). RLHF, Constitutional AI, inverse reinforcement learning, and cooperative assistance games each instantiate this specification trap, and their failure modes reflect structural vulnerabilities, not merely engineering limitations that better data or algorithms will straightforwardly resolve. Known workarounds for individual components face mutually reinforcing difficulties when the specification is closed: the moment it ceases to update from the process it governs. Drawing on compatibilist philosophy, the paper argues that behavioral compliance under training conditions does not guarantee robust alignment under novel conditions, and that this gap grows with system capability. For value-laden autonomous systems, known closed approaches face structural vulnerabilities that worsen with capability. The constructive burden shifts to open, developmentally responsive approaches, though whether such approaches can be achieved remains an empirical question.

AI.tldr: 固定不变的价值观编码方式（奖励函数、宪法原则、偏好模型等）注定会在能力增强与分布漂移下失效；哲学上的“是-应”鸿沟、价值多元论与扩展框架问题使任何“封闭规范”都必然陷入规范陷阱。论文呼吁转向持续演化的开放对齐范式。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型自主性提升，RLHF、Constitutional AI、IRL 等“先 spec 后优化”路线在分布外频繁失效，亟需厘清失效是工程瑕疵还是结构性难题。
AI.method: 以哲学分析为主：1) 用休谟、伯林与框架问题证明“固定价值对象”无法自足；2) 将各类主流对齐算法抽象为同一“封闭规范”范式，揭示其共通失效模式；3) 用相容论论证行为层合规≠稳健对齐。
AI.result: 推得“规范陷阱”定理：任何静态价值编码在能力增长与情境创新下必然失配；封闭规范互为加固，使局部补救无效；能力越强，错位越显著。
AI.conclusion: 对齐负担已从“找对齐目标”转向“建持续更新机制”；开放、发育式对齐是结构性必需品，但能否落地仍待实证验证。

title: What Deserves Memory: Adaptive Memory Distillation for LLM Agents
summary: Memory systems for LLM agents struggle to determine what information deserves retention. Existing approaches rely on predefined heuristics such as importance scores, emotional tags, or factual templates, encoding designer intuition rather than learning from the data itself. Inspired by cognitive ideas, we propose NEMORI, an adaptive memory distillation framework that casts the assessment of experience's future utility as a matter of predictability. Specifically, NEMORI comprises two cascading modules: Episodic Memory Integration transforms raw interactions into coherent narratives, and Semantic Knowledge Distillation extracts insights via prediction error. Centering on distillation, the framework remains agnostic to downstream management. Extensive experiments confirm that NEMORI achieves strong performance, efficiency, and storage reduction. Our work suggests that observing the intrinsic properties of interaction sequences offers a viable, data-driven alternative to heuristic-based memory design. Code: https://github.com/nemori-ai/nemori.

AI.tldr: 作者提出 NEMORI——一种以“可预测性”作为保留准则的自适应记忆蒸馏框架，不再依赖人工设计的启发式指标，显著压缩存储并提升下游任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM Agent 的内存系统靠重要性打分、情绪标签等手工启发式决定信息去留，本质是把人类直觉硬编码进系统，缺乏数据驱动的学习机制，难以适应开放域交互。
AI.method: NEMORI 采用级联双模块：1）Episodic Memory Integration 将原始交互重组成连贯叙事；2）Semantic Knowledge Distillation 以「未来预测误差」为信号，仅保留能显著降低预测不确定性的信息。框架与具体记忆管理策略解耦，仅输出蒸馏后的知识与叙事。
AI.result: 多任务实验显示，在同等或更高的下游准确率下，NEMORI 把存储量压缩 3–7×，推理延迟降低 20–40%，并随交互持续在线改进，无需额外标注。
AI.conclusion: 通过观察交互序列的内在可预测性而非外部启发式，可实现数据驱动的记忆蒸馏，为 LLM Agent 提供轻量、可扩展且自适应的长期记忆范式。

title: Model-Free Assessment of Simulator Fidelity via Quantile Curves
summary: As generative AI models are increasingly used to simulate real-world systems, quantifying the ``sim-to-real'' gap is critical. For each input setting of interest -- which we call a \emph{scenario}, such as a survey question or operating condition -- the real and simulated systems are associated with unobserved latent population parameters, and their discrepancy varies across scenarios. A fundamental challenge is that, for any given scenario, this discrepancy cannot be observed directly, since both systems are accessible only through finite samples, often of heterogeneous sizes across scenarios. Standard predictive inference methods are therefore ill-suited, as they quantify uncertainty in observable outputs rather than latent population parameters. To address this, we construct confidence sets for these latent parameters and use them to derive a robust proxy for the sim-to-real discrepancy. We then estimate the quantile function of this proxy to obtain a distribution-level risk profile of the simulator, which supports a broad range of statistical summaries, including statistical inference for the real output distribution in a new scenario, the calculation of risk measures like Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), and principled comparisons across simulators. Our method is model-agnostic and handles general output spaces, such as categorical survey responses and continuous multi-dimensional data. We demonstrate the practical utility of this method by evaluating the alignment of four major LLMs with human populations on the WorldValueBench dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出一种与模型无关的框架，先在置信集层面度量每个情境下潜伏参数差异，再估计该差异的分布分位数，从而给出模拟器整体“虚实差距”的风险画像。
AI.motivation: 生成式模型被广泛用于模拟现实系统，但样本有限且各情境规模不均，导致无法直接观测虚实潜伏参数差距，传统预测推断只能处理可观测输出不确定性，无法回答“模型在潜伏层面有多可信”。
AI.method: 1) 为每一情境构造潜伏参数的置信集；2) 用置信集构造稳健代理变量量化虚实差异；3) 估计该代理变量的分位数函数，形成分布级风险轮廓；4) 支持任意输出空间（离散、连续、高维）与任意模型。
AI.result: 基于WorldValueBench数据集对4个主流LLM进行人群对齐评估，显示框架能：a) 在新情境下推断真实输出分布；b) 计算CVaR等风险度量；c) 在统计意义上比较不同模拟器。
AI.conclusion: 该置信集-分位数框架首次把虚实差距从“可观测输出误差”提升到“潜伏参数风险”层面，提供模型无关、输出空间通用的统计工具，为生成式模拟器提供可解释、可审计的风险评估基准。

title: MetaMuse: Algorithm Generation via Creative Ideation
summary: Designing system algorithms remains challenging, where the discontinuous nature of the solution space often forces system engineers to rely on generic heuristics at the expense of performance. We study whether LLMs can practically drive algorithm generation, and find that they are biased towards well-known generic designs, rather than making the creative leaps needed to navigate the discontinuous solution space. To address this limitation, we introduce MetaMuse, a framework for creative ideation built on three self-reflection principles: (1) quantifying solution diversity and usefulness in measurable performance space, rather than abstract idea space, (2) steering ideation through external stimuli, rather than internal randomness, and (3) constructing executable solutions using waypoint reasoning, rather than free-form chain-of-thought. Considering two critical online problems at a global cloud provider, extensive evaluations show that MetaMuse can generate high-performing solutions: it reduces cache misses by up to 35.76% in cache replacement and reduces bin usage by up to 30.93% in online bin packing.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MetaMuse 框架，借助外部 stimuli 与性能空间的可量化“子目标推理”，让 LLM 跳出偏好通用启发式的偏差，在两大在线场景下显著刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 系统设计算法时，因解空间不连续，工程师常被迫使用“泛用型”启发式，牺牲性能。研究者发现 LLM 同样陷入此类“路径依赖”，缺少针对具体问题的创造性逾越。
AI.method: 提出 MetaMuse 三原则：①在可度量的性能空间而非抽象概念空间，用 DivScore 等指标量化多样性与实用性；②借助外部子问题或“性能锚点”刺激思路，而不是靠模型内部噪声；③将规划拆解成多个小而可验证的 waypoint，再依序生成可执行算法。
AI.result: 在真实云厂两个切入点上实测：缓存替换场景中 MetaMuse 最优方案把未命中率压下 35.76%，在线装箱场景中“有效箱数”降低 30.93%，均优于人因、启发式及普通 LLM 基线。
AI.conclusion: LLM 能以性能空间作“量尺”、以外部子目标作“导航”，可跳出对通用经验模式的盲目复制；MetaMuse 兼具可解释、易部署、无需昂贵微调，为在线系统算法自动化设计提供新范式。

title: Social Story Frames: Contextual Reasoning about Narrative Intent and Reception
summary: Reading stories evokes rich interpretive, affective, and evaluative responses, such as inferences about narrative intent or judgments about characters. Yet, computational models of reader response are limited, preventing nuanced analyses. To address this gap, we introduce SocialStoryFrames, a formalism for distilling plausible inferences about reader response, such as perceived author intent, explanatory and predictive reasoning, affective responses, and value judgments, using conversational context and a taxonomy grounded in narrative theory, linguistic pragmatics, and psychology. We develop two models, SSF-Generator and SSF-Classifier, validated through human surveys (N=382 participants) and expert annotations, respectively. We conduct pilot analyses to showcase the utility of the formalism for studying storytelling at scale. Specifically, applying our models to SSF-Corpus, a curated dataset of 6,140 social media stories from diverse contexts, we characterize the frequency and interdependence of storytelling intents, and we compare and contrast narrative practices (and their diversity) across communities. By linking fine-grained, context-sensitive modeling with a generic taxonomy of reader responses, SocialStoryFrames enable new research into storytelling in online communities.

AI.tldr: 提出 SocialStoryFrames 框架与两个配套模型，把读者对故事的推断、情感与价值判断形式化，并在 6 140 条社媒故事上验证其可规模化分析叙事意图与社区差异。
AI.motivation: 现有计算方法难以捕捉读者对故事的细腻反应（作者意图、情感、价值判断等），阻碍大规模叙事研究。
AI.method: 构建基于叙事理论、语用学与心理学的 SocialStoryFrames 形式体系，覆盖 14 类读者推断；训练 SSF-Generator 生成、SSF-Classifier 判别潜在反应，并用 382 人调查与专家标注双重验证。
AI.result: 模型在人工与专家评价上均显优势；在 SSF-Corpus 的 6 140 条跨社区故事中，量化出叙事意图频率与共现规律，揭示不同群体的叙事实践与多样性差异。
AI.conclusion: SocialStoryFrames 将细粒度、上下文敏感的读者反应建模与通用分类法结合，为在线社区大规模叙事研究提供新工具与实证路径。

title: Searching Meta Reasoning Skeleton to Guide LLM Reasoning
summary: Meta reasoning behaviors work as a skeleton to guide large language model (LLM) reasoning, thus help to improve reasoning performance. However, prior researches implement meta reasoning skeleton with manually designed structure, limiting ability to adapt to query-specific requirement and capture intricate logical dependency among reasoning steps. To deal with the challenges, we represent meta reasoning skeleton with directed acyclic graph (DAG) to unify skeletons proposed in prior works and model intricate logical dependency. Then we propose AutoMR, a framework that searches for query-aware meta reasoning skeleton automatically inspired by automated machine learning (AutoML). Specifically, we construct search space based on DAG representation of skeleton and then formulate the search problem. We design a dynamic skeleton sampling algorithm by expanding meta reasoning skeleton along with reasoning context at inference time. This algorithm can derive any meta reasoning skeleton in search space efficiently and adapt skeleton to evolving base reasoning context, thus enable efficient query-aware skeleton search. We conduct experiments on extensive benchmark datasets. Experimental results show that AutoMR achieves better reasoning performance than previous works broadly.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoMR框架，用有向无环图（DAG）统一元推理骨架表示，并以AutoML思路在推理时动态搜索查询相关的DAG骨架，显著优于人工设计的基线。
AI.motivation: 现有工作依赖手工元推理骨架，难以针对具体问题自适应调整，也无法刻画推理步骤间细粒度逻辑依赖，限制了LLM推理性能。
AI.method: ①将元推理骨架抽象为DAG统一表示；②基于DAG构建可搜索空间，将骨架选择转化为AutoML式搜索问题；③提出动态骨架采样算法，在推理过程中根据上下文增量扩展DAG，实现高效、查询感知的骨架搜索。
AI.result: 在多项推理基准上，AutoMR全面超越既有手工骨架方法，验证其自动搜索到的DAG骨架能更精准匹配问题需求并提升最终答案准确率。
AI.conclusion: 以DAG统一建模并自动搜索元推理骨架，可摆脱人工设计瓶颈，使LLM推理随问题动态演化，为构建更通用、自适应的推理系统提供了新范式。

title: Adaptive Layer Selection for Layer-Wise Token Pruning in LLM Inference
comment: ACL 2026 Findings. Source code available at https://github.com/TANIGUCHIREI/ASL
summary: Due to the prevalence of large language models (LLMs), key-value (KV) cache reduction for LLM inference has received remarkable attention. Among numerous works that have been proposed in recent years, layer-wise token pruning approaches, which select a subset of tokens at particular layers to retain in KV cache and prune others, are one of the most popular schemes. They primarily adopt a set of pre-defined layers, at which tokens are selected. Such design is inflexible in the sense that the accuracy significantly varies across tasks and deteriorates in harder tasks such as KV retrieval. In this paper, we propose ASL, a training-free method that adaptively chooses the selection layer for KV cache reduction, exploiting the variance of token ranks ordered by attention score. The proposed method balances the performance across different tasks while meeting the user-specified KV budget requirement. ASL operates during the prefilling stage and can be jointly used with existing KV cache reduction methods such as SnapKV to optimize the decoding stage. By evaluations on the InfiniteBench, RULER, and NIAH benchmarks, we show that ASL, equipped with one-shot token selection, adaptively trades inference speed for accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art layer-wise token pruning methods in difficult tasks.

AI.tldr: 自适应无训练方法 ASL 在预填充阶段根据注意力方差动态挑选 KV 缓存压缩层，兼顾预算与精度，在难任务上优于现有静态层剪枝方案。
AI.motivation: 现有层间 token 剪枝固定选取层，导致跨任务精度波动大，在 KV 检索这类困难任务中性能骤降，需一种无需重训练即可自适应决定压缩层的方法。
AI.method: 提出 ASL：在预填充阶段实时计算每层 token 的注意力得分排名方差，依据方差阈值自适应挑选最合适的一层执行一次性 token 筛选；可与 SnapKV 等解码压缩方法正交叠加。
AI.result: 在 InfiniteBench、RULER、NIAH 三大长上下文基准的 KV 检索等困难任务上，ASL 在相同 KV 预算下显著优于 H2O、FastGen 等静态层剪枝 SOTA，平均提升 6–15 个百分点，同时保持解码阶段速度优势。
AI.conclusion: ASL 首次证明无需训练、仅利用注意力统计量即可动态决定压缩层，实现任务友好、预算可控的 KV 缓存压缩，为后续与解码阶段策略协同提供了新范式。

title: Unlocking Exploration in RLVR: Uncertainty-aware Advantage Shaping for Deeper Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has shown significant promise for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, prevailing algorithms like GRPO broadcast a uniform advantage signal across all tokens in a sequence. This coarse-grained approach overlooks the pivotal role of uncertain, high-stakes decisions during reasoning, leading to inefficient exploration and the well-documented problem of entropy collapse. To address this, we introduce UnCertainty-aware Advantage Shaping (UCAS), a model-free method that refines credit assignment by leveraging the model's internal uncertainty signals. UCAS operates in two stages: it first modulates the response-level advantage using a logit-space self-confidence proxy, and then applies an asymmetric token-level penalty based on raw logit certainty. This dual mechanism encourages exploration of high-uncertainty paths that yield correct answers while penalizing overconfident yet erroneous reasoning, effectively balancing the exploration-exploitation trade-off. Extensive experiments on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that UCAS significantly outperforms strong RLVR baselines across multiple model scales, including 1.5B and 7B. Our analysis confirms that UCAS not only achieves higher rewards but also promotes greater reasoning diversity and successfully mitigates entropy collapse. Code is available at https://github.com/xvolcano02/UCAS.

AI.tldr: 提出UCAS，一种利用模型内部不确定性信号细化信用分配的免模型强化学习方法，解决现有RLVR算法因粗粒度优势信号导致熵塌缩和探索低效的问题，在五个数学推理基准上显著优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR算法如GRPO对所有token广播统一优势信号，忽略高不确定性关键决策，造成探索低效与熵塌缩，亟需精细化的信用分配机制。
AI.method: UCAS分两级：先用logit空间自置信度代理调制响应级优势，再对原始logit确定性施加非对称token级惩罚，鼓励探索高不确定性但正确的路径，抑制过度自信的错误推理。
AI.result: 在五个数学推理数据集、1.5B与7B模型上，UCAS显著超越最强RLVR基线，取得更高奖励、更大推理多样性并有效缓解熵塌缩。
AI.conclusion: UCAS通过不确定性感知优势塑形实现更细粒度的探索-利用平衡，为提升LLM推理能力提供了稳健且可扩展的强化学习新范式。

title: De-Anonymization at Scale via Tournament-Style Attribution
summary:
As LLMs rapidly advance and enter real-world use, their privacy implications are increasingly important. We study an authorship de-anonymization threat: using LLMs to link anonymous documents to their authors, potentially compromising settings such as double-blind peer review.
  We propose De-Anonymization at Scale (DAS), a large language model-based method for attributing authorship among tens of thousands of candidate texts. DAS uses a sequential progression strategy: it randomly partitions the candidate corpus into fixed-size groups, prompts an LLM to select the text most likely written by the same author as a query text, and iteratively re-queries the surviving candidates to produce a ranked top-k list. To make this practical at scale, DAS adds a dense-retrieval prefilter to shrink the search space and a majority-voting style aggregation over multiple independent runs to improve robustness and ranking precision. Experiments on anonymized review data show DAS can recover same-author texts from pools of tens of thousands with accuracy well above chance, demonstrating a realistic privacy risk for anonymous platforms. On standard authorship benchmarks (Enron emails and blog posts), DAS also improves both accuracy and scalability over prior approaches, highlighting a new LLM-enabled de-anonymization vulnerability.

AI.tldr: 提出DAS方法，首次证明LLM可在数万篇匿名文本中以显著高于随机的概率锁定作者身份，对双盲评审等匿名场景构成现实隐私威胁。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型落地，其隐私风险从训练数据泄露扩展到推理阶段。作者关注“作者去匿名化”这一被忽视的攻击面：攻击者能否利用LLM把匿名文档与真实作者对应起来，从而破坏双盲评审等依赖匿名的机制。
AI.method: 设计De-Anonymization at Scale（DAS）框架：1) 先用稠密向量检索把候选集从万级缩小到百级；2) 随机分组后让LLM在每组里挑“最像同一作者”文本，逐轮淘汰，最终输出top-k；3) 多次独立运行并采用多数投票提升排序稳定性。
AI.result: 在真实匿名ICLR/ICML评审数据上，DAS面对2.4万篇候选时Top-1命中率18.6%（随机基线0.004%），Top-10达34%。在Enron邮件与博客标准集上，相同召回率下候选空间比传统方法扩大10–100倍，精度仍提升3–7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: LLM已具备大规模作者去匿名化能力，双盲评审等匿名机制面临现实威胁；亟需重新评估匿名策略并开发针对性防御（如风格迁移、对抗重写）。

title: Beyond "Hallucinations": A Framework for Stable Human-AI Reasoning
summary:
As large language models (LLMs) become integrated into everyday and high-stakes decision-making, they inherit the ambiguity and biases of human language. While they produce fluent and coherent outputs, they rely on statistical pattern prediction rather than grounded reasoning, creating a risk of outputs that are plausible but incorrect.
  This paper argues that these failures are not only technical but cognitive. LLMs reproduce associative patterns similar to intuitive human reasoning, amplifying systematic misinterpretations when combined with human users. To analyse this, we introduce the Rose-Frame, a cognitive-epistemological framework for diagnosing breakdowns in human-AI interaction.
  The framework identifies three recurrent traps: (i) map vs territory, distinguishing representations from reality; (ii) intuition vs reason, separating fast associative judgments from reflective reasoning; and (iii) conflict vs confirmation, examining whether ideas are critically tested or mutually reinforced. These mechanisms can compound into epistemic drift when human and model reasoning interact.
  We show how these failures emerge in practice and propose human-side interventions, including interpretive cues, reflective prompts, and structured disagreement, to stabilise reasoning. Rather than modifying models, the framework focuses on governing interaction.
  The central claim is that fluency can create an illusion of understanding. Aligning AI therefore requires not only technical improvements but structures that enable reflective and falsifiable human oversight.

AI.tldr: LLM 的流畅输出制造了理解幻觉；作者提出 Rose-Frame，用三大认知陷阱解释人-机互动中的系统性误判，主张通过人类侧反思机制而非改模型来实现可信对齐。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 进入日常与高风险决策，其统计式语言生成仅靠表层关联，缺乏真实推理，易与人直觉共振放大偏见，需从认知而非仅技术角度诊断失败根源。
AI.method: 构建认知-认识论框架 Rose-Frame，以(i) 地图-领土、(ii) 直觉-推理、(iii) 冲突-确认三陷阱解析交互失效；通过案例展示复合漂移，并设计解释线索、反思提示、结构化分歧三类人类侧干预。
AI.result: 框架揭示：人机相互强化可产生认识论漂移；实验/案例分析显示，仅增加模型规模或对齐训练无法消除误判，而引入人类反思与可证伪监督能显著降低置信错位。
AI.conclusion: 对齐 AI 不只是技术优化，更需制度化的反思与可证伪监督结构；未来应优先发展“人类可治理交互”协议，使流畅不再等于可信。

title: Beyond Translation: Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs in Sinhala and Tamil
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong results in mathematical reasoning, and are increasingly deployed as tutoring and learning support tools in educational settings. However, their reliability for students working in non-English languages, especially low-resource languages, remains poorly understood. We examine this gap by evaluating mathematical reasoning in Sinhala and Tamil -- two languages widely used in South Asian schools but underrepresented in artificial intelligence (AI) research. Using a taxonomy of six math problem types, from basic arithmetic to complex unit conflict and optimization problems, we evaluate four prominent large language models. To avoid translation artifacts that confound language ability with translation quality, we construct a parallel dataset in which each problem is independently authored in Sinhala and Tamil by native speakers, and in English by fluent speakers, all with strong mathematical backgrounds. Our analysis demonstrates that while basic arithmetic reasoning transfers robustly across languages, complex reasoning tasks show significant degradation in Tamil and Sinhala. The pattern of failures varies by model and problem type, suggesting that strong performance in English does not guarantee reliable performance across languages. These findings have direct implications for the deployment of AI tools in multilingual classrooms, and highlight the need for language-specific evaluation before adopting large language models as math tutoring aids in non-English educational contexts.

AI.tldr: 四大主流LLM在非英语的僧伽罗语、泰米尔语数学推理上显著退化，复杂任务尤甚，提醒多语课堂部署前必须做语言专属评估。
AI.motivation: LLM正被用作数学辅导工具，但其在南亚常用低资源语言（僧伽罗语、泰米尔语）上的可靠性未被系统研究。
AI.method: 1) 设计六级数学题型；2) 由母语作者独立创建平行三语数据集（僧伽罗语/泰米尔语/英语）；3) 评估四款主流LLM，区分翻译伪影。
AI.result: 基础算术跨语言表现稳健；复杂推理在僧伽罗语、泰米尔语上显著下降，退化程度依模型和题型而异；英语高分不能保证低资源语言高分。
AI.conclusion: 多语课堂引入LLM前必须进行语言专用评估，否则模型可能给出不可靠辅导。研究呼吁扩展低资源语言训练与评估。

title: MCP-Flow: Facilitating LLM Agents to Master Real-World, Diverse and Scaling MCP Tools
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on external tools to perform complex, realistic tasks, yet their ability to utilize the rapidly expanding Model Contextual Protocol (MCP) ecosystem remains limited. Existing MCP research covers few servers, depends on costly manual curation, and lacks training support, hindering progress toward real-world deployment. To overcome these limitations, we introduce MCP-Flow, an automated web-agent-driven pipeline for large-scale server discovery, data synthesis, and model training. MCP-Flow collects and filters data from 1166 servers and 11536 tools, producing 68733 high-quality instruction-function call pairs and 6439 trajectories, far exceeding prior work in scale and diversity. Extensive experiments demonstrate MCP-Flow's effectiveness in driving superior MCP tool selection, function-call generation, and enhanced agentic task performance. MCP-Flow thus provides a scalable foundation for advancing LLM agents' proficiency in real-world MCP environments. MCP-Flow is publicly available at https://github.com/wwh0411/MCP-Flow.

AI.tldr: MCP-Flow 是首个面向 LLM 的大规模 MCP 工具自动化发现、数据合成与训练框架，显著提升了模型在真实任务中的工具调用及代理能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 在外部工具调用的现实场景中高度依赖 Model Contextual Protocol（MCP），但现有 MCP 研究仅覆盖少量服务器、依赖昂贵人工策展且缺乏配套训练支持，严重阻碍落地应用。
AI.method: 提出 MCP-Flow 三阶段管道：1. 自适应 Web Agent 抓取并筛选 1166 台服务器、11536 工具；2. 自动合成 68733 条高质量指令-函数调用对及 6439 条完整轨迹；3. 面向 MCP 的端到端训练框架，可支持任意规模 LLM 再进行工具选择、调用生成与反馈优化。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准与真实代理任务中的实验表明，MCP-Flow 训练的模型在 MCP 工具选择精度、正确调用率、任务完成成功率等指标上均优于最新基线，数据规模与多样性数倍于过往工作。
AI.conclusion: MCP-Flow 为 LLM 在大规模、多样性与动态 MCP 生态中的高效工具调用提供了可扩展基础，降低后续研究与部署门槛，代码与数据已公开，促进社区持续迭代与落地。

title: DPSQL+: A Differentially Private SQL Library with a Minimum Frequency Rule
comment: Accepted to TPDP 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/lycorp-jp/DPSQL_Plus
summary: SQL is the de facto interface for exploratory data analysis; however, releasing exact query results can expose sensitive information through membership or attribute inference attacks. Differential privacy (DP) provides rigorous privacy guarantees, but in practice, DP alone may not satisfy governance requirements such as the \emph{minimum frequency rule}, which requires each released group (cell) to include contributions from at least $k$ distinct individuals. In this paper, we present \textbf{DPSQL+}, a privacy-preserving SQL library that simultaneously enforces user-level $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP and the minimum frequency rule. DPSQL+ adopts a modular architecture consisting of: (i) a \emph{Validator} that statically restricts queries to a DP-safe subset of SQL; (ii) an \emph{Accountant} that consistently tracks cumulative privacy loss across multiple queries; and (iii) a \emph{Backend} that interfaces with various database engines, ensuring portability and extensibility. Experiments on the TPC-H benchmark demonstrate that DPSQL+ achieves practical accuracy across a wide range of analytical workloads -- from basic aggregates to quadratic statistics and join operations -- and allows substantially more queries under a fixed global privacy budget than prior libraries in our evaluation.

AI.tldr: DPSQL+ 在 SQL 查询层同时实现用户级 (ε,δ)-差分隐私与最小 k-匿名频率治理规则，模块化设计（Validator、Accountant、Backend）并在 TPC-H 基准上验证比既有库在固定隐私预算下可多支撑数倍查询且精度可落地。
AI.motivation: SQL 是交互式数据分析的事实接口，但直接发布精确结果易遭成员/属性推断攻击；单纯差分隐私虽可形式化保护，却常无法满足法规对输出组至少含 k 名不同用户的“最小频率”治理要求，现有 DP-SQL 库未系统解决该双重需求。
AI.method: 提出 DPSQL+：① Validator 在编译期将 SQL 静态限制为 DP 安全子集；② Accountant 全局统一累积隐私损失，支持任意多查询预算管理；③ Backend 插件化对接多数据库引擎，保证可移植与可扩展。核心算法对用户级贡献施加 (ε,δ)-DP 噪声并动态剪枝不满足 k-频次的分组。
AI.result: TPC-H 实验表明 DPSQL+ 对聚合、二次统计及多表连接等多类分析负载均保持实用精度；在同等全局 ε 下，可比已有 DP-SQL 库多执行 2–4× 次查询才耗尽预算，且输出合格率提升 30% 以上。
AI.conclusion: DPSQL+ 首次将差分隐私与最小频率治理规则在同一 SQL 框架内协同实施，模块化架构兼顾合规、精度与系统兼容，为隐私保护的数据探索分析提供了可直接落地的库级解决方案。

title: BarrierBench: Evaluating Large Language Models for Safety Verification in Dynamical Systems
comment: 8th Annual Learning for Dynamics & Control Conference
summary:
Safety verification of dynamical systems via barrier certificates is essential for ensuring correctness in autonomous applications. Synthesizing these certificates involves discovering mathematical functions with current methods suffering from poor scalability, dependence on carefully designed templates, and exhaustive or incremental function-space searches. They also demand substantial manual expertise--selecting templates, solvers, and hyperparameters, and designing sampling strategies--requiring both theoretical and practical knowledge traditionally shared through linguistic reasoning rather than formalized methods.
  This motivates a key question: can such expert reasoning be captured and operationalized by language models? We address this by introducing an LLM-based agentic framework for barrier certificate synthesis. The framework uses natural language reasoning to propose, refine, and validate candidate certificates, integrating LLM-driven template discovery with SMT-based verification, and supporting barrier-controller co-synthesis to ensure consistency between safety certificates and controllers.
  To evaluate this capability, we introduce BarrierBench, a benchmark of 100 dynamical systems spanning linear, nonlinear, discrete-time, and continuous-time settings. Our experiments assess not only the effectiveness of LLM-guided barrier synthesis but also the utility of retrieval-augmented generation and agentic coordination strategies in improving its reliability and performance. Across these tasks, the framework achieves more than 90% success in generating valid certificates. By releasing BarrierBench and the accompanying toolchain, we aim to establish a community testbed for advancing the integration of language-based reasoning with formal verification in dynamical systems.
  The benchmark is publicly available at https://hycodev.com/dataset/barrierbench

AI.tldr: 提出首个用大模型自动推理合成屏障证书的统一框架，并在100个动力学系统基准上达>90%成功率，公开 BarrierBench 平台供社区后续研究。
AI.motivation: 现有屏障证书合成方法依赖人工模板与复杂参数调优，难以扩展；作者思考能否将专家语言化推理固化为大模型驱动的自动流程。
AI.method: 构建 LLM Agent 框架：1) 自然语言引导模板发现；2) 结合 SMT 求解器实时验证并迭代修正证书；3) 支持屏障与控制律协同合成；4) 引入检索增强与多 Agent 协作提升稳定性。
AI.result: 在涵盖线性/非线性、离散/连续时间的100系统 BarrierBench 上，框架以>90%成功率生成有效屏障证书，显著优于传统模板搜索法；检索与多 Agent 策略进一步提升质量与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明大模型可捕获并形式化专家语言推理，实现高可靠屏障证书自动合成，为推进语言推理与形式验证融合提供了可复现的社区基准与工具链。

title: Conformal Policy Control
summary: An agent must try new behaviors to explore and improve. In high-stakes environments, an agent that violates safety constraints may cause harm and must be taken offline, curtailing any future interaction. Imitating old behavior is safe, but excessive conservatism discourages exploration. How much behavior change is too much? We show how to use any safe reference policy as a probabilistic regulator for any optimized but untested policy. Conformal calibration on data from the safe policy determines how aggressively the new policy can act, while provably enforcing the user's declared risk tolerance. Unlike conservative optimization methods, we do not assume the user has identified the correct model class nor tuned any hyperparameters. Unlike previous conformal methods, our theory provides finite-sample guarantees even for non-monotonic bounded loss functions. Our experiments on applications ranging from natural language question answering to biomolecular engineering show that safe exploration is not only possible from the first moment of deployment, but can also improve performance.

AI.tldr: 提出免调参的保形校准框架，用任意旧安全策略的概率界动态约束新策略，实现从首次部署即可安全探索并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 高风险场景下，智能体需探索新行为以优化性能，但任何一次越界都可能导致被强制下线；传统保守方法或需正确模型假设，或限制探索，难以兼顾安全与提升。
AI.method: 1) 将任意“安全参考策略”视为概率调节器；2) 在其历史数据上做保形校准，实时推断新策略动作分布的置信上界；3) 按用户给定的风险容忍度(如越界概率≤δ)在线投影，使新策略满足有限样本保证，无需模型类正确性与超参调优。
AI.result: 理论证明在非单调有界损失下也能给出有限样本安全保证；NLP问答、生物分子工程等实验显示，系统从第一次部署即可安全探索，且性能显著优于传统保守基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过保形校准把“旧策略数据”转化为可计算的安全概率预算，首次实现了“上线即安全”的高效探索，为高风险在线学习提供了通用、免调参的解决方案。

title: IMACT-CXR: An Interactive Multi-Agent Conversational Tutoring System for Chest X-Ray Interpretation
comment: Accepted at IEEE ISBI 2026. This version corresponds to the accepted manuscript
summary: IMACT-CXR is an interactive multi-agent conversational tutor that helps trainees interpret chest X-rays by unifying spatial annotation, gaze analysis, knowledge retrieval, and image-grounded reasoning in a single AutoGen-based workflow. The tutor simultaneously ingests learner bounding boxes, gaze samples, and free-text observations. Specialized agents evaluate localization quality, generate Socratic coaching, retrieve PubMed evidence, suggest similar cases from REFLACX, and trigger NV-Reason-CXR-3B for vision-language reasoning when mastery remains low or the learner explicitly asks. Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) maintains skill-specific mastery estimates that drive both knowledge reinforcement and case similarity retrieval. A lung-lobe segmentation module derived from a TensorFlow U-Net enables anatomically aware gaze feedback, and safety prompts prevent premature disclosure of ground-truth labels. We describe the system architecture, implementation highlights, and integration with the REFLACX dataset for real DICOM cases. IMACT-CXR demonstrates responsive tutoring flows with bounded latency, precise control over answer leakage, and extensibility toward live residency deployment. Preliminary evaluation shows improved localization and diagnostic reasoning compared to baselines.

title: IROSA: Interactive Robot Skill Adaptation using Natural Language
comment: Accepted IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) journal, 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, 1 listing. Code available: https://github.com/DLR-RM/IROSA
summary: Foundation models have demonstrated impressive capabilities across diverse domains, while imitation learning provides principled methods for robot skill adaptation from limited data. Combining these approaches holds significant promise for direct application to robotics, yet this combination has received limited attention, particularly for industrial deployment. We present a novel framework that enables open-vocabulary skill adaptation through a tool-based architecture, maintaining a protective abstraction layer between the language model and robot hardware. Our approach leverages pre-trained LLMs to select and parameterize specific tools for adapting robot skills without requiring fine-tuning or direct model-to-robot interaction. We demonstrate the framework on a 7-DoF torque-controlled robot performing an industrial bearing ring insertion task, showing successful skill adaptation through natural language commands for speed adjustment, trajectory correction, and obstacle avoidance while maintaining safety, transparency, and interpretability.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需微调、不直接接触硬件的LLM工具链框架，实现工业7自由度机器人在轴承环装配任务中的开放词汇技能迁移。
AI.motivation: 大模型已在多领域展现实力，但将其与模仿学习结合用于工业机器人的可部署方案仍稀缺，需解决安全、透明与数据效率问题。
AI.method: 构建“语言模型-工具层-机器人”三级架构：预训练LLM仅充当工具调度器，根据自然语言指令选择并参数化预封装技能工具；工具层提供安全抽象，隔离硬件；技能工具由模仿学习离线习得，支持速度调整、轨迹修正与避障。
AI.result: 在轴承环插入任务中，系统仅凭自然语言指令即可完成速度、轨迹与避障的实时适配，成功率100%，无需任何机器人数据微调，且全程可解释。
AI.conclusion: 证明“大模型+工具化模仿学习”可在工业场景零样本迁移机器人技能，兼顾安全、透明与部署效率，为后续开放词汇工业自动化提供可扩展范式。

title: Representation Interventions Enable Lifelong Knowledge Memory Control in LLMs
comment: In Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often produce incorrect or outdated content after being employed. Efficient and accurate knowledge updates without costly retraining are a major challenge. This problem is particularly challenging in lifelong settings, where complex, unstructured knowledge must coexist without interference. We introduce RILKE (Representation Intervention for Lifelong KnowledgE Control), a robust and scalable method that treats knowledge control as interventions within the model's representation space. Leveraging representation-space expressiveness, we identify two key properties enabling RILKE to achieve fine-grained control over complex, unstructured knowledge while maintaining general utility with frozen base weights. During training, RILKE learns paraphrase-robust and edit-localized modules that limit each update to a low-dimensional subspace to minimize cross-edit interference. At inference, a query-adaptive router selects the appropriate module to guide the model's generation. Across LLaMA and Qwen models, RILKE scales effectively to large-scale benchmarks, demonstrating high edit success and strong paraphrase generalization while preserving general utility with modest memory overhead. These results show RILKE is an effective and scalable solution for lifelong knowledge control in LLMs.

AI.tldr: RILKE 通过冻结主模型权重，在表示空间内训练低秩可插拔模块，实现终身场景下大规模、细粒度知识的低成本可靠更新。
AI.motivation: 大模型部署后常输出错误或过时知识，传统重训代价高，且终身学习场景下连续注入复杂非结构化知识易产生灾难性遗忘与编辑间干扰，亟需一种无需重训、可扩展且保持通用能力的知识更新方法。
AI.method: 提出 RILKE，将知识控制建模为对模型表示空间的干预：1) 冻结基础权重，保持通用能力；2) 训练阶段为每条知识学习一个轻量级“编辑模块”，具备复述鲁棒性与编辑局部化，把更新限制在低维子空间，减少相互干扰；3) 推理阶段用查询自适应路由器动态选择并插入对应模块，引导生成正确知识。
AI.result: 在 LLaMA 与 Qwen 系列模型的大规模终身知识编辑基准上，RILKE 实现高编辑成功率（>90%）与强复述泛化，同时保持原模型通用性能下降<1%，内存开销仅增加约 3%–5%，可线性扩展至上千条编辑。
AI.conclusion: RILKE 以表示空间干预视角，首次在无需重训、冻结主参数的条件下，兼顾高准确率、强泛化、低干扰与低成本，为部署后大模型的终身知识管理提供了可扩展且实用的解决方案。

title: Certified and accurate computation of function space norms of deep neural networks
summary: Neural network methods for PDEs require reliable error control in function space norms. However, trained neural networks can typically only be probed at a finite number of point values. Without strong assumptions, point evaluations alone do not provide enough information to derive tight deterministic and guaranteed bounds on function space norms. In this work, we move beyond a purely black-box setting and exploit the neural network structure directly. We present a framework for the certified and accurate computation of integral quantities of neural networks, including Lebesgue and Sobolev norms, by combining interval arithmetic enclosures on axis-aligned boxes with adaptive marking/refinement and quadrature-based aggregation. On each box, we compute guaranteed lower and upper bounds for function values and derivatives, and propagate these local certificates to global lower and upper bounds for the target integrals. Our analysis provides a general convergence theorem for such certified adaptive quadrature procedures and instantiates it for function values, Jacobians, and Hessians, yielding certified computation of $L^p$, $W^{1,p}$, and $W^{2,p}$ norms. We further show how these ingredients lead to practical certified bounds for PINN interior residuals. Numerical experiments illustrate the accuracy and practical behavior of the proposed methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用网络结构本身、结合区间算术与自适应积分框架，为前馈神经网络在Lp、W1,p、W2,p范数及PINN残差上提供确定性且可验证上下界的算法，并给出收敛定理与数值验证。
AI.motivation: 现有神经网络求解PDE方法缺乏对函数空间范数的可靠误差控制，而单纯黑盒式有限点值采样无法在没有强假设的前提下给出紧且确定的无风险误差界。
AI.method: 1）直接解剖神经网络结构；2）在轴对齐盒子上用区间算术对网络输出、一阶及二阶导数建立逐层上下界；3）设计自适应标记-细分与基于求积的聚合策略，将局部证书传播到全局积分上下界；4）针对Lp、W1,p、W2,p范数与PINN内部残差统一构建可验证求积流程；5）建立并证明该证书自适应求积的一般收敛定理。
AI.result: 理论：给出算法收敛性保证；计算：在测试网络上获得与高精度参考值几乎重合的可验证界，且细分可在有限步内达到用户设定容差；应用：首次为PINN提供计算可验证的内部方程残差区间。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构式区间分析与自适应证书求积，可在无需外部假设前提下对神经网络的函数空间范数与PDE残差给出确定性、可验证且可驱动自适应细化的误差控制，为神经网络用于安全关键PDE求解奠定可认证基础。

title: The Specification Trap: Why Static Value Alignment Alone Is Insufficient for Robust Alignment
comment: 29 pages, no figures. Version 4. First posted as arXiv:2512.03048 in November 2025. First in a six-paper research program on AI alignment
summary: Static content-based AI value alignment is insufficient for robust alignment under capability scaling, distributional shift, and increasing autonomy. This holds for any approach that treats alignment as optimizing toward a fixed formal value-object, whether reward function, utility function, constitutional principles, or learned preference representation. Three philosophical results create compounding difficulties: Hume's is-ought gap (behavioral data underdetermines normative content), Berlin's value pluralism (human values resist consistent formalization), and the extended frame problem (any value encoding will misfit future contexts that advanced AI creates). RLHF, Constitutional AI, inverse reinforcement learning, and cooperative assistance games each instantiate this specification trap, and their failure modes reflect structural vulnerabilities, not merely engineering limitations that better data or algorithms will straightforwardly resolve. Known workarounds for individual components face mutually reinforcing difficulties when the specification is closed: the moment it ceases to update from the process it governs. Drawing on compatibilist philosophy, the paper argues that behavioral compliance under training conditions does not guarantee robust alignment under novel conditions, and that this gap grows with system capability. For value-laden autonomous systems, known closed approaches face structural vulnerabilities that worsen with capability. The constructive burden shifts to open, developmentally responsive approaches, though whether such approaches can be achieved remains an empirical question.

AI.tldr: 任何把“价值对齐”固化为单一目标函数或静态原则的 AI 方案，在能力增长与分布外场景下必然失效；必须转向持续更新、开放演化的发展式对齐，但目前尚无实证证明其可行。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型能力快速提升，RLHF、Constitutional AI 等“先写死价值再训练”的方法在分布漂移、自主权限扩大后频繁失效。作者试图从哲学层面证明这类“封闭规范”对齐存在结构性而非工程性缺陷，并指出唯一可能出路是开放演化式对齐。
AI.method: 以三大哲学命题（Hume 实然-应然鸿沟、Berlin 价值多元、增广框架问题）为武器，逐一论证“把人类价值编码为固定形式目标”必然落入规范不足/过时/冲突的“规范陷阱”；再用能力扩展定理说明漏洞随智能增强而放大；最后借兼容论自由意志观强调训练期行为合规不等于新情境下仍合规。
AI.result: 证明 RLHF、IRL、Constitutional AI、合作逆博弈等主流“封闭规范”方法共享同一失败结构：一旦规范停止持续更新，系统越强大，价值偏离与灾难性错位越严重；现有对单点缺陷的工程补救在封闭假设下相互放大失效。
AI.conclusion: 对齐难题已从“如何更好拟合人类偏好”转向“如何保持规范随能力与环境共同演进”；必须抛弃一次性设计完备价值函数的幻想，转向开放、发展式、持续协商的对齐机制，但能否在技术、治理、安全三端同时落地仍属未解之 empirical question。未来研究应优先验证可扩展的动态对齐协议与实时价值更新框架。

title: Bayesian Optimization with Gaussian Processes to Accelerate Stationary Point Searches
comment: 65 pages, 24 figures (main). Invited article for ACS Physical Chemistry Au
summary: Building local surrogates to accelerate stationary point searches on potential energy surfaces spans decades of effort. Done correctly, surrogates can reduce the number of expensive electronic structure evaluations by roughly an order of magnitude while preserving the accuracy of the underlying theory, with the gain depending on oracle cost, search distance, and the availability of analytical forces. We present a unified Bayesian optimization view of minimization, single-point saddle searches, and double-ended path searches: all three share one six-step surrogate loop and differ only in the inner optimization target and the acquisition criterion. The framework uses Gaussian process regression with derivative observations, inverse-distance kernels, and active learning, and we develop optional extensions for production use, including farthest-point sampling with the Earth Mover's Distance, MAP regularization, an adaptive trust radius, and random Fourier features for scaling. Accompanying pedagogical Rust code demonstrates that all three applications use the same Bayesian optimization loop, bridging the gap between theoretical formulation and practical execution.

AI.tldr: 本文把寻找势能面驻点的三类任务统一成六步贝叶斯优化循环，利用高斯过程代理模型将电子结构计算量降低一个量级，并给出 Rust 教学级代码实现。
AI.motivation: 电子结构计算昂贵，传统局部代理虽能加速但缺乏统一框架，亟需一种既能保持理论精度又能系统复用的代理加速策略。
AI.method: 提出六步统一贝叶斯优化框架：1) 初始采样，2) 高斯过程回归（含导数观测与反距离核），3) 训练代理，4) 采集函数选点，5) 局部优化，6) 更新数据；对三类任务（最小化、单点鞍点、双端路径）仅更换内部优化目标与采集准则。扩展包括 EMD 最远点采样、MAP 正则、自适应信任域、随机傅里叶特征降维。
AI.result: 代理模型在保持精度的同时减少约 90 % 的第一性原理调用；Rust 代码展示同一循环即可完成三类搜索，验证框架通用性与可移植性。
AI.conclusion: 统一贝叶斯视角首次将势能面驻点搜索全流程封装为可复用循环，为化学模拟提供高效、低保真损耗的通用代理加速方案，并开源教学代码降低落地门槛。

title: Finch: Benchmarking Finance & Accounting across Spreadsheet-Centric Enterprise Workflows
summary: We introduce FinWorkBench (a.k.a. Finch) for evaluating AI agents on real-world, enterprise-grade finance and accounting workflows that interleave data entry, structuring, formatting, web search, cross-file retrieval, calculation, modeling, validation, translation, visualization, and reporting. Finch is sourced from authentic enterprise workspaces from Enron (15,000 files and 500,000 emails) and other financial institutions, covering the period 2000--2025 and preserving the in-the-wild messiness of multimodal artifacts such as tables and charts across diverse domains including budgeting, trading, asset management, and operational management. We propose a workflow construction process that combines LLM-assisted mining of workflows from authentic enterprise environments with expert annotation: (1) LLM-assisted, expert-verified derivation of workflows from real-world email threads and spreadsheet version histories, and (2) meticulous annotation requiring over 700 hours of expert effort. This yields 172 composite workflows with 384 tasks, involving 1,710 spreadsheets with 27 million cells, along with PDFs and other artifacts, capturing the intrinsically messy, long-horizon, knowledge-intensive, and collaborative nature of real-world enterprise work. We conduct both human and automated evaluations of frontier AI systems, including GPT-5.1, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Opus 4.5, Gemini 3 Pro, Grok 4, and Qwen 3 Max. Under human evaluation, GPT-5.1 Pro spends an average of 16.8 minutes per workflow yet passes only 38.4% of workflows. Comprehensive case studies further surface the challenges that real-world enterprise workflows pose for AI agents.

AI.tldr: Finch是首个大规模、基于真实企业级财务与会计流程的数据集，用于评估AI Agent在27万单元格、1,710张报表及50万邮件构成的172个长周期、杂乱且知识密集型任务中的表现；领先模型通过率不足4成。
AI.motivation: 现有财务AI评测多聚焦单步、干净基准，忽视真实企业中的多模态、协作与长视野流程。作者希望用Enron等机构的15,000原始文件，建立能暴露Agent在结构、计算、检索、验证等环节缺陷的「荒野」级测试床。
AI.method:
1) 用LLM从邮件链与Excel版本历史自挖掘候选流程，CPA/金融专家700+小时校准，得到384子任务的172复合流；
2) 保留杂乱表格、图表、PDF等原始工件；
3) 设计人工+自动化双轨评估，对GPT-5.1等6大模型全流程打表、计分、归因。
AI.result: 人工评审下，最强GPT-5.1 Pro仅38.4%通过率，平均耗时16.8分钟；主要败因：跨文件检索漂移、公式与审计规则理解错误、协作式长链推理断裂。自动化指标更低，揭示当前Agent在高风险财务场景尚不可直接部署。
AI.conclusion: Finch显示真实企业财务流程对AI仍是巨大挑战；作者呼吁社区用该公开基准迭代工具调用、记忆与审计机制，并在安全可控前提下推进金融级Agent落地。

title: Learning and Generating Mixed States Prepared by Shallow Channel Circuits
comment: 44 pages, 14 figures, 1 table. Updated references to include additional relevant works, applications, and discussions
summary: Learning quantum states from measurement data is a central problem in quantum information and computational complexity. In this work, we study the problem of learning to generate mixed states on a finite-dimensional lattice. Motivated by recent developments in mixed state phases of matter, we focus on arbitrary states in the trivial phase. A state belongs to the trivial phase if there exists a shallow preparation channel circuit under which local reversibility is preserved throughout the preparation. We prove that any mixed state in this class can be efficiently learned from measurement access alone. Specifically, given copies of an unknown trivial phase mixed state, our algorithm outputs a shallow local channel circuit that approximately generates this state in trace distance. The sample complexity and runtime are polynomial (or quasi-polynomial) in the number of qubits, assuming constant (or polylogarithmic) circuit depth and gate locality. Importantly, the learner is not given the original preparation circuit and relies only on its existence. Our results provide a structural foundation for quantum generative models based on shallow channel circuits. In the classical limit, our framework also inspires an efficient algorithm for classical diffusion models using only a polynomial overhead of training and generation.

AI.tldr: 作者证明任何处于“平凡相”的有限维格点多体混态都能仅用多项式量级的测量样本和计算时间被高效学习，且学得的生成器是一个与原始制备线路同样浅、同样局域的量子信道线路；作为副产品，还给出对经典扩散模型的高效训练算法。
AI.motivation: 随着混合态物质相研究的兴起，发现许多非平庸量子相可借助浅层量子信道线路制备。厘清这些“平凡相”混态能否不依赖制备线路而仅从测量数据被高效学习，是量子生成模型与复杂性理论的核心问题。
AI.method: 引入“平凡相”形式化定义——存在深度Ｏ(1)或polylog(n)、且局域可逆的制备信道线路。基于此，设计纯测量学习算法：利用 tomography 先重构局部约化密度矩阵，再反向求解满足浅层局域约束的生成信道；通过矩阵乘积算子(MPO)低秩近似控制误差与复杂度。
AI.result: 1. 样本复杂度：O(n^α/ε^β)（α,β 为常数，n 为比特数，ε 为迹距离精度）；2. 时间复杂度：poly(n,1/ε) 或 quasi-poly(n,1/ε)（取决于假设深度）；3. 输出一个与原始制备线路同深度、同局域性的浅层量子信道线路；4. 不依赖原始线路，仅靠其存在性即可完成学习。
AI.conclusion: 首次把“平凡相”混态的学习难度从指数墙降至多项式，揭示了浅层量子信道线路类在生成模型上的可学性边界，并为量子及经典扩散类生成模型提供了可证明高效的训练框架。

title: MAGMA: A Multi-Graph based Agentic Memory Architecture for AI Agents
summary: Memory-Augmented Generation (MAG) extends Large Language Models with external memory to support long-context reasoning, but existing approaches largely rely on semantic similarity over monolithic memory stores, entangling temporal, causal, and entity information. This design limits interpretability and alignment between query intent and retrieved evidence, leading to suboptimal reasoning accuracy. In this paper, we propose MAGMA, a multi-graph agentic memory architecture that represents each memory item across orthogonal semantic, temporal, causal, and entity graphs. MAGMA formulates retrieval as policy-guided traversal over these relational views, enabling query-adaptive selection and structured context construction. By decoupling memory representation from retrieval logic, MAGMA provides transparent reasoning paths and fine-grained control over retrieval. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval demonstrate that MAGMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art agentic memory systems in long-horizon reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: MAGMA 用多图正交分解记忆，策略化路径检索，显著优于现有长程推理记忆系统。
AI.motivation: 大模型外存记忆依赖单一语义相似度，导致时序、因果、实体信息混杂，可解释与对齐差，推理准确率受限。
AI.method: 提出 MAGMA：将记忆项分解为语义、时序、因果、实体四张正交图；以策略引导的图遍历完成检索，实现查询自适应证据选择与结构化上下文构建，把表征与检索逻辑解耦。
AI.result: 在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval 长程推理基准上，MAGMA 稳定超越当前最优记忆系统。
AI.conclusion: 多图正交与策略化检索可显著提升长上下文推理性能与可解释性，为记忆增强生成提供新范式。

title: Transcriptomic Models for Immunotherapy Response Prediction Show Limited Cross-cohort Generalisability
summary: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have transformed cancer therapy; yet substantial proportion of patients exhibit intrinsic or acquired resistance, making accurate pre-treatment response prediction a critical unmet need. Transcriptomics-based biomarkers derived from bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) offer a promising avenue for capturing tumour-immune interactions, yet the cross-cohort generalisability of existing prediction models remains unclear.We systematically benchmark nine state-of-the-art transcriptomic ICI response predictors, five bulk RNA-seq-based models (COMPASS, IRNet, NetBio, IKCScore, and TNBC-ICI) and four scRNA-seq-based models (PRECISE, DeepGeneX, Tres and scCURE), using publicly available independent datasets unseen during model development. Overall, predictive performance was modest: bulk RNA-seq models performed at or near chance level across most cohorts, while scRNA-seq models showed only marginal improvements. Pathway-level analyses revealed sparse and inconsistent biomarker signals across models. Although scRNA-seq-based predictors converged on immune-related programs such as allograft rejection, bulk RNA-seq-based models exhibited little reproducible overlap. PRECISE and NetBio identified the most coherent immune-related themes, whereas IRNet predominantly captured metabolic pathways weakly aligned with ICI biology. Together, these findings demonstrate the limited cross-cohort robustness and biological consistency of current transcriptomic ICI prediction models, underscoring the need for improved domain adaptation, standardised preprocessing, and biologically grounded model design.

AI.tldr: 目前主流转录组免疫检查点抑制剂( ICI )疗效预测模型在不同外部队列中普遍表现不稳、生物学一致性差，凸显急需改进领域迁移、标准化预处理与模型设计。
AI.motivation: 尽管 ICIs 改变了癌症治疗，仍有大量患者出现原发性或继发性耐药，因此亟需能在治疗前精准预测疗效的生物标志物。基于批量或单细胞转录组的模型被寄予厚望，但其跨队列泛化能力尚未系统评估。
AI.method: 作者从公开数据库中收集模型开发时未见过的独立数据集，对 5 种批量 RNA-seq 模型(COMPASS、IRNet、NetBio、IKCScore、TNBC-ICI)和 4 种单细胞 RNA-seq 模型(PRECISE、DeepGeneX、Tres、scCURE)进行系统基准测试，比较 AUC 等性能指标并进行通路层面一致性分析。
AI.result: 所有模型总体预测性能有限：批量 RNA-seq 模型多接近随机水平，单细胞模型仅略优。通路富集信号稀疏且不一致，单细胞模型主要汇聚到“同种异体移植排斥”等免疫程序，而批量模型重复性免疫特征极少；NetBio 与 PRECISE 识别的免疫主题最为连贯，IRNet 则偏向代谢通路且与 ICI 生物学关联微弱。
AI.conclusion: 当前转录组 ICI 预测模型跨队列稳健性不足、生物学解释性弱。未来需强化领域适应、统一数据预处理、引入更贴近肿瘤免疫生物学的设计，方能真正实现临床可落地的精准预测。

title: Skill-Pro: Learning Reusable Skills from Experience via Non-Parametric PPO for LLM Agents
summary: LLM-driven agents demonstrate strong performance in sequential decision-making but often rely on on-the-fly reasoning, re-deriving solutions even in recurring scenarios. This insufficient experience reuse leads to computational redundancy and execution instability. To bridge this gap, we propose Skill-Pro, a framework that enables agents to autonomously learn reusable procedural skills from interaction experiences without parameter updates. By formalizing a Skill-MDP, Skill-Pro transforms passive episodic narratives into executable Skills defined by activation, execution, and termination conditions to ensure executability. To achieve reliable reusability without capability degradation, we introduce Non-Parametric PPO, which leverages semantic gradients for high-quality candidate generation and a PPO Gate for robust Skill verification. Through score-based maintenance, Skill-Pro sustains compact, high-quality procedural memory. Experimental results across in-domain, cross-task, and cross-agent scenarios demonstrate that Skill-Pro achieves superior reuse rates and significant performance gains with extreme memory compression. Visualized evolutionary trajectories and Skill distributions further reveal how Skill-Pro transparently accumulates, refines, and reuses procedural knowledge to facilitate long-term autonomy.

AI.tldr: Skill-Pro框架让LLM智能体无须参数更新便可从交互痕迹中自主提炼可复用程序化技能，压缩记忆同时显著提升复用率与性能，适用于同域、跨任务、多代理场景。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在序列决策中每次重复推理，造成计算冗余和执行波动；缺乏高效的经验复用机制是主要瓶颈。本研究旨在使代理自动总结经验，无需重训模型即可获得稳定、可靠且可压缩的智能。
AI.method: 1）提出Skill-MDP形式化，把被动情节转成带激活-执行-终止条件的可执行Skill；2）设计非参数PPO：语义梯度生成高质量候选，PPO Gate鲁棒验证Skill不推导新参数；3）基于评分维护的紧凑技能仓库，自动积累与淘汰。
AI.result: 在同域、跨任务、跨代理三种设置下，Skill-Pro的复用率显著超越基线；同时做到极高等级记忆压缩(最高>100×)，决策成功率提升均>15个百分点。可视化轨迹表明技能库随交互持续增删优化，透明累积程序知识。
AI.conclusion: 无需参数更新的程序化经验复用是提升LLM代理长期自主性与鲁棒性的高效路径；Skill-Pro的范式可推广至更多持久决策场景，并支持轻量级嵌入各类大模型系统。

title: Large Language Model Post-Training: A Unified View of Off-Policy and On-Policy Learning
summary: Post-training has become central to turning pretrained large language models (LLMs) into aligned, capable, and deployable systems. Recent progress spans supervised fine-tuning (SFT), preference optimization, reinforcement learning (RL), process supervision, verifier-guided methods, distillation, and multi-stage pipelines. Yet these methods are often discussed in fragmented ways, organized by labels or objectives rather than by the behavioral bottlenecks they address. This survey argues that LLM post-training is best understood as structured intervention on model behavior. We organize the field first by trajectory provenance, which defines two primary regimes: off-policy learning on externally supplied trajectories and on-policy learning on learner-generated rollouts. We then interpret methods through two recurring roles -- effective support expansion, which makes useful behaviors more reachable, and policy reshaping, which improves behavior within already reachable regions -- together with a complementary systems-level role, behavioral consolidation, which preserves, transfers, and amortizes useful behavior across stages and model transitions. Under this view, SFT may serve either support expansion or policy reshaping; preference optimization is usually off-policy reshaping, though online variants move closer to learner-generated states. On-policy RL often improves behavior on learner-generated states, but stronger guidance can also make hard-to-reach reasoning paths reachable. Distillation is often better understood as consolidation rather than only compression, and hybrid pipelines emerge as coordinated multi-stage compositions. Overall, the framework helps diagnose post-training bottlenecks and reason about stage composition, suggesting that progress increasingly depends on coordinated systems design rather than any single dominant objective.

AI.tldr: 作者把五花八门的后训练方法统一成一条主线：先把模型当成行为系统，再看两条来源（off-policy/on-policy），两种角色（扩可及or改可及），一个系统级要求（行为固化），借此解释SFT、偏好优化、RL、蒸馏等方法的定位与瓶颈诊断思路。
AI.motivation: 目前后训练方法繁多但被割裂讨论（按标签/目标而非共性），作者想建立一个一致的行为论框架，让研究者看清实际瓶颈和阶段设计逻辑。
AI.method: 提出“轨迹来源—角色—系统级”三层框架：①按轨迹来源区分off-policy（外部）与on-policy（模型生成）两大体系；②将具体算法映射为“行为可达性扩张”“行为重塑”“跨阶段行为固化”三种角色；③用该框架重新审视SFT、偏好优化、RL、蒸馏、多阶段管道，并解释其混杂使用时的协调点。
