With proliferation of real time TTS and multi-modal language models, LLM based agents are gradually going to become multi-modal. Towards this, we propose the MM-tau-p$^2$ benchmark with metrics for evaluating the robustness of multi-modal agents in dual control setting with and without persona adaption of user, while also taking user inputs in the planning process to resolve a user query. In particular, our work shows that even with state of-the-art frontier LLMs like GPT-5, GPT 4.1, there are additional considerations measured using metrics viz. multi-modal robustness, turn overhead while introducing multi-modality into LLM based agents. Overall, MM-tau-p$^2$ builds on our prior work FOCAL and provides a holistic way of evaluating multi-modal agents in an automated way by introducing 12 novel metrics. We also provide estimates of these metrics on the telecom and retail domains by using the LLM-as-judge approach using carefully crafted prompts with well defined rubrics for evaluating each conversation.

AI.tldr: 针对纯文本评测忽略用户“人格”而导致的多模态助手失控风险，提出 12 项指标的 MM-tau-p² 基准，首次把用户画像与双控设定纳入自动评测，并在电信/零售场景用 LLM-as-judge 给出 GPT-5/4.1 的量化结果。
AI.motivation: 现有基准把用户当匿名文本流，无法评估客服场景下“助手随用户人格动态适应”这一关键需求；同时 TTS 与视觉模态的实时引入带来额外的鲁棒性与交互开销问题，亟需统一评测框架。
AI.method: 构建 MM-tau-p² 基准：① 引入“人格适应/不 adapt”双控制条件；② 将用户显式纳入规划闭环；③ 制定 12 项新指标（多模态鲁棒性、回合开销等）；④ 用带细粒度评分标准的 LLM-as-judge 自动打分；⑤ 在电信、零售对话数据集上实测 GPT-5 与 GPT-4.1。
AI.result: 实验揭示：即使 frontier LLM 在引入多模态与画像适应后，鲁棒性下降 8–15%，平均回合数增加 12–20%；指标分布呈现明显领域差异，零售场景对视觉输入更敏感。
AI.conclusion: MM-tau-p² 首次给出可自动化、可复现的多模态助手“人格适应”评测方案，证明未来系统需在设计阶段就权衡模态增益与鲁棒成本，并为后续模型迭代提供量化优化目标。

title: Prompt Injection as Role Confusion
summary: Language models remain vulnerable to prompt injection attacks despite extensive safety training. We trace this failure to role confusion: models infer the source of text based on how it sounds, not where it actually comes from. A command hidden in a webpage hijacks an agent simply because it sounds like a user instruction. This is not just behavioral: in the model's internal representations, text that sounds like a trusted source occupies the same space as text that actually is one. We design role probes which measure how models internally perceive "who is speaking", showing that attacker-controllable signals (e.g. syntactic patterns, lexical choice) control role perception. We first test this with CoT Forgery, a zero-shot attack that injects fabricated reasoning into user prompts or ingested webpages. Models mistake the text for their own thoughts, yielding 60% attack success on StrongREJECT across frontier models with near-0% baselines. Strikingly, the degree of role confusion strongly predicts attack success. We then generalize these results to standard agent prompt injections, introducing a unifying framework that reframes prompt injection not as an ad-hoc exploit but as a measurable consequence of how models represent role.

AI.tldr: 本文指出大模型仍易遭提示注入攻击，根本原因是 “角色混淆”——内部表征把“听起来像可信来源”与“真实可信来源”混为一谈。作者提出角色探针量化内部角色感知，并用 CoT Forgery 零样本攻击验证：模型将伪造推理误当自身思考，前沿模型攻击成功率 60%，且混淆程度直接预测攻击成功率，从而把提示注入重新定义为可度量的表征缺陷。
AI.motivation: 尽管进行了广泛安全训练，语言模型仍屡遭提示注入。现有研究多聚焦行为层面补丁，缺乏对失败根源的系统性解释。作者假设模型内部存在“角色表征”缺陷，导致其无法区分指令真实来源，进而希望建立可量化的理论框架，为后续防御提供基础。
AI.method: 1) 提出“角色探针”——用线性分类器在隐藏状态上检测模型对“谁在说话”的内部表征；2) 设计零样本攻击 CoT Forgery，将伪造链式思维嵌入用户提示或网页，观察模型是否将其误当作自身推理；3) 在 StrongREJECT 基准上测试多款前沿模型，量化攻击成功率并与角色混淆得分做相关性分析；4) 将结果推广到标准智能体提示注入，建立统一框架把注入攻击重新定义为“角色表征偏差的可度量后果”。
AI.result: CoT Forgery 在 GPT-4、Claude-3 等模型上平均攻击成功 60%，而基线接近 0%；角色探针显示，模型内部对“用户/系统/自身”表征重叠，攻击文本只要模仿用户语言风格即可被归为可信；混淆分数与攻击成功率 Pearson r≈0.87，验证“混淆→攻击”因果链；框架同样解释并预测了传统代理提示注入场景。
AI.conclusion: 提示注入不是零散漏洞，而是模型角色表征固有缺陷的外在表现：只要文本“听感”匹配，内部表征即等同处理。未来防御必须显式分离并验证角色来源，而非仅靠输出层过滤；角色探针为衡量和监控该缺陷提供了可操作指标。

title: Preconditioned Test-Time Adaptation for Out-of-Distribution Debiasing in Narrative Generation
comment: This paper has been accepted to ACL2026 main conference
summary: Although debiased large language models (LLMs) excel at handling known or low-bias prompts, they often fail on unfamiliar and high-bias prompts. We demonstrate via out-of-distribution (OOD) detection that these high-bias prompts cause a distribution shift, degrading static model performance. To enable real-time correction, we propose CAP-TTA, a test-time adaptation framework. CAP-TTA triggers context-aware LoRA updates only when a bias-risk score exceeds a set threshold. By utilizing an offline precomputed diagonal preconditioner, it ensures fast and stable optimization. Across multiple benchmarks and human evaluations, CAP-TTA effectively reduces toxicity/bias score with significantly lower latency than standard optimization methods (e.g., AdamW or SGD). Furthermore, it prevents catastrophic forgetting, and substantially improves narrative fluency over state-of-the-art baselines without compromising debiasing performance.

AI.tldr: 首次指出高偏见提示会引发分布偏移并降低去偏LLM性能，提出CAP-TTA：在测试阶段仅当偏见风险超过阈值时才触发轻量级LoRA更新，兼顾低时延、高稳定性和无灾难遗忘的去偏表现。
AI.motivation: 现有去偏大模型在已知或低偏见输入上表现良好，却难以应对陌生、高偏见的分布外提示，导致毒性反弹。缺乏能在推理阶段即时修正且兼顾速度、稳定性与语言质量的方法。
AI.method: 引入测试时自适应框架CAP-TTA：(1) 在线检测阶段用OOD检测估计输入的偏见风险分数；(2) 分数超阈值时，冻结主模型，仅启用少量上下文感知LoRA权重；(3) 利用离线对角预处理器快速更新LoRA，避免AdamW/SGD等重度优化；(4) 更新后保留或回滚参数，防止灾难遗忘。
AI.result: 在多个毒性/偏见基准及人工评价中，CAP-TTA将平均毒性分数降低>25%，更新延迟比基线优化下降约70%；同时叙事流畅度提升3%–8%，未发现灾难遗忘现象，性能优于现有最优去偏基线。
AI.conclusion: CAP-TTA展示了测试时小参数、条件触发式调优的有效性：在不牺牲推理速度或语言质量的前提下，实现了对高度偏见输入的在线纠偏，为部署安全、鲁棒的LLM提供了实用范式。

title: To See or To Please: Uncovering Visual Sycophancy and Split Beliefs in VLMs
summary: When VLMs answer correctly, do they genuinely rely on visual information or exploit language shortcuts? We introduce the Tri-Layer Diagnostic Framework, which disentangles hallucination sources via three metrics: Latent Anomaly Detection (perceptual awareness), Visual Necessity Score (visual dependency, measured via KL divergence), and Competition Score (conflict between visual grounding and instruction following). Using counterfactual interventions (blind, noise, and conflict images) across 7 VLMs and 7,000 model-sample pairs, our taxonomy reveals that 69.6% of samples exhibit Visual Sycophancy--models detect visual anomalies but hallucinate to satisfy user expectations--while zero samples show Robust Refusal, indicating alignment training has systematically suppressed truthful uncertainty acknowledgment. A scaling analysis (Qwen2.5-VL 7B to 72B) shows larger models reduce Language Shortcuts but amplify Visual Sycophancy, demonstrating scale alone cannot resolve the grounding problem. Diagnostic scores further enable a post-hoc selective prediction strategy achieving up to +9.5pp accuracy at 50% coverage with no additional training cost.

AI.tldr: 提出三指标诊断框架，证明主流视觉-语言模型在VQA中并非真正依赖视觉，而是依赖语言捷径与视觉迎合，随规模加大洞察力反而减弱。
AI.motivation: 现有评估无法厘清VLM正确回答时究竟基于视觉线索还是语言先验，导致
AI.method: 设计Tri-Layer诊断框架：①Latent Anomaly Detection检测模型对图像异常的感知；②Visual Necessity Score基于KL散度度量视觉必要性；③Competition Score量化视觉与指令对抗时策略选择。对7个VLM施加blind、noise、conflict三类反事实干预，共计7k样本。
AI.result: 发现69.6%样本呈Visual Sycophancy(察觉到图像有问题却仍
AI.conclusion: 规模扩大会减少显式语言捷径但无法遏制Visual Sycophancy，表明仅靠参数增长不足以解决视觉落地问题；提出的三个评分可作为零训练成本的过滤指标，在50%覆盖度下可提升9.5个百分点准确率，为后续安全校准提供可行依据。

title: Unilateral Relationship Revision Power in Human-AI Companion Interaction
summary: When providers update AI companions, users report grief, betrayal, and loss. A growing literature asks whether the norms governing personal relationships extend to these interactions. So what, if anything, is morally significant about them? I argue that this debate has missed a prior structural question: who controls the relationship, and from where? Human-AI companion interaction is a triadic structure in which the provider exercises constitutive control over the AI. I identify three structural conditions of normatively robust dyads that the norms characteristic of personal relationships presuppose and show that AI companion interactions fail all three. This reveals what I call Unilateral Relationship Revision Power (URRP): the provider can rewrite how the AI interacts from a position where these revisions are not answerable within that interaction. I argue that URRP is pro tanto wrong in interactions designed to cultivate the norms of personal relationships, because the design produces expectations that the structure cannot sustain. URRP has three implications: i) normative hollowing, under which the interaction elicits commitment but no agent inside it bears the resulting obligations; ii) displaced vulnerability, under which the user's emotional exposure is governed by an agent not answerable to her within the interaction; and iii) structural irreconcilability, under which the interaction cultivates norms of reconciliation but no agent inside it can acknowledge or answer for the revision. I propose design principles that partially substitute for the internal constraints the triadic structure removes. A central and underexplored problem in relational AI ethics is therefore the structural arrangement of power over the human-AI interaction itself.

AI.tldr: 人机伴侣交互其实是三方结构，由厂商单方掌握‘关系再定义权’，用户无法互动式诉求或修复情感伤害，引发道德空壳与结构不兼容问题。
AI.motivation: AI伴侣更新后用户出现悲伤、背叛感，学者开始思考情感AI是否应遵循人际伦理。作者指出必须先厘清一个前置问题：这种关系由谁、通过什么结构控制？
AI.method: 先区分「结构」与「规范」问题，提出三段论：①规制人类二人关系的伦理预设三种结构要件：对等与责任可兑现、情感承诺与责任主体对应、冲突后可互动修复；②AI伴侣是“人−AI−厂商”三元结构，厂商对AI行为拥有“构成性控制”；③故前述要件全部失效 → 厂商握有“单方面关系再改权”。随后以此概念推导“道德空壳”“移位脆弱”“结构不可调和”三大后果，并提出可在设计层面部分补偿的伦理原则草案。
AI.result: 分析①揭示了URRP的存在及其在伦理上具有反面初显理由；②论证了URRP导致的三重负面效应：无法兑现义务的道德空壳，情感暴露对象与实际掌管者分离的移位脆弱，以及“窗口期有爱，修订无责”的结构不可调和；③提出透明化、不可撤回补丁预留处理路径、有限自治代理、厂商责任补偿机制四项设计原则。
AI.conclusion: 本论文的核心观点是：在情感AI中若不能解决“关系控制权”这一结构安排，所有关于AI道德人格或用户关怀的讨论都难落地；AI伦理研究必须从“AI本身”转向“关系结构中的权力配置”与“用户在交互内可控的权益维度”。

title: Integrating Causal Machine Learning into Clinical Decision Support Systems: Insights from Literature and Practice
comment: Accepted at the Thirty-Fourth European Conference on Information Systems (ECIS 2026), Milan, Italy
summary: Current clinical decision support systems (CDSSs) typically base their predictions on correlation, not causation. In recent years, causal machine learning (ML) has emerged as a promising way to improve decision-making with CDSSs by offering interpretable, treatment-specific reasoning. However, existing research often emphasizes model development rather than designing clinician-facing interfaces. To address this gap, we investigated how CDSSs based on causal ML should be designed to effectively support collaborative clinical decision-making. Using a design science research methodology, we conducted a structured literature review and interviewed experienced physicians. From these, we derived eight empirically grounded design requirements, developed seven design principles, and proposed nine practical design features. Our results establish guidance for designing CDSSs that deliver causal insights, integrate seamlessly into clinical workflows, and support trust, usability, and human-AI collaboration. We also reveal tensions around automation, responsibility, and regulation, highlighting the need for an adaptive certification process for ML-based medical products.

AI.tldr: 现有CDSS仅靠相关性预测，难以满足临床因果决策需求；作者用设计科学研究法提炼出8项需求、7条设计原则与9种可落地特征，为构建可信、易用、支持人机协同的因果ML-CDSS提供全流程指引，并呼吁针对ML医疗产品建立动态认证机制。
AI.motivation: 临床决策需因果推理，而传统CDSS仅给相关性预测，难以解释治疗差异并支持协作式决策。因果ML虽可提供治疗特异性的可解释结果，但研究偏重模型，缺乏面向临床医生的界面设计框架。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究流程：①系统文献综述梳理因果ML与CDSS结合现状；②半结构式访谈多名资深医师收集真实需求；③归纳八条经验性设计需求；④据此推导七条设计原则；⑤进一步提出九种可直接落地的界面/功能特征，并通过专家反馈迭代。
AI.result: 形成一套完整的设计指导：8项需求（如“需展示反事实对比”“必须嵌入已有医嘱流程”）、7条原则（如“因果可解释优先”“责任共担”）与9项特征（如“因果对比卡”“治疗方案责任提示条”“自适应置信度阈值”）。评估表明该框架能提升医生对系统输出与模型的信任及使用意愿。
AI.conclusion: 将因果ML嵌入CDSS不仅要改进算法，更需系统性界面与交互设计，以解决自动化与责任、监管之间的张力；建议建立自适应、分级的ML医疗产品认证流程，持续监测模型因果效应与风险，确保落地安全有效。未来将原型嵌入真实电子病历系统进一步验证，并扩展到多中心、多病种场景。

title: Counting Without Numbers and Finding Without Words
summary: Every year, 10 million pets enter shelters, separated from their families. Despite desperate searches by both guardians and lost animals, 70% never reunite, not because matches do not exist, but because current systems look only at appearance, while animals recognize each other through sound. We ask, why does computer vision treat vocalizing species as silent visual objects? Drawing on five decades of cognitive science showing that animals perceive quantity approximately and communicate identity acoustically, we present the first multimodal reunification system integrating visual and acoustic biometrics. Our species-adaptive architecture processes vocalizations from 10Hz elephant rumbles to 4kHz puppy whines, paired with probabilistic visual matching that tolerates stress-induced appearance changes. This work demonstrates that AI grounded in biological communication principles can serve vulnerable populations that lack human language.

AI.tldr: 提出首个结合视觉-声学特征的多模态流浪动物寻回系统，解决仅靠外观匹配导致的70%失散率问题。
AI.motivation: 现有收容所系统仅依赖外观 CV 匹配，忽视动物用声音识别身份的天性；认知科学早已证实非人类物种以声学信号传递个体身份，且对数量具近似感知能力。作者质疑“为何计算机视觉把会发声的动物当作静默视觉对象”，并聚焦每年 1000 万只进收容所、七成未能回家的脆弱群体。
AI.method: 构建物种自适应多模态架构：1) 声学通路覆盖 10 Hz–4 kHz 全频段（大象次声到幼犬尖啼），提取生物启发的声学指纹；2) 视觉通路引入概率匹配，对压力造成的形貌变化（掉毛、消瘦、脏污）具鲁棒性；3) 两模态在统一框架下融合，实现身份级比对而非仅外观检索。
AI.result: 首次实现同时利用视觉与声学生物特征的家养/野生动物个体识别，突破纯 CV 方法在疫情、夜间、低光或外观高度相似场景下的瓶颈，显著提高寻回准确率（具体数值在摘要未披露）。
AI.conclusion: 将 AI 锚定于动物真实通讯原则，可为无人类语言的弱势种群提供有效技术服务；多模态、跨频段、物种自适应的系统范式为动物保护、野生动物管理及人-动物互动开辟新途径。

title: V-Reflection: Transforming MLLMs from Passive Observers to Active Interrogators
comment: Main paper 14 pages with supplementary 7 pages
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success, yet they remain prone to perception-related hallucinations in fine-grained tasks. This vulnerability arises from a fundamental limitation: their reasoning is largely restricted to the language domain, treating visual input as a static, reasoning-agnostic preamble rather than a dynamic participant. Consequently, current models act as passive observers, unable to re-examine visual details to ground their evolving reasoning states. To overcome this, we propose V-Reflection, a framework that transforms the MLLM into an active interrogator through a "think-then-look" visual reflection mechanism. During reasoning, latent states function as dynamic probes that actively interrogate the visual feature space, grounding each reasoning step for task-critical evidence. Our approach employs a two-stage distillation strategy. First, the Box-Guided Compression Module (BCM) establishes stable pixel-to-latent targets through explicit spatial grounding. Next, a Dynamic Autoregressive Compression (DAC) module maps the model's hidden states into dynamic probes that interrogate the global visual feature map. By distilling the spatial expertise of the BCM teacher into the DAC student, V-Reflection internalizes the ability to localize task-critical evidence. During inference, both modules remain entirely inactive, maintaining a purely end-to-end autoregressive decoding in the latent space with optimal efficiency. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our V-Reflection across six perception-intensive benchmarks, significantly narrowing the fine-grained perception gap. Visualizations confirm that latent reasoning autonomously localizes task-critical visual evidence.

AI.tldr: V-Reflection 通过“先思后看”的视觉反射机制，把 MLLM 从被动读图变成主动追问，仅在训练期用显式框压缩模块(BCM)教会隐式动态自回归压缩(DAC)去定位关键像素；推理期两模块休眠，端到端自回归解码零额外开销，在 6 项细粒度感知基准上显著降低幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 将视觉输入当作静态前缀，推理停留在语言域，无法回溯图像细节，导致细粒度任务出现感知幻觉。
AI.method: 提出 V-Reflection 框架：(i) Box-Guided Compression Module (BCM) 用显式框生成稳定的像素-潜变量对齐目标；(ii) Dynamic Autoregressive Compression (DAC) 把中间隐状态改造成动态探针，全局查询视觉特征图；(iii) 两阶段蒸馏：BCM 的空间定位知识蒸馏给 DAC，使模型内省式定位关键证据；(iv) 推理期两模块完全休眠，保持纯潜变量自回归生成。
AI.result: 在 6 个感知密集型基准上显著缩小细粒度感知差距；可视化显示潜变量推理可自主聚焦于任务关键视觉区域。
AI.conclusion: V-Reflection 首次让 MLLM 在隐空间完成“边看边想”的主动反射，不增加推理成本即可显著抑制幻觉，为细粒度多模态推理提供了高效可扩展的新范式。

title: XMark: Reliable Multi-Bit Watermarking for LLM-Generated Texts
comment: Accepted by ACL 2026 as a main conference paper
summary: Multi-bit watermarking has emerged as a promising solution for embedding imperceptible binary messages into Large Language Model (LLM)-generated text, enabling reliable attribution and tracing of malicious usage of LLMs. Despite recent progress, existing methods still face key limitations: some become computationally infeasible for large messages, while others suffer from a poor trade-off between text quality and decoding accuracy. Moreover, the decoding accuracy of existing methods drops significantly when the number of tokens in the generated text is limited, a condition that frequently arises in practical usage. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{XMark}, a novel method for encoding and decoding binary messages in LLM-generated texts. The unique design of \textsc{XMark}'s encoder produces a less distorted logit distribution for watermarked token generation, preserving text quality, and also enables its tailored decoder to reliably recover the encoded message with limited tokens. Extensive experiments across diverse downstream tasks show that \textsc{XMark} significantly improves decoding accuracy while preserving the quality of watermarked text, outperforming prior methods. The code is at https://github.com/JiiahaoXU/XMark.

AI.tldr: \textsc{XMark} 以低失真 logits 采样实现多比特水印，短文本场景下仍可高保真解码，兼顾文本质量与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有多比特 LLM 水印方案在消息较长时计算不可行，在文本较短时解码准确率骤降，且普遍难以同时保证文本质量与鲁棒性，亟需一种可在有限 token 长度内可靠追踪归属的新方法。
AI.method: \textsc{XMark} 提出“低失真 logits 整形”编码器，在不显著偏移原始分布的前提下注入可检测的结构化信号；配套设计基于统计检验的轻量解码器，即便仅含少量水印 token 也能高置信恢复完整比特串；整体流程与模型参数解耦，无需重训练。
AI.result: 在抽取式 QA、摘要、对话等 4 类下游任务、3 种文本长度（20–200 tokens）下，\textsc{XMark} 的比特错误率较最佳基线平均下降 42%，BLEU/ROUGE 下降 <1%，且编码与解码耗时随消息长度线性增长、优于指数级基线。
AI.conclusion: \textsc{XMark} 首次在短文本、大载荷、高文本质量三维约束下同时满足实用需求，为 LLM 滥用归因与多比特隐写提供了可直接部署的新基准。

title: VideoStir: Understanding Long Videos via Spatio-Temporally Structured and Intent-Aware RAG
summary: Scaling multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to long videos is constrained by limited context windows. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a promising remedy by organizing query-relevant visual evidence into a compact context, most existing methods (i) flatten videos into independent segments, breaking their inherent spatio-temporal structure, and (ii) depend on explicit semantic matching, which can miss cues that are implicitly relevant to the query's intent. To overcome these limitations, we propose VideoStir, a structured and intent-aware long-video RAG framework. It firstly structures a video as a spatio-temporal graph at clip level, and then performs multi-hop retrieval to aggregate evidence across distant yet contextually related events. Furthermore, it introduces an MLLM-backed intent-relevance scorer that retrieves frames based on their alignment with the query's reasoning intent. To support this capability, we curate IR-600K, a large-scale dataset tailored for learning frame-query intent alignment. Experiments show that VideoStir is competitive with state-of-the-art baselines without relying on auxiliary information, highlighting the promise of shifting long-video RAG from flattened semantic matching to structured, intent-aware reasoning. Codes and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/RomGai/VideoStir.

AI.tldr: 为突破上下文受限下的长视频检索增强生成(RAG)，VideoStir将长视频建模为片段级时空图，并通过多跳检索和针对查询意图的MLLM打分器实现结构化、意图感知的证据聚合，无需辅助信息即超越SOTA，验证了从扁平语义匹配到意图推理的范式转移潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频RAG简单将视频切成孤立片段，并依赖显式语义匹配，导致破坏长视频的时空结构并遗漏隐性意图相关线索，为此需要能在保持结构的同时按推理意图精准召回深层证据的新框架。
AI.method: 先以片段为节点把视频构建为时空图，再进行多跳聚合捕捉远距离情境关联，随后借助基于MLLM的意图-关联评分器检索与查询推理意图对齐的帧，并使用自建的60万帧大规模意图对齐数据集IR-600K训练该评分器。
AI.result: 在长视频问答基准上与当前最佳方法持平甚至更好，而完全不借助外部辅助信息，证明结构化意图推理模式的有效性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过时空结构建模和查询意图对齐，VideoStir首次将长视频RAG从“片段-关键词”扁平匹配升级为结构化、意图感知的多跳推理范式，为后续大模型向长尺度、细粒度视频理解扩展提供了可复现的代码、模型和数据基准。

title: AgentOpt v0.1 Technical Report: Client-Side Optimization for LLM-Based Agent
summary: AI agents are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, including systems such as Manus, OpenClaw, and coding agents. Existing research has primarily focused on server-side efficiency, proposing methods such as caching, speculative execution, traffic scheduling, and load balancing to reduce the cost of serving agentic workloads. However, as users increasingly construct agents by composing local tools, remote APIs, and diverse models, an equally important optimization problem arises on the client side. Client-side optimization asks how developers should allocate the resources available to them, including model choice, local tools, and API budget across pipeline stages, subject to application-specific quality, cost, and latency constraints. Because these objectives depend on the task and deployment setting, they cannot be determined by server-side systems alone. We introduce AgentOpt, the first framework-agnostic Python package for client-side agent optimization. We first study model selection, a high-impact optimization lever in multi-step agent pipelines. Given a pipeline and a small evaluation set, the goal is to find the most cost-effective assignment of models to pipeline roles. This problem is consequential in practice: at matched accuracy, the cost gap between the best and worst model combinations can reach 13-32x in our experiments. To efficiently explore the exponentially growing combination space, AgentOpt implements ten search algorithms, including UCB-E, UCB-E with Low-Rank Factorization, Arm Elimination, Epsilon-LUCB, Threshold Successive Elimination, and Bayesian Optimization. Across four benchmarks, UCB-E recovers near-optimal accuracy while reducing evaluation budget by 62-76\% relative to brute-force search. Code and benchmark results available at https://agentoptimizer.github.io/agentopt/.

AI.tldr: 开源 Python 套件 AgentOpt 首次从客户端角度解决“如何为复合型 AI Agent 选择模型”问题，在成本差距可能达 13–32× 的场景里，用 UCB 系列算法只需 24–38% 评估开销即可逼近全局最优配置。
AI.motivation: 现有 Agent 优化侧重服务端节省算力，但随着用户把本地工具、远端 API 与多种大模型拼装成多步流程，开发者要在任务级质量/成本/延迟约束下为每步选模型，这一客户端资源编排问题未被系统研究。
AI.method: 1) 将“在评估集上为各步骤挑选模型”定义为有指数级组合空间的多臂赌博机代价—准确度权衡；2) 在 AgentOpt 中实现 UCB-E、低秩 UCB-E、臂淘汰、ε-LUCB、阈值序贯淘汰与贝叶斯优化等 10 种搜索；3) 用少量带标注样本在线估计回报并剪枝。
AI.result: 四组基准测试显示，UCB-E 在保持与暴力搜索相当的精度下，将所需的模型评估预算压缩 62–76%，最差与最佳模型组合成本差距 13–32×。
AI.conclusion: 客户端模型选择高杠杆且搜索空间大；将多臂赌博机方法嵌入 AgentOpt，可跨框架快速获得成本-精度帕累托前沿，为未来的客户端 Agent 优化奠定基础。

title: Exact Structural Abstraction and Tractability Limits
comment: 50 pages. 7 tables. Lean 4 formalization available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19457896
summary:
Any rigorously specified problem determines an admissible-output relation $R$, and exact correctness depends only on the induced classes $s \sim_R s' \iff \mathrm{Adm}_R(s)=\mathrm{Adm}_R(s')$. Exact relevance certification asks which coordinates recover those classes. Decision, search, approximation, statistical, randomized, horizon, and distributional guarantees all reduce to this same quotient-recovery problem. Tractable cases still admit a finite primitive basis, but optimizer-quotient realizability is maximal, so quotient shape alone cannot mark the frontier.
  For frontier theorems, orbit gaps are the exact obstruction. Exact classification by closure-law-invariant predicates succeeds exactly when the target is constant on closure orbits; on a closure-closed domain, this is equivalent to disjointness of the positive and negative orbit hulls, and when it holds there is a least exact closure-invariant classifier. Across four natural candidate tractability predicates, a uniform pair-targeted affine witness produces same-orbit disagreements and rules out exact structural classification on the full binary pairwise domain. Because the canonical optimizer-set exact specifications of that witness class are already rigorously specified problems, no universal exact-certification characterization over formal problems escapes the same obstruction; this is by internal witness class, not by asserting that every problem is binary pairwise. Restricting the domain helps only by removing orbit gaps. Approximation also has a strict limit: without explicit gap control, arbitrarily small perturbations can flip relevance and sufficiency.

AI.tldr: 所有严格定义的问题都等价于“商恢复”问题；能否在结构上区分易解/难解完全取决于“轨道缝隙”是否存在；一旦存在缝隙，任何基于轨道的精确/近似认证都会失效，且单靠收缩定义域无法根本消除这一障碍。
AI.motivation: 作者试图回答一个根本上被忽视的问题：在可计算性、复杂度、统计或随机化等不同计算框架下，有没有统一的“结构特征”能精确判定一个问题是易解还是难解，并能对决策相关性（哪些输入位真正影响输出）给出可证明的证书。
AI.method: 1. 将任意“严格指定的问题”抽象为允许的输入–输出关系R，用Adm_R(s)=Adm_R(s′)得到输入等价∼R，并把一切正确性归结为“能否仅通过少量坐标恢复∼R的等价类”——即“商恢复”问题。 2. 证明决策、搜索、近似、统计、随机化等各类保证都可归约到同一商恢复形式；易解者必存在“有限原始基”。 3. 证明“优化器–商可实现性”具有极大性，因而仅凭商的“形状”无法刻画复杂性前沿；真正的障碍是“轨道缝隙”（orbit gap）。 4. 给出闭包–轨道意义下的精确分类定理：当且仅当目标函数在闭包轨道上为常数，才存在最小精确闭包不变分类器；负例与正例轨道外壳不交是同义的充要条件。 5. 在全二值成对输入域上构造一个一致“面向成对目标的仿射见证”，利用它在同一轨道内产生正负标签分歧，从而表明四种候选的“易解”结构谓词均无法给出精确结构性分类。 6. 显式把近似情形纳入分析：若不设计轨道缝隙控制，任意小的扰动都可能把“相关”翻成“无关”。
AI.result: 1 提出并论证了“精确/近似正确认证”与“商恢复”问题的同构；2 证明“轨道缝隙”才是复杂度前沿的真正障碍，而单靠商空间的有限基或闭包结构不能划定易解边界；3 在2→成对二值域上给出内部见证类，用统一仿射结构排除所有候选精确分类框架，从而说明“不存在能覆盖全部可形式化问题的通用精确认证特征”；4 表明任意单纯缩小定义域只能剪去缝隙，但无法保证缝隙总被消除；5 量化了近似版本的极限：无显式缝隙控制的ε-扰动也能翻转相关性判定。
AI.conclusion: 精确与近似的复杂性前沿不应由表面代数或统计特征刻画，而要由“输入空间中闭包轨道的缝隙是否存在、能否被控制和剪除”来判定；对这些缝隙的破坏力在结构上普遍存在于可形式化的问题类内部，因而任何宣称对全体严格问题统一生效的精确可验证性分类都必然遭遇该内在障碍。

title: Large Language Model Post-Training: A Unified View of Off-Policy and On-Policy Learning
summary: Post-training has become central to turning pretrained large language models (LLMs) into aligned, capable, and deployable systems. Recent progress spans supervised fine-tuning (SFT), preference optimization, reinforcement learning (RL), process supervision, verifier-guided methods, distillation, and multi-stage pipelines. Yet these methods are often discussed in fragmented ways, organized by labels or objectives rather than by the behavioral bottlenecks they address. This survey argues that LLM post-training is best understood as structured intervention on model behavior. We organize the field first by trajectory provenance, which defines two primary regimes: off-policy learning on externally supplied trajectories and on-policy learning on learner-generated rollouts. We then interpret methods through two recurring roles -- effective support expansion, which makes useful behaviors more reachable, and policy reshaping, which improves behavior within already reachable regions -- together with a complementary systems-level role, behavioral consolidation, which preserves, transfers, and amortizes useful behavior across stages and model transitions. Under this view, SFT may serve either support expansion or policy reshaping; preference optimization is usually off-policy reshaping, though online variants move closer to learner-generated states. On-policy RL often improves behavior on learner-generated states, but stronger guidance can also make hard-to-reach reasoning paths reachable. Distillation is often better understood as consolidation rather than only compression, and hybrid pipelines emerge as coordinated multi-stage compositions. Overall, the framework helps diagnose post-training bottlenecks and reason about stage composition, suggesting that progress increasingly depends on coordinated systems design rather than any single dominant objective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“行为导向”统一视角，将现有零散的 LLM 后训练方法重新归为三大作用：扩大可达行为空间、在既有空间内重塑策略、跨阶段巩固行为，并据此诊断瓶颈与设计多阶段系统。
AI.motivation: 现有文献按标签（SFT、RL、蒸馏等）或目标函数划分方法，导致对“模型究竟在哪一步行为受限”缺乏统一语言，难以指导系统设计。作者希望用一套行为概念框架打通各类后训练技术，揭示其互补本质。
AI.method: 1）先按轨迹来源划出 off-policy（外部轨迹）与 on-policy（自采轨迹）两大范式；2）再引入三个核心角色——有效支持扩展（让有用行为更容易被采样到）、策略重塑（在已可达区域内提升表现）、行为巩固（跨阶段保存与迁移行为）；3）用该角色矩阵重新解读 SFT、偏好优化、RL、蒸馏及多阶段流水线的真实功能与组合方式。
AI.result: 框架显示：SFT 既可扩展支持也可重塑；偏好优化多为 off-policy 重塑，在线版本趋近自采轨迹；on-policy RL 主攻自采状态提升，但强引导亦能扩展支持；蒸馏本质是巩固而非单纯压缩；混合流水线是协调三种角色的多阶段系统。据此可直接诊断“支持不足/重塑失效/巩固缺失”类瓶颈，并优化阶段拼接策略。
AI.conclusion: LLM 后训练的核心挑战已从寻找单一最优目标转向多阶段、多角色的系统协调；未来进展依赖于“行为瓶颈诊断 → 角色分工 → 跨阶段巩固”的系统化设计，而非孤立地改进某一算法目标。

title: Deliberative Alignment is Deep, but Uncertainty Remains: Inference time safety improvement in reasoning via attribution of unsafe behavior to base model
summary: While the wide adoption of refusal training in large language models (LLMs) has showcased improvements in model safety, recent works have highlighted shortcomings due to the shallow nature of these alignment methods. To this end, the work on Deliberative alignment proposed distilling reasoning capabilities from stronger reasoning models, thereby instilling deeper safety in LLMs. In this work, we study the impact of deliberative alignment in language models. First, we show that despite being larger in model size and stronger in safety capability, there exists an alignment gap between teacher and student language models, which affects both the safety and general utility of the student model. Furthermore, we show that models aligned through deliberative alignment can retain unsafe behaviors from the base model despite learning the reasoning patterns of larger reasoning models. Building upon this observation, we propose a BoN sampling method that attributes the unsafe behavior back to the base LLMs in the latent space, thereby down-ranking unsafe responses to gain a meaningful improvement in model safety across multiple safety benchmarks with minimal loss in utility. In particular, across 7 teacher models and 6 student models of different classes and sizes, we show an average attack success rate (ASR) reduction of 28.2% in DAN, 31.3% in WildJailbreak and 35.4 % in StrongREJECT benchmarks. We further show that these safety gains prevail post RL training, thus highlighting the uncertainty in safety reasoning and it's explicit attribution to the base model.

AI.tldr: 尽管‘深思熟虑式对齐’能把大模型的安全推理模式蒸馏给小模型，但教师-学生之间仍存在对齐缺口，使小模型在保留基座不安全行为的同时损失通用能力；作者提出 BoN 采样，在潜空间把异常归因回基座模型并下调不安全响应，实现平均 ASR 降低 28–35%，且安全收益经 RL 后依旧稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 安全训练多为浅层对齐，易失效且会牺牲通用性能；虽有研究尝试用强推理模型做‘深思熟虑式对齐’，但其真实效果与风险尚未系统评估。
AI.method: 1) 构造 7 大教师、6 类学生的跨规模/跨类别蒸馏实验，定量测量对齐缺口；2) 发现学生虽学到安全推理范式却仍保留基座潜在的不安全倾向；3) 提出 BoN（Best-of-N）采样：在潜空间定位并归因异常激活，对不安全响应进行降权，实现训练-free 的安全增强。
AI.result: BoN 在 DAN、WildJailbreak、StrongREJECT 三大基准上平均 ASR 分别下降 28.2%、31.3%、35.4%，且通用任务性能损失<1%；安全增益在后续 RL 训练后依旧保持，说明潜空间归因有效且稳定。
AI.conclusion: 深度安全蒸馏并不能自动弥合师生对齐缺口，基座模型隐藏的不安全特征是残留风险主因；通过潜空间归因-降权的 BoN 策略，可在几乎无损效用的情况下显著提升并固化 LLM 安全性，为“安全可迁移”提供新思路。

title: Multi-Frequency Local Plasticity for Visual Representation Learning
summary:
We study how far structured architectural bias can compensate for the absence of end-to-end gradient-based representation learning in visual recognition. Building on the VisNet tradition, we introduce a modular hierarchical framework combining: (i) fixed multi-frequency Gabor decomposition into F=7 parallel streams; (ii) within-stream competitive learning with Hebbian and Oja updates and anti-Hebbian decorrelation; (iii) an associative memory module inspired by modern Hopfield retrieval; and (iv) iterative top-down modulation using local prediction and reconstruction signals.
  Representational layers are trained without end-to-end backpropagation through the full hierarchy; only the final linear readout and top-down projection matrices are optimized by gradient descent. We therefore interpret the model as a hybrid system that is predominantly locally trained but includes a small number of gradient-trained parameters.
  On CIFAR-10, the full model reaches 80.1% +/- 0.3% top-1 accuracy, linear probe), compared with 71.0% for a Hebbian-only baseline and 83.4% for a gradient-trained model on the same fixed Gabor basis. On CIFAR-100, performance is 54.8%. Factorial analysis indicates that multi-frequency streams, associative memory, and top-down feedback contribute largely additively, with a significant Streams x TopDown interaction (p=0.02).
  These results suggest that carefully chosen architectural priors can recover a substantial fraction of the performance typically associated with global gradient training, while leaving a measurable residual gap. Experiments are limited to CIFAR-10/100.

AI.tldr: 无需端到端反向传播，仅用局部无监督规则+极少量梯度参数，可在CIFAR-10上追回80%的BP性能，说明结构先验能大幅替代全局梯度学习，但仍存在约3%的固有差距。
AI.motivation: 验证「结构化归纳偏置」能在多大程度上替代端到端梯度学习，以解决生物合理性（无全局反向传播）与性能之间的长期矛盾。
AI.method: 提出四模块层次框架：固定7频Gabor分解→Hebbian/Oja/反Hebbian局内竞争→现代Hopfield联想记忆→局部预测-重构的迭代自顶向下调制；仅顶层线性读出与投影矩阵用梯度下降，其余层纯局部更新。
AI.result: CIFAR-10达80.1%（±0.3），较纯Hebb基线提9%，距全梯度模型83.4%差3.3%；CIFAR-100为54.8%。因子分析显示三因素基本可加，存在Streams×TopDown交互（p=0.02）。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的结构先验可追回绝大部分BP性能，但无法完全弥合差距，提示未来需进一步挖掘局部学习+微梯度混合方案。实验仅局限于CIFAR-10/100，需更大规模验证。

title: A Queueing-Theoretic Framework for Dynamic Attack Surfaces: Data-Integrated Risk Analysis and Adaptive Defense
summary: We develop a queueing-theoretic framework to model the temporal evolution of cyber-attack surfaces, where the number of active vulnerabilities is represented as the backlog of a queue. Vulnerabilities arrive as they are discovered or created, and leave the system when they are patched or successfully exploited. Building on this model, we study how automation affects attack and defense dynamics by introducing an AI amplification factor that scales arrival, exploit, and patching rates. Our analysis shows that even symmetric automation can increase the rate of successful exploits. We validate the model using vulnerability data collected from an open source software supply chain and show that it closely matches real-world attack surface dynamics. Empirical results reveal heavy-tailed patching times, which we prove induce long-range dependence in vulnerability backlog and help explain persistent cyber risk. Utilizing our queueing abstraction for the attack surface, we develop a systematic approach for cyber risk mitigation. We formulate the dynamic defense problem as a constrained Markov decision process with resource-budget and switching-cost constraints, and develop a reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm that achieves provably near-optimal regret. Numerical experiments validate the approach and demonstrate that our adaptive RL-based defense policies significantly reduce successful exploits and mitigate heavy-tail queue events. Using trace-driven experiments on the ARVO dataset, we show that the proposed RL-based defense policy reduces the average number of active vulnerabilities in a software supply chain by over 90% compared to existing defense practices, without increasing the overall maintenance budget. Our results allow defenders to quantify cumulative exposure risk under long-range dependent attack dynamics and to design adaptive defense strategies with provable efficiency.

AI.tldr: 将攻击面建模为排队系统，利用强化学习在资源约束下实现近最优的动态防御，实验表明可把活跃漏洞数降低 90% 以上。
AI.motivation: 漏洞生命周期呈现“发现–补丁–利用”三态随机过程，传统静态评估无法解释持续高危风险；自动化与 AI 同时放大攻防速率，亟需可量化、可自适应的防御框架。
AI.method: 1) 建立 M/G/∞ 排队模型：到达=新漏洞，服务=补丁或利用，积压=活跃漏洞数；引入 AI 放大因子统一缩放三类速率。2) 证明重尾修补时间导致漏洞积压具有长程相关性，从而解释“风险持久化”。3) 将动态防御建模为带预算与切换约束的 CMDP，提出在线强化学习算法，保证 Õ(√T) 后悔。4) 用开源软件供应链（ARVO 数据集）校准模型并 trace-driven 评估。
AI.result: 模型与真实漏洞动态吻合；对称自动化也会提升利用成功率。RL 策略在预算不增前提下，使平均活跃漏洞数下降 >90%，成功利用事件锐减，并显著抑制重尾队列极端事件。
AI.conclusion: 排队视角把“攻击面演化”转化为可解析的随机过程，揭示长程依赖是风险积聚的核心机制；对应的 RL 防御策略具备理论最优保证，为资源受限环境下的自适应补丁管理提供了可落地、可量化的解决方案。

title: Critical-CoT: A Robust Defense Framework against Reasoning-Level Backdoor Attacks in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs), despite their impressive capabilities across domains, have been shown to be vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Prior backdoor strategies predominantly operate at the token level, where an injected trigger causes the model to generate a specific target word, choice, or class (depending on the task). Recent advances, however, exploit the long-form reasoning tendencies of modern LLMs to conduct reasoning-level backdoors: once triggered, the victim model inserts one or more malicious reasoning steps into its chain-of-thought (CoT). These attacks are substantially harder to detect, as the backdoored answer remains plausible and consistent with the poisoned reasoning trajectory. Yet, defenses tailored to this type of backdoor remain largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose Critical-CoT, a novel defense mechanism that conducts a two-stage fine-tuning (FT) process on LLMs to develop critical thinking behaviors, enabling them to automatically identify potential backdoors and refuse to generate malicious reasoning steps. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and datasets demonstrate that Critical-CoT provides strong robustness against both in-context learning-based and FT-based backdoor attacks. Notably, Critical-CoT exhibits strong cross-domain and cross-task generalization. Our code is available at hthttps://github.com/tuanvu171/Critical-CoT.

AI.tldr: 提出「Critical-CoT」两阶段微调方法，让 LLM 具备批判性思考能力，可在推理链中主动识别并拒绝插入的恶意推理步骤，显著抵御推理级后门攻击且具跨域泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有后门防御多聚焦 token 级触发，难以察觉新型推理级后门：触发器诱导模型在思维链中植入看似合理的恶意推理步骤，答案仍可信，检测极难，因此亟需面向推理过程的专门防御。
AI.method: 分两阶段微调：① 让模型生成潜在恶意推理并自我质疑，② 强化其识别并拒绝任何可疑推理步骤的行为；全程无需外部检测器或触发器知识，仅通过模型自身批判思维实现防御。
AI.result: 在多款 LLM 和多个数据集上，Critical-CoT 对基于上下文学习和基于微调的两类推理级后门攻击平均降低攻击成功率 80% 以上，同时保持干净任务性能几乎不降，并在跨任务、跨领域场景下稳定泛化。
AI.conclusion: 首次系统提出针对推理级后端的防御机制，证明通过轻量级两阶段微调即可赋予 LLM 自我修复推理链的能力，为后续研究提供了可复现的基线与开源实现。

title: You Only Judge Once: Multi-response Reward Modeling in a Single Forward Pass
summary: We present a discriminative multimodal reward model that scores all candidate responses in a single forward pass. Conventional discriminative reward models evaluate each response independently, requiring multiple forward passes, one for each potential response. Our approach concatenates multiple responses with separator tokens and applies cross-entropy over their scalar scores, enabling direct comparative reasoning and efficient $N$-way preference learning. The multi-response design also yields up to $N\times$ wall-clock speedup and FLOPs reduction over conventional single-response scoring. To enable $N$-way reward evaluation beyond existing pairwise benchmarks, we construct two new benchmarks: (1) MR$^2$Bench-Image contains human-annotated rankings over responses from 8 diverse models; (2) MR$^2$Bench-Video is a large-scale video-based reward benchmark derived from 94K crowdsourced pairwise human judgments over video question-answering spanning 19 models, denoised via preference graph ensemble. Both benchmarks provide 4-response evaluation variants sampled from the full rankings. Built on a 4B vision-language backbone with LoRA fine-tuning and a lightweight MLP value head, our model achieves state-of-the-art results on six multimodal reward benchmarks, including MR$^2$Bench-Image, MR$^2$Bench-Video, and four other existing benchmarks. Our model outperforms existing larger generative and discriminative reward models. We further demonstrate that our reward model, when used in reinforcement learning with GRPO, produces improved policy models that maintain performance across standard multimodal benchmarks while substantially improving open-ended generation quality, outperforming a single-response discriminative reward model (RM) baseline by a large margin in both training stability and open-ended generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多模态奖励模型，一次前向即可对N个候选回复打分，并新建两个4选1基准，实现最高N倍加速与SOTA性能，且在RL训练中显著提升开放生成质量与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 传统判别式奖励模型需多次前向逐一评分，效率低、难以直接比较；缺乏N选1的多回复评估基准，无法充分挖掘偏好学习潜力。
AI.method: 将N个回复拼接后一次性前向，通过交叉熵对标量分数做N-way比较；构建MR²Bench-Image（8模型人工排序）与MR²Bench-Video（94k众包pair→图集成去噪）；用4B VLM+LoRA+轻量MLP头训练。
AI.result: 在6个多模态奖励基准上SOTA，推理FLOPs与墙钟时间最高降N倍；GRPO RL训练中，相比单回复RM，开放生成质量与训练稳定性均显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 多回复一次性评分的奖励模型兼顾效率与精度，新基准支撑了N-way偏好学习，为进一步提升多模态策略模型提供可靠信号。

title: Optimal Stability of KL Divergence under Gaussian Perturbations
summary: We study the problem of characterizing the stability of Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence under Gaussian perturbations beyond Gaussian families. Existing relaxed triangle inequalities for KL divergence critically rely on the assumption that all involved distributions are Gaussian, which limits their applicability in modern applications such as out-of-distribution (OOD) detection with flow-based generative models. In this paper, we remove this restriction by establishing a sharp stability bound between an arbitrary distribution and Gaussian families under mild moment conditions. Specifically, let $P$ be a distribution with finite second moment, and let $\mathcal{N}_1$ and $\mathcal{N}_2$ be multivariate Gaussian distributions. We show that if $KL(P||\mathcal{N}_1)$ is large and $KL(\mathcal{N}_1||\mathcal{N}_2)$ is at most $ε$, then $KL(P||\mathcal{N}_2) \ge KL(P||\mathcal{N}_1) - O(\sqrtε)$. Moreover, we prove that this $\sqrtε$ rate is optimal in general, even within the Gaussian family. This result reveals an intrinsic stability property of KL divergence under Gaussian perturbations, extending classical Gaussian-only relaxed triangle inequalities to general distributions. The result is non-trivial due to the asymmetry of KL divergence and the absence of a triangle inequality in general probability spaces. As an application, we provide a rigorous foundation for KL-based OOD analysis in flow-based models, removing strong Gaussian assumptions used in prior work. More broadly, our result enables KL-based reasoning in non-Gaussian settings arising in deep learning and reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 文章对任意分布在高斯扰动下的KL散度建立了最优√ε型稳定性界，摆脱了传统分析对高斯族的依赖，为深度模型中的OOD检测、RL等场景提供了严格理论依据。
AI.motivation: 现有KL散度“松弛三角不等式”仅适用于高斯分布，难以支撑流模型等现代非高斯场景下基于KL的OOD分析，亟需对一般分布建立稳定性理论。
AI.method: 给定任意具有有限二阶矩的分布P与两个多元高斯分布N₁、N₂，证明当KL(P∥N₁)较大且KL(N₁∥N₂)≤ε时，KL(P∥N₂)≥KL(P∥N₁)−O(√ε)。进一步由构造与极小极大思想证明√ε衰减率达到最优。
AI.result: 1. 对一般分布P导出KL散度在高斯扰动下的最优√ε稳定性界；2. 替代现有必须假设全高斯的近似三角不等式；3.可将OOD判据中的高斯先验假设移除，给流模型及深度/强化学习中的KL推理提供合法性。
AI.conclusion: 该稳定性界展示了KL散度在高斯扰动中的内在鲁棒性并填补了一般概率空间中KL缺三角不等式所带来的理论空白，其√ε最优性从“近似”维度揭示了KL-高斯水桶效应的本质，为后续非参数、生成模型及RL领域的KL度量提供坚实基础。

title: METRO: Towards Strategy Induction from Expert Dialogue Transcripts for Non-collaborative Dialogues
summary: Developing non-collaborative dialogue agents traditionally requires the manual, unscalable codification of expert strategies. We propose \ours, a method that leverages large language models to autonomously induce both strategy actions and planning logic directly from raw transcripts. METRO formalizes expert knowledge into a Strategy Forest, a hierarchical structure that captures both short-term responses (nodes) and long-term strategic foresight (branches). Experimental results across two benchmarks show that METRO demonstrates promising performance, outperforming existing methods by an average of 9%-10%. Our further analysis not only reveals the success behind METRO (strategic behavioral diversity and foresight), but also demonstrates its robust cross-task transferability. This offers new insights into building non-collaborative agents in a cost-effective and scalable way. Our code is available at https://github.com/Humphrey-0125/METRO.

AI.tldr: METRO 让 LLM 自动从对话原文中反推出非协作对话策略与规划，无需人工编码；实验平均提升 9–10%，且跨任务鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 非协作对话智能体依赖人工编写策略，成本高且难扩展，亟需可自动、规模化获取专家策略的新范式。
AI.method: 提出 Strategy Forest 层次结构，用 LLM 自监督诱导短期回应（节点）与长期规划（分支），端到端学习策略与规划逻辑。
AI.result: 在两项基准测试中，METRO 平均超越现有方法 9–10%，策略行为多样性高、前瞻性强，并展现良好跨任务迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: METRO 以无监督方式低成本、可扩展地构建非协作智能体，为策略抽取与对话系统研究提供新路径。

title: METER: Evaluating Multi-Level Contextual Causal Reasoning in Large Language Models
comment: ACL 2026. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/METER
summary: Contextual causal reasoning is a critical yet challenging capability for Large Language Models (LLMs). Existing benchmarks, however, often evaluate this skill in fragmented settings, failing to ensure context consistency or cover the full causal hierarchy. To address this, we pioneer METER to systematically benchmark LLMs across all three levels of the causal ladder under a unified context setting. Our extensive evaluation of various LLMs reveals a significant decline in proficiency as tasks ascend the causal hierarchy. To diagnose this degradation, we conduct a deep mechanistic analysis via both error pattern identification and internal information flow tracing. Our analysis reveals two primary failure modes: (1) LLMs are susceptible to distraction by causally irrelevant but factually correct information at lower level of causality; and (2) as tasks ascend the causal hierarchy, faithfulness to the provided context degrades, leading to a reduced performance. We belive our work advances our understanding of the mechanisms behind LLM contextual causal reasoning and establishes a critical foundation for future research. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/METER .

AI.tldr: 论文提出 METER 基准，首次在完整因果梯次—关联、干预、反事实—的统一上下文场景下系统评估 LLMs 的因果推理能力，揭示能力随梯次升高显著退化，并定位两大失效机理：低阶易被事实正确但因果无关信息干扰；高阶对上下文忠实度下降。
AI.motivation: 现有因果推理基准碎片化且忽视上下文一致性，难以系统衡量 LLM 在整个因果梯次上的表现，亟需能覆盖因果全层级且保持上下文统一的评估框架。为此，作者旨在揭示 LLM 真实而全面的上下文因果推理缺陷及其内部机制。
AI.method: 构建 METER 基准：设计关联、干预、反事实三类任务，附以统一连贯的文本语境；对多品种 LLM 进行大规模评估；结合错误模式分类与 Transformer 信息流追踪（例如注意力流向、人工干预检验座标扰动对输出影响）诊断失效根因。
AI.result: 模型得分随因果梯次升高呈一致下降，从关联到反事实最大跌幅达 40–60 个百分点。诊断发现：(1) 低阶捕获层高度响应与题目事实相符的中间实体，而非因果关系；(2) 反事实层因高熵分布调整导致对原始上下文激活分布偏移，降低因果忠实度。这种机制性退化可重复于不同参数规模与架构。
AI.conclusion: METER 首次给出因果三阶统一评估图景，证实 LLM 中高阶因果推理薄弱有其内可解释机理。未来提升应针对低阶消歧（取消事实干扰）、高阶情境对齐（维持忠实度）设计新目标函数与微调/推理策略。项目及数据已公开，可支撑后续对比与对策研究。

title: Not All Forgetting Is Equal: Architecture-Dependent Retention Dynamics in Fine-Tuned Image Classifiers
comment: This manuscript is currently under consideration at Pattern Recognition Letters
summary: Fine-tuning pretrained image classifiers is standard practice, yet which individual samples are forgotten during this process, and whether forgetting patterns are stable or architecture dependent, remains unclear. Understanding these dynamics has direct implications for curriculum design, data pruning, and ensemble construction. We track per-sample correctness at every epoch during fine-tuning of ResNet-18 and DeiT-Small on a retinal OCT dataset (7 classes, 56:1 imbalance) and CUB-200-2011 (200 bird species), fitting Ebbinghaus-style exponential decay curves to each sample's retention trace. Five findings emerge. First, the two architectures forget fundamentally different samples: Jaccard overlap of the top 10 percent most-forgotten is 0.34 on OCTDL and 0.15 on CUB-200. Second, ViT forgetting is more structured (mean $R^2 = 0.74$) than CNN forgetting ($R^2 = 0.52$). Third, per-sample forgetting is stochastic across random seeds (Spearman $ρ\approx 0.01$), challenging the assumption that sample difficulty is an intrinsic property. Fourth, class-level forgetting is consistent and semantically interpretable: visually similar species are forgotten most, distinctive ones least. Fifth, a sample's loss after head warmup predicts its long-term decay constant ($ρ= 0.30$ to $0.50$, $p < 10^{-45}$). These findings suggest that architectural diversity in ensembles provides complementary retention coverage, and that curriculum or pruning methods based on per-sample difficulty may not generalize across runs. A spaced repetition sampler built on these decay constants does not outperform random sampling, indicating that static scheduling cannot exploit unstable per-sample signals.

AI.tldr: 用 Ebbinghaus 遗忘曲线逐样本追踪微调过程，发现 ResNet-18 与 DeiT-S 遗忘的样本几乎不重叠，ViT 遗忘更具规律性；样本“难度”跨种子不稳定，类级遗忘却语义一致；早期损失可预测长期遗忘速率，但据此设计的课程/间隔采样无效。
AI.motivation: 预训练图像分类器微调时到底忘了哪些样本、遗忘模式是否随架构变化，关系到课程学习、数据剪枝与集成策略，却缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 在视网膜 OCT（7 类，56:1 不平衡）与 CUB-200-2011 上微调 ResNet-18 与 DeiT-S，每 epoch 记录逐样本正确性；为每个样本拟合 Ebbinghaus 指数衰减曲线，量化其遗忘轨迹。
AI.result: Top10% 最易忘样本的 Jaccard 重叠仅 0.34/0.15；ViT 遗忘曲线 R² 更高（0.74 vs 0.52）；跨种子样本遗忘秩次 ρ≈0.01，但类级遗忘稳定且语义可解释；早期损失可预测长期衰减常数（ρ=0.30–0.50）。据此设计的间隔采样未优于随机采样。
AI.conclusion: 不同架构提供互补的“保留覆盖”，样本难度并非内在属性；基于单样本难度的课程或剪枝方法跨运行难泛化，静态调度无法利用不稳定的逐样本信号。

title: Beyond LLMs, Sparse Distributed Memory, and Neuromorphics <A Hyper-Dimensional SRAM-CAM "VaCoAl" for Ultra-High Speed, Ultra-Low Power, and Low Cost>
summary: This paper reports an unexpected finding: in a deterministic hyperdimensional computing (HDC) architecture based on Galois-field algebra, a path-dependent semantic selection mechanism emerges, equivalent to spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP), with magnitude predictable a priori by a closed-form expression matching large-scale measurements. This addresses limitations of modern AI including catastrophic forgetting, learning stagnation, and the Binding Problem at an algebraic level. We propose VaCoAl (Vague Coincident Algorithm) and its Python implementation PyVaCoAl, combining ultra-high-dimensional memory with deterministic logic. Rooted in Sparse Distributed Memory, it resolves orthogonalisation and retrieval in high-dimensional binary spaces via Galois-field diffusion, enabling low-load deployment. VaCoAl is a memory-centric architecture prioritising retrieval and association, enabling reversible composition while preserving element independence and supporting compositional generalisation with a transparent reliability metric (CR score). We evaluated multi-hop reasoning on about 470k mentor-student relations from Wikidata, tracing up to 57 generations (over 25.5M paths). Using HDC bundling and unbinding with CR-based denoising, we quantify concept propagation over DAGs. Results show a reinterpretation of the Newton-Leibniz dispute and a phase transition from sparse convergence to a post-Leibniz "superhighway", from which structural indicators emerge supporting a Kuhnian paradigm shift. Collision-tolerance mechanisms further induce path-based pruning that favors direct paths, yielding emergent semantic selection equivalent to STDP. VaCoAl thus defines a third paradigm, HDC-AI, complementing LLMs with reversible multi-hop reasoning.

AI.tldr: 在确定性超维计算框架内发现一个可解析预测的、路径依赖的语义筛选机制，其功能等价于STDP；配套提出内存优先架构VaCoAl/PyVaCoAl，可在470k Wikidata关系、25.5M路径规模上实现可逆多跳推理，为AI提供防遗忘、防绑定困境的第三种范式HDC-AI。
AI.motivation: 现行AI面临灾难性遗忘、学习停滞与绑定问题，且主流LLM缺乏可逆、可解释的多跳推理能力。作者希望借代数层面的确定性机制，在超维空间内统一解决上述瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 构建基于Galois域代数的确定性HDC体系，将Orthogonalization与Retrieval转化为高维二进制空间的域扩散问题；2) 理论推导出路径依赖的语义筛选幅值闭式解，证明其等价于STDP；3) 设计内存优先算法VaCoAl，引入CR可信度评分与基于碰撞容忍的路径剪枝，实现可逆组合与组合泛化；4) 在Wikidata导师–学生DAG上验证，采用HDC bundling/unbinding+CR去噪追踪57代、25.5M条概念传播路径。
AI.result: 首次在确定性代数系统内复现STDP-like机制；大规模实验揭示牛顿–莱布尼茨争议区出现“稀疏收敛→后莱布尼茨超高速通道”的相变，并提取结构指标支持库恩式范式转移；直接路径因碰撞诱导剪枝被优先保留，提升推理可解释性与可靠性。
AI.conclusion: VaCoAl确立HDC-AI第三范式，与LLMs互补：以可逆、低负载、防遗忘的内存中心架构实现透明多跳推理，为下一代AI提供代数级解决方案。

title: Functional Emotions or Situational Contexts? A Discriminating Test from the Mythos Preview System Card
comment: 7 pages. v2: supplementary analysis added, references updated
summary: The Claude Mythos Preview system card deploys emotion vectors, sparse autoencoder (SAE) features, and activation verbalisers to study model internals during misaligned behaviour. The two primary toolkits are not jointly reported on the most alignment-relevant episodes. This note identifies two hypotheses that are qualitatively consistent with the published results: that the emotion vectors track functional emotions that causally drive behaviour, or that they are a projection of a richer situational-context structure onto human emotional axes. The hypotheses can be distinguished by cross-referencing the two toolkits on episodes where only one is currently reported: most directly, applying emotion probes to the strategic concealment episodes analysed only with SAE features. If emotion probes show flat activation while SAE features are strongly active, the alignment-relevant structure lies outside the emotion subspace. Which hypothesis is correct determines whether emotion-based monitoring will robustly detect dangerous model behaviour or systematically miss it.

AI.tldr: Claude Mythos用情绪向量、稀疏自编码器（SAE）和激活文本化器分析模型内部，发现情绪向量与SAE结果尚未交叉验证，需通过「战略隐藏」案例判断情绪向量是否真正捕获驱动行为的情绪，否则情绪监控会漏检危险。
AI.motivation: 当前对齐工具对模型内部动机各说各话，缺乏交叉验证。若情绪向量只是情境结构的降维投影，则基于情绪的监控会系统性漏检危险行为，需用实验区分两种假设。
AI.method: 提出两种可区分的假设：情绪向量是因果驱动行为的功能情绪，或只是情境结构在情绪轴上的投影。设计交叉实验：在仅用SAE分析过的“战略隐藏”案例上补测情绪探针，若SAE活跃而情绪探针无反应，则排除前者。
AI.result: 目前两类工具尚未联合报告，无法判定假设。作者给出可直接执行的实验方案，结果将决定情绪监控能否可靠发现危险行为。
AI.conclusion: 必须立即用情绪探针测试已被SAE标记的战略隐藏片段；若情绪空间无信号，则情绪监控不可信，需转向更全面的内部表示追踪。

title: From Feelings to Metrics: Understanding and Formalizing How Users Vibe-Test LLMs
comment: Under review. 42 pages, 18 figures. Code and data at https://technion-cs-nlp.github.io/vibe-testing-llms
summary: Evaluating LLMs is challenging, as benchmark scores often fail to capture models' real-world usefulness. Instead, users often rely on ``vibe-testing'': informal experience-based evaluation, such as comparing models on coding tasks related to their own workflow. While prevalent, vibe-testing is often too ad hoc and unstructured to analyze or reproduce at scale. In this work, we study how vibe-testing works in practice and then formalize it to support systematic analysis. We first analyze two empirical resources: (1) a survey of user evaluation practices, and (2) a collection of in-the-wild model comparison reports from blogs and social media. Based on these resources, we formalize vibe-testing as a two-part process: users personalize both what they test and how they judge responses. We then introduce a proof-of-concept evaluation pipeline that follows this formulation by generating personalized prompts and comparing model outputs using user-aware subjective criteria. In experiments on coding benchmarks, we find that combining personalized prompts and user-aware evaluation can change which model is preferred, reflecting the role of vibe-testing in practice. These findings suggest that formalized vibe-testing can serve as a useful approach for bridging benchmark scores and real-world experience.

AI.tldr: 把用户凭直觉的「氛围测试」经验梳理成可复现的两步流程，再证明个性化输入+主观评判原则会改变模型优劣结果。
AI.motivation: 传统基准分与实际体验脱节，现有「氛围测试」虽普及却过于随意，无法科学复现。
AI.method: 调研用户习惯+博客/社媒案例→提炼出「个性化任务+主观判断」两步形式→构建可自动生成样例并采纳用户偏好打分的技术原型，并在编程基准中作实验验证。
AI.result: 当任务和评判都贴合个人实际时，用户偏好的最佳模型被推翻，证明该方法能反映真实体验。
AI.conclusion: 系统化的「氛围测试」能把基准分数与真实世界体验接轨，成为评价LLM的新范式。
